items.title: Country Beer Duck
items.core: Duck meat is stewed with beer. The soup is rich, the meat is fragrant and soft, and it also has a faint fragrance of beer. It is a home-cooked dish with a unique flavor. Duck meat itself is nutritious and rich in protein, B vitamins and various minerals. It becomes more delicious after being stewed with beer. Although this recipe has a few steps, it is not complicated and can be completed by beginners in about 1 hour.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Duck meat - Beer - A wok over 32 cm (the pan is too small to stir-fry) - Green pepper - Red pepper - Garlic - Ginger - Millet pepper - Garlic sprouts - Green onion - Grass fruit - Cinnamon - Star anise - Bay leaves - Dried chili pepper

Calculation: - duck meat (half, 1 kg, let the market owner chop it into small pieces) - 1000 ml beer (you can buy two bottles of 500 ml canned beer) - 2 green peppers, 1 red pepper (length between 10 cm and 15 cm is acceptable) (cut into sections or slices, 2 cm sections) Accessories: - 4 garlic, smashed and set aside - 3 ginger cm long, break up and set aside - 3 pieces of spicy millet, cut into two sections (you can omit it if you don’t like spicy food) - 2 garlic sprouts, cut into sections and set aside

Operation: Blanch the duck meat to remove the fishy smell and blood: 1. Wash the duck meat and put it into the pot 2. Add water to submerge the duck meat 3. Add 20 ml of cooking wine 4. Add the spare 1 green onion 5. Add ginger, beaten into pieces 2 cm 6. Bring to a boil 7. Remove the foam 8. Remove the duck meat, wash it with water and set aside. Start cooking: 1. Clean the pot and heat it up, add 60ml of peanut oil 2. When the oil temperature reaches 60 degrees, add a handful of Sichuan peppercorns (30) 3. Add duck meat and stir-fry for 4 minutes - add all spices after 2 minutes - add all ingredients (ginger, garlic, millet spicy) at 3 minutes 4. Add 1000 ml of beer 5. Roast duck meat for 30 minutes - add at 10 minutes Salt (3g) Light soy sauce (10 ml) Dark soy sauce (5 ml) - 20 minutes Add all the auxiliary ingredients (green pepper and red pepper segments) - 29 minutes Add garlic sprouts and green onions - Stir fry for 1 minute 6. Take out of the pot

Additional content: - During operation, you need to pay attention to the boiling water level. If you find that the ingredients are lower than 2/3, you should heat water or add beer. - Chef: The "Country Beer Duck" is cooked in an earthen stove, and the taste is so comfortable that it can't be overstated
Blanch the duck pieces in a pot with cold water and add ginger slices, skim off the foam and then stew. The soup will be clearer and less fishy.
First add 80% of the beer to cover the duck meat, simmer over low heat for half an hour, then add a little to reduce the juice, and the malt aroma will be more obvious.
Add salt and green garlic before cooking to prevent the duck meat from becoming tight after stewing for a long time, and to retain the fragrance and freshness.

Case: Two friends came to the house over the weekend. I blanched the duck pieces and simmered them with ginger, garlic, and beer for 40 minutes, and finally used high heat to reduce the juice. When it was served, the duck meat was soft and tender with the aroma of wheat. My friend mixed the rice with the soup and scraped the bottom of the pot clean.

items.id: 农家一碗香-农家一碗香
items.title: A bowl of farmhouse fragrance
items.core: This is a Hunan home-style stir-fry with a salty aroma that goes well with rice. The oiliness of the pork belly, the tenderness of the eggs, and the fragrance of green peppers blend together, creating a rich texture. Pork and eggs provide high-quality protein, and green peppers supplement vitamin C for a balanced nutrition. It is of medium difficulty. You need to pay attention to the stir-frying heat and the order of seasoning. Novices can do it well with a little practice. Expect 7 minutes of prep time and 10 minutes of cooking time, for a total of about 17 minutes to be ready.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: + Pork (pork belly is recommended) + Green pepper + Garlic slices + Doubanjiang + Soy sauce + Millet pepper + White sugar + Ginger slices

Calculation: You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. One serving here is enough for 1-2 people. + 250g pork + 3 green peppers + 2 garlic slices + 10g bean paste + 1 millet pepper + 5g sugar + 15ml soy sauce + 2 slices ginger

Operation: 1. Preparation stage: Slice the pork, preferably separating the fat and thin. At the same time, cut the green pepper and millet into sections, smash the garlic slices into mince with the back of a knife, and cut the ginger into shreds. Crack the eggs into a small bowl and beat with chopsticks. 2. After preparing the dishes, you can start cooking. Pour the oil into the pot first, turn on a low heat in the pot, pour the egg liquid into the pot after the oil is hot, stir-fry the eggs until they are broken, and put them back into a small bowl for later use. 3. Add a little more oil to the pot, turn on low heat, and when the pot is hot, pour the previously cut fatty pork into the pot to squeeze out the lard. 4. When the fat meat turns golden brown, increase the heat to medium, add the lean meat together in the pot and stir-fry. 5. When all the lean meat is fried, add the prepared shredded ginger, minced garlic and bean paste and stir-fry evenly to color the pork. 6. Add green and red peppers, fried eggs until they are broken, add soy sauce and sugar, continue to stir-fry them until the green peppers are slightly broken, and keep the crisp taste of the green peppers. 7. Take out the pan and serve!
Additional content: + If you put too much oil when frying the eggs for the first time, you can skip the oil when frying the pork. + References in the Kitchen
Cut the pork belly into thin slices, stir-fry the oil in a dry pan over low heat, stir-fry until the edges are slightly curled, and then add the green pepper for a more fragrant aroma.

Add a little salt and water to the eggs and beat them up. When the oil is hot, they will spread quickly. Take them out when they are medium-cooked and then return them to the pot until they are tender.
For seasoning, pour light soy sauce and a little dark soy sauce along the edge of the pot. Add tempeh first and then green pepper. The saltiness will be even and not bitter.

Case: When I got home from get off work, there were only pork belly, eggs and two green peppers left in the refrigerator. I sliced ​​the meat and stir-fried it with eggs, and then seasoned it. Fifteen minutes later, it was put on the plate, and my husband cooked two bowls of rice in a row, saying that it was more filling than taking out.

items.title: Winter Melon Sauna Chicken
items.core: Winter Melon Sauna Chicken is a refreshing steamed dish. Winter melon is at the bottom to soak up the chicken juice, Cordyceps flowers are fresh, and the chicken is tender and smooth. It is steamed with steam. It is low in calories, has enough protein, and is simple to make. It takes about 35 minutes from preparation to serving, making it suitable for daily home cooking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Chicken - Shredded ginger - Light soy sauce - Oyster sauce - Salt - Cooking oil - Winter melon - Cordyceps flowers

Calculation: per serving (one serving is just enough for 2 people): - 400 g chicken (cut into pieces) - 300 g winter melon (cut into thin slices) - 30 g cordyceps flowers (rinse and soak in advance) - 10 g shredded ginger - 15 ml light soy sauce - Oyster sauce 10 g - Salt 3 g - Edible oil 10 ml

Operation: 1. Cut the chicken into pieces, add shredded ginger, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt, and cooking oil, knead evenly and marinate for 20 minutes. 2. Cut the winter melon into thin slices and place them on the bottom of the plate. 3. Spread another layer of soaked Cordyceps flowers. 4. Spread the marinated chicken on top of the Cordyceps flowers. 5. After the water is boiled, put it into a steamer and steam it. 15 minutes, ready to serve

Additional content: - Cut the winter melon into thin slices and lay them on the bottom to make it easier to steam and absorb the flavor of the chicken soup. - Rinse and soak the cordyceps flowers in advance and spread them between the winter melon and chicken to allow the delicious flavor to permeate up and down
Cut the winter melon into 1cm thick slices and lay them on the base. It can prevent sticking and catch the chicken juice. It will not turn into paste after steaming.
Chicken leg meat is more tender than chicken breast. Add a little starch and oil when marinating to lock in moisture and not burn any wood after steaming.
After the water boils, add it to the pot, steam over medium-high heat for fifteen to eighteen minutes, turn off the heat and simmer for two minutes to make the meat more tender.

Case: I don’t want to stir-fry for a long time in the dog days of summer, so I put thick slices of winter melon on the bottom, marinate the chicken legs with cordyceps flowers and shredded ginger for ten minutes and then steam them. It took eighteen minutes to cook. The winter melon soaked up the chicken juice, and the child even scooped up the soup to mix with the rice.

items.title: Winter Melon Stuffed Pork
items.core: Winter Melon Stuffed Pork is a home-style steamed dish that combines meat and vegetables. It tastes fresh and smooth. The salty aroma of the meat filling and the sweetness of the winter melon blend together, making it refreshing and not greasy. Minced pork provides high-quality protein and essential amino acids, while winter melon helps clear away heat, diuresis and replenish water. The method is simple, even a novice can easily get started, just need to practice the meat rolling skills a little. From preparation to serving, it takes about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Winter melon - Minced pork - Egg - Green onion - Minced green onion and ginger - Pepper - Light soy sauce - Starch

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each portion: - 300g minced pork - 1 egg (optional, it may be a little fishy for those who are not used to it) - 200g winter melon - chopped green onion (about 20g) - 5g pepper - 10ml light soy sauce - 5g starch - 25g water starch (25g starch, 50ml water) - minced green onion and ginger (3-4 pieces of ginger, about 30g, Take the white part of the chopped green onion above) - Salt 20g

Operation: 1. Peel the winter melon and cut into 25cm long and 3cm thick slices 2. Put the cut winter melon into a bowl, add 15g of salt, spread the winter melon evenly and leave it for 10 minutes 3. While placing the winter melon, change a bowl and add minced meat, minced onion and ginger, 5g salt, 5g starch, pepper, light soy sauce, pepper 4. Use chopsticks to stir the minced meat clockwise until there is no obvious contrast in the color of the ingredients (about 2 minutes) 5. Wash the pickled winter melon (it will become soft) three times with clean water 6. Take out 1 piece of winter melon, roll it up, and stuff the meat inside 7. Put it in a plate and place it to the edge of the plate 8. Beat 1 egg into the middle circle 9. Put the water in an ordinary iron pot and steam it 15 Minutes, cover the pot. 10. Open the lid and take out the steamed winter melon stuffed meat. 11. Pour the water from the winter melon stuffed meat dish into the pot, add water starch, add 50ml of water, pour into the pot and bring to a boil. 12. Pour over the winter melon stuffed meat
Additional content: - During operation, when taking out the winter melon stuffed meat, be aware that the dish is very hot, so operate with caution. - Reference: B station video
Cut the winter melon with a razor blade but don’t cut off the bottom. The meat stuffing should be about 70% full so it won’t fall off easily during steaming.
Add minced pork to onion and ginger water and stir clockwise until it becomes sticky, then mix in a little starch and steam it to become more elastic and tender.
A small amount of winter melon slices or oil-absorbing paper can be placed on the bottom of the plate to prevent the steamed water from soaking the bottom of the meat filling.

Case: The old man in my family has bad teeth, so I cut the winter melon into thick slices, stuffed it with prepared minced pork and steamed it on a plate. When it comes out of the pot, the melon slices are translucent and the meat filling is fresh and tender. The old man said it is refreshing and not greasy, making it more suitable for dinner than braised pork.

items.title: cold rabbit
items.core: This is a classic Sichuan Zigong salt dish, spicy and dry, the rabbit meat is firm and chewy, spicy at first and then fresh in the mouth, with a long aftertaste. Rabbit meat is high in protein and low in fat, rich in lecithin and a variety of amino acids, rich in nutrients and easy to digest. The production process requires handling a variety of spices and strictly controlling the heat, which is a challenge for novices. It takes about 1.5 hours from preparation to stir-frying, but the flavor is better after it's been left overnight, so it's worth preparing ahead of time.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Rabbit meat - Salt - MSG - Oyster sauce - Cooking wine - Garlic - Ginger - Shallots/scallions/onions - Dried chilies - Green peppercorns - Star anise - Cinnamon - Bay leaves - Kaempferol - White cardamom - Cumin - White sesame

Calculation: - Amount of salt = number of pounds of rabbit meat * 2 grams - Amount of MSG = number of pounds of rabbit meat * 1 Grams - The amount of oyster sauce = the number of pounds of rabbit meat * 5 grams - The amount of cooking wine = the number of pounds of rabbit meat * 10 grams - The amount of oil = the number of pounds of rabbit meat * 0.9 ~ 1 liter - The amount of garlic = the number of pounds of rabbit meat * 1/2 a head of garlic - The amount of ginger = the amount of garlic - The total amount of shallots/green onions/onions = the number of pounds of rabbit meat * 15 grams - The amount of dried chili = The total volume of the pepper segments is equal to the total volume of the rabbit meat - Amount of green pepper = 3 kilograms of rabbit meat corresponding to a small bowl for eating, a whole bowl of pepper - Amount of star anise = kilograms of rabbit meat * 1 piece - Amount of cinnamon = kilograms of rabbit meat * a thumb-length piece - Amount of bay leaves = kilograms of rabbit meat * 5 slices - Amount of kaempferol = kilograms of rabbit meat * a soybean-sized piece - Amount of white cardamom = kilograms of rabbit meat * 2 Particles - Amount of cumin = number of pounds of rabbit meat * 15 grams - Amount of white sesame seeds = number of pounds of rabbit meat * 25 grams Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials planned to be used.

Operation: 1. Peel and chop garlic and ginger and set aside. Wash star anise, cinnamon, bay leaves, kaempferol, white cardamom and fennel and set aside. 2. Cut the dried chilies into 2 cm pieces, wash and set aside. 3. Wash the shallots/green onions/onions and cut the onions into small pieces. 4. Chop the rabbit meat into 2 cm pieces, season with salt, cooking wine and MSG, and marinate for 15 minutes. 5. Pour oil into the pot, heat the oil to 40%, stir-fry the shallots/green onions/onions over medium-low heat until fragrant, wait until the shallots/green onions/onions are slightly charred, then take them out. 6. Turn on high heat and increase the oil temperature. When the oil temperature is 80% hot, add the rabbit meat. During the frying process, turn to medium-low heat and fry until the rabbit meat is slightly browned. Remove the rabbit meat. 7. Increase the oil temperature, add dried chilies, green peppercorns, star anise, cinnamon, bay leaves, kaempferol, white cardamom and cumin; turn to low heat and fry the chili segments until crispy. 8. Add rabbit meat again, add oyster sauce and stir-fry for a few minutes. 9. Turn off the heat, add garlic, ginger and white sesame seeds, stir-fry evenly. 10. Leave it overnight to enhance the flavor.

Additional content: In step 6 of the operation, please pay attention: the amount of oil should submerge the rabbit meat. If it is not submerged, it needs to be replenished in time. Please note in the 7th step of the operation: the peppers are very easy to fry and the batter will turn black. This process is very fast, so the heat must be low, and basically wait until not much water vapor evaporates, then you can add the rabbit meat.
Soak the rabbit meat in cold water for twenty minutes to remove the blood, then blanch it and dry it, and then stir-fry it so that it is not fishy or watery.
Slowly sauté the dried chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns over low heat until fragrant. When the color becomes darker, add the rabbit meat to avoid turning black and bitter.
To collect the juice, stir-fry until the soup almost coats the shredded pork. Turn off the heat and sprinkle with pepper powder and cooked sesame seeds to make the aroma more prominent.

Case: A friend brought rabbit meat back from Zigong. I followed the instructions of Yanbang Cai, blanched it, stir-fried it until brown, then added dried chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns and stir-fried over low heat. Let it cool overnight and then pack it into a box and take it to the camp. Everyone chews it while chatting, and the more it tastes, the more delicious it becomes.

items.title: Cold shredded chicken
items.core: A home-cooked cold dish with less oil and calories. The shredded chicken is tender and delicious. The sesame oil and balsamic vinegar blend to create a slightly numb and slightly sour refreshing taste, suitable for relieving greasiness in summer. Chicken breast is rich in high-quality protein and low in fat. The recipe is simple and can be easily started by novices, and it only takes about 30 minutes from preparation to completion.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Chicken breast (can be frozen at room temperature) - Sesame oil (Panthoxylum bungeanum) - Light soy sauce - Balsamic vinegar - Sugar - Salt - Cooking wine - Ginger - Cold boiled water
Calculation: per serving: - 200 grams of chicken breast - 5 ml of sesame oil - 4 ml of light soy sauce - 4 ml of balsamic vinegar - 3 grams of sugar - 2 grams of salt - 20 grams of ginger

Operation: 1. Slice ginger and set aside 2. Pour 4 liters of water into the pot 3. Add chicken breasts and ginger slices 4. Pour in 20 ml of cooking wine 5. Boil the water over high heat without covering 6. After the water boils, turn to medium heat and use a spoon to remove the foam 7. Continue to cook for 5-7 minutes. If it is non-frozen meat, cook for 5 minutes, and for frozen meat, cook for 7 minutes. 8. The size of the chicken breast will affect the ripening time. Use chopsticks to insert the chicken breast. If it can be inserted easily, it means the chicken is cooked. If it is not cooked, you need to extend the cooking time. 9. Soak the chicken breast in cold boiled water and bring the chicken breast to room temperature. 10. Tear the chicken breast into thin shreds along the texture of the chicken breast. 11. Prepare a bowl. 12. Add the prepared sesame oil, light soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, sugar, and salt to the bowl. 13. Stir the sauce to dissolve the sugar and salt as much as possible. 14. Pour the sauce into the shredded chicken and stir evenly

Additional content: - This dish is made with existing materials during the quarantine period. If possible, you can add coriander, green onions, etc. for seasoning. If you like spicy food, you can add chili oil
Put chicken breasts in a pot under cold water, add ginger slices and cooking wine, boil the water slightly and simmer for eight minutes and then simmer for five minutes to make the meat more tender.
Put the cooked chicken breasts immediately in ice water or cold boiled water to cool them. After the fibers are tightened, it will be easier to tear them into even thin shreds.
Mix the sauce with a ratio of 2 parts vinegar, 1 part light soy sauce and 50% sesame oil. Let the minced garlic sit for five minutes before mixing so that the flavors are more integrated.

Case: I don’t have an appetite for lunch in the summer, so I cooked the chicken breast in advance, shredded it into thin shreds and mixed it with minced garlic, balsamic vinegar and a small amount of sesame oil. Place it in the refrigerator for fifteen minutes before eating. It is sour and refreshing. It can be eaten in one meal with cucumber shreds.

items.title: Braised vegetables
items.core: This is a classic Chinese braised food. The meat is tender and tasty, with a rich aroma. The marinade can be used repeatedly and becomes more fragrant as it ages. It is suitable for cold dishes, wine, or with staple food. The dishes are rich in high-quality protein and multiple vitamins, and are nutritionally balanced. It requires a little patience to make, but the steps are clear and friendly to novices. It takes about 1 hour to soak in blood-removing water, boil sugar color and high-pressure brine. Then soak overnight to allow the flavor to fully penetrate. Take it out and slice it the next day to enjoy.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Marinade package (available in supermarkets) - Soybean paste - Bean paste - Oyster sauce - Southern fermented bean curd - Onion - Ginger - Garlic - Dried chili pepper - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Salt - White sugar (preferably yellow rock sugar, used to boil the sugar color) - Beer - Beef shank (or other meat) - Pressure cooker - Strainer

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving serves about 2-3 people. Each portion: - 1 marinade packet (about 10g) - 15ml soybean paste - 15ml bean paste - oyster sauce 15ml - 15ml fermented bean curd - half onion (about 100g) - 30g ginger - 40g garlic - 10g dried chili - 120ml light soy sauce - 60ml dark soy sauce - salt 10-15g - 30g white sugar (used to cook the sugar color) - 1 can of beer (330ml) - 500g beef tendon - enough water (needs to cover all the meat)

Operation: It is recommended to check the tutorial on stir-frying the sugar color before this 1. Soak the beef tendon in cold water for more than 3 hours in advance to remove the blood. Prepare the brine: 1. Prepare the sugar color: add 30g to the pot Heat the sugar over low heat until the sugar is completely melted and turns brown, add 150ml of hot water, stir well and set aside. 2. Cut the onion into cubes, smash the ginger and garlic, and break the dried chili pepper and set aside. 3. Add enough water to the pot, add the marinade package, onion, ginger, garlic, and dried chili pepper, and bring to a boil over high heat. 4. Add 15ml each of soybean paste, bean paste, oyster sauce, and fermented bean curd, and stir well 5. Pour in the prepared sugar color and mix evenly. 6. Add 120ml of light soy sauce and 60ml of dark soy sauce and mix evenly. 7. Add 10-15g of salt to taste. 8. Pour in 1 can of beer (330ml) and bring to the boil again. Braised beef: 1. Blanch the beef shanks in a pot for 2-3 minutes, remove and rinse the foam on the surface with hot water. 2. Put the blanched beef tendon into the boiled brine, making sure that the brine covers all the meat. 3. Cover the pressure cooker lid, turn on the steam and continue cooking for 25-30 minutes. 4. After cooking is completed, do not open the lid to keep it warm, let it cool naturally and soak it overnight (this will make it more delicious). 5. Take out the braised meat and put it in the refrigerator to refrigerate and let it take shape. 6. Take out the slices before eating. You can eat it directly or cool it. Save the brine: 1. How to reuse the brine: After braising the meat each time, filter the brine to remove all solid contents, boil it again for sterilization, and store it in the refrigerator or freezer after cooling. When using, re-add seasonings according to the original recipe proportions. (The amount of water added depends on the usage of the brine) 2. The brine can be used for a long time if stored properly, and the older it gets, the more fragrant it becomes. 3. Important note: If you are braised vegetarian dishes, you must take another part of the brine and use it separately, and the brine after marinating the vegetable dishes cannot be reused. Cold seasoning: 1. Mix minced garlic, chopped green onion, white sesame and chili powder in a ratio of 1:1:1:1, add spicy millet according to personal taste, add a small amount of sesame oil or cane pepper oil to the hot vegetable oil, pour it on the seasoning in batches, then add 10ml each of light soy sauce, vinegar, oyster sauce, 5ml sugar, MSG/chicken essence, and finally 15ml marinated soup and mix evenly. 2. When served cold, it can be paired with cucumber, fungus, fried peanuts, coriander and other side dishes.
Additional content: - You can use another part of the brine to make beef noodles and use it as the soup base for white water noodles. Add your favorite vegetables to taste. Brine:
Soak the meat in cold water for one hour, changing the water twice in the middle, which can remove the blood and make the brine look cleaner.
When you see the jujube red bubbles in the stir-fried sugar, you will immediately eat it. It will become bitter after the heat is over, so I would rather have a lighter color.
Don’t rush to take it out after marinating. Let it soak in the marinade for more than four hours. The flavor will be more transparent and even after slicing.

Case: On Sunday night, I soaked the pig ears and chicken feet in blood water in advance, fried them until they turned brown, and then marinated them with spices under high pressure for 20 minutes. After turning off the heat, let them soak in the marinade overnight, then slice them into slices and serve them cold the next day. After the neighbors tasted them, they came to ask how to make them.

items.title: Saliva Chicken
items.core: Saliva Chicken is a classic Sichuan cold dish. The chicken wrapped in red oil is cool, spicy, spicy and fragrant. It is appetizing and relieves greasiness when eaten in summer. The chicken is rich in high-quality protein and paired with chopped peanuts and spices to provide energy and flavor. The difficulty of making it is medium. You need to pay attention to the cooking temperature of the chicken and seasoning with red oil. It is suitable for cooks with certain cooking experience. It is expected to take about 1.5 hours from preparing the ingredients, cooking the chicken, cooling it to finishing pouring the sauce.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Half a chicken - Chili powder - Sichuan peppercorns - Peanuts - Onions, ginger and garlic - Sichuan peppercorns - White sugar - Light soy sauce - Vinegar - MSG

Calculation: per serving: - 20ml cooking oil - Half chicken (500g) - Chili powder 20g - 30 Sichuan peppercorns (20g) - 10 peanuts (30g) - 2 green onions (50g) - 1 small piece of ginger (20g) - 2 pieces of garlic (10g) - 5g of sugar - 5ml of light soy sauce - 5ml of vinegar - 5g of monosodium glutamate - 5g of pepper powder - 5g of coriander

Operation: 1. Slice ginger, 1 shallot, 15 peppercorns for later use 2. Wash the chicken, put it into a pot, cover the chicken with water, add ginger slices, shallots and peppercorns, and bring to a boil over high heat. 3. After the fire comes to a boil, reduce the heat to medium-low and turn off the heat for 20 minutes. 4. Take out the chicken and put it in ice water until it is cold. 5. Take out the chicken, cut it into pieces and place it on a plate, set aside. 6. Heat the pot over low heat, add the peanuts, and bake until the skin bursts. (Be careful to flip at any time to avoid burning) 7. Cut a green onion into sections, mince the garlic, 15 Sichuan peppercorns, peel and chop the peanuts. 8. Heat the oil in the pot, add the green onions, Sichuan peppercorns and half of the minced garlic, stir-fry until fragrant. 9. Stir-fry until the oil temperature is 80% hot, turn off the heat and filter out the hot oil. 10. Pour the hot oil into the bowl with the chili powder, stir and filter out the red oil. 11. Add the remaining minced garlic, light soy sauce, vinegar, salt, MSG, sugar, sesame oil and Sichuan peppercorns to the red oil. Mix well and let cool. 12. Sprinkle chopped peanuts on the chicken, pour the red oil on the cut chicken, and sprinkle with coriander. Plate
Additional content: - The second recipe of saliva chicken to be updated -
After the chicken legs are boiled, turn down the heat and simmer for twelve minutes, then turn off the heat and simmer for five minutes. The center will be the most tender when it is just cooked.
Put ice water in ice water for ten minutes immediately after cooking. The skin of the chicken will be firmer and elastic, and it will not be easy to break when cutting into pieces.
Add a little chicken stock to the red oil to boil, then add chopped peanuts and chopped green onions to make the taste more rounded and not spicy.

Case: After dinner at home, I cooked the chicken legs until they were just cooked and then chilled them, then added red oil, pepper powder and crushed peanuts. When it was served, the chicken skin was juicy and the meat was juicy. Everyone said it was spicy and delicious, and they couldn't stop eating it.

items.title: Cola Chicken Wings
items.core: Cola Chicken Wings are bright red in color, tender and smooth, and taste salty and sweet. They are a popular creative dish on the family table. Chicken wings are rich in high-quality protein and fat, and the meat becomes softer after being cooked with cola. The production process requires mastering the heat of frying and collecting juice, which is a challenge for novices, but they can still succeed if they follow the steps. It took about 40 minutes from prep to finish.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Chicken wings * Coke * White sugar * Light soy sauce * Salt * Ginger * Cooking wine or beer * Spring onions

Calculation: According to the portion of 1 plate: * 10 to 12 chicken wings * Coke 500ml * White sugar 10 grams * Light soy sauce 15 grams * Dark soy sauce 3 grams * Salt 2 grams * 2 slices of ginger * Cooking wine 20 ml * Spring onions tied into knots

Operation: 1. Put the chicken wings into the pot, pour in cold water and submerge. Add 1 piece of ginger and 10 to 20 ml of cooking wine. After boiling over high heat (about 2 minutes), skim off the scum and drain out the water. * This step is for chilled chicken wings. You can just marinate the freshly bought chicken wings with a knife and use light soy sauce. 2. Take out the chicken wings and use a knife to make two cuts on each side. Marinate the chicken wings with about 10 grams of light soy sauce for 10 minutes (the light soy sauce can completely coat the surface of the chicken wings and add flavor) 3. Return the oil to low heat in the pot, sauté the remaining ginger slices until fragrant, and then add the marinated chicken wings. Fry the chicken wings until golden brown and flip over (until both sides are golden brown), flip the chicken wings with a cooking spoon, and stir-fry with the ginger slices 4 to 5 times (the purpose is to prevent the chicken wings and ginger slices from sticking). 4. When the chicken wings are golden, pour in cola to cover the chicken wings. Turn up the heat and bring the cola to a boil, then skim off any floating black foam (including blood). At this time add the onion knots. 5. Seasoning: add 2 grams of edible salt, 10 grams of sugar, and 3 grams of light soy sauce (you can use dark soy sauce to adjust the base color, 3 grams). 6. Wait until the onion knots turn yellow, remove them together with the ginger slices, turn to medium heat and continue to slow cook the Coke Chicken Wings. 7. Wait until the cola is in a silky state, then turn down the heat to allow the juice to hang firmly on the chicken wings. Remove from pan and plate.

Additional content: * Adding ginger to saute it will prevent the chicken wings from sticking to the pan. * Do not turn on high heat when collecting the juice at the end to prevent the taste from becoming bitter. *This dish is on the sweet side.
Score the chicken wings twice on both sides and then fry them to heat them more evenly and allow the cola sauce to penetrate into the meat faster.
Pour the cola until 80% of the chicken wings are covered. Stir frequently when the juice is collected. When there are big bubbles on the surface, the sugar will easily stick to the pot.
Only add a few drops of light soy sauce to add saltiness and dark soy sauce for coloring. Turn off the heat immediately after the juice thickens to avoid bitterness.

Case: After school, my child said he wanted to eat sweet chicken wings. I fried the chicken wings on both sides until they were slightly brown, then poured in cola and light soy sauce over low heat to reduce the juice. After more than 20 minutes, the color turned bright red. The child ate four of them in one go and mixed the rice with the sauce at the bottom of the plate.

items.id: 台式卤肉饭-台式卤肉饭
items.title: Taiwanese Braised Pork Rice
items.core: Taiwanese braised pork rice is a fragrant Taiwanese home-cooked dish. The meat strips are soft and glutinous, and the sauce is amber-like and oily. It is poured on the hot rice and is full of fat. Rich in high-quality protein, collagen and carbohydrates, it can quickly replenish energy. The method is very friendly to novices. You only need to prepare the ingredients and control the heat. The whole process can be completed in about 1.5 hours, of which only half an hour is needed for hands-on work, and the rest is left to simmering over low heat.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: - shallots (scallions) - pork belly with skin (can be replaced by minced pork) - eggs (optional) - edible oil - light soy sauce - rice wine (can be replaced by cooking wine) - garlic - bay leaves - star anise - rock sugar - white pepper - five spice powder (optional) - rice

Calculation: You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. The following serves about 2~3 people. - 25 g shallots - 500g pork belly with skin - 4 eggs (the number of eggs can be modified as desired) - 15 ml cooking oil - 75 ml light soy sauce - 10 + 25 ml rice wine - 25 g garlic - 2 bay leaves - 1 star anise - 20 g rock sugar - 6 g white pepper - 6 g allspice - rice (Depending on personal appetite)

Operation: 1. Cut the skin-on pork belly into thin strips of $0.7cm (length) \times 0.7cm (width) \times 2.5cm (height) $ 2. Mince the shallots and garlic and set aside. 3. Boil the eggs and peel them, and use a knife to cut the egg whites (for easier flavor) and set aside. 4. Heat the pot over high heat, put 15 ml of cooking oil in the pot, and let the oil cover the bottom of the pot. - The purpose of adding oil is to prevent the pork belly from sticking to the pan when it is first taken out of the pan. Wait 5 seconds for the oil temperature to rise slightly. 5. Add the pork belly strips and stir-fry until the color of the meat turns slightly white. Pour 10ml of rice wine along the edge of the pot. Continue to stir-fry until the pork belly is no longer oily. 6. Add the chopped shallots to the pot and stir-fry for 1 minute to release the aroma of the shallots. 7. Add the sliced ​​shallots to the pan and stir-fry for 30 seconds. 8. Push the pork to the side, add rock sugar and heat until it melts and bubbles into caramel, then stir the pork together so that the caramel adheres evenly. 9. Add light soy sauce and stir-fry until fragrant. 10. Add 25 ml of rice wine, add water until the pork is covered, add white pepper, five-spice powder, star anise, bay leaves and hard-boiled eggs. After boiling, reduce the heat to simmer for 1 hour. - Note: Different soy sauces have different saltiness. Be sure to test the taste when marinating. If it is too sweet, add soy sauce. If it is too salty, add some sugar or water to adjust. - While simmering over low heat, stir and check every 15 minutes to prevent sticking to the pan. - If it is found to be too dry, add 100ml of water and continue stewing. 11. After 1 hour, turn up the heat and reduce the sauce until it thickens and takes on a glossy amber color, it is done. 12. After the stew is finished, take a bowl of rice, pour the soft braised pork on the rice, add the braised eggs, and enjoy.

Additional content: - For the step of cutting pork belly into strips, definition: Place the pork belly with the skin side up on the table. At this time, the plane where the skin is located is the plane formed by the length and width, and the plane perpendicular to this plane is the height. The final effect of the meat strips is slender strips with alternating fat and thin strips. (Note: The meat strips must be thin here, that is, smaller in length and width. Thin meat strips are easier to stew and become soft and glutinous). - Tips for cutting pork belly into strips: - If the pork belly is not frozen, you can put it in the freezer of the refrigerator for 30 minutes before taking it out and cutting it into strips. - If it is frozen pork belly, you can leave it at room temperature for 30 minutes before cutting into strips. - When cutting into strips, you can quickly rub the knife blade against the meat with less force, which makes it easier to cut and protect the fat and lean structure of the pork belly.
Cut the pork belly into small cubes and stir-fry until slightly charred. Pour out excess fat. The marinade will be fragrant but not greasy.
Saute the shredded onions until golden and then add the diced meat. The sweetness will naturally be released, making it softer than relying on sugar alone.
Stew the braised pork until the meat strips are soft and glutinous, then open the lid to collect the juice for three minutes. The soup can catch the rice and make the bibimbap more fragrant.

Case: I didn’t want to go out to buy rice on a rainy day, so I fried diced pork belly until the oil was released, added onions, mushrooms and soy sauce and simmered it for an hour. Pour it over hot rice and serve it with braised eggs. After finishing it, my husband said it was like the bowl at a night market restaurant, with no sauce left.

items.title: Gourd and Sour Pork
items.core: Sweet and Sour Pork is a classic Cantonese home-cooked dish. It is sour and sweet, appetizing, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The fruity aroma of pineapple makes the meat taste particularly refreshing and relieves greasiness. Pork provides high-quality protein, while green peppers and pineapples supplement vitamins and dietary fiber. The difficulty of this dish is to control the heat of the fried meat, which is a bit challenging for novices, but as long as you follow the steps, you can succeed. From marinating to serving, the whole process takes about 40 minutes, making it a perfect dish for the family as a quick meal.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: - Plum pork - Green pepper - Canned pineapple slices - Salt - Tomato juice - White vinegar - Minced garlic - Light soy sauce - Cornstarch - White sugar

Calculation: per serving: - 1 tablespoon = 15ml - 1 teaspoon = 5ml - Plum pork 100g - Green pepper 25g - Canned pineapple slices 75g - Salt 1/4 teaspoon - 4 tbsp tomato juice - 2 tsp white vinegar - 1 tbsp minced garlic - 1/2 tsp light soy sauce - 2 1/2 tsp cornstarch - 2 tbsp sugar - 200 ml water

Operation: 1. Wash the plum pork (100 g), then wipe dry with kitchen paper, and cut the pork into pieces smaller than the desired finished product. 2. Marinate the plum pork with salt (1/2 teaspoon) for 20 minutes. 3. Chop green peppers (25 g). 4. Cut pineapple slices (75g) into pieces. 5. Add tomato juice (4 tbsp), white vinegar (2 tsp), minced garlic (1 tbsp), light soy sauce (½ tsp), cornstarch (2½ tsp), sugar (2 tbsp), salt (¼ tsp) and water (200 ml) in a bowl, mix well to form a sauce. 6. Dip the plum pork cubes into cornstarch (6 tablespoons). 7. Add oil (500 ml) and heat over medium heat. 8. Put the plum pork cubes into the pot and fry over medium heat for 5 minutes, then remove. 9. Add plum pork cubes and fry over high heat for 1 minute. 10. Add oil (1 tsp) and sauce and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes. 11. Add green pepper and pineapple and cook over high heat for 2 minutes. 12. Mix the fried plum pork cubes with the sauce evenly.
Additional content: - If you want the meat to be more layered, you can add eggs to the cornstarch, and it will be crispier when fried
The tenderloin is marinated for ten minutes and then wrapped in dry starch. The starch should be compacted on the surface and the shell should be evenly crisped after frying.
Dry it over medium heat for the first time, then fry it for 20 seconds over high heat the second time. The shell will be crispier and the meat juice will not be lost easily.
The sweet and sour sauce is prepared in advance. After the pot is hot, stir it quickly and serve. Add the pineapple later to maintain the fragrance and crispness.

Case: My children’s classmates came to my house for dinner on the weekend. I marinated the tenderloin, coated it in flour and fried it again. Then I quickly mixed it with pineapple, green pepper and sweet and sour sauce. The skin was still crispy when it came to the table. The children sandwiched the pineapple and meat pieces, and soon the dishes were ready.

items.title: Curry Beef
items.core: Curry Beef is a rich home-cooked dish that goes well with rice. The spice of curry blends with the fat of beef, and is paired with potatoes, carrots and other vegetables, giving it a soft and mellow taste. Rich in protein, vitamins and calcium, with a balanced mix of meat and vegetables. It's easy to make, beginner-friendly, and typically has on the table in just 40 minutes, making it a great lunchbox dish.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Bay leaves - Pure milk (Weigang fresh milk is recommended) - Onions - Carrots - Potatoes - Fatty beef rolls - Curry cubes

Calculation: You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each portion: - 1 bay leaf - 50ml pure milk - 100g onion - 150g carrot - 200g potato (very filling, add as appropriate) - 300g beef roll (more if you like meat) - 2 curry cubes (about 100g)

Operation: 1. Cut the onion into strips, cut the carrot and potato into chunks, set aside 2. Boil a pot of water. When the water boils, roll the fat beef into the pot, remove the blood foam and set aside to drain. 3. Heat the pot and put 10ml - 15ml cooking oil in the pot. Wait 10 seconds for the oil temperature to rise. 4. Add the onions and stir-fry until the onions become soft and transparent. 5. Add the potatoes and carrots and stir-fry for 2 minutes. 6. Add cold water until all ingredients are submerged. 7. Put bay leaves and curry cubes into the pot, cover the pot, wait until the water boils, then reduce the heat and wait until the potato and carrot cubes are stewed until soft (use chopsticks to confirm) 8. Add the beef rolls and milk, cover the pot and simmer over low heat for 2-3 minutes before serving (stir the ingredients with a spoon and pay attention to avoid the fat beef rolls breaking)

Additional content: - There is no need to mash the curry cubes, just add them in whole pieces. - When operating, you need to pay attention to stirring the ingredients to avoid uneven ingredients and seasonings.
Cut the potatoes and carrots into 1cm pieces and boil them until soft before adding the curry. This can shorten the time and make it easier to taste.
Turn down the heat and add the curry cubes. Stir and cook until melted to avoid burning and clumping.
The fat beef rolls are put into the pot last. Once they change color, turn off the heat immediately to keep them tender and smooth, and will not become hard due to long cooking.

Case study: I ​​wanted to bring a lunch box on Monday, so I cut the potatoes and carrots into small pieces and stewed them until soft, then added the curry cubes and beef rolls and cooked them for five minutes. After being packed into the box, the soup was absorbed by the rice. When my colleague opened the box, he said it was very fragrant and he finished it in a few minutes.

items.title: Shangzhi Pork
items.core: Shangzhi Pork is a traditional dish from Shangxian County, Shaanxi Province. It is red in color, soft and tender in texture, fat but not greasy, and has the unique fragrance of Shangzhi. Pork provides high-quality protein and fat, while fern vegetables add dietary fiber and a variety of trace elements. The process of this dish is complicated and requires both knife skills and heat. It is suitable for people with certain cooking skills to challenge. From preparation to dish, the entire process takes about 2.5 hours.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Pork belly with skin (boneless) - Shangzhi (also known as Ziziphus, a fern with edible young leaves) - Green onion - Ginger - Star anise - Honey - Vinegar - Cooking wine - MSG - Soy sauce - Egg skin - Refined salt - Chicken broth - Sesame oil - Cooked lard

Calculation: Each serving: two people - Pork belly with skin: 500 grams - Shangzhi: 50g - Green onion: 10g - Ginger: 2g - Star anise: 3 pieces - Honey: 15g - Vinegar: 5g - Cooking wine: 15g - MSG: 1.5g - Soy sauce: 10g - Spread out egg skin: about 15g per piece - Refined salt: 1g - Chicken broth: 200g - Sesame oil: 10 grams - Cooked lard: 2000 grams (approximately 60 grams consumed)

Operation: 1. Scrape the meat clean, put it into a pot and cook until it is six ripe (the color changes to white), take it out and smear the skin with honey and vinegar while it is hot. 2. Put the cooked lard in the wok and cook it over a high fire until it is cooked (about 200 degrees, there is a lot of green smoke on the oil surface and the oil is calm). Put the meat pieces skin side down and fry until it turns golden red. Then put it into the cold meat pot (the pot that was cooked before) and soak it until soft. Place it on the chopping board and cut it into three-inch (10 cm) long and two-minute (0.6 cm) thick slices. Keep the skin side down and put them neatly into a steaming bowl. 3. Cut 5 grams of green onions into 2.4 cm long segments and 5 grams into 2.4 cm long diagonal slices. Peel and wash the ginger, cut 1.5 grams into slices, cut 5 grams into mince, and cut the egg skin into 2.4 cm long isosceles triangle slices. 4. Boil Shangzhi in a pot of boiling water until soft, remove old stems and impurities, wash clean, cut into 3 cm long sections, put in a bowl, add soy sauce (5g), refined salt (1g), cooked lard (10g), mix well, cover the meat slices, put chicken soup (100g) into a small bowl, add soy sauce (5g), refined salt (0.5g), cooking wine (15g) g), mix well, pour into a steaming bowl, then add ginger slices, green onion segments, and star anise, steam on high heat for about half an hour, then switch to low heat and continue steaming for about an hour and thirty minutes. When cooked, take it out, remove the ginger, green onion, and star anise, pour and filter the original juice, and put the meat into a soup plate. 5. In the wok, add chicken soup (100 grams), add the original juice, bring to a boil over high heat, add minced ginger, green onion slices, MSG and mix well, add egg skin, drizzle with sesame oil, pour into the soup plate and serve.

Additional content: - Shangzhi is a specialty that is not particularly famous in small places. At least I have not seen it in other places. It can be replaced with other fern vegetables when making it.
Choose fat and lean pork belly, blanch the whole piece to remove the foam, let it cool and then cut into slices of consistent thickness.
Soak Shangzhi in advance to wash off the sediment, blanch it in water for one minute to remove the astringency, then drain it and set aside.
Stir out the oil from the meat slices first, add sugar and spices, pour hot water and simmer slowly over low heat, and finally collect the thick soup.

Case: I went home on the weekend to try making Shangzhi pork for my parents. I blanched the pork belly and cut it into thick slices, soaked the pork belly and simmered it over low heat for ninety minutes. It was rosy and soft when I served it. My father said it tasted like the one made in the store.

items.title: Beer Duck
items.core: This is a home-cooked dish with a unique flavor. The duck meat is delicious and soft, with a light fragrance of beer. It is hot but not flaky, fragrant but not greasy. Duck meat is rich in protein, and beer can remove the fishy smell and add flavor, making it more delicious when eaten together. The recipe is beginner-friendly and takes about 1 hour from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Duck meat - Beer - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Ginger - Garlic - Rock sugar - Dried chili - Cooking wine - Salt - Chicken essence - Cloves - Star anise - Bay leaves - Bean paste

Calculation: per portion: - Half duck meat (about 1kg) - Beer 800ml - Light soy sauce 10-15ml - Dark soy sauce 5-10ml - 5 slices of ginger - 12 cloves of garlic - 10g of rock sugar - 5 dried chili peppers - 30ml of cooking wine - 8g of salt - 5g of chicken essence - 4 cloves - 3 star anise - 3 bay leaves - 20g bean paste

Operation: 1. Cut the duck into 3 cm Put small pieces of duck meat into a pot with cold water, add ginger slices and cooking wine, blanch it in water, drain it and set aside. 2. Heat the wok, add about 100ml cooking oil, wait until the oil boils over high heat, add the duck meat into the pan and stir-fry until it changes color. 3. When the duck meat has completely changed color (visible to the naked eye and turned white), move the duck meat to one side of the pot, pour in the bean paste and sugar, and stir-fry over low heat until the aroma and sugar color are released. 4. Add cloves, star anise, bay leaves, dried chili peppers, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 5. Pour in the beer to cover the duck meat, add salt and chicken essence, and then cook the duck over medium heat for 30 minutes (if you have bad teeth, you can cook it for an additional 5 minutes). 6. Remove from the pan, serve on a plate and serve.
Additional content: - The amount of beer must be enough to cover all the duck meat. It is best to choose a light-flavored beer.
Blanch the duck meat in a pot with cold water and add ginger slices, skim off the foam and rinse, which can effectively reduce the fishy smell.
Saute ginger, garlic and watercress until fragrant, then add the duck pieces and stir-fry until the duck skin is slightly yellow to increase the base flavor.
Beer covers two-thirds of the duck meat. Bring to a boil and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes until the juice is reduced.

Case: After get off work, I prepared dinner for two people. I blanch the duck pieces to remove the smell, sautéed the ginger and garlic, poured beer and simmered it for 40 minutes. When the soup thickened, the duck meat was soft and rotten, and it was just right with rice.

items.title: Twice-cooked pork
items.core: Twice-cooked pork is a famous traditional Sichuan dish. It is made from two-knife pork or pork belly. The finished dish is bright red in color, the fat meat is transparent and slightly rolled, and the lean meat is dry but fragrant. The taste is fat but not greasy, salty and slightly spicy, with the compound aroma of garlic sprouts and bean paste. Pork is rich in high-quality protein and essential fatty acids. Paired with green and red peppers and garlic sprouts, it can supplement vitamins. This dish has a few steps, including boiling, cutting, and stir-frying. It requires certain heat and knife skills, but even a novice can succeed by following the process. The whole process is expected to take about 40 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Pork belly - Spring onions - Ginger - Green and red peppers - Garlic sprouts - Cooking wine - Doubanjiang - Light soy sauce - MSG

Calculation: - The amount of pork belly is 0.5 jin/man and 0.3 jin/woman (authentic twice-cooked pork is made with Erdao Pork [commonly known as hip tip], the meat is firm and suitable for fat and leanness) - 2 green onions - Ginger 10-40g - Green and red peppers (choose according to the degree of spiciness, 0-30g) *Note: It is not recommended to use thick-fleshed vegetable peppers - 1 handful of garlic sprouts - Cooking wine 5ml - Bean paste 10ml - MSG 5g - Light soy sauce 5ml

Operation: One section of pork belly: 1. Heat the pot, press the pork belly tightly on the pot with your hands to grill the skin - This step is to deal with the sweat glands on the pig skin (or ask the chef to burn the skin when you buy the meat. If you like sweat glands, you can ignore it) 2. Use a steel ball to brush the skin clean until the black part and the carbonized part are completely removed. If you don't brush it clean, it will have a bitter taste. 3. Put the pork belly in the pot, add cold water that can submerge the pork belly, add ginger slices, cooking wine and green onions (take 2 green onions and tie them) 4. Turn on high heat and cook, skim off the foam after the water boils, continue to cook for 15 minutes, until the lean part can be easily pierced with chopsticks. Side dish preparation: 1. Cut green and red peppers into rings 2. Cut garlic sprouts into sections 3. Cut ginger into thin slices 4. Mix 5ml bean paste and 5ml light soy sauce in advance. Pork belly second section processing: 1. Take out the cooked pork belly and put it in cold water to cool down 2. Wipe off the water from the pork belly and cut it into 2mm thin slices with fat on top and thin on the bottom (thick cuts will not taste good and are very oily). Start frying the meat: Note that this step should be done quickly and be careful not to burn the pot. 1. Heat the pot and add a layer of oil to the pot. 2. Add the pork belly and stir-fry until the fat is transparent and the meat slices are slightly rolled (if you want to call it a lantern nest), the effect of two cuts of pork is best. 3. Pour in the light bean soy sauce mixture, stir-fry 5g MSG for 15 seconds. 4. Add green and red pepper rings and small ginger slices, add another 5ml of bean paste and stir-fry for 30 seconds. 5. Add garlic sprouts and stir-fry for 60 seconds. 6. Remove from the pan. Simple version: 1. Choose frozen pork belly and leave it for 0.5 hours or fresh pork belly in the refrigerator for 1 hour and cut into 2-5 mm slices. 2. Turn on medium heat, stir-fry the chili peppers in the pot for 30-45 seconds, then take it out. 3. Heat the pot, put a layer of oil into the pan, add the ginger slices and stir-fry for 15 seconds. 4. Pour in the pork belly and stir-fry once every 10 seconds until the pork belly turns brown (the longer the stir-fry time, the harder the pork belly will taste) 5. Pour in the previously dry-stirred chili peppers and 10ml Add bean paste, season with light soy sauce, and continue to stir-fry for 60 seconds. 6. Pour in the chopped garlic sprouts and stir-fry for 10 seconds. 7. Remove from the pan

The texture of the twice-cooked pork will become firmer after it is cooled in cold water - The purpose of drying the twice-cooked pork is to avoid oil splashing when frying - Remember not to cut the twice-cooked pork thick, otherwise it will be very greasy -
Put the two cuts of pork into a pot with cold water, add onion, ginger, and pepper and cook for 20 minutes. Take it out if there is no blood on the chopsticks.
Let the cooked meat cool and then cut into thin slices. Heat a pan with a little oil and stir-fry until the fat is transparent and slightly rolled.
Chop the bean paste into small pieces and stir-fry the red oil over low heat. Add the meat slices to coat them first, then add the garlic sprouts and stir-fry quickly over high heat.

Case: Make twice-cooked pork for guests at noon on Saturday. Boil the meat until tender and then cut into thin slices. Stir out the lantern nest, add watercress and garlic sprouts, and serve it to the table. Everyone adds two bowls of rice.

items.id: 土豆炖排骨-土豆炖排骨
items.title: Potato Stewed Pork Ribs
items.core: The ribs are soft and fall off the bones, the potatoes are soft and tasty, and the sauce is rich, slightly sweet and spicy. It is a typical northern home-cooked stew. Rich in protein, calcium and carbohydrates, nutritionally balanced. It is a little difficult to make, as you need to master the color and heat of the fried sugar, but the steps are clear and even novices can try it. The whole process takes about 1.5 hours.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Ribs * Potatoes * Ginger * Spring onions * Cooking wine * Sugar * Dried chili peppers * Star anise * Sichuan peppercorns * Cinnamon * Light soy sauce * Dark soy sauce * Oyster sauce * Soybean paste * Salt * Edible oil

Calculation: Note: The following parameters are accurate configurations for a standard serving of 2-3 people. * Ribs = 750g * Potatoes = 300g * Ginger = 30g (divided into two parts: 15g for blanching, 15g for stir-frying) * Green onion = 25g (divided into two parts: 15g tied into knots, 10g chopped green onion) * Cooking wine = 25ml (divided into two parts: 15ml for blanching, 10ml for stir-frying) * White sugar = 10g * Dried chili = 5g * Star anise = 1g (about 1-2 pieces) * Sichuan peppercorns = 1g (about 10 pieces) * Cinnamon = 1g (a small piece) * Light soy sauce = 10ml * Dark soy sauce = 5ml * Oyster sauce = 5ml * Soybean paste = 5g * Salt = 3g (for final juice collection and seasoning) * Boiling water = 700ml * Edible oil = 20ml

Operation: Pre-processing: cutting and oxidation of ingredients: 1. Processing potatoes: Peel 300g potatoes and cut into irregular hob pieces. Immediately after cutting, soak in a basin of clean water to isolate oxygen and prevent the surface from oxidizing and blackening, and set aside. 2. Process the onions and ginger: Cut all 30g of ginger into thin slices (divided into two 15g portions). Process 25g of shallots: roll 15g into a knot, and chop the remaining 10g into finely chopped scallions. Set aside. Preprocessing: Seasoning encapsulation and asynchronous tasks: 1. Encapsulate sauce bowl (one-click call): Take a small bowl, add 10ml light soy sauce, 5ml dark soy sauce, 5ml oyster sauce, 5ml soybean paste in sequence, mix thoroughly and put it within reach of the stove for later use. 2. Pack the spice dish (one-click call): Take a small dish and add 5g of dried chili pepper, 1g of star anise (about 1-2 pieces), 1g of Sichuan peppercorns (about 10 pieces), 1g of cinnamon (a small piece), and the 15g of ginger slices just cut, set aside. 3. Start the asynchronous water process: Press the electric kettle switch to start boiling 700ml of boiling water. (Make sure the boiling water is just ready when the frying is completed). Preliminary processing: blanching and dehydration of ribs: 1. Blanching in cold water: Put 750g of ribs in cold water, add 15g of green onions, 15g of ginger slices, and 15ml of cooking wine. After boiling over high heat, continue to boil and blanch for 2 minutes to force out the blood foam inside. 2. Hot washing and cold protection: After taking out the ribs, you must use hot water to clean the remaining foam on the surface of the ribs (the meat will shrink violently and harden when exposed to cold water). 3. Absolute dehydration (explosion-proof and splash-proof): The washed ribs must be thoroughly dried with kitchen paper to dry the surface moisture, put on a plate and placed next to the wok for later use (to prevent violent frying when high-temperature sugar is added later). Core frying: sugar color and sauteing (high concurrency stage): 1. Frying sugar color: Heat cold oil in a pan and add 20ml cooking oil. Pour 10g of white sugar into the pot and stir constantly over medium-low heat. Stir-fry until the sugar is completely melted and bubbling, and takes on a reddish-brown caramel color. 2. Color and fry: Quickly add 750g of thoroughly dehydrated pork ribs, turn to medium heat and stir-fry. Fry for about 2-3 minutes, until both sides of the ribs are lightly golden and evenly coated with caramel color. 3. One-click sauteing: Make a small space in the pot and pour the [Spice Dish] directly. Use the hot oil at the bottom of the pot to sauté for about 10 seconds to bring out the fat-soluble aroma of the spices. 4. One-click seasoning: Pour the remaining 10ml of cooking wine along the edge of the hot pot to stimulate the steam. Then pour directly into the [sauce bowl] and stir-fry for about 30 seconds, allowing the sauce to completely coat the ribs and stir-fry the rich sauce aroma. Stew to collect the juice: add frosting and remove from the pot: 1. Add water and stew for a long time: At this time, the electric kettle has boiled, directly add 700ml of boiling water (the amount of water needs to cover the ribs), and bring to a boil over high heat. Then cover the pot, reduce heat and continue simmering for 40 minutes. 2. Add potatoes: After 40 minutes, open the lid of the pot, drain 300g of potatoes soaked in water, and put them into the pot. Replace the lid and continue to simmer for 15-20 minutes, until the potatoes can be easily pierced with chopsticks. 3. Season and collect the sauce: Open the lid of the pot and add 3g of salt (you can taste the soup at this time and fine-tune it according to your personal taste). Turn up the heat and start stir-frying to reduce the juice, which will take about 3-5 minutes. Turn off the heat until the soup thickens and evenly coats the ribs and potatoes. 4. Garnish and serve: Place on a plate and serve, sprinkle 10g of pre-processed green onion evenly on the surface as UI decoration.
Additional Content
Soak the ribs in cold water for an hour to remove the blood. After blanching, rinse with warm water to make the meat cleaner.
As soon as the color of the sugar turns amber, add the pork ribs and stir-fry. After the color is uniform, add hot water to cover it.
Cut the potatoes into hob pieces and simmer them over low heat for fifteen minutes until soft, then reduce the juice over high heat and season.

Case: I wanted to eat something hot on a rainy or snowy day, so I blanched the ribs and fried them until they turned sugary. I heated the water to simmer and then added the potatoes. When it came out of the pot, the soup was thick and bright, and the kids ate all the potatoes and rice.

items.id: 奥尔良风味烤鸡腿-奥尔良风味烤鸡腿
items.title: Grilled Chicken Thighs Orleans Style
items.core: Grilled Chicken Thighs Orleans Style is a simple and easy dish that is rich in protein and iron. It took about 3 hours in total, with about 20 minutes of manual work.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Oven - Baking pan - Aluminum foil - Pistol drumsticks - New Orleans grilled wing seasoning (recommended brand: McCormick) - Soy sauce (recommended brand: Hiyori, "Thin Salt Rice Roll with Soy Sauce")
Calculation: One serving is just enough for 1 person. Per serving: - 2 pistol drumsticks (each pistol leg weighs about 200g, about 400g in total) - New Orleans wing seasoning 15 - 20 g - Water ≥30 mL

Operation: 1. Thaw the pistol drumsticks and wash them. 2. Modify pistol drumsticks into flower knife: Make 4-6 cuts with a knife at the "barrel" of each pistol drumstick parallel to the "barrel", making the cut as deep as possible. 3. Take a pot and add 15 - 20 g New Orleans grilled wing seasoning powder, 5 g salt, and ≥30 mL water. 4. Put the modified chicken legs into the pot and mix well. 5. Place the entire pot in the refrigerator for 2 - 4 hours. The longer the time, the more delicious it will be. 6. Place a piece of aluminum foil on the baking sheet, take out the chicken legs and place them skin side down (do not break the aluminum foil). Discard remaining liquid in pot. 7. Place the upper layer in the oven and bake according to the following parameters: _upper layer 230 ℃, lower layer 230 ℃, upper and lower layer bake, 20 minutes timer_ 8. Take out, pour the grease in the baking pan into a large bowl and set aside. (Do not break the aluminum foil) 9. Flip all chicken drumsticks. 10. Place in the upper rack of the oven and bake according to the following parameters: _upper rack 150 ℃, lower rack 230 ℃, upper and lower rack bake, 20 minutes timer_ 11. Take out, pour the grease in the baking pan into a large bowl and set aside. (Do not break the aluminum foil) 12. Place in the upper layer of the oven and bake according to the following parameters: _Upper layer 60 ℃, lower layer 60 ℃, bake upper and lower layers, 15-20 minutes timer_ 13. Take out, pour the grease in the baking pan into a large bowl and set aside. (Do not break the aluminum foil) 14. Take a small bowl and add the fat and soy sauce in the large bowl in a volume ratio of 10:1 - 2:1. The more sauce, the saltier it will be, and the exact amount you add depends on your personal taste. 15. Grasp the base of the chicken drumstick and dip it into the liquid in the small bowl. You can use a napkin or gloves to separate the oil. Now it's time to enjoy Orleans Style Grilled Chicken Thighs straight from the foil baking sheet. If the liquid in the small bowl runs out halfway, repeat the previous step.

Additional content: - You can take it out and stir well during the refrigeration. Do not refrigerate for too long. - This guide is based on an oven with a volume of 25 L and a power of 1400 W. If the oven power is lower/higher than this value, the oven timing can be appropriately extended/shortened, but please ensure that the chicken legs are cooked.
Score the chicken legs twice for easy flavoring, adjust the marinade according to the package proportion, and marinate in the refrigerator for four hours for more transparency.
Drain the chicken legs before grilling, place them on the grill with the skin side up, and place tin foil underneath to catch the oil.
Bake in the oven at 200 degrees for 25 minutes, flip over and bake for another 15 minutes, until the skin is golden brown.

Case: The night before friends gathered for a dinner, I rubbed Orleans marinade on the chicken legs, marinated them in the refrigerator for four hours and then put them in the oven. When they came out of the oven, the skin was golden and everyone said it was more fragrant than takeout.

items.id: 奶酪培根通心粉-奶酪培根通心粉
items.title: Cheese and Bacon Macaroni
items.core: Cheese and Bacon Macaroni is a classic American home-cooked dish with a rich and dense taste. The cheese-wrapped springy macaroni is paired with crispy bacon for a satisfying salty taste. Rich in protein and calcium, but high in calories and fat, it is recommended to be enjoyed occasionally. Making it requires a certain amount of patience. Mastering the basic white sauce and heat is a slight challenge for novices. The overall difficulty is medium. It will be ready to serve in about 30 minutes without baking, but if you choose to bake it will require additional preheating and baking, a total time of about 1 hour.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Macaroni - Cheese - Meat - Onions - Butter - Flour - Milk - Garlic

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. - Macaroni 100-125g - Cheese 40-55g, if you want to bake, prepare an extra 25g, in strips - Bacon or other meat 100-125g - Onion 25g-40g chopped into pieces - Butter 15g - Flour 10g - Milk 125ml - Half a clove of garlic, chopped

Operation: 1. Grate the cheese into fine pieces 2. Cut the onion into strips 3. Boil macaroni in slightly salted water for 6 minutes 4. Medium heat 5. Put butter in the pot and wait for melting 6. Add onions 7. Add garlic after onions soften 8. After garlic smells, add meat and wait 5 seconds 9. Low heat 10. Add milk in four batches, stirring for 5 seconds each time before adding the next one 11. Add flour and stir well 12. Add cheese and stir well 13. Stir in the macaroni and cheese 14. If not baking, eat as is
Additional content: This dish is extremely unhealthy. It contains about 1,300 calories and 80g of fat. It is not recommended to eat it often.
Cook the macaroni for two minutes less than the package time, remove and leave half a cup of noodle soup for making sauce.
Fry the bacon over low heat until slightly crispy, pour off excess fat, then add onions and flour and saute until fragrant.
Pour the milk into the flour batter in batches and stir, cook over low heat until thickened, then stir in the grated cheese.

Case: Time is tight for cooking on weekday evenings. I cooked macaroni and fried bacon. I mixed the creamy white sauce and baked it for ten minutes. After the child finished eating, he asked if he could make it again tomorrow.

items.title: Fried chicken with ginger
items.core: Stir-fried chicken with ginger is a Hunan-style rice dish. The chicken is dry and fragrant. The ginger is rich in flavor, spicy but not dry. Chicken is rich in high-quality protein, and ginger helps to dispel cold, warm the stomach and stimulate appetite. The method is simple and can be easily mastered by novices. It takes about 1 hour from marinating to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Chicken - Ginger - Beer - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Salt - Millet pepper - Meiren spicy - Pickled pepper - Garlic

Calculation: - Chicken = half (local chicken is best, estimated to be 650g) - Edible oil = 50ml (tea oil is best, use rapeseed oil if not available) - Ginger = half a catty (250g) - Beer = half a bottle of 250ml - Light soy sauce = 20ml - Dark soy sauce = 10ml - Salt = 3g - Millet pepper = 0-5 pieces (0-50g) (adjust according to spicy taste) - Meiren spicy = 0-5 pcs (0-50g) (if not available, you can use millet pepper instead) - Pickled pepper = 5 pcs (50g) - Garlic = 3 heads (50g)

Operation: 1. Chop the chicken into 1cm pieces, wash and drain, then marinate with light soy sauce and cooking wine for 30 minutes. 2. Heat the pan until it smokes slightly, add cooking oil and wait for 5 seconds. 3. Add the ginger slices and stir-fry over medium heat for 30 seconds. 4. Add the chicken pieces and stir-fry for 3 minutes to dry out the water and stir out the chicken fat. 5. Add various chopped chilies and garlic seeds, add salt and dark soy sauce and continue stir-frying for 30 seconds. 6. Pour in beer and simmer over medium-low heat for 2 minutes. 7. Reduce the juice over high heat and serve on a plate.
Additional Content
The chicken pieces are marinated in light soy sauce and cooking wine starch for 20 minutes to lock in the moisture and make them more tender when fried.
Cut the old ginger into thick slices, stir-fry over medium-low heat with dried chili until fragrant, add the chicken pieces and stir-fry over high heat.
After the chicken changes color, add light soy sauce and a small amount of hot water, cover and simmer for five minutes and then reduce the juice over high heat.

Case: I wanted to eat something warm at home that night when the temperature was cooling down. I marinated the chicken nuggets first, sautéed the thick slices of ginger in a hot pan, and then stir-fried. When the juice was reduced and the sauce came out of the pan, the ginger was fragrant. Both of us had half a bowl of rice.

items.title: Chicken with Ginger and Onion
items.core: Chicken with ginger and onion is a classic Cantonese home-cooked dish. The chicken is tender and juicy, the onion and ginger are rich in aroma, salty and delicious, and it goes very well with rice. Chicken thigh meat provides high-quality protein, and when paired with ginger and green onion, it can warm the body, dispel cold, and increase appetite. The overall operation is mainly based on steaming and hand shredding, and the steps are clear, making it easier for novices to get started. It takes about 40 minutes from prep to finish.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Chicken thighs - Salt-baked chicken powder - Onions, ginger

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each portion: - 4 chicken legs, about 400g - 5g salt-baked chicken powder - 50g ginger - 1 green onion - 5g salt - 5g sugar - 35ml oil

Operation: 1. Clean four chicken legs and put them in a bowl. 2. Add salt-baked chicken powder and 5ml oil in the bowl and stir evenly. 3. Let the chicken legs stand and marinate for 15 minutes. At the same time, prepare a steamer and boil the water. 4. After the chicken legs are marinated, put them into the steamer with boiling water and steam them for 20 minutes. 5. Cut the ginger into 1) minced ginger or 2) shredded ginger or 3) granulated ginger according to your personal taste. 6. Cut the green onion into 0.5cm pieces 7. Put the green onion and ginger into the dipping bowl, and add salt and sugar 8. Pour the remaining oil into another pot and heat it to level 6 or 7. 9. Pour the hot oil into the green onion and ginger bowl. 10. After the chicken legs are steamed, shred them into shredded chicken. It doesn’t need to be particularly thin, about 1cm thick. 11. Pour the ginger, green onion and ginger oil on the chicken shreds, and stir evenly.
Additional content: - Reference: The White Rice Killer is Coming #江草草鸡 - Bilibili
Steam the chicken legs with ginger, green onion and cooking wine for fifteen to twenty minutes, then turn off the heat and simmer for five minutes to make the meat juicier.
Immediately soak the steamed chicken legs in ice water for two minutes. The skin will be firmer and will not break when torn by hand.
Pour the chopped green onion, white ginger and hot oil to stir fragrant aroma, add light soy sauce, salt and a little sugar, mix well and pour it on the shredded chicken.

Case: I had no appetite in the summer afternoon, so I steamed two chicken legs, let them cool and then shredded them into strips. I mixed them with hot onion, ginger, oil and light soy sauce. It was tender and refreshing in the mouth, and was eaten quickly with porridge.

items.title: cumin beef
items.core: Cumin beef is a spicy and tender home-style stir-fry. The rich cumin flavor is perfectly blended with the softness of the beef and the crispness of the green pepper. Beef is rich in high-quality protein and iron. When paired with green pepper, it can also supplement vitamins and provide balanced nutrition. The production requires some knife skills and heat control, so it is suitable for enthusiasts with certain cooking skills to try. Including marinating the meat and preparing the vegetables, it takes about 45 minutes to have it on the table.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Beef fillet or beef shoulder * Green pepper * Cumin (granules > powder) * Millet pepper * Light soy sauce * Starch * Oil * Salt * Green onions * Pounding jar (optional)

Calculation: * The amount of beef is 250 g/person * The amount of green pepper is 2 pieces/person, 100g each * The amount of cumin is 20 g/person * The amount of millet pepper is 3 pieces/person, 5g each * The amount of light soy sauce is 20 ml/person * The amount of starch is 10g/person * The amount of oil is 15ml/person * The amount of salt is 3 g/person * The amount of green onion is 1 piece/person, 20g each. Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials planned to be used, and adjust according to taste.

Operation: 1. First chop the millet pepper, put it into a mash jar with cumin seeds and mash it into particles, which will make it more delicious. If you are pressed for time, you can skip the mashing step. 2. Cut off the heads of the green peppers and remove the seeds (don’t remove them if you like spicy food), and cut them into shreds. Cut green onions into sections. 3. Thaw the beef in advance, wash it with water, dry it or use kitchen paper to dry it, and cut the beef into slices along the grain. 4. Then marinate the meat, add light soy sauce, starch, and oil, stir evenly, and let it rest for 30 minutes. You can also refer to the method of marinating meat. 5. Heat oil in a pan, add green onions, and stir-fry the marinated beef after the aroma is released. 6. After the beef changes color, evenly add cumin and chili pepper particles and stir-fry until cooked. 7. Then add shredded green peppers, and add salt after breaking them. 8. Stir-fry for 1 minute, then turn off the heat and stir-fry for 30 seconds to ensure even heating before serving.
Additional Content
Cut the beef tenderloin into 2mm thin slices against the grain, add egg white starch and oil, mix well, and marinate for fifteen minutes.
Burn the pot until it smokes slightly and then add oil. The beef will quickly fall apart and will be 70% discolored. Dish it out immediately.
Stir-fry the green peppers and onions until they are raw, sprinkle the twice-cooked beef with cumin chili noodles, and stir-fry over high heat for ten seconds.

Case: I made a quick dinner after working out. I sliced ​​the beef against the grain and marinated it. I quickly stir-fried it in a hot pan over high heat and then added green peppers and cumin. When it came out of the pan, the meat was tender and the peppers were crispy, and the rice bottomed out quickly.

items.title: Kung Pao Chicken
items.core: This famous Sichuan dish is famous for its spicy lychee flavor. It is sweet and sour with the aroma of dried chili pepper and Sichuan peppercorns. The chicken is tender and smooth, the peanuts are crispy, and the taste is rich in layers. Rich in high-quality protein and unsaturated fatty acids, it is an appetizing meal. The method is divided into two versions: simple and advanced. It is more friendly to novices. Just plan the marinating time in advance. It takes about 1.5 hours from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Pistol legs (or chicken breasts) - Green onions - Dried chili peppers (or two wattle strips) - Cooked peanuts - Light soy sauce - Balsamic vinegar - White sugar - Cooking wine - Salt - Chicken essence - Starch - Vegetable oil - Sesame oil Optional ingredients: - Spicy pepper - Lettuce - Raw peanuts - Doubanjiang

Calculation: Note that this dish is the default version for one person, which is enough for two people. In theory, it can be simply doubled for multiple people. - Necessary ingredients - Pistol leg (or chicken breast) = 1 (about 350g) - Green onion = 1 (about 180g) - Cooked peanuts = 150g - Ginger slices = 10g - Dried chili pepper (or two wattle sticks) = 10g (if you choose 2 wattle sticks, you will need about 4 sticks) - Light soy sauce = 10g - White sugar = 2g - Salt = 2g - vegetable oil = 20g - starch = 15g - cooking wine = 15g - advanced ingredients - dark soy sauce = 5g - pepper = 5g - balsamic vinegar = 5g - chicken essence = 2g - sesame oil = 10g - starch (for thickening) = 10g - bean paste = 10g - optional ingredients - lettuce = approx. 250g - Chili seeds = 5g Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials planned to be used, and adjust according to taste.

Operation: Simple version: 1. Debone the pistol legs with scissors, beat the chicken noodles with the back of the knife, cut into strips and cut into 1.5cm cubes; soak in water for 10 minutes, remove and dry and set aside (if it is chicken breast, you can directly cut into cubes and the next step) 2. Take 5g of green onions and ginger slices in a bowl, pour 50g of boiling water and set aside; cut the green onions white. 1.5cm round grains for later use; place the peanuts in the microwave and bake at high heat for 5 minutes for later use. 3. Add 2g of salt, 5g of dark soy sauce, 15g of cooking wine, and 15g of starch to the diced chicken. Stir evenly until slightly dry; slowly add part of the onion and ginger water, stir the diced chicken until it sticks to your hands; seal with plastic wrap and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour. 4.
