Cut the dried chilies into sections; heat the pot over high heat, then turn to low heat; add the dried chilies and bake until slightly mushy, remove and set aside; roast the peppercorns until fragrant, remove and set aside. 5. Turn up the heat, pour in 20g of vegetable oil, add diced chicken at 70% heat (bamboo chopsticks will bubble), fry until the top begins to turn white, turn over with a spatula, fry for 30 seconds and stir-fry evenly. 6. Add in green onions and stir-fry, add the remaining green onion and ginger water. 100g, add a little water (must be hot water); cover the pot, turn to medium-low heat and simmer for 2 minutes; 7. Turn to high heat, add cooked peanuts, dried chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns; add 2g chicken essence, 5g balsamic vinegar, 2g sugar, stir-fry evenly; 8. Starch 10g, add 50g water to make water starch, add it to the pot, stir-fry evenly, and reduce the juice to the desired concentration 9. Turn off the heat, pour in 10g of sesame oil, and serve. A slightly more complicated but more mouth-watering version: Compared to the simple version, it is more recommended to use two vitex branches and raw peanuts. Lettuce is added to complement the crunchiness of peanuts and the softness of chicken. 1. Peel the lettuce and cut into 1cm square pieces, set aside; 2. Cut the two wattle sticks into 1cm long sections; 3. Use scissors to remove the bones from the pistol legs, beat the chicken noodles with the back of a knife, cut into strips and cut into 1.5cm square pieces; soak in water 10 Minutes, remove and dry and set aside (if it is chicken breast, you can directly cut into cubes and the next step); 4. Take 5g of green onions and ginger slices in a bowl, pour 50g of boiling water and set aside; cut the white onions into 1.5cm rounds and set aside. 5. Add 2g of salt, 5g of dark soy sauce, 15g of cooking wine, and 15g of starch to the diced chicken. Stir evenly until slightly dry; slowly add part of the onion and ginger water, stir the diced chicken until it sticks to your hands; seal with plastic wrap and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour. 6. Turn to medium heat, pour in 20g of vegetable oil, add raw peanuts and stir-fry until the surface is slightly burnt, remove the peanuts but leave the oil in the pot; 7. Continue to heat, add diced chicken at 70% heat (bamboo chopsticks will bubble), add bean paste, and stir-fry for about 1 minute; 8. Add the prepared diced lettuce and continue to stir-fry for 1 minute; 9. Add the diced green onion and stir-fry, add the remaining green onion and ginger, add less than 100g of water, and add a little water (must be hot water); add two pieces of wattle sticks; cover the pot, and simmer over medium-low heat for 2 minutes; 10. Turn up the heat, add the peanuts and Sichuan peppercorns that were previously scooped up and set aside; add 2g of chicken essence, 5g of balsamic vinegar, and 2g of white sugar, and stir-fry evenly; 11. Add 10g of starch to 50g of water to make water starch, add it to the pot, stir-fry evenly, and reduce the juice to the desired concentration. 12. Turn off the heat, pour in 10g of sesame oil and 5g of spicy oil, stir-fry for 10 seconds, and it is ready to serve
Additional content: Add the pepper according to your personal taste, remove the seeds if you are afraid of spicy;
Cut the chicken thighs into 1cm cubes, add egg white starch and cooking wine, mix well, refrigerate and marinate for 20 minutes.
Mix sugar and vinegar thoroughly, add light soy sauce, starch and a small amount of water, and stir well before adding to the pot.
Saute the dried chili and Sichuan peppercorns over low heat until fragrant. When the diced chicken is cooked, pour into the bowl of juice, and finally stir in the peanuts.

Case: Friends are having a dinner at home. I marinated the chicken in advance and prepared the bowl sauce. I sauteed the dried chili pepper until fragrant and then stir-fried quickly. The finished product was sweet and sour and slightly spicy, and the peanuts were still crispy before serving.

items.title: Stir-fried Pork
items.core: Stir-fried Pork is a classic Hunan-style home-cooked dish that is spicy and served with rice. The pork belly slices are charred and not greasy, and are stir-fried with fresh chili, tempeh and bean paste to create a rich sauce aroma. Packed with high-quality protein and fat, chili peppers provide a rich source of vitamin C, which helps to warm up the stomach and warm up the body. The difficulty of making it is medium, suitable for novices with a certain foundation. You need to pay attention to marinating the meat and controlling the heat. It takes about 1 hour from preparation to serving, including 30 minutes of marinating and 15 minutes of stir-frying.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - pork belly - Chaotian pepper - millet pepper - black bean paste - bean paste - dark soy sauce - starch - salt - onion - garlic

Calculation: per portion: - 500g pork belly - 4 Chaotian pepper strips - 4 millet peppers - 10g black bean paste, add or subtract ±5g according to personal taste - Doubanjiang 10g, add or subtract ±5g according to personal taste - 10ml of dark soy sauce - 10g of starch - 1-2g of salt - 0.5-1 onion - 2 cloves of garlic - 15ml of cooking oil

Operation: 1. Slice the pork belly 2. Put the meat into a container, add starch, dark soy sauce and salt, stir and marinate for half an hour 3. Cut the green onion into sections 4. Cut the millet pepper and Chaotian pepper with a diagonal knife 5. Heat the pan and pour oil. 6. When the oil is hot, add pork belly and stir-fry. Stir-fry until it changes color and then take it out. 7. Add garlic to the pot, stir-fry until fragrant, add black bean paste and stir-fry evenly. 8. Add bean paste and stir-fry evenly. 9. Add fried pork belly and continue stir-frying evenly. 10. Add millet pepper, chili pepper and green onion and stir-fry for 40 seconds. 11. Remove from the pot.
Additional Content
Refrigerate the pork belly for 20 minutes to cut it into thin slices, add light soy sauce, cooking wine starch, mix well and marinate for 30 minutes.
Cut the fresh pepper into diagonal sections, mince the black bean paste slightly, and stir-fry the meat slices in a hot pan until the edges are slightly burnt.
Push the meat slices to one side, sauté the black bean chili pepper in the base oil until fragrant, then stir-fry together and pour light soy sauce along the edge of the pot.

Case: When I got home from overtime and wanted to make a meal, I cut the pork belly into thin slices, marinated it, and stir-fried it with fresh pepper and black bean for fifteen minutes. The finished product was caramel and slightly spicy. The two of them each added a bowl of rice.

items.title: Stir-fried chicken liver
items.core: This stir-fried chicken liver is rich in garlic aroma, tender and tender with a hint of cumin. It is a home-style stir-fry. Chicken liver is rich in iron, vitamin A and high-quality protein, which can help replenish blood and improve eyesight. When making it, you need to master the skills of blanching to remove the fishy smell, which is a bit challenging for novices. It takes about forty minutes from preparing the ingredients to taking it out of the pot.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Raw chicken liver - Garlic sprouts (garlic sprouts refer to garlic seedlings that have developed to a certain stage. In some places, they are called green garlic, please explain.) - Green onions, ginger, cooking wine - Edible salt, chicken essence (monosodium glutamate), allspice (thirteen spices), pepper - Barbecue seasoning or cumin powder (optional) - Sesame seeds (optional) - Edible oil

Calculation: You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each serving: - 5 raw chicken livers (about 800g) - Garlic sprouts (about 200g, you can add more if you like) - 150g green onions (divided into two parts, one cut into sections 100g, one cut into 50g slices) - 120g ginger (divided into two parts, one cut into 70g, one cut into dices 50g) - 30ml cooking wine - 5g edible salt - Chicken essence 5g (can also be MSG) - 5g five-spice powder (Thirteen Spice) - 5g pepper - 10g barbecue seasoning or cumin powder (optional) - 5g sesame seeds (optional) - 30ml cooking oil

Operation: 1. Wash the chicken liver and set aside 2. Wash the garlic sprouts, cut into sections and set aside 3. Wash the green onions, cut into sections 100g, and slice 50g into pieces, set aside 4. Clear the ginger, take 70g and slice it, take 50g and dice it, and set aside. 5. Step 1: Blanch - Put the washed chicken liver into the pot, add cold water to submerge the chicken liver, and add 100g of chopped green onions, 70g of sliced ginger and 30ml of cooking wine - Turn on high heat, wait until the water boils to medium heat and skim off the scum and wait for 5-10 minutes - Turn off the heat, take out the cold water and clean it - Clean and slice, set aside. 6. Step 2: Stir-fry - turn on medium heat. Add 30ml cooking oil to the pot, wait 10 seconds for the oil to heat up - Add 50g sliced green onions and 50g diced ginger, stir-fry until fragrant - Add sliced chicken livers after sauteing, stir-fry until slightly yellow - Add garlic sprouts, stir-fry for 30 seconds, then reduce to low heat - Add seasonings - 5g edible salt - 5g chicken essence (MSG) - Five-spice powder (Thirteen Spice) 5g - Pepper 5g - BBQ seasoning or 10g (optional) - Turn to high heat, stir-fry quickly for 30 seconds to avoid burning the pan, turn off the heat - Remove to a plate, you can sprinkle 5g sesame seeds as decoration, if you don't like it or don't have it, you don't need to add it.

Additional content: - When blanching water, you need to pay attention to the boiling water level and do not let the water overflow to avoid danger. - It is recommended to rinse the blanched chicken livers with cold water, and ice water is more recommended, which can make the taste better.
Cut the chicken liver into thick slices and soak it in water for 20 minutes. Change the water halfway to remove the fishy smell of blood.
Put ginger slices into a pot under cold water and blanch them in cooking wine for one minute. After the water boils, remove and rinse. Do not cook for too long.
Heat oil and sauté minced garlic and cumin until fragrant. Add chicken liver and stir-fry over high heat for 30 seconds. Season immediately when color changes and serve.

Case: I bought fresh chicken liver in the evening. I sliced ​​it into pieces, soaked it and blanched it, then stir-fried it quickly with minced garlic and cumin over high heat. It came out tender and not fishy, ​​and I ate it with hot steamed buns.

items.id: 小炒黄牛肉-小炒黄牛肉
items.title: Stir-fried yellow beef
items.core: This Hunan-style stir-fry is stir-fried over high heat to bring out the tenderness and peppery aroma of the beef. It has a spicy and refreshing taste, and the celery is crisp and tender, giving it a very Hunan flavor. Beef tenderloin provides high-quality protein and easily absorbable iron. Paired with celery to add dietary fiber, it is nutritionally balanced. The preparation and cooking steps are simple and clear, and the whole process is stir-fried quickly, which is very friendly to novices. It can be completed in about an hour from cutting the ingredients to taking it out of the pan.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Beef tenderloin - Celery - Millet pepper - Wild mountain pepper - Coriander
Calculation: Per serving: - Beef tenderloin 400g - Celery 200g - Millet pepper 30g - Wild mountain pepper 30g - Coriander 30g - Edible oil 15ml - Soy sauce 6ml

Operation: 1. Cut the beef tenderloin into thin slices no more than 3cm wide and 3mm thick. Pour 6ml of soy sauce and mix well with your hands. 2. Cut the celery into small sections no more than 5cm and set aside. 3. Cut the millet pepper into shreds and set aside. 4. Cut the wild pepper into granules and set aside. 5. Cut the coriander into small sections no more than 3cm and set aside. 6. Heat the pot and put 15ml in it. Cooking oil, wait for 30 seconds over high heat to allow the oil temperature to rise. 7. Add millet pepper and wild mountain pepper and sauté until fragrant. 8. Add beef tenderloin and celery, then stir-fry over high heat for 1 minute. 9. Turn off the heat, sprinkle with coriander, and serve on a plate
Additional content: - During operation, high fire is required throughout the process

Choose the beef tenderloin or dragon part, cut into thin slices against the grain, mix well with light soy sauce, cooking wine and starch and marinate for 15 minutes to make the beef more tender and smooth.

When frying, the oil temperature should be sufficient. Stir-fry the beef quickly until it changes color and take it out immediately. Stir-fry the celery until it is raw and then mix it to maintain the taste of the ingredients.
If you like spicy food, you can add spicy millet or chopped peppers. If you can’t tolerate spicy food, use colored peppers instead. Finally, sprinkle with pepper powder to add a numbing aroma.

Case: I had a dinner with friends last week. I sliced ​​the beef tenderloin against the grain and marinated it in advance. I processed the beef and celery separately while stir-frying over high heat, and finally mixed and seasoned quickly. The beef that comes out of the pot is tender and smooth, the celery is crisp, and the aroma of fresh chili instantly conquers everyone. Even friends who don't usually eat spicy food are ordering more.

items.title: Spicy stir-fried pork with millet
items.core: Stir-fried pork with spicy millet is spicy and satisfying. It is a typical southwestern-style side dish. The tenderness of the pork combined with the spiciness of the spicy millet will whet your appetite. Pork is rich in protein and fat, and chili peppers provide a rich source of vitamin C, which stimulates appetite. Although you need to master the heat of sauteing and stir-frying, the steps are clear and novices can easily get started. It is expected to take about 25 minutes to make. Note that this dish is very spicy and is not recommended for light eaters.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Chili millet * Peanut oil * Pork belly/lean meat * Salt * Light soy sauce * Oyster sauce * Garlic * Ginger * Bean paste * Chicken essence * White sugar

Calculation: per serving: - 20 millet peppers, add or subtract based on personal taste - 20ml peanut oil - 200g pork belly/lean meat - 1-2g salt - 10ml light soy sauce - 10ml oyster sauce - 50g ginger and garlic - 10g bean paste, add or subtract based on personal taste - 10g chicken essence - 5g sugar

Operation: 1. Wash the millet and cut it into larger pieces with a diagonal knife. 2. If you want to shred the meat, add seasonings (light soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt) and marinate for 5 minutes. 3. Pour oil into the hot pan, fry the meat first and serve. 4. Saute ginger and garlic until fragrant, add bean paste and stir-fry. Add the chopped millet, then add lean meat, stir-fry, add some light soy sauce, chicken essence, salt and sugar.
Additional content: You can add seasonings according to your own preferences, or add dark soy sauce, which is more fragrant!
Choose pork front legs or pork belly with some fat, cut into thin slices, marinate with a little cooking wine and starch for 10 minutes.
Cut spicy millet into diagonal sections. If you are afraid of spiciness, remove the seeds and reduce the amount. Saute it with garlic slices or shredded ginger to balance the spiciness.

Keep the fire on high throughout the whole process, first stir-fry the meat slices until slightly charred, then sauté the chili until fragrant, and finally return to the pot and stir-fry quickly evenly.

Case study: When I got home from get off work on a weekday evening, I quickly stir-fried pork belly slices and millet, added garlic slices and light soy sauce, and served it in just 20 minutes. The spicy taste instantly awakens the taste buds. After eating two bowls with rice, the fatigue is gone.

items.title: Small crispy pork
items.core: The short crispy pork is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a salty aroma and a slight numbness from Sichuan peppercorns. It is a homely fried dish that every household in Sichuan and Chongqing makes. Pork is rich in protein and fat. It has high calories after frying and is suitable for occasional cravings. This dish has a few steps, and requires mastering the heat of the initial frying and re-frying for coloring. It is a bit challenging for novices. It is expected to be completed in about 1 hour and 30 minutes from start to finish.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Skinless pork (choose fat or lean according to preference) - Vegetable oil - Old ginger - Spring onions - Cooking wine - Salt - Thirteen spices - Pepper - MSG - Chicken essence - Crushed Sichuan peppercorns - Sichuan peppercorns - Light soy sauce - Eggs - Flour - Sweet potato starch

Calculation: Main ingredients: - 500 grams of pork. Accessories: - 2 eggs - 30 grams of flour - 120 grams of sweet potato starch. Green onion and ginger water: - 20 grams of old ginger - 15 grams of shallots - 15 grams of cooking wine - 80 grams of water. Pickling seasonings: - 4 grams of salt - 2 grams of thirteen spices - 3 grams of pepper - 5g MSG - 5g chicken essence - 3g crushed Sichuan peppercorns - 3g Sichuan peppercorns - 8g light soy sauce

Operation: Preparation of green onion and ginger water: 1. Cut the old ginger into shreds, but do not cut the green onion. 2. Pour cooking wine and water according to the calculation formula. 3. Knead with your hands for 5 minutes to fully dissolve the flavor of ginger and green onion in the water. Pork processing: 1. Peel and wash the pork. 2. Cut into strips of 8~10 cm in length and 1.5 cm in thickness. 3. Add salt, thirteen spices, pepper, MSG, chicken essence, crushed Sichuan peppercorns, Sichuan peppercorns, and light soy sauce according to the calculation formula above. 4. Pour in the onion and ginger water prepared earlier. 5. Knead evenly and knead thoroughly for 10 minutes until the meat absorbs all the water and becomes sticky. 6. Cover with plastic wrap and let rest in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Pork breading: 1. Pour flour and sweet potato flour into the marinated meat, and add egg white. 2. Knead thoroughly for 15 minutes. Initial frying to determine the shape: 1. Pour vegetable oil into the pot, control the amount of oil according to the size of the pot, and the oil surface height should be more than 3 cm. 2. After heating to 150° over high heat, turn to low heat to maintain the temperature. 3. Put the flour-coated meat strips into the oil pan with chopsticks, shape into your favorite shape, and fry for 3 to 5 minutes to set. Visually, the color is slightly yellow, and you can flip it with a spatula and feel it is slightly hard. The specific time is affected by the size of the meat pieces, oil temperature, and breading degree. 4. Remove and drain. Tips: If you are not sure about the time, you can fry it a little longer, otherwise the meat will have a bit of a raw taste. If you don't have experience, you can put them into the pot one by one to prevent sticking. Re-fry the finished product: 1. Increase the oil temperature to 180°, add the initially fried meat strips, fry until golden brown and take out.

Additional content: - When breading, be sure to knead the sweet potato flour loosely, and do not have dry particles wrapped in it, otherwise it will fry! ! ! - If there is too much meat to eat, you can just fry it once and put it in the refrigerator. When you eat it later, take it out and fry it again, and the taste is basically not affected.

Choose pork plum blossoms or hind leg meat and cut it into strips. Marinate it with salt, peppercorns, cooking wine and ginger slices for more than 30 minutes to fully absorb the flavor of the meat strips.
When breading, use sweet potato starch and add a little water to make a thick paste. Heat the oil to 60% and fry for the first time to set it. Then raise it to 80% and fry again for 30 seconds.
Immediately after re-frying, remove and drain the oil, sprinkle with pepper salt or chili powder, eat while hot for the crispiest texture, and will soften after cooling.

Case: For a weekend family gathering, I marinated the pork strips with peppercorns and salt in advance, coated them in sweet potato starch and fried them to shape, then raised the oil temperature and fried them again until golden brown. The finished product is crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. The numbing aroma of Sichuan peppercorns makes people unable to stop using their chopsticks, and even children rush to eat it.

items.title: Screaming Bullfrog
items.core: This dish is spicy and appetizing. The frog meat is tender and chewy. It is a typical Sichuan home-cooked dish. Bullfrog itself is high in protein and low in fat, and paired with fermented ingredients such as pickled ginger and pickled peppers, it can help increase appetite. The method is relatively straightforward, but you need to pay a little attention to the oil temperature control and seasoning ratio. Generally, beginners can complete it in 1 to 2 hours.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Bullfrog meat - Pickled ginger - Pickled pepper - Wild mountain pepper (dried red pepper can also be used instead) - Green and red pepper - Garlic - Doubanjiang (Pixian County doubanjiang is recommended) - Salt - Pepper - Cornstarch (dry starch is also acceptable) - Beer (snowflakes are recommended) - Cooking wine - Vine pepper oil (optional) - Lard (optional) - Chopped green onion

Calculation: 1 serving Per serving: - 800g bullfrog meat (if you buy 3 kilograms of live frogs, it is recommended to choose small ones, the meat is fresh and tender) - 20-30g pickled ginger (depending on personal taste, you can add more if you like a stronger taste) - 5-10g pickled pepper (depending on the individual's tolerance for spicy food, if you can't eat spicy food, it is recommended to halve it to 2.5g, slightly spicy) - 10g wild sansho pepper - 20 green and red chili peppers Grams - 30-50 grams of garlic (can be adjusted according to taste preference, preferably no less than 30 grams) - 20-30 grams of bean paste (choose 30 for heavy taste, 20 grams for lighter taste. PS this dish cannot be too light, haha) - 15 grams of salt - 10 grams of pepper - Beer 400-500ml - Cooking wine 10ml - Vine pepper oil 5-10ml - 30 grams of cornstarch (dry starch can be substituted) - 20ml of lard (you can use cooking oil instead of lard) - 200ml of cooking oil - 5 grams of chopped green onion

Operation: 1. Wash the bullfrog meat and drain it, add more than 10g of salt and more than 50ml of beer, and grasp it with your hands for 5 minutes to remove the fishy smell of the bullfrog meat 2. Then rinse with clean water until blood and impurities no longer flow out, drain the water, and place it in a suitable vessel for marinating. 3. Add 5 grams of salt, 30 grams of cornstarch, 10ml of cooking wine, and 5 grams of pepper. Grip it evenly with your hands and marinate for 5-10 minutes. 4. Cut the pickled ginger, pickled peppers, and wild pepper into shreds or slices (according to your knife skills), cut green and red peppers into circles, and spread the garlic. 5. Heat up the pot, add 200ml cooking oil (if the bottom of the pot is relatively flat, you can add 100ml), heat to 60% oil temperature (small bubbles appear), pour in the marinated bullfrog, fry it quickly, take it out after 10 seconds (do not overtime too much, otherwise the frog meat will become stale) 6. After taking out the frog meat, control the oil, pour the hot oil in the pot into a bowl, reserve 30ml, and add 20ml Lard (if not, keep a total of 50ml cooking oil in the pot) 7. When the oil temperature is 60% hot, add pickled ginger, pickled peppers, wild peppers, and garlic. When fragrant, add 20 grams of bean paste, stir-fry over medium heat until red oil comes out (time is controlled at 30 seconds), pour 400ml beer, 8. Then pour in the fried bullfrog meat, push it with a spoon, do not stir hard, add 5 grams of pepper, add 5ml vine pepper oil, simmer over medium heat for 3 minutes. 9. Increase the heat, reduce the juice for half a minute, add green and red pepper rings, cook for another 10 seconds and prepare to serve. 10. Transfer to a basin, sprinkle with chopped green onion, and it’s ready to go!
Additional content: - When controlling the moisture, you can use a slotted spoon to press - When kneading the cornstarch, cover the frog meat evenly

Chop the bullfrog into pieces, wash it with cooking wine, ginger slices and starch to remove the mucus, blanch it in water for 30 seconds and take it out, which can effectively remove the fishy smell.
Chop the pickled pepper and pickled ginger, sauté in hot oil until fragrant, add bean paste and stir-fry until fragrant, add bullfrog and stir-fry quickly.

Keep the fire on high throughout the whole process. Season the bullfrog immediately after it changes color and take it out of the pot. Overcooking will cause the meat to become old and lose its elasticity.

Case: As the self-proclaimed "spicy king", I tried this Sichuan dish for the first time. After blanching it according to the recipe to remove the fishy smell, stir-fry the bullfrog with pickled ginger and pickled peppers, control the heat and stir-fry quickly. The finished frog meat is smooth, tender and chewy, with a spicy and fresh taste. It is so enjoyable to eat with rice that there is no soup left.

items.title: Stir-fried beef with peppers
items.core: A home-style stir-fry, salty and slightly spicy, the beef is smooth and tender, and the peppers are crisp and refreshing. Beef provides high-quality protein and iron, and peppers are rich in vitamin C, making them a nutritionally balanced combination. Although pickling requires some patience, the steps are clear, novices can get started, and the difficulty is moderate. It takes about 1 hour from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Beef * Onion, ginger, garlic * Pepper * Soy sauce * Salt * Sugar

Calculation: * The amount of beef is 250 g/person * The amount of green onion is 0.5/person * The amount of ginger is 1/person * The amount of salt is 3 g/person * The amount of sugar is 1.5 g/person * The amount of soy sauce is 9 ml/person Using the conditions above, calculate the proportion of raw materials you plan to use.

Operation: Side dish preparation: 1. Chop garlic into minced garlic 2. Cut green onion into sections 3. Cut ginger into slices 4. Cut pepper into sections Beef pre-processing: 1. Put beef in a bowl 2. Add ginger, salt, soy sauce and sugar and marinate for 30-40 minutes 3. Remove the pickled ginger. Stir-fry: 1. Add cold oil to the pan and wait until the oil becomes hot until there are occasional bubbles. 2. Add the minced garlic 3. When the minced garlic turns golden, add the pepper 4. When the skin of the pepper is slightly wrinkled, add the marinated beef and stir-fry 5. Before stir-frying, add the green onion and continue to stir-fry 6. Stir-fry until the beef is cooked, turn off the heat and remove from the pan

Additional content: * Baking soda can be added to the marinade to tenderize the beef. The ratio of beef to soda is 500g:3g. * When pickling, ginger slices can be replaced by cooking wine. The amount of cooking wine is 3 g/person
Choose beef tenderloin or beef shank with low fat content, cut into thin slices against the grain, and use egg white and starch sizing to lock in the moisture.
Remove the seeds from the peppers and cut them into hob pieces. Stir-fry them in a dry pan until the skin is slightly wrinkled. This can bring out the aroma of the peppers.
When the beef is stir-fried until it is medium cooked, add hot pepper, light soy sauce and oyster sauce and stir-fry quickly and evenly. Maintain high heat to shorten the cooking time.

Case: During the fitness and muscle-building period, I chose this low-calorie and high-protein dish for lunch. Slice the beef tenderloin against the grain and marinate, cut the pepper into hob pieces, and stir-fry over high heat for two minutes before serving. The beef was tender, the peppers were crisp, and the 449 calories made me feel satisfied and not burdened.

items.title: Shanxi oily pork
items.core: Oily pork is a traditional Shanxi dish. The meat slices are smooth and tender, the garlic moss is crispy, salty and slightly sour, with the mellow aroma of mature vinegar, which is a typical local home-cooked flavor. Pork tenderloin provides high-quality protein, and is paired with fungus, garlic and onions for a balanced nutritional profile. This dish has certain requirements for heat and sizing skills, and is more suitable for enthusiasts with a certain cooking foundation to try. From preparation to serving, it takes about 40 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Pork tenderloin - Garlic moss - Salt - Soy sauce - Onion, ginger and garlic - Eggs - Starch - Edible oil - Fungus - Onion - Cooking wine - Aged vinegar - Sichuan pepper powder - Chicken essence

Calculation: I eat a lot, so this is the amount for one person - Pork tenderloin 150 g - 6 garlic moss - Edible oil 300ml - Onion, ginger and garlic 50g - 20ml light soy sauce - 10g salt - 1 egg - 10g starch - 20g fungus - 100g green onion - 20g other seasonings

Operation: 1. Soak the fungus in advance. If you are in a hurry, you can soak it in hot water. 2. Slice the pork loin into a bowl, add 20ml of light soy sauce, cooking wine, and Sichuan peppercorn powder, beat in an egg, stir evenly with your hands, add starch (sweet potato starch is recommended), mix well, pour in 300ml of edible oil seal slurry, and marinate for 15 minutes. 3. Cut the garlic into approximately 3cm pieces and cut the onions into diamond-shaped pieces and set aside. 4. Heat a little more oil in the pot, the oil temperature should be 50% hot, add the marinated meat slices, break up the meat slices, remove and control the oil and set aside. 5. Pour out the excess oil in the pot and leave 10ml of oil for cooking. The oil temperature is 70% hot. 6. Add the onion, ginger and garlic and saute until fragrant. Add the garlic and fry until raw. Then add the fungus and onion. Add light soy sauce and pepper powder. Stir-fry for a few times. Add the previously fried meat slices and stir-fry. 7. Add 10g of salt. Add 10ml of vinegar and chicken essence before serving. Remove from the pan and serve on a plate.

Additional content: - When frying the meat slices, just let the surface be slightly burnt, and pay attention to controlling the heat. - You can also add a thin layer of water starch before serving for a better taste.
Cut the pork loin into thin slices, sizing it with salt, cooking wine, egg white and starch, and let it sit for 15 minutes to allow the meat slices to fully absorb the moisture.
When lubricating oil, the oil temperature is 40% hot. When the meat slices are spread out, quickly scatter them. Remove them immediately when they change color to maintain a tender and smooth taste.
Pour Shanxi mature vinegar along the edge of the pot, use high temperature to stimulate the vinegar aroma, and finally stir-fry quickly over high heat to reduce the juice.

Case: A friend from Shanxi came to my house as a guest, and I deliberately learned to cook this hometown dish. Slice the pork tenderloin, starch it and grease it with oil, stir-fry it with garlic moss, fungus, and onion, and finally pour in vinegar and serve. It's salty, slightly sour, and the meat is smooth and tender. My friend said that the taste reminded him of his mother's cooking experience.

items.id: 巴基斯坦牛肉咖喱-巴基斯坦牛肉咖喱
items.title: Pakistani Beef Curry
items.core: This Pakistani-style beef curry is fragrant, soft and glutinous, sour and appetizing, with a strong aroma of spices. Beef provides high-quality protein, and paired with tomatoes and yogurt, it is nutritionally balanced. The method is not complicated, but slow cooking requires a little patience, so it is suitable for leisurely preparation on weekends. It takes about two and a half hours from start to finish to serve up a warm pot of exotic delicacies.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Ordinary wok - Rice cooker/electric stew pot - Masala powder (brand optional Shan) - Beef - Tomato - Spicy pepper - Original yogurt - Garlic powder - Ginger powder

Calculation: Here, the amount of side dishes required for 1kg of beef is used as the standard, and different amounts of dishes can be calculated. 1kg of beef makes enough curry for about 5 people. Amount of side dishes required for 1kg of beef: - 4 tomatoes 🍅 - 2 peppers (large ones) - 1 box of original yogurt - 50g pack of masala powder - 5g garlic powder - 5g ginger powder

Operation: 1. Cut all peppers into segments and set aside 2. Beat all tomatoes into tomato puree and set aside 3. Cut the beef into 2cm pieces, wash and set aside 4. Pour a layer of oil into the wok (to prevent the tomato puree from boiling and evaporating) 5. Pour in the tomato puree and stir continuously for 2-3 minutes, waiting for it to become redder and redder. 6. Add 5g garlic powder, 5g ginger powder and 1 50g packet of masala powder, stir evenly 7. Add beef and screw pepper segments, stir evenly 8. Add 1 box of yogurt (to make the entire sauce thicker), stir evenly 9. Transfer the entire pot of ingredients to the rice cooker/electric stew pot, and add 250 ml of water, turn on the stew/simmer setting, and set the time for 2-3 hours. 10. Wait until it is completed, open the pot and check if the beef is soft and glutinous, and it is ready to eat

Additional content: This dish was stolen from a Pakistani friend, and I specially compiled the notes. It is absolutely authentic. It is usually served with roti, naan or rice. If you want to make Chicken karahi, the process is almost the same, except you first brown the chicken in oil and various Sichuan peppercorns.
Cut the beef into large pieces and blanch it to remove the blood foam, sauté the onions in butter until they turn caramel color, add tomato paste and stir-fry until the red oil turns out.
Mix cumin, chili powder, turmeric and cinnamon powder, mix with yogurt and pour into the pot, simmer over low heat for 2 hours until the beef is tender.
Finally, reduce the juice over high heat and add salt to taste. If you like sourness, squeeze lemon juice and sprinkle with coriander to add a fresh taste.

Case: On a rainy weekend, I decided to try this exotic dish. The beef is blanched and then simmered slowly with fried onions, tomatoes, yogurt and spices. After two and a half hours, the soup is rich and the beef is soft and glutinous. When eaten with naan bread, it feels like being on the streets of Pakistan.

items.title: Elbow with handle
items.core: Elbow with handle is a traditional famous dish in Dali, Shaanxi Province. It is named after its claws are shaped like a handle. The skin of the elbow is sticky and glutinous, and the meat is crispy and not greasy. It is dipped in sweet noodle sauce and served with scallions. It has a salty and mellow aroma. Rich in collagen and high-quality protein, nourishing and nourishing the skin. The production requires bone removal, shaping, and long-term steaming, which is a challenge for novices. The entire production process is expected to take about 3.5 hours.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: Raw materials: - Pig elbows with legs and claws - Red bean curd - Sweet noodle sauce - Refined salt - Red soy sauce - White soy sauce - Cooking wine - Garlic slices - Minced ginger - Star anise - Cinnamon - Green onion Tools: - Small ax (for breaking bones) - Sterilized gauze (can cover the elbows)

Calculation: Each serving: three people - Pig elbows with legs and claws: One (about two pounds and a half = 1250 grams) - Red bean curd: 1 piece = 10 grams - Sweet noodle sauce: 150 grams - Refined salt: 15 grams - Red soy sauce: 35 grams - White soy sauce: 25 grams - Cooking wine: 25 grams - Garlic slices: 50 grams - Minced ginger: 10 grams - Star anise: 3 pcs - Cinnamon: 5g - Green onion: 200g

Operation: 1. Scrape and clean the elbow, place it on the chopping board with the elbow facing outward, the elbow handle (paw) facing in, and the elbow skin facing down. 2. Use a knife to cut open the skin along the leg bone in the middle from elbow to elbow, remove the meat on both sides of the leg bone (the meat is separated from three sides), connect the bottom bone to the meat to expose the bones, and then break the two leg bones in the middle with the back of a knife (or use an axe). 3. Place the elbows in a pot and cook until they are seven-cooked, take them out (normal appearance, light red inside), dry the water with a clean rag, and smear the skin with red soy sauce while it is still hot. 4. Take a steamer, put star anise and cinnamon in the bottom of the pot, break off the elbow joints with your hands without damaging the skin, and then put the elbow skin down into the steamer. When loading the pot, according to the shape of the elbow, place the elbow handle against the edge of the pot and insert it into the pot to make it round. 5. Sprinkle in refined salt, cover the meat with sterilized clean gauze, then spread the sweet noodle sauce (50g), green onions (75g), red bean curd, red soy sauce, white soy sauce, ginger, garlic, etc. on the gauze, and steam over high heat for about three hours (subject to steaming until tender). 6. After steaming, take it out, remove the gauze, place it on a plate, remove the star anise, and serve with scallions and a small plate of sweet noodle sauce (or spread the sweet noodle sauce on the elbows and add a small plate of scallions).

Additional content: - The maturity of the elbow must be judged based on the actual situation. If possible, you can ask the elders in the family. -Put water in the lower half of the steamer and place the elbows in the upper half. Add water in time during steaming to prevent them from drying out.
When deboning the pork elbow, use a knife to peel it close to the bone to keep the skin intact. Marinate it with green onions, ginger slices, cooking wine and Sichuan peppercorns for 2 hours.
Put the meat skin side down in a hot pan and fry until golden brown and wrinkled. This will make the treated elbow skin softer, waxier and less greasy after steaming.
Wrap the elbow tightly with gauze into a cylindrical shape, steam it in a basket for 3 hours until chopsticks can be inserted easily, cool and slice into pieces for dipping in sauce.

Case: Last year’s New Year’s Eve dinner, I challenged this Shaanxi dish. Debone the pork knuckle one day in advance, marinate it with onion, ginger and cooking wine, then fry the skin, wrap it into shape and steam it for three hours. The finished elbow has sticky skin and crispy meat. It is dipped in sweet noodle sauce and served with scallions. The whole family is full of praise.

items.title: Stir-fried Chicken
items.core: This is an innovative Sichuan dish with a sweet and spicy flavor originating from the Peking University canteen. The chicken is marinated and then fried. It is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The potatoes are fragrant and waxy, and the green peppers are crispy. It is covered with a bright red sweet and spicy sauce. The salty, sweet and slightly spicy sauce is very appetizing. Rich in protein, carbohydrates and vitamins. The preparation involves frying and boiling the sauce, which is a bit challenging for novices, but you can succeed by following the steps, and the whole process takes about 1 hour.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Chicken legs - Potatoes - Green peppers - Garlic - Salt - Pepper - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Cooking wine - Starch - Pixian red oil bean paste (note the distinction, not the brown-yellow bean paste) - White sugar - Crushed Sichuan peppercorns

Calculation: 1-2 people: - 400g chicken thighs - 200g potatoes - 60g green pepper - 10g garlic cloves - 3g salt - 3g chicken essence (optional) - 2g pepper - 5g light soy sauce - 2g dark soy sauce - 5g cooking wine - 20g starch - 40g Pixian red oil bean paste - white sugar 30g - crushed Sichuan peppercorns 2g

Operation: 1. Debone the chicken legs (if using chicken leg steaks, you can ignore this step), smash the chicken legs with the back of a knife and cut into 2cm pieces. 2. Add salt, chicken essence (optional), pepper, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and cooking wine to the chicken thighs. When the chicken legs are sticky, add starch and mix well. Add cooking oil to prevent sticking and marinate for 30 minutes. 3. Peel the potatoes and cut them into 2cm pieces. Boil them in boiling water for 5 minutes and then remove them. Drain the potatoes to prevent them from exploding during frying. 4. Remove seeds from the green pepper, cut into 2cm pieces, and place in a rack for later use. 5. Add a wide amount of oil to the pot (depending on the shape of the pot, just enough to cover the ingredients). When the oil temperature reaches 180°C, add the potato cubes and fry for 3 minutes before taking them out. 6. When the oil temperature rises to 180℃ again, add the chicken pieces and fry for 2 minutes before taking them out. 7. When the oil temperature rises to 180℃ again, add the chicken pieces and fry again for 1 minute before taking them out. 8. When the oil temperature rises to 180℃ again, add the potato pieces and fry again for 1 minute. Then filter the oil and potato pieces in the pot through a strainer and pour them out, leaving the green pepper slices on the strainer to grow. 9. Add 5ml cooking oil to the pot, stir-fry the garlic cloves over low heat until they turn yellow, add red bean paste and stir-fry until fragrant, add white sugar and stir-fry until it melts, add crushed Sichuan peppercorns, add 40ml water, stir constantly until the sauce becomes thick. 10. Add the fried chicken pieces, potato pieces, and green pepper slices, stir evenly and remove from the pan.

Additional content: - If you are not willing to use wide oil for frying, you can use less oil for frying chicken and potato cubes. It will increase the cooking time and partially affect the taste, but it will not affect the overall taste. - Reference: Official information from Peking University Catering Center

Debone the chicken thighs and cut them into pieces, marinate them with light soy sauce, cooking wine, pepper and starch for 20 minutes. Cut the potatoes into strips and soak them in water to remove the starch.
Heat the oil to 60% and fry the potato strips until golden brown, then fry the chicken pieces until they are set. Finally, increase the oil temperature and fry again until crispy.
When making the sauce, mix tomato sauce, sugar and chili sauce in a ratio of 2:1:1, add a little water and bring to a boil, then add the ingredients and stir-fry quickly to coat evenly.

Case: I couldn’t forget the signature dish of a Sichuan restaurant near the university, so I recreated it at home. The chicken thighs are cut into cubes, marinated and deep-fried, and the potato strips are deep-fried until golden brown, and finally coated with sweet and spicy sauce. The finished product is bright and attractive, sweet and spicy, and every bite is full of memories of youth.

items.id: 广式萝卜牛腩-广式萝卜牛腩
items.title: Cantonese-style radish and beef brisket
items.core: This is a Cantonese-style home-style stew. The beef brisket is soft and delicious. The radish is sweet and rich after absorbing the soup, and the overall sauce flavor is sweet. Rich in high-quality protein and dietary fiber, it is appetizing and aids digestion. There are a few steps to make but the difficulty is moderate. Novices can also succeed if they follow the steps step by step. Expect it to take approximately 2.5 hours to complete from start to finish.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Beef brisket - White radish - Ginger slices - Garlic cloves - Green onions - Star anise - Cinnamon - Dried chilies - Bay leaves - Southern milk - Zhuhou sauce - Oyster sauce - Soy sauce - Rock sugar - Salt - Dark soy sauce

Calculation: One serving is just enough for 3-4 people. - 500g beef brisket - 1 white radish - 8 slices of ginger - 5 garlic cloves - a handful of onion knots - 2 slices of star anise - 1 small piece of cinnamon - 2 dried chili peppers - 2 bay leaves - 1 piece of southern milk - 30g of Zhuhou sauce - 15g of oyster sauce - 15g of soy sauce - 10g of rock sugar - Salt 5g - Dark soy sauce 15g

Operation: Start making: 1. Roll the radish until cut into pieces and set aside 2. Blanch the whole beef brisket, add 2 slices of ginger and a handful of green onions, wait for the water to boil, cook for 5-10 minutes, then remove and cut into pieces 3. Cut the beef brisket into pieces and cut it into the size you like (the beef brisket is blanched and will hardly shrink when braised later, and large pieces will be braised for a relatively short time) 4. Prepare the sauce for braised beef brisket. Mix the southern milk, Zhuhou sauce, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and salt according to the above amounts (the rock sugar has just been replaced with white sugar) 5. Heat oil in the pan, sauté the ginger and garlic until fragrant, add the beef brisket, stir-fry until dry, add the prepared sauce, and stir-fry until fragrant. If you like a thicker color, add a little dark soy sauce to taste. 6. Mix the seasonings thoroughly and then pour in hot water. 7. Change the beef brisket to the soup pot, add cinnamon, star anise, bay leaves and dried chili peppers, and simmer for about 2 hours. 8. Stew the beef brisket until it is semi-soft, then add the white radish and continue simmering. 30 minutes 9. Wait until the radish is simmered until soft, and a pot of fragrant radish and beef brisket is completed
Additional Content
Cut the beef brisket into pieces and blanch in cold water, remove and rinse with warm water to prevent the meat from shrinking and hardening when it is cold.
Saute ginger slices and scallions in a wok until fragrant, add beef brisket and stir-fry until slightly brown, add Zhuhou sauce, light soy sauce and rock sugar and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add enough boiling water to cover the ingredients, simmer over low heat for 1.5 hours, then add the radish cubes, and continue to simmer until the radish is transparent and fragrant.

Case: The weather turned cold after autumn, so I stewed a pot of Cantonese-style radish and beef brisket. Blanch the beef brisket and sauté it with ginger slices and star anise until fragrant. Add boiling water to cover the ingredients and simmer over low heat for 1.5 hours. Finally, add the white radish and simmer for another 30 minutes. The radish soup is full of sweetness and richness, and the whole family will feel warm and stomach-warming.

items.id: 徽派红烧肉-徽派红烧肉
items.title: Hui-style braised pork
items.core: Hui-style braised pork is a classic Anhui-style home-cooked dish that is bright red in color, fat but not greasy, with a soft and chewy texture, a blend of salty and sweet. Using pork belly as the main ingredient, it is rich in high-quality protein and fat and can provide plenty of energy. Cooking requires mastering the color and heat of the fried sugar, which is a bit challenging. The estimated cooking time is about 45 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Pork belly * White sugar * Edible oil * Light soy sauce * Oyster sauce * Dark soy sauce * Ginger slices * Garlic * Cooking wine * Green onions * Five-spice powder * Salt

Calculation: Per serving: * Pork belly 300 g * White sugar 100 g * Edible oil 200 g * Light soy sauce 10 ml * Oyster sauce 5 ml * 5 ml dark soy sauce * 2 slices of ginger * 3 pieces of garlic * 100 ml of cooking wine * 1 green onion * 10 g of five-spice powder * 10 g of salt

Operation: 1. Cut the pork belly into pieces, each piece is 2-3 cm in size 2. Add 150 ml of cooking oil to the pot, pour in the pork belly, and fry for 2 minutes Then, add salt and stir-fry the pork belly for 2 minutes. Remove from the pan. 3. Add 50 ml cooking oil to the pot, pour in the sugar, and stir-fry until brown. 4. Pour in the pork belly and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add ginger slices and garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds. 5. Add cooking wine, five-spice powder, green onions, add water to cover the pork belly, cover the pot and cook for 10 minutes. 6. Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and oyster sauce, and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. 7. Boil the pot, simmer the sauce over high heat, and serve on a plate

Additional content: * The green onions are whole and do not need to be chopped * The purpose of adding salt in step 2 is to lock in the fat of the pork belly * During the production process, part of the pork belly was boiled, and the unprocessed ones were used for subsequent production. It was found that the uncooked meat was more elastic
Choose pork belly with skin and cut it into 3cm square pieces, blanch it in a pot under cold water to remove the blood foam, take it out, wash it with warm water and drain it.

When frying the sugar color, put oil and rock sugar in a cold pan, stir-fry over low heat until it becomes maroon red and bubbles appear. Immediately add the meat pieces and stir-fry for color, being careful not to burn it.
Add boiling water to cover the meat, add onions, ginger, star anise, cinnamon and light soy sauce, simmer over low heat for 40 minutes, then reduce the sauce over high heat until thickened.

Case: After watching a food documentary, I tried Huizhou braised pork for the first time. Cut the skin-on pork belly into cubes, stir-fry in a cold pan until the color turns red, add the meat pieces and stir-fry until browned, add boiling water and simmer over low heat for 40 minutes. The finished product was red and attractive, fat but not greasy, with a blend of salty and sweet. Even my wife, who usually doesn't eat fatty meat, ate two pieces.

items.title: Roast Chicken
items.core: Roasted Chicken is a home-cooked oven dish with a Mediterranean flavor. The chicken thighs are marinated in garlic olive oil, grilled and slightly charred on the outside, tender and juicy on the inside. Served with lemon juice and parsley, the taste is refreshing and not greasy. Chicken is rich in high-quality protein, and olive oil provides unsaturated fatty acids, which is nutritionally balanced. The difficulty of making it is moderate, and the oven needs to be preheated in advance. Novices can also complete it smoothly by following the steps. It takes about fifty minutes in total from marinating to taking out the oven.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Chicken thighs - Salt - Black pepper - Olive oil - Garlic - Lemon juice - Parsley

Calculation: - The amount of chicken thighs is usually 1-2 pieces/person - The amount of salt is 2 g/person - The amount of black pepper is 0.5 g/person - The amount of olive oil is 5 ml/person - The amount of garlic is 1 clove/person - The amount of lemon juice is 5ml/person - The amount of parsley is 1 stick/person Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials you plan to use.

Operation: Preparing the chicken: 1. Coat the chicken legs with salt, black pepper, olive oil and minced garlic 2. Place in an oven preheated to 180 degrees and bake for 30-40 minutes or until cooked. Preparation of condiments: 1. Chop the parsley and set aside. 2. Squeeze the juice from the lemon and set aside. Roasting: 1. Take out the roasted chicken and pour lemon juice on it. 2. Sprinkle with chopped parsley.

Additional content: - You can drizzle the chicken with honey or other barbecue sauce to enhance the taste when grilling - Preheat the oven to 180 degrees, the baking time will depend on the size and thickness of the chicken, make sure the chicken is cooked through - The chicken must be fully cooked before eating, eating undercooked chicken may cause food poisoning and infection with bacteria such as salmonella and flexneri.
Marinate the chicken legs with minced garlic, olive oil, salt, black pepper and rosemary for 30 minutes, and cut a few times to allow the seasoning to penetrate better.
Preheat the oven to 200 degrees in advance, place the chicken skin side up on the grill, place a baking sheet on the bottom to catch the oil, and bake for 25-35 minutes until the skin is golden.

After taking it out of the oven, let it rest for 5 minutes before cutting it, squeeze in fresh lemon juice, sprinkle with chopped parsley, and serve with grilled vegetables or salad for a refreshing meal.

Case: As a novice in Western food, I tried Italian grilled chicken for the first time. Marinate the chicken legs with minced garlic, olive oil, and rosemary for half an hour. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees and bake for 35 minutes. When it comes out of the oven, it's slightly charred on the outside and juicy on the inside. Squeeze lemon juice and sprinkle with parsley. It's refreshing and not greasy. Friends say it has a restaurant-like taste.

items.id: 新疆大盘鸡-新疆大盘鸡
items.title: Xinjiang Chicken
items.core: Xinjiang Chicken is a home-cooked dish from Xinjiang with rich flavor and bright colors. The chicken is tender and tender, the potatoes are soft and glutinous to absorb the juice, and it is spicy and slightly sweet. Rich in high-quality protein and carbohydrates, it also adds vitamin C when paired with bell peppers. The production process requires frying the sugar color and mastering the heat to reduce the juice, which is a certain challenge for novices, but it is not difficult to follow the steps carefully and can be completed in about 1 hour.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Sichuan peppercorns, bay leaves, xiangguo, dry pepper, garlic, scallions - Oil, salt, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, cooking wine (you can get beer), sugar - Chicken (chicken legs are best), potatoes, vegetable peppers and sweet peppers (you can use them, and the color will look good)

Calculation: Serves 2 people - 2 turkey legs of chicken (this is about 1kg) - 2 potatoes of medium size: 750g - 100g green onions - 1 bell pepper, 50g each - 20g sugar - 5 dry peppers - 4 cloves of garlic - 50g oil

Operation: 1. Chop the meat into pieces first, soak it in water and salt for 5 minutes, remove the blood and fishy smell, and then drain the water. 2. Wash the onions, garlic, peppers, potatoes, etc., and peel the potatoes. 3. Cut the white onions into long sections, 4cm in length, and cut the green peppers and string peppers into cubes. 4. Cut the potatoes into hob potatoes, that is, cut them once and roll them around. A piece of potato is about 4cm*4cm in size. 5. Fry the sugar color: first add oil to the pot, then add the white sugar, stir back and forth with a spatula to stir-fry the sugar, and then stir-fry until it turns brown. At this time, pour the dry chicken into the pot and stir-fry for color. 6. Add peppercorns, bay leaves, fragrant fruits, dried peppers, etc. and stir-fry. 7. Add 5g of salt, 7ml of light soy sauce, 10g of oyster sauce, 100g of cooking wine, and pour 1 Liter water, cooking wine can be replaced with beer. 8. Adjust to medium heat, boil the water, and simmer over medium to low heat until the chicken is about to be exposed. Place the potatoes on the surface of the pot: be careful not to flip the potatoes, just cover the surface, otherwise they will stick to the pot. Continue to cover the pot and simmer. After simmering for a while, add the green onions, bell peppers and bell peppers and continue to stew. 10. When simmering until the juice is almost reduced, you can turn it over, absorb the potatoes and soup, and finally turn off the heat and serve. Also: This method can be used to eat noodles. Buy a thick noodle, flatten it, and then pull it into wide noodles by hand. It must be a wide noodle. After it is done, you can put it into a large plate of chicken, and it tastes great when mixed with the soup!
Additional Content
Keep medium-low heat while frying the sugar. When the rock sugar melts and turns maroon, add the chicken pieces immediately to avoid burning and bitterness.
After cutting the potatoes into hob pieces, soak them to remove the starch. Add the chicken after stewing for 20 minutes to prevent it from becoming too rotten.
During the juice collection stage, you need to stir constantly. When the soup is thickened and placed on a spoon, turn off the heat to keep the dish oily and delicious.

Case: Try making Xinjiang chicken at family dinner on weekends. Follow the steps to stir-fry the sugar until brown, add chicken pieces and stir-fry, add potatoes and simmer to reduce the juice. The finished product is bright red in color, the chicken is delicious, and the potatoes are soft and glutinous. It is well received by the family.

items.title: Boneless chicken feet
items.core: Hot and sour, appetizing, and chewy in texture, it is a home-cooked cold snack. Chicken feet are rich in collagen, which is good for the skin. The bone removal step is tedious and laborious, making it difficult to make, so it is not suitable for novices to try. The journey takes approximately 8 hours and 15 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - chicken feet - ginger - cooking wine - green onions - garlic - spicy millet - onions - light soy sauce - oyster sauce - black vinegar (aged vinegar is recommended) - white sugar - salt - pepper oil - coriander - lemon

Calculation: One serving is just enough for 2-3 people. - 1kg chicken feet - 4 slices of ginger - 65g cooking wine - 3 sections of green onion (5cm section) - 10 cloves of garlic - 4 spicy millet, 6 medium spicy, 12 spicy (recommended spicy) - Onion (half) - Light soy sauce 75g = 15g * 5 - Oyster sauce 30g = 15g * 2 - Black vinegar (aged vinegar is recommended) 50g - white sugar 10g - salt 3g - pepper oil 10ml - 3 coriander - 2 lemons (adjust the acidity in units of 1)

Operation: Chicken feet processing: 1. Use scissors/knives to cut off all the nails on the chicken feet, including the meat and bones under the nails, leaving no nails at all. 2. Wash them with water and set aside. 3. Put the chicken feet in a large pot to remove the fishy smell. 4. Put all the green onions, cooking wine, and ginger in. 5. Add water to cover the chicken feet. 6. Boil over high heat. You can pick up the floating powder halfway. 7. Boil the water at 100 degrees and wait for 10 minutes after boiling. 8. Turn off the heat, take it out, drain the water, wash it, and put it into a basin. Deboning: This step can be omitted. This step takes about 2 hours. 1. Put it in the refrigerator and freeze it for 20 minutes. 2. Put everything in a refrigerator that is not a freezer, and then take it out in batches of 10 and remove the bones. 3. Starting from the front end of the finger (chicken claw), use a knife to cut each finger to the back of the hand. 4. Then use a knife to cut from the back of the hand to the entire arm. 5. Break each finger joint and press the finger to point out the sound. 6. Press the front end of the finger and push inward. Do the same for each finger, first push to the back of the middle palm. 7. After the skin of each finger comes off, push it from the palm to the arm until it is completely off. 8. Put it in a bowl and set aside. Prepare the marinade: 1. Cut the millet into small pieces. 2. Chop the garlic, onion and coriander. 3. Cut the lemon in half and squeeze the lemon juice into the container of chicken feet. 4. Pour all the seasoning into the container of chicken feet, add the millet, garlic, onion and coriander. 5. Mix well 6. Put it in the refrigerator overnight (6 hours) 7. After mixing, add all the prepared chicken feet

Additional content: - During operation, you need to pay attention to the boiling water level. If you find that the food is lower than 3/4, you should heat the water until the food is submerged. - Chicken feet deboning tutorial: bili_89324373958
When cooking chicken feet, add ginger slices and cooking wine to remove the fishy smell. Boil the water for 8 minutes and chill immediately to ensure firm meat.
When removing the bone, use scissors to cut along the toe bone, and twist and remove the bone against the direction of the joint to keep the claw shape intact.
When marinating, mix vinegar, light soy sauce, and sugar in a ratio of 1:1:0.5, and refrigerate overnight to enhance the flavor.

Case: Prepare boneless chicken feet before friends get together. After carefully removing the bones from the cooked chicken feet, add minced garlic, spicy millet and lemon juice and marinate for 6 hours. The finished hot and sour bomb has become the most popular appetizer at parties.

items.title: butcher's cabbage
items.core: This is a classic stew originating from the Northeast. It is sour, fragrant, heart-warming and stomach-warming. Sauerkraut is rich in lactic acid bacteria and dietary fiber, pork ribs provide high-quality protein and calcium, and blood sausage can supplement iron. When making it, you need to handle the blood sausage patiently to prevent it from exploding, which is a challenge for novices in the kitchen. From preparation to serving, it is expected to take about an hour.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Blood sausage - Sauerkraut - Spare ribs - Cooking wine - Chili pepper - Bay leaves - Star anise - Onion knots - Sesame oil - Rapeseed oil - Garlic

Calculation: This dish is suitable for 2-3 people. The ingredients that should be added to each portion of this dish are: - 200 grams of blood sausage - 500 grams of sauerkraut - 400 grams of pork ribs - 10 grams of cooking wine - 5 garlic cloves - 5 grams of ginger powder - 5 dried chili peppers - 2 bay leaves - 1 star anise - 1 onion knot - 10 grams of sesame oil - 10 grams of rapeseed oil - salt 5g - Dipping ingredients: 5g chili oil, 10g light soy sauce, 5g minced garlic, 2g sesame oil.

Operation: 1. Poke some small holes in the blood sausage with toothpicks, then put it in water and simmer for ten minutes. Do not let the water boil and keep it at 80 degrees, otherwise the blood sausage will burst easily. 2. Cut the cooked blood sausage into cubes and set aside. 3. Blanch the pork ribs in cooking wine, drain and set aside. 4. Put rapeseed oil in the pot, add garlic cloves, dried chili peppers, and ginger powder and stir-fry until fragrant. 5. Add the pork ribs and stir-fry until the surface is golden brown. 6. Wash the sauerkraut and wring out the water, put it in a pot, add sesame oil and stir-fry. The sesame oil can better remove the sour taste and make the sauerkraut more fragrant. Stir-fry for two minutes on high heat. 7. Add 600ml hot water. 8. Transfer to electric pressure cooker, add bay leaves, star anise, scallions and salt. 9. Press in strong aroma mode for 40 minutes. 10. After the time is up, deflate and open the lid. Add the blood sausage and wolfberry, cover the pot and simmer for two minutes. The blood sausage is cooked and does not need to be reheated. 11. Pour it into a basin, prepare the dipping sauce according to the table above, and you are ready to eat.
Additional Content
Prick a hole with a toothpick to vent the blood sausage before putting it in the pot. Keep the water temperature at 85℃ and cook for 10 minutes to prevent explosion.
The sauerkraut needs to be squeezed out of the water and then stir-fried. Stir-frying it with the pork belly can enhance the fat and aroma.
The pork ribs need to be blanched in advance to remove the blood foam, and then simmered with sauerkraut for 40 minutes until the bones and flesh are separated.

Case: Making butchered vegetables when relatives come to visit in the cold winter. Stir-fry the sauerkraut until fragrant, stew it with the ribs, and finally add the blood sausage and soak it over low heat. The soup is slightly white in color, the sauerkraut is crispy, and the blood sausage is tender and smooth. Everyone feels warm and satisfied after eating.

items.id: 枝竹羊腩煲-枝竹羊腩煲
items.title: Zhizhu Mutton Stewed Pot
items.core: This is a traditional clay pot dish originating from Guangdong. The mutton and yuba are blended with Zhuhou sauce and fermented bean curd. The sauce is rich in flavor, and the taste is plump but not greasy. It warms the body and heart, and is especially suitable for cold winter consumption. Mutton is rich in protein and iron, which can warm and replenish qi and blood, while yuba provides high-quality plant protein, which makes the combination nutritionally balanced. Although there are many steps for preparing ingredients and stewing, the entire heat control is not complicated, and novices can succeed just by following the steps. Expect it to take about two and a half hours from prep to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Lamb brisket - Bean curd - Zhuhou sauce - Bean curd - Nanfu - Dark soy sauce - Cooking wine - Oyster sauce - Water - Rock sugar - Scallions - Ginger slices - Mushrooms - Onions or shallots - Garlic cloves - Bay leaves - Star anise - Cinnamon - Other side dishes such as water chestnuts, potatoes or radishes can be added according to personal preference

Calculation: per serving: - Lamb belly 500g - fried bean curd stick 30g-50g - Zhuhou sauce 30g - bean curd 40g - southern milk 35g - dark soy sauce 5ml - chili oil 5ml - water 500ml - rock sugar 20g - granulated sugar 10g - 5 green onions - 6-8 ginger slices - 7-8 shiitake mushrooms - onion 1 or 4-5 shallots - 7-8 garlic cloves - 1 bay leaf - 4-5 star anise - 10g cinnamon

Operation: 1. Preparation: Soak the mushrooms for 2-3 hours in advance until soft. Soak the yuba for 30 minutes in advance until soft. 2. Prepare the sauce 1: Put Nanfu, Zhuhou sauce, 20g fermented bean curd, and dark soy sauce into the same small bowl and stir well. 3. Prepare the sauce 2: Put 20g fermented bean curd, sugar, and chili oil in the same small bowl and stir well. 4. Remove the roots of the soaked shiitake mushrooms 5. Cut the soaked yuba into 5cm pieces, squeeze out the water. 6. Peel and shred the onions. You can also substitute peeled shallots for a better taste. 7. Cut the shallot into about 5cm pieces. 8. Put the lamb brisket in a pot under cold water, add 2-3 slices of ginger, pour in cold water, cook over high heat until the water boils and then turn off the heat. 9. Take out the lamb brisket and put it in the prepared cold water basin to cool to make it chewier. 10. After the pot is hot, add cold oil, add 4-5 slices of ginger, onions/scallions, white scallions, 7-8 Sauté the garlic cloves until fragrant. 11. Add the cooled lamb brisket and stir with chopsticks for about 2 - 5 minutes until golden brown. 12. Add the prepared sauce 1 and stir-fry for about 2 minutes until the color is even. 13. Pour in water until the ingredients are just covered. 14. Add the mushrooms, rock sugar, bay leaves, star anise, and cinnamon. 15. Cover and simmer on low heat for 90 minutes. 16. Open the lid and add the yuba, cover and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. 17. Open the lid and add the sauce. 2 Stir evenly. 18. Turn off the heat and add green onions or coriander before serving

Additional content: - This dish is a Cantonese dish, and most authentic recipes will add water chestnuts. Considering that everyone has their own preference for radish and green vegetables, you can also substitute potatoes, radish and other ingredients according to your personal taste - Reference: [Zhizhu Lamb Stew with Bean Curd Sheet [by Dian Cook Guide]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ThVDpVoToDQ)
Blanch the mutton brisket in a pot with cold water, add ginger slices and cooking wine, boil it, skim off the floating foam, take it out and wash it with warm water.
Mix Zhuhou sauce and fermented bean curd in a ratio of 3:1, stir-fry over low heat until the sauce becomes fragrant, then add the mutton and stir-fry until browned.
The yuba needs to be soaked in advance and added after the mutton has been stewed for 1 hour to avoid breaking up after long cooking.

Case: As the temperature dropped in Guangzhou last week, I bought lamb brisket and bamboo shoots at home to try making claypot dishes. After blanching, stir-fry with Zhuhou sauce and fermented bean curd until fragrant, and then simmer it for more than two hours. The sauce is thick and the mutton is soft. The whole family can eat it warmly around the stove.

items.title: Zhuhou Beef Brisket
items.core: This is a classic Cantonese-style dish with rich meat aroma and bright red color. The ribbed beef brisket is soft and tasty, with a rich taste. Rich in high-quality protein and collagen, nourishing and warming. Although it requires some patience, using a pressure cooker can greatly shorten the time and is more friendly to novices. It takes about 3 hours to simmer normally, or about 1 hour in a pressure cooker.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Stew pot, pressure cooker (optional, but highly recommended!) - Beef brisket (pitted brisket, ribbed parts are preferred) - Zhuhou sauce (core sauce), Pixian bean paste, southern fermented bean curd, barbecued pork sauce (optional), oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce - Huadiao wine, white wine - Bay leaves, Sichuan peppercorns, star anise, dried chili peppers, cloves, licorice, dried chili peppers, spicy millet (optional), ginger, garlic

Calculation: The following is the amount for two people: - Beef brisket 500-600g - 30g ginger - Half a head of garlic - 1 spicy millet (the amount can be adjusted according to taste) - 2 bay leaves - 0.5g Sichuan peppercorns - 2 star anise - 3 dried chili peppers (the amount can be adjusted according to taste) - 3 cloves - 2 slices of licorice - 2 pieces of southern fermented bean curd - 15g of Pixian bean paste - 10g of rock sugar - 10g of Huadiao wine - 20g of white wine - 50g of Zhuhou sauce - 20g of oyster sauce - 5g of dark soy sauce - 60g of light soy sauce - BBQ pork sauce 20g

Operation: 1. Prepare the auxiliary ingredients first: - Bowl 1: Cut the ginger into 1.5cm\*1.5cm pieces, peel half of the garlic, and cut the millet into 1cm pieces - Bowl 2: Add 2 bay leaves, 0.5g peppercorns, 2 star anise, 3 dried chili peppers, 3 cloves, 2 slices of licorice - Bowl 3: Add 2 Chuannan Ru - Bowl 4: Add 15g bean paste - Bowl 5: Add 10g rock sugar - Bowl 6: Pour 10g Huadiao wine and 10g white wine - Bowl 7: Add 50g Zhuhou sauce, 20g oyster sauce, 20g barbecued pork sauce, 5g dark soy sauce, 60g light soy sauce 2. No need to cut the beef, put it in cold water and blanch it over high heat. When the water boils, take out the beef. 3. Rinse the impurities on the surface of the beef and cut it into large pieces of 4cm\4cm\4cm. Drain the water and put it in a bowl for later use. 4. Turn on high heat, add oil to the hot pot, pour bowl 1 (ginger, garlic, spicy millet) into the pot and stir-fry until fragrant. 5. Pour bowl 2 (spices) into the pot over medium-low heat and stir-fry evenly, about 30 seconds. 6. On medium-low heat, put in Bowl 3 (Nan Ru) and crush the Nan Ru with a spatula. 7. On medium-low heat, put in Bowl 4 (Doubanjiang) and stir-fry evenly, about 30 seconds. 8. On medium-low heat, put in Bowl 5 (rock sugar) and stir-fry until melted. 9. On medium-low heat, add the beef brisket and stir-fry until the beef is colored. 10. On high heat, pour in the bowl along the edge of the pot. 6 (wine), stir-fry quickly until the surface of the beef is slightly browned. 11. Pour into bowl 7 (sauce), stir-fry quickly, paying attention to the bottom juice, and stir-fry until small bubbles continue to appear and the soup is slightly thicker. 12. Transfer all the ingredients in the pot to another stew pot or pressure cooker, and add water to cover the ingredients. 13. Choose the stew time according to the pot used: - a. Ordinary stew pot: simmer for 3 hours on low heat - b. Pressure cooker: press 40 minutes 14. After the time is up, open the lid and season. If it is not salty enough, add salt or light soy sauce (add a small amount and keep tasting until it is right). If it is not sweet enough, add sugar in the same way. 15. After adjusting the taste, you can take out the beef brisket. 16. If you want to eat radish potatoes, peel them and cut them into 2cm thick slices. Add them to the pot and cook for 10 - 15 minutes (or cook until the texture you want). If it is a pressure cooker, cook for 5 minutes. 17. After cooking, take out the radish, potatoes and beef brisket and put them together. 18. Strain the soup and pour it into a bowl
Additional content: - Reference: Zhuhou Beef Brisket + Grassroots, Horseshoe, Bamboo Cane Water Tutorial - Pay attention to safety when operating the pressure cooker!
Cut the beef brisket into pieces and soak it in cold water for 2 hours to remove the blood. When blanching, use a three-piece set of onion, ginger and cooking wine to remove the fishy smell.
When the pressure cooker is simmering, the amount of water just covers the ingredients. After putting on the steam, turn to low heat for 25 minutes to naturally release the pressure.
When the sauce is reduced, add rock sugar to make it fresh. When the sauce can hang on the back of the spoon, turn off the heat and the taste will be more mellow.

Case Study: Try the Post-Hot Beef Brisket for weeknight dinner. Use a pressure cooker to simmer the beef brisket with tendons, turn on the steam and press for 25 minutes. After opening the lid, the beef brisket is soft and delicious, and the sauce is rich. It can be paired with rice to create an authentic Cantonese flavor in a short time.

items.id: 桂林十八酿-桂林十八酿
items.title: Guilin Eighteen Stuffed Vegetables
items.core: Guilin traditional stuffed vegetable series, stuffing seasoned pork, shrimp paste and other fillings into more than ten kinds of hollow ingredients such as green peppers, bitter melons, snails, eggplants, etc., fried and stewed into dishes, one dish at a time, fresh and juicy, soft or chewy in texture, and a rich local home-cooked flavor. The stuffing provides high-quality protein, is paired with a variety of vegetables, is rich in vitamins and dietary fiber, and is nutritionally balanced. The production steps require filling the fillings and controlling the heat one by one, which requires a little patience, but the operation logic is simple and even novice cooks can try it. It is estimated that it will take about 1.5 hours to complete.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: Container (Wrapper) - tube-shaped object: - Green pepper, bitter melon, eggplant, snail, tofu, mushrooms, pumpkin flowers - Pomelo, bamboo shoots, winter melon, taro, garlic, tomato, bean sprouts, eggs, mushrooms - Principle: anything can be stuffed Filling (Filling) - Mainly meat filling: - Pork filling (basic, fat to thin ratio 3:7) - Shrimp filling (fork version) - Fish stuffing - Mixed stuffing (pork + shrimp paste, pork + snail meat, etc. free combination)

Calculation: 18 kinds of containers × 4 kinds of fillings = 72 kinds of combinations, and there are about 20 kinds of combinations that are actually commonly used. Core formula: tube + meat filling + frying/stewing = stuffing

Operation: Core idea: The so-called "stuffing" is to find a hollow tube-shaped food material as a container, stuff the seasoned meat filling into it, and then fry or braise it. Take the two included stuffed dishes as an example: 1. Stuffed green peppers: Remove the seeds from the green peppers and hollow them → stuff them with pork filling or shrimp paste → fry until they are tiger skin color → stew them in sauce 2. Stuffed field snails: blanch the snails in water to get the meat → mince and mix the snail meat and pork → stuff the snail shells back → stew with perilla and mint. If you replace it with other tube-shaped ingredients, repeat the same process again, and you will have a new dish. Stuffed bitter melon, stuffed eggplant, stuffed tofu...all are like this. Stuffing (stuffing) can also be changed: 3. Pork filling: the most basic choice, fat and lean 3:7 for the best taste 4. Shrimp filling: fresh, sweet and chewy, commonly used in green pepper stuffing 5. Snail meat and pork mixed filling: the soul of field snail stuffing, snail meat and pork 1:1, with perilla mint 6. Mixed filling: pork + shrimp filling, a mixture of sweetness and oily fragrance. One container is equipped with one kind of stuffing, and you can change it to a new stuffing. There is a local saying that "everything can be brewed", which is exactly the reason. Bridge Pattern: Decouple "container" and "stuffing" so that they can change independently and be combined freely: Abstract Wrapper: Tube (CylindricalContainer) ├── Stuffed green pepper extends CylindricalContainer ├── Stuffed bitter melon extends CylindricalContainer ├── Stuffed eggplant extends CylindricalContainer ├── Stuffed snail extends CylindricalContainer ├── Stuffed tofu extends CylindricalContainer ├── Stuffed mushrooms extends CylindricalContainer ├── Stuffed pumpkin extends CylindricalContainer ├── Stuffed grapefruit extends CylindricalContainer ├── Stuffed bamboo shoots extends CylindricalContainer ├── Stuffed winter melon extends CylindricalContainer ├── Taro stuffed extends CylindricalContainer ├── Garlic stuffed extends CylindricalContainer ├── Tomato stuffed extends CylindricalContainer ├── Bean sprouts stuffed extends CylindricalContainer ├── Egg stuffed extends CylindricalContainer ├── Fragrant mushroom stuffed extends CylindricalContainer └──... Everything can be stuffed. Filling Implementation: Meat Filling ├── Pork filling implements MeatFilling ├── Shrimp filling implements MeatFilling ├── Fish filling implements MeatFilling └── Mixed filling implements MeatFilling // Pork + shrimp filling, pork + snail meat... Change a wrapper It’s just a new dish, another filling and a variation.

Additional content: Already have recipes: - Stuffed green peppers - green peppers stuffed with meat / stuffed green peppers with shrimps (fork version) - Stuffed snails - stuffed snail meat and pork 1:1, with perilla and mint Stuffed vegetables illustration:
Use a baller to keep the shape intact when removing the core from the green pepper. Blanch the bitter melon for 30 seconds to reduce the bitterness.
The meat filling is prepared according to the ratio of fat to lean 3:7, and minced water chestnuts are added to increase the crispy taste, and the filling is about 70% to 80% full.
When simmering, add stock to cover 2/3 of the ingredients, reduce the juice over medium-low heat for 8 minutes, and keep the shape of the stuffed vegetables intact.

Case: Learning to make Shiba Yong while traveling in Guilin. Choose green peppers, bitter melon and other seasonal vegetables to fill the meat filling, fry until golden brown on both sides and then simmer. The finished product is served garnished with chopped green onion, and the filling is delicious and juicy, fully demonstrating the wisdom of local food.

items.title: Braised pork with pickled vegetables
items.core: This is a traditional Hakka dish. The finished dish has a bright red sauce, a thick soup, and the meat is fat but not greasy, soft and mellow. Pork belly is rich in high-quality protein and fatty acids, and paired with prunes, it can provide dietary fiber. The overall process is a bit more, and you need to master the heat of boiling, frying, and steaming, which is a challenge for novices. From preparation to serving, including the time for soaking the pickles, it takes about 2.5 hours.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * pork belly * pickles * five-spice powder * cooking oil * white sugar * dark soy sauce * light soy sauce * millet pepper * minced garlic * edible salt * chicken essence

Calculation: per portion: * 200 g pork belly * 30 g prunes * 2 g five-spice powder * 300 ml cooking oil * 5 g sugar * 30 ml dark soy sauce * 20 ml light soy sauce * 1 millet pepper * 10 g minced garlic * 2 g edible salt * 2 g chicken essence

Operation: 1. Put the pickles in clean water and soak for 1 hour. 2.
