Pour 50 ml cooking oil into the pot, put the whole pork belly and pork skin down, put it in the pot for 1 minute, take out and hang up the pig skin [optional] 3. Add boiling water to the pot, put in the pork belly, cook on high heat for 20 minutes (chopsticks can be inserted into the pork belly), take out the pork belly 4. Spread dark soy sauce, five-spice powder, and white sugar evenly on the surface of the pork belly and leave for 15 minutes. 5. Heat oil in a pan, add pork belly, and fry over medium heat until both sides are golden brown (3-5 minutes). 6. Heat oil in a pan, pour in the pickles, add millet pepper, minced garlic, chicken essence, and edible salt and stir-fry until the dried pickles are moist. 7. Slice the pork belly (rear end 0.5-1 cm), put it in a large bowl, and scatter the pickles. 8. Steam over medium heat for 45 minutes. 9. Cover the large pork belly bowl with a plate and pour the pork belly onto the plate.

Additional content: * During the production process, I found that the crispy pork belly is really fragrant Orz~ * If you don’t like sweet food, you can remove the white sugar, which will not affect the main process * The penultimate step can be adjusted according to your personal preference. * The function of frying dried prunes is to absorb oil later (blind guess)
Cook the pork belly until chopsticks can be inserted. Prick the skin and apply white vinegar on it. This will make the skin easier to peel when fried.
Wash the pickled vegetables repeatedly to remove the sand, change the water twice when soaking, and add a little sugar when frying to enhance the freshness.
When steaming, cover the mouth of the bowl with plastic wrap to prevent steam. Turn the heat to medium to low and steam for 90 minutes until the meat is soft and tender.

Case: Prepare braised pork with pickled vegetables for New Year’s Eve dinner. The pork belly is cooked thoroughly and the tiger skin is fried, sliced ​​and steamed in a bowl of pickled pickled vegetables. When served upside down, the meat slices are intact, fat but not greasy, and the pickles absorb enough gravy, making it the highlight of the banquet.

items.title: Salt and pepper steak
items.core: Salt and pepper ribs are a classic home-cooked dish in local Shanghai cuisine. They are crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a delicious salty aroma. Pork chops provide high-quality protein and essential amino acids, which can replenish physical strength. Although this dish has a few steps, it is not difficult to follow the process, and novices can also try it boldly. From preparation to serving, it takes about 40 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Ribs - Eggs - Salt - Salt and pepper powder - Green onion and ginger water - Flour - Starch - Custard powder (to add color and flavor, you can leave it out if you don't have it) - Water - Oil

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is enough for 1-2 people. - 4 pieces of large ribs (about 360 grams) - 1 50 g egg - 1 g of salt - 10 g of salt and pepper powder - 100 ml of green onion and ginger water - 80 g of flour - 80 g of starch - 2-3 g of custard powder (for color and flavor, you can omit it if you don’t have it) - 10 g of water - 10 g of oil

Operation: 1. Wash the large ribs, debone them, fluff them with a knife, cut into thick slices, and then cut into thick strips. 2. Add pepper and salt powder, mix well, wait until it becomes gelatinous, add onion and ginger water in batches, and marinate in the refrigerator for 20 minutes. 3. Make fried batter. Add 80 g flour, 20 g starch (note that it is 20 g starch, leaving 60 g for later use), 2 - 3 g custard powder, and 1 g salt. 4. Crack in an egg, stir, then add 100 g of water in batches, then add 10 g of oil, and stir repeatedly. Cook until the fried batter is completely mixed and slightly thick. 5. Take out the remaining 60 g of starch, take out the strips, cover them with a layer of starch, and then cover them with batter. 6. Add oil to the pot, just enough to cover the ingredients, and heat to about 150 ℃ - 160 ℃. Add the strips and fry until light golden brown, then take them out. There may be adhesion when the strips are first inserted, so do not move them. After the strips are set, you can flip them with chopsticks and separate them. 7. When the oil temperature rises to 150 ℃ - 160 ℃ again, add the strips and fry again until golden brown, then remove. 8. Sprinkle with pepper and salt powder, stir evenly and remove from the pan.

Extras: - You can also use bread crumbs instead of fried batter, but the taste will be very different. - Fried batter can also be used to fry chicken legs, fried fish, etc. - Reference: How to make salt and pepper steaks
Use the back of a knife to loosen the fibers of the large ribs, add meat tenderizer and marinate for 15 minutes. The texture will become softer after frying.
Use sweet potato starch for flour coating. Heat the oil to 60% for initial frying to set the shape. Fry for 20 seconds for 20 seconds to make it crispier.
Salt and pepper are fried and ready to use: Roast Sichuan peppercorns and salt at a ratio of 1:3 over low heat, crush until fragrant, and sprinkle on the strips while hot.

Case: Make salt and pepper steak for picky children. Cut the pork ribs into strips, marinate them, coat them in starch and fry them, then sprinkle with salt and pepper and toss. The skin is crispy and the meat is tender. The child ate most of the plate in one go and asked to make it again next time.

items.title: Boiled beef
items.core: Boiled beef is a classic spicy flavor in Sichuan cuisine. It has a smooth and tender texture, a bright red soup, and is spicy and fresh. Beef is rich in high-quality protein and iron, and paired with bean sprouts, it can supplement dietary fiber. This dish is not too difficult for novices, but they need to pay attention to the safety of heat and oil pouring. The overall preparation takes about forty minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Beef - Bean sprouts - Eggs - Coriander - Bean paste - Cooking wine - Starch - Dried chili powder - Ginger - Garlic - Red pepper - Oyster sauce

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. This is the amount of one serving: - 300g beef - 100g bean sprouts - 1 egg - 5 coriander - 10g bean paste - cooking wine 10ml - starch 15g - dried chili powder 5g - 20g ginger - 3 cloves garlic - 1 red pepper - 8g oyster sauce

Operation: 1. Wash the beef and slice it. 2. Add 15g shredded ginger, 1 egg, 15g starch, 8g oyster sauce, 10ml cooking wine, mix well, and marinate for 15 minutes. 3. Wash and chop the coriander. 4. Pour oil into the pot, add bean paste, 5g shredded ginger, and garlic slices. 5. Pour in boiling water and cook into red soup. 6. Wash the bean sprouts, remove the ends, and blanch them in boiling water. 7. Spread the bean sprouts into the bottom of the bowl. 8. Put the beef slices into the red soup one by one, and take them out after they are cooked. 9. Place the beef on the bean sprouts and sprinkle with coriander stalks. 10. Sprinkle with coriander leaves, chili powder, and chili rings. 11. Heat up the oil in another pan, pour the hot oil on top of the vegetables, and it’s done.
Additional content: - Reference: Detailed steps of boiled beef
Cut the beef into thin slices against the grain, wash with baking soda and rinse, add egg white starch to lock in moisture.
Use soybean sprouts and lettuce tips as the base dish, stir-fry them until they are raw, and use bean paste to stir-fry red oil in the soup.
Spill the oil twice: first pour the spice oil to stimulate the fragrance, then pour the peppercorn oil to increase the numbness. The oil temperature is 70% hot, which is optimal.

Case: Sichuan cuisine lovers challenge boiled beef. After the beef is sliced ​​and marinated, cook it together with the bean sprouts and put it into a bowl. Spread the chili pepper and pour hot oil on it. The finished product is spicy and fragrant, the beef is tender and smooth, and you can enjoy it with rice.

items.title: Boiled Pork Slices
items.core: Boiled Pork Slices is a classic Sichuan dish that is spicy and fragrant, with smooth and tender meat slices and crispy side dishes. It is very suitable for rice. Pork tenderloin provides high-quality protein, and when paired with vegetables such as bean sprouts, it is nutritionally balanced. The method is a bit tedious, especially requiring patience in marinating the meat slices and making the knife-edge chili. It takes about 1 to 2 hours for a novice to complete.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Pork tenderloin - Edible salt - Pepper - Light soy sauce - Cooking wine - Egg white - Potato starch - Vegetable oil - Bean sprouts - Anchovies - Celery - Garlic sprouts - Garlic - Ginger - Red pickled pepper - Green pepper - Dried chili - Red oil bean paste - Chicken essence - White sugar - Shallot - Rapeseed oil

Calculation: - The amount of tenderloin is 300g - 2 shallots - 10g ginger - 20g garlic - 20g red pickled pepper (choose 0-40g according to the degree of spiciness) - 2 garlic sprouts - 3 celery - 5ml red oil sauce - 1.5g chicken essence - 5g light soy sauce - 5g edible salt - 2g pepper - 3g cooking wine - 1 egg white - 7g potato starch - 280g vegetable oil (choose according to the situation, if you want to eat heavy oil, add 100g more) - 200g rapeseed oil (choose according to the situation, if you want to eat heavy oil, add 100g more) - 100g mung bean sprouts - 1 phoenix tail - 1g white sugar - 20g spicy dried millet chili (choose according to the degree of spiciness) 0-40g) - 5g green peppercorns (choose according to the situation, more 5g if you want to eat hemp)

Operation: 1. Cut the tenderloin into small pieces, and then cut into 2 mm slices (can be improved according to your own taste), put it in a bowl, add water and wash it twice to remove blood and impurities, remove and squeeze out the water and set aside. 2. Add 1.5g of edible salt, 1g of pepper, 5g of light soy sauce, and 3g of cooking wine to the bowl, then stir in one direction for 2 minutes to infuse the flavors. 3. Prepare another bowl, add an egg white, add 7g of potato starch, stir evenly in one direction, and pour into the meat - Stir evenly in one direction again (a lubricating film will be formed on the surface of the meat, which will make the meat more tender) - Finally, add 30g of vegetable oil and stir gently (to prevent the meat slices from sticking). 4. 100g mung bean sprouts, 1 phoenix tail (cut into small strips), 3 celery stalks cut into small sections, 2 garlic sprouts smashed and cut into small sections. 5. Chop 20g garlic, mince ginger into small pieces, and mince 20g red pickled pepper. 6. Add 15g of millet, spicy dried chili peppers, and 3g of green peppercorns. Add oil to the pan. When the oil is slightly hot, pour out the excess and reserve 50g of base oil. Add the dried chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns. Stir-fry over low heat until fragrant. Be sure not to burn them (the color must turn black). Pour out and chop finely on a cutting board. 7. Heat the pot, add 100g vegetable oil and heat until 60% hot, add 2g green peppercorns and dried chili peppers and sauté until fragrant, add garnishes to the pot, add 1g edible salt, stir-fry until cooked, place in a bowl and set aside. 8. Clean the pot, add 150g of vegetable oil and heat it to 60% heat. Add the prepared ginger, garlic and red pickled peppers. Saute until fragrant. Add 10g of watercress. Turn on low heat and stir-fry the watercress until fragrant and the red oil will come out. 9. Add 800 ml of water (choose according to the actual situation), bring to a boil over high heat, turn to low heat and season, add 2.5g edible salt, 1.5g chicken essence, 1g white sugar for freshness, 1g pepper, 5g water starch (choose according to the actual situation) to thicken the soup. 10. After the soup is boiling, turn on low heat and put the marinated meat slices into the pot one by one. Then turn on medium heat and scald the meat slices until cooked. Use a spatula to gently push the meat slices to avoid sticking. When the soup is boiling, take the meat slices out and place them in a bowl with garnishes. Then pour the original soup (no more than the dish). 11. Sprinkle the chili pepper, minced garlic and chopped green onion evenly into the bowl. 12. Clean the pot, add 200g of rapeseed oil, heat until 70% hot, then pour it evenly on the meat slices in the bowl at once (pay attention to safety), the deliciousness is complete.

Additional content: - Choose the bottom vegetables according to your own taste (mushrooms, cabbage, lettuce, etc.). - If it is troublesome to make knife-edge chili peppers, you can directly use dried chili pepper segments and green peppercorns instead. - Pay special attention to the marinating of the meat (turn it in one direction when stirring, and clean the blood) to ensure that the meat is smooth and tender (mix the egg white and starch evenly). - You can also follow this method for boiled beef. References: - Food writer Wang Gang R
Refrigerate the tenderloin for 1 hour for better cutting. Add pepper, cooking wine and starch, mix well and marinate for 20 minutes.
Knife-edge chili requires a ratio of 5:1 between dried chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns. It is fragrant on a low fire and then crushed by hand to retain the grainy texture.
When pouring the soup, put the meat slices first and then pour the soup to avoid aging after long cooking. Finally, sprinkle with minced garlic and chili pepper.

Case: Try boiled meat slices for family dinner. Homemade chili peppers, the meat slices are marinated and cooked smoothly, and the side dishes are served as a base for the soup. The aroma of tumbling red oil is fragrant, and the meat slices are tender and delicious. Even family members who don't usually eat spicy food are eager to try it.

items.title: Fried pork with onions
items.core: This is a home-style stir-fry, salty and sweet, with a rich sauce aroma. The onions are softly fried and have a mild taste. It goes well with tender pork slices. Pork provides high-quality protein and B vitamins, while onions contain dietary fiber and a variety of antioxidants, which are appetizing and aid digestion. The operation is simple, even for novices, and the production time is expected to only take 15 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Onions - Pork slices - Tomato sauce - Sesame oil

Calculation: per serving: Ingredients - One onion (it is the protagonist, you can add half to one more if you like onions) - Pork (250g) - Garlic (3 cloves) Seasoning - Edible oil (15ml) - Black pepper (1.25g) - Soy sauce (30ml) - Sugar (15g) - Sesame oil (5ml) - Tomato paste (15ml) - Cooking wine (15ml) Note: You can consider purchasing teaspoons and tablespoons to accurately determine the amount of ingredients.

Operation: 1. Slice the onion, smash the pork and garlic, and mix the above seasonings and set aside. 2. Pour 1 tablespoon of cooking oil into the wok (wait 10 seconds for the oil temperature to rise), and add the pork. 3. Stir-fry until it changes color, add the garlic and stir-fry until fragrant, and set aside. 4. Stir-fry the onions in the original pot for 3 to 4 minutes, then add the seasonings and stir-fry evenly. 5. Add the freshly prepared pork and stir-fry until the pork is cooked. 6. After the pork is cooked, stir-fry for 1 or 2 minutes before serving
Additional content: - For pork, you can choose pork shoulder slices or shredded pork, depending on your personal preference. References: - Ai Cuisine
Slice the pork tenderloin thinly against the grain, add light soy sauce and starch to mix well, marinate in oil for 10 minutes to make it more tender.
Cut the onions into shreds and soak them in cold water for 5 minutes. This will make them less watery and crispier and sweeter when fried.
Heat the pan and fry the meat slices in cold oil until they change color. Saute the onions before returning to the pan. Stir-fry quickly over high heat.

Case: Make fried pork with onions quickly after get off work. Slice the pork and stir well, slice the onion into shreds and sauté until fragrant, stir-fry quickly over high heat and season. It's served in 15 minutes. It's salty and sweet, the onions are soft and the glutinous pork is tender. It's served with rice to relieve the fatigue of the day.

items.title: Zibo BBQ
items.core: This is a Shandong Zibo specialty barbecue dish. The meat is rolled in small pancakes and served with green onions. It has a unique flavor. The aroma of meat, sauce and green onions blend together, and the taste is rich in layers. Pork belly is rich in high-quality protein and fat, and green onions provide dietary fiber. Paired with shortbread, it can quickly replenish energy. The production requires controlling the charcoal heat and flipping skills, which is a bit challenging for novices. The whole process can be completed in about 40 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Pork belly - Small pancakes (ready-made in the market) - Green onions - Sesame sauce - Sweet noodle sauce - Sesame salt - Barbecue grill - Grilling net - Charcoal fire or gas

Calculation: Each portion is the amount for one person, and more people can add more in proportion. Each portion: - 200g pork belly - 5 small pancakes - 1 green onion (about 100g) - 20g sesame sauce - 15g sweet noodle sauce

Operation: 1. Cut the pork belly into pieces no more than 2cm thick and skewer them into skewers. (Pork belly can be marinated in advance for better taste) 2. Cut the green onions into 5cm long slices and set aside. 3. Add 10ml warm water to the sesame sauce to dilute and mix evenly with the sweet noodle sauce. Set aside (can be replaced with "sesame salt") 4. Light the charcoal fire and wait until the charcoal fire is red and flameless (about 15 minutes) 5. Arrange the pork belly skewers evenly on the grill, grill until the bottom is brown and oily, then turn over 6. Continue grilling for about 2 - 3 minutes, until both sides are browned and the edges are slightly charred, then remove. 7. Spread a small thin pancake flat and spread 3 - 4g of the mixed sauce. 8. Place the grilled meat slices and 1 - 2 sections of green onions, roll up and serve

Additional content: - When slicing the pork belly, it is recommended to put it in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before cutting, so that it is easier to cut into pieces. - The flavor of charcoal grilling is better than that of gas. It is recommended to use charcoal if possible. - For the sauce, you can adjust the ratio of sesame sauce to sweet noodle sauce according to your personal taste, or you can replace it with sesame salt.
Cut the pork belly into 1cm thick slices. When roasting the fat and lean meat, it is easier to produce oil. It is better to keep the charcoal fire 15cm away from the meat.
When grilling, grill the fat part first, turn it over when the fat drips and starts to flame, and sprinkle with cumin and chili powder to increase the aroma.
Microwave the pancakes for 10 seconds to make them softer. When rolling the meat, add garlic sauce and green onions to enhance the flavor and relieve greasiness.

Case: Travel to Zibo to experience authentic barbecue. Grill the pork belly over charcoal fire until it becomes sizzling and oily, then roll the meat, green onions and sauce into small pancakes. After one bite, the aroma of meat and noodles blended together, and I finally understood why Zibo barbecue is so popular.

items.title: Steamed mandarin fish
items.core: Steamed mandarin fish has tender meat and outstanding sweet and sweet flavor. It is a home-cooked river fish recipe that pays attention to the original taste. Mandarin fish is rich in high-quality protein and a variety of trace elements, and is easy to digest and absorb. You need to be careful with the fins when handling, but the overall steps are not complicated, and novices can do it with a little attention. From preparation to serving, it only takes about half an hour.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Mandarin fish - Green onion - Shallot - Light soy sauce - Red pepper - Ginger slices - Edible oil
Calculation: per serving (about 2 people): - 500g mandarin fish - 1 section of green onion - 2 shallots - 30g of light soy sauce - 1 red pepper - 3 slices of ginger - 20ml cooking oil

Operation: 1. Ingredients processing: - Cut the mandarin fish from the abdomen, remove the gills and internal organs, remove the fish scales, and scrape the mucus on the skin (this step can also be handled by the enthusiastic stall owner) - Cut the mandarin fish with a flower knife, add ginger slices, and some lard if possible, place it on a plate with a chopstick underneath to facilitate even heating during steaming - Slice the scallions and remove the core in the middle, leaving only the outer two layers - Slice the green onions and set aside - Remove the chili seeds and inner meat from the red pepper and set aside. - Put the prepared scallions, spring onions, and chili peppers together, cut into shreds, and soak in water for later use. 2. Stir-frying process: - Add water to the pot, with a larger amount of water. When the water is hot, add the mandarin fish, cover the pot, and steam over high heat for 8-10 minutes. Four tips for steaming fish: Use high heat. - During the steaming process, use another superheated oil. The oil needs to be burned until it smokes. - After steaming, pour out the water in the steamed fish, remove the ginger slices, add shredded green onions, and pour hot oil - pour in light soy sauce or steamed fish soy sauce and serve

Additional content: - Notes: 1. The fins on the back of the mandarin fish are easy to hurt, so you need to be careful when handling them. It is best to cut them off with scissors. 2. The steaming time needs to be adjusted according to the size of the fish. The key to steaming the fish is to have enough water and steam to make a big fire
When handling mandarin fish, first cut off the dorsal and pectoral fins, and wear gloves to avoid being punctured by hard thorns.
After the water boils, place the fish plate and steam for six to ten minutes depending on the thickness of the fish. Turn off the heat and simmer for two minutes to make it more tender.
Pour away the fishy water on the plate and lay on top of shredded green onions. Pour hot oil over it and then add steamed fish soy sauce along the edge of the plate to avoid diluting the fish meat.

Case: For weekend family dinner, my mother scaled and gutted the mandarin fish, then cut a knife on the fish body, spread it with ginger and green onions, steamed it in a pan for eight minutes, poured hot oil and steamed fish soy sauce, and when it was served, the fish was tender and not fishy, ​​and the children picked up two bowls of rice.

items.id: 湖南家常红烧肉-湖南家常红烧肉
items.title: Hunan Home-style Braised Pork
items.core: Hunan Home-style Braised Pork is a home-cooked dish with a strong Hunan flavor. The pork belly is fat but not greasy after being slow-cooked. It is soft and glutinous in the mouth, with a salty aroma and a sweet aftertaste. Rich in high-quality protein and fat, it can provide the body with sufficient energy. The production requires some patience and is a challenge for novices, but it is not difficult to master by following the steps. The whole process is expected to take about 1 hour.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Pork belly with skin - Dried millet pepper 🌶 (depending on personal circumstances) - Ginger - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Bay leaves - Cinnamon - Star anise - Rock sugar - Cooking wine - Salt - Rock sugar (to lock oil and color) - Edible oil - Boiled water

Calculation: One serving is just enough for 2 people. - Pork belly: 500g - Edible oil: 10g - 5 bay leaves - 3 ginger slices - 1 small piece of cinnamon - 6 rock sugar - 20 grams of cooking wine - 5 grams of light soy sauce - 2 grams of dark soy sauce - 2 grams of salt - 3 star anise

Operation: 1. Wash the pork belly with skin and put it into the pot under cold water and add 2~3 pieces of ginger. Remove the fishy smell from the slices, boil until boiling, remove the cold water and rinse off the foam. 2. Cut the pork belly into cubes, size 1.5cm*1.5cm. 3. Add oil to the hot pot, add rock sugar and stir over low heat until caramel color. Add the sliced pork belly and stir-fry over medium heat until it gets color. 4. Add the prepared ginger slices, star anise, cinnamon, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, cooking wine, dried millet pepper, salt, and stir-fry over low heat 1 Minutes, add boiling water to cover the meat. 5. Cover and bring to a boil over medium heat, then turn to low heat and simmer for 30 minutes. During the slow simmering period, stir every 10 minutes to prevent sticking. 6. When one-third of the soup is simmered over low heat, turn to medium heat to reduce the sauce and remove from the pot.
Additional Content
Choose pork belly with three layers of fat and lean meat, cut into two centimeter squares, blanch and rinse with warm water to remove the scum.

When frying the sugar color, the heat will be low throughout. The sugar liquid will turn into maroon red and the meat will be removed immediately. If the color is too dark, it will have a bitter taste.
While stewing, heat the water to cover the meat surface, and finally use high heat to reduce the juice and keep turning so that each piece is coated with the sauce.

Case: There were guests at home over the weekend. My father cut the pork belly into pieces, blanched them and fried them to a sugary color. He added dried chili peppers and star anise and simmered it for 40 minutes.

items.id: 湘祁米夫鸭-湘祁米夫鸭
items.title: Xiangqi Mifu Duck
items.core: A traditional specialty dish from the Liangqi region of Hunan, duck meat is stir-fried and then wrapped in mixed rice flour and steamed. It has a soft and glutinous texture, a salty aroma and a long aftertaste. Duck meat is rich in high-quality protein and B vitamins. When paired with rice noodles, it provides energy and balanced nutrition. The preparation requires stir-frying and then high-pressure steaming, which is a little difficult and suitable for those who have a certain cooking foundation. It takes about 1 hour from preparation to cooking. If you choose old duck, you need to extend the steaming time.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Duck (must be freshly killed) - Glutinous rice flour - Rice flour - Steamed meat powder - Fine chili powder (add if spicy) - White pepper - Pork belly (optional or not) - Ginger and garlic - Salt - Edible oil - Boiled water

Calculation: Normally 3-4 people eat - Duck: 1000g - Glutinous rice flour: 100g - Rice flour: 300g - Steamed pork powder: 50g - Fine chili powder: 50g - White pepper: 5g - Pork belly: 50g - Ginger and garlic: 20g - Salt: 10g - Edible oil: 10g - Boiled water: 100g

Operation: 1. Mix glutinous rice flour, rice flour, steamed pork powder, fine chili powder, 5 grams of salt, and white pepper together. 2. Ask the enthusiastic stall owner to chop the duck into steaming pieces, slice the ginger, peel the garlic, and slice the pork belly. 3. Stir-fry the pork belly with cold oil in a hot pan until the oil is released, then add cooking oil to heat, add the duck and stir-fry. 4. Stir-fry the duck until the skin is charred and changes color, add ginger, garlic and salt and continue to stir-fry until fragrant. 5. Turn down the heat and stir-fry the rice noodles until the duck meat is evenly coated with the rice noodles. Add boiling water, a little at a time, and stir-fry while adding. 6. Stir-fry the duck meat and rice noodles until they feel moist. Scoop them out into a bowl, put water in the pressure cooker and steam for 20-25 minutes. 7. Sprinkle some chopped green onion before serving and enjoy

Additional content: This is a hometown dish. There is no limit on duck breeds. The one bought here is teal, the price is 24. Steam for 20 minutes, or more than an hour if it is old duck. In the first step, sticky rice flour is the main powder, glutinous rice flour adds a soft and glutinous texture, steamed pork powder adds a five-spice flavor, and chili powder and pepper add a complex flavor. Important steps are posted below for reference:
Blanch the duck pieces in cold water to remove the blood foam, and then stir-fry until the skin is slightly yellow, which can reduce the fishy smell and increase the aroma.
Rice flour can be mixed with glutinous rice flour and sticky rice flour at a ratio of 2:1. The texture will be softer and glutinous and will not spread easily.

The pressure will naturally release after 25 minutes of high-pressure steaming. For old duck, it needs to be extended for ten minutes. Make sure the duck meat can be easily removed from the bones before opening the lid.

Case: At the banquet in my hometown, my aunt first stir-fries the duck into duck fat, mixes it with rice noodles and watercress, puts it in a bowl and steams it under high pressure, then sprinkles chopped green onion over it, the rice noodles soak up the soup, and the duck meat is soft, glutinous and spicy, and relatives compete for more rice.

items.id: 澳门湿版免治牛肉饭-澳门湿版免治牛肉饭
items.title: Macau Wet Version Beef Rice
items.core: This is a classic Macau Portuguese-style fast food. The minced beef is tender and salty, wrapped in rich sauce and half-boiled egg liquid. It tastes oily and attractive after being mixed with rice. Ground beef provides high-quality protein, and when combined with eggs and onions, it is nutritionally balanced and filling. The operation steps are simple and easy to use, especially suitable for novices to try. It only takes about 30 minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: - Ground beef (can be replaced with slightly fatter minced pork) - Onions - Eggs - Butter (can be replaced with ordinary cooking oil) - Spring onions (optional) - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Tomato paste - White sugar - Cooking wine - Black pepper - Starch - Rice

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Each portion: - 200g minced beef - half onion - 1 egg (for making poached eggs or half-boiled omelette) - 3 tablespoons light soy sauce (1 tablespoon for marinating, 2 tablespoons for sauce) - half tablespoon dark soy sauce - 2 tablespoons tomato paste - half tablespoon sugar - 1 tablespoon cooking wine - 1 tablespoon starch - 50ml water

Operation: 1. Mix 200g Put the minced beef into a bowl, add 1 tablespoon light soy sauce, half a tablespoon sugar and 2g black pepper, stir well and wait for marinating for 10 minutes. 2. Cut half an onion into small cubes and set aside. 3. Prepare the sauce: Add 2 tablespoons of light soy sauce, 2 tablespoons of tomato paste, 1 tablespoon of cooking wine, 1 tablespoon of starch, half a tablespoon of dark soy sauce and 50ml of water in a bowl, stir well and set aside. 4. In another pot, make a poached egg or half-boiled omelette and set aside. 5. Heat the pan and add 10g of butter. After the butter melts, add the diced onions and fry over low heat until fragrant. 6. Add marinated minced beef and stir-fry with onions until beef changes color. 7. Pour in the prepared sauce, sprinkle with 2g of black pepper, continue to stir-fry until the soup becomes thick, then turn off the heat. 8. Pour the fried minced beef on the hot rice and top with the prepared poached eggs or half-boiled eggs. 9. (Optional) Sprinkle 5g of chopped green onion on the surface for decoration.

Additional content: - If you don’t have butter, you can also use ordinary cooking oil, but butter will add a unique milky flavor. - When eating, poke the half-cooked egg yolk and mix it with beef and rice for the best taste.
Choose minced beef with a fat-to-lean ratio of about 8:2. Stir-fry it until it turns white and then season it to keep it tender and smooth.
Saute the onions over low heat until soft and then add the minced beef. The sweetness will penetrate into the sauce and the texture will be richer when mixed with rice.
Boil the soft-boiled eggs in boiling water for six and a half minutes and then immediately soak them in ice water. The yolks will just run out when cut.

Case: On a weekday night, Xiao Li stir-fries the minced beef, then adds onions and soy sauce to stew it into a sauce. He puts it on the hot rice and then puts the soft-boiled egg. After mixing well, the meat is tender and fragrant. After more than 20 minutes, he is full and satisfied.

items.title: Grilled Chicken Wings
items.core: The marinated chicken wings are roasted at high temperature. The outside is slightly charred and the inside is tender and juicy, with the salty aroma of black pepper and soy sauce. Rich in high-quality protein and collagen. The difficulty level is moderate, and it can be easily picked up by novices. It takes about 1 hour from preparation to cooking. You can also add honey or allspice to enhance the flavor if you like.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Chicken wings - Salt - Black pepper - Soy sauce - Cooking wine - Oven

Calculation: - The amount of chicken wings is 3-4 pieces/person - The amount of salt is 2 g/person - The amount of black pepper is 1 g/person - The amount of soy sauce is 3 ml/person - The amount of cooking wine is 3 ml/person Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials planned to be used.

Operation: Pre-processing of chicken wings: 1. Put the chicken wings in a bowl 2. Add salt, black pepper, soy sauce, and cooking wine to marinate for 30-40 minutes. Baking process: 1. Preheat the oven to 200℃ 2. Place the marinated chicken wings evenly on the baking sheet 3. Place the baking sheet in the middle of the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes 4. Take out the baking sheet, turn the chicken wings over, and bake for another 15-20 minutes minutes until cooked

Additional content: - You can add honey, soy sauce, ginger and garlic powder, five-spice powder, etc. as seasonings when marinating the chicken wings to enhance the taste and aroma - When grilling the chicken wings, it is recommended to put a layer of tin foil on the bottom of the baking pan to facilitate cleaning of the baking pan
Score two knives on both sides of the chicken wings so that the marinade can penetrate into the meat more easily and the flavor will not just stay on the surface after grilling.
Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius in advance, and bake the middle layer with upper and lower heat for 20 minutes. Turn over halfway through to heat more evenly.
If you like the taste of honey, apply a thin layer in the last five minutes. Applying it too early may cause it to burn and become bitter.

Case: Before a dinner party with friends, Xiao Lin cut the chicken wings twice and marinated them with soy sauce, black pepper and minced garlic for half an hour. Then he put them in the oven and roasted them at 200 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes. When they came out of the oven, the skin was slightly charred and everyone ate while chatting.

items.title: Pan-fried lamb chops
items.core: A dish that is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a rich aroma. It is first stewed with spices and then pan-fried to create a golden crispy shell. Mutton is rich in high-quality protein and minerals such as iron and zinc, which helps warm and replenish qi and blood. The steps are slightly more, but as long as you follow the process, novices can master it; the whole process takes about 1 hour with a pressure cooker and 1.5 hours with an ordinary pot.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Lamb chops - Cinnamon bark - Sichuan peppercorns - Star anise - Angelica dahurica - Bay leaves - Salt - Cooking wine - Chili powder - Cumin grains - Barbeque sprinkles - Cumin powder - White sesame seeds - Sugar - Pressure cooker - Wok/frying pan

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 3-4 people. Each portion: - 750g lamb chops (it is recommended to choose the ones with some fat) - 2g cinnamon - 5g peppercorns - 1 star anise - 6g angelica - 5 bay leaves - 25g salt (Note: If you plan to drink the soup of lamb chops, the salt here is omitted in the stewing step and added in the final frying step) - 10ml cooking wine - 5g chili powder - Cumin grains 2g - Barbeque sprinkles 2g - Cumin powder 2g - White sesame seeds 2g - Sugar 1g

Operation: 1. Cut the lamb chops into pieces according to the bone distribution. 2. Add cold water to the wok, add all the lamb chops, continue to blanch for 2-3 minutes after the water boils, remove and set aside. 3. Put the blanched lamb chops, cinnamon bark, peppercorns, star anise, angelica root, bay leaves, and cooking wine into a pot (pressure cooker or ordinary pot). 4. Add drinking water to cover all ingredients. If using a pressure cooker, turn on the steam and pressure for 30 minutes. If using a regular pot, simmer for 80 minutes. 5. Take out the stewed lamb chops, drain them, and put them into a wok/frying pan without oil or water. 6. Fry over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes, until the fat in the lamb chops is fried and the surface is golden and crispy. 7. Keep the fried mutton oil in the pot, add chili powder, cumin seeds, barbecue seasonings, cumin powder, and white sesame seeds, and stir-fry evenly. 8. Add sugar and salt (if not added during the simmering step) and stir-fry evenly. 9. Stir until evenly stir-fried, then turn off the heat and serve on a plate.

Additional content:- Zanthoxylum bungeanum and Angelica dahurica are the key seasonings of this dish and are indispensable. - The stewing time should not be too long. If the lamb chops are too soft, they will easily break during frying. - When frying, the fat from the lamb chop itself is used to stir-fry the seasonings for a better flavor. - A lot of suet will be produced during blanching, stewing, and frying. Please be careful not to pour it directly into the sewer when handling it to prevent blockage.
The lamb chops are first blanched in cold water to remove the blood foam, and then stewed with ginger slices, Sichuan peppercorns and cooking wine. The mutton smell will be significantly reduced.
After stewing until soft, be sure to wipe off the surface moisture, then heat the pan and fry with less oil to form a golden and crispy shell.
Fry each side for two to three minutes. If you turn it over too often, it will lose its charred crust. After taking it out of the pan, let it sit for five minutes before cutting.

Case: Winter Solstice family banquet, the host blanched the lamb chops and stewed them with ginger slices, peppercorns and salt until tender, then fried them in a hot pan until golden brown on all sides, the ribs were charred and the meat was juicy. After it was served, it was quickly shared by the family.

items.title: Steak
items.core: This is a classic Western-style pan-fried steak. The tender and juicy meat heart is wrapped in a caramelized shell. It is paired with butter, garlic and herbs, and has a rich flavor. Rich in high-quality protein, oil and minerals such as iron and zinc. The cooking process is relatively beginner-friendly, but mastering the heat still requires some practice and can be completed in 15-30 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Pan (cast iron pan is recommended if possible) - Tinfoil (optional) - Kitchen paper (optional) - Spoon - Steak, see how to choose different types of steak - Olive oil (extra virgin olive oil is recommended) - Butter - Salt (large grain sea salt is recommended) - Black pepper (coarse grain freshly ground black pepper is recommended) - Garlic - Spices (optional, rosemary or thyme is recommended, try to use fresh plant branches instead of ground spices) - Premade steak sauce (optional) - Side dishes (optional, prepare according to preference, here we recommend asparagus, mushrooms, small tomatoes, small potatoes, choose 1-2 of them)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Per portion: - Steak 450-500g (two steaks) - 2g black pepper - 5g salt - 1 garlic (about 25-30g, the actual amount is about 5-10g) - Olive oil 10-15ml - Butter 20-25g - 5-10 mushrooms - 5-10 small potatoes (about 20g each) - Small tomatoes 5-10 pieces (about 15g each) - 2g thyme (if using fresh thyme branches, take 3-6 branches, each about 10cm long)

Operation: Preparation: 1. Take the steak out of the refrigerator and defrost it. - If the steak is frozen, transfer it to the refrigerator the night before and let it sit at room temperature half an hour before cooking. - Do not place steak in water or heat to defrost. 2. Wash the small tomatoes, small potatoes and mushrooms, cut them in half and set aside. 3. Peel the garlic, leaving 5-8 larger garlic cloves, flatten them with the back of a knife and set aside. 4. Preparing the Steak - For ribeye steaks (see How to Choose Different Types of Steaks), use kitchen scissors inserted vertically into the center of the ribeye steak and make 1-2 cuts into the connective tissue. This is because the "eye" (that is, the connective tissue) of rib-eye steak will shrink violently at high temperatures, causing the steak to deform, making it impossible for the steak to be heated evenly. - For sirloin steak, if you don't like the fat on the sides of the sirloin steak, slowly remove it with a knife. - Then, wrap the steak with kitchen paper and absorb all the water attached to the steak until no obvious water stains are left when the steak is placed on the chopping board and picked up. Cooking: NOTE: This process is suitable for steaks 2-3cm thick, 5-7 done. If you prefer a different doneness, consider increasing or shortening the first half of the frying time by 20-30%. 1. Turn on the stove to high heat (see the appendix for instructions on heat), add olive oil to the pot, and heat the pot for 15-30 seconds. 2. Marinate the steak. Sprinkle the sea salt and black pepper evenly over the entire surface of the steak and rub it with your hands so that the salt and pepper particles are embedded into the meat as much as possible. Note that the steak needs to be cooked immediately after marinating. It is not recommended to marinate the steak in advance. This is because the salt applied on the surface will precipitate the moisture in the beef, affecting the cooking process and losing the flavor. 3. Heat the pan until the oil temperature is 60-80% (see oil temperature judgment tips), and slowly put the steak into the pan from near to far. 4. If you are using potatoes as a side dish, place the potatoes in a bowl and microwave for 10 minutes, or boil them in boiling water for 3-5 minutes. 5. Cook on one side for 1.5 minutes (This time is for steaks approximately 2-3cm thick. If your steak is thinner, consider reducing this time to 1 minute. If your steak is thicker, consider increasing this time to 2-2.5 minutes.) 6. Flip and cook for another 1.5 minutes. - For sirloin and filet mignon, you will need to use chopsticks or a spatula to hold the steak upright and sear it on the sides for about 30 seconds. 7. Turn the stove to medium heat and quickly add the butter, garlic, and thyme in that order. Use a spatula to quickly spread the butter in the pan until completely melted. Press the garlic under the steak for added flavor. 8. Place the pan on the stove at an angle so that all the oil flows to one side of the pan. 9. Place the spices and garlic on top of the steak, spoon in the oil from the pan and drizzle over the steak continuously. Continue this process for 30 seconds, then turn the steak over and repeat the process for another 30 seconds. - You can tell the current heat level by looking at the way the oil pours on the surface of the steak. If the oil bubbles when drizzled over the steak and the color of the oil does not turn dark brown, the oil is at the right temperature. - If your steak is not wiped clean or defrosted in a way that is not recommended, or salted in advance, a large amount of water will appear in the pot, causing the steak to be "cooked" in the end and lose its flavor. - If there are a lot of oil bubbles on the surface of the steak and the color of the oil turns dark brown, it means the oil temperature is too high. You need to remove the pot from the stove and wait for a while before continuing to pour the oil. 10. Place the steak on a chopping board, wrap it in foil and wait for 5-10 minutes. The purpose of this process (called thawing) is to use the steak's own temperature to continue heating it and lock in the moisture. 11. Add the side dishes (potatoes, tomatoes, mushrooms) to the pot and fry over medium heat for 5 minutes. 12. Take out the steak and cut it into 1.5cm wide strips with a knife. At this time you can observe the doneness of the beef. 13. Take out the side dishes, put them on a plate, and pour the remaining oil in the pan or steak sauce (optional)

Additional content: Control of heat: Frying steak is the art of controlling heat. Due to space limitations, here are some methods for quantitatively evaluating fire power and fire-related terms used in this article. For more information, see Oil Temperature Judgment Tips. - For induction cooker: - High fire: Power 1.8Kw - 2.2kw. - Medium fire: power 800w - 1.4kw. - Small fire: power 200w - 600w. - For gas stoves: - High flame: Turn the gas valve to 70%-90% of the maximum gas outlet speed. - Medium heat: Rotate the air valve to 40%-60% of the maximum air outlet speed. - Low fire: Rotate the air valve to 10%-30% of the maximum air outlet speed. Regarding seasoning: Seasoning your steak does not necessarily need to follow the specifications of this guide. Generally speaking, garlic, black pepper, and butter are a must, but if you don't like flavors like rosemary or thyme, like labiatae, feel free to try other steak seasonings for flavor. There are also a variety of barbecue seasoning salts available on the market to choose from. The author once discovered a way to combine Chinese and Western methods, which is to add spicy cut millet and garlic slices to fry in olive oil, and then pour it on the steak as a seasoning, which also has a unique flavor.
Remove the steak from the refrigerator and let it warm for 20 minutes before frying, and dry it with kitchen paper to avoid burning on the outside and cooking on the inside.
Put the steak in the pot until it is smoking slightly. Don't flip it in a hurry on the first side, so that the caramelized shell will be stable.
Medium-rare can be taken out of the pan when the core temperature is about 55 degrees Celsius. Let it sit for five minutes before cutting to lock in the gravy.

Case: For anniversary dinner, Xiao Zhang warmed up the sirloin steak in advance and wiped it dry. He added butter and garlic cloves in a hot pan and fried both sides until fragrant. After letting it sit for a few minutes, it turned pink when cut and tasted fresh and juicy.

items.title: Pork skin jelly
items.core: Pork skin jelly is a traditional cold dish common in northern New Year's Eve dinners. It is crystal clear and has a smooth and chewy texture. It is especially suitable for drinking. Pig skin is rich in collagen and has beauty and beauty effects. This dish is a bit more difficult, requiring patience to remove the fishy smell from the pig skin and long cooking time, and is expected to take about 24 hours to make.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Pork rinds - aniseed, peppercorns, angelica dahurica, cinnamon, cloves, bay leaves, fennel

Calculation: per serving: * Ingredients: 1kg pig rinds, 4kg water * Seasonings: 13g salt, 10g MSG, 15g chicken essence, 50ml light soy sauce, 20ml dark soy sauce, 10g green onions, 10g green onions, 20g ginger slices * Spice bag: 10g star anise, 5g Sichuan pepper

Operation: 1. Chop the pig skin into small pieces no more than 10cm, soak in water for 12 hours, then put it in cold water, add 10g ginger and 50ml cooking wine, blanch for 5-10 minutes, remove and put into cold water 2. Place the blanched pig skin on the chopping board, remove all the white meat inside, and then cut it into strips no longer than 3mm, and put it into a basin. 3. Add 20g of white vinegar, 5g of salt, scrub for 3 minutes, and then rinse with water. The pig skin at this time has almost no fishy smell. 4. Add 4kg of water to the pot, add the pig skin, 10g of green onions, 10g of ginger slices, and star anise. 10g, 5g Sichuan peppercorns, bring to a boil over high heat, then simmer over low heat for 90 minutes until the pig skin is soft. 5. Add 8g salt, 10g MSG, 15g chicken essence, 50ml light soy sauce, 20ml dark soy sauce, season, pour into a plate, pick out the onion, ginger and star anise, let cool until jelly-like 6. Refrigerate, cut into small pieces or thick slices when eating

Additional content: - When operating, you need to pay attention. When making pig skin jelly, it will be "waste" if you cook it directly in the pot. This is also the most taboo. You must wash the pig skin continuously with white vinegar and salt. This will ensure that the cooked pig skin is crystal clear and has no fishy smell - Reference: Ming Ge talks about delicious food
Pork skin must be boiled until soft and then the oil and hair roots on the inside are scraped off. This is the key to removing the fishy smell and obtaining a clear taste.
Don’t use too little water when cooking, keep it boiling over low heat, filter out the impurities after the soup thickens, and then pour it into the mold.
Refrigerate for at least eight hours before cutting. Dip a knife in warm water to cut more neatly, or dip it in garlic paste and vinegar to relieve greasiness.

Case: To prepare New Year’s dishes during the twelfth lunar month, grandma scraped off the fat from the pig skin and blanched it repeatedly, then added ginger slices and simmered it for two hours, filtered the juice and refrigerated it overnight.

items.title: Pork stew with sauerkraut
items.core: Pork braised with sauerkraut is a northern home-style stew with rich sour aroma, soft pork belly and delicious ribs. Mainly providing protein, sauerkraut also brings beneficial ingredients such as lactic acid bacteria. The steps are clear and novices can complete it step by step, but it requires patience and slow cooking, which takes about 3 hours from start to finish.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Pork belly or pork ribs * Northeastern pickled cabbage * Green onions * Ginger * Garlic * Salt * Light soy sauce * Five-spice powder * Cooking wine * Aniseed

Calculation: According to the amount for 3-5 people: * 1500 grams of pork ribs or pork belly (total) * 1000 grams of Northeastern pickled cabbage * 1 green onion * 100 grams of ginger * 4 cloves of garlic * 10 grams of salt * 15 grams of light soy sauce * 10 grams of five-spice powder * 20 ml of cooking wine * 2 aniseeds

Operation: 1. Cut green onions into sections; cut 50 grams of ginger into sections and mince 50 grams; mince garlic and set aside. 2. Cut all the sauerkraut into shreds, rinse with water 2 to 3 times and set aside. -The number of rinses depends on personal taste. If you like sour taste, you can rinse it 2 times. If you are afraid of the sour smell, you can rinse it 3 to 4 times. You can't not rinse it, otherwise it will be too acidic. 3. Put the ribs and pork belly into the pot and pour in cold water to cover. Add all green onion segments, 50 g ginger segments and 20 ml cooking wine. Bring to a boil and wait 5 minutes. Turn off the heat, take out the ribs and pork belly, rinse with cold water to remove the scum, and set aside. 4. Slice or cut the cooked pork belly into cubes and set aside. 5. Wash the previous pot and dry it (otherwise the oil will collapse when added). 6. Add oil to the pot, turn on medium heat, add minced ginger and garlic and sauté until fragrant, add pork belly and ribs. Fry the pork belly and ribs until golden brown, add 10 grams of five-spice powder and 15 grams of light soy sauce, and stir with a spatula for 1 to 2 minutes. 7. Add the rinsed sauerkraut shreds to the pot and stir-fry for 3 minutes. 8. Pour in purified water until the ingredients are just covered, add 2 aniseed, and turn up the heat until the water in the pot boils. Turn to medium heat, cover and simmer. 9. Wait for 1.5 to 2 hours until the pork belly is tender (you can easily pierce it with chopsticks) 10. Open the lid of the pot, turn on high heat to remove the soup, stir the ingredients in the pot until the remaining water in the pot only covers the bottom of the pot, turn down the heat and prepare for seasoning. 11. Seasoning: add 10 grams of edible salt and stir evenly. 12. Turn off the heat and remove from the pot.

Additional content: - When the soup is boiling over high heat, be careful not to burn the pot. You can check the water level by turning it appropriately. - Seasoning skills, when adding salt at the end, you can add it little by little, stir and taste until the taste is acceptable - This dish has the special flavor of sauerkraut
Squeeze out the water from the sauerkraut before stir-frying it to remove excess acidic water and make the flavor more concentrated.
The pork belly and pork ribs are first stir-fried until the surface is slightly brown and then stewed. The meat will be more fragrant and the soup will not be bland.
Keep the stew on low heat for at least ninety minutes. The ribs are deboned and the sauerkraut tastes best when they are transparent.

Case: Stew at home in the winter in the north. My mother sautéed the pork belly and ribs, added sauerkraut and simmered for more than two hours. She sprinkled garlic sprouts before taking it out of the pot.

items.title: Sweet and Spicy Grilled Whole Wings
items.core: This sweet and spicy grilled whole wing is cooked in the air fryer, with a slightly charred exterior and juicy interior. The sweet yet spicy flavor is a hit. Chicken is rich in high-quality protein. Using air frying instead of deep-frying greatly reduces the fat and makes it lighter to eat. The production process is clear and simple. You only need to marinate it in advance and turn it over halfway. It is also friendly to novices. It takes about 3 hours from processing the ingredients to taking it out of the pot, most of which is the time of resting and marinating, so the actual operation is not cumbersome.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Air fryer - Whole chicken wings - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Garlic powder - Pepper powder - Sugar - Bell pepper powder - Chili powder - Oyster sauce - Water - Oil - Tinfoil plate - Plastic wrap

Calculation: One serving is a meal for one person, and the number of meals for multiple people increases in equal proportions. One serving: - 4 whole chicken wings - 45ml light soy sauce - 15ml dark soy sauce - 10g garlic powder - 5g pepper powder - 10g sugar - 10g bell pepper powder - 5g chili powder - 15ml oyster sauce - 20ml water - 10ml oil

Operation: 1. Take out 4 fresh chicken wings, use a knife to cut the skin between the two bones in the wings, and cut the skin once on each side. 2. Put the 4 chicken wings into a bowl, add 45ml of light soy sauce, 15ml of dark soy sauce, 10g of garlic powder, 5g of pepper, 10g of sugar, 10g of sweet pepper powder, 5g of chili powder, and oyster sauce. 15ml, water 20ml and oil 10ml 3. Use a spoon to spread the sauce evenly on the whole chicken wings, especially the knife edges in the wings, it will take about 3 minutes. 4. Cover the bowl of oil-proof marinated chicken wings with plastic wrap and put it in the refrigerator to rest for 120 minutes. 5. Take out the chicken whole wings, put 4 chicken wings in the tin foil plate, and pour the remaining sauce in the bowl evenly over the chicken wings 6. Place the foil plate on the baking basket of the air fryer and bake at 200 degrees Celsius for 25 minutes. 7. Open the air fryer, carefully remove the foil plate, and turn the chicken wings over. 8. Continue to bake at 200 degrees Celsius for 25 minutes. 9. Take it out and serve.

Additional content: - The taste of the chicken whole wings in this example is slightly spicy. If you need to increase the spiciness, please increase the amount of chili powder, but it should not exceed 30g - The whole chicken wings refer to the chicken wings including the tip, middle and root of the wings - The effect of this product is slightly burnt, if you don't like the burnt brown appearance, do not pour the remaining sauce into the tin foil plate and bake each side for only 20 minutes - The actual grilling effect depends on the power of your air fryer - Bell pepper powder plays a role in adding color and flavor, but cannot be used as a spicy agent by itself. - The marinating time can be controlled freely, and it is recommended to be between 60 minutes and 180 minutes. - The tin foil plate that has just been taken out of the pot is relatively hot, so please use tongs to pick it up or use an insulating material such as a wet rag to handle it.
Marinate the whole wings for at least one hour. If time is tight, you can also use a toothpick to prick holes to help the sweet and spicy flavor penetrate into the meat.
The air fryer starts at 180 degrees Celsius, turning it over once in the middle to avoid overdrying one side and losing the flavor on the other.
Drain excess marinade from the surface of the wings before grilling, otherwise water will easily appear and the edges will burn, affecting the taste of the skin.

Case: Before watching a drama in the evening, Xiao Zhou marinated the whole wings in sweet and spicy sauce for two hours, then put them in the air fryer and baked them at 180 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes, flipped them over and grilled them for another ten minutes. The skin of the wings was slightly charred and juicy, and his family said it was more refreshing than takeout.

items.title: Stuffed snails
items.core: Stuffed snails are the first among Yangshuo's "Eighteen Brews". The snail meat is tough and firm, the pork is tender and smooth, and the perilla mint is fragrant. It has been featured in "A Bite of China 2". Rich in protein and a variety of trace elements, snail meat and pork are nutritionally complementary. This dish has a few steps and is a challenge for novices. You need to let the snails spit out the sand half a day in advance. It takes about 40 minutes to make it. It is suitable for the whole family to make together during holidays.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Large snails (table tennis size, about 20-25 pieces, buy them in the morning and let them spit out sand all afternoon) - Pork (250g, the fat-to-lean ratio is 3:7, the front meat is best) - Fresh mint leaves (a small handful, the finishing touch) - Perilla leaves (a small handful, a perfect match with the snails) - Ginger (1 small piece) - Onions (2 stalks) - Guilin Sanhua Wine - Light soy sauce - Salt - Edible oil - Pickled bamboo shoots (optional, 50g) - Garlic (optional, 4-5 cloves) - Dried chili peppers (optional, 3-4 pcs) - Oyster sauce (optional) - Starch (optional) - White pepper (optional)

Calculation: per serving (2-3 people): - 20 large field snails (about 1000g) - 250g pork - 10g fresh mint leaves - 10g perilla leaves - 1 small piece of ginger (about 15g) - 2 green onions (about 30g) - Guilin Sanhua wine 15ml - 30ml light soy sauce (15ml of which Stuffing, 15ml seasoning soup) - 5g salt - 30ml cooking oil - 50g pickled bamboo shoots (optional) - 5 cloves garlic (optional, about 20g) - 4 dried chili peppers (optional) - 10ml oyster sauce (optional) - 10g starch (optional) - 2g white pepper (optional)

Operation: Sand spitting (half a day in advance): 1. Buy the snails in the morning, put them in a basin of clean water, and let them sit for an afternoon to spit out the sand. 2. Drop a few drops of sesame oil (or mustard~) in the water to speed up the sand spitting. Handling the snails: 1. Use a brush to clean the snail shell (this step can take longer) 2. Use a vise or kitchen knife to cut off the tail of the snail (cut off about 1/3 to half) 3. Boil water in a large pot, add the snails and blanch them for 1-2 minutes (the time should not be too long, the snail meat will become old) 4. Remove the snail meat with a toothpick, remove the snail cover and black mud sausage 5. Rinse the snail shell with water, shake off the water and set aside. To make the filling: 1. Wash the snail meat with salt and chop it into pieces (do not mince it into puree, keep the grain texture to have a chewy texture) 2. Chop the pork into minced meat 3. Chop mint leaves and perilla leaves, mince ginger, and chop green onions. 4. Put minced snail meat, minced pork, mint, perilla, ginger, and chopped green onion into a bowl. 5. Add 15ml of Sanhua wine, 15ml of light soy sauce, and 3g of salt. 6. Optional addition: 10ml of oyster sauce, 2g of white pepper, and 10g of starch. 7. Stir in one direction until the filling becomes thick and thick. 8. To save trouble, put everything above directly into the meat blender and beat it directly. Brewing: 1. Use chopsticks to stuff the filling into the snail shell, try to stuff it as tightly as possible, but do not burst the snail shell. 2. Stuff all the snails in turn. Stew: 1. Heat the pot, pour 30ml cooking oil, optionally add sour bamboo shoots and dried chili peppers to stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Pour in about 300ml of water or stock, add 15ml of light soy sauce, 2g of salt, and bring to a boil over high heat 3. Put the stuffed snails into the pot, cover the pot, and simmer over medium-low heat for 10 minutes. 4. Do not stir frequently during the simmering process. Wait until the meat filling is mature and set, then stir gently. 5. Open the lid, add the remaining fresh mint leaves and perilla leaves, and simmer for another 2-3 minutes. 6. Reduce the juice over high heat until the soup is thick, and take it out of the pot.

Additional content: - How to eat: first suck the soup in the shell, then use a toothpick to pick out or suck out the meat filling with your mouth - "Put the snail against your lips and inhale fiercely" - The best ratio of snail meat to pork is 1:1 - Mint is the essence of this dish, perilla and snails are a perfect match, at least one of the two is required - If there is no Sanhua wine, you can use cooking wine instead, but the flavor will be compromised - The blanching time must be short, as the snail meat will become old and hard over time - Pairing it with ice-cold Liquan beer is a standard way of eating in Yangshuo - Reference: Yangshuo snail brew_Baidu Encyclopedia
The snails are first soaked in clean water with a little salt and left to vomit sand for more than half a day. During this period, the water is changed twice, and they taste good.
Chop the snail meat and mix it with fat and lean pork at a ratio of one to two, and add perilla and mint to make it more tender and fragrant.
Arrange the stuffed snails on a plate with the opening facing up to prevent the fillings from falling out, and collect the thick soup before serving to make it more delicious.

Case: When I returned to Yangshuo during the National Day, my cousin made the snails spit sand one day in advance. At dinner, she mixed the snail meat and pork and perilla and stuffed it back into the snail shell to stew.

items.title: tomato red sauce
items.core: This Italian-style sauce is fragrant and delicious, and the combination of vegetables and beef brings a rich taste. It is rich in protein and multiple vitamins and has balanced nutrition. The production process is a little tedious and requires some cooking basics, such as stir-frying grainy beef and slow cooking under controlled heat. It takes about an hour from preparation to completion. You can make more batches at a time and freeze them for storage. It is very convenient to take and use at any time.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Ground beef - Garlic cloves - Carrots - Celery - Onion - Olive oil - Sugar - Salt - Pepper - Tomato paste - Milk - Dried basil or thyme (optional)
Calculation: per portion: - 500g minced beef - 2 garlic cloves - half a carrot - one celery - half an onion - olive oil - 2g sugar - 10g salt - 5g black pepper - 300g tomato paste - 300ml milk

Operation: 1. Chop carrots, celery, onions, and slice garlic cloves. 2. Add 10ml olive oil, heat the vegetables and stir-fry over high heat until they begin to change color slightly, then remove. 3. Add 10ml of oil to the pot, add garlic and stir-fry for 10 seconds. Add ground beef, sugar, salt, pepper and spices and stir-fry the beef until crispy (grainy). 4. Add the fried vegetables and tomato paste and continue to stir-fry until evenly mixed. 5. Slowly pour in the milk several times and cook over medium-low heat for 30 minutes until done.

Additional content: - Considering that the salt content in each brand of tomato sauce is different, it is recommended to add less salt when frying the beef, and taste it before seasoning. - Please stir while the sauce is cooking to avoid sticking to the pan. If the sauce becomes thick, it’s ready to serve! - Depending on personal taste, replace the ground beef with half ground pork and half ground beef, and replace the milk with chicken broth or drinking water.
Put the minced beef into the pot and stir-fry it first, then stir-fry it until it is slightly charred. When it becomes grainy, the sauce will be more fragrant and layered.
Peel the tomatoes and cut into small cubes. Add a small amount of tomato paste and fry together to make the red sauce brighter and more flavorful.
Simmer the sauce over low heat until a spoon can be traced across the bottom of the pot. After cooling, divide into portions and freeze. Thaw and heat before use.

Case: When preparing meals on the weekend, Xiao Chen sautéed onions, tomatoes and minced beef, then simmered it into a pot of red sauce, divided it into three boxes and froze it. After cooking the pasta, he only had to heat it and pour it over, and he had a rich dinner in ten minutes.

items.title: Lean Potato Chips
items.core: A quick home-cooked stir-fry, the meat slices are smooth and tender, the potato slices are soft and tasty, and have the fragrance of garlic sprouts. It is a typical home-cooked dish. Lean meat is rich in high-quality protein and iron, and potatoes provide carbohydrates and dietary fiber in a balanced combination. The production process is simple and straightforward, requiring attention to knife skills and heat. It is suitable for novices with a certain foundation to try. From preparation to serving, it should take about 1 hour to complete.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Pure lean meat - Potatoes - Garlic sprouts - Cornstarch (cornstarch or other starches) - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Edible salt
Calculation: version for 1 person - 200g pure lean meat - 200g potatoes - 2 garlic sprouts (about 20 g) - 5g cornstarch - 10g light soy sauce - 3g dark soy sauce - 2g edible salt

Operation: 1. Peel the potatoes, cut in half, and then cut into about 2mm slices, set aside. 2. Wash the garlic sprouts, cut into sections of about 1cm, set aside. 3. Wash the lean meat, cut into about 2mm slices, put it in a bowl, add 5g cornstarch, 5g light soy sauce, 3g dark soy sauce and marinate for ten minutes, set aside. 4. When marinating lean meat, boil a pot of water, put potato slices into the pot, and blanch for about 5 minutes. 5. Heat the pot and put 10ml - 15ml cooking oil in the pot. Wait 10 seconds for the oil temperature to rise. 6. Add the lean meat and stir-fry until it changes color. Add the garlic sprouts and stir-fry the garlic sprouts for about 20 seconds. 7. Add the potatoes, keep stirring, add 2g of edible salt and 5g of light soy sauce. 8. Stir-fry for about 3 minutes and serve on a plate.
Additional content: - Be careful not to blanch potato slices for too long to prevent them from becoming soft - Stir the marinated lean meat evenly
Cut the lean meat into thin slices against the grain, add light soy sauce, cooking wine, starch and a little oil to mix well, marinate for ten minutes to make it smoother and more tender.
Cut the potatoes into thin slices and soak them in water for five minutes, drain them and put them in the pot. This can remove the starch and keep the crispy texture.
Smooth the meat and scoop it out first, then fry the potatoes until the edges are translucent, and finally return to the pot and stir-fry to prevent the meat from burning for a long time.

Case: After get off work, the refrigerator only had lean meat and potatoes. She cut the meat into thin slices against the grain to capture the starch, soaked the potatoes in thin slices, stir-fried them quickly in a hot pan, sprinkled with garlic sprouts, and served it with rice in about 20 minutes. The meat slices were smooth and tender.

items.title: Braised Vermicelli with Cabbage and Pork
items.core: Stewed vermicelli with pork and cabbage is a classic home-cooked stew in the Northeast. The soup is rich and salty, the pork belly is soft and rotten, the vermicelli is smooth and tasty after absorbing the aroma of the meat, and the cabbage is sweet and soothing. The whole dish has a balanced mix of meat and vegetables, which can provide protein, vitamins and carbohydrates, making it nutritious and filling. The production process requires some patience, especially the handling of vermicelli and the simmering temperature, which is a certain challenge for novices, but it is not easy to fail if you follow the steps. It takes about 45 minutes to serve from beginning to end.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Pork belly - Cabbage - Dried potato vermicelli - Thirteen spices - Chicken essence - Edible salt - Dark soy sauce - Light soy sauce
Calculation: per serving: - 300g pork belly - 500g Chinese cabbage - 50g dried potato vermicelli - 10g Shisanxiang - 5g chicken essence - 15g edible salt - 5ml dark soy sauce - 5ml light soy sauce

Operation: 1. Boil water in the pot, add dry vermicelli after boiling, boil for 5 minutes, pour out the water together with the container, cover the lid and continue to soak and set aside (do this first, you can do the following steps in the meantime) 2. Cut the pork belly into 3mm slices, set aside 3. Separate the young Chinese cabbage leaves and cabbage sticks into 2 slices, set aside 4. Heat the pot, and put 10ml - 15ml cooking oil in the pot. Wait 10 seconds for the oil temperature to rise. 5. Add pork belly and stir-fry until the meat changes color. 6. Add dark soy sauce and stir-fry for 1 minute to color the meat. 7. Add cabbage dumplings, salt and light soy sauce, stir-fry for one minute (if it sticks to the pan, add 10ml of water) 8. Add water to cover all ingredients, add chicken essence and thirteen spices. After boiling, turn down the heat and wait for 20 minutes. 9. Drain the water and cut the vermicelli into small pieces and put it into a bowl. Set aside. 10. Add the young cabbage leaves and stir-fry well. Place the vermicelli on top of the vegetable, cover and cook for another 5 minutes. 11. Taste, turn off the heat and let the juice reduce.

Additional content: - Dried potato vermicelli takes a long time to cook. You can put it in the first step and perform other steps during the process. - Taste the last step. If you find that it tastes light and undercooked, continue to cover and cook for a while.

Soak the vermicelli in warm water in advance until it is soft enough to bend. Do not soak it until it becomes rotten. It will absorb the flavor more easily and will not burn easily after being put into the pot.
Stir-fry the pork belly over low heat to remove the fat, then stir-fry the onion, ginger and cabbage. The soup base will be more fragrant and not greasy.
Add water to cover the cabbage, simmer and then turn down the heat to low, add the vermicelli to the pot and simmer for five to eight minutes to reduce the juice.

Case: There were guests at home on the weekend. He stir-fried the pork belly to remove the oil, added cabbage and hot water to stew until soft. Finally, he added soaked sweet potato vermicelli to reduce the juice. When it was served, the vermicelli was full of meaty aroma and the cabbage was sweet. The guests even added a bowl of rice.

items.id: 空气炸锅脆皮现腌炸鸡-空气炸锅脆皮现腌炸鸡
items.title: Air fryer crispy marinated fried chicken
items.core: Air fryer fried chicken is a home-style meat dish that is first marinated and then fried. It has a crispy outer shell and juicy interior. The seasoning can be flexibly switched according to taste. Chicken wings are rich in high-quality protein and fat and are suitable as a main course or snack. The actual operation takes about 55-70 minutes (including the first coating with flour; if you choose the second coating, it will take about 70-90 minutes). If you want the best effect, you can refrigerate and marinate overnight (prepare one day in advance and fry the next day).
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Fresh chicken wings - Light soy sauce - Garlic powder - Paprika (red bell pepper powder) - Onion powder - Black pepper - All-purpose flour - Starch (cornstarch or potato starch will work) - Cooking oil (for spraying or brushing) - Air fryer - Yogurt or milk (optional, helps the meat to be more tender) - Eggs (optional, helps form a fuller shell) - Baking powder (optional, helps form a crispier crust)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. This recipe is written for 1 serving (6 chicken wings, approximately 300g) and will fit in one layer in most air fryers. 1 portion: - 6 chicken wings (about 300g) - 15ml light soy sauce - 5ml yogurt or milk (optional) - 1 egg (optional, for batter) - 13g garlic powder - 10g paprika (red pepper powder) - 5g onion powder - 5g black pepper - 60g all-purpose flour - 30g starch - 1g baking powder - Edible oil 5ml

Operation: Marinate chicken wings (one night in advance): 1. Wash the chicken wings and dry them. Score 2 knives on both sides of each chicken wing for easy flavoring. 2. Prepare marinade: 15ml light soy sauce, 8g garlic powder, 5g red bell pepper powder, 3g onion powder, 3g black pepper powder, 5ml milk or Greek yogurt (optional, to make the chicken more tender) and mix well. 3. Put the marinade and chicken wings into a large zip bag, stir and massage thoroughly, and let rest in the refrigerator overnight. Breading powder preparation: 4. Breading powder: 60g all-purpose flour, 30g starch, 5g garlic powder, 5g red bell pepper powder, 2g onion powder, 2g black pepper powder, 1g baking powder (optional, make the shell crisper) and mix well. 5. Battering batter (optional): 1 egg, 5ml milk or water, beaten thoroughly. Breading in flour: 6. Breading in flour: Shake dry the water from the chicken wings, put them into the breading flour and press lightly, shake off the excess flour, and let it sit aside for 10 minutes. 7. Coating (optional): If you want a fuller crust, you can coat it with another layer of batter, and then repeat the coating step. - Add the batter to the chicken wings that have been left to rest, and then gently shake off the excess batter. - Add the breading flour again, press gently and shake off excess flour. - Let it sit aside for 20 minutes (it can be longer if necessary, the shell will be stronger and not easy to fall off). Frying: 8. Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 5 minutes. 9. Brush the frying basket with thin oil, put the chicken skin side down, and spray or brush the chicken wings with thin oil. 10. Set the air fryer to 180°C and fry for 10 minutes. 11. Open the frying basket and turn it over, spray or brush a thin layer of oil on the surface of the chicken wings, and fry at 180°C for 6 minutes. 12. Observe the color of the chicken skin and prick the thickest part with a toothpick to see if there is blood flowing out. 13. If necessary, fry at 200°C for another 1-2 minutes to add crispiness and color (it can be done iteratively, first fry for 1 minute and observe before deciding whether to continue).

Extras:- This recipe can also be used to fry bone-in chicken drumsticks, just adjust the amount of ingredients and frying time accordingly. - The amount of garlic powder, red bell pepper powder and onion powder can be adjusted according to personal taste. - If you want to make it spicy: add 3g of chili powder to the breading powder, or sprinkle 2g of chili powder after taking it out of the pan. - If you want to make cumin flavor: Sprinkle 2g of cumin powder and 2g of white sesame seeds after serving. - It is not recommended to stack chicken wings, as this will cause insufficient heating of the contact surface and the shell will not be crisp enough.
Slice the chicken wings twice on both sides and marinate them with yogurt or soy sauce and garlic paste for more than 30 minutes, so that the flavor can penetrate into the meat.
Let the surface of the chicken wings dry slightly before coating them in flour, and apply a thin layer of starch to make them crispier and less likely to lose flour.
Fry at 190 degrees for 12 minutes, turn over and brush with a little oil, and fry for another 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown.

Case: The child wanted to eat fried chicken on Saturday night. She marinated the chicken wings with a knife and then coated them in starch. She flipped the chicken wings in the air fryer and brushed them with oil. After more than 20 minutes, the outer shell was golden and crispy, and it was still juicy when cut into pieces. Eating it with lettuce was more refreshing than taking out.

items.title: Steamed Pork
items.core: Steamed pork with rice flour is a classic Chinese steamed dish with rich aroma and soft and glutinous texture. It is a widely popular home-style flavor. Pork belly provides high-quality protein and fat, and is nutritionally balanced when paired with root vegetables such as potatoes. This dish is suitable for those with some cooking experience and takes about 90 minutes from prep to finish.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - 500g pork belly (alternatively fat and lean) - 100g steamed pork rice noodles (Lee Kum Kee or homemade is recommended) - 15ml light soy sauce - 10ml dark soy sauce - 15ml cooking wine - 10g Pixian bean paste (optional) - 10g minced ginger - 10g minced garlic - 5g white sugar - 300g potatoes (or pumpkin 300g, as base ingredient) - 2000ml water (for steamer)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 3 people. Each serving: - Pork belly 250g - Steamed pork rice noodles 50g - Light soy sauce 7.5ml - Dark soy sauce 5ml - Cooking wine 7.5ml - Pixian bean paste 5g (optional) - Minced ginger 5g - Minced garlic 5g - White sugar 2.5g - Potatoes or pumpkins 150g - Steamer water 1000ml

Operation: 1. Wash the pork belly and cut into slices about 5cm long, 3cm wide and 0.5cm thick. 2. Cut the ginger and garlic into fine pieces with a particle diameter of no more than 1mm. 3. Take a large bowl and add the sliced pork belly, 15ml light soy sauce, 10ml dark soy sauce, 15ml cooking wine, 10g Pixian bean paste, 10g minced ginger, 10g Minced garlic, 5g white sugar 4. Stir evenly with chopsticks, cover with plastic wrap, and let marinate at room temperature (20°C - 25°C) for 30 minutes. 5. After marinating, add 100g steamed pork rice noodles and continue stirring for 2 minutes to ensure that each piece of meat is evenly coated. 6. Peel the potatoes, slice the thickness to 0.8cm, the area of the slices is about 5cm x 5cm, and the weight is controlled at 300g 7. Spread the potato slices on the bottom of a deep bowl with a diameter of 20cm, and try not to overlap. 8. Spread the mixed pork belly evenly on the potato slices, and compact it. 9.
