Operation: 1. Soak the sweet potato vermicelli until soft in advance, soak in water for 20 minutes, and set aside 2. Chop the garlic and ginger separately and set aside. 3. Heat the pot, add 10ml cooking oil, add minced garlic and ginger and stir-fry until fragrant. 4. Add minced pork and stir-fry until the meat is white and slightly oily. 5. Add Pixian bean paste and stir-fry until the red oil precipitates. 6. Add light soy sauce and dark soy sauce, stir-fry evenly. 7. Pour in 300ml of water and boil 8. Add the soaked and drained vermicelli and stir it gently with chopsticks to prevent sticking. 9. Cook over medium-low heat for about 5 minutes until the vermicelli completely absorbs the soup and becomes slightly dry. 10. Sprinkle in minced green onions according to taste, turn off the heat and serve on a plate

Additional content: - It is not recommended to cook vermicelli for too long, as it will break easily and taste worse; if the time is too long, the soup should be reduced appropriately - Pixian bean paste has a high salt content, so you can reduce the amount of light soy sauce according to your taste - you can add 0.5g of white pepper for seasoning for a better flavor
Soak the sweet potato vermicelli in warm water for 20 minutes until soft, cut into pieces and drain the water to prevent them from sticking during frying.
Add cooking wine and light soy sauce to the minced meat, stir well, add oil in a hot pan and stir-fry until it changes color, add bean paste and stir-fry until red oil appears.
Add a bowl of stock and bring to a boil, add the vermicelli, simmer over medium heat for 3 minutes, sprinkle with chopped green onions, then reduce the juice over high heat and remove from the pot.

Case: I made a quick dinner after working overtime. The vermicelli was put into the pot without soaking it in advance, causing it to stick to a ball. After adjusting, soak it in warm water until soft and then stir-fry. Stir-fry the minced meat and then add stock to simmer. The finished product is soft and flavourful.

items.title: Plasma Duck
items.core: .jpg) .jpg) Plasma duck is a traditional dish in Wugang, Hunan. The duck meat is crispy and tender. After being soaked in vinegar and blood, even the ginger and chili become sweet and not spicy. Duck meat and duck blood provide high-quality protein and iron, which are suitable for nourishing blood and maintaining health. There are many steps to make, and you need to pay attention to the heat and stir-frying, but by following the steps, beginners can complete it in about 2 hours.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Fresh duck meat - Fresh duck blood (add vinegar to catch the duck blood when slaughtering the duck, and stir clockwise with chopsticks to prevent coagulation) - Ginger - Garlic - Green onion - Chili pepper - Wine (or white wine, beer, rice wine) - Light soy sauce - Cooking wine - Salt - Chicken essence

Calculation: per serving (recommended for 2-4 people): - Fresh duck meat 2000g - 250ml of fresh duck blood - 6 slices of ginger (you can add 1-3 more slices of ginger according to your personal preference for spicy food) - 6 cloves of garlic - 2 chives, cut and set aside - 1000g of chili pepper (you can choose green peppers, line peppers, beauty peppers, etc. according to your personal preference for spicy food. If you like spicy food, you can add 5-8 more millet peppers or Chaotian peppers, cut and set aside) - Wine (choose one): - High-strength liquor 50ml + water 150ml - beer 200ml - rice wine 200ml - light soy sauce 10ml - cooking wine 30ml - salt 8g - chicken essence 5g

Operation: 1. Cut the fresh duck meat into small pieces of about 3cm, add cooking wine and ginger slices, and remove the blood. 2. Heat the wok, add about 100ml cooking oil, wait until the oil boils over high heat, add the marinated fresh duck meat, and stir-fry continuously. 3. When the duck meat completely changes color (visible to the naked eye and turns white), add wine, then add 200ml boiling water to just cover the duck meat, cover the pot and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes. 4. After the water boils, open the lid of the pot, add ginger and garlic, stir-fry once, cover the pot and continue heating for 10 minutes. 5. Open the lid of the pot, add the chili peppers, and stir-fry until the chili peppers are visibly soft. Add the fresh duck blood. Stir-fry frequently to ensure that each piece of duck meat and each piece of chili pepper is soaked with duck blood (this is the essence of plasma duck). 6. Stir-fry until the duck blood is black visible to the naked eye. Add salt, chicken essence, and chives (if you like mountain pepper oil, you can also add 3-6 drops of mountain pepper oil at this time) and stir-fry once or twice. 7. Remove from the pan, serve on a plate and serve.

Additional content: - During operation, you need to pay attention to the water level and adjust the fire size to prevent the water from burning out and sticking to the pan. - When adding fresh duck blood, you need to stir-fry and stir continuously to prevent the duck blood from clumping and solidifying into clumps.

Blanch the duck pieces in cold water in a pot until the foam is bloody, drain them, and then stir-fry them in a hot pot until the skin is firm and slightly yellow, which can significantly reduce the fishy smell.
The vinegar blood should be stirred and sieved in advance. When the juice is collected, remove from the heat and pour it in in batches to avoid clumping or sour and bitter taste.

Stir-fry the ginger slices and chili peppers over low heat before adding the duck meat. Keep turning over medium heat frequently to prevent the sugar-colored and bloody sauce from sticking to the pan.

Case study: I ​​had guests at home over the weekend. I stir-fried the duck pieces according to the Wugang method, then poured in vinegar and blood over low heat to reduce the juice. During this period, I kept stir-frying to prevent it from sticking. When it came out of the pot, the duck meat was crispy and fragrant, and the soup was fragrant. Everyone ate two bowls of rice with rice.

items.id: 西红柿土豆炖牛肉-西红柿土豆炖牛肉
items.title: Beef Stew with Tomatoes and Potatoes
items.core: A home-style stew, sweet and sour and appetizing, the soup is rich, the beef is soft and the potatoes are dense. Beef provides high-quality protein, tomatoes are rich in lycopene, and paired with potatoes and onions, it is nutritionally balanced. The operation is simple, no complicated skills are required, and novices can easily get started. It takes approximately 1 to 1.5 hours from prep to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Beef - Small ingredients - Onions - Ginger - Cooking wine - Sichuan peppercorns - Star anise - Bay leaves - White sugar or rock sugar - Soy sauce (optional) - Dark soy sauce - Black pepper (or white pepper) - Potatoes - Tomatoes - Onions

Calculation: - Beef 500-700g - Small ingredients - One green onion, four slices of ginger, cooking wine - 3g of Sichuan peppercorns - One (half) star anise - Two bay leaves - 15ml oil (if using beef brisket, you can reduce it to 10ml according to your preference) - Condiments - White sugar or rock sugar - Soy sauce (Qianhe brewed light soy sauce has no additives), dark soy sauce - Black pepper (white is also acceptable) 2g - Two or three potatoes (depend on your preference, the pot can hold it) - Two or three tomatoes about the size of a fist - An onion a little bigger than your fist

Operation: 1. Preparation: - Peel the potatoes and cut into 5cm large pieces, set aside - Cut the tomatoes into cross-cut knives, blanch them in boiling water and peel them, remove the core in the middle, cut them into 3cm pieces and set aside - Cut the green onions into 4g chopped green onions and break the rest into 5-8cm pieces - Soak the beef in cold water for half an hour to remove the blood, or boil in cold water until the surface turns white and take it out, skimming off the floating residue during the period - cut the onion into 0.5-1cm pieces 2. Preparation - medium heat throughout - cover the beef with cold water, put in the pressure cooker, add green onions and ginger slices, add 20g of cooking wine, steam for 20 minutes - take out the beef, cut into 5cm large pieces, pick out the ginger, put the soup into a large bowl and simmer for a while - Pour in the oil, heat the oil 40 to 50%, add the peppercorns, star anise and bay leaves. When fragrant, pick them out before making the paste. - Add the beef, green onion and ginger, and stir-fry until fragrant. It doesn't matter how long it takes. If it looks a little mushy, scoop out 10ml of soup. The same goes for the following. - After stir-fry, add 15ml of light soy sauce, 15ml of cooking wine, pepper, 5-10g of tomato paste, tomato paste or a can of tomatoes. Add the onion and stir-fry until it becomes transparent. - (Optional) You can add a little salt to prevent the onions from becoming mushy, but don’t add too much. Season later - add tomatoes and stir-fry until the tomatoes are melted and soft, then pour in the remaining soup. 3. Stew - After boiling over medium heat, lower the heat throughout - 30-40 minutes before serving. Add potatoes and season - taste and add sugar and salt according to personal taste, until it is suitable - poke the beef with chopsticks and take it out!

Additional content: - When stewing, make sure the soup is warm when added - Do not close the lid when stewing, otherwise the potatoes will rot - Stir occasionally during stewing to avoid burning the bottom - The casserole stew will be more delicious. You can pour it into the cooking pot after frying in the wok. If you use the casserole, do not use high heat before boiling to avoid cracking - Do not use too much soy sauce. When the soup is concentrated, it will become salty. Do not use chicken essence and MSG, it will take away the flavor of the beef
Blanch the beef in cold water to remove the blood foam, then rinse with warm water to prevent the meat from shrinking and hardening when it is cold.
Saute the tomatoes first and then add hot water to make the soup thicker; cut the potatoes into large pieces before adding them to keep them dense.
Use low heat throughout the stew and keep the soup slightly boiling. Add the salt after the last ten minutes to make the beef softer.

Case: I wanted to eat something hot after get off work. I blanched the beef brisket and stewed it with tomato cubes and potatoes. I added hot water twice in the middle. After an hour, the beef was soft and the soup was sour and sweet. The children even drank the soup.

items.id: 西红柿牛腩-西红柿牛腩
items.title: Tomato Beef Brisket
items.core: The tomato beef brisket soup is rich and sweet and sour, and the beef is soft and mellow. It is an appetizer and a home-cooked dish. Rich in protein, vitamins and lycopene, nutritionally balanced. There is a certain challenge for novices, who need to master the skills of stewing meat and frying tomatoes. It usually takes beginners about 90 minutes to complete.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Tomatoes * Beef brisket * Gas stove (for peeling tomatoes) * Pressure cooker/casserole/ordinary aluminum pot (iron pot) * 2cm two onion segments, two slices of ginger, 10g each of chopped green onion and ginger * Light soy sauce, white pepper, white sugar, seasoning/yellow wine, three small slices of star anise * Beef brisket (choose the fat and thin ones for better taste)
Calculation: Per serving: - Tomatoes 3-4 pieces (about 200g each) - Beef brisket 500g - Edible oil 20-30ml

Operation: 1. Cut the brisket into strips and cubes with a width and height of 2cm, put it in a pot with cold water, boil it for 2 minutes to remove the blood, remove and rinse. 2. Bring another 2L of water to a boil, add two 2cm green onions, two slices of ginger, star anise, and rice wine 5-10ml, add the blanched beef, cover and stew (1 hour in the casserole, 45 minutes in the pressure cooker stew mode). If chopsticks can be easily inserted through, it proves that the stew is done. 3. Peel the tomatoes: slide the head of the tomato cross to the waist line, insert the chopsticks/knife and fork from the fruit base, use the gas stove over low heat, roast while turning, take it out in time to check, tear off the skin and cut into pieces. The smaller the better - peel and blanch carefully, the peeled tomatoes are particularly slippery, be careful when cutting slowly for safety. 4. Heat oil in a pan, 70% hot, add 10g each of green onions and ginger, add tomatoes to the pan, stir-fry until the tomatoes turn red, add cooked beef brisket and original soup, the original soup just covers the beef. 5. Add salt, sugar and light soy sauce to taste according to personal taste and cover. 6. After boiling the pot, continue to stir-fry on high heat for 3-5 minutes. 7. When the tomato juice reaches a medium consistency, turn off the heat, scatter in the chopped green onion, and serve on a plate

Additional content: - Be safe with fire, be safe with fire, be safe with fire - When stewing meat in a casserole/aluminum pot, turn to medium/low heat after the water boils, and use a pressure cooker. See Learn to use a pressure cooker - The method of peeling tomatoes in the tutorial is the fastest method I have practiced so far - Absolutely no tomato sauce and add less condiments to restore the original flavor of the ingredients as much as possible

Cut the beef brisket into three-centimeter chunks, blanch it in water and wipe the surface dry. Stir-fry the onions and ginger first before adding the meat. This will make it easier to remove the fishy smell and add flavor.
Peel the tomatoes and add them in two batches: stir-fry half to make a sauce, and add half to retain the pulp for a richer taste.
Simmer the beef brisket until chopsticks can be inserted easily and then collect the juice. Stir frequently when the juice is collected to prevent the tomato sugar from sticking to the bottom.

Case: This is the first time I cook for my parents. I blanch the beef brisket first, then stir-fry the tomatoes to make red juice and stew them together. Finally, the soup is reduced slightly over high heat. When it was served, the beef brisket was soft and juicy. My father said it was more appetizing than the ones in stores outside.

items.id: 豆豉鲮鱼油麦菜-豆豉鲮鱼油麦菜
items.title: Dace and lettuce with black bean paste
items.core: Dace and lettuce with black bean paste is a quick and savory home-cooked stir-fry that goes well with rice. It is derived from Cantonese canned dishes. The lettuce is crisp and the dace fish is crispy and fragrant. A combination of meat and vegetables, rich in protein and dietary fiber. The method is simple, very friendly to novices, and can usually be completed in fifteen minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Lettuce - Ganzhu brand canned dace - Garlic - Light soy sauce - White sugar - Edible oil
Calculation: per serving (about 2 people): - Lettuce 500g - 1 can of canned dace (about 250g) - 4 cloves of garlic - 20g of light soy sauce - 3g of sugar - Edible oil 15ml

Operation: 1. Ingredients processing: - Wash the lettuce and cut it into sections - After opening the canned dace, remove the main spines of the dace and cut it into small pieces for later use - Mince the garlic 2. Stir-frying process: - Heat the pot and pour in cooking oil. When the oil is hot, add the washed lettuce, fry until it wilts and water comes out, then set aside and pour out the water from the frying - After reheating the pot, add the oil from the canned dace, add the minced garlic and stir-fry - After the minced garlic is fragrant, add the tempeh from the canned dace, stir and add the chopped dace pieces, stir again - Stir evenly and then add the lettuce, add light soy sauce and sugar to taste - After the seasoning is added, stir briefly and take it out of the pot and serve
Additional content: - Notes: 1. Canned dace has its own flavor. Adding light soy sauce will give it enough flavor without adding salt.
Be sure to drain the lettuce after washing. Put the stems and leaves in the pot separately. Fry the stems first and then the leaves to keep them crisp and not watery.
Put the oil in the can and tempeh into the pot together, sauté over low heat until fragrant, then add the dace and stir gently to avoid frying the fish into pieces.
Add less or no salt, the can itself is very salty; pour a little water on the side of the pot before taking it out to make the taste more even.

Case: With only ten minutes left on a weekday evening, I tore open the can of dace with black bean sauce, quickly stir-fried the lettuce over high heat, then added the dace and stirred it well. After being plated, the vegetable leaves are still crispy and salty, and can be eaten quickly with rice.

items.title: Pork Ribs in Black Bean Sauce
items.core: This is a popular steamed dish in Cantonese teahouses. The soybean flavor is mellow and the pork ribs are smooth and tender. Pork ribs provide high-quality protein and calcium, and fermented tempeh adds flavor and is easier to absorb. The method requires soaking, marinating and steaming under controlled heat, which is a bit challenging for novices, but the steps are clear and easy to follow, and it only takes about 1 hour from preparation to cooking. The remaining soup is especially delicious when used with rice or noodles.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Ribs - Yangjiang black bean sauce - Minced garlic - Minced ginger - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Oyster sauce - White sugar - Cornstarch - Edible oil - Water - Chopped green onions (optional) - White sesame seeds (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough to feed 2-4 people. Each serving: - 500 g ribs - 15 g Yangjiang black bean paste - 10 g minced garlic - 5 g minced ginger - 15 ml light soy sauce - 3 ml dark soy sauce - 10 g oyster sauce - 5 g white sugar - 8 g corn starch - 20 ml cooking oil (10 ml if you do not plan to pour hot oil) - 30 ml water ml

Operation: 1. Soak the ribs in cold water for 10 minutes to remove the blood, change the water twice, and drain with kitchen paper 2. Soak the black bean sauce in the water for 5 minutes 3. Mix all the ingredients (put 10 ml of cooking oil) and marinate for 8-30 minutes 4. After the water boils, steam it for 18 minutes 5. Simmer for 2 minutes 6. Pour 10 ml into the pot Heat the oil to 180-200 ℃ 7. Spread the chopped green onion and white sesame seeds evenly, and pour the hot oil over the ingredients

Additional content: - The black bean sauce will be more flavorful after being soaked and minced slightly - The steaming time will be adjusted according to the size of the ribs, as long as the chopsticks can be easily inserted into the cartilage - Traditional black bean sauce spareribs do not need to be sprinkled with ingredients and hot oil - The leftover soup can be used to mix rice or noodles
Soak the pork ribs in water for 20 minutes and change the water twice to remove the blood. After steaming, the color will be cleaner and the fishy smell will be lighter.
Chop the tempeh slightly, mix with minced garlic, light soy sauce, and a little sugar, and marinate for at least 20 minutes before the flavor develops.
After the water boils, steam over high heat. Spread the ribs flat and do not stack them too thickly. Remove them from the pot immediately after they are cooked to avoid the taste becoming woody.

Case: My family has an old man with a weak tooth. I soaked the pork ribs in water to remove the blood, then marinated them with black bean, minced garlic and starch for half an hour. After the water boiled, I steamed them. The ribs are tender and fall off the bone when they come out of the pot, and the rice with the soup at the bottom of the plate is also very fragrant.

items.id: 豉汁蒸白鱔-豉汁蒸白鱔
items.title: Steamed white eel with black bean sauce
items.core: Steamed white eel with black bean sauce is a classic Cantonese steamed dish. The aroma of black bean and garlic paste penetrates into the fish, making it tender and delicious. White eel is rich in high-quality protein and a variety of unsaturated fatty acids, which has a nourishing effect on the body. The operation steps are clear, but handling raw fish and controlling the heat are a little challenging, so it is suitable for cooks with a certain foundation. It takes about 30 minutes from prep to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - White eel - Black soybean - Garlic - Ginger - Onion - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Sugar - Sesame oil - Cornstarch (optional) - Red pepper (optional, for decoration) Tools: - Steamer or electric steamer - Heat-resistant plate (suitable for steaming) - Knife and chopping board - Small bowl (for sauce making)

Calculation: one person per serving: - 250g white eel (about a small white eel, gutted and cut into sections) - 1 tablespoon black bean sauce - 2 cloves garlic (chopped) - 3 slices ginger (shredded) - 1 green onion (cut into sections or shreds) - 1.5 tablespoons light soy sauce - 0.5 teaspoons dark soy sauce - 0.5 teaspoons sugar - 0.5 teaspoons sesame oil teaspoon - 1 teaspoon cornstarch (optional, for pickling) - 1 tablespoon water (to prepare the sauce) - 10g red pepper (shredded, for decoration)

Operation: 1. Check and clean the white eel: - When purchasing, ask the fishmonger to remove the internal organs, scrape off the mucus and cut into sections about 5 cm long. - Check the eel when you get home and rinse it to make sure there is no remaining mucus or impurities. - Optional: Gently rub the eel segments with 3g of salt and 1 teaspoon of cornstarch, marinate for 5 minutes and then rinse to remove the fishy smell and increase the tenderness. 2. Prepare the sauce: - Mix 1 tablespoon tempeh, 2 cloves minced garlic, 1.5 tablespoon light soy sauce, 0.5 teaspoon dark soy sauce, 0.5 teaspoon sugar, 0.5 teaspoon sesame oil and 1 tablespoon water in a small bowl and stir well. - If you like a richer black bean sauce, add 0.5 tablespoon more black bean sauce. 3. Plating: - Lay the cut eel segments flat on a heat-proof plate, trying not to overlap. - Spread the shredded ginger evenly on the eel. - Pour the prepared black bean sauce evenly over the eel. 4. Steaming: - Add water (500ml) to a steamer or electric steamer and bring to a boil. - Place the plate with the eel in the steamer and close the lid. - Steam over medium-high heat for about 8-10 minutes (adjust the time depending on the size of the eel segments) until the eel is cooked but not too old (the meat turns white and there is no blood). 5. Decoration and completion: - Take out after steaming, sprinkle with shredded green onion and red pepper (optional) for decoration. - Drizzle hot sesame oil to enhance the aroma. - Serve hot with rice.

Additional content: - Notes: - Make sure the eel is fresh and choose live fish when purchasing, the meat will be more tender. - The fishmonger can specify the length when cutting into sections (approximately 5 cm is appropriate) for easy steaming and eating. - The steaming time should not be too long to prevent the eel meat from becoming tough. - Variation: - Add chili or XO sauce to add spiciness and layered texture. - If you like a softer texture, you can add rice wine when marinating.
Ask the stall owner to cut open the eel from the back and remove the bones. Then rinse the mucus and dry it when you get home. It will not smell fishy after steaming.
Add a little oil to the black bean garlic paste and mix into a sauce. Spread evenly on the fish. Do not pile it too thick to avoid covering up the fish.

The water must be boiled before putting it in the pot. Steam the fish for six to eight minutes according to the thickness of the fish. Turn off the heat and simmer for two minutes. Steaming for a long time will make it old.

Case: A friend sent me a white eel. I asked the stall owner to clean it. I cut it into sections when I got home and spread it with black bean paste and minced garlic. I steamed it for eight minutes and simmered it for two minutes. The fish meat is fresh and tender without any fishy smell, and the aroma of black soy sauce permeates every section.

items.id: 贵州辣子鸡-贵州辣子鸡
items.title: Guizhou Spicy Chicken
items.core: Guizhou Spicy Chicken is a classic home-cooked dish in Guizhou. It is cooked with glutinous rice cake peppers and a variety of spices. The chicken is fragrant and soft, the potatoes are dense and tasty, and the overall flavor is spicy and rich. Chicken is rich in high-quality protein and paired with potatoes and other side dishes, it is nutritionally balanced. This dish has a lot of steps and may pose a challenge to novices, but you can still succeed if you follow the steps. From preparation to serving, it is expected to take 1.about 5 hours.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Rural corn chicken - Potatoes - Garlic - Bay leaves - Ginger - Dark soy sauce - Sichuan peppercorns or Sichuan peppercorns - Ciba peppers (peppers from Huaxi Dangwu, bullets from Zunyi, sliver peppers, and generous wrinkled peppers mixed and crushed) - bean paste - beer - garlic sprouts - distiller's grains - edible oil

Calculation: per serving: - The amount of chicken for three to four people is four kilograms. If there are more people, you can add it up in sequence - half a bottle of beer - two finger-sized ginger sticks - 500g of glutinous rice cake, which will be two fist-sized lumps - three garlic sprouts - 2 bay leaves - two garlic - two potatoes - two kilograms of rapeseed oil, which will be used a lot in the beginning - dark soy sauce 20 ml

Operation: 1. Add oil half the height of the pot, fry the potatoes cut into long strips until the surface is golden brown, then take them out and set aside. When the oil is hot enough to bake, put the cut chicken pieces into the pot and fry, and add the sliced ginger and peppercorns. 2. When you first fry the chicken, the oil will be turbid because there is water in the chicken pieces. Wait until it is clear and the chicken pieces are fried, then take them out and set aside. 3. Now you can take out one-third of the oil in the pot, and you don’t need so much oil now. 4. Heat the remaining oil in the pot, add glutinous rice cake pepper, bean paste, and ginger slices, stir-fry until red oil forms, and stir-fry the fried chicken pieces evenly. 5. Wait until the chicken pieces are colored, add dark soy sauce, and pour in beer. The beer must cover the chicken pieces, cover with bay leaves, and simmer for ten minutes, stirring at intervals. 6. Then add potato strips and garlic (no need to cut, one by one is best), and simmer for another 20 minutes 7. Finally, add the distiller's grains and stir-fry evenly, then add the chopped garlic sprouts, and it's ready to serve.
Additional content: - When operating, you need to pay attention to stir-frying, because the glutinous rice cake will burn the pepper

The glutinous rice cake peppers can be steamed with dried chili peppers until soft and then chopped into pieces. Stir-fry over low heat while stir-frying. The aroma will be more mellow and less likely to be bitter.

The chicken pieces are first marinated in cooking wine and ginger slices for ten minutes, and then fried until the skin is slightly yellow. It will be easier to absorb the juice after returning to the pot.
Cut the potatoes into hob pieces and put them in. Cover and simmer until soft, then use high heat to reduce the juice. Let the spicy oil evenly coat the chicken and potatoes.

Case: Recreating the Guizhou flavor at home during the National Day, I first fried the chicken pieces until they were slightly brown, then slowly sauteed them with glutinous rice cake peppers and Sichuan peppercorns, then added them to the pot and simmered until soft. After it comes out of the pan, the red oil is bright, the chicken pieces are soft, glutinous and spicy, and the rice is not enough.

items.title: Chili Stir-fried Pork
items.core: Chili Stir-fried Pork is a home-cooked dish with a strong Hunan flavor. The dried chili peppers are slightly burnt, the meat slices are smooth and tender, and the salty and slightly spicy meat is perfect for rice. Pork is rich in high-quality protein and B vitamins, while green peppers provide a rich source of vitamin C. This dish requires mastering the heat of dry stir-frying and quick stir-frying, so it is suitable for friends with a certain cooking foundation to try. From preparation to serving, it takes about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Green peppers (if you want spicy food, it is recommended to use Hangzhou pepper, screw pepper, and if you don’t want spicy food, use sharp pepper, sweet pepper) * Lean pork * Salt * Light soy sauce * Oyster sauce * Garlic * Ginger * Soy sauce (optional) * Black bean (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Total quantity: Number of green peppers = 3 servings. Amount of meat = portion size 200g. Amount of salt = serving 3g. Light soy sauce = serving 3ml. Oyster Sauce = Serving 3ml. Garlic = Serving 5g. Ginger = Serving 5g. Soy Sauce = Servings 2ml. Tempeh = Serving 3g. Using the conditions above, calculate the proportion of raw materials you plan to use.

Operation: 1. Wash the green peppers, remove the handles and seeds, then cut them with a hob and set aside. 2. Clap the garlic with a knife, then cut it into garlic cloves crosswise, and chop the ginger into minced ginger. 3. Cut the lean pork into slices (cut along the grain of the pork, that is, the knife and the grain of the meat form a horizontal line, and the texture of the sliced ​​meat will look like the word "Chuan"). 4. Wash the cut pork, put it into an empty bowl, then add the calculated light soy sauce, oyster sauce, and salt, stir evenly, and marinate for 10 minutes. 5. Heat the pan without pouring oil. Add the sliced ​​green peppers into the pan and stir-fry over high heat until they become like tiger skin. Add 2g of salt and continue to stir-fry for 1 minute before removing. 6. No need to wash the pot, heat the pot over high heat, add portion * 8ml oil, wait 30s, add garlic cloves and minced ginger and stir-fry for 15s. 7. Add the marinated pork into the pot and stir-fry for 2 minutes, then add the dry and stir-fried green pepper and stir-fry for 1 minute. 8. Add tempeh according to personal taste preference, finally add soy sauce, and continue to stir-fry for 30 seconds. 9. Remove from the pan and serve on a plate.
Additional content: You can only choose green peppers for peppers, and screw peppers are the best solution. Do not choose other varieties of peppers!
Choose front legs or plum meat with a little fat, cut into thin slices against the grain, and add a little starch and oil when marinating to make it more tender.
Dry the green peppers without adding oil until the skin becomes wrinkled, then add a little oil and stir-fry until fragrant. This can create a dry aroma and reduce the spiciness.

When stir-frying over high heat, the meat slices will fall apart within ten seconds after being put into the pot. Season the meat when it changes color and take it out of the pot. If it is stir-fried for a long time, it will easily become hard.

Case: I was in a hurry after get off work, so I cut the front leg meat into thin slices and marinated it. First, I stir-fried the green pepper to the skin, then added the meat and quickly stir-fried it. The whole process takes less than half an hour. The meat is tender and spicy, and can be eaten with rice.

items.title: Sauce Spare Ribs
items.core: Sauce Spare Ribs are red in color, crispy in texture, rich in bone flavor, juicy and fresh, salty and sweet. It is a classic home-cooked dish. Spare ribs are rich in high-quality protein and calcium and have balanced nutrition. The preparation involves frying the sugar and stewing it for a long time, which is a certain challenge for novices, but as long as you follow the steps, you can master it smoothly. Expect it to take about 1 hour from prep to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Spare ribs * Five-spice powder * Cooking wine * Cooking oil * White sugar * Dark soy sauce * Light soy sauce * Oyster sauce * Millet pepper * Garlic * Ginger

Calculation: per serving: * 300 g spare ribs * Five-spice powder 20 g * Cooking wine 10 ml * Cooking oil 30 ml * White sugar 15 g * Dark soy sauce 10 ml * 10 ml of light soy sauce * 5 ml of oyster sauce * 1 millet pepper * 2 pieces of garlic * 2 slices of ginger

Operation: 1. Heat the hot water in a pot, add the ribs, ginger slices, and cooking wine. When it boils, scoop out the white oil foam with a spoon and take it out of the pot after 2-3 minutes. 2. Wash the ribs in cold water and wash it 2-3 times. 3. Heat the pot over low heat, add cooking oil, and add white sugar. , stir gently until the sugar water turns yellow. 4. Pour in the ribs and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add light soy sauce, oyster sauce, five-spice powder, garlic, and millet pepper and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add water to cover the ribs. 5. Boil over high heat for 30 minutes, add dark soy sauce to color, and cook for another 10 minutes. 6. Remove from the pot and plate

Additional content: * To increase the taste, consider adding bean paste, tomato sauce, etc. * The cooking time on high heat can be adjusted according to each person's situation * While cooking the ribs, you can add 2-3 eggs and cook them together to make a simple version of braised eggs
When frying the sugar color, turn down the heat immediately after the sugar melts. When it turns amber, add the ribs. If the color is too dark, it will be bitter.
After blanching the ribs, wipe them dry before putting them in the pot. The sugar color and sauce can hang on the surface, and the color of the finished product will be brighter.
When stewing, add enough hot water at a time, simmer over low heat until the bones and meat are loose, and finally use high heat to reduce the juice and keep turning to prevent burning.

Case: Before the New Year’s Eve dinner, I stewed a pot of sauced pork ribs in advance. I first fried the pork ribs to brown, then stir-fried the pork ribs, added spices and simmered over low heat. After the sauce is reduced, the pork ribs will be shiny red, crispy and tasty, and they will be empty soon after being served to the table.

items.title: Soy Sauce Beef
items.core: Soy Beef is a northern home-style cold meat dish with rich sauce aroma, firm texture and chewy texture. Beef tendon meat is rich in high-quality protein and a variety of amino acids, and is easier to digest and absorb after being slow-cooked. The process is not complicated, but it does involve marinating, simmering, and long periods of refrigeration, so it requires some patience for novices, and takes about 10 hours from start to finish.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Beef shank - Bay leaves - Ginger - Green onion - Dark soy sauce - Cinnamon - Rock sugar - Sichuan peppercorns - Cooking wine - Light soy sauce - Salt - Star anise - Soybean paste

Calculation: per portion: - 2000 grams of beef shank - 1 bay leaf - 3 slices of ginger - Half green onion - 15ml dark soy sauce - 1 piece of cinnamon bark - 7-8 pieces of rock sugar - 15 pieces of Sichuan peppercorns - 30ml of cooking wine - 15ml of light soy sauce - 8g of salt - 4 star anise - 15ml of soybean paste

Operation: 1. Clean the beef shank and soak it in water for 1 hour to remove the blood. 2. Use a toothpick or fork to prick the surface of the beef shank. Add cooking wine, pepper and ginger slices, wrap the container tightly with plastic wrap, and marinate for 4-6 hours. 3. Cut the beef tendon into 8cm and no more than 10cm pieces. 4. Put the beef shank meat into the pot, add cold water until the water surface covers the beef, boil the pot until the water boils and start timing, and remove the foam at the same time. After 3 minutes, stop the fire, take out the beef, and wash it with warm water. 5. Put the washed beef tendon meat into a casserole or stew pot, add water to cover the beef tendon meat, turn on high heat, and add other unused ingredients except salt. 6. After the water boils, turn the high heat to low heat and continue to heat for 90 minutes. Add salt. 7. After adding salt, continue to low heat for 90 minutes (Note: Check the water level every 30 minutes and it must be at least the height of the beef noodles. 80%) 8. After heating for 180 minutes, take out the beef shank, wrap it tightly with plastic wrap, and put it in the refrigerator for a few hours. 9. Take it out, slice it along the grain of the beef, and serve it. It is recommended not to slice and refrigerate other beef shank

Additional content: - During operation, you need to pay attention to the boiling water level. If you find that the ingredients are lower than 2/3, you should heat the water until the ingredients are submerged (confirm about every 30 minutes). - Wrap the beef tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate it for a few hours to make the sliced ​​meat firmer and firmer. - Use a toothpick or fork to poke holes on the surface of the beef to break the fascia and make it easier to taste. References: - Recipes in the Kitchen app
For beef tendon, choose the front tendons with clear patterns. After braised, the slices will not fall apart easily and the texture will be chewier.
Boil light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, soybean paste and spices first before adding beef. Steeping over low heat allows the flavor to enter into the fiber.
Don’t rush to fish it out after turning off the heat. Soak it in the soup for more than four hours and refrigerate it before cutting into thin slices to make it neater.

Case study: On Sunday, I bought beef tendon to make sauced beef. I marinated it overnight, then simmered it in sauce for ninety minutes, then turned off the heat and soaked it, then put it in the refrigerator. The next day, the texture of the slices is clear and the sauce is fragrant, making it easy to serve guests.

items.title: Drunken Spare Ribs
items.core: Drunken Spare Ribs is a traditional famous dish in Fuzhou. It tastes crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. It is sweet and sour and appetizing, with a unique fish sauce flavor. Pork ribs are rich in protein and calcium, which is nutritious and satisfies cravings. This dish requires mastering the skills of battering and re-frying, and is more suitable for friends with some cooking experience. The whole process takes about 40 minutes to complete.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Spare ribs * White sugar * Cooking oil * Fish sauce * Sesame seeds * Tomato sauce * Balsamic vinegar * Garlic * Green onions * Sweet potato powder * Egg yolks

Calculation: Per portion: * Spare ribs 200 g * White sugar 10 g * Cooking oil 500 ml * Fish sauce 5 ml * Sesame seeds 5 g * Tomato sauce 5 g * Balsamic vinegar 5 ml * 2 garlic cloves * 1 green onion * 30 g sweet potato powder * 1 egg yolk

Operation: 1. Add 5 g sweet potato powder and water to the ribs and stir, wash 2-3 times and put into a large bowl for later use 2. Add fish sauce, sweet potato powder, and egg yolk to the ribs and mix thoroughly 3. Put the ribs into the pot one by one (remember not to pour the whole bowl), ensuring that each one does not stick together 4. After putting all the pieces in, use a spoon to flip the lean meat pieces back and forth every 30 seconds until the surface of the ribs is golden. 5. Take out the ribs, pour them into the oil pan after one minute and continue frying until the surface of the lean meat pieces is browned. Pour the soup into the ribs, stir well and pour into the plate

Additional content: * Fish sauce, also known as fish soy sauce, is a common condiment in Guangdong, Fujian and other places. The effect is similar to that of light soy sauce * During this production process, due to the epidemic, there was no rain and dew, so dark soy sauce could only be used instead, so the color of the ribs is darker, which is normally golden
Marinate the pork ribs for twenty minutes before coating them in dry starch. A thin layer is enough. If it is too thick, it will feel powdery and affect the crispiness.
The first time is to fry at 60% oil temperature until cooked. The second time is to raise the oil temperature and fry again for 20 seconds. The outer shell will be crispier and less likely to soften.
Prepare the sauce in advance. Pour the ribs in immediately after they come out of the pot and mix well. Use the residual heat to absorb the flavor to avoid soaking for a long time and becoming soft.

Case: A friend from Fuzhou taught me how to make drunken pork ribs. I marinated the pork ribs, coated them in starch and fried them twice. Then, while they were still hot, I poured in the sweet and sour fish sauce and stirred evenly. The finished product is crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, sweet and sour, and is eaten by children after it is served.

items.id: 青椒土豆炒肉-青椒土豆炒肉
items.title: Fried meat with green pepper and potatoes
items.core: Stir-fried meat with green pepper and potato is a home-style stir-fry with meat and vegetables. It has a fresh and crisp taste and a rich sauce, which is especially good with rice. Potatoes are rich in carbohydrates and vitamin C, and green peppers provide rich vitamin C and dietary fiber. Together with the high-quality protein of pork, the nutrition is balanced. This dish is not complicated to make and is friendly to novices. It only takes about 1 hour from preparation to cooking.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: - Green peppers - Potatoes - Pork (pork belly) - Onions - Ginger - Garlic - Salt - Soy sauce - Potato starch

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each portion: - 2 green peppers (about 200g in total) - 2 potatoes (about 300g in total) - 200g pork - 1 green onion (about 10g) - 1 piece of ginger (about 5g) - 3 cloves of garlic (about 12g) - 7g of salt - 6-10ml of soy sauce - 10-15ml of cooking oil - 5g of potato starch - Water 15g

Operation: 1. Remove the roots of the green pepper and cut into small pieces, peel the potatoes and cut into 2mm thin slices, cut the pork into 4mm thin slices, cut the green onion into 3mm pieces crosswise and lengthwise, peel the ginger and garlic, smash into pieces and chop into small pieces; add about 15g of water to the potato starch and stir evenly until it becomes starchy. 2. Heat oil in a pan, heat to 70% heat, add pork slices, stir-fry slowly until the meat turns red, add about 3ml of soy sauce, stir-fry the meat slices to evenly color, and add about 2g of salt. 3. Turn the oil to 50%, add the onion, ginger and garlic and fry for 5 seconds, then add the potato slices, turn the oil to 70% and stir-fry evenly, add about 5ml of soy sauce and 2g of salt, stir-fry until the potatoes are tender and the surface is slightly browned. 4. Turn the oil to 80% and add the green peppers. Stir-fry over high heat until white smoke comes out. Stir-fry evenly for 1 minute to add color. Finally, pour water and starch around the pot and turn to 4% to thicken the sauce. 5. Turn off the heat after it becomes sticky and serve on a plate
Additional Content
Cut the potatoes into thin slices, soak them in water for five minutes and drain them. Fry them until the edges are slightly brown. They will not break easily and will be more fragrant when fried.
The meat slices are mixed with light soy sauce, cooking wine and a little starch, and finally stir-fried quickly to keep it smooth and tender.
Remove the seeds from the green pepper and cut into cubes, then stir-fry until raw. This will retain the crispiness and reduce the loss of vitamins.

Case: There are only potatoes, green peppers and a little pork left at home. I cut the potatoes into thin slices and fry them until fragrant, then add the meat slices and green peppers and stir-fry them quickly. The seasoning is simple but the sauce is rich in flavor. It takes about ten minutes to cook and goes well with rice.

items.title: Stuffed with green peppers
items.core: This classic Guangxi home-cooked dish is wrapped in green peppers and seasoned meat fillings or shrimp paste, fried until the skin wrinkles and turns the color of tiger skin, and then simmered to add flavor. Pork and shrimp provide high-quality protein, and green peppers are rich in vitamin C and are nutritionally balanced. Making the stuffing requires a little patience, but the overall process is clear and can usually be completed in 30 minutes by following the steps.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Green peppers (6-8 pieces, choose straight, thick ones, do not use bell peppers) - Pork (250g, the fat-to-lean ratio is 3:7, the front meat is best) - Green onions (2 stalks) - Ginger (1 small piece) - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Salt - Edible oil - Starch (optional, coat the inner wall of the green peppers to prevent sticking and thicken the juice) - Garlic (optional, 3-4 cloves) - Oyster sauce (optional) - Cooking wine (optional) - Eggs (optional) - White pepper (optional) - White sugar (optional)

Calculation: per portion: - 8 green peppers (about 400g, choose straight and thick peppers) - 250g pork filling (fat to thin ratio 3:7) - 2 green onions (about 30g) - 1 ginger Small pieces (about 10g) - 30ml light soy sauce (15ml for stuffing and 15ml for sauce) - 5ml dark soy sauce - 3g salt - 30ml cooking oil - 10g starch (optional, 5g of which is used to coat the inner wall of green pepper and 5g water starch to thicken) - 4 cloves of garlic (optional, about 15g) - 10ml oyster sauce (optional) - 10ml cooking wine (optional) - 1 egg (optional) - 2g white pepper (optional) - 5g sugar (optional)

Operation: Prepare the stuffing: 1. Wash the pork and chop it into minced meat (or use a meat grinder), mince the ginger, and chop the green onion. 2. Add minced ginger, chopped green onion, 15ml of light soy sauce, 5ml of dark soy sauce, and 3g of salt to the meat stuffing. Stir evenly. 3. Optional addition: 10ml of cooking wine, 10ml of oyster sauce, 1 egg, 5g of starch, 2g of white pepper, and 5g of white sugar. 4. Stir the meat filling in one direction until it becomes thick and thick, and marinate for 10 minutes. Handle the green peppers: 1. Wash the green peppers, remove the stems, and use chopsticks to carefully dig out the seeds and white tendons inside to keep the green peppers intact. 2. You can optionally sprinkle about 5g of dry starch on the inner wall of the green peppers, and shake evenly to help the meat fillings adhere to each other and not fall off. Stuff the meat fillings: 1. Use chopsticks or a piping bag to stuff the marinated meat filling into the green pepper, try to fill it as much as possible but not too tight to prevent bursting. 2. Stuff everything and set aside. Prepare the sauce: 1. Add 15ml of light soy sauce, 5ml of dark soy sauce, and 100ml of water in a bowl, stir well. 2. Optional 5g of starch can be added to make the soup thicker. Fry and stew: 1. Heat the pot and pour 30ml. Cooking oil, when the oil temperature is 50% to 60% hot, add the stuffed green peppers (fry meat side down first) 2. Slowly fry over medium-low heat, turn over and fry the green peppers on all sides until the skin is wrinkled and tiger-skin color, remove and set aside. 3. Leave the bottom oil in the pot, optionally add minced garlic and saute until fragrant 4. Pour in the prepared sauce, bring to a boil and add the fried green peppers 5. Turn to medium-low heat, cover the pot and simmer for 5-8 Minutes, until the soup thickens and the green peppers become soft. 6. Open the lid and reduce the sauce over high heat until the soup is shiny and wrap the green peppers. Take it out of the pot and serve it on a plate. Fork version of shrimp paste: Green pepper stuffed with shrimp paste is also very common in Guangxi. It is an orthodox way of eating, not an evil practice~ 1. Shrimp 250g Remove the shrimp threads and pound them into a paste with the back of a knife (keep a certain graininess for a better taste. Just buy finished shrimps to make them slippery. Buy the triangular ones and stuff them directly) 2. Season the shrimp filling: 5g minced ginger, 2g salt, 5g starch, 10ml light soy sauce. 3. Optional additions: 5ml cooking wine, 1g white pepper, and half an egg white. 4. Stir in one direction until the shrimps are firm and marinate for 10 minutes. 5. The subsequent steps of stuffing, frying, and stewing are the same as the pork version. 6. Shrimp are smooth and easy to cook, and the stewing time can be shortened to 4-5 minutes.

Additional content: - Choose straight green peppers for stuffing, and thicker peppers taste better than thin-skinned peppers. - Stir the filling in one direction to make it stronger and more elastic. - Applying dry starch on the inner wall of the green pepper is the key to preventing sticking, and the meat filling will not fall off during frying. - Frying until tiger skin color is the source of the flavor, don't skip it - The sauce can be adjusted according to personal taste, if you like it spicier, you can add Guilin chili sauce - Shrimp paste and pork filling can be mixed in any proportion, the shrimp meat adds freshness and sweetness, and the pork provides oily aroma - The soup mixed with rice is excellent, don't make it too dry

Choose thin-skinned green peppers and leave the stems intact when removing the seeds. Use chopsticks dipped in a little dry starch to smear the inner wall to prevent the meat filling from falling off.

Add minced shrimp to the meat filling according to the ratio of fat to lean: 3:7, add green onion and ginger water and beat vigorously in a clockwise direction, and finally stir in a little starch to lock in water.

When frying, first set the temperature over high heat and then turn to low heat. Use a spatula to lightly press the green peppers to heat them evenly. Turn them over when the surface is golden and wrinkled.

Case: During the weekend dinner, Xiao Li selected thin-skinned green peppers, removed the seeds, filled them with pork and shrimp mixture, fried them over low heat to create tiger skin patterns, and then simmered them to reduce the juice. The finished green pepper is fragrant, soft and tender, and the filling is delicious and juicy. My family praised it for being a great addition to rice, and it was ready to go in half an hour.

items.title: Fragrant dried pork shreds
items.core: Fragrant dried pork shreds are a home-style stir-fry that goes well with rice. The shredded pork is tender and smooth, the fragrant dried pork is pliable, and the green pepper is crisp. It is rich in animal and plant protein, and paired with green peppers to supplement vitamins. The difficulty is moderate and beginners can master it with a little practice. The estimated production time is about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Pork tenderloin (you can buy chopped and weighed shredded pork in the supermarket) * Dried sesame seeds * Salt * Light soy sauce * Starch * Garlic * Green pepper * Chicken essence

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Total amount: Dried sesame seeds = 75g servings. Number of green peppers = 5 servings. Meat = 100g servings. Salt = 3g servings. Light soy sauce = 5ml servings. Starch = 5g servings. Garlic = 5g servings (approximately 3 garlic cloves) * Chicken essence = 2g. Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials you plan to use.

Operation: Preparation work: 1. Use light soy sauce (3ml) and cornstarch for shredded pork (if there is no shredded pork, cut it yourself) and set aside. 2. Wash the green peppers, then cut them with a hob and set aside. 3. Cut the garlic into slices crosswise, and shred the dried coriander into shreds. 4. Mix starch and water (10ml) and stir evenly. Start the pot: 1. Clean the pot and add 15ml of oil. Do not wait for the oil to heat up. Pour in the shredded pork and slowly break it up. When the shredded pork is cooked, take it out immediately and leave the oil in the pot. 2. Put the garlic slices and dried fragrant seeds into the pot, add 2ml of light soy sauce, and stir-fry evenly. 3. For 2-3 minutes, depending on the heat, add shredded green peppers to the pot, mix, and stir-fry. 4. After 1 minute, add shredded pork and mix. 5. Pour in a mixture of starch and water to thicken, add 3g of salt and 2g of chicken essence, stir-fry for 2-3 minutes and remove from the pan. 6. Finished product. Note that different pots or stoves will affect the stir-frying time. It is recommended that if you are not sure whether it is cooked, you can try it.

Additional content: Green peppers are the best choice for peppers, and screw peppers are the best solution. If you like spicy food, you can add millet peppers, chop them into fine pieces, and add them together with the green peppers!
Cut the tenderloin against the grain to the thickness of a matchstick, marinate with a little baking soda for 10 minutes, rinse, and then use egg white starch to make it more tender.
Cut the dried fragrant into strips and blanch in boiling water with a little salt for 30 seconds, remove and drain. This can remove the beany smell and make the texture more pliable and tasty.

Add the sauce in the bowl: 1 spoon of light soy sauce + half a spoon of dark soy sauce + a little sugar + 2 spoons of starch water. When stir-frying, pour in along the edge of the pot and stir quickly to remove.

Case: After get off work, Xiao Wang quickly prepared the ingredients. Shred the tenderloin and mix it with egg white starch. Cut the dried fragrant seeds into strips and blanch them in water to remove the beany smell. Stir-fry the shredded pork in a hot pan with cold oil until it changes colour, add green pepper and fragrant dry stir-fry for seasoning, and the salty, tender and tender dish will be served in 30 minutes. Eat two bowls with rice.

items.id: 香干芹菜炒肉-香干芹菜炒肉
items.title: Stir-fried Pork with Dried Celery
items.core: Stir-fried Pork with Dried Dried Celery is a home-style stir-fry. The dried tofu is soft, the celery is crisp, the pork is tender, and it is salty and slightly spicy. Celery is rich in dietary fiber, and dried tofu and pork provide high-quality plant protein and animal protein. It’s simple and beginner-friendly, and only takes about 30 minutes from prep to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Dried tofu - Parsley/celery - Pork - Garlic - Chili peppers: green or red peppers are OK - Sichuan peppercorns: optional - Salt - Chicken essence: optional - Dark soy sauce - Oyster sauce - Edible oil

Calculation: Note that this value is about the amount for 2 people. Each portion: - Dried tofu: 150g - Parsley: 4 stalks - Pork: 200g - Garlic: 2 cloves - Chili pepper: 4 pieces - Sichuan peppercorns: 6 pieces (you can omit it if you don't like it, or add peppercorn water) - Salt: 5g - Chicken essence: 3g - Dark soy sauce: 8ml - Oyster sauce: 5ml - Edible oil: 10-15ml

Operation: 1. Remove the leaves from the celery and cut into strips no larger than 4cm, set aside. 2. Cut the dried sesame into strips, about the width of your little finger, set aside. 3. Slice or mince the garlic into minced garlic, set aside. 4. Cut the peppers into rings or cut them diagonally into strips, set aside. 5. Heat a pot and put 10ml - 15ml cooking oil in the pot. Wait 10 seconds for the oil temperature to rise. 6. Add peppercorns and garlic and sauté until fragrant (you can also add some extra ginger slices/shredded ginger) 7. Add pork and stir-fry until it changes color, then add 8ml dark soy sauce and stir-fry evenly (if there is bean paste, you can add 3ml bean paste and stir-fry together) 8. Add dried fragrant seeds and stir-fry evenly (about 2 minutes) 9. Add chili and stir-fry evenly (about 1-2 minutes) 10. Add celery, add 5g salt and stir-fry for 1 minute. 11. Add 3g chicken essence and 5ml oyster sauce, stir-fry evenly, and serve.

Additional content: - If you don't buy parsley, or the celery you use is thicker, you can consider blanch it, put it in boiling water for 1 minute, take it out, and rinse it with cold water (to keep it crispy) - If the tofu you buy is hard and firm, you can also cut it into strips and then blanch it - Tutorial on stir-fried pork with dried celery
Cut the celery into diagonal sections and blanch it in boiling water with a few drops of oil for 20 seconds. Use cold water to keep it green and crispy, and reduce the subsequent frying time.

Cut the lean meat into shreds, add light soy sauce, cooking wine and a little oil, mix well and marinate. The oil will seal in the water, making it less likely to stick to the pan and turn into firewood when stir-frying.

First, stir-fry the shredded pork until slightly charred, then add the dried coriander and stir-fry the beans to get the fragrance. Finally, add the celery, stir-fry over high heat for 1 minute, then season and serve.

Case: Ms. Li cooks dinner for her husband who is controlling his sugar level. Blanch celery and stir-fry it with dried fragrant and lean pork, and add millet and pepper to enhance the flavor. The finished product is refreshing, crispy and tender, and my husband’s blood sugar is stable. He praised it for being less oily than takeout and having more dietary fiber. It takes 30 minutes to complete a healthy meal.

items.id: 香煎五花肉-香煎五花肉
items.title: Pan-fried pork belly
items.core: Pan-fried pork belly is a home-style quick meat dish. The pork belly slices are pan-fried until they are crispy, fat but not greasy. It is paired with crisp lettuce leaves and salty fresh bean paste. The sauce is rich and soothing. Pork is rich in high-quality protein and fat, which can quickly replenish energy, while lettuce provides dietary fiber and vitamins, making the nutrition more balanced. This dish is suitable for friends who have some basic knowledge of cooking. Novices can also easily get started as long as they pay attention to the heat and prevent splashing of oil. It takes about half an hour from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Pork belly strips (recommended length, width and height are 20cm\6cm\5cm) - Lettuce - Soy sauce, salt, monosodium glutamate, cooking wine, ginger and garlic, oil, bean paste

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Each portion: - Pork belly strips (recommended length, width and height are 20cm\6cm\5cm) - One head of lettuce - 5ml cooking oil

Operation: 1. Slice the pork belly strips along the long side, each slice is 1mm-1.5mm thick, and set aside. 2. Place the sliced ​​pork belly in a bowl, add 8g soy sauce, 1g salt, 1g MSG, 10g cooking wine, two slices of ginger, and two flattened garlic and marinate for 10 minutes. 3. Pick off the lettuce leaves directly with your hands, wash them, and set aside. 4. Heat the pot and pour 5ml of cooking oil. When the oil smokes slightly, add the pork belly. Flip until browned on one side and do the same with the other side. 5. After the pork belly is out of the pan, put it on a plate. 6. Spread the bean paste onto the vegetable leaves, roll the pork belly and serve
Additional content: - Be careful of getting burned by oil splash during operation.
Choose fat and lean pork belly, freeze it for 1 hour and cut into 2mm thin slices. It will not fall apart easily when fried and will be evenly thick and easy to cook through.

Before placing the meat slices in the pan, use kitchen paper to absorb moisture from the surface to prevent hot oil from splashing; after the pan is hot, turn to medium-low heat and slowly fry to release the oil.
Add a little minced garlic and sesame oil to dilute the bean paste, choose young round lettuce leaves, and soak them in ice water for 5 minutes to make them crispier and less greasy.

Case: During the dinner, Mr. Zhang used kitchen paper to absorb the moisture from the pork belly slices and fry them in a pan with a little oil until both sides were golden and curled. Lettuce is placed on the bottom, and the meat slices are dipped in bean paste and rolled up. It is fat but not greasy and won praises from friends. It shows cooking skills in half an hour without any fumes.

items.title: Chicken with Mushrooms
items.core: Mushroom-smoothed chicken is a home-cooked dish that uses chicken thighs and shiitake mushrooms as the main ingredients. The chicken thighs are stir-fried and braised to give it a smooth and tender texture. It is paired with the unique aroma of the shiitake mushrooms and the soup is rich and delicious. It is a Cantonese style that is suitable for all ages. Chicken is rich in high-quality protein and a variety of amino acids, and mushrooms contain lentinan and dietary fiber, which help enhance immunity and promote digestion. This dish requires some knife skills and fire control, making it challenging for novices, and takes about an hour to make.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Large chicken drumsticks - Dried shiitake mushrooms - Ginger - Onions - Garlic

Calculation: per portion: - 2 large chicken drumsticks - 5 dried shiitake mushrooms - 2 slices of ginger - 2 green onions - 2 cloves of garlic - 150ml of warm water (30-40 ℃) - 15ml of cooking wine - 30ml of light soy sauce - 1.5g of salt - 15ml of dark soy sauce - 15ml of sugar - 5ml of sesame oil

Operation: 1. Soak the dried mushrooms in warm water. 2. Cut the ginger into small pieces, cut the green onion into sections, and cut the garlic in half into small pieces. 3. Remove the bones from the chicken legs (you can also do it without bone removal, it will only affect the programmer's eating efficiency) and cut into small pieces. 4. Divide the soaked mushrooms into quarters and reserve the mushroom water for later use. 5. Blanch the chicken legs for 1 minute to remove blood foam and impurities. 6. Add cooking wine to the chicken legs. 15ml, 15ml light soy sauce, 1.5g salt, 15ml dark soy sauce, mix well 7. Heat the oil to 30%, add the chicken thighs and stir-fry, wait until the chicken thighs are golden brown, take it out and set aside. 8. Leave the oil in the pot, add onions, ginger and garlic and stir-fry until fragrant, add the mushrooms to the pot, stir well over high heat 9. Wait 20 The aroma of mushrooms will waft out of the pot in seconds. At this time, add the stir-fried chicken legs, mushroom water (all, this programmer thinks of the soul operation), 15ml of sugar, and 30ml of light soy sauce. 10. Turn to medium heat without covering, simmer for 2 minutes to thicken the soup, pour in 5ml of sesame oil, sprinkle with chopped green onion, then turn off the heat and plate.

Additional content: - The operation of deboning chicken legs is more complicated. My experience can be used as a reference: - Place the chicken legs on the chopping board, with the bones facing the programmer. Cut a knife from the head to the bottom. The knife edge should be deep to ensure that it touches the bones. - Use your hands to pull the meat to both sides. - Use the tip of the knife to separate the meat on the bones.
Debone the chicken thighs and cut into 2 cm cubes. Add oyster sauce, light soy sauce, starch and a little oil and mix well. Marinate for 15 minutes to make it more flavorful and tender.
Soak the dried mushrooms in warm water in advance. Filter the soaking water after it settles and keep it. Add it when stewing to enhance the rich aroma and umami flavor of the mushrooms.

Stir-fry the chicken until the surface is slightly brown, then add the mushrooms, add filtered mushroom soaking water to cover the ingredients, and simmer over medium-low heat for 10 minutes to thicken the soup.

Case: Chen’s mother made mushroom-smoothed chicken for her picky eater. The chicken legs were diced and marinated in oyster sauce starch, and the dried mushrooms were soaked and sliced. Stir-fry chicken with ginger and garlic in a hot pan until white, add mushrooms and simmer until the juice is reduced. The finished product is smooth, tender and fragrant, and the children take the initiative to add rice. It takes only an hour to achieve balanced nutrition.

items.title: Spicy Chicken Feet Clay Pot
items.core: Spicy, rich and chewy, it is a common home-cooked dish. Chicken feet are rich in collagen, which helps moisturize the skin and strengthen bones. To make it, you need to remove the toenails first. If you use the whole chicken feet, you also need to remove the bones. It is a bit challenging for novices, but you can succeed if you follow the steps patiently. The whole process from blanching to simmering over low heat and then stir-frying to add flavor takes about 45 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Chicken feet - Green onions - Ginger - Cooking wine - Bay leaves - Star anise - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Garlic - Millet pepper - Chili powder (optional) - Oyster sauce - Five spice powder - Salt - Chicken essence
Calculation: - One pound of chicken feet - 3 bay leaves - 3 star anise - 6 millet peppers - 10g minced ginger - 10g minced garlic - 2 spring onions - 3g oyster sauce

Operation: 1. Cut off the nails of the chicken feet. If the chicken feet you buy only have the sole part, just cut them in half. If it is a whole chicken foot, it needs to be boned. Rinse clean with water. 2. Place the chicken feet in a pot under cold water, blanch the onions, ginger and cooking wine, bring the water to a boil and skim off the foam. 3. Add bay leaves, star anise, light soy sauce, and dark soy sauce, cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes. 4. Remove the chicken feet and keep a bowl of chicken soup aside. 5. Heat oil in a pan, stir-fry minced ginger, minced garlic, and millet pepper over low heat until fragrant. Add some chili powder if you like it spicy. Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, five-spice powder, and salt and stir-fry until the sauce becomes fragrant. 6. Add the chicken feet, season with a little salt, stir-fry for a minute or two, then pour in the chicken soup, stirring while frying. 7. Add chicken essence to enhance the freshness, add green onions and stir evenly before serving. Note: If you need to add side dishes, please add the chicken feet and stir-fry the base until fragrant.
Additional Content
After cutting the toenails off the chicken feet, wash them with flour to remove the mucus. When blanching, add ginger slices and cooking wine and cook for 3 minutes. Remove and rinse away any foam.
Debone the whole chicken feet: After cooking, let it cool, use a knife to cut along the toe bones, twist and pull out the bones, keeping the claw shape intact without breaking the skin.
When stewing, heat the water to cover the chicken feet, simmer over low heat for 40 minutes, and finally use high heat to reduce the juice and sprinkle with white sesame seeds to add flavor.

Case: Xiao Li cuts off the toenails of chicken feet when preparing a meal, blanchs them and adds ginger slices and cooking wine to remove the smell. Heat oil and sauté chicken feet in bean paste until fragrant, add spices and hot water and simmer for 40 minutes until soft and waxy. The finished product is so delicious that you can't stop chewing it when watching TV series. It is full of collagen.

items.title: Fish flavored shredded pork
items.core: Fish-flavored shredded pork is a classic Sichuan dish with a sweet and sour taste, smooth and tender pork, and rich taste with carrots, green peppers and fungus. It is rich in protein and multiple vitamins, with a combination of meat and vegetables, and balanced nutrition. It is a bit difficult to make, as you need to adjust the fish sauce and master the stir-fry temperature. Novices are advised to strictly follow the steps. The estimated preparation time is about 40 minutes (excluding fungus soaking time).
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Tenderloin 200g * Carrots 100g * Green pepper 100g * Fungus (dried) 5g * Light soy sauce 10ml * Cooking wine 5ml * 1 egg white * Starch 10g * Vinegar 15ml * Sugar 10g * Salt 5g * Ginger 20g * Onion 20g * 2 garlic cloves * Doubanjiang 15g
Calculation: Note that there is only enough version of this dish to feed 1-2 people.

Operation: Make marinade and fragrant bowl juice: 1. Make marinade: Mix the following ingredients: * Light soy sauce 5ml * Cooking wine 5ml * Starch 5g * Water 20ml * 1 egg white 2. Make fragrant sauce: Mix the following ingredients: * Light soy sauce 5ml * Vinegar 15ml * White sugar 10g * Salt 1g * Starch 5g * Water 20ml Process the ingredients: 1. Marinate the tenderloin with marinade for 15-30 minutes. Pay attention to grasp the meat evenly. 2. Soak the dried fungus for 4 hours, wash and cut into small pieces. 3. Wash the green peppers, remove the stems and cut into shreds. 4. Wash the carrots, cut into shreds, and blanch the carrot shreds. 5. Mince ginger and garlic. 6. Cut green onions into 5mm pieces. Fry various ingredients: 1. Heat the pot and add 15ml oil. 2. Pour the prepared marinated meat into the pot, spread quickly until it turns white, and set aside. 3. Heat the pan and add 5ml of oil. 4. Pour in all the onions, ginger, garlic, and bean paste. 5. Add all the carrots, stir-fry for 20 seconds, then add green pepper and fungus, stir-fry for 2 minutes. 6. Pour in the fried meat. Quickly stir-fry evenly. Be careful not to fry for more than 20 seconds. 7. Pour in the aromatic sauce. Quickly stir-fry evenly. Be careful not to fry for more than 15 seconds. 8. Turn off the heat and serve on a plate.
Additional Content

The golden ratio of fish sauce: 2 spoons of light soy sauce + 2 spoons of balsamic vinegar + 2 spoons of sugar + 1 spoon of starch + 3 spoons of water. Mix thoroughly and set aside to prevent confusion.
Soak the fungus in cold water for 2 hours in advance and cut into thin strips; cut the carrots and green peppers into matchstick-thickness to ensure consistent ripening time.
The shredded pork is starched with egg white starch, stir-fried in a hot pan with cold oil until it turns white, then scooped out. Finally, it is wrapped in sauce to keep it tender and smooth.

Case: Novice Xiao Chen soaks the fungus in advance, cuts the shredded meat, carrots, and green peppers neatly. Prepare the fish sauce and set aside. Stir-fry the shredded pork over high heat, add the garnishes, pour the sauce and stir-fry quickly. The 45-minute finished product is sour, sweet and slightly spicy, with silky and tender meat and crispy side dishes. My family thinks it is of restaurant quality.

items.title: Fish-flavored eggplant
items.core: Fish-flavored eggplant is a classic Sichuan home-cooked dish, sweet and sour and slightly spicy. The eggplant is soft and glutinous and absorbs the juice. It goes very well with rice. Eggplant is rich in dietary fiber and multiple vitamins, and can supplement protein when paired with minced meat. The difficulty of making it is medium, and you need to master the skills of frying eggplant and seasoning. Even novices can succeed with a little practice. It takes about 30 minutes from prep to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Eggplant - Minced meat - Salt - Sugar - MSG - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Vinegar - Water starch - Doubanjiang

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for one person. - 2 eggplants - 20g minced meat - 3-5g salt - 5-10g sugar - 5g MSG - 10ml light soy sauce - 5ml dark soy sauce - vinegar 10ml - 100ml water starch - 20-30g bean paste - shallots, ginger, garlic, millet (according to your own taste)

Operation: 1. Cut the eggplant into strips. 2. Cut the meat into minced meat, chop the onion, ginger, garlic, and dice the millet and pepper. 3. Prepare fish sauce: Put salt, monosodium glutamate, sugar, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, vinegar, and water starch in a bowl and stir evenly. 4. Pour 300ml oil into the pot, turn on low heat (low heat is easy to control), wait until the oil temperature is 70% hot (low heat is about 40 seconds, smoke will come out), add the eggplant and fry for two minutes, take it out when the edges of the eggplant are slightly brown. The extra oil can be scooped out and used for cooking later. 5. Leave 15-30ml of oil in the pot, pour in the minced meat and stir-fry until the color turns white, then take it out. 6. Pour 15-30ml oil into the pot, add bean paste, scallions, ginger and garlic and stir-fry until fragrant, then add minced meat and stir-fry evenly. 7. Add 80-150ml of water (the water surface is expected to be 80% of the height of the eggplant), pour in the eggplant, pour in the sauce, and stir-fry until the flavor is reduced. Finally, add the onions and stir-fry evenly before serving.
Additional content: - Depending on personal preference, you can peel the eggplant and add more minced meat. - Reference: Detailed steps for making fish-flavored eggplant

Cut the eggplant into hob pieces, sprinkle with salt and marinate for 10 minutes, squeeze out the water and then fry. This can reduce oil absorption and prevent it from falling apart to maintain its shape.
To adjust the fish flavor sauce: mix light soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and starch in proportion, and prepare it in advance to avoid burning the pot when frying.
When frying the eggplant, heat the oil to 60%, fry until the surface is slightly wrinkled and golden, take it out, and simmer it with the minced meat sauce for 2 minutes to enhance the flavor.

Case: Aunt Wang cut the eggplant into hob pieces, sprinkled with salt and marinated for 10 minutes, squeezing out water to reduce oil absorption. Heat and fry until soft and golden, take it out, sauté the minced pork and bean paste until fragrant, add the eggplant and fish sauce and simmer until the juice is reduced. The finished product is soft, glutinous and not greasy. It was served in 30 minutes and my wife praised it for eating.

items.title: Mapo Tofu
items.core: This spicy and tender tofu dish uses salted duck eggs instead of traditional bean paste. It is salty and slightly spicy, making it particularly appetizing. Rich in high-quality protein and various trace elements such as calcium and iron. It's moderately difficult to make, beginner-friendly, and takes about 40 minutes to complete.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Fatty tofu (Qingmei is recommended) - Fruit knife - Salted duck eggs (Leaving duck is recommended, this is the soul) - Pork belly (minced meat from the supermarket is also acceptable) - Garlic - Ginger - Millet pepper (optional if you don't like spicy food) - Spicy sauce (Guangle is recommended) - Sichuan peppercorns - Salt - Soy sauce (very fresh soy sauce)

Calculation: - 1 box of fat tofu - 1 salted duck egg - 20-30g pork belly - 2 cloves of garlic - 2 slices of ginger - 5 sticks of chili millet - 5g of garlic chili sauce - 20 Sichuan peppercorns - 3g of salt - 10g of soy sauce

Operation: 1. Chop the garlic and ginger, set aside 2. Cut the millet into pepper rings, set aside 3. Cut the pork belly into minced meat (skip the minced meat you bought) 4. Add half of the salt and very fresh soy sauce to the minced meat, mix well, set aside 5. Cut the duck eggs in half vertically with a kitchen knife (pay attention to safety), remove the yolk (be sure to remove it, otherwise it will be fishy), and mash the remaining egg white into about 2 mm * 2 mm size, do not break it too much, set aside 6. Open the tofu package, use a knife to cut the tofu in the box into about 2.5 cm * 3 cm size, set aside 7. Heat the pot and put 10ml - 15ml cooking oil in the pot. Wait 10 seconds for the oil temperature to rise. 8. Turn to low heat, add garlic, ginger, chili rings, Sichuan peppercorns, salted duck eggs, and garlic chili sauce and stir-fry for 20 seconds until fragrant. 9. Turn to medium heat, add minced meat, and stir-fry for about 1 minute until the meat changes color. 10. Turn to low heat, add tofu, and sprinkle the remaining salt and extremely fresh soy sauce evenly on the tofu. 11. Pour boiling water from the side of the pot (otherwise the tofu will break easily), just enough to cover the tofu. 12. Turn on high heat, turn to medium heat immediately after the water boils, and wait for about 10 minutes. 13. Wait until only 1/5 of the water is left and the surface of the tofu has taken on color, turn off the heat and serve on a plate
Additional content: - Be sure to observe carefully during this period to prevent the pot from getting stuck.
Crush the yolk of the salted duck egg, and chop the egg white into fine pieces; when frying, stir-fry the egg white until oil comes out, then add the egg yolk and stir-fry the red sand oily sauce.

Cut the tender tofu into 2cm pieces, blanch it in boiling water with a little salt for 30 seconds and take it out. This can remove the beany smell and prevent it from breaking while maintaining its intact shape.
After adding the tofu, use the back of a spatula to gently push it. Do not stir-fry. Simmer over medium-low heat for 3 minutes to allow the tofu to absorb the flavor, and finally thicken the gravy.

Case: Xiao Zhao innovatively used salted duck eggs instead of bean paste, crushed the egg yolks and stir-fried the red oil, added minced meat and tender tofu cubes and gently simmered. Sprinkle with pepper powder and chopped green onion, and the dish is salty and slightly numb. It subverts the tradition. The finished product in 40 minutes is tender and delicious. My roommate exclaimed that it is appetizing and delicious.

items.title: Spicy hot pot
items.core: A spicy and rich Sichuan-style home-cooked dish, which brings together vegetables, meat and soy products. It has a spicy and spicy taste and rich layers. The combination of meat and vegetables provides high-quality protein and multiple vitamins, providing comprehensive nutrition. The steps are clear and you need to master the heat of blanching and stir-frying, which is a challenge for novices. The total production time is about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Green vegetables (rapeseed, lettuce, spinach) - Boneless meat (pork, beef, chicken, fish balls, ham sausage) - Dried tofu - Beijing Spicy Instant Noodles - Dried chili peppers

Calculation: This value is approximately the amount for 3 people. - A total of 455 grams of vegetables is required, of which the proportion of rapeseed, lettuce and spinach can be allocated according to your preference - A total of 430 grams of boneless meat is required, of which the proportion of pork, beef, chicken, fish balls and ham sausage can be allocated according to your preference - 152 grams of dried tofu - 1 bag of Beijing spicy instant noodles - 5 grams of dried chili - 110 grams of spicy hot pot seasoning In the above content, the ratio of green vegetables, boneless meat, dried tofu, and Beijing spicy instant noodles is the recommended ratio. If you have your favorite ingredients, you can redistribute the ratio according to your preference.

Operation: 1. Boil a pot of water (just enough water to cover the ingredients in steps 2-4). 2. Add green vegetables to boiling water, blanch for 5 minutes and set aside. 3. Add boneless meat to boiling water, blanch for 4 minutes and set aside. 4. Add Beijing Spicy Instant Noodles to boiling water, cook for 2 minutes and set aside. 5. Pour out the boiling water, dry the pot, add 105 grams of cooking oil, and heat over high heat for 30 seconds. 6. Add spicy hot pot seasoning and stir-fry for 20 seconds. 7. Add dried chilies and stir-fry for 10 seconds. 8. Add the blanched vegetables, increase the heat to medium, and stir-fry for 3 minutes. 9. Add blanched boneless meat and stir-fry for 3 minutes. 10.
