Add the cooked Beijing Spicy Instant Noodles and stir with chopsticks for 1 minute. 11. Turn off the heat and remove from the pot.

Additional content: Notes on fire temperature: - A large fire usually has a temperature of 240 degrees Celsius, taking an induction cooker as an example, the input power is about 2 kilowatts. - Medium heat usually has a temperature of 120 degrees Celsius, and for an induction cooker, for example, the input power is about 1.4 kilowatts.
Blank ingredients in separate pots: Boil meat until half-cooked, blanch vegetables until raw, drain and then stir-fry to avoid water diluting the spicy flavor.
For the base, use hot pot base, add a little bean paste and peppercorns, stir-fry the red oil over low heat and then add the ingredients. The aroma will be richer and more authentic.

Put them into the pot in order of frying resistance: stir-fry the luncheon meat and shrimps first, then add the lotus root slices and broccoli. Stir-fry quickly over high heat to lock in the crispness and tenderness.

Case: Friends are having a dinner together. Xiaolin prepares lotus root, lunch meat and shrimp paste, blanchs them separately and drains them. Stir-fry the spicy base in a hot pan until fragrant. Add the meat first and stir-fry until it changes color, then add the vegetables and quickly stir-fry for seasoning. The fragrant pot was served in 30 minutes. The meat and vegetables were balanced and spicy, and everyone rushed to eat it up.

items.title: Butter Chicken
items.core: This is a classic curry dish originating from India. It is made of roasted and then stewed chicken legs with a sauce made of tomatoes, butter and cream. It has a mellow and silky taste, sweet and sour slightly spicy, and a unique complex aroma of spices. Chicken, yogurt, and cashews provide a rich source of protein and healthy fats, while tomatoes and spices also provide vitamins and antioxidants. There are certain challenges in making it, as you need to master the balance of heat and spices. Including marinating time, it takes about 1 hour and 45 minutes to complete.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Chicken thighs (boneless) - Yogurt - Butter - Heavy Cream - Tomatoes - Onions - Ginger - Garlic - Cashews (for thickening) - Turmeric powder - Red chili powder (Kashmiri red chili powder is the best, red in color and not spicy in taste) - Indian mixed spice powder (Garam Masala) - Coriander powder - Cumin powder - Cardamom powder - Dried Fenugreek Leaves (Kasuri Methi) - Optional but highly recommended - Sugar - Salt - Cooking Oil - Wok - Blender/Cooking Machine

Calculation: You need to decide how many servings you plan to make before making each time. One serving is just enough for 3-4 people. Per portion: Marinate chicken part: - 500g chicken thighs (boneless, cut into large pieces) - 80ml yogurt - 10g ginger, grated - 4 cloves garlic (approx. 12g), grated - 5g red chili powder - 3g turmeric powder - 3g salt - 15ml lemon juice - 15ml cooking oil Sauce part: - 5 tomatoes (approx. 500g), cut into pieces - 1 onion (about 100g), cut into pieces - 30g cashew nuts - 10g ginger - 4 cloves garlic - butter 50g - light cream 100ml - red chili powder 5g (Kashmiri red chili powder is the best) - coriander powder 5g - cumin powder 3g - Indian mixed spice powder 3g - cardamom powder 2g - 3g of dried fenugreek leaves (crushed by hand) - 10g of sugar - 5g of salt - 100ml of water

Operation: Marinate chicken (1 hour in advance): 1. Mix yogurt, ginger paste, garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric powder, salt, lemon juice in a large bowl 2. Add chicken pieces and coat well with marinade 3. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to marinate Grilled chicken: 1. Pour 15ml cooking oil into the pan and heat over high heat 2. Put the marinated chicken pieces into the pan (do not pour the marinade) 3. Fry over high heat until both sides are browned (about 3 minutes per side), the chicken does not need to be fully cooked 4. Dish out and set aside. Make the sauce base: 1. Add 100ml of tomato cubes, onion cubes, cashews, ginger, garlic and water in the pan 2. Bring to a boil over high heat, then turn to medium heat and cook for 15 minutes, until all ingredients are completely soft. 3. After cooling slightly, pour into a blender and beat into a smooth puree. 4. Strain through a mesh to remove residue and obtain a smooth sauce. Set aside. Stew: 1. Put 50g butter in a wok and heat over medium heat to melt. 2. Pour in the filtered tomato sauce. 3. Add 5g red pepper powder, 5g coriander powder, 3g cumin powder, and 5g salt. 4. Stir-fry. 3-5 minutes, until the color of the sauce turns dark and the oil floats. 5. Add the roasted chicken pieces and stir evenly. 6. Add 10g sugar (to balance the sourness of the tomatoes) and stir. 7. Pour in 100ml light cream and stir evenly. 8. Simmer for 10-12 minutes to allow the chicken to be fully cooked and absorb the sauce. 9. Add 3g Indian mixed spice powder and 2g cardamom powder 10. Sprinkle in dried fenugreek leaves. 3g (crushed by hand and sprinkled in) 11. Stir evenly and turn off the heat 12. Serve on a plate, you can add a small amount of whipped cream as decoration

Additional content: - Dried fenugreek leaves (Kasuri Methi) are the key ingredient for the unique flavor of this dish, which can give a special herbal aroma. It can be purchased in Indian food stores or e-commerce platforms. - Use Kashmiri red chilli powder for a brighter red color but less spiciness. If you can't find it, halve regular red pepper powder and add 3g of red bell pepper powder. -The cashews make the sauce thicker and smoother. If you are allergic to nuts, substitute an equal amount of whipping cream. - This dish is usually served with Naan or Basmati rice. - Butter chicken is considered one of India's greatest contributions to world cuisine and is featured on almost every Indian restaurant menu around the world.

Debone the chicken thighs and cut them into cubes. Marinate them with yogurt + ginger garlic paste + curry powder + cumin powder for 1 hour. The acidity softens the meat and removes the fishy smell to increase the aroma.
Cashew nuts are soaked in warm water for 20 minutes in advance and smashed into a delicate sauce together with sauteed onions and tomatoes, which is the key to a mellow taste.

Bake the chicken in the oven at 200℃ for 15 minutes until the surface is caramelized, then add the sauce and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes. Finally, add butter and cream and stir well to thicken.

Case: Trying out Indian flavor on the weekend, Mr. Wang marinated the chicken legs with yogurt and spices for 1 hour, grilled them until slightly charred and set aside. Sauté onions, tomatoes and cashews to make a sauce, add chicken and butter and stew. After 1 hour and 45 minutes, the sauce will be mellow and you can enjoy an exotic meal with rice.

items.title: Braised Chicken
items.core: Braised Chicken is a home-cooked dish with chicken legs, mushrooms, and green peppers as the main ingredients. The soup is rich, the chicken is tender, salty and slightly sweet, and it goes very well with rice. Rich in high-quality protein and mushroom polysaccharides and other nutrients. The process of frying the sugar color is slightly challenging, but it can be replaced by dark soy sauce. The overall difficulty is not high, and novices can master it smoothly. From prep to serving, it takes about 40 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - chicken legs - shiitake mushrooms (dried shiitake mushrooms are best) - green peppers - ginger slices - dried chili peppers - salt - cooking wine - white pepper - sugar - soy sauce - MSG - potatoes (optional)

Calculation: - chicken legs = two - shiitake mushrooms (dried shiitake mushrooms are best) = 5 - green peppers = two - ginger slices = two slices - dried chilies = 5,6 - salt = 10g - cooking wine = 10ml - white pepper = 5g - sugar = 5g - soy sauce = 5ml - potato = one (optional, can make the soup thicker)

Operation: Preparation stage: 1. Wash the chicken legs and chop into 4cm pieces 2. Slice the ginger and cut the dried chili into small rings 3. Slice the mushrooms and cut the green peppers into long and thin horseshoe shapes. If they are dried, wash the dust and soak them overnight and reserve the mushroom water for later use. 4. If you have potatoes, cut them into hob pieces similar to the size of chicken. Stir-frying stage: 1. Stir-fry sugar color: Pour base oil into the pot, add sugar when the oil is cold (there is a certain difficulty, novices can skip to frying chicken and use dark soy sauce instead) 2. Heat slowly over low heat until the oil temperature gradually rises and the sugar begins to melt and turn into a darker brown color (keep stirring during this period to prevent it from sticking to the pot) 3. Quickly add the chicken pieces, turn up the heat and stir-fry quickly! Add the cooking wine and continue to stir-fry for a while. 4. Add the ginger slices and dried chili peppers. 5. Add the soy sauce and stir-fry evenly. 6. Pour in the mushroom water or water to cover the chicken. 7. Pour in the mushroom slices, white pepper, salt, and potatoes. 8. After stir-frying evenly, cover the pot and simmer. Turn to medium-low heat for 15-20 minutes. If possible, transfer to a casserole. 9. After the chicken is tender and the soup is thickened (don't make the soup too dry), finally add green pepper 10. Add MSG, stir-fry evenly, and turn off the heat! Just cut the green peppers basically raw, don't fry them for too long
Additional Content

Cut the chicken legs into pieces and soak them in cold water for 10 minutes to remove the blood. When blanching, add ginger slices and cooking wine. Boil until foam comes out, rinse and drain, then stir-fry to remove the fishy smell.

No need to fry the sugar color for beginners: 2 spoons of light soy sauce + 1 spoon of dark soy sauce + 1 spoon of oyster sauce + 5 pieces of rock sugar. When stir-frying the chicken pieces, pour in and stir-fry until browned.
Soak and slice shiitake mushrooms, stir-fry with chicken pieces to absorb the umami flavor; add green peppers for the last 5 minutes to maintain a crisp texture and bright color.

Case: Xiao Zhou, an office worker, uses dark soy sauce instead of stir-fried sugar. He blanchs chicken leg pieces and stir-fries with soaked mushrooms. Adds light soy sauce, dark soy sauce and hot water to simmer. Finally, add the green pepper to reduce the juice, and the salty, slightly sweet braised chicken is ready for 40 minutes. The rich soup is poured over the rice, making it warm and satisfying for one person.

items.title: Cucumber Stir-fried Pork
items.core: This is a refreshing, crispy and tender home-cooked dish, salty and delicious, with garlic flavor and slight spiciness. Rich in protein and multivitamins, it helps clear away heat and replenishes moisture. It's friendly to novices, as long as you pay attention to the heat, you can succeed. It is expected to take about 25 minutes to make.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Cucumber * Lean pork * Edible oil * Light soy sauce * Salt * Garlic * Spicy millet

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person Total quantity: Cucumber = 100 g serving Pork = 50 g serving Amount of oil = 50 g serving Amount of salt = 10 g serving Soy sauce = 5 g serving Garlic cloves = 2 cloves serving Spicy millet = 1 serving No.

Operation: 1. Slice the lean pork, put it in a bowl, and pour in cooking oil 10 grams of light soy sauce, mix well, and marinate for 10 minutes. 2. Cut off 5 cm of the head and tail of the cucumber, and cut the remaining part into 0.5 cm slices diagonally. 3. Pour the cucumber into a bowl, sprinkle with 8 grams of salt, stir well, and marinate for 5 minutes. 4. Peel the garlic cloves, flatten them, and mince them for later use. 5. Dice the millet and cut it into even 0.5 cm segments. 6. Heat the pan and pour oil. 40 grams, wait until the oil is hot enough to smoke, add minced garlic and millet and stir-fry 5 times. 7. Add the marinated lean pork, stir-fry until the meat is cooked and changes color. 8. Add cucumber, add 2 grams of salt, stir-fry evenly for half a minute on high heat, and take it out of the pan. * If the high heat cannot be guaranteed, it may be a little raw. Consider increasing to 50 seconds.
Additional Content

Crack the cucumber with the back of a knife and cut it into sections. The rough section will make it easier to absorb the flavor. When frying, the whole process should be done over high heat for no more than two minutes to maintain the crispiness.

Cut the lean meat into thin slices against the grain, add a little light soy sauce, starch and oil, mix well and marinate for ten minutes, put it in the pot and remove it from the dish to avoid aging.

First saute the minced garlic and dried chili until fragrant, add the meat slices and stir-fry until they change color, then add the cucumber. Drizzle a little balsamic vinegar along the edge of the pot to stimulate the aroma of the garlic.

Case study: I ​​only had cucumbers and lean meat in the refrigerator when I got home from get off work late. I split the cucumbers into sections and sliced ​​the meat to capture the starch. I sautéed the garlic in a hot pan with cold oil and then stir-fried it over high heat for two minutes. The dish was crispy and tender but not watery. I ate it with rice and the whole family ate it.

items.title: Black Pepper Beef Tenderloin
items.core: Black Pepper Beef Tenderloin is a popular home-style stir-fry. It has a rich black pepper flavor and tender tenderloin. It is paired with sweet and crispy onions and colorful peppers. It has a balanced meat and vegetable taste and is suitable for all ages. Beef is rich in high-quality protein and iron, and bell peppers and onions can supplement a variety of vitamins. This dish is very novice-friendly and can usually be completed within an hour from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Beef (you can use beef tenderloin or steak meat) - Onions - Vegetable peppers (red/yellow peppers) - Starch - Black pepper (powder) - Black pepper (marinate) - Salt - Peanut oil Note: Powder and marinade can be substituted for each other. Please refer to the instructions on the food package you purchased for the specific dosage. It is recommended to use a non-stick pan.

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2-3 people. Total amount: - Amount of beef = number of servings * 100 grams (depending on the stomach capacity of the diner and the capacity of the pot) - Amount of onions = number of servings * 1/12 pieces (that is, cut into 1/4 for 3 people) - Amount of peppers = number of servings * 1/12 pieces (that is, cut into 1/4 for 3 people) - Amount of salt = number of servings 1g - Starch = number of servings * 3g - Black pepper marinade = marinate in proportion according to the instructions of the purchased product - Black pepper = number of servings * 1g (actually sprinkle it casually) - Peanut oil = number of servings * 10ml (actually the amount of oil changes based on the amount of vegetables. If the amount of beef increases or decreases, please change it in the corresponding proportion) Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials planned to be used.

Operation: 1. Cut the beef into strips, the length is preferably less than 8 cm, the thickness is about 5-10 mm, and the width is about 1 cm (the requirements are not strict) 2. Marinate the beef with marinade, mix evenly and let it stand. Please refer to the product description for the dosage and time. It can be extended but not shortened. 3. If you use liquid marinade, you can sprinkle a layer of black pepper three minutes before the end of marinating, then add starch, mix evenly again and let it sit for 20 minutes. 4. Turn on the heat, heat the pan, and add peanut oil. 5. When you can see a trace of smoke coming out of the oil in the pot, add the beef and stir-fry. 6. Turn on medium-high heat and stir-fry for 2 minutes until the appearance of the beef changes color (that is, there is no obvious blood color, and the bloody part means that the stir-fry is not done properly) (be careful with oil droplets splashing here). 7. Add onions and peppers and stir-fry for 2 minutes. 8. Add salt, sprinkle again with black pepper, stir-fry for 30 seconds, and stir evenly. 9. Observe that the onions have softened, then turn off the heat, remove from the pan, and serve on a plate.
Additional Content

Choose beef tenderloin and cut it into strips against the grain, add light soy sauce, oyster sauce, baking soda and starch and mix well. Finally, seal in oil and refrigerate for 20 minutes to make it more tender.
Cut the onions and colored peppers into diamond-shaped pieces. Stir-fry the onions over high heat until translucent before adding the beef to avoid water diluting the flavor of the black pepper.
Sprinkle freshly ground black pepper before serving, using the residual heat to stimulate the aroma, making it richer and less bitter than adding it in advance.

Case: I marinated the beef tenderloin in advance for a weekend dinner with friends, cut the bell peppers and onions into cubes, and stir-fried them over high heat for ten minutes. The aroma of black pepper was fragrant, the beef tenderloin was tender and tender, and the side dishes were sweet and crispy. Even children who don’t usually eat spicy food added rice to it.

items.id: 黔式腊肠娃娃菜-黔式腊肠娃娃菜
items.title: Guizhou-style sausage and baby cabbage
items.core: This dish is salty, fresh and delicious. It combines the mellow aroma of Guizhou-style sausage and the sweetness of baby cabbage. It is a rare non-spicy flavor in southwestern cuisine and is suitable for both north and south. Baby cabbage is rich in vitamins and dietary fiber, and combined with the protein and fat of sausage, it is nutritionally balanced. The preparation process is extremely simple, and there is no need to control the heat or additional seasoning. It only takes 15 minutes from preparation to serving, making it very suitable for novices and busy daily people.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Guizhou-style sausage - Baby cabbage
Calculation: According to the portion of 1 person: - Guizhou-style sausage 200g - Baby cabbage 300g - Water 750ml

Operation: 1. Put 750ml water in the pot, heat to boiling 2. Add the sausage and time it for 13 minutes 3. Add the baby cabbage and time it for 2 minutes 4. Turn off the heat, take out the sausage and baby cabbage 5. Cut the baby cabbage into sections, slice the sausage, and put it on a plate

Additional content: - Depending on the size of the pot, it is recommended that the amount of water cover the ingredients, rather more than less - If you don’t have a knife, you can also leave the baby cabbage and sausage uncut
There is no need to defrost the sausage in advance. Steam it directly under cold water for ten minutes. The oil seeped into the baby cabbage can replace additional oil for seasoning.

The baby cabbage is cut lengthwise into four pieces and placed on the plate. The sides of the cabbage face outward for easier cooking. Wrapping the sausage slices in the cabbage leaves can lock in the sweet juice.

Spread a few slices of ginger or scallions on the bottom of the plate to remove the pickling flavor from the sausage. After steaming, pour a little soy sauce on the steamed fish to enhance its freshness. Be careful not to add too much salt to avoid being salty.

Case: After working overtime until I got home at eight o'clock, I took out the Guizhou-style sausage slices from the freezer, spread out the Chinese baby cabbage on a plate, put the sausage on it and steamed it for ten minutes.

items.id: 上汤娃娃菜-上汤娃娃菜
items.title: Potato cabbage in soup
items.core: This baby cabbage in soup is sweet and delicious, with a soft texture. It is a home-cooked vegetarian dish, especially suitable for consumption during weight loss. Baby cabbage is rich in vitamins and dietary fiber, low in fat and calories. It can be paired with preserved eggs and luncheon meat to add flavor without adding too much burden. The preparation is moderately difficult and can be tried by novices. It only takes about 20 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Baby cabbage - Preserved eggs - Luncheon meat (ham sausage) - Onion - Ginger - Garlic - Salt - Sugar - Starch

Calculation: Note that this dish is only available in a version that is enough for 2-4 people. - 700g baby cabbage - 10g enoki mushrooms (depends on personal preference, leave it out if you don't like see you tomorrow 😂) - One preserved egg (you can omit it if you don't have it) - Luncheon meat (ham sausage can be substituted)

Operation: 1. Wash the baby cabbage, cut it vertically and cut it into sections. 2. Cut 3g green onion into small pieces. 10g garlic sliced. 10g ginger cut into small slices. 3. Cut preserved eggs into dices, ham sausage or luncheon meat into dices (1cm size) 4. Wash and tear the enoki mushrooms 5. Heat hot water and put the baby cabbage in for ten seconds and drain out the water. 6. Heat the pan and cool the oil. Pour the oil into the heated pan and then pour it out. Pour in a little more oil. 7. Reduce the heat to low, add onions, ginger and garlic, and stir-fry until fragrant. 8. Add appropriate 300g of water (the amount of water is enough to cover the baby cabbage), add baby cabbage, enoki mushrooms, and luncheon meat. 9. Add seasonings oyster sauce, sugar, salt, and MSG and bring to a boil. 10. Cook for 3 minutes. After boiling, start to put it on the plate. After taking out the baby cabbage, put the preserved egg on top and pour the soup on it. 11. Although the photography skills are limited, the taste is still very good.
Additional Content

Blanch the baby cabbage whole for 30 seconds before cutting into sections. This can keep the leaves intact and prevent them from being cooked. When placing on the plate, put the vegetables at the bottom and the leaves at the top.

Before cutting the preserved eggs into slices, use a stringer to cut them more neatly than a knife. Fry the luncheon meat until slightly charred and then add it to the soup. The aroma is significantly improved compared to boiling it directly.

Use chicken broth or boiling water with a little salt for the soup. Avoid using bone soup that has been simmered for a long time. A light soup base can highlight the sweetness of the baby cabbage itself.

Case study: At noon on a light meal day, I cut half a preserved egg and two slices of luncheon meat. Blanched the baby cabbage and put it in a bowl. Pour in hot chicken soup, sprinkle with wolfberry and simmer for three minutes. It was sweet and delicious without any greasy feeling. My stomach was very comfortable after eating and I didn't feel sleepy in the afternoon.

items.title: Qianlong cabbage
items.core: Qianlong cabbage is a classic Beijing-style cold dish. It is made of hand-shredded cabbage hearts mixed with thick sesame sauce. It has a sweet and sour taste, crispy, mellow and appetizing. Cabbage is rich in vitamins and dietary fiber, while sesame paste brings high-quality fat and calcium, which is refreshing and nutritious. There is no frying or boiling in the whole process, just make the sauce and mix well. It is very friendly to novices and it usually only takes 10 minutes to serve it on the table.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Chinese cabbage (yellow-centered young leaves, yellow-centered cabbage in winter is best) - sesame paste - mature vinegar (Zhenjiang balsamic vinegar or Shanxi mature vinegar is recommended) - white sugar - sesame oil - cooked white sesame seeds (optional, for garnishing)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each portion: - 300g Chinese cabbage leaves - 30g sesame paste (about 2 tablespoons) - 45ml aged vinegar (about 3 tablespoons, the ratio of vinegar to sesame paste is about 3:2) - 5g sugar (about 1 teaspoon) - 5ml sesame oil - 1g salt - 3g cooked white sesame seeds (optional)

Operation: 1. Only take the inner young leaves (yellow part) of the Chinese cabbage, remove the edges, and tear it into half-palm-sized pieces by hand. Do not cut it with a knife (the rough section when cut by hand is easier for sauce to hang on) 2. Rinse the torn cabbage leaves and fully control the water. The remaining water will prevent the sauce from hanging. 3. Add 30g of sesame paste to the bowl, first add 45ml Aged vinegar, stir in the same direction, and slowly dilute the sesame paste until it drips in a thin line (do not stir back and forth, as it will cause the sesame paste to "leak out") 4. Add 5g of white sugar to the sesame sauce, and stir evenly; add 1g of salt, and stir evenly; finally add 5ml of sesame oil, and stir evenly (each seasoning needs to be added in batches and stirred separately, feeling the consistency while adding) 5. Pour the prepared sesame sauce evenly on the cabbage leaves, and mix gently with your hands to coat each leaf with the sauce. 6. Sprinkle with cooked white sesame seeds, plate and serve; if you have enough time, let it sit for 5 minutes until the flavor is absorbed before eating

Additional content: - Water control of cabbage is key, the drier the better; wet cabbage leaves cannot hold the sesame sauce, and the taste of the entire dish will be diluted. - When preparing sesame sauce, you must first use vinegar to "solubilize" the sauce, and then add other seasonings in sequence. Do not pour them all at once. - Zhenjiang balsamic vinegar is preferred for mature vinegar, as it has the most suitable color and sour aroma; it is not recommended to use rice vinegar (too light) or white vinegar (light color and thin taste). - This recipe is a vinegar-sugar version. If you want the taste to be more mellow and round, you can replace half of the white sugar with honey.
Only take the tenderest part of the cabbage and tear it into irregular large pieces by hand. The rough section can catch the thick sesame sauce better than cutting with a knife.

Pour the sesame paste in one direction with warm water, add a little salt, sugar and balsamic vinegar to make it look like yogurt. If it is too thick, it will form lumps and it will be difficult to mix well.

After mixing, let it sit for five minutes before eating. This will allow the vegetable leaves to release a little water and blend with the sauce. The taste will be more mellow and the water will not dilute the taste.

Case: There was too much fish and meat on the New Year’s Eve dinner. I tore two cabbage hearts and mixed them with sesame sauce. It was sour, sweet and crispy and instantly relieved the greasiness. My relatives even said that it was more popular than meat. After ten minutes of recording, I was asked how to make it. The whole process was not started.

items.title: Cold fungus
items.core: Cold fungus, because there are a lot of dry goods in the distribution materials, fungus is a relatively healthy food. And the cooking method of cold fungus is relatively simple.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Dry fungus (wet fungus can also be soaked, but it cannot be soaked too long ago, it must be fresh wet fungus) * Garlic cloves * White sugar * Chili millet * Salt * Sesame oil * Light soy sauce * Vinegar * Mustard (optional)

Calculation: per serving (for 1 person): * Dry fungus: 20g / Wet fungus: 120g * Garlic cloves: 2-3 * Spicy millet: 2 * Salt: 2 g * Sugar: 5-10g (according to personal taste) * Light soy sauce: 15ml * Vinegar: 15ml * Sesame oil: 5ml * Mustard: (about 2cm)

Operation: 1. Soak the dried fungus, add about 400ml of water, and soak for about 45 minutes. (Skip this step for wet fungus) 2. Remove the roots of the soaked fungus (as shown in Figures 4, 5, 6), and wash thoroughly. 3. Boil water in a pot. When the water boils, add the fungus and cook over high heat for 1.5-2 minutes. 4. Chop the garlic cloves and millet into a bowl (you can choose a medium to large bowl), and add salt, sugar, light soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, and mustard in order, with the above amounts. 5. Drain the fungus and put it into the bowl from the previous step. 6. Stir thoroughly and serve.

Additional content: * The amount of condiments can be adjusted according to personal taste. If you don’t like mustard, you don’t need to add it. * The fungus will taste better after it cools down, about 15 minutes.

The fungus must be soaked in cold water for more than 2 hours. If soaked in hot water, it will become soft and lose its crispness. After soaking, pick off the hard stems at the root and tear off the florets.

Add a few drops of oil to boiling water, blanch the fungus for 90 seconds and immediately drain it into ice water to cool. The thermal expansion and contraction will make the taste more crispy, tender and chewy.
The sauce is mixed with minced garlic, light soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, sugar and sesame oil. Avoid adding pepper oil or chili oil to avoid covering up the fragrance of the fungus.

Case: I received dried fungus in the supply package for home quarantine. I soaked it in cold water one night in advance, blanched it for two minutes the next day, added minced garlic, balsamic vinegar and a small amount of sesame oil and mixed it cold. It was crispy and appetizing and was eaten with porridge. Even my picky nephew ate two bowls.

items.title: Cold lettuce
items.core: A refreshing home-cooked cold dish, the richness of sesame sauce wraps the crispness and tenderness of the lettuce, with a mixture of sweet, sour and salty flavors, very appetizing. Lettuce is rich in vitamins and dietary fiber, while sesame paste supplements calcium and healthy fats, providing a balanced nutrition. There is no difficulty in making it, just cut everything and mix it. It only takes ten minutes from preparation to serving. It is especially suitable for novices and quick dishes when you are busy.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Lettuce * Sesame paste * Soy sauce * Vinegar * Oyster sauce * Sugar * Sesame oil * Garlic * Salt

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 1-2 people. Total amount: 1 romaine lettuce (about 200g) 15ml vinegar 5ml soy sauce 10ml sesame oil 5g sugar 10ml oyster sauce 2 heads of garlic

Operation: 1. Crush the garlic and mince 2. Put vinegar, soy sauce, sesame paste, sesame oil, sugar, oyster sauce, and minced garlic into a bowl and stir evenly. 3. Cut the lettuce into sections, each section no longer than 4cm. 4. Put the lettuce into a larger basin, pour the sauce into the above bowl, and stir thoroughly.
Additional content: * Sesame sauce can be replaced with peanut butter * Sesame sauce must be mixed evenly with lettuce to taste better.
After washing the lettuce, be sure to spin it dry or squeeze the water with gauze. Mixing the sauce with water will dilute the taste and make the water collapse, affecting the crisp and tender taste.

Pour the sesame paste into a flowable state with a small amount of warm water, and add a little sugar and balsamic vinegar to balance it. It is more appetizing and relieves greasiness than pure salty taste.

The length of the vegetable segments should be controlled at 4-5 cm. If they are too long, it is difficult to pick them up, and if they are too short, they may become watery. Eat them as soon as possible after mixing to avoid them becoming soft.

Case: I have no appetite in the dog days of summer, so I wash the lettuce and cut it into two sections, squeeze out the water and mix in the diluted sesame paste. The sweet, sour and salty flavor fills my mouth in one bite. It is served with white porridge in five minutes. My husband takes the initiative to pack the leftovers with him after finishing the meal.

items.title: Cold Lettuce
items.core: A crisp and refreshing home-cooked cold side dish. The lettuce is extra crispy and tender after being pickled, with a slight spiciness, which is very appetizing. Rich in vitamins and dietary fiber, low in calories. The preparation is simple and friendly to novices. It takes about twenty minutes from preparation to serving. The flavor is better after being chilled.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Lettuce * Radish * Spicy millet * Ginger * Garlic * Salt * Edible oil
Calculation: Each portion: * 1 lettuce * 0.25 radish * 2 spicy millets * 1 slice of ginger * 2 garlic * Salt 5 g * Edible oil 25 ml

Operation: 1. Peel the lettuce and cut into small strips. Cut the radish into strips, put them into a large bowl, add salt, stir, and let stand for 10 minutes. 2. Wash the lettuce with water 1-2 times after placing it. 3. Boil water in a pot, add lettuce, and cook for 1 minute. Remove, drain, and put into a large bowl. 4. Heat oil in a pot, add ginger slices, garlic granules, and millet pepper, stir-fry for 30-45 seconds, and pour into the lettuce. 5. Stir thoroughly and serve

Additional content: * The radish is not necessary, just to increase the variety of the dish * After serving, you can add additional seasonings such as light soy sauce, white sugar, balsamic vinegar, sesame, etc. according to your personal taste * The size of the lettuce strips depends on your personal taste, but the lettuce skin should be peeled as much as possible, otherwise it will really affect the taste * The chilled effect is more
Cut the lettuce into shreds and marinate it with 1% salt for 10 minutes to squeeze out excess water to make it crispier. After marinating, rinse with cold water and squeeze dry.
After mixing well, put it in the refrigerator for 15 minutes before eating. The low temperature can tighten the lettuce cells, increase the crispness and make the spiciness softer and refreshing.

Use balsamic vinegar, a small amount of sugar and minced garlic for seasoning to enhance the freshness, and pour the chili oil at the end to avoid adding it in advance and making the lettuce watery and bitter.

Case: Before dinner, I found that the lettuce was a little wilted. I peeled it, cut it into thin strips, and marinated it with salt for ten minutes. I squeezed out the water and mixed it with vinegar and chili oil. I took it out of the refrigerator for fifteen minutes. It was crispy and slightly spicy and even more delicious than when it was fresh. The whole family rushed to pick it up.

items.title: Cold Tofu
items.core: This cold dish is refreshing and delicious, rich in plant protein and calcium, low in fat and healthy. It is simple and quick to make. It only takes 10 minutes for beginners to complete it.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Tofu (Northern tofu or old tofu is recommended) - Spring onions - Garlic - Light soy sauce - Sesame oil - Vinegar (optional) - Sugar (optional) - Chili oil (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Per serving: - 250 g tofu (about 1 common size piece of tofu) - 10 g green onion - 2-3 cloves garlic - 15 ml light soy sauce - 5 ml sesame oil - 5 ml vinegar (optional) - 2 g sugar (optional) - 5 ml chili oil (optional)

Operation: 1. Cut the tofu into 2 cm square pieces and set aside. 2. Add 500 ml drinking water to the pot and bring to a boil over high heat. 3. Add the tofu cubes and cook for 1-2 minutes to remove the beany smell and make the tofu firmer. 4. Take out the cooked tofu pieces, drain the water, put them in a bowl, and set aside. 5. Wash the green onions, cut into chopped green onions and set aside. 6. Peel the garlic, cut into minced garlic, and set aside. 7. In a clean small bowl, add 15 ml light soy sauce, 5 ml sesame oil, 5 ml vinegar (optional), and 2 g white sugar (optional). 8. Add minced garlic. 9. Stir evenly to fully dissolve the sugar and mix the sauce evenly. 10. Pour the prepared sauce evenly over the tofu pieces. 11. Sprinkle with chopped green onions. 12. Drizzle with 5 ml chili oil (optional) according to personal preference. 13. Use chopsticks or spoon to mix gently and serve.

Additional content: - When making cold tofu, it is recommended to use northern tofu or old tofu with a harder texture, which is not easy to break and has a better taste. - If you prefer a lighter taste, you can omit the vinegar and chili oil. -The proportion of sauce can be adjusted according to personal taste.
Choose lactone tofu or soft tofu for a smoother taste. Before cutting into pieces, turn the box upside down and make four cuts on the plate. The whole piece will be unmolded and not easy to break.
Pour the sauce along the edge of the plate, avoid hitting it directly on the tofu, use the back of a spoon to push gently and mix well. Stirring vigorously will cause the tofu to become crumbly.
The flavor will be better when eaten chilled. You can add a little chopped mustard or preserved egg dices to increase the texture, but it should not be too much to cover up the bean flavor.

Case study: It was a sweltering summer afternoon and I lost my appetite. I took out the boxed soft tofu and cut it into cubes, topped it with light soy sauce, sesame oil and chopped green onion, and mixed it gently with a spoon.

items.title: Cold Enoki Mushrooms
items.core: Cold Enoki Mushrooms is a simple and quick home-cooked appetizer with a crisp, tender and smooth texture, salty and slightly sour. Enoki mushrooms are rich in dietary fiber and multivitamins and have low calories. The entire preparation process only requires blanching and seasoning. It is very friendly to novices and can be prepared quickly when you are busy. It only takes about 10 minutes from prep to done.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Enoki mushrooms - Spring onions - Garlic - Light soy sauce - Vinegar - Sugar (optional) - Sesame oil (optional) - Chili oil (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Per portion: - 150 g Enoki mushrooms (about 1 small package) - 5 g spring onions - 2 cloves garlic - 15 ml light soy sauce - 10 ml vinegar - 3 g sugar (optional) - 5 ml sesame oil (optional) - 5 ml chili oil (optional)

Operation: 1. Cut off the roots of Enoki mushrooms, rinse them with clean water and set aside. 2. Wash the green onions, cut into chopped green onions, and set aside. 3. Peel the garlic, cut into minced garlic, and set aside. 4. Add 1000 ml drinking water to the pot and bring to a boil over high heat. 5. Add the enoki mushrooms and cook for 1-2 minutes until the enoki mushrooms become soft. 6. Take out the cooked enoki mushrooms, drain the water, put them into a larger bowl, and set aside. 7. In another clean small bowl, add 15 ml light soy sauce, 10 ml vinegar, 3 g sugar (optional), and 5 ml sesame oil (optional). 8. Add minced garlic. 9. Stir evenly to fully dissolve the sugar and mix the sauce evenly. 10. Pour the prepared sauce evenly on the enoki mushrooms. 11. Sprinkle with chopped green onion. 12. Drizzle with 5 ml chili oil (optional) according to personal preference. 13. Use chopsticks to mix gently and serve.

Additional content: - The blanch time of Enoki mushrooms should not be too long, so as not to affect the taste. -The proportion of sauce can be adjusted according to personal taste preference. - If you don’t like spicy food, you can omit the chili oil.

Cut off 2cm of the root of the enoki mushrooms, blanch them in boiling water for 60 seconds and immediately drain them into ice water. If cooked for a long time, they will become soft and lose their crisp and tender texture.
Be sure to fully squeeze out the water after blanching, otherwise water will continue to leak out after mixing, and the taste will be bland and the texture will become watery and unpalatable.

For seasoning, use minced garlic, mature vinegar, light soy sauce and a little chili oil. Add a spoonful of peppercorn oil to enhance the aroma. A little more vinegar can stimulate the appetizing sour aroma.

Case: I only had enoki mushrooms in the refrigerator after working overtime. I cut off the roots and blanched them for one minute. After running them in cold water, I added minced garlic, light soy sauce and mature vinegar and mixed them well. They were served in ten minutes. They were sour, spicy, crisp and tender, and salivated. I ate two of them in one go with steamed buns.

items.title: Cold Cucumber
items.core: This is a refreshing and appetizing home-cooked cold dish, with a crisp and tender texture and a delicious sour aroma. Cucumber is rich in water and vitamins, which helps to clear away heat, relieve heat, and beautify the skin. The preparation is very simple and friendly to novices. You only need to smash it, season it, and marinate it for 15 minutes. The whole process can be completed in about 20 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Cucumber * Vinegar * Soy sauce * Garlic

Calculation: You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. One serving is just enough for 1 person Total quantity: Cucumber 200 g Serving Vinegar 7.5 ml + 4 ml Serving Soy sauce 5 ml + 2.5 ml Serving Garlic 3 cloves Serving Salt 0.4 g + 0.2 g Serving Sesame oil 5 ml + 2 ml Serving * Oyster sauce 5 ml

Operation: 1. Flatten the cucumber with a kitchen knife and chop into 3 cm pieces. 2. Put the crushed cucumber into a bowl. 3. Crush the garlic and mince it. 4. Put 5 grams of white sugar in the bowl, stir well and marinate for 15 minutes (pickling with sugar is more delicious, and the color will be better and will not wilt). 5. Pour the vinegar, soy sauce, salt, oyster sauce and garlic into the bowl in turn and stir well. 6. Pour the sesame oil into a bowl and stir evenly

Additional content: * In some cases, the end of the cucumber has a bitter taste, please wash and cut it to confirm * Eat it directly after making it, or you can prepare it first and put it in the refrigerator (not frozen) before eating * If you put it in the refrigerator, you need to wrap it tightly with plastic wrap and eat it within 8 hours, otherwise the cucumber will lose its crisp taste due to over-pickling * It is recommended to peel the cucumber for a better taste

Use the back of a knife to crack the cucumber and then break it into segments with your hands. The rough section can absorb the juice better than the slices. When pickling, add salt to kill the water and make it crispier.

Soak the minced garlic in a little balsamic vinegar for five minutes in advance to remove the spiciness of raw garlic and release the aroma of garlic, which goes better with the refreshing taste of cucumber.
After marinating, drain the excess water from the plate and drizzle with sesame oil to prevent the soup from diluting the flavor too much. The flavor will be doubled after being refrigerated.

Case: It’s too hot to stir-fry during the dog days of summer, so I smashed the cucumbers and cut them into sections, added minced garlic, salt and balsamic vinegar and marinated it for fifteen minutes. It was cool, crisp, sour and fragrant, and served with mung bean porridge for dinner. After eating it, I felt so good that even the children who usually don’t like vegetables ate half a bowl of rice.

items.id: 包菜炒鸡蛋粉丝-包菜炒鸡蛋粉丝
items.title: Fried vermicelli with cabbage and eggs
items.core: Fried vermicelli with cabbage and eggs is a salty and delicious home-cooked dish. The crispy and sweet cabbage shreds are blended with the soft vermicelli and tender eggs, creating a rich texture. Cabbage is rich in vitamins and dietary fiber, eggs provide high-quality protein, carrots add nutrition, and the mix of meat and vegetables is balanced. The fans need to be soaked in advance during production. The overall process is a bit more but the operation is not complicated, making it challenging for novices. From preparation to serving, it takes about 1 hour and 20 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Cabbage * Eggs * Vermicelli * Carrots * Rapeseed oil * Salt, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce * Onion, garlic, dried chili pepper

Calculation: per portion: * Half cabbage * 2 eggs * 1 handful of vermicelli * Half carrot * Rapeseed oil 20 ml * Salt 2 g, light soy sauce 15 ml, dark soy sauce 10 ml, oyster sauce 10 ml * half green onion, 2 garlic cloves, 5 dried chili peppers

Operation: 1. Cut carrots and cabbage into shreds and set aside 2. Soak the vermicelli in cold water for 1 hour, then put the vermicelli in a pot, add boiling water until the vermicelli is soft, take it out and set aside 3. Crack the eggs into a bowl, add salt and stir for 15 seconds 4. Cut the onions, garlic and pepper into small pieces and set aside 5. Heat oil in a pan, add eggs, stir-fry until cooked and take out. 6. Pour in oil, add onions, garlic and dried chilies and stir-fry for 8 seconds. 7. Add carrots and shredded cabbage and stir-fry for 30 seconds. 8. Add vermicelli. 9. Add seasonings, 15 ml light soy sauce, 10 ml dark soy sauce, 10 ml oyster sauce, 2 grams salt. 10. Add the previously fried eggs and stir-fry for about 15 seconds. 11. Plate
Additional Content

Soak the vermicelli in warm water for 40 minutes until there is no hard core. Cut into two sections to prevent them from being too long and difficult to pinch. After soaking, pour them into cold water and drain them to prevent them from sticking together.
After frying the eggs, take them out first, and finally stir them back into the pot to avoid overheating and aging, and maintain the tender texture and distinct layers of vermicelli.

Stir-fry the shredded cabbage over high heat until the edges are slightly charred and add water to simmer until soft. The sweetness is released more fully and contrasts with the lightness of the vermicelli.

Case study: On Sunday, I soaked the vermicelli two hours in advance, cut the cabbage into shreds, and scrambled the eggs. I fried the cabbage until soft and then added the vermicelli and eggs. After seasoning, I took it out of the pan. The vermicelli soaked up the soup and became soft and tasty. My husband mistakenly thought it was fried pancakes bought from outside.

items.title: Indian potato and cauliflower
items.core: This Indian home-cooked vegetarian dish is characterized by dry golden color and rich spices. The potatoes are soft and the cauliflower has a slightly burnt edge. It belongs to the North Indian style. Potatoes and cauliflower are rich in dietary fiber and vitamin C, providing a balanced nutritional profile. It’s simple, novice-friendly, and takes about 25 minutes from prep to dish.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Potatoes - Cauliflower (cauliflower) - Onions - Tomatoes - Ginger - Garlic - Green chillies - Coriander - Cooking oil - Cumin seeds - Turmeric powder - Red chilli powder - Coriander powder - Indian mixed spice powder (Garam Masala) - Salt - Wok (with lid)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2-3 people. Per serving: - 2 potatoes (about 250g), peeled and cut into pieces (about 2cm size) - 1 cauliflower (about 300g), broken into small florets - 1 onion (about 100g), chopped - 1 tomato (about 100g), chopped - 8g ginger, grated - 3 cloves of garlic (about 9g), chopped - 1 green chili Roots, chopped - Edible oil 30ml - Cumin seeds 3g - Turmeric powder 3g - Red chilli powder 3g - Coriander powder 5g - Indian mixed spice powder 3g - Salt 5g - Coriander leaves 15g (for decoration)

Operation: 1. Peel the potatoes and cut them into pieces of about 2cm. 2. Break the cauliflower into uniform florets. Large florets can be cut into small pieces with a knife. 3. Pour 30ml of cooking oil into the wok and heat it over medium heat. 4. When the oil is hot, add 3g of cumin seeds and fry until the cumin seeds turn dark and fragrant (about 10 seconds, be careful not to fry them). 5. Add chopped onions and stir-fry until the onions turn transparent and light yellow (about 10 seconds). 3-4 minutes) 6. Add ginger, garlic and green chili and stir-fry for 1 minute 7. Add chopped tomatoes and stir-fry until tomatoes are soft (about 2-3 minutes) 8. Add 3g turmeric powder, 3g red chili powder, 5g coriander powder, 5g salt 9. Stir-fry for 1 minute to allow the spices to blend with the vegetables 10. Add the potato cubes and stir-fry for 2 minutes to coat the potatoes with spices 11. Add the cauliflower and stir gently. 12. Cover the pot, turn to medium-low heat, and simmer for 12-15 minutes, stirring every 3-4 minutes to prevent sticking to the pan. 13. When the potatoes can be easily poked through with chopsticks and the cauliflower is slightly burnt, add 3g of Indian mixed spice powder 14. Stir-fry for 1 minute 15. Turn off the heat, sprinkle with coriander leaves, and serve on a plate

Additional content: - This dish is a dry stir-fry style (Dry) and does not require the addition of water. If it feels too dry and easy to stick to the pan, you can add a very small amount of water (about 15-30ml), but not too much. - Don't cut the potato pieces too small, otherwise they will fall apart easily. - It is normal for the cauliflower to brown slightly on the edges and will add to the flavor. - Aloo Gobi is well known in the western world from the 2001 British comedy film "Bend It Like Beckham". - This dish can be served with Naan, Roti or rice.
Cut the potatoes into 2cm pieces, boil them in cold water for five minutes, and then fry them until the surface is golden brown. This can shorten the frying time and prevent them from becoming raw.

Chop the cauliflower into bite-sized pieces and drain thoroughly. After adding it to the pot, stir-fry over high heat for two minutes. Season until the edges appear charred and then season to make it more fragrant.
Stir the curry powder, cumin powder and turmeric powder with a small amount of hot oil first, then add the vegetables and mix well. The spices will be more even and not bitter.
Case: For weekend lunch, Xiao Li cut the potatoes into cubes and broke the cauliflower into small florets. He fried the potatoes first, then added the cauliflower and curry powder for dry frying.

items.title: Indian Bottle Gourd Meatballs
items.core: This North Indian vegetarian dish is made of grated gourd and chickpea flour. It is fried and soaked in tomato and onion curry. It is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The sauce is rich and spicy. The gourd is refreshing and the chickpea flour provides plant protein and dietary fiber, making it a filling and balanced vegetarian dish. The preparation involves frying and boiling the sauce, which is a bit more steps but not difficult to master in sequence. The whole process takes about 40 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Gourd (Gourd) - Chickpea flour (Besan) - Onion - Tomato - Ginger - Garlic - Green chilli - Coriander - Turmeric powder (Turmeric) - Red chilli powder - Coriander powder (Coriander Powder) - Cumin powder - Indian mixed spice powder (Garam Masala) - Salt - Cooking oil - Deep pot or wok

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2-3 people. Each portion: Meatball part: - 1 gourd (gourd) (about 400g) - Chickpea flour 80g - Salt 3g - Red pepper powder 3g - Coriander powder 3g - Cooking oil (for fried meatballs) 500ml Sauce part: - 2 onions (about 200g), chopped - 3 tomatoes (about 300g), chopped - Ginger 10g, grated - 4 cloves of garlic (about 12g), grated - 1 green chili, chopped - cooking oil 30ml - turmeric powder 3g - red chili powder 5g - coriander powder 5g - cumin powder 3g - Indian mixed spice powder 3g - salt 5g - water 200ml - coriander leaves (for decoration) 10g

Operation: Make meatballs: 1. Peel the gourd and grate it into thin strips with a grater. 2. Squeeze out the water in the gourd shreds with your hands. Squeeze as much as possible, otherwise the meatballs will not be fried. 3. Add 80g of chickpea flour, 3g of salt, 3g of red pepper powder, and 3g of coriander powder to the squeezed gourd shreds. 4. Mix well with your hands and knead into a non-sticky dough. 5. Knead the mixture into a diameter of about 3cm. of small meatballs and set aside. 6. Pour 500ml cooking oil into a deep pot and heat it over medium heat until the oil temperature is about 170°C (put in a small piece of dough that can quickly float and bubble) 7. Put the meatballs into the oil in batches and fry for 4-5 minutes until the surface is golden and crispy. 8. Use kitchen paper to absorb the excess oil from the fried meatballs and set aside. Make the sauce: 1. Pour 30ml cooking oil into the wok and heat it over medium heat. 10 seconds 2. Add chopped onions and stir-fry until the onions turn golden brown (about 5-7 minutes) 3. Add grated ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute until the aroma is released 4. Add chopped tomatoes and stir-fry until the tomatoes are completely soft and oily (about 5 minutes) 5. Add 3g turmeric powder, 5g red pepper powder, 5g coriander powder, 3g cumin powder, 5g salt 6. Stir-fry 2 minutes to allow the spices to fully blend with the tomatoes. 7. Add 200ml water, stir evenly, bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes. 8. Gently put the fried meatballs into the sauce and simmer for 3-5 minutes to allow the meatballs to absorb the sauce. 9. Sprinkle 3g of Indian mixed spice powder and chopped green chili. 10. Turn off the heat, garnish with coriander leaves, and serve on a plate

Additional content: - Squeezing the gourd water is a key step. Too much water will cause the meatballs to fall apart and fail to shape. - The meatballs should not be simmered in the sauce for too long, otherwise they will become soft and lose their taste. - This dish is usually served with Naan or Chawal in India. - The word "Kofte" originates from Persian/Arabic, meaning "crushed, ground" and is widely spread in South Asia and the Middle East.
Add salt to the gourd shreds and let it sit for ten minutes. Then squeeze out the water. The balls will be easy to shape and will not easily fall apart and absorb oil when fried.

Add the chickpea flour in batches and adjust the humidity to a level that allows you to knead it into a ball but not stick to your hands. The meatballs will have the most stable texture when they are crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.
Fry the tomato and onion sauce until shiny, then add water, add the meatballs and simmer over low heat for eight to ten minutes to prevent the skin from softening too quickly.

Case: Before dinner, Amin shredded the gourd and squeezed water, mixed it with chickpea flour, kneaded it into pellets and fried it until golden brown, then poured in tomato and onion curry and simmered it for ten minutes. The child even mixed the soup with the rice.

items.title: Di San Xian
items.core: Di San Xian is a classic home-cooked dish in Northeast China. The eggplant is soft and waxy, the potatoes are fragrant, the peppers are crisp, and the sauce is salty and delicious. It goes well with rice. The combination of ingredients can provide rich vitamins and dietary fiber, and potatoes also bring satisfying carbohydrate energy. This dish requires deep frying and quick stir-frying, which requires certain skills. Novices need a little practice. The whole process takes about 40 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggplant - Potato - Pepper - Onion - Ginger - Garlic - Bean paste - Light soy sauce - Sugar - Starch

Calculation: Note that this dish is only available in a version that is enough for 2-4 people. - Eggplant 200g - Potato 150g - 3 - 4 peppers - Starch 8g Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials planned to be used.

Operation: Prepare raw materials: 1. Wash potatoes, eggplants and peppers. 2. Peel the potatoes. 3. Cut the eggplant and potatoes into 15g irregular pieces. 4. Just tear the peppers along the lines with your hands, and tear them into pieces that are 25% larger than potatoes or eggplants. 5. Remove as much moisture from the surface of the green peppers as possible to avoid water damage during subsequent frying. Consider using kitchen paper or air drying for half an hour. 6. Cut green onions into 0.5cm pieces, taking a total of 5g. Chop the garlic into minced garlic, take 15g, divide it into two portions, 7.5g each. Mince ginger and take 5g. 7. Take an empty bowl, add 10ml of light soy sauce, 10g of sugar, 8g of starch, add 80ml of water, mix thoroughly and use it as a seasoning bowl, set aside. Preliminary frying: 1. Heat the pan and add 150ml oil. 2. Add potatoes and fry for about 3-4 minutes, until golden brown and can be easily pierced with chopsticks. 3. Remove the potatoes, leaving the oil. 4. Add the eggplant and fry for about 2-3 minutes, until it is about 7 minutes cooked, when the eggplant is soft, slightly charred on the edges and spits out excess fat. 5. Remove the eggplant, leaving the oil. (There may be no remaining oil) 6. If there is no flowing oil in the pot, consider adding 15ml of oil. 7. Add the pepper cubes and fry for about 15 seconds. Remove the skin from the edges and remove immediately. Pour out the oil from the pan. Final frying: 1. Reheat the pan and add 15ml of new base oil. 2. Add 5g of green onion, 5g of ginger and 7.5g of garlic. Fragrant over medium-low heat. 3. Add 15ml of bean paste. Turn to low heat and stir-fry until the aroma of red oil and sauce comes out. 4. Pour into a mixing bowl. Turn up the heat immediately and stir at high speed to avoid burning the pot! The sauce will begin to bubble and thicken in about 10 seconds. 5. Immediately add all the potatoes, eggplants and peppers prepared previously. 6. Stir-fry for 20 seconds to let the thick sauce evenly coat the ingredients. 7. Turn off the heat and add 7.5g garlic. Stir evenly and serve on a plate.

Additional content: * It makes perfect sense to have more sugar than starch. Starch is not responsible for providing flavor here, it is just a physical thickener. * Eggplant will reduce in size 4 times after frying. So when you take it, you may notice that a lot of eggplant goes into the pot and very little comes out of the pot. This is normal. * A lot of moisture may burst out when the green peppers are placed in the pot, causing oil to splash. Be sure to use the pot lid as a shield when removing the pot, and be careful when unloading.
Cut the eggplant into cubes, sprinkle with salt and let it sit for ten minutes, squeeze out some of the water and then fry. This will absorb less oil and maintain a soft and waxy texture.
Cut the potatoes into thick slices and fry them until the edges are golden brown, then add the eggplants to the pan to avoid undercooking the potatoes or overly rotten eggplants.

To make the sauce, mix light soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and a small amount of water in advance. After returning to the pot, stir-fry quickly over high heat to reduce the sauce and the taste will be more uniform.

Case study: When there are guests at home, Lao Wang first deep-fries the eggplant cubes until soft, then deep-fries the potato slices until golden brown. Finally, he quickly stir-fries with hot peppers to reduce the juice. After serving, they are all sandwiched together. The sauce is fragrant but not greasy.

items.title: Home-style Japanese tofu
items.core: Home-style Japanese tofu is a quick home-cooked dish that is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The golden crispy shell wraps the smooth Tamago tofu, and is paired with green peppers, carrots and other seasonal vegetables. It can be made into a salty or sweet flavor, crisp, tender and salty. Japanese tofu uses eggs as the main raw material, rich in high-quality protein, plus fungus and vegetables, and has balanced nutrition. It requires a little skill in frying tofu, it is moderately difficult and can be tried by novices, and it can be served in about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Japanese tofu (tamago tofu) - green pepper - carrot - ham sausage (optional) - black fungus (optional) - onion (optional) - corn starch - garlic - oil (for frying the tofu, just enough to cover more than half of it) - 8 ml of light soy sauce - 15 ml of oyster sauce - salt (salty and fresh) - chicken essence (salty and fresh, optional) - Ketchup (sweet and sour) - white sugar (sweet and sour)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Per portion: - 300 g Japanese tofu (about 3 pieces) - 120 g green pepper (1 medium size) - 50 g carrots - 50 g ham sausage (about 1 piece) - 30 g black fungus (about 10 g dried black fungus soaked) - 80 g cornstarch - 30 g onion - 10 g garlic (about 2 cloves) - oil 160-165 ml - light soy sauce 8 ml - oyster sauce 15 ml - salt 2 g (if chicken essence is added, only add 0.5g or not) - chicken essence 3 g - white sugar 10 g - tomato sauce 15 ml

Operation: 1. Slice the carrots, cut the pepper into thin pieces, and mince the onion and garlic 2. Open the bag of purchased Japanese tofu and cut it into roughly 1 cm thick cylinder 3. Put the cornstarch in a flat plate and prepare to coat the tofu. 4. Gently put the tofu on the flour and coat the upper and lower sides and the periphery with flour. Be careful not to wrap it too thickly. 5. Put 150 ml of oil in the pan. The oil can cover more than half of the tofu. When the edge color turns golden, flip and fry. 6. When both sides are fried, take it out and put it on a clean plate for later use. 7. Pour 10-15 ml oil into the wok, add onions and garlic, sauté until fragrant, add green peppers, carrots, ham sausage, and black fungus. 8. Add oyster sauce, light soy sauce, salt, chicken essence, white sugar, and tomato sauce. 9. Gently stir-fry until the color is even.

Additional content: - Do not leave the fried tofu for too long, prepare the ingredients in advance - Reference: [Step-by-step diagram] Home-style braised Japanese tofu ~ Super meal! 🎊Recipe_Home-style braised Japanese tofu~super delicious! 🎊 Steps to make_Add to the meal_Add to the kitchen
Cut the Japanese tofu into sections and use kitchen paper to absorb the moisture on the surface. Then wrap it lightly in corn starch to prevent it from breaking and sticking to the pan when frying.
Heat the oil in the pan to 60%, add the tofu, set one side and then gently push the other side to form a complete crispy shell.

Stir-fry the side dishes until cooked through, then add the tofu into the pot. Pour in the seasoning along the edge of the pot and stir evenly quickly to prevent it from becoming stale after being fried for a long time.

Case: After get off work, Xiao Zhou cut Japanese tofu into sections and wrapped it in thin starch, fried it into a golden shell, then added green peppers, carrots and fungus, stirred it well, and served it in more than 20 minutes. The tofu was tender but not broken.

items.title: Stir-fried lotus root
items.core: Stir-fried lotus root is a quick home-cooked vegetarian dish. The lotus root is crisp, tender and refreshing, salty and slightly spicy, and goes very well with rice. Lotus root is rich in dietary fiber and vitamins, which helps clear away heat and moisturizes dryness. It is simple to make, as long as you pay attention to blanching the lotus roots and seasoning, even a novice in the kitchen can complete it easily. It’s on the table in about 20 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - green onions - spicy millet - lotus root - light soy sauce - dark soy sauce - oil consumption - oil

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each portion: - 1 section of green onions - 1-2 millet stalks (depending on how spicy you like it) - 1 section of lotus root - 30 ml of light soy sauce - 15 ml of dark soy sauce - Oil consumption 15 ml - 10-15ml of edible oil

Operation: 1. Cut the scallions and millet pepper into small sections and set aside. 2. Peel the lotus root and cut into pieces no larger than 3cm. of small pieces, put them into water and set aside (to prevent oxidation and blackening) 3. Take a wok, put 500ml cold water into the pot, and boil 4. Add the diced lotus root into the boiling water, blanch it for 2 minutes, take it out and put it on a plate for later use. 5. Pour out the water in the pot, heat the pot to dry, and add 10-15 ml of cooking oil. 6. After the oil temperature rises, add chopped green onions and stir-fry millet until fragrant. 7. Add the processed diced lotus root into the pot and stir-fry over high heat. 8. Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce and oil. 9. Stir-fry for 2 minutes and it is ready to serve.

Additional content: - For edible lotus roots, choose those with yellowish-brown skin and thick and white flesh. If it turns black and has a peculiar smell, it is not suitable for consumption. - Please try not to use ironware, as it will cause the lotus roots to turn black
After dicing the lotus root, soak it in light salt water immediately to prevent it from oxidizing and turning black. Remove it and drain it before frying to avoid water from entering the pot.
After the water boils, blanch the diced lotus root for one minute. If the time is too long, it will lose its crispiness. If you take it out and cool it, it will keep its refreshing taste.

Seasoning: Pour white vinegar and a little light soy sauce along the edge of the pot, stir-fry quickly for half a minute and remove. The sour aroma will be more prominent and the color will be clearer.

Case study: For weekday dinner, Xiao Lin cut the lotus root into cubes, blanched it in water, and then cooled it. Then sauteed the dried chili pepper and minced garlic in a hot pot until fragrant, then added the diced lotus root and stir-fried quickly for seasoning. It took more than ten minutes to cook, and it had a crisp texture and served well with rice.

items.title: Griddle Cauliflower
items.core: Griddle Cauliflower is a Hunan-style home-cooked dish, with a crispy, tender, dry and fragrant texture. The pork belly is charred and fragrant, with a slight spiciness. Cauliflower is rich in vitamin C and dietary fiber, and paired with pork belly to supplement protein and energy. The difficulty of making it is moderate. Just pay attention to blanch the water and drain the pork belly thoroughly to remove the fat. It is suitable for cooking novices with a certain foundation. It takes about 40 minutes from prep to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Cauliflower - Pork belly - Chili - Light soy sauce - Sugar - Garlic - Salt - Oil
Calculation: per portion: - Cauliflower 400 g - Pork belly 100 g - Chili 1-2 - Light soy sauce 10 ml - Sugar 5g - 3-4 garlic cloves - Salt 2 g - Oil 10 ml

Operation: 1. With the cauliflower facing down, soak it in light salt water for 20 minutes. Then wash and cut into small florets with a knife. 2. Blanch in a pot of boiling water for 1 minute, take out and immediately rinse with cold water until completely cool. Drain and set aside. 3. Cut the pork belly into thin slices, cut off the white garlic and flatten it with the back of a knife. Cut the red pepper into sections. 4. Heat the pot and add oil. Heat the oil and sauté the green onions until fragrant. 5. Add the pork belly slices to the pot, stir-fry over medium heat until the surface changes color, continue to stir-fry for a while, and force out some of the oil from the fat part. 6. Add the red pepper segments and cauliflower, stir-fry a few times. 7. Add 10 ml of light soy sauce. 8. Add 5 g of white sugar, turn to high heat and stir-fry for 1 minute. 9. Cut the garlic leaves into sections, add them to the pot, stir-fry for a few times, then turn off the heat and cover with a lid to simmer. 1 minute ready
Additional Content
Blank the cauliflower for 30 seconds, take it out and spread it out to dry. The drier the surface, the easier it will be to get charred edges without turning into a boiled smell.
Cut the pork belly into thin slices and put it in a cold pan, stir-fry over low heat until it curls and releases oil, then stir-fry the cauliflower with the meat oil to make it more fragrant.

Saute the dried chili peppers and garlic slices until fragrant first, put the cauliflower into the pot and stir-fry quickly over high heat, and finally add light soy sauce and salt to avoid premature release of water.

Case: Before having a dinner with friends, Xiao Chen blanched the cauliflower and spread it out to dry. Stir-fry the pork belly to release the oil. Then he added the cauliflower and dried chili and stir-fried until fragrant. The finished dish was dry and had a burnt aroma, and the bottom of the plate was bottomless.

items.title: Hand-shredded cabbage
items.core: Shredded cabbage is a classic Hunan dish that is spicy, sour and crispy. The cooked cabbage is crispy, tender and flavorful, and the dried pork belly is fragrant and not greasy, making it an appetizing meal. Cabbage is rich in vitamin C and dietary fiber, and when paired with pork belly, it provides protein and energy. When making it, you need to master the heat of high fire and stir-fry quickly. It is a little challenging for novices, but you can still succeed if you follow the steps. It takes about 20 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Cabbage * Pork belly * Spicy millet * Edible oil * Cooking wine * Light soy sauce * Balsamic vinegar * Chicken essence * Ginger * Garlic * Garlic sprouts * Salt

Calculation: per portion: * 1 cabbage * 200 g pork belly * 2 spicy millets * 60 ml cooking oil * 5 ml cooking wine * 5 ml light soy sauce * balsamic vinegar 5 ml * 2 g chicken essence * 2 slices of ginger * 2 garlic * 0.5 garlic sprouts * 5 g salt

Operation: 1. Cut the cabbage in half and remove the white part in the middle [See Figure 1] 2. Tear the cabbage by hand, put 2 g of salt in a bowl, wash the cabbage and drain it and set aside [See Figure 2] 3. Process the ginger slices, garlic, millet and garlic sprouts and set aside [See Figure 3] 4. Slice the pork belly, wash it with water and set aside 5. Add 30 ml cooking oil to the pot, pour in the cabbage and stir-fry over high heat for 1 minute, then add 3 g salt, continue to stir-fry for 2 minutes, then take it out and set aside. 6. Add 30 ml of cooking oil to the pot, pour in the pork belly, and stir-fry for 1 minute on high heat. 7. Pour in ginger slices and other ingredients, and stir-fry for 1 minute. 8. Add cabbage and stir-fry, add balsamic vinegar, cooking wine, chicken essence, cooking wine, continue to stir-fry over high heat, and take out after 2 minutes.

Additional content:* In step five, the stir-frying time needs to be adjusted according to the actual situation. Generally, it is enough to stir-fry the cabbage until it is halfway cooked. Medium rare means that the cabbage has come out of the water and has become soft in texture * In step five, the role of adding salt is to lock in the moisture of the cabbage and give it a little flavor * In the last step, the stir-frying time can be flexibly adjusted according to the actual situation and personal taste
Tear the cabbage into large pieces by hand and shake off the water. A little water on the leaves will cool down and affect the crispiness of the quick frying over high heat.
First stir-fry the pork belly until slightly charred and oily, then add garlic slices and dried chili peppers. The meaty aroma will make the cabbage more delicious.
Pour vinegar and light soy sauce along the edge of the pot, stir-fry for ten seconds and it will be out of the pot immediately. The sour aroma will be obvious without making the cabbage soft.

Case: My family wanted to eat Hunan flavor. Xiao Zhao washed and dried the hand-shredded cabbage, stir-fried the pork belly and garlic slices in a hot pot, stir-fried it quickly over high heat and then added some vinegar to the pot. The cabbage was crispy, tender, sour and spicy, and even cooking the rice was not enough.

items.title: Drawed potatoes
items.core: Drawed potatoes are a classic Shandong dish. The finished dish is golden in color, with slender sugar threads, crispy on the outside and waxy on the inside, sweet and delicious. Potatoes are rich in carbohydrates and vitamin C, providing a quick energy boost. This dish is a bit difficult. Beginners need to pay attention to the cooking temperature of the sugar to avoid turning it into sand or burning it. From preparation to serving, it takes about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Potatoes * Edible oil * Starch * White sugar * Water * Sesame

Calculation: Per portion: * 2 potatoes * 300 ml of cooking oil (potatoes can float on the oil) * 30 g of starch * 120 g of white sugar (more sugar is needed to coat the potatoes with a thick layer of syrup to create a wire-drawing effect) * 100 ml of water * Sesame seeds 5 g

Operation: 1. Peel the potatoes and cut into even pieces. Add starch (without adding water) and stir until the starch covers the surface of the potatoes. 2. Heat oil in a pan, add potato pieces, and fry slowly for 5-7 minutes until chopsticks can be inserted into the potatoes. 3. Take out the potatoes and put them into a large bowl and set aside. 4. Add water and white sugar to the pot and slowly stir the white sugar in one direction until the white sugar turns brown. 5. Pour in the potatoes again and stir-fry for 30 seconds before removing from the pot. 6. Serve the potatoes on a plate, sprinkle with sesame seeds

Additional content: * Do not fry the potatoes too well, otherwise it will not be easy to shape when cutting and serving on the plate, which will affect the appearance * For using the remaining cooking oil, you can consider collecting it again in an oil pot.
The potato cubes are fried first and then re-fried for 30 seconds to make the outer shell firmer. After being coated in sugar, they can maintain the crispy outside and waxy inside.
Boil the sugar over medium-low heat. When the sugar liquid changes from large bubbles to small bubbles and becomes light amber, add potatoes immediately. If it is too dark, it will become bitter.

Before putting it on the plate, spread a thin layer of oil on the bottom of the plate, pour in the potatoes and draw them while they are still hot. The sugar will harden when it cools and affect the drawing effect.

Case: Making beets for New Year’s Eve dinner, Xiao Liu fried the potato cubes until the shells were golden, boiled the sugar in another pot until it turned light amber, then quickly rolled it, put it on a plate and pulled out slender sugar strands, which looked like candied haws to the child.

items.title: Pine Nut Corn
items.core: Pine Nut Corn is a home-cooked quick dish with a sweet, crisp and tender taste. The pine nuts are crispy and the corn is sweet. It is a popular northern home-cooked flavor. The combination of corn and pine nuts can provide rich dietary fiber, unsaturated fatty acids and multiple vitamins, providing balanced nutrition. The method is simple and can be easily mastered by novices. It usually only takes about fifteen minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Corn kernels (sweet corn is recommended) * Cooked pine nuts * Carrots (optional, add color) * Edible oil * White sugar * Salt * Starch * Water

Calculation: Per portion: * Corn kernels 200 g (canned sweet corn can be used, or you can cook it yourself) * 30 g cooked pine nuts * 50 g carrots (cut into small cubes, can be omitted) * Edible oil 15 ml * White sugar 10 g * Salt 1 g * Starch 5 g * Water 20 ml (for adjusting starch water)

Operation: 1. Blanch corn kernels and diced carrots for 1 minute in advance, remove and drain and set aside. 2. Heat cold oil in a pan, add diced carrots and stir-fry briefly, then add corn kernels and stir-fry 3. Add white sugar and salt, stir well 4. Mix water and starch to form water starch, pour into the pot and stir-fry quickly to make the soup slightly thicker. 5. Add cooked pine nuts and stir-fry evenly 6. Remove from the pan and serve

Additional content: * Pine nuts can be dry-fried over low heat in advance until slightly golden and crispy, which is more delicious * When using canned corn, drain the water first to avoid excessive water during the frying process * The heat should not be too high when frying to prevent the pot from being burned or the pine nuts being burnt
Blanching the corn kernels for one minute and then draining them can shorten the frying time and keep the kernels plump and sweet.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan over low heat until lightly browned and scoop them out immediately to prevent them from becoming soft and bitter due to prolonged frying with the vegetables.
Stir-fry the diced green beans and carrots first, then add the corn and pine nuts, and finally add a small amount of salt and sugar to enhance the flavor.

Case: In the weekend lunch box, Xiao He blanched the corn kernels and drained them, roasted the pine nuts over low heat until fragrant, and quickly stir-fried the diced green beans and carrots for seasoning. The finished product was sweet, crisp and tender, and the child asked to take it with him the next day.

items.title: Salt and Pepper Corn
items.core: A snack that is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a tangy salty aroma. It has the dry flavor common in Sichuan restaurants, and the sweetness of the corn comes when you bite into it. Corn provides rich carbohydrates and dietary fiber, and when paired with sesame seeds, it can also supplement high-quality fats and vitamin E. This dish has a few steps but is simple to operate. It requires a little patience to shake the water and coat with flour, making it more friendly to novices. It takes about 30 minutes from defrosting to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Corn kernels - Salt and pepper - Sesame seeds - Oil - Starch - Two plastic dustpans - Several oil-absorbing papers

Calculation: The portion of this dish is the same as the standard portion ordered in a Sichuan restaurant - corn kernels (packed) 350g - starch (the surface of the corn kernels can be completely covered in the pot, 40-70g) - salt and pepper 10g - sesame seeds 10g

Operation: 1. The corn kernels are peeled and can be defrosted directly. Soak in warm water for 15 minutes or boil in boiling water for 5 minutes. 2. Take out a dustpan, assume it is Box A, line it with absorbent paper, and pour in the thawed corn kernels. 3. shaking shaking shaking! - until the absorbent paper becomes completely wet. 4. Take out the second dustpan BoxB, line it with absorbent paper, and pour all the corn kernels from BoxA into BoxB. 5. shaking shaking shaking! - until all the absorbent paper becomes wet. 6. Repeat the above operation several times until there are no obvious water droplets on the surface of the corn but it remains moist. 7. Pour in enough starch to completely cover the corn kernels. 8. shaking shaking shaking! - until the corn kernels are coated with starch 9. Turn on the stove - put the pot - pour in oil and cover the bottom of the pot as much as possible but not too much. 10. Heat the oil to 80% and pour in the corn kernels coated with starch. 11. Fry over medium heat for 30 seconds. Do not stir fry, otherwise the starch will fall off. 12. Stir-fry lightly for 3 minutes and serve. 13. The most important step: Sprinkle 3g salt and pepper and sprinkle with sesame seeds! 14. The fragrant "salt and pepper corn" is ready

Additional content: Don’t peel the corn kernels yourself. If you don’t need to use your hands, you can directly buy the “already peeled corn kernels” through the takeout app and defrost them in warm water after 30 minutes of delivery.
