Boil it in boiling water if it defrosts slowly! (Never cook the corn itself, cook it with the package and tear off a mouthful)

Use kitchen paper to repeatedly absorb the moisture from the corn kernels before coating them in flour so that the starch can adhere to them thinly and make it difficult to peel off the corn kernels after frying.
Sie out excess starch after coating in flour, and use chopsticks to spread it when putting it in the pot to prevent the corn kernels from sticking into a ball and affecting the crispiness.
Sprinkle the salt, pepper and cooked sesame seeds in while it is still hot after it is out of the pot. Use the residual heat to stimulate the aroma, and the salty aroma will be more even and lasting.

Case: For snack time in the afternoon, Xiao Tang shook off the water from the corn kernels and rolled them in starch. He fried them twice until the crispy kernels were distinct. He sprinkled them with salt, pepper and sesame seeds and mixed them well. After cooling, they were still crispy. Friends thought they were snacks he bought.

items.id: 榄菜肉末四季豆-榄菜肉末四季豆
items.title: Green beans with minced pork and olives
items.core: Green beans with minced pork and olives is a home-style stir-fry with strong Chaoshan flavor. It tastes salty, crispy and tender, and goes well with rice. Green beans are rich in dietary fiber and vitamins. When paired with minced meat, they can provide high-quality protein, while olives bring a unique salty flavor. The steps of this recipe are clear, and novices can get started quickly. Just pay attention to frying the green beans thoroughly. From preparation to serving, it takes about thirty minutes to complete.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * French beans * Pork belly * Olive vegetables * Garlic * Spicy millet (you can leave it out if you don’t like spicy food)
Calculation: * French beans 220g * Pork belly 100g * Olive vegetables 20g * Garlic 10g * Spicy millet 10g

Operation: 1. Wash the green beans and tear off the tendons, then cut them into evenly sized particles and set aside. 2. Crush the garlic and chop into minced garlic. Set aside. 3. Cut the spicy millet into evenly sized particles and set aside. 4. Peel the pork belly, then chop into mince and set aside. 5. Heat the pan, then add 20ml of oil to the pan. After the pan is smooth, pour out the hot oil, and then add 10ml of cold oil. This is the legendary hot pan and cold oil. This is mainly to prevent the minced meat from sticking to the pan. 6. If you don’t have an oil bottle at home, you don’t need a sliding pan. After adding the oil, directly add the minced meat and start stir-frying. Stir-fry over low heat for two minutes until the lard comes out. 7. After the minced meat is stir-fried, add minced garlic, olives and millet and stir-fry until fragrant. 8. Add the green beans and stir-fry over medium heat. Stir-fry the green beans for at least 5 minutes. Make sure the green beans are cooked thoroughly, otherwise you may get food poisoning. 9. After the green beans are fried, add 2ml of soy sauce and pour it from the side of the pot, then add 2g of salt, 1g of chicken essence, 1g of pepper and 0.5g of sugar. 10. Stir the seasonings evenly. 11. Remove from the pan and plate.
Additional Content

Blank the green beans after dicing them for more than three minutes to completely remove the raw smell, then stir-fry them quickly to make them cooked through while still keeping them crispy and tender.
Stir-fry the minced meat over medium heat until fragrant, then add the olives to prevent the olives from turning black and losing their flavor after long frying.
Olive vegetables are inherently salty, so add a small amount of salt at the end. You can taste it before seasoning to prevent the whole dish from being too salty.

Case: When preparing rice for his family, Xiao Zheng diced the green beans and blanched them thoroughly, stir-fried the minced meat, then added olives and green beans and stir-fried. It was salty, crispy and tender, and even his picky eater added half a bowl of rice.

items.title: Braised vegetables in water and oil
items.core: Braised vegetables in water and oil is a simple and quick home-cooked meal. Add a few drops of oil and seasonings to boiling water to make the leafy vegetables soft and tender, shiny in color, refreshing and with a light oily aroma. This practice helps improve the absorption rate of fat-soluble vitamins and has more nutritional value than eating raw vegetables. The cooking difficulty is low and very friendly to novices. It usually only takes 10 minutes from washing vegetables to cooking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Cooking oil * Salt * Oyster sauce (optional) * Leafy vegetables
Calculation: Leafy vegetables contain more water and may appear bulky when prepared. The actual volume will decrease rapidly after heating. * Leafy vegetables: 300g ~ 500g

Operation: 1. Wash the vegetables 2. Add 150ml water to the pot and bring to a boil. (The water does not need to be able to completely cover the vegetables) 3. Add 3g salt 4. (Optional) Add 3ml oyster sauce 5. Add 2ml cooking oil 6. Serve, stir, then cover the pot and simmer for 1 minute 7. Place on a plate

Additional content: * If you are not sure about the saltiness, you can add less salt first, taste it before taking it out of the pot, and consider adjusting the salt * You can use chicken broth, bone broth, etc. instead of water, which will be more delicious * Do not stew for too long
Drain the leafy vegetables as much as possible after washing them, and put them in the pot after the water boils. This can reduce the loss of nutrients and keep the color bright.
The amount of water is only a shallow layer at the bottom of the pot. Just add a few drops of oil. Too much oil will make it greasy, and too little will not make it shiny enough.

Cover and simmer for one to two minutes, then immediately open the lid and season. Take the leafy vegetables out of the pot as soon as they become soft to prevent them from turning yellow and collapsing.

Case: When Xiao Sun came home from overtime, he washed and drained the green vegetables. After the water in the pot was boiled, he added a few drops of oil, covered the vegetables and simmered them for two minutes. When they came out of the pot, they were bright green and shiny, and it was very refreshing to eat with porridge.

items.title: Oil and vinegar fried eggs
items.core: This is a quick home-cooked dish full of Hunan flavor. It is sour, spicy and fragrant. The eggs are fluffy and covered in rich soup. It is very appetizing. Eggs provide high-quality protein and lecithin, and paired with balsamic vinegar, they can help stimulate appetite. The recipe is extremely simple and beginner-friendly, and it only takes about ten minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggs - Chili millet - Spring onions - Garlic - Oil - Balsamic vinegar - Light soy sauce - Oyster sauce (optional but recommended) - Sugar (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each serving: - 4 eggs - 10 g spicy millet (about 3 pieces) - 35-50 mL cooking oil - 10 g spring onions - 5 g garlic - balsamic vinegar 15 mL - light soy sauce 10-15 mL - oyster sauce 10 g - sugar 0-5 g

Operation: 1. Do not beat the eggs, just break them into a bowl and set aside 2. Cut the chives 3cm long pieces are enough. 3. Put the garlic cloves and spicy millet into a garlic beater and beat into foam. 4. Add the balsamic vinegar, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and water to a small bowl and mix well to make a sweet and sour sauce. 5. Heat the oil and pour in the eggs. When the eggs are solidified, shovel them into large pieces. Pour in the minced garlic, spicy millet, and sweet and sour sauce. 6. Reduce the sauce over high heat and add the green onions when it is about to come out of the pot.
Additional content: - I personally tested that Lao Henghe’s balsamic vinegar has the best taste without adding any additives. The aroma of vinegar is the soul of this dish.
Add a little water and salt to the eggs and mix well. Place hot oil in the pan and spread quickly. The egg pieces will be more fluffy and less likely to get old.
Pour the balsamic vinegar along the edge of the pot and use high temperature to bring out the sour aroma. Do not pour the eggs directly to avoid the aroma dissipating.
Saute the spicy millet and minced garlic over low heat until fragrant, then add the sauce and stir-fry for ten seconds to make the hot and sour flavor more even.

Case: I got off work late, and there were only eggs and balsamic vinegar in the refrigerator. I fried the eggs in hot oil, added chili millet and soy sauce, poured vinegar along the edge of the pot and sauteed until fragrant. It took ten minutes to cook, mix the hot and sour soup with the rice, and my family scraped the plates clean.

items.id: 洋葱炒鸡蛋-洋葱炒鸡蛋
items.title: Fried Eggs with Onions
items.core: Fried Eggs with Onions is a home-cooked dish with a salty and delicious aroma and a rich onion aroma. The eggs are tender and smooth, and the onions are sweet. It is a national snack. Eggs are rich in high-quality protein and multiple vitamins, and onions contain dietary fiber and antioxidants. They are a nutritionally balanced quick dish. This recipe is extremely simple and beginner-friendly, taking only about 5 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Eggs * Onions * Cooking oil * Salt * Green onions * Cooking wine
Calculation: per serving: * 2 eggs * Onions 50 g * Edible oil 50 ml * Salt 2 g * Half green onions * Cooking wine 2 ml

Operation: 1. Break the eggs into a large bowl, add onion slices and salt and stir 60 S 2. Heat the oil in the pan, pour in the eggs, and fry for 30-45 seconds on one side. Turn over and continue to stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. Sprinkle in the cooking wine and serve. 3. Place the eggs on a plate and sprinkle with chopped green onions
Additional Content
Cut the onion into thin strips along the grain, fry until the edges are slightly translucent and then add the egg. The sweetness will be more obvious and it will not become watery.
Beat the eggs, add a small amount of salt and a spoonful of water, stir-fry quickly after the oil is hot, and the texture will be more tender.
First scramble the eggs, then stir-fry the onions, and finally return to the pot to combine the flavors to prevent the eggs from becoming hard and yellow after being fried for a long time.

Case: I was in a hurry at noon, so I cut half an onion and three eggs. I fried the eggs until they were solid and took them out. Then I fried the onions and stirred them well. After five minutes, I put them on the plate. The sweet and fragrant green onions were paired with soft eggs. Even my colleagues who don’t like onions picked up two chopsticks.

items.title: Sauteed cauliflower
items.core: A common home-cooked vegetarian dish, with a crisp, tender and refreshing taste. Rich in vitamin C and dietary fiber. The method is simple and quick, and it only takes 15 minutes for beginners to complete it.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Cauliflower - Garlic - Salt

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough to feed 2 people (as a side dish). Each serving: - About 300 g of cauliflower (about 1/2 medium-sized cauliflower) - 2-3 cloves of garlic - 3 g of salt - 15 ml of cooking oil - 50 ml of drinking water (for the frying process)

Operation: 1. Wash the cauliflower, break it into florets with a knife or your hands, and slice the thick stem part and set aside. 2. Peel the garlic, cut into slices and set aside. 3. Add 1000 ml drinking water to the pot and bring to a boil over high heat. 4. Add the cauliflower and cook for 2-3 minutes until the color of the cauliflower becomes lighter and the texture becomes slightly softer. 5. Take out the cooked cauliflower, drain and set aside. 6. Heat the pan, add 15 ml cooking oil and heat over high heat. 7. Add garlic slices and stir-fry quickly until fragrant. 8. Add the blanched cauliflower buds, turn to medium-high heat, and stir-fry quickly for about 2 minutes so that the cauliflower is evenly heated. 9. Add 3 g of salt and continue to stir-fry evenly. 10. Pour 50 ml of drinking water along the edge of the pot, cover the pot, and simmer for 1 minute to help the cauliflower become fully cooked and flavorful. 11. Open the lid, stir-fry quickly and serve.

Additional content: - Blanching the cauliflower ahead of time shortens the frying time and makes it easier to cook. - The frying time can be adjusted according to personal preference of the softness and hardness of the cauliflower. If you like it crispier, you can shorten the time.
Break the cauliflower into small uniform florets, soak in salt water for ten minutes and then rinse to remove impurities in the gaps.
Add a few drops of oil to boiling water and blanch for one minute before taking it out. This will keep it white, crispy and tender, and it will not be cooked during subsequent frying.
Sauté the garlic slices first until fragrant, put the cauliflower into the pot and stir-fry quickly over high heat, then season before it is out of the pot to prevent the water from becoming soft.

Case study: After cleaning out the refrigerator over the weekend, only half a head of cauliflower was left. I broke off a small floret and blanched it for a minute, then stir-fried it with garlic slices over high heat. Added salt and took it out of the pot. The cauliflower was crisp and tender without turning yellow. It was very refreshing when eaten with multi-grain rice, and there was no soup left.

items.title: Steamed Pumpkin
items.core: An authentic home-cooked steamed dish that retains the natural sweetness and nutrition of pumpkin to the greatest extent. It has a soft, glutinous and sweet texture and can be used as a dessert or a staple food. Pumpkin is rich in beta-carotene and dietary fiber, which is good for eyesight and gastrointestinal health. It is extremely simple to make, even for novices, and it only takes 15-20 minutes from cutting to cooking.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Pumpkin - Steamer

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1-2 people. Per portion: - 300 g pumpkin - 1000 ml drinking water (for steamer)

Operation: 1. Wash the pumpkin skin and remove the pulp and seeds. 2. Cut the pumpkin into slices about 2 cm thick and set aside. 3. Add 1000 ml of drinking water to the steamer pot. 4. Arrange the cut pumpkin slices evenly on the plate. 5. After the water in the steamer boils, place the plate with pumpkin in the steamer. 6. Cover the pot and steam over high heat for 15-20 minutes, until the pumpkin is soft and can be easily penetrated with chopsticks. 7. Turn off the heat and carefully remove the plate.

Additional content:- Different varieties of pumpkins will have different sweetness and taste. Older squash is usually sweeter and flourier. - Pumpkin skin contains nutrients. You can steam it without peeling it if you like, but it needs to be washed thoroughly. - Steaming time depends on the size and thickness of the pumpkin pieces, as well as the variety of pumpkin. Testing with chopsticks is a good way to tell if it's steamed.
Choose Beibei pumpkin or old pumpkin, cut into two centimeter thick slices, it will be heated evenly and steamed through more easily.
After the water boils, put it in the pot and steam over medium heat for fifteen to twenty minutes, until it can be easily pierced with chopsticks.
After steaming, pour off the excess water in the plate, sprinkle a small amount of chopped green onion or eat it plain to avoid diluting the taste.

Case: I prepared breakfast for my children in the morning. I cut half a pumpkin and put it on the plate. After the water boiled, I steamed it for fifteen minutes. It came out soft, glutinous and sweet. My children ate two pieces without adding sugar, and the rest was used as a staple food in the afternoon to satisfy their hunger.

items.title: Steamed fried potatoes and carrots
items.core: This steamed fried potato and carrot dish adopts the method of "steaming first and then frying". The finished product has distinct roots, soft waxy and salty flavor. Potatoes and carrots are rich in potassium and beta-carotene and are nutritionally balanced. The whole process is simple and fast, making it easy for novices to use. It only takes 20 minutes from preparing ingredients to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Potatoes - Carrots - Chives - Garlic cloves - Salt - Chef Li brand stir-fry ingredients - Chef Li brand meat flavor - MSG - Dried chilies

Calculation: per portion: - 320 g potatoes - 200 g carrots - 20 g chives - 3 cloves of garlic - 1/2 teaspoon salt - Chef Li brand stir-fry ingredients 1/2 tsp - Chef Li brand meat flavor 1/2 tsp - MSG 1/4 tsp - dried chili pepper half

Operation: 1. Cut the carrots and potatoes into thin strips (you can use a grater) 2. Coat the carrots and shredded potatoes with flour (the color of the carrots is like a small sausage, and the potatoes are wrapped like noodles, with clear roots, and they can be picked up with dry hands and scattered without sticking) 3. Use an electric steamer to steam the potatoes and carrot shreds for 5 minutes/steam the steamer on high heat for 5 minutes after the steamer is vented. 4. Be careful not to cover the pot directly. 15 seconds after turning on the high heat, add the green onions and stir-fry, stir-fry the green onions for 40 seconds, add the mixed potatoes and shredded carrots and stir-fry 6. After 20 seconds, add Chef Li's brand stir-fry ingredients, then add Chef Li's brand of meat flavor, then add salt, then add MSG, take it out of the pot after a while, turn off the heat
Additional Content
Cut potatoes and carrots into strips of similar thickness and steam them for eight to ten minutes to reduce the frying time.
After steaming, spread it out to let the water vapor on the surface dry, and then fry it in the pan. The finished product will be more distinct and non-sticky.
Add minced garlic and light soy sauce at the last stage and stir well over high heat to prevent the seasoning from leaking out of the pot too early.

Case: Before friends came over, I cut potatoes and carrots into strips and steamed them in a pan for ten minutes. Then I quickly stir-fried them with garlic and light soy sauce. After twenty minutes, I served them on the table. The strips were soft, glutinous, and salty, and everyone ate them up quickly.

items.title: Fried Eggs
items.core: Fried Eggs is a classic home-cooked dish with a tender texture and rich egg flavor, with a touch of milk. Eggs are rich in high-quality protein and multiple vitamins, rich in nutrients and easy to absorb. The recipe is very user-friendly and can be easily mastered by novices. It only takes about 5 minutes from preparation to serving, making it an ideal choice for quick energy replenishment when you are busy.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Eggs (preferably sterile eggs) - Milk
Calculation: per serving: - 4 eggs - 30ml of milk - 10ml of cooking oil

Operation: 1. Add eggs to milk and 5ml of cooking oil, mix well, set aside 2. Heat the pan over high heat for about 30s, add 5ml of cooking oil 3. Cook for 30s, turn to low heat, and add the stirred eggs 4. After letting it sit in the pot for 5 seconds, use a spatula to slowly push the egg mixture from the edges to the middle. 5. Stir-fry until the eggs are roughly solidified, then turn off the heat and put on a plate
Additional content: - Finally, you can season with some black pepper or salt according to your personal taste. Reference - Tianchen Kitchen
Add one to two spoons of milk or water to three eggs, beat thoroughly and sift to make the egg liquid more delicate.
After the pot is hot, turn to low heat, pour oil to moisten the pot and then pour in the egg liquid. Use a spatula to slowly push it from the bottom without frying.

Turn off the heat when there is still a small amount of liquid in the egg liquid, and simmer it with the residual heat until it is cooked. It will remain tender and smooth after being taken out of the pan.

Case study: I ​​don’t want to stir-fry at night, so I beat three eggs with two spoons of milk, slowly push them over low heat into soft egg cubes, sprinkle some chopped green onion, and serve it in five minutes. It’s as tender and smooth as pudding in the mouth. Paired with white porridge, it makes your stomach feel comfortable after working overtime.

items.title: Fried Eggplant
items.core: This home-style fried eggplant is soft and tender, with a rich sauce flavor, and the addition of star anise makes it even more flavorful. Eggplant is rich in dietary fiber, vitamin P and potassium, which help protect cardiovascular systems. The method is simple and friendly to novices. The whole process is very fast and can be completed in about 20 minutes from preparing the ingredients to taking it out of the pan.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggplant - Star anise (optional) - Dried shrimp (optional) - Chives (optional) - Minced meat (optional) - Soy sauce - Sugar (optional) - Vinegar (optional) - Rapeseed oil or peanut oil

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1-2 people. Total quantity: - Number of eggplants = servings * 1.8 pieces - Star anise = servings * 1 piece - Small shrimps = servings * A normal man can grab half a handful - Chives = servings * 2 pieces - Minced meat = servings * 50 g - Soy sauce = servings * 40 ml - Sugar = servings * 5 g - Vinegar = servings * 10 ml Note: The two ingredients of oil and soy sauce are also reflected in the operation. You can cross-compare to determine the amount of added ingredients

Operation: 1. Wash the eggplant and divide it into two sections (cut vertically). Cut each section of eggplant into diamond-shaped pieces, put the cut eggplant into a bowl and set aside. 2. Wash the scallions, cut into slices and place on the chopping board until ready. 3. Cut the star anise and place it on the chopping board. 4. If you plan to add minced meat, first use 10 ml (if it is pure lean meat, use 15 ml) oil to fry over medium heat until it changes color (about 1 minute), then take it out and set aside. 5. Heat the pot over high heat until there is no water in the pot. 6. Pour cooking oil into the pot to cover twice the bottom of the pot (you can add more oil, but not less). 7. Heat the oil for about 6 seconds and add the three optional ingredients: star anise, dried shrimps and chives. 8. If you don’t have optional ingredients such as star anise, heat the oil until it’s done. 9. When the oil in the pot is 9 mature, pour the eggplant in the bowl into the pot and stir-fry with a spatula. 10. Stir-fry for about 40 seconds, hold the spatula parallel to the pot, and pour the soy sauce into the spatula. Approximately 2.5 spatulas per person (you can add less soy sauce, but not more, as it will be salty). 11. When the eggplant is stir-fried until it is semi-soft (about 1 minute later), add the pre-fried minced meat and stir evenly. 12. If you plan to add sugar and vinegar, add sugar and vinegar. 13. Continue to stir-fry. 14. Wait until all the eggplants in the pot change color and become soft, take them out.

Additional content:- Because of the soy sauce, there is no need to add salt to this dish. You can taste it before taking it out of the pan. If it is not salty, you can add a small amount of salt. The amount of soy sauce should be increased the next time you fry it - if you add dried shrimps, you can reduce the amount of soy sauce as appropriate. - When frying this dish, just keep it on high heat. - Don't! Be sure not to add water, otherwise it will turn into boiled eggplant and have a bad taste, so you can add more oil but not less. - If the temperature of the household stove no longer continues to rise significantly after it reaches 70% oil temperature, you can proceed directly to the next step without forcing the 90% oil temperature. - Add sugar and vinegar at the last stage, stir-fry for 20 seconds and then remove from the pan. Avoid adding vinegar too early, otherwise the sour taste will evaporate.
Cut the eggplant into pieces, sprinkle with salt and let it sit for ten minutes to squeeze out some of the water. It will absorb less oil when frying and make it easier to absorb the flavor.
First fry the star anise over low heat to bring out the fragrance and then add the eggplant. The sauce will be more fragrant, but don’t add too much to avoid overpowering the flavor.
Add a small amount of water and simmer for two minutes, then open the lid and simmer over high heat to collect the juice. The eggplant will be soft and waxy but not watery.

Case study: I ​​want to make a meal for dinner. I cut the eggplant into hob pieces and sprinkled it with salt and let it sit. After sauteing the star anise, I stir-fry the eggplant over high heat. I add light soy sauce and minced garlic and simmer for two minutes. The sauce is rich and the eggplant does not absorb oil. The rice is mixed with the soup and is finished.

items.title: Stir-fried green vegetables
items.core: This is a refreshing and delicious home-cooked vegetarian dish with a crisp and tender texture, salty and sweet taste. Green vegetables are rich in vitamins and dietary fiber, which help promote digestion. The recipe is very simple and can be easily mastered with no basic knowledge. It only takes about 10 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Green vegetables

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Total quantity: - 100g green vegetables * number of servings - 2 garlic cloves * number of servings - cooking oil 10-15ml (just cover the bottom of the pot) - 2g salt * number of servings - drinking water 70ml * number of servings - 5g sugar * number of servings

Operation: 1. Break the vegetables into small cloves, wash them with water and set aside. 2. Chop the garlic cloves and set aside. 3. After heating the pot over medium or high heat, add 10-15ml cooking oil in the pot. Wait another 30 seconds for the oil to heat up. 4. Pour the prepared vegetables into the pot and stir-fry until the vegetables become soft (about 1 minute). 5. Add the minced garlic cloves. 6. Pour in the calculated water. The water level should be completely soaked or almost cover the vegetables. Add salt (2g * portion) and continue to stir-fry for about 1 minute. 7. Finally add sugar and heat over low heat for 2 minutes. Cover the pot while heating. 8. Serve on a plate.
Additional content: Adding sugar will make the vegetables greener.
Wash the green vegetables and drain them. Separate the stems and leaves. Fry the stems first and then the leaves to make the cooking degree more consistent.
The pot should be heated before adding oil and garlic. After the vegetables are placed in the pot, turn them over quickly to keep them crisp, tender and bright in color.
Add salt and a small amount of light soy sauce just before the pot is out of the pot. If you put it in too early, water will come out and the vegetable leaves will easily turn yellow and soft.

Case study: I ​​was very hungry when I got home from overtime. I washed a handful of Shanghai greens, minced garlic, sauteed it until fragrant, stir-fried it over high heat, added salt, and cooked it for 30 seconds. The leaves were green and crisp, and I served it with hot rice to relieve fatigue. I suppressed my fatigue in less than ten minutes.

items.title: Fried onion flowers
items.core: Fried onion flowers are a classic fried dish in American restaurants. The whole onion is cut without cutting. After being coated in flour and fried, the petals naturally open up, like a big golden flower that explodes. The outer layer is crispy and the inside is sweet from the onion itself. It is perfect as a party snack when paired with dipping sauce. The difficulty lies in the selection of ingredients, knife skills and oil temperature: the onions should be large and sweet, the petals will be cut off and spread out, the flour will not be fully coated and the crispy shell cannot be fried, and the oil temperature will be too high and the outer layer will be burnt. It takes about 40 minutes from prep to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - yellow onions (i.e. sweet onions, choose large ones with a diameter of more than 9cm, with thick slices and high sweetness, which are the key to this dish) - eggs - low-gluten flour - cornstarch - chili powder (optional, you can omit if you don't like spicy food) - black pepper - salt - cooking oil (for frying, it needs to be able to cover the whole onion) - deep pot (choose a diameter of 16cm) For the following deep pots or soup pots, the walls of the pot should be higher than the onions, shallow pans cannot be used) - Kitchen thermometer - Colander

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough to feed 2 people, calculated as follows per serving. Each serving: - 1 yellow onion (diameter over 9cm, about 350g) - 1 egg (about 50g) - 120g low-gluten flour (40g of which is used for the first flour) - 40g corn starch - 100ml ice water - 2g chili powder - 1g black pepper - 3g salt - 1200ml cooking oil (for frying, actual consumption is about 80ml)

Operation: Cut flowers: 1. Peel off the outer dry skin of the yellow onion, cut off the top 5mm, leaving the bottom root disk uncut. 2. Cut from the top, cut vertically in the diameter direction to stop 1cm away from the root disk, that is, do not cut off the root disk. 3. In the same way, cut once every 45 degrees, for a total of 16 cuts, and divide the whole onion into 16 segments 4. Turn the onion over, with the root disk facing up, and cut 1 knives between each two halves in the same way, making a total of 8 knives. Soaking in water: 1. Put the cut onions with the root disk facing up in ice water and soak for 20 minutes. 2. After soaking, take it out and let it stand for 5 minutes with the root disk facing up to drain the water. Breading: 1. Take 40g. Sprinkle low-gluten flour evenly between the onion petals, spreading the petals while spreading, so that the inside of each layer of petals is covered with dry powder. 2. Mix the remaining 80g low-gluten flour, 40g cornstarch, 2g chili powder, 1g black pepper, and 3g salt, and set aside. 3. Mix 1 egg with 100ml ice water, beat for 30 seconds until completely uniform, and set aside. 4. Dip the onion root disk upward into the egg liquid and turn it over 3 times so that the front and back of each petal are covered with egg liquid. 5. Put the onion root disk upward into the mixed powder, use your hands to sprinkle the flour from the center to the edges of the petals, and turn it over 3 times. 6. Lift the onion and shake off the excess powder, check whether there is any white at the base of the petals, and sprinkle mixed powder on the exposed white area. 7. Let stand for 2 minutes to allow the flour to regain moisture. At this time, the shell should show a uniform white powder layer. Frying: 1. Pour 1200ml cooking oil into a deep pot and heat to 170℃ over medium heat. 2. Put the onion root disk side down into the oil. The oil will bubble violently at this time. 3. Maintain 165℃ - 175℃ and fry for 3 minutes. During this period, use a slotted spoon to ladle hot oil over the top of the onion repeatedly. 4. Turn the onion over, with the root disk facing up, and continue frying for 2 minutes. 5. Remove the petals when they turn golden brown and the outer shell becomes hard. The criterion is that the onions can float on the oil surface and the petals are fully opened. 6. Drain the oil on a colander for 2 minutes. Plate: 1. Place the onion root plate down on the plate and spread the petals naturally. 2. Place 30ml of dipping sauce (ketchup, mayonnaise or honey mustard) in the center

Additional content: - Onions must be yellow onions (sweet onions) and large. Purple onions are pungent and white onions are watery. Small onion petals are too thin and easy to break. - When cutting onions, you can use two chopsticks on both sides of the onion and stop when the knife touches the chopsticks to avoid cutting off the root plate. - Soaking in ice water can make the petals crisp and open naturally. This step cannot be omitted. - Insufficient flour coating is the primary cause of failure. The inner parts of the petals that are not coated with flour will become soft and collapse after frying. The purpose of using a deep pot instead of a pan is to allow the oil to cover the whole onion, otherwise the top petals cannot be fried. - When the oil temperature is higher than 180°C, the outer layer will be burnt first and the inside will not be cooked yet. The whole process should be controlled below 180°C. - There is no kitchen thermometer to insert chopsticks into the oil. When small bubbles are densely forming around the chopsticks, the temperature is about 170°C. - Please refer to the dipping sauce Garlic Soy Sauce
Choose large, firm-skinned onions, leaving the bottom uncut so that the petals can spread naturally after frying.
After cutting, coat in flour, egg liquid, and bread crumbs. Press each layer lightly so that the pastry shell will not fall off easily.
Control the oil temperature to 60% hot. Fry first to set the shape, then increase the oil temperature and fry again for half a minute. The color will be golden and crispy.

Case: Before a friend’s party, I chose a large onion without cutting the bottom, cut it into petals horizontally and vertically, rolled it in flour and bread crumbs, put it in a pan, fried it until golden and opened up, and served it on the table like a flower. Everyone took photos while dipping it in the sauce.

items.title: Grilled Eggplant
items.core: Grilled eggplant is rich in aroma, charred on the outside and tender on the inside. The spices of cumin and minced garlic are perfectly blended into the soft and waxy eggplant meat. It is a dish that can easily recreate the flavor of street barbecue at home. Eggplant is rich in vitamin P and anthocyanins, which help protect cardiovascular and antioxidant properties. The recipe requires the use of an oven, but the steps are clear and a novice can complete it in about half an hour. It is very suitable as a quick meal for family dinners.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggplant - Cooking oil - Soy sauce (light soy sauce) - Minced garlic - Chili pepper - Cumin - Edible salt

Calculation: According to the serving size for two people: - 1 eggplant (about 200g) - 20-30 ml of cooking oil - 4-6 grams of soy sauce - 1 millet pepper (about 20g) - 3-4 cloves of minced garlic - 1-3 grams of cumin - 0.5-2 grams of edible salt

Operation: 1. Place soy sauce, cumin, salt, minced garlic and chopped millet pepper in a bowl, stir evenly and set aside. 2. Wash the eggplant and dry the surface with paper towels. 3. Prick one side of the eggplant 4-8 times with a fork. 4. Use 15-25ml cooking oil to coat the surface of the eggplant. 5. Set the oven temperature to 200℃ (turn on the oven fan to high heat) and preheat for 2 minutes 6. Place the eggplant in the middle or upper rack of the oven and bake for 12-15 minutes (the surface of the eggplant should be wrinkled and can be pressed to a depth of 0.3-0.5cm). 7. Take out the eggplant and make a vertical slit on the eggplant with a knife. Place the opening in the center, 1-1.5cm from top to bottom. 8. Insert a knife or fork into the opening and cut the inside of the eggplant vertically. 9. Open the opening slightly and pour in the sauce prepared in the first step. 10. Place the eggplant in the oven again, set the oven temperature to 200°C, and bake for 4-7 minutes. 11. Take it out and turn off the oven

Additional content: The final product is similar to the grilled eggplant from the barbecue stall downstairs, so fragrant! Note: There is moisture on the surface of the eggplant, it is not coated with cooking oil, or it is not pierced with a fork, which may cause the eggplant to burst during the grilling process. Points that can be improved: When you first make a cut with a knife, you can directly cut the eggplant in half vertically, then cut out the lines and apply the sauce
Wash and dry the eggplant, cut it in half, and make a few cuts but don’t cut it to make it easier for the seasoning to penetrate and prevent it from falling apart.
Brush with a thin layer of oil and then spread with garlic sauce. Wrap in tin foil and bake for fifteen minutes to keep the eggplant meat moist and soft.
In the last ten minutes, remove the tin foil and sprinkle with cumin and chili powder. The edges will be slightly burnt, closer to the barbecue flavor.

Case: I simulated barbecue at home on the weekend. I cut the eggplant in half and brushed it with oil, spread minced garlic and cumin and put it in the oven. After more than 20 minutes, the aroma filled the house, the eggplant flesh was soft and glutinous, and I served it with iced drinks on the table, just like the smell of a night market stall.

items.title: Boiled Choy Sum
items.core: This classic Cantonese dish uses the blanching technique. It is quickly blanched in boiling water to retain the sweetness, crispness and tenderness of the cabbage. The rhizome is particularly refreshing and has a light and delicious taste. Rich in vitamin C and dietary fiber, low in fat and calories, it is suitable for people who pursue a healthy diet. The preparation is very simple, with an estimated difficulty of only two stars. It only takes 15 minutes for beginners to complete it, making it an ideal choice for quickly replenishing green leafy vegetables.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Fresh cabbage - Light soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt - Garlic, spicy millet - Edible oil

Calculation: The following amounts are enough for two people, and it can be eaten by one person directly with rice. - 250g of fresh cabbage - 10g of cooking oil - Make a soul sauce - 5g of light soy sauce - 5g of oyster sauce - 5g of salt and sugar - four or five cloves of garlic, one or two sprigs of spicy millet

Operation: 1. Wash the cabbage and remove the hard or old parts of the roots. Here, I also used a knife to scrape the rhizome of the cabbage to remove the hard outer layer. The inside of the cabbage is more delicious, but pay attention to how long it takes to boil the rhizome. If the time is too long, the rhizome will not be crispy. 2. Chop the garlic into minced garlic and add some onions if there are any. 3. Prepare the soul sauce: 5g of light soy sauce, 5g of oyster sauce, add 3g of sugar and 100g of water to make half a bowl of juice. If starch is added, the soup will be more likely to stick to the cabbage after boiling, and the taste will be stronger, which may not be used by Cantonese people. 4. Add 5g of salt and 10g of cooking oil to a pot of 500ml water and bring to a boil. 5. Blanch the cabbage rhizome in boiling water for 1 minute until the rhizome turns dark green. Then put the whole cabbage sum in the pot and blanch for 1 minute, pick it up and put it on a plate. 6. Open another small pot and pour the mixed sauce, bring to a boil over low heat, add half of the minced garlic, a little shredded ginger and crushed millet and pepper. When making, add a little bit of chopped onion and garlic. First pour oil in the bottom of the pot. After 50% heat, add minced garlic and onion. Saute for a while before adding the sauce. Add millet and spicy and bring to boil. 7. The sauce is slightly reduced. After boiling, wait for about ten seconds. Then pour it directly on the cabbage. Not too much, but the minced garlic is still very powerful. Don’t be short of garlic
Additional content: - Choose fresh cabbage! Fresh! - Add oil and salt to boil water in the pot
Choose cabbage cabbage of the same size, lightly scrape the old skin at the root, and blanch the cabbage to a uniform ripeness and a more tender texture.
Add a little salt and a few drops of oil to the water to keep the cabbage green, blanch it for 30 to 60 seconds and then remove it.
Put it out, place it on a plate, pour a small amount of light soy sauce, and finally pour a spoonful of hot oil to stir the aroma. Do not marinate the water for a long time in advance.

Case: The old man at home said he wanted to eat something lighter, so I boiled water and added a few drops of oil, blanched the cabbage for 30 seconds, scooped it out, and poured light soy sauce and hot oil on it. The rhizome was refreshing and the tips of the leaves were green. After eating it, the old man said it was even fresher than the fried one.

items.title: Preserved Egg Tofu
items.core: Preserved Egg Tofu is a refreshing and appetizing cold home-cooked dish. The preserved eggs are smooth and tender, and the soft tofu melts in your mouth. The salty and slightly sour taste goes well with rice. Tofu is rich in high-quality plant protein and calcium, while preserved eggs provide iron, vitamin A and other nutrients, which are easy to digest and absorb when eaten together. The production process is almost zero-threshold and can be easily completed by novices. It only takes about 5 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - preserved eggs - lactone tofu - light soy sauce - white sugar - vinegar (Zhenjiang balsamic vinegar is recommended) - sesame oil (optional) - chili oil (optional) - chopped peanuts (optional) - chopped green onion (optional) - coriander (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Each serving: - 2 preserved eggs - 1 box of lactone tofu - 15 ml of light soy sauce - 2.5g of sugar - 15 ml of vinegar - 15 ml of sesame oil - 10 ml of chili oil - 10 g of chopped peanuts - 15 g of chopped green onion - 1 stalk of coriander

Operation: 1. Peel the preserved eggs first and cut them into four pieces. 2. Cut the soft tofu into cubes or slices and place them in the middle. 3. Mix light soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, sesame oil and chili oil into a sauce and pour it on. 4. Finally, optionally sprinkle with chopped peanuts, chopped green onion, and coriander.

Additional content: - Blanch the tofu first to remove the beany smell - You can apply some sesame oil on the knife when cutting the preserved eggs to prevent them from sticking - Reference: Cold preserved egg tofu by Low-end version of Xiaodangjia - Ai Cuisine
Use lactone tofu or soft tofu, and mark a circle on the edge of the box before inverting it. The texture will be more delicate after complete demoulding.
Blank preserved eggs in hot water for 30 seconds before cutting. The yolk will not stick to the knife easily, and the slices will be neater and less fishy.
Mix the sauce with 2 tablespoons of light soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of balsamic vinegar, and a little sesame oil. Refrigerate for ten minutes to make it more flavorful.

Case: I have no appetite in summer, so I tore open the preserved egg and cut it into slices, put it on the boxed soft tofu, poured it with light soy vinegar and sesame oil, sprinkled it with chopped green onions and put it in the refrigerator for ten minutes. It was cold and tender in the mouth, sour and salty, and appetizing. I ate half a bowl of rice more for dinner.

items.id: 糖拌西红柿-糖拌西红柿
items.title: Sugar mixed tomatoes
items.core: This is a home-cooked cold dish suitable for summer, sweet and sour, refreshing and easy to make. Tomatoes are rich in vitamin C, which is appetizing and relieves fatigue. Easy for novices to make, the entire process (including refrigeration) takes about 15 minutes and is ready to serve.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Tomatoes - Sugar - Refrigerator
Calculation: One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each portion: - 2 tomatoes (each tomato is about 100g, 200g in total) - 20g white sugar

Operation: 1. Use a knife to cut the skin of the tomatoes into rice shapes. 2. Insert the chrysanthemums of the tomatoes with chopsticks, turn and grill on the gas for 10 seconds (or rinse with boiling water for 30 seconds) until the skins of the tomatoes are curled. 3. Take off the clothes of the tomatoes 4. Cut the tomatoes into eight pieces (cut along the grain to retain more juice), remove the head and base, and set aside. 5. After all the tomatoes are cut, place the tomatoes in an even layer on the plate. 6. Sprinkle the tomatoes with sugar and repeat the above step until all the tomatoes are gone. 7. Place in the refrigerator for 10 minutes. 8. A plate of tomatoes mixed with sugar is enough. It is nutritious and delicious, sweet and sour, and can relieve summer heat and fatigue.
Additional content: Please be careful when using knives during the production process.
Choose highly mature red tomatoes. They are soft when pinched and have elastic skin. They produce more juice and are sweeter.

After cutting the tomatoes into halves, sprinkle them with sugar and let them sit for five minutes before refrigerating them. This will allow the sweetness to penetrate and prevent them from turning watery and bland early.
Add the amount of sugar according to one-tenth of the weight of the tomatoes. If you want it to be more refreshing, add less sugar and mix it again before eating.

Case: The weather was very hot on the weekend afternoon. Xiaolin cut two ripe tomatoes into wedges and sprinkled them with sugar. They put them in the refrigerator for ten minutes. After serving them, the family ate them in between. The juice was sweet and sour and appetizing, and they could be seen on the bottom of the plate before dinner.

items.title: Vegetarian Stir-fried Beans
items.core: This is a home-style stir-fry with a rich sauce. The beans are tender and flavorful, and are spicy enough to go with rice. Rich in dietary fiber and multivitamins, it helps promote digestion. The recipe is simple and can be easily mastered by novices. It takes about 20 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Beans - Millet peppers - Onions - Garlic - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Oil consumption - Salt

Calculation: Note that due to individual ingredients, this recipe is for 2 people - 250g green beans - 2 millet peppers - 3 rings of green onions - 2 garlic - 6ml light soy sauce - 2ml dark soy sauce - 6ml oil consumption - Salt 6g

Operation: 1. Cut the green onion into flowers, mince the garlic into fine pieces and set aside. 2. Mix the sauce of light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oil and salt and set aside. 3. Cut millet pepper into rings and set aside. 4. Remove the gluten from the green beans, cut into 4-10cm pieces at a 45° angle, and set aside. 5. Heat oil (10ml - 15ml) in a pan. When it starts to smoke, add green onions and millet peppers and stir-fry until fragrant; 6. Add beans and stir-fry for 30 seconds. 7. Add sauce and stir-fry over high heat for 2 minutes. 8. Pour in 150ml of water. 9. Turn to medium to low heat, cover and simmer for 8-10 minutes. 10. Add minced garlic and remove from the pan.
Additional content: - Cutting beans requires a certain amount of knife skills, you can use scissors if you don't know how
The green beans are first trimmed and cut into sections, then blanched in boiling water with a little salt for three minutes, which can shorten the frying time and keep them green.
The green beans must be completely cut off and stir-fried until the color becomes darker and there is no taste of raw beans in the mouth to avoid discomfort after eating.
Use minced garlic and dried chili pepper to simmer the pot first, then pour light soy sauce along the edge of the pot. The sauce will be more fragrant and less likely to leak out.

Case: There was a handful of green beans left in the refrigerator on Tuesday night. Xiao Li cut them into sections and blanched them in a hot pan to sauté the minced garlic until fragrant. Stir-fry over high heat and add light soy sauce. After 15 minutes, the beans were soft and tender, and they were eaten with rice.

items.title: Braised winter melon
items.core: Braised winter melon is a home-cooked vegetarian dish with bright red color, delicious fragrance, soft and glutinous texture, and is a popular Chinese cooking dish. Winter melon itself is rich in water, dietary fiber and vitamin C. It has the effects of clearing away heat, relieving summer heat, diuresis and reducing swelling. With simple seasonings, it is nutritious and easy to digest. This dish is relatively beginner-friendly with clear steps. You only need to master the heat and seasoning. It is expected to take about 25 minutes to make.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Winter melon * Edible oil * Cooking wine * Starch * Light soy sauce * Dark soy sauce * Chicken essence * Chives * Minced ginger * Oyster sauce

Calculation: Per portion: * Winter melon 300 g * Edible oil 50 ml * Cooking wine 2 ml * Starch 10 g * Light soy sauce 10 ml * Dark soy sauce 15 ml * Chicken essence 3 g * 0.5 chives * 1 minced ginger * oyster sauce 15 ml

Operation: 1. Peel the winter melon and cut into small pieces with sides no longer than 2cm. 2. Heat oil in a pan, add the winter melon, slowly turn and fry for 2 minutes until the surface of the winter melon turns golden brown. 3. Take out the winter melon and put it into a large bowl for later use. 4. Use the remaining oil in the pot, add minced ginger, light soy sauce, and oyster sauce, and stir-fry for 15 seconds. 5. Pour in the winter melon again, stir-fry for 30 seconds, then add boiling water, so that the water covers the surface of the winter melon, and cook on high heat for 10 minutes. 6. Add dark soy sauce to color, and continue cooking until the winter melon is soft and glutinous (chopsticks can be easily inserted close to the winter melon). 7. Add chicken essence, cooking wine, and chives and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Take out the winter melon and put it into a large bowl. 8. Reserve the remaining soup in the pot, pour in water and starch, and pour the soup over the surface of the winter melon after boiling
Additional Content
Cut the winter melon into 1cm thick pieces, wipe the surface dry and put it in the pan. Fry until it is slightly brown so that it will not fall apart easily and absorb the soup.
Start with two spoons of light soy sauce, half a spoon of dark soy sauce, and half a spoon of sugar. Start with less and then more to avoid excessive color and bitterness.
Add water to cover half of the winter melon, simmer over low heat until transparent and soft, then reduce the juice over high heat to let the flavor linger.

Case: There were guests at home during the dog days of summer. Xiao Wang cut the winter melon into thick pieces and fried it until slightly brown, then added soy sauce and sugar and simmered over low heat. After more than 20 minutes, it was out of the pan. The winter melon was soft and glutinous and wrapped in sauce. The guests even mixed the soup with rice and ate it.

items.title: Braised eggplant
items.core: Braised eggplant is a home-cooked dish with a strong salty aroma. The soft and waxy eggplant pieces soak up the soup, and it is paired with bell peppers and tomatoes. It is sour and spicy. Eggplant is rich in dietary fiber and vitamin P, and the fried eggplant pieces are fragrant but not greasy. It requires frying in batter and slow-cooking to infuse the flavor. There are a few steps, but it can still be tried by novices. Pay attention to the details and you can succeed. It takes about 45 minutes from prep to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Garlic - Green onions - Green peppers - Onions - Tomatoes - Green eggplants - Salt - Soy sauce - Eggs - Flour - Starch

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people Total quantity: - Number of green eggplants = number of servings * 0.7 pieces - Green peppers = number of servings * 0.5 pieces - Onions = number of servings * 0.3 pieces - Tomatoes = 1 piece - Green onion = half - Garlic = 3 cloves - Egg = 1 piece - Flour = Number of green eggplants * 150 g - Starch = flour / 4 g - Soy sauce = Number of eggplants * 7 grams (round up)

Operation: 1. Wash green eggplants, green peppers, tomatoes, onions, and green onions. 1. Cut the green onion into 5 mm wide slices, peel and smash the garlic, cut the tomatoes into 6 cubic centimeter pieces, and cut the green pepper and onion into 5g pieces. 1. Cut the eggplant into diamond-shaped pieces (first cut into 2 cm thick slices, then cut the slices into 2 cm strips, and finally cut into pieces with a diagonal knife...). 1. Pour the flour into a basin, add a small amount of water one by one, and stir evenly until it becomes a thick paste. 1. Add starch, add 30 grams of water, and stir evenly. 1. Crack the eggs into a basin, add (flour/20) grams of salt, and stir evenly. 1. Pour the eggplant pieces into the batter and stir so that all sides of the eggplant pieces are coated with the batter. 1. Turn on high heat, heat the pan, and add 500 ml of oil. When you can see a trace of smoke coming out of the oil in the pan, reduce the heat to low. Use chopsticks to insert the eggplant pieces into the oil pan. After all the eggplant pieces are in the pan, turn to medium heat and take them out when the eggplant pieces turn golden brown. Pour out the oil. 1. Add (portion * 5) g of oil, add garlic and chopped green onion, stir-fry for 15 seconds, add green chili cubes and stir-fry for 30 seconds, add tomatoes and stir-fry for 30 seconds. 1. Add the fried eggplant cubes and add water to a level 0.8 times the height of the ingredients in the pot. 1. Add soy sauce and (portion * 3) g of salt. 1. Wait until the soup becomes thick (the water level is about 0.2-0.3 times the height of the remaining ingredients), open the lid, take out the dishes, and turn off the heat.
Additional content: Please pay attention to steps 4-6 of the operation: Be sure to perform them in order, otherwise there will be catastrophic mistakes...
After cutting the eggplants into hob pieces, sprinkle them with salt and let them sit for ten minutes to squeeze out the water. They will absorb less oil and become softer when fried.
Use starch to flour at a ratio of 2:1 for the paste. Just wrap it in a thin layer. If it is too thick, it will be hard on the outside and hard on the inside, affecting the taste.
After frying, add minced garlic, tomatoes and a small amount of sweet and sour sauce. Simmer over low heat for three to five minutes before thickening.

Case: There was a small dinner party at home on the weekend. Xiao Zhang thinly battered the eggplant cubes and deep-fried them until fragrant, then cooked them with tomatoes and green peppers. After more than 40 minutes, he put them on the plate. The eggplant cubes were filled with sauce and were quickly emptied on the table.

items.title: Crispy tofu
items.core: Crispy tofu is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, and the sauce is salty and sweet. It is a quick meal. Tofu is rich in plant protein and calcium, and eggs provide high-quality protein with a balanced nutritional mix. Making it requires patience to fry the golden crispy skin, but the steps are clear and even beginners can master it. The whole process takes about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Laodoufu - Eggs - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Oyster sauce - White sugar - Cornstarch - Pan

Calculation: per serving: - 1 block of Laodoufu (1.25 square meters to buy at the market * person) - 2 eggs * Number of old tofu blocks - Cornstarch 50 g * Number of old tofu blocks - 20 g of light soy sauce - Oyster sauce 10 g - Dark soy sauce 5 g - White sugar 10 g

Operation: 1. Stir the eggs to form egg liquid and set aside. 2. Prepare the sauce (20 g light soy sauce+10 g oyster sauce+5 g dark soy sauce+10 g white sugar+10 g corn starch+200 ml water) 3. Slice the old tofu (personal suggestion, for reference only Person * 5 slices, thickness 1.2 cm) 4. Pour cornstarch into a plate, coat the old tofu slices with starch, then coat with egg liquid, and set aside. 5. Heat the pot and add 18ml cooking oil in the pot. Wait 10 seconds for the oil temperature to rise. 6. Evenly put the old tofu slices coated with egg liquid into the pot, spread the bottom of the pot, and fry over low heat until golden brown. Flip over. 7. After frying until golden brown on both sides, pour in the sauce so that each piece of tofu is bathed in the sauce. Cook on high heat for 3 minutes until the sauce thickens. 8. Turn off the heat
Additional Content
Choose northern tofu or old tofu, cut into 1cm thick pieces and use kitchen paper to absorb the moisture on the surface. It will not break easily when fried.
Add a small amount of starch into the egg liquid and mix well, let the tofu thickly coat with paste, fry over medium-low heat until both sides are golden brown, then turn over.
The sauce is prepared in advance with light soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and water. Pour it in all at once before serving, and stir quickly to combine.

Case: It was late after get off work and there was no time to make complicated dishes. Xiao Chen cut the old tofu into cubes, wrapped it in egg liquid and fried it in a pan. After golden brown on both sides, pour the sauce. It was served in 25 minutes. It was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The child even picked up several pieces.

items.id: 芹菜拌茶树菇-芹菜拌茶树菇
items.title: Celery mixed with tea tree mushrooms
items.core: This is a refreshing and crispy cold dish. The crispness of celery and the chewy texture of tea tree mushrooms complement each other, and the taste is rich in layers. Rich in a variety of vitamins and minerals, nutritious and appetizing. The recipe is very simple and can be easily mastered by novices. It only takes about 30 minutes from preparation to completion.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Fujian tea tree mushroom - celery - sesame oil - oyster sauce - extremely fresh flavor - edible salt

Calculation: You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. One serving serves 1-2 people. Each portion: - 1 bottle of Minxing Tea Tree Mushroom - 250-300g of celery (30cm tall celery seedlings are recommended. If you don't have celery seedlings, you can use celery or celery instead but they need to be slightly blanched) - 5ml of sesame oil - about 7ml of oyster sauce - 3ml of very fresh taste - about 2g of edible salt

Operation: 1. (If it is celery seedlings, skip this step) Use a hot water kettle to boil a pot of hot water and set aside. 2. Remove the yellow leaves from fresh celery seedlings or celery, wash them, and set aside. 3. (If it is celery seedlings, skip this step) Remove the leaves from the celery and put them in a separate pot. Cut the celery stems into 2-3 mm wide celery sticks with a knife and set aside. The purpose of this step is to make the celery break faster and more evenly, and taste crisper and more delicious. 4. Cut the celery seedlings into 4cm celery segments, set aside. 5. (If it is celery seedlings, skip this step) Turn on the pot and pour boiling water into the pot. Wait until the water bubbles and boils. 6. (If it is celery seedlings, skip this step) Put the cut celery sticks into the pot and blanch them. Add the celery leaves for about 20 seconds. After 5 seconds, turn off the heat and drain them all into cold water. Set aside. 7. Sprinkle the blanched celery or celery seedlings in the basin with the prepared salt, sesame oil, oyster sauce and the fresh flavor and mix well. 8. Pour the tea tree mushrooms into the basin and mix well. 9. Plate 10. Start eating
Additional content: - The water level during blanching needs to cover the celery - If the celery leaves are too old and hard, you can omit them
Blanch celery in diagonal sections for 20 seconds and immediately run it through cold water to keep it crisp, tender and bright green.
Bleach the tea tree mushrooms for two to three minutes to remove the earthy smell, then squeeze out the water so that the seasoning will not be diluted when mixed.
For seasoning, use minced garlic, light soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, a little sugar and sesame oil. Mix well along the edge of the bowl and let it sit for five minutes to enhance the flavor.

Case: A friend came over for a light dinner. Xiao Zhao blanched celery and tea tree mushrooms, added minced garlic and balsamic vinegar, mixed well, refrigerated for a while and then took it out. The vegetables were crispy and the mushrooms were fragrant, and they were quickly eaten.

items.title: Eggplant Stewed with Potatoes
items.core: Eggplant Stewed with Potatoes is a home-cooked stew from Northeast China. It has a soft and salty texture, with the slight spiciness of chili and the aroma of garlic. It goes very well with rice. Eggplant is rich in anthocyanins and dietary fiber, while potatoes provide carbohydrates and vitamin C. Together with the protein of pork, it is nutritionally balanced and filling. The operation process of this dish is simple, but it requires mastery of stir-frying and reducing the heat. It will be a challenge for novices, and the difficulty is estimated to be medium. It takes about 45 minutes from prep to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggplant - Potatoes - Meat - Chili (green chili, not chili powder or chili oil) - Soy sauce - Salt - Garlic

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2-3 people Total quantity: - Number of eggplants = number of servings * 1 (each eggplant is about 150g) - Number of potatoes = number of servings * 1 (each potato is about 150g) - Amount of meat = number of servings * 180g - Amount of soy sauce = number of servings * 15 ml - Amount of salt = number of servings * 5g - Amount of chilli = 50 Grams (seasoning, so no matter how many people put these.) - Amount of garlic = 3 cloves (seasoning, so no matter how many people put these. Note that it is 3 small cloves inside, not 3 whole heads) Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials you plan to use.

Operation: 1. Wash the eggplant, potatoes and peppers, peel and smash the garlic. 2. Cut the eggplant and potatoes into about 6 cubic centimeter pieces, cut the pepper into 5g pieces, and cut the meat into 3cm strips. 3. Turn on the heat, heat the pan and add portion * 13 ml of oil. 4. When you can see a hint of smoke coming out of the oil in the pan, add the chili peppers. 5. After the chili aroma is released, immediately add the meat and stir-fry with a spatula for 30 seconds. 6. Add potatoes and stir fry for 30 seconds. 7. Add eggplant and stir-fry for 30 seconds. 8. Add soy sauce and salt and continue stir-frying for 5 minutes. 9. Add water until the height of the water surface is 0.9 times the height of the ingredients in the pot, and cover the pot with a lid. 10. Wait until the height of the water in the pot is 0.1 times the height of the remaining ingredients, open the lid, add the garlic, stir evenly, and turn off the heat.

Additional content: Please note in steps 5-7 of the operation: During this process, pay attention to the bottom of the pot. If there is no liquid (oil or water), add 5 ml of water and continue to stir-fry.
Cut the potatoes into hob pieces and soak them in water to remove the starch. Cut the eggplants into pieces and then sprinkle them with salt and let them sit. This can reduce oil absorption and stew.
First stir-fry the pork slices, onions, ginger and garlic, then add the eggplant and stir-fry. When the eggplant becomes soft, add the potatoes and hot water.
Simmer until the potatoes can be easily pierced with chopsticks, add salt, turn to high heat to reduce the juice, and finally sprinkle with minced garlic to enhance the aroma.

Case: As the temperature dropped over the weekend, Xiao Liu stewed the eggplant, potatoes and some meat slices in the refrigerator. He sauteed it until fragrant and then simmered it in water. After forty minutes, the soup became thick, the potatoes were soft and the eggplant was delicious. The whole family ate it with rice.

items.id: 莴笋叶煎饼-莴笋叶煎饼
items.title: Lettuce leaf pancakes
items.core: Lettuce leaf pancakes are a simple and quick home-cooked snack. They are crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with the fragrance of lettuce leaves. Lettuce leaves are rich in vitamins and dietary fiber, and paired with eggs to supplement high-quality protein, the nutrition is balanced. The preparation process does not require complicated skills, just stir and fry both sides, and it is easy for novices to use. It is expected to only take about 10 minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Lettuce leaves * Eggs * Edible oil * Light soy sauce * Starch * Chicken essence
Calculation: Each portion: * Lettuce leaves 50 g * 2 eggs * Edible oil 30 ml * Light soy sauce 5 ml * Starch 15 g * Chicken essence 2 g

Operation: 1. Chop the lettuce leaves into small pieces, add eggs, cornstarch, light soy sauce, and chicken essence, mix well and set aside. 2. Heat oil in a pan, pour in the lettuce leaf juice, and spread it evenly on the surface of the pan. 3. Fry the first side for 120 seconds, then turn over and fry for another 60 seconds, then take it out of the pot
Lettuce leaves have a bitter taste after being directly blanched and served cold, so they are chosen as a side dish for pancakes
Wash and chop the lettuce leaves, mix with a small amount of salt to kill the water, and then squeeze them dry so that they will not become watery and fall apart when making pancakes.
Add the batter to the ratio of flour, eggs and water until it flows slowly, and let it sit for five minutes to allow the flour to absorb water.
Fry in a pan with thin oil over medium-low heat. When the surface is solidified, turn it over. Once both sides are golden, remove from the pan and cut into pieces.

Case: There were only a few lettuce leaves left in the refrigerator in the morning. Xiao Zhou chopped them into pieces and mixed them with eggs and flour to make a paste. He fried two pieces in a pan over low heat and served them on the table ten minutes later. The edges of the cake were crispy and the vegetable aroma was obvious. It was a filling breakfast.

items.id: 菠菜炒鸡蛋-菠菜炒鸡蛋
items.title: Scrambled eggs with spinach
items.core: Scrambled eggs with spinach is a light and refreshing home-cooked dish. The spinach is soft and tender, and the eggs are fragrant. It is a popular flavor suitable for both north and south. Spinach is rich in iron, folic acid and vitamins, and eggs provide high-quality protein and lecithin. Eating them together can help replenish blood, nourish qi, and enhance physical fitness. The entire dish is simple to make and perfect for novice cooks, taking only about 15 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Spinach - Eggs - Edible oil - Edible salt
Calculation: According to the portion of 1 person: - Spinach 350g - 2 eggs - Edible oil 15ml - Edible salt 5g

Operation: 1. Remove the roots of spinach, wash it, put it in a basket, and blanch it 2. Crack the eggs into a bowl and stir well 3. Heat the pan and add 10ml of oil 4. After the oil is hot, pour in the egg liquid and stir-fry over medium heat for 15 seconds. Fry it into an omelette first, and then cut it into small pieces with a spatula. 5. Turn off the heat, put the egg cubes on a plate, do not wash the pan. 6. Turn on the heat again, pour in 5ml of oil. When the oil is hot, add spinach, stir-fry over high heat for 15 seconds. After that, add the egg cubes, stir-fry evenly. 7. Add 5g of salt, 100ml of drinking water, stir-fry over high heat for 10 Seconds 8. Turn off the heat and serve on a plate
Additional Content
Blanach the spinach for 20 seconds and then cool it, which can remove part of the oxalic acid and keep the color green without turning yellow.
Add a little salt and water to the eggs, stir-fry them in a hot pan until they are just solidified, and then serve them out for a more tender texture.
When frying spinach and eggs together, work quickly and add the salt last to prevent the spinach from releasing a lot of water and turning into soup.

Case: Time is tight at noon on weekdays. Xiao Wu blanched the spinach to remove astringency, stir-fried the eggs and stir-fried for seasoning, and put it on the plate in 12 minutes. The eggs were fragrant and the spinach was soft and tender. After a meal with steamed buns, the bottom of the plate was clean.

items.title: Pan-fried tofu with green onions
items.core: Brown on the outside and tender on the inside, rich onion aroma, salty and slightly spicy, it is a home-cooked dish. Tofu is rich in plant protein and calcium, and paired with green peppers and green onions, it is nutritionally balanced. The difficulty of making the tofu is moderate. When frying tofu, you need to master low heat and slow frying. Even a novice can cook it patiently and follow the steps. The whole process takes about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - White tofu - Green onion - Green chili - Salt - Chicken stock - Pan

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Total Amount: - Amount of White Tofu = Servings * 0.8 Round up. - Number of peppers = 1.5/person. - Number of green onions = 2/person. - Amount of salt = servings * 3g. - Amount of chicken essence = number of servings * 1.5g. Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials you plan to use and adjust according to taste.

Operation: 1. Wash the tofu. Cut into approximately 5 mm thickness and place on a plate. 2. Wash the green onions, remove the roots, cut into finely chopped green onions and set aside. 3. Wash the peppers, cut them, remove seeds, cut them into 1cm * 1cm shapes and set aside. 4. Heat the pan and add portion * 9ml oil. 5. After adding oil to the pot, spread it evenly on the bottom of the pot, add tofu evenly, and fry over low heat until golden brown. 6. When both sides are golden, transfer to a plate and set aside. 7. Add oil to cover the bottom of the pot, add chili and stir-fry over high heat for 3 minutes. 8. Pour in the tofu, stir-fry, add salt and chicken essence, stir-fry over medium heat for 1 minute, then add 10 ML water, and reduce the juice over high heat. 9. Before serving, sprinkle with the chopped green onions, remove from the pan and serve on a plate.
Additional Content
Cut the tofu into thick slices and wipe off the water. Do not flip it immediately after putting it in the pot. Fry the tofu into a hard shell and gently push it to prevent it from breaking.
Use the green onion whites to stir-fry until fragrant first, and add the green onion leaves last. The fragrant layers of the onion will be clearer and will not turn black.
Seasoning: Pour soy sauce and a little water along the edge of the pot, cover and simmer for one minute to allow the inside of the tofu to absorb the flavor and then dry up.

Case: I wanted to have some vegetarian dishes for dinner, so Xiao Zheng cut the tofu into thick slices and slowly fried it over low heat, added scallions and green peppers and stir-fried for seasoning. After half an hour, I took it out. The tofu was charred on the outside and tender on the inside, and the onions were fragrant. It was finished quickly.

items.id: 蒜蓉炒芹菜-蒜蓉炒芹菜
items.title: Stir-fried celery with garlic
items.core: Stir-fried celery with garlic is a crisp and refreshing home-cooked vegetarian dish with rich garlic aroma. Celery is rich in dietary fiber, vitamin K, and potassium. The soul of this dish lies in its "crispness" - stir-fry it over high heat for half a minute and it's crispy and juicy when you bite into it. It only takes about 10 minutes from prep to serving.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: * Celery (parsley is best) * Lard (no edible oil can be substituted, but lard has a better flavor) * Garlic * Salt
Calculation: Per portion: * 300 g parsley (about 2 large handfuls) * 4 cloves of garlic, minced * 15 ml lard * 2 g salt

Operation: 1. Remove most of the leaves from the celery, leaving only a few young leaves. If the stem is thick, cut it lengthwise to make it uniform in thickness, and then cut it into sections no more than 5 cm (about the length of your thumb, too long can get stuck in the throat) 2. Cut the garlic into minced garlic, and set aside 3. Drain the celery segments as much as possible before putting them in the pot, and shake them as dry as possible 4. Heat the wok, add 15 ml lard, and sprinkle 2 g of salt when the oil is hot 5. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry over low heat 10 Stir-fry for seconds 6. Turn up the heat, add the celery segments, stir-fry quickly for 30 seconds, and serve immediately. 7. Cooking criteria: The celery looks half-cooked, green in color, and not soft when fried. The texture is the crispest at this time

Additional content: * For celery, parsley (thin-stem variety) is the best, and has the crispest texture. Ordinary celery can also be used, but those with thick stems need to be chopped lengthwise * Stir-frying quickly over high heat is the key, and the celery should not take more than 1 minute from the time it is put into the pot to the time it is taken out of the pot. If it is fried for a long time, it will become soft and wilted, and lose its crisp texture * Be sure to drain as much water as possible before adding celery to the pot. Too much water will lower the temperature of the pot, causing it to be "boiled" instead of "fried" * Stir-frying with lard is more fragrant than cooking oil. If lard is not available, cooking oil can also be substituted
Choose thin stalks of celery and cut it diagonally after removing the outer thick ribs. It will be crispier in the mouth and easier to taste.
Blank for ten seconds and then cool immediately to fix the green color; drain before frying to prevent the water from becoming soft after being put into the pot.
The pot should be heated until it smokes slightly before adding the minced garlic and celery. The whole process should be under high heat for no more than one minute. Sprinkle the salt at the end.

Case: Before lunch, I found that the celery was a little wilted. Xiao He cut it into sections and quickly blanched it. Stir-fried the minced garlic in a hot pan for half a minute. It was still crispy green and juicy when it came out of the pan. My family said it was more delicious than usual.

items.id: 蒜蓉空心菜-蒜蓉空心菜
items.title: Garlic water spinach
items.core: Garlic water spinach is a crisp and refreshing home-cooked dish with a strong garlic aroma, which is a typical Sichuan style stir-fry flavor. Water spinach is rich in dietary fiber, vitamins and calcium, which helps promote intestinal peristalsis. The recipe is very simple and friendly to novices, and it only takes about 15 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Water spinach * Minced garlic * Salt * Light soy sauce * Chopsticks * Shovel
Calculation: per serving: * Fresh water spinach 250 g * Half garlic, chopped into minced garlic * Edible oil 45 ml * Salt 2 g * White sugar 3 g * Light soy sauce 8 ml

Operation: 1. Wash water spinach, remove rotten leaves or old stems, and cut into even slices Stage 2 or Stage 3 (to prevent it from being too long and difficult to fry) 2. Pour a small amount of oil into the pot and heat it until it smokes slightly. At this time, pick up the pot and soak the domestic hot oil around so that the oil evenly covers the bottom of the pot, and then pour in the remaining oil (hot pot and cold oil method). 3. Add minced garlic and stir-fry over low heat for 10 to 15 seconds until fragrant. 4. Add water spinach evenly as soon as possible, turn on high heat, hold a spatula in your left hand and chopsticks in your right hand, and keep turning the water spinach until it softens and turns green. 5. Then, instead of using chopsticks, use a shovel to quickly stir-fry the softened water spinach for 15-20 seconds to heat it more evenly. Sprinkle in 2 g of salt, 3 g of sugar, and 8 ml of light soy sauce. 6. Continue to stir-fry over high heat for 10 seconds, then serve.

Additional content: * Try to choose fresh and tender water spinach, otherwise it may taste old when fried * The actual amount of water spinach can be determined according to the size of the pot. It is recommended not to exceed one pot. Otherwise, if there are too many, a small amount of water spinach will easily fall out of the stove during the initial stirring stage and subsequent stir-frying.
Put the water spinach stems and leaves into the pot separately. Fry the stems for 30 seconds before adding the leaves, so that the maturity will be more even.
Put the minced garlic in twice, add half to the pot to enhance the aroma, and stir in half before taking it out of the pot to make the garlic taste fresher and less bitter.
Stir-fry quickly over high heat. When the leaves collapse, season immediately and take out the pan. Stir-frying for a long time will turn black and lose their crispiness.

Case: I bought a handful of water spinach for dinner in the summer. Xiao Meng picked it and washed it, then stir-fried it quickly over high heat. When the garlic was fragrant, I immediately added salt and took it out of the pan. It was served in ten minutes. The leaves are green and crisp, perfect for porridge.

items.title: Garlic Broccoli
items.core: This home-cooked vegetable is known for its strong garlic aroma and simple seasoning. The broccoli is tender or slightly crispy after blanching, making it light and delicious. Rich in vitamin C, dietary fiber and various antioxidants, it is a nutritionally balanced quick-serve vegetarian dish. The preparation process is not difficult and can be easily mastered by novices. It usually takes about 15 minutes to complete from preparing ingredients to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - 1 broccoli - 3-4 cloves of garlic - light soy sauce - oyster sauce - sugar

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Per portion: - About 200 g broccoli (about 1/2 medium broccoli) - 3-4 cloves garlic - 10 ml light soy sauce - 5 ml oyster sauce - 2 g sugar

Operation: 1. Cut the broccoli into small florets and clean them. 2. Peel the garlic, cut into minced garlic, and set aside. 3. Add 1000 ml drinking water to the pot and bring to a boil over high heat. 4. Add the broccoli and cook over high heat for 2-3 minutes until the broccoli turns green and becomes soft. 5. Take out the cooked broccoli, drain the water, place it on a plate and set aside. 6. Heat the pan and add 10 ml cooking oil. After the oil temperature rises, add minced garlic and stir-fry over low heat until fragrant. 7. Add 10 ml light soy sauce, 5 ml oyster sauce, 2 g sugar, and 30 ml drinking water. 8. Bring the soup in the pot to a boil. 9. Pour the cooked garlic sauce evenly over the broccoli on the plate.

Additional content: - The blanching time should not exceed the recommended time to avoid affecting the taste and nutrition of broccoli. - If you want to keep the crispier texture of broccoli, you can shorten the blanching time.
