Break the broccoli into small uniform florets. Add a little salt and oil when blanching to keep it green, and it will taste more crispy and tender when taken out of cold water.
Put the minced garlic in twice, stir-fry half to enhance the aroma, and add half before taking it out of the pan. The garlic will be more fragrant. If you like spicy food, add millet.
The seasoning is very simple, just add salt and a little oyster sauce, thicken the gravy so that the sauce hangs on the broccoli, the taste is more uniform, light and not greasy.

Case: When I got home from get off work, I wanted to make a quick healthy dish. I broke the broccoli into small florets and blanched them for 2 minutes. Then sautéed the minced garlic in hot oil and quickly stir-fried over high heat. Add a little salt to taste. The dish was out of the pan in 5 minutes. It was green and crispy and tender. The whole family loved it.

items.title: Kabayaki Eggplant
items.core: Kabayaki Eggplant is a home-cooked dish that is salty and sweet, with a soft and glutinous texture. It borrows the flavor of Japanese Kabayaki but uses Chinese frying techniques. Eggplant is rich in dietary fiber and multiple vitamins, which help clear away heat and activate blood circulation. The difficulty is moderate and requires a little patience for novices. The estimated production time is about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Eggplant - Kabayaki juice - Honey - White sugar - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Cooking wine - Water

Calculation: - Determine different amounts of oil according to the type of pot - Non-stick pan: The oil should be spread over the area of the eggplant after it is gathered into drops - Iron pan: After spreading, the oil can just cover the bottom of the pot - 1 long eggplant with a small top and a large bottom (be careful not to use Zhejiang eggplants and round eggplants) - 1 Bun kabayaki sauce - 20 ml honey - 15 ml white sugar - 40 ml light soy sauce - 10 ml dark soy sauce - 20 ml cooking wine - 100 ml water

Operation: 1. Peel the eggplant and cut it into two sections crosswise 2. Steam for 5 minutes 3. Cut it lengthwise, do not cut it, and score 2~3 knives on both sides until it can be flattened 4. Fry until both sides are golden. 5. Pour the kabayaki sauce over the eggplant until it covers 1/2 of the eggplant height. 6. Fry until the back is colored and turn over - at the same time, the juice is reduced. If the juice cannot be reduced, you can add water starch (the ratio of cornstarch to water is 1:4 to 1:10, depending on the juice collection) 7. Pour the remaining kabayaki sauce over the eggplant. 8. Take it out of the pan, and a portion of the eggplant kabayaki sauce is ready

Additional content: - This Kabayaki is actually very Chinese, and Japanese-style Kabayaki is actually grilled. -The soul actually lies in kabayaki juice? You can also buy ready-made kabayaki sauce. - If you feel tired, you can sprinkle some green onions cut into 2~5 mm after putting it on the plate. The color combination will also be less monotonous. - Fried eggplant (fish-flavored eggplant, stir-fried eggplant with soy sauce). Wall crack recommends Zhejiang eggplant. It is long and slender, so it is just right to cut into hob pieces. The skin is very tender and does not need to be peeled here. The eggplant has a moderate taste.

Cut the eggplants into strips, sprinkle them with salt to kill the water, squeeze them dry and then fry or fry them. This can reduce the amount of oil absorbed, make them soft and not greasy, and save cooking time.
Mix 2 spoons of light soy sauce, half a spoon of dark soy sauce, 1 spoon of mirin and 1 spoon of sugar. Boil it until it is thick and tastes salty and sweet.

Pour the fried eggplant into the sauce and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes to allow the eggplant to fully absorb the flavor. Remove from the pan and sprinkle with white sesame seeds and chopped green onion to enhance the flavor.

Case study: I ​​tried to make Kabayaki eggplant on the weekend. Cut the long eggplant into strips and deep-fry until soft. Then pour the Kabayaki sauce mixed with soy sauce, mirin and sugar, and sprinkle with white sesame seeds. It is salty, sweet and soft. I ate two bowls of it with rice. My friends all praised the craftsmanship.

items.title: Tiger green pepper
items.core: Tiger green pepper is a home-cooked side dish. The skin is slightly charred and wrinkled, the texture is soft and crispy, and the salty and sour taste is very appetizing. Green peppers are rich in vitamin C and dietary fiber, which help strengthen immunity and improve digestion. The production process is simple and straightforward. You only need to master the pressing and heat. It is also friendly to novices and can usually be completed in about 15 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Green peppers - Garlic - White sugar (soul) - Vinegar - Light soy sauce - Salt - Pot or a bowl with a certain depth
Calculation: per serving: - 5 green peppers, 10-15cm in length is most suitable - 2-3 cloves of garlic - Oil 20ml - White sugar 15g - Light soy sauce 15ml - Balsamic vinegar 15ml - Salt 4g

Operation: 1. Remove the green pepper stalks and rinse them with tap water. 2. Cut the green pepper into long slices. On average, cut one green pepper into 3-4 slices lengthwise. 3. Peel the garlic and chop into fine pieces, with a volume of 2mm x 2mm x 2mm. 4. Seasoning 1: Take a small bowl, pour 20ml of oil, and put the minced garlic into it. 5. Seasoning 2: Pour sugar, light soy sauce, vinegar, and salt into a bowl (bowl) and stir. 6. Pour seasoning 1 into the pot, heat until 50%, add green peppers, do not stack the green pepper slices, place them in separate slices in the pot. 7. Use a spatula to keep pressing the green peppers, and turn them over when appropriate. 8. Stir-fry for about 2 minutes. When the skin of the green pepper becomes wrinkled, add seasoning 2. 9. Increase the heat and continue to stir-fry for 30 seconds, then remove from the pan and place on a plate.
Additional Content

Choose thin-skinned green peppers and press them with a spatula until the skin wrinkles. This will make it easier to absorb the flavor. The taste will be soft and crispy, and the green peppers will not become soft and rotten easily.
When frying green peppers, use medium-low heat and keep turning and pressing until the skin is slightly charred and wrinkled, so that the tiger skin lines are more obvious.
Use light soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, a little sugar and salt for seasoning. Pour a little water starch before serving. The sauce will be wrapped on the green pepper for more flavor.

Case study: I ​​wanted to have appetizers for dinner, so I washed and dried thin-skinned green peppers, fried them without oil until the skin became wrinkled, added minced garlic, light soy sauce and balsamic vinegar and stir-fried, then cooked it with hot and sour rice. It was done in ten minutes, and my husband said it was so satisfying.

items.id: 蚝油三鲜菇-蚝油三鲜菇
items.title: Three Fresh Mushrooms in Oyster Sauce
items.core: Three Fresh Mushrooms in Oyster Sauce is a delicious and tender home-cooked quick dish. The mushrooms soak up the oyster sauce and have a soft, chewy texture with a slight spiciness, refreshing and not greasy. Rich in plant protein, dietary fiber and multiple vitamins, it is nutritionally balanced with broccoli. It is simple to make and can be easily mastered by novices. It only takes about 15 minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Shiitake mushrooms * Crab-flavored mushrooms * White jade mushrooms * Chili millet * Vegetable pepper * Edible oil * Salt * Cooking wine * Starch * Light soy sauce * Chicken essence * Chives * Minced ginger * Oyster sauce * Broccoli

Calculation: Per portion: * 2 fresh shiitake mushrooms * Crab-flavored mushrooms 30 g * White jade mushrooms 30 g * 1 spicy millet * 0.5 vegetable peppers * 10 ml edible oil * 5 g edible salt * 2 ml cooking wine * 10 g starch * 10 ml light soy sauce * 3 g chicken essence * 0.5 chives * 1 minced ginger * 5 ml oyster sauce * 350 ml boiling water * 100 g broccoli

Operation: 1. For crab-flavored mushrooms and white jade mushrooms, remove the dirt from the roots and break up the mushroom buds. 2. Slice the mushrooms (each slice is 0.5-1 cm thick, thicker ones are chewier than thinner ones). 3. Pour the cornstarch into a small bowl, add 50ml of water, and stir the cornstarch until it melts without particles (i.e., water starch). Set aside. 4. Boil water, add broccoli, boil for 3 minutes, put it in a bowl and set aside. 5. Wash the pot and boil water, add 5 g. Add edible salt, add crab-flavored mushrooms, white jade mushrooms, and shiitake mushrooms, and cook for 1 minute. 6. After 1 minute, remove and drain the water. 7. Heat oil in a pan. When the oil starts to bubble, add minced ginger, spicy millet, and green pepper. Stir-fry for 30 seconds. 8. Pour in the three fresh mushrooms, then pour in light soy sauce, oyster sauce, and chicken essence. Stir evenly, then pour in water starch. 9. Dry the juice over medium heat, add cooking wine, and chopped green onion. Remove from the pan 10. Arrange broccoli
Additional Content
The three types of mushrooms are processed separately, slicing mushrooms, cutting shiitake mushrooms, and tearing king oyster mushrooms into strips. The taste is richer and easier to savor.

Dry and stir-fry the mushrooms first to remove the water and then add oil, which can stimulate the umami flavor. The stir-fried vegetables will not be watery and the oyster sauce will have a richer aroma.
Put the oyster sauce last to avoid losing the flavor by frying at high temperature for a long time. Add a little sugar to enhance the flavor. If you like spicy food, add millet spicy rings.

Case: I have guests at home who want to cook quickly. I blanch mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms and king oyster mushrooms in slices, saute minced garlic until fragrant, add mushrooms and stir-fry, add oyster sauce and a little spicy food, and cook it in 15 minutes. It is fragrant and tender, and the guests eat them all.

items.title: Oyster Sauce Lettuce
items.core: Oyster Sauce Lettuce is a refreshing and fragrant home-cooked dish. Crisp and tender lettuce is topped with garlic oyster sauce. It is salty and sweet. It is a quick vegetarian dish that is common in Cantonese and Sichuan restaurants. Rich in vitamins and dietary fiber, it helps promote digestion. The recipe is very beginner-friendly, and it only takes about 15 minutes to complete from washing the vegetables to taking it out of the pot.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Lettuce - Oyster sauce - Garlic - Light soy sauce - Salt - Sugar - Edible oil

Calculation: The portion of this dish is the same as the standard portion ordered in a Sichuan restaurant - 1 head of lettuce (200 g ± 50) - 6-8 ml of oyster sauce - 4-5 cloves of garlic (made into minced garlic or minced) - 6 ml of light soy sauce - Salt 0.5 g - white sugar 1 g - edible oil 5-8 ml

Operation: 1. Wash the lettuce and remove the rotten leaves. 2. Heat the pot, first put 1 L of clean water (cool), then add 2 ml - 3 ml cooking oil and 0.5 g of salt into the pot, and wait for the water in the pot to boil. 3. After the water boils, add lettuce and blanch each lettuce leaf for 10 seconds. 4. Remove the lettuce, drain it, and arrange on a plate. 5. Make the sauce: Put 10 ml of light soy sauce, 6-8 ml of oyster sauce, 0.5 g of salt, and 1 g of sugar into a bowl and mix thoroughly, then add 10-15 ml of water (cool) and stir evenly. 6. Turn the heat back on, heat the pan, add 5-8 ml of cooking oil, add minced garlic when the oil is hot. 7. Wait until the aroma of garlic comes out, pour in the prepared juice, bring to a boil, and turn off the heat immediately. 8. Pour the soup from the pot evenly over the lettuce.
Additional content: This dish is rich in vitamins, simple to make, delicious and not irritating.

Blank the whole lettuce and put it on the plate, or break it into slices and blanch them one by one. Blanch them for 10 seconds and then remove them. This will keep the crisp and tender texture and avoid becoming soft and yellow.
Saute the oyster sauce with minced garlic until fragrant, add light soy sauce, a little sugar and water starch and simmer until thick, pour it on the lettuce and taste even and not bland.
Adding salt and a few drops of oil to the water for blanching lettuce can keep the lettuce green and look more beautiful when placed on the plate with the stems facing out.

Case: During the fat loss period, I was craving for something flavorful. After blanching the lettuce, I added minced garlic, oyster sauce, light soy sauce and water starch to the sauce. It was refreshing, crispy, tender and low in calories. It took five minutes to cook and I didn’t get tired of it even after eating it for a week.

items.title: Fried Eggs with Tomatoes
items.core: A sweet and sour home-cooked dish, with tender eggs wrapped in soft and juicy tomatoes. It is a classic taste on Chinese family tables. Eggs provide high-quality protein, and tomatoes are rich in vitamin C and lycopene, which are nutritionally balanced and easy to absorb. The steps are simple and the raw materials are easily available. It is especially suitable for beginners in the kitchen. It only takes about 15 minutes from preparation to plating.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Tomatoes * Eggs * Edible oil * Salt * Sugar (optional) * Chopped green onions (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person Total amount: Tomato = 1 (about 180g) Number of servings Eggs = 1.5 servings, round up Edible oil = 4ml Egg/piece Salt = 1.5-2g servings Sugar = 0-2g servings Chopped green onions = 0-10g servings

Operation: 1. Wash the tomatoes 2. Optional: Remove the outer skin of the tomatoes - Blanch the skin with boiling water, then put the tomatoes into cold water and peel off the skin. 3. Remove the stems of the tomatoes and cut them into small pieces with a side length of no more than 4cm, which are tomato pieces. 4. Break the eggs into a bowl, add 1g * parts of salt, stir well, and it is the egg liquid - you can consider adding 1ml vinegar to the eggs, which can remove the fishy smell and make the eggs more fluffy. 5. Heat the pan and add cooking oil 6. After the oil is hot, pour in Egg liquid. Stir-fry until the eggs become solid and slightly yellow in color, which is called half-boiled eggs. 7. Turn off the heat. Put the half-boiled eggs on a plate and turn on the heat again - Note: Do not wash the pot. 8. Add the tomato pieces, beat with a spatula and stir-fry for 20 seconds, or until the tomatoes are soft. 9. Add the half-boiled eggs to the pot, stir-fry evenly - You can consider adding 10ml tomato sauce and 50ml water to increase the soup - You can add some other cooked meat and ingredients 10. Add the remaining salt, sugar (optional, if you prefer a sweet version), chopped green onion (optional), stir-fry evenly 11. Turn off the heat, serve on a plate

Additional content: There are many versions of this dish according to different taste preferences, including but not limited to: * Quick method: - Add tomato cubes directly to the pot with half-boiled eggs, and stir-fry with the eggs until the tomatoes are soft - continue to step 10 * Add salt and change to "Add two drops of light soy sauce"
Add a little salt and warm water to beat the eggs, add hot oil to the pan and quickly spread them, stir-fry until solid and serve out, so that the eggs are tender and not stale.
Peel the tops of the tomatoes by criss-crossing them, cut them into small pieces and stir-fry to make the sauce. Add a little sugar to neutralize the sourness and make the soup richer.
After returning the eggs to the pot, stir-fry quickly to coat the egg pieces with tomato juice. Add a little chopped green onion to enhance the flavor. Taste to adjust the saltiness before serving.

Case: It was the first time I cooked for my parents. I broke up 3 eggs and fried them until they were solid. Then I fried the tomatoes until they were soft and the juice came out. I stir-fried the eggs again and added salt and sugar to taste. It was sour, sweet and tender. My parents said it tasted better than a restaurant.

items.id: 西红柿豆腐汤羹-西红柿豆腐汤羹
items.title: Tomato and Tofu Soup
items.core: A light and delicious home-cooked soup, sweet and sour, appetizing, and tender in texture. Tomatoes are rich in vitamin C and lycopene. When paired with eggs and tofu, they can supplement high-quality protein and have balanced nutrition that is easy to absorb. The recipe is simple, just add, stir-fry and cook, and it can be easily mastered by novices. It can be completed in about 15 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: * Tomatoes * Eggs * Tofu * Edible oil * Salt * Starch * Chicken essence * Chives * Ginger * Boiled water
Calculation: Per portion: * 1 tomato * 1 egg * 100 g tofu * 5 ml cooking oil * 2 g salt * Starch 5 g * Chicken essence 2 g * 0.5 chives * 1 slice of ginger * Boiling water 350 ml

Operation: 1. Cut the tomatoes into small cubes, stir the eggs into a bowl, and cut the tofu into cubes and set aside. 2. Heat oil in a pot, add ginger slices for 5 seconds, then add tomatoes and stir-fry for 30 seconds. 3. Add boiling water to the pot, bring the soup to a boil, add egg liquid and tofu cubes after 60 seconds. 4. After the soup boils again, add water starch and stir 2 times in one direction. 5. Add chicken essence, salt and chives, and cook after 30 seconds
Additional Content

Peel the tomatoes and cut them into small pieces, fry them in red oil and add water. The soup will be bright red and taste more intense. Add a little tomato sauce to enhance the sweetness and sourness.
Blanching the soft tofu into cubes for 30 seconds can remove the beany smell, make it less brittle when cooked, and make it more tender and smooth.
The egg liquid should be poured in slowly and stirred gently to form beautiful egg droplets. Finally, add white pepper powder to enhance the freshness and sprinkle with chopped green onion for color.

Case: The season is dry and I want something light. I fry soft tomatoes and add water to boil, add soft tofu cubes and beaten egg liquid, sprinkle with salt and white pepper, and prepare a pot in 15 minutes. It is sweet and sour, tender and smooth, warm to the stomach and comfortable.

items.id: 西葫芦炒鸡蛋-西葫芦炒鸡蛋
items.title: Zucchini Scrambled Eggs
items.core: Zucchini Scrambled Eggs is a refreshing and delicious home-cooked quick dish. The zucchini is soft and juicy, and the eggs are fragrant and fluffy. Adding tomatoes adds a sweet and sour flavor, making it a perfect meal. Eggs provide high-quality protein and lecithin, and zucchini is rich in vitamin C and dietary fiber, making it a nutritionally balanced combination. The preparation process is simple and very friendly to novices. From preparation to cooking, it only takes 15 minutes for beginners to complete it.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Zucchini - Eggs - Tomatoes (optional) - Edible salt - Edible oil
Calculation: According to the serving size for 2 people: - Zucchini 500g - Tomatoes 100g - 3 eggs - Edible oil 10-20ml - Edible salt 6g

Operation: 1. Wash the tomatoes, cut into small pieces, and set aside 2. Wash the zucchini and cut it into approximately 4cm rhombus, set aside. 3. Crack three eggs into a bowl, beat well, set aside. 4. Heat a pan, put 5ml - 10ml cooking oil in the pan. 5. Pour in the eggs, keep stirring until the eggs become solid, break them into small pieces with a spatula, and put them into a bowl, set aside. 6. Put 5ml - 10ml cooking oil in the pan, pour in the tomatoes, stir-fry until soft. 7. Pour in the zucchini and stir-fry evenly, add 6g salt, turn down the heat and wait for 4 - 5 minutes 8. Pour in the reserved eggs, stir-fry over medium heat for 15 seconds 9. Turn off the heat and serve on a plate
Additional Content
Cut zucchini into thin slices or rhombus-shaped slices. If it is too thick, it will not be cooked easily. It will produce water when fried. Thin slices are more tender and easier to taste.
Fry the eggs first, stir-fry the zucchini until soft, and then return to the pot to avoid overcooking the eggs and maintain a tender and smooth taste.
Add a few tomato pieces to increase the sweetness and sourness and make the color of the dish more beautiful. Add salt and minced garlic to enhance the flavor before serving.

Case study: There were only zucchini and eggs left in the refrigerator. I sliced ​​them and fried them until soft, then added the scrambled eggs, added some tomato cubes to enhance the flavor, and cooked it in 15 minutes. It was a refreshing meal, and I could eat two at a time with steamed buns. It was simple and satisfying.

items.id: 话梅煮毛豆-话梅煮毛豆
items.title: Boiled edamame with plums
items.core: Boiled edamame with plums is a sweet and sour appetizing home-cooked dish with a refreshing and soft texture, with the natural fruity aroma of plums. Edamame is rich in plant protein and dietary fiber, which helps replenish energy and promote digestion. The method is very simple, even for novices, and it only takes 35 to 45 minutes to complete.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Edamame * Plum * Edible salt
Calculation: per serving: * 300 g edamame * 6 plums * 2 g edible salt
Operation: 1. Add edible salt to water, soak edamame for 15 minutes 2. Add boiling water, pour in edamame and plum, cook for 20-30 minutes 3. Remove from pot and start eating
Additional Content
Cut off both ends of edamame to make it easier to absorb the flavor. Do not cover the pot when cooking to maintain the emerald green color and refreshing taste.
Choose nine-made Hua Mei, which makes the sweetness and sourness stronger. Add a little rock sugar to balance the taste. The soup can be used repeatedly.
After cooking, continue to simmer for 1 hour to allow the edamame to fully absorb the flavor. Remove it from cold water or chill it on ice for a crisper and more tender texture.

Case: I have no appetite in summer, so when I cook edamame, I add prunes, star anise, dried chili peppers and salt, cook for 20 minutes, turn off the heat and simmer for 1 hour, take it out and eat it after cooling.

items.title: Hot and Sour Potato Shreds
items.core: A classic home-cooked dish that is spicy and sour. It has a crisp texture and bright color. It is a quick stir-fry that everyone loves. Potatoes provide carbohydrates and potassium, and peppers are rich in vitamin C, which helps increase appetite. The operation steps are simple and clear, very friendly to novices, and it only takes about 20 minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: - Potatoes - Garlic - Green peppers - Red peppers - Dried peppers - Green onions - Light soy sauce - Aged vinegar - Salt

Calculation: Per portion: - 240g potatoes (the thinner, the longer, the better) - 4 cloves of garlic - 0.5 green peppers - 0.5 red peppers - 3 dried peppers - 1 green onion - 5ml light soy sauce - 10ml mature vinegar - Salt 2g - Edible oil 10-15ml

Operation: 1. Peel and shred potatoes (or use a grater). 2. Wash the cut potato shreds with water to remove excess starch, and then blanch the potato shreds for 10 seconds. Drain and set aside. 3. Cut the green onions into chopped green onions; crush the garlic and mince it (divide it into two equal parts for later use); cut the dried chili peppers into small sections; cut the green and red chili peppers into shreds. 4. Heat oil in a pan over low heat, add half of the chopped green onions (white part), half of the minced garlic and dried chili peppers and sauté until fragrant. 5. Add green and red peppers and stir-fry for a few times. Add shredded potatoes and stir-fry until they change color. 6. Add 5ml light soy sauce, 10ml mature vinegar, pour in the remaining half of the minced garlic and 2g salt and stir-fry quickly evenly. 7. Sprinkle the remaining chopped green onions before serving, stir well and serve on a plate.

Additional content: - Be sure to remove the potato starch when cleaning, otherwise it will all stick together - Add minced garlic and salt and remove from the pot as soon as possible to retain the aroma of garlic and avoid damaging the taste.
Cut the potatoes into thin slices and rinse them twice with water. Soak them in water for 10 minutes to remove the starch. The potatoes will become crispier and non-stick when fried.

Hot a pan with cold oil and sauté the Sichuan peppercorns and dried chilies until fragrant. Remove the Sichuan peppercorns and leave the base oil, so that the spiciness is pure without being overtaken by the numbing taste.

Pour white vinegar along the edge of the pot to make the sour taste more fragrant. Add a little sugar to enhance the freshness. Stir-fry quickly on high heat for 2 minutes and then remove from the pot to maintain crispiness.

Case: After learning how to make hot and sour potato shreds three times, I finally mastered the technique: cut into shreds and soak in water to remove starch, sauté dried Sichuan peppercorns in hot oil, stir-fry over high heat for 2 minutes, add white vinegar and salt, the dish is crispy and sour, and my husband ate a plate.

items.title: Japanese Tofu Pot with Enoki Mushrooms
items.core: Japanese Tofu Pot with Enoki Mushrooms is a home-cooked dish with a rich sauce. The tofu is charred on the outside and tender on the inside, and the enoki mushrooms are smooth and delicious. Enoki mushrooms are rich in amino acids and dietary fiber, and Japanese tofu provides high-quality protein and is nutritious and appetizing. This recipe is simple enough for novices to master, and it takes about 30 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: - Enoki mushrooms - Japanese tofu (tamagotofu) - Millet peppers - Light soy sauce - Oyster sauce - Salt - Sugar - Cooking oil

Calculation: per serving: - 1-2 handfuls of Enoki mushrooms - 2 bags of tofu - 3-5 millet peppers, minced - 2-3 cloves of garlic - 15ml of light soy sauce - 5ml of oyster sauce - Dark soy sauce 3ml - Sugar 3g - Edible oil 10-15ml

Operation: 1. Slice the tofu and fry over low heat until golden brown on both sides. Set aside. 2. Cut the garlic into minced garlic; mix light soy sauce, oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar and 100ml water and set aside. 3. Heat oil in a pan. When the oil is hot, add millet pepper and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add enoki mushrooms first and stir-fry until soft. Spread the fried tofu on the enoki mushrooms, pour in the sauce prepared in #2, and simmer for 5 minutes until the juice is reduced.
Additional content: - The enoki mushrooms must be fried until soft - Try not to stir-fry the tofu, as it is easy to break

Japanese tofu is cut into sections, wrapped in a thin layer of starch, and fried until golden brown on both sides. This way, it will not break easily when stewed, and it will taste charred on the outside and tender on the inside.
Dry the enoki mushrooms first and stir-fry out the water, then spread them on the bottom of the casserole, which can absorb the soup without letting the tofu soak in the water to affect the taste.

For seasoning, use oyster sauce, light soy sauce, a little sugar and water starch, simmer for 3 minutes to let the tofu absorb the flavor, and sprinkle with chopped green onion to add flavor and color.

Case study: It’s cold and I want to eat something hot. I cut the Japanese tofu into sections and fry them until golden brown. I fried the enoki mushrooms until soft and put them on the bottom. I added the tofu and oyster sauce and simmered for 3 minutes. Then I sprinkled with chopped green onion and served it with rice. The sauce was rich and fragrant. One pot was not enough for the whole family.

items.title: Qianqian Egg
items.core: Qianqian Egg is a Hunan-style home-cooked dish that is crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, salty and slightly spicy. The egg slices fried until golden are shaped like copper coins, which means good luck. Paired with green and red peppers, eggs are rich in high-quality protein and multiple vitamins and have balanced nutrition. The difficulty of preparation is medium, and novices can master it with a little practice. The whole process takes about 30 minutes to complete the meal.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggs - Chili peppers - Chili millet - Bean paste - Garlic - Spring onions - Corn starch (optional) - Edible oil - Light soy sauce - Oyster sauce - Sugar

Calculation: You need to determine how many servings you plan to make before each production. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each portion: - 5 eggs - 40 g corn starch - 20-35 ml cooking oil - 15 g chili pepper - 6-15 g spicy millet (about 2-5 pieces) - 15 ml bean paste - 10 g garlic (about 2-3 cloves) - 3 g green onion (about 1-2 stalks) - 15 ml light soy sauce - 15 oyster sauce ml - sugar 5 g

Operation: 1. Put the eggs in a pot with cold water, bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low heat and simmer for 8 minutes. 2. Rinse with tap water to facilitate peeling. 3. Mince the garlic (the particle size is no more than 1 mm), and cut the pepper and millet into small pieces (about 2-3 mm). 4. Cut each cooked egg into 4 parts of similar size along the short axis. 5. If you plan to dip the eggs into starch, coat each egg with starch and shake off the excess starch. 6. Put 25 ml of oil in the pot (if it does not stick to starch, add 20 ml), add the cooked egg slices. 7. Fry until slightly brown, add 10 ml of oil (if it does not stick to starch, add 10 ml), and turn over. 8. When the second side is slightly brown, add chili pepper, millet chili, and minced garlic and fry for about a minute, then flip over. 9. Then add bean paste and fry for a few dozen seconds, and flip over. 10. Mix light soy sauce, oil and sugar into juice, stir the pot gently and it is ready to serve

Additional content: - For the original recipe, it is recommended to add 15 g, if you can't eat spicy food, reduce it to 6 g, and you can also remove the pepper seeds - It is recommended to use a non-stick pan. When using a non-stick pan, you can reduce the oil by 5 ml for the first time - Make sure that the eggs have completely solidified when peeling - Do not over stir-fry, as it will fall apart easily - References: [Step map] Hunan Cuisine Restaurant-How to make golden eggs_Hunan Cuisine Restaurant-How to make golden eggs_Home cooking_Kitchen

The eggs are boiled and allowed to cool, then sliced, wrapped in a thin layer of starch and then fried to prevent them from falling apart. The surface is golden and crispy, and the shape is exactly like a copper coin.

Put out the fried egg slices first, sauté the minced garlic and green and red pepper, then return to the pan and stir-fry, so that the egg slices will not be broken into pieces and the taste will be better.
Use light soy sauce, a little bean paste and sugar for seasoning. It is salty and slightly spicy. Drizzle a little sesame oil before serving and sprinkle with chopped green onion for color and aroma.

Case study: I ​​watched the video and learned how to make money eggs. Slices of hard-boiled eggs are fried until golden, stir-fried with green and red peppers and minced garlic, and seasoned with light soy sauce and bean paste. It is salty and slightly spicy.

items.title: Northern Shaanxi Bean Stew
items.core: This is a northwest farmhouse-style stew, with soft beans, glutinous potato paste, rich tomato soup, and appetizing sourness. Rich in dietary fiber, vitamins and carbohydrates, nutritionally balanced. The method is extremely simple, the amount of ingredients can be adjusted according to preference, there is almost no possibility of failure, and it is especially friendly to novices. From preparation to serving, it only takes about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Beans - Potatoes - Tomatoes - Spicy peppers (optional) - Salt - Light soy sauce - Five-spice powder - Oyster sauce - Green onion - Ginger - Garlic

Calculation: Note that due to individual ingredients, this recipe is for 2 people - 300g of green beans * 2 people - 1 potato * 2 people - 1 tomato * 2 people - Screw pepper (optional) 2 pieces * 2 people - Salt 6g * 2 people - Light soy sauce 6ml * 2 people - Five-spice powder 3g * 2 people - Oyster sauce 6ml * 2 people - 3 rings of green onion - 2g ginger - 2 garlic - Chopped coriander (optional) Add according to taste

Operation: 1. Cut green onion into flowers, mince garlic, shred ginger, and set aside. 2. Remove gluten from the beans, cut into 2-10cm pieces, and set aside. 3. Peel the potatoes, cut into 1cm³ pieces, and set aside. 4. Peel the tomatoes, cut into 1cm³ pieces, and set aside. 5. Remove the peppers and cut into 0.15cm wide strips. Set aside. 6. Heat oil (10ml - 15ml) in a pot, add onion, ginger and garlic when it starts to smoke, and stir-fry until you can smell the aroma of onion, ginger and garlic; 7. Add beans and stir-fry until they change color (green turns to emerald green); 8. Add potato cubes and stir-fry for 30 seconds; 9. Add hot water (the water just covers the vegetables), cover the pot and simmer until the potatoes are soft (you can use chopsticks to confirm); 10. Add tomato cubes, salt, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, five-spice powder, and chili pepper, and simmer until the tomatoes turn into juice (be careful to stir to avoid sticking to the pot); 11. Add chopped coriander and remove from the pot.
Additional content:- After adding tomatoes and continuing to cook, you need to stir occasionally to prevent the bottom from burning
It is recommended to use fresh and tender beans, remove the gluten and cut them into sections. This will make the beans softer and more flavorful after stewing.
Cut potatoes into hob-sized pieces, similar in size to beans. They are heated evenly during stewing and can maintain a chewy texture without falling into pieces.
You can stir-fry the tomatoes first and then add water to make the soup richer. Finally, add salt to taste. It will be sour and appetizing.

Case: Xiao Li, a newbie in the kitchen, tried boiling beans from northern Shaanxi for the first time. He cut the potatoes and beans and put them into a pot to stew. In less than half an hour, a home-cooked dish with rich soup and soft beans was ready. His family praised it for its authentic taste.

items.title: Thunder pepper preserved eggs
items.core: Thunder pepper preserved egg is a home-cooked cold dish that is simple in appearance but full of flavor. The burnt aroma of green pepper blends with the smoothness of preserved egg. It is sour and spicy and appetizing, especially suitable for summer meals. Preserved eggs are rich in protein and minerals, green peppers provide a rich source of vitamin C, and garlic helps increase appetite. The whole dish is simple to make, even for novices, and it only takes about 15 minutes from preparation to completion.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Preserved eggs - Long green peppers (some are called string peppers, replaced by "green peppers" later) - Onions - Garlic - Spicy millet (optional) - Edible oil - Light soy sauce - Aged vinegar - White sugar - Sesame oil - A small, deeper iron basin

Calculation: per serving: - 2 preserved eggs - 4 green peppers (10-15cm long, 2-4cm wide) - Onions (about 10cm is enough, green ones are best) - 3-4 cloves of garlic - 10-20ml of cooking oil - 15-20ml of light soy sauce - 15-20ml of mature vinegar - 6-10g of sugar - 5-7ml of sesame oil - 3-4 pieces of spicy millet

Operation: 1. Wash the green peppers, remove the roots, cut the sides, remove the inner seeds and flatten them on the chopping board, set aside (be sure to remove the green pepper seeds, otherwise they will explode in the pot) 2. Cut the onions into half-centimeter pieces, set aside 3. Peel the garlic, mince, set aside 4. Peel the preserved eggs, set aside 5. Spicy millet, cut into 5-10mm pieces, set aside 6. Heat the pot, put 10ml - 20ml cooking oil in the pot 7. Add all the green peppers, reduce the heat to low to maintain the temperature of the pot, and fry until the green peppers become soft (you can try it with chopsticks, it will be translucent when inserted) 8. Turn off the heat, put the preserved eggs and green peppers into a small iron basin 9. Method 1: If you have a rolling pin and smashing things will not disturb the neighbors: use the end of the rolling pin to smash the preserved eggs and green peppers in the small basin until the preserved eggs and green peppers are mixed (optional) 10. Method 2: Tear the green peppers with your hands into strips of about half a centimeter, and crush the preserved eggs with a fork (optional) 11. Spicy millet 12. Pour in light soy sauce, mature vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, and other unused spare ingredients 13. Stir evenly
Additional Content
Roast green peppers on a gas stove over an open flame until the skin is charred, which can stimulate the charred aroma. After roasting, simmer for a while to make peeling easier.
When cutting preserved eggs into slices, dip them in a little white vinegar or cold water. The knife surface will not stick easily and the cuts will be neat and beautiful.
When seasoning, first add light soy sauce, balsamic vinegar and sugar, and finally pour hot oil to stimulate the aroma of minced garlic, making the flavor richer.

Case: Ms. Wang, who has a poor appetite in summer, spent 15 minutes making thunder pepper preserved eggs. She tore up the charred green peppers into pieces and mixed them with the preserved eggs. The spicy and sour taste made her eat two bowls of rice in a row, and her family members were full of praise.

items.title: Fried eggs with chives
items.core: Scrambled eggs with chives is a classic home-cooked dish. The leeks are rich in aroma, the eggs are tender and delicious, simple and easy to make, and rich in nutrients. Leeks are rich in vitamins and fiber, and eggs provide high-quality protein. This dish is simple to make and the raw materials are easily available. It is especially suitable for beginners in the kitchen. It only takes about 10 minutes to prepare the dish from scratch and put it on the plate.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Chives * Eggs * Edible oil * Salt

Calculation: You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. One portion is just enough for 1 person. Total amount: Leek = 100g portion Egg = 2 portions Edible oil = 10ml portion Salt = 2g portion

Operation: 1. Wash the leeks and drain the water 2. Cut the leeks into small sections about 3cm long, which are leek segments 3. Break the eggs into a bowl and mix well. Egg liquid 4. Heat the pan and add cooking oil. 5. When the oil is hot, pour in the egg liquid and stir-fry quickly until the eggs solidify into lumps. Take it out and set aside, which is the scrambled eggs. 6. Add 5ml of cooking oil to the pan, add the leek segments and stir-fry quickly for 30 seconds on high heat. 7. Add the scrambled eggs to the pan and stir-fry evenly. 8. Add salt and stir-fry evenly. 9. Turn off the heat and serve on a plate.

Additional content:* Fried eggs with leeks require high heat and fast frying. If leeks are fried for a long time, they will easily lose their aroma and crisp texture. * If you like the leeks to be softer, you can extend the stir-frying time appropriately
Wash the leeks and drain them thoroughly. Cut them into sections and toss them with a little oil to lock in the water. When fried, the soup will not come out and they will be more crispy and tender.
Add a little water or milk to the egg liquid to make it more tender, fluffy and taste better.
First fry the eggs with cold oil in a hot pan until solid, then quickly stir-fry the leeks over high heat, and finally return to the pan to mix to maintain the freshness.

Case: Xiao Chen, a college student, cooks for the first time to make scrambled eggs with chives. He pours the chopped leeks into the scrambled eggs and stir-fry quickly. After 10 minutes, a fragrant dish is served, and his roommates praise his cooking skills.

items.title: Sauteed cucumbers with eggs and ham
items.core: This is a refreshing and quick home-cooked stir-fry, salty and delicious. The cucumbers are crisp and tender, the eggs are soft and smooth, and the ham is fragrant. It is a popular Chinese home-cooked dish. Eggs provide high-quality protein, cucumbers are rich in vitamins and water, ham adds flavor, and the overall nutrition is balanced. The cooking steps are simple and clear, with low difficulty and very friendly to kitchen novices. From preparation to serving, the whole process only takes about 10 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Cucumber - Egg - Ham sausage - Salt - Light soy sauce - Red pepper (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Each serving: - 1 cucumber (about 200g) - 2 eggs - 1 ham sausage (about 40g) - 1 red pepper (optional) - 10ml cooking oil - 3ml light soy sauce - 2g salt

Operation: 1. Wash the cucumber, cut into semi-circular slices, set aside 2. Cut the ham into semi-circular slices, set aside 3. Chop the red pepper (optional), set aside 4. Crack the eggs into a bowl and mix well, which is the egg liquid. 5. Pour 5ml cooking oil into the hot pot. 6. When the oil is hot, turn down the heat, pour in the beaten egg liquid, spread it with chopsticks, and stir-fry until the eggs are solid and slightly yellow in color. This is the half-boiled egg. Dish it out and set aside. 7. Do not wash the pot, pour 5ml cooking oil into the pot, add cucumber slices and stir-fry over high heat for 1 minute. 8. Fry the half-boiled eggs over high heat. Pour into the pot, add 2g salt and 3ml light soy sauce, immediately add ham slices and chopped chili pepper (optional) and stir-fry evenly 9. Turn off the heat and serve on a plate
Additional content: - Ham is salty and needs to be added after seasoning, so that the ham will not be stained with salt
Cut the cucumber into rhombus-shaped slices, sprinkle a little salt with it and let it sit for 5 minutes. It will become crispier and less likely to become watery when fried.
For ham, choose lunch meat or sandwich ham, cut into thin slices and stir-fry to release the fat, which can increase the flavor of the whole dish.
First scramble the eggs and scoop them out, then stir-fry the ham and cucumber, and finally mix and stir-fry to maintain the texture of the ingredients.

Case: Mr. Zhang, an office worker, has a tight lunch time, so he made fried cucumbers with eggs and ham in 10 minutes. The crisp and tender cucumbers are paired with soft eggs and salty ham. It is refreshing and not greasy, making his work meal delicious.

items.title: Microwave egg custard
items.core: Microwave egg custard is a simple and quick home-cooked steamed egg dish with a smooth and delicate texture, especially suitable as a late night snack or a quick snack. Eggs are rich in high-quality protein and multiple vitamins, which can provide the body with necessary nutrients. Shopee also supplements calcium. This dish is very beginner-friendly and requires no mastery of cooking skills. The whole process from beating eggs and seasoning to taking it out of the oven only takes about 10 minutes to complete.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: You can make up to three copies each time. If more than 3 people need it, it will need to be made in multiple batches. - Eggs - Water

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Total quantity: - 2 eggs * servings - 200ml water * servings - 10 dried shrimps * servings (optional) - 5g green onions * servings (optional) - 3g salt * servings - soy sauce (optional) - sesame oil (sesame oil) 1ml (optional)

Operation: 1. Break the eggs into a microwave-safe ceramic bowl and use chopsticks to break them up. 2. Add water and salt and mix well. 3. Put the dried shrimps into a bowl and stir evenly to ensure that all the dried shrimps do not pile up together. 4. Chop the green onion until the side length is 0.6±3mm, put it in a bowl and mix evenly. 5. Put the bowl and contents into the microwave oven, cover the surface of the container with plastic wrap or cover it with a microwaveable porcelain plate (note: it must not be sealed, and expansion and contraction must be allowed) and heat for 2 minutes (500W). 6. Carefully remove plastic wrap or other covering and continue heating for 2 minutes. 7. If the microwave does not have a rotating heating plate, slowly rotate the bowl 180 degrees horizontally to ensure that the contents are heated evenly. 8. Add sesame oil. 9. Carefully remove the bowl from the microwave (it's really hot). 10. If you choose to add soy sauce, make sure that the soy sauce flows on the surface of the egg custard and can cover the surface of the egg custard in the thinnest form. 11. Enjoy egg custard happily

Additional content: - 1 egg is about 50±5g. If using other types of eggs, the amount of water can be increased or decreased proportionally. - Always make sure to break up the eggs or a mild egg explosion may occur. - Eggs and water should not exceed 2/3 of the bowl's capacity, otherwise overflow may occur.
Mix egg liquid and warm water in a ratio of 1:1.5, sieve to filter out the foam, and the steamed custard will be more delicate and honeycomb-free.
Heat in the microwave on medium heat for 2 minutes, pause and stir once, and then continue heating to avoid overcooking and aging.
Cover the bowl with high-temperature plastic wrap or a plate, leaving gaps for ventilation to prevent water vapor from dripping and damaging the surface.

Case: Xiao Liu came home from working overtime late at night and was very hungry. He used the microwave oven for 10 minutes to make a tender and smooth egg custard, adding dried shrimps for freshness.

items.title: Steamer egg custard
items.core: This is a tender, home-made egg custard that is quickly made using a steamer. The taste can be adjusted, with less water making it more elastic, and more water making it tender. Rich in high-quality protein and various nutrients, easy to digest and absorb. It's moderately difficult and can be mastered by novices with a little attention, and it only takes about 15 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Eggs - Edible salt - Edible oil - Light soy sauce (optional) - Steamer
Calculation: According to the serving size for 1 person: - 1 egg - Edible salt 1g - Edible oil 5ml - Light soy sauce / very fresh flavor 6ml (optional seasoning)

Operation: 1. Put an egg into a bowl and beat it 2. Add 1.0-1.5 times the volume of the egg to the bowl 60 Pure water and stir evenly - within the correct range, the less elastic the water, the more tender the water. - Note: beyond the range, the less water will make the taste too elastic, and the more water, the taste will become too thin. 3. Add 1g of edible salt - salt plays an important role in increasing the base flavor and coagulation. 4. Add 5ml of cooking oil. 5. Filter the egg liquid and remove the scum in the egg liquid (optional, the eggs steamed without filtering will have bubbles, which will make it unsightly) 6. Confirm that the water source in the steamer has been replenished enough (if unsure, you can fill the sink) 7. Place the bowl of egg liquid that has been thoroughly mixed evenly into the steamer 8. Adjust to 100 degrees Celsius to steam for 10 minutes 9. Open the steamer (note: steam will spurt out instantly when it is opened, be careful to open it slowly) 10. Take it out of the pot (you can add light soy sauce for seasoning) 11. Enjoy
Additional Content
Adjust the egg-water ratio according to taste preference, 1:1.2 is more elastic, 1:1.5 is more tender, to meet different needs.
Set the temperature of the steamer to 100°C. After the steaming time is up, simmer for 2 minutes before taking it out to avoid collapse due to sudden cooling.
The egg liquid must be sieved twice to remove unbeaten egg white fascia and the finished product will be smoother and more delicate.
A wet cloth can be placed at the bottom of the steaming bowl to heat more evenly and prevent the edges from becoming too old and the center from being undercooked.

Case: Ms. Li, a new mother, used a steamer to make egg custard for her children. After adjusting the ratio of water and eggs, she steamed it for 15 minutes. The resulting egg custard was tender and delicious, and her children liked it very much. It easily solved the breakfast problem.

items.title: Egg Custard
items.core: This dish is a simple and quick home-cooked steamed dish. It tastes as tender and smooth as jelly, salty and delicious. It often appears on dining tables everywhere as breakfast or as a side dish. Eggs provide high-quality protein and lecithin, which are easy to digest and absorb. It is very friendly to novices and can steam a smooth and smooth custard in just a few simple steps. The whole process takes about 15 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Eggs - Edible salt - Sesame oil - Light soy sauce / very fresh flavor - White vinegar (optional) - Vine pepper oil (optional)

Calculation: According to the portion of 1 person: - 2 eggs - Edible salt 3g - Sesame oil (or sesame oil) 2-4ml - Light soy sauce / very fresh flavor 8ml - White vinegar (or cooking wine) 2ml (optional)

Operation: 1. Beat two eggs in a bowl 2. Add 3g of edible salt - salt plays an important role in increasing the base flavor and coagulation 3. Add 2ml white vinegar to remove the fishy smell of eggs (optional) - Adding rice vinegar is also OK, but the color of rice vinegar will make the eggs slightly black - You can also add cooking wine, which also has the effect of removing fishy smell and does not have the sour smell of vinegar 4. Add the volume of eggs to the bowl 1-1.5 times 70 degree purified water, and stir evenly - 1 times water eggs are more elastic, 1.5 times water eggs are more tender 5. Filter the egg liquid and remove the foam in the egg liquid (optional, eggs steamed without filtering will have bubbles which will make them unsightly) 6. Add 300-500ml water to any pot, after the water boils, put it into a bowl containing the egg liquid - Cover the steaming bowl with a lid, invert a grooved iron plate, or use plastic wrap to reduce the entry of water vapor. This is to prevent it from turning into a honeycomb shape. 7. Steaming steps (choose one of two) 1. Steam over medium heat for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, turn off the heat and simmer for 5 minutes. 2. Turn on high heat and steam for 5 minutes. Keep the water in the pot boiling, otherwise the time will be extended. Open the lid every 2 minutes to release water vapor. If you open the lid too late, the custard will easily turn into a honeycomb shape; if you open the lid too early/frequently, the steaming time will take longer. 8. How to tell if it’s done? - Shake the bowl, the custard will no longer be in a liquid state, and will have a jelly-like Q-bomb state before serving. 9. Take it out of the pan 10. Add sesame oil and light soy sauce and enjoy - you can also use cane pepper oil instead of sesame oil to increase the numbing taste

Additional content: The above is the basic steamed egg recipe, which can be derived on this basis. Add ingredients such as ham sausage, meat filling, shrimp skin, etc. to enrich the taste of the egg custard.
Adding a small amount of salt when beating eggs not only adds seasoning, but also helps the egg liquid solidify more evenly.
After the water in the steamer boils, put the egg bowl in, steam over medium heat for 10-12 minutes, turn off the heat and simmer for 3 minutes before uncovering.
After taking it out of the pot, pour a little sesame oil and steamed fish soy sauce, sprinkle with chopped green onion for color and fragrance, simple seasoning is very delicious.

Case: Mother Zhao spends 15 minutes every morning steaming a bowl of egg custard for breakfast for the whole family. The texture is as tender as pudding and is paired with salty and fresh seasonings. The children will not get tired of eating it even for a week. It is nutritious and worry-free.

items.title: Frangipani
items.core: A simple and easy-to-make home-cooked therapeutic soup, it has sweet and salty flavors and a smooth and tender taste. It is a folk throat soothing recipe. It is rich in high-quality protein and lecithin, easy to digest and absorb, and can relieve dry and itchy throat discomfort. It is extremely simple to make, and beginners can get started with just one look. It only takes about 5 minutes from boiling water to completion.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggs - Sugar (optional, to make a sweet taste) - Salt (optional, to make a salty taste) - Blender (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Each portion: - 1 egg (about 50 g after shelling) - 100 - 150 ml boiling water - 5 - 10 g sugar (if making a sweet dish) - 1 - 2 g of salt (if making a salty dish)

Operation: 1. Crack the eggs into a bowl. 2. Use chopsticks or a whisk to beat the egg liquid in one direction until the egg white and egg yolk are completely mixed and uniform in color. (This process takes about 1 - 2 minutes) 3. Add seasonings such as sugar or salt to the egg liquid and mix slightly. 4. Prepare freshly boiled 100°C boiling water. 5. While using chopsticks to quickly stir the egg liquid in the bowl, pour the boiling water into the egg liquid in a thin stream. Make sure the boiling water is thoroughly mixed with the egg mixture. 6. Continue stirring for a while until the egg liquid is completely cooked and a uniform light yellow egg drop is formed.
Additional content: - In order to prevent salmonella that may be contained in raw eggs, it is recommended to use freshly boiled, 100°C boiling water to scald the egg liquid completely in an instant.
After the water boils, turn to low heat, and then slowly pour in the egg liquid, which can form beautiful flocculent egg drops and have a smoother taste.
For the sweet version, add rock sugar or white sugar after the water boils. For the salty version, add salt, sesame oil and chopped green onion. Choose according to your preference.
Add a little water starch to the egg liquid, mix well, and pour it into the pot to form a more stable egg drop that will not easily fall into pieces.

Case: Ms. Chen, who had a cold and dry and itchy throat, made a bowl of sweet egg droplets in 5 minutes. She slowly poured the egg liquid into boiling water to form beautiful egg droplets. After drinking it while it was hot, the throat discomfort was significantly relieved and it was very comfortable.

items.title: Chinese pie
items.core: This pie is slightly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The filling is salty and fragrant. It is a home-style pasta. Rich in carbohydrates and protein, it is even more nutritious when paired with carrots and eggs. The difficulty of making it is medium, and novices need to master the heat, but the steps are clear and easy to master. It takes approximately 1 hour from prep to completion.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Flour (not self-raising flour) * Minced meat * Oil * Salt * Sugar * Cornstarch * Soy sauce * Flavors (such as chicken powder, cumin, salt and pepper, optional) * Garlic * Green onions * Eggs (optional) * Carrots (optional) * Pan * Wok (the same pan can be used instead)

Calculation: Each serving contains: * Flour 200g * Minced meat 50g * Oil 30ml * Salt 3g * Sugar 5g * Cornstarch 10g * Soy sauce 5g * Flavor 3g * 2 cloves of garlic * 1/4 green onion (the leaf part) * Egg (optional, 1) Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials planned to be used.

Operation: Prepare raw materials: 1. Take the minced meat (thawed), add 1/2 of all the above seasonings (oil, salt, sugar, soy sauce, flavorings) and all the cornstarch, stir evenly, and marinate for 30 minutes. 2. Add flour to the bowl, add eggs, add the remaining 1/2 of all the above ingredients, add water equivalent to 1/2 of the flour (making the flour relatively sticky but flowable), and mix well. 3. Cut the garlic into minced garlic. 4. Cut green onions into sections. 5. Finely chop the carrots (it is used as filling, so it is required to be as finely chopped as possible, you can use a random knife) Cooking: 1. Heat the pan with cold oil, and heat the pan with oil. 2. After the oil is hot, add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. 3. Add marinated minced pork and stir-fry until cooked through. 4. Add the minced carrots to the minced meat and stir-fry until the oil turns golden brown (this is to extract the flavor of the carrots). 5. Turn off the heat. Let cool for 2 minutes. 6. Pour the fried minced meat into the raw batter and mix well. 7. Turn the heat back on and grease the pan with base oil. 8. Reduce the heat to low, pour the batter into the pan and spread it evenly. Make sure the thickness is not too high. This can be done by lifting the pan and letting the batter flow over the bottom. 9. When the surface of the cake is still liquid, sprinkle green onion segments. 10. Keep the heat low until the base is set. 11. Flip the cake over and continue cooking over low heat until the other side is set. 12. After that, fry each side for an additional 20 seconds. 13. Turn off the heat and remove from the pot.

Additional content: - After adding the minced meat and carrots to the batter, stir it as evenly as possible to ensure that the flavor spreads throughout the cake. - Minced meat and minced carrots can be replaced with various cooked fillings.
Knead the dough with warm water until smooth and let it rest for more than 30 minutes. The dough will be softer and less likely to shrink when rolled out.
Add beaten eggs and grated carrots to the filling to increase nutrition and taste, and use a little sesame oil to lock in moisture.
While frying, cook over low heat for 2 minutes, then turn over. The outside will be golden and the inside will be cooked without being cooked.

Case: Xiao Zhou, who was resting at home on the weekend, tried to make Chinese pie. He mixed the dough with the stuffing and rolled it into a pie dough. He fried it in a pan over low heat until both sides were golden brown. The outside was crispy and the filling was delicious. His family thought he bought it.

items.title: Jiang Noodles
items.core: Jiang Noodles is a traditional snack originating from Sichuan. It has a cool and smooth taste, sour and spicy appetizer, and is very suitable for cooling off in summer. The main raw material is pea starch, which is rich in carbohydrates and can quickly replenish energy for the body. The production process is not complicated, but it requires patient stirring and long-term refrigeration to set the shape. It is moderately difficult for novices. It takes about 3-4 hours from cooking to completion, most of which is waiting for refrigeration, and only about half an hour of hands-on time.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Pea starch - Garlic - Chili millet - Chili powder - Soy sauce - Vinegar - Sugar - Chicken essence - Salt - Crushed peanuts - Coriander

Calculation: The following materials are for one person. You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. One serving is just enough for one person. - 100g pea starch - 3 cloves garlic - 3 chili millet - 10g chili powder - 10ml soy sauce - 10ml vinegar - 3ml sugar - 3g chicken essence - 3g salt - 5g chopped peanuts - 5g coriander

Operation: 1. Prepare the ingredients. 2. Mix 100 grams each of pea starch and water. 3. Pour 600g of water into the pot, bring to a boil over high heat and then reduce to low heat. 4. Pour in the starch water, stirring continuously while pouring, until thick and uniform in color. 5. Find a container and brush a thin layer of cooking oil into the container. 6. Pour the cooked starch into a container and refrigerate for 2-4 hours. 7. After refrigeration, take out, unmold and cut into strips. 8. Chop garlic and millet into fine powder, add 10g chili powder, 5g crushed peanuts, heat oil and stir evenly. 9. Add 10ml soy sauce, 10ml vinegar, 5g sugar, 3g chicken essence, 3g salt and stir evenly. 10. Pour the seasoning onto the jelly and sprinkle with coriander.
Additional content:- Reference: Detailed steps for making jelly
Mix pea starch and water thoroughly in a ratio of 1:5, stir over low heat and stir continuously during the cooking process to prevent the paste from clumping.
Pour the cooked jelly paste into an oiled mold, smooth the surface, and refrigerate for more than 3 hours to completely set.
When unmoulding, mark a circle around the edge of the mold, turn it upside down and cut into strips. The flavor will be better with garlic paste, balsamic vinegar and chili oil.

Case: On a hot summer day, Xiao Wu spent half an hour cooking the jelly paste, poured it into a mold and refrigerated it for 3 hours, took it out, cut it into strips and mixed it with hot and sour seasonings. A bowl of cold and smooth jelly instantly relieved him of the heat and whetted his appetite.

items.title: Ritti Choka
items.core: Ritti Choka is a traditional staple food in Bihar, India. It consists of roasted golden wheat balls and smoky flavored vegetable puree. It has a crispy texture on the outside and a soft inside on the inside. It has a rich aroma. Roasted chickpea flour filling is rich in plant protein and dietary fiber, and paired with eggplant, tomatoes, potatoes and other vegetables, it is rich in nutrients. The preparation requires kneading dough, stuffing, roasting and processing vegetables. There are many steps and it is a challenge for novices. The whole process takes about 60 minutes to complete.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Whole wheat flour (Atta) - Roasted chickpea flour (Sattu) - Can be replaced by fried chickpea flour - Eggplant - Tomato - Potato - Onion - Garlic - Ginger - Green chilli - Lemon - Coriander - Mustard Oil (Mustard Oil) - Can be replaced by other cooking oils - Cumin seeds - Indian black salt (Kala Namak) - Can be replaced by ordinary salt - Red chilli powder - Sesame seeds - Ghee - Salt - Oven or open flame

Calculation: You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Per portion: Litti (noodle ball) part: - 200g whole wheat flour - 120g roasted chickpea flour - 1 onion (about 80g), finely chopped - 2 green chillies, finely chopped - 5g ginger, grated - 15ml mustard oil - 10ml lemon juice - 10g coriander leaves, chopped - 3g cumin seeds - 5g sesame seeds - Red chili powder 3g - Indian black salt 3g - Salt 3g - Warm water about 100ml (for kneading the dough) - Ghee 30g (for spreading after roasting) Chokha (vegetable puree) part: - 1 eggplant (about 250g) - 2 tomatoes (about 180g) - 2 potatoes (about 240g) - 4 cloves of garlic (about 12g) - 1 green chilli - Mustard oil 15ml - Salt 4g - Coriander leaves 10g

Operation: Make leeti filling: 1. Mix roasted chickpea flour 120g, chopped onion, green chilli, ginger in a bowl 2. Add 3g cumin seeds, 5g sesame seeds, 3g red chilli powder, 3g Indian black salt, 3g salt 3. Add mustard oil 15ml, lemon juice 10ml, chopped coriander leaves 4. Mix thoroughly, the filling should be loose but kneadable, set aside. Make the leeti dough: 1. Put 200g whole wheat flour into a large bowl 2. Gradually add warm water and knead while adding to form a smooth and soft dough 3. Let the dough rest for 15 minutes 4. Divide the dough into 8 equal-sized balls 5. Press each dough into a round dough piece with a diameter of about 8cm (slightly thick in the middle) with your hands. 6. Put about 15g of filling in the center of the dough piece. 7. Gather the dough around to wrap the filling, pinch the sealing area, and roll it into a ball. Baking Liti: 1. Preheat the oven to 200°C 2. Place Liti on the baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes, turning it over once during the period, until the surface is golden brown and cracked. 3. If using an open fire: Bake the leeti directly on a charcoal or gas stove over low heat, turning constantly, until evenly browned. 4. After baking, apply ghee on the surface of each leeti while it is hot, so that it can be soaked and absorbed. To make chocolate: 1. Roast eggplants, tomatoes, and potatoes directly on an open flame, or bake in a 200°C oven for 20-25 minutes, until the outer skin is charred and the inside is completely soft. 2. After roasting, peel off the skin and mash the eggplant, tomatoes and potatoes with a fork or hands respectively. 3. Mix the mashed vegetables together 4. Add chopped garlic, green chili pepper, 4g salt, and 15ml mustard oil 5. Stir well and mix well 6. Sprinkle coriander leaves for decoration Serve: 1. Arrange the leeti on a plate and place the chakra vegetable puree next to it 2. Serve hot, break the lechon with your hands and dip it in chakra

Additional content: - Roasted chickpea flour (Sattu) is a specialty ingredient of Bihar. It has extremely high nutritional value and is rich in protein and fiber. It may be difficult to buy in China, but you can make your own: dry-fry the chickpeas (Chana) until dark brown and grind them into powder. - Traditional leeti is grilled on cow dung cake fire, which gives it a unique smoky flavor. A household oven or open flame can be substituted. -Mustard oil is the soul of this dish and it is not recommended to replace it. If mustard oil is not available, canola oil can be used as a second choice. - Litichoka is one of the oldest foods in India. It is said to have a history of thousands of years and was the marching food of ancient soldiers.
The chickpea flour filling can be sauteed in advance and seasoned with cumin and chili powder for a more authentic flavor.
Pinch the wheat dough tightly when stuffing it to prevent it from cracking when baking. Brush the surface with thin oil and bake until golden and crispy.
Roast the pureed vegetables in the oven until the skin is slightly charred, tear off the skin and mix well to make the smoky aroma more intense.

Case: Xiao Li, a food lover, challenged the Indian Litti Choka. Wheat dough was stuffed with chickpea filling and baked into golden wheat balls. It was paired with smoked vegetable puree. After one bite, it was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The rich exotic flavor gave him a sense of accomplishment.

items.title: Naan
items.core: This is an Indian-style fermented naan. It is slightly crispy on the outside and soft and chewy on the inside. It is an excellent partner for curry. Rich in carbohydrates and protein, the addition of yogurt also makes the bread easier to digest. It is a little difficult to make, and you need to pay attention to the softness and hardness of the dough and the heat, but it can be operated in a pan. It is fermented 1 hour in advance and takes about 1.5 hours in total.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - All-purpose flour (or high-gluten flour) - Yogurt - Yeast - Sugar - Salt - Ghee or butter - Warm water - Black or white sesame seeds (optional) - Coriander leaves (optional) - Garlic (garlic naan version, optional) - Pan (non-stick pan or cast iron pan) - Rolling pin

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving makes 6 scones, enough for 2-3 people. Each serving: - 300g all-purpose flour - 60ml yogurt - 3g dry yeast - 10g sugar - 5g salt - 15ml cooking oil (for kneading) - 100ml warm water (approx. 40°C) - 30g ghee or butter (for spreading) - 5g black sesame seeds (optional) - 10g coriander leaves (optional) - 3 cloves of garlic (approx. 9g), chopped (garlic version optional)

Operation: Kneading and fermentation: 1. Dissolve 3g dry yeast and 10g sugar in 100ml warm water (the water temperature is about 40°C, not too hot) 2. Let it sit for 5 minutes until fine foam appears on the surface (indicating that the yeast has been activated) 3. Put 300g all-purpose flour and 5g salt in a large bowl, mix well 4. Pour in yeast water and yogurt 60ml and cooking oil 15ml 5. Knead the dough with your hands into a smooth and soft dough (the dough should be slightly softer than ordinary dough, and it is normal to be slightly sticky) 6. Knead the dough for 8-10 minutes 7. Apply 3ml oil on the surface of the dough to prevent it from drying out 8. Cover the mouth of the bowl with a damp cloth or plastic wrap 9. Leave to ferment in a warm place for at least 1 hour, until the dough swells to about twice the size. Divide and roll out: 1. Take out the fermented dough and knead it gently to deflate the air. 2. Divide into 6 small balls of equal size (about 80g each) 3. Take a ball and dip your hands in 3ml of flour or oil. 4. Use a rolling pin to roll it into an oval or teardrop-shaped dough, about 4-5mm thick. 5. If making garlic naan: Sprinkle chopped garlic and coriander leaves on the surface of the dough, and gently roll it to embed it into the dough. 6. You can sprinkle sesame seeds on the surface of the dough. Baking: Method 1: Pan (recommended) 1. Heat a pan (cast iron pan is best) until it is very hot (the dripping water will evaporate immediately) 2. Brush one side of the dough with a thin layer of water 3. Put the water side down into the pan 4. Bake for 1-2 minutes, until golden brown spots appear on the bottom and the dough starts to bubble 5. Turn over and continue baking for 1-2 minutes 6. If you have a gas stove: After turning over, you can pick up the dough with tongs and place it directly on the open flame to bake for a few seconds. The dough will puff up quickly. 7. Immediately apply ghee or butter on the surface after taking it out. Method 2: Oven 8. Preheat the oven to the highest temperature (usually 250°C) 9. Place the dough on the baking sheet 10. Bake for 3-5 minutes until the surface is golden and puffy. 11. Take it out and spread it with ghee or butter. Serve: 1. Serve hot 2. Suitable to match any Indian curry, such as butter chicken, red kidney bean curry, etc.

Additional content: - The softness of the dough is key. If the dough is too hard, the baked cake will be dry and hard. The dough should be moist and slightly sticky. - Cast iron pans work better than non-stick pans, producing higher temperatures and a better sear. - Ghee or butter must be applied immediately after baking, this is the key to the aroma and taste of naan. - In addition to the original Naan, common variations include: Garlic Naan, Cheese Naan, and Butter Naan. - Naan has been practiced in India for hundreds of years, with the earliest records appearing in 1300, and is thought to be derived from Persian culture.
Add original yogurt to the dough to ferment more fully, making the cake softer and with a slightly sour aroma.
After the dough has fermented until doubled in size, deflate it and divide it into small pieces. Roll it into thin pancakes. The thickness will be even and it will heat up faster.
After the pan is hot, add the cake base. When bubbles appear on the surface, turn it over and cook until both sides are golden and slightly burnt.

Case: Ms. Wang, a lover of Indian food, mixes the fermented dough 1 hour in advance and bakes Indian naan in a pan. The body of the pancake is slightly bulging, crispy on the outside and soft and chewy on the inside. It is eaten with curry and has a great flavor.

items.title: Indian stewed rice
items.core: Indian stewed rice is a royal cuisine originated from the Mughal Empire. The rice is slender, rich in spices, the chicken is tender, the rice is clear, and the layers are rich. Rich in protein and various spice essences, it can stimulate appetite. The preparation steps are complicated and not very friendly to novices. The whole process takes about 90 minutes (the chicken needs to be marinated for 1 hour in advance).
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Basmati Rice - Chicken thigh (boneless, mutton can be substituted) - Yogurt - Onion - Tomato - Ginger - Garlic - Green chilli - Coriander - Mint leaves - Saffron - edible yellow coloring can be substituted - Milk - Ghee - Edible oil - Turmeric powder - Red chilli powder - Indian mixed spice powder (Garam) Masala) - All spices: bay leaves, cinnamon sticks, cardamom, cloves, star anise - Salt - Thick-bottomed pot (with lid, for sealing) - Dough (for sealing the pot)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 3-4 people. Per portion: Cured meat part: - 500g chicken thighs (boneless, cut into large pieces) - Yogurt 100ml - 15g ginger, grated - 6 cloves of garlic (about 18g), grated - Red chili powder 5g - Turmeric powder 3g - Indian mixed spice powder 5g - Salt 5g - Lemon juice 15ml Rice part: - Basmati rice 300g (soaked in advance 30 minutes) - 2000ml water (for cooking rice) - 2 bay leaves - 3 cardamom - 4 cloves - 1 cinnamon stick (about 5cm) - 1 star anise - 10g salt Assembly parts: - 3 onions (about 300g), thinly sliced - 50ml cooking oil (for frying the onions) - 30g ghee - 0.5g saffron + 30ml warm milk (for soaking) - 20g mint leaves - 20g coriander leaves - 3 green chilies, slit

Operation: Marinate chicken (1 hour in advance): 1. Mix yogurt, grated ginger and garlic, red chili powder, turmeric powder, Indian mixed spice powder, salt, lemon juice in a large bowl. 2. Add chicken pieces and coat evenly with marinade 3. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour (overnight is better). Prepare saffron milk and fried onions: 1. Soak 0.5g saffron in 30ml warm milk for 15 minutes and set aside. 2. Pour 50ml cooking oil into the pot and heat over medium heat. 3. Add onion slices and stir-fry until dark golden brown and crispy (about 12-15 minutes, patience required) 4. Remove the fried onions, absorb the oil with kitchen paper and set aside. Cook half-cooked rice: 1. Drain the soaked basmati rice. 2. Boil 2000ml water in a large pot. 3. Add bay leaves, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon sticks, star anise and 10g of salt. 4. Add the rice and cook over high heat for 5-6 minutes until the rice grains are about seven degrees mature (soft on the outside but still hard in the core) 5. Drain immediately, discard all spices, and set aside. Assembly and stewing: 1. Spread 15g of ghee on the bottom of a heavy-bottomed pot 2. First layer: Spread the marinated chicken evenly on the bottom of the pot 3. Second layer: Spread half of the half-cooked rice 4. Sprinkle half of the fried onions, mint leaves, coriander leaves, and green chilies 5. Third layer: Spread the remaining rice 6. Sprinkle the remaining fried onions, mint leaves, and coriander leaves 7. Pour the saffron milk evenly on the surface of the top layer of rice. 8. Add the remaining 15g of ghee (cut into small pieces and scatter) 9. Seal the pot lid: add flour and water to form dough strips, seal the gap along the edge of the pot mouth (traditional method), or wrap the pot mouth with tin foil and cover the pot lid. 10. Heat over high heat for 3 minutes until steam starts to come out of the pot. 11. Then turn to minimum heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes. 12. Do not open the lid after turning off the heat and simmer for another 5 minutes. 13. Open the lid and stir gently from the bottom with a large spatula to mix all layers evenly. 14. Serve on a plate and serve with yogurt (Raita)

Additional content: - Basmati rice is an essential ingredient for making Biryani. Ordinary rice cannot replace its unique long-grain aroma. Available on all major e-commerce platforms in China. - Sealed stewing (Dum) is the essence of this dish. The steam cannot leak, otherwise the rice will dry out. - Rice can only be cooked until it is seven degrees cooked, because it will continue to absorb water and become cooked during the simmering process. Overcooking will result in mushy rice in the end product. - There are two main schools of Biryani: Hyderabadi style, which uses raw meat on the bottom and stews it, and Lucknowi style, where the meat is cooked first and then assembled with rice. This recipe uses the most common mix. - This dish is a must-have dish for weddings and festivals in India and is known as "India's national dish".
Cut the chicken into pieces and marinate it with yogurt and spices for 1 hour to ensure the meat is tender and delicious.
First fry the onions over high heat until golden brown, then add the tomatoes and spices and stir-fry the red oil to lay the foundation of flavor.
The ratio of rice to water is 1:1.5. After boiling, turn to low heat and simmer for 15 minutes, then turn off the heat and simmer for another 10 minutes.

Case: When having a dinner with friends on the weekend, Xiao Li marinated the chicken for 1 hour in advance and simmered the rice with saffron and various spices. When it comes out of the pan, the rice is crispy and the chicken is tender. Friends praise it for its rich layers and ask for advice on how to make it.

items.title: Cola Fried Rice
items.core: This dish is seasoned with cola instead of sugar, bringing a unique caramel and slightly sweet flavor. The rich sauce coats the grains of rice. It is a creative home-style fried rice. Eggs and ham provide high-quality protein and energy, and paired with the staple food of rice, it is nutritionally balanced and filling. The steps are intuitive and suitable for novices to try. It usually takes about 20 minutes to serve.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Rice - Coke (with or without sugar) - Eggs - Ham sausage (or luncheon meat, optional) - Oil - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Oyster sauce - Bean paste (optional) - Chopped green onion - Pepper (either white pepper or black pepper)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Per portion: - Rice 200 g - Coke 160 ml - 3 eggs - Ham sausage 20-100 g - Oil 25 ml - Light soy sauce 15 ml - Dark soy sauce 7.5 ml (if using sugar-free Coke, add 5 ml; if not using doubanjiang, add 5 ml) - Doubanjiang 7.5 ml - Oyster sauce 5 ml - 5 g chopped green onion - 1 g pepper

Operation: 1. After the pot is hot, add 25 ml oil, put two eggs, and fry until the bottom is completely solidified. 2. Turn over and fry until both sides are completely solidified. 3. Turn off the heat, take out the eggs, cut them into 2-5 cm² pieces and put them back into the pot (you can also use a spatula to smash them directly) 4. Turn the heat back on, pour in cola, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, bean paste, and oyster sauce, and stir evenly. 5. Heat until 1/3 of the liquid in the pot is left, pour in rice and ham sausage, and stir-fry. 6. After stir-frying evenly, reduce the heat to low, make a hole in the center of the food in the pot, break in 1 egg, cover the pot, and simmer for 2 minutes. 7. Open the lid and stir-fry until the third egg is cooked, sprinkle with chopped green onion and pepper, and remove from the pot

Additional content: - Sugary cola tastes better - if you like it drier, stir-fry for a while - if you find it troublesome, you can put 3 eggs directly in the first step and skip the step of digging a hole to beat another egg
Control the amount of cola to 1/3 of the rice to avoid being too sweet. You can add a little light soy sauce to balance the taste.
Stir-fry the rice over medium heat until the grains are distinct, then pour in the cola to quickly reduce the juice and prevent it from sticking to the pan.
First fry the eggs and scoop them out, then fry the ham and rice, and finally mix the eggs to maintain the texture.
