Case: Xiao Wang, an overtime worker, quickly stir-fries leftover rice and cola, wraps the rice grains in a caramelized and slightly sweet sauce, and pairs it with fried eggs and ham sausage. 20 minutes later, the family was full of praise and said it was more delicious than takeout.

items.title: Bacon and vegetable rice
items.core: This is a home-cooked staple food full of Shanghai alley style. The mellow flavor of bacon and the sweetness of vegetables are melted into every grain of rice with the help of lard. The rice is crispy and crispy, but the vegetable stems are tender and well-defined. Green vegetables are rich in vitamins and dietary fiber, while bacon provides protein and energy, with a balanced mix of meat and vegetables. The method is not complicated, but you need to master the skills of removing the leaves in batches, which is a bit challenging for novices. It takes about 1 hour from start to finish.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Rice - Green vegetables (dwarf green vegetables are recommended, also known as Shanghai greens) - Bacon (lightly salty pork) - Winter bamboo shoots (optional) - Lard - Cooking wine (optional) - White sugar (optional) - White pepper (optional)

Calculation: You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. One serving is enough for 3 people. Each portion: - 300 g of rice - 310 ml of water (300 ml for hard, 325 ml for soft, if adding winter bamboo shoots, add an additional 20 ml) - 400 g vegetables - 150 g bacon - 100 g winter bamboo shoots - 15 g lard - 15 ml cooking wine - 0-3 g sugar - white pepper 1 g

Operation: 1. If adding winter bamboo shoots, cut into thin slices and boil in cold water for 10 minutes to remove the astringency. 2. Cut the bacon into 1 cm cubes. 3. Add 10 g of bacon and winter bamboo shoots in a cold pot with lard, cooking wine, and sugar. Stir-fry over medium-low heat until transparent and bubbling. 4. Chop the vegetables, separate the stems and leaves, cut the stems into square pieces with a side length of 0.5 cm, and cut the leaves into long pieces. 2-3 cm, 1-1.5 cm wide rectangular pieces 5. Fry the vegetable stems until emerald color 6. After washing the rice, pour it into the rice cooker and add water 7. Spread the fried bacon and vegetable stems on the rice 8. Start the normal cooking mode, open the lid and quickly add the vegetable leaves for the last 10 minutes 9. After cooking, simmer for 5 minutes, then pour 5 g Stir the lard and white pepper powder evenly

Additional content: - Spread the fried bacon and vegetable stems on the rice. Do not stir evenly when cooking - Try not to buy "hometown fresh meat", it can be expected to be very salty. If it is not light bacon, you can mix in fresh diced pork belly, or reduce the amount of bacon, or cut off the lean meat and soak it in 5% sugar water for 20 minutes. - Reference: Bacon and Rice - Wikipedia
Cut the bacon into cubes and soak it in warm water for 10 minutes to remove excess salt and avoid being overly salty.
Put the vegetable stems into the pot and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add the vegetable leaves 5 minutes before turning off the heat to maintain a crisp and tender texture.
Add a spoonful of lard when cooking rice to make the rice more oily and the crispy rice crispy.

Case: Aunt Chen, a housewife from Shanghai, cooked the vegetable leaves twice, frying the stems first and then adding the leaves, and then sauteed the bacon with lard. The cooked vegetables and rice crispy rice are crispy and the vegetable stems are tender and tender. Neighbors smell the smell and come to ask for the recipe.

items.id: 基础牛奶面包-基础牛奶面包
items.title: Basic Milk Bread
items.core: This basic milk bread simplifies the making of traditional bread through starter fermentation. The finished product has a rich milky aroma and a soft texture. Rich in carbohydrates and protein, it provides energy to the body. The difficulty level is moderate and suitable for novice bakers. The whole process takes about 200 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: Required ingredients: - High-gluten or all-purpose flour (try to use high-gluten flour, but avoid using low-gluten flour. All "all-purpose flour" without special instructions are all-purpose flour) - Eggs (do not overly require size and weight) - Sugar (if there is syrup, it is best.) - Dry yeast - Salt - Milk or light cream or condensed milk or milk powder (It is best to use milk powder, which is full of milk flavor, but do not use any compound milk powder, such as adult milk powder or infant milk powder, because of its unstable chemical properties. You can mix the two milk products at the same time. Try to avoid using raw materials with extra sugar, because the actual sugar content will be more than the recommended amount of sugar in this recipe) - Butter or corn oil (If the dairy product you choose has extremely high fat content, you can omit it. Try to use animal fat and no salt. Soybean oil may have a beany smell, so try not to use it.) - Gluten flour (optional) - Vanilla extract (optional) Necessary tools: - Oven (do not use an oven without temperature control) - Measuring cup - Cloth - Rolling pin - Silicone paper or mold Optional materials, tools and introduction to materials and tools: Baking is an independent category of food production, so it is very different from daily cooking tools. Commonly used tools are introduced below. - ① Measuring cup: measure the raw materials. Measuring cups generally use cup as the unit of measurement. Do not shake when measuring to avoid measuring too little raw material. - ②Scraper: Also known as silicone spatula, it is used to stir and scrape off the batter attached to the edge of the container. - ③Cloth: Cover the surface of the dough to prevent excessive moisture loss during the making process. During the production process, choose to use wet or dry cloth according to the actual situation. It is recommended to use the drawer cloth of the steamer (not the disposable drawer cloth), and you can also use plastic wrap. - ④Oven: Bake ingredients. Ovens are divided into small economical ovens and large professional ovens. Economical ovens may heat unevenly due to poor airtightness. In this case, the temperature can be lowered to extend the baking time. The oven must be preheated first. Later chapters will elaborate on this. - ⑤Scraper: scrape off the dough on the panel and cut the dough into appropriate sizes. You can also use a clean knife instead. - ⑥Rolling pin: press the dough. - ⑦Water bottle: Evenly cover the surface of the dough or container with water or oil, used for baking crispy skin and preventing sticking. - ⑧Sifter: spread the flour evenly or filter out flour lumps and impurities. - ⑨ Panel or silicone mat: perform dough kneading operations on it to prevent contamination of the dough and its place. - ⑩ Brush: Used to brush egg liquid on the dough to make the finished product more bright, bright and shiny. - 11. Silicone paper: prevents it from adhering to items during baking, making it difficult to release the baked product. Silicone paper is resistant to high temperatures and has no safety issues. Some silicone papers have front and back sides, so be careful when using them. - 12. Mold: helps the bread to shape when baking. There are no too many requirements for the mold for baking bread, but the mold for baking cakes must be made of anodized aluminum and it is best to spray an oil mixture on the surface to help the cake rise. - Gluten: This is a protein extracted from wheat that forms a lattice-like structure after absorbing water. It is widely used in daily life, such as gluten, etc. - Vanilla extract: Vanilla extract is a highly purified natural food flavor from vanilla. It is often used to make vanilla-flavored foods and is also used to neutralize odors such as eggy smell.

Calculation: Note: Although the specific dosage of raw materials is given, the indoor temperature, indoor humidity and even the yeast content in the air will affect the production process. This recipe will provide suggestions for adjustments as much as possible during the production process. The cup is a commonly used unit of measurement for baking because it allows easy conversion between volume and weight. 1 cup = 250 ml, generally, 1 cup flour = 120 g. See additional content for more conversions. Here, cup is used for larger amounts and g is used for smaller amounts. Each portion: - Yeast - 1 cup of flour (take a cup and hang up the excess with a spoon, do not shake) - 30 ℃ warm water (it is better not to be hot) 1 cup - Yeast 2 g - Salt 2 g - Dough - Flour 2½ cup - 1 egg - Sugar or syrup ⅛ cup - Dairy products After mixing, a total of ¼ cup (milk powder needs to be mixed with water.) - Butter or corn oil ⅛ cup - Gluten ¼ ~ ½ cup (optional) - Vanilla extract 3 g (optional)

Operation: Preparation of starter: The starter is the product of pre-fermentation. Through pre-fermentation, not only can the success rate be improved, but a longer fermentation time will make the bread taste better. If possible, the starter should be fermented for 4 days to achieve optimal flavor. But for novices, the finished product of a 30-minute fermentation starter is already impressive. Next make the starter. 1. First, mix the yeast and 30℃ warm water evenly with a spatula or kitchen utensil and let it sit for 5 minutes. Then mix with flour and mix well. The starter at this time should be a very thick batter. 2. Cover the batter with a cloth and place the batter in a warm place to ferment for 45 ~ 60 minutes. 3. The final batter should have many bubbles on the surface and increase in volume significantly. Fermentation failed? Take a look here: 1. Make sure the yeast is not expired 2. Make sure the water temperature is appropriate 3. Extend the fermentation time, you can put it in the refrigerator overnight 4. The temperature may not be enough. In this case, you can preheat the oven to 60°C, stop heating and put it in the oven for fermentation. 5. You can add the same amount of yeast, stir evenly, ferment again and extend the fermentation time. 6. You can try adding 3g of sugar for fermentation again. How to make a "permanent" starter? With a starter, baking bread at any time is no longer a dream! A "permanent" starter can be made as follows: 1. After making the starter according to the above method, place it in a cool place (even a refrigerator!) Sprinkle a thin layer of flour on it every 1-3 days (as long as the thickness of the batter is not visible!) Stir again, and continue to cover with a cloth to ferment. If it ferments too quickly and becomes too bulky, throw away part of it. 2. When you start making bread, just leave the pre-fermentation volume of the starter to continue fermentation, and the rest is used for making bread. 3. Over time, the starter will produce a unique aroma, which is the best "raw material" for bread! Making the dough: With the starter, half the battle is done! 1. Mix and stir all the remaining ingredients with the starter using a spatula. Be sure to scrape the walls while stirring to mix thoroughly. When the dough is formed and there is no dry flour, use a clean, dry hand to press the dough, and hold the container with the other hand to form a large dough, and then pour it onto the panel or silicone mat. At this time, the dough should have been formed and relatively soft. If it cannot be formed and is very sticky, then there is less flour, so add ¼ cup flour and mix thoroughly again until it forms. If the dough is shaped or has a lot of dry flour, it means that the kneading time is not enough. You can increase the kneading time at this time. When pressing the dough, push the dough open with your fists, then fold it in half and push it open again. Repeat this to knead all the flour on the wall of the container into the dough. 2. Push the dough out with the lower part of your palm, then fold it in half and push it out again until there are no dry powder lumps on the surface. The dough at this time is not very smooth yet. If the panel is used during this process, there may be a small amount of adhesion, which can be removed with a scraper or knife. If the dough forms but is hard, it means there is too little moisture. At this time, you can use wet hands or a watering can to evenly cover the surface with water, cover it with a damp cloth and let it ferment for 20 minutes, repeating this process. 3. Use a spray bottle to spray a layer of vegetable oil into a container that is at least three times the size of the current dough (you can also spread it evenly with your hands), put the dough into it, cover it with a cloth, and let it ferment for 1 hour. If there is a problem with fermentation, please refer to the solutions to fermentation failure under making starter. The surface of the fermented dough should be sticky. If not, use wet hands or a spray bottle to evenly cover the surface with water and ferment again for 20 minutes. 4. At this point the dough should be twice in size. Sprinkle a thin layer of flour on the panel or silicone mat (you can see the thickness of the panel or silicone mat), then take out the dough and press it with your hands to deflate the dough. 5. Then use a rolling pin to roll it into a 1 cm thick piece. And roll it up from one side tightly without leaving any gaps. 6. Then rotate 90° and repeat steps 4 and 5. 7. Shape the bread and place it on a baking sheet lined with silicone paper or a greased mold. Note that the seams are facing downwards. You can spray a layer of oil evenly on the baking sheet or spread a thin layer with butter and put silicone paper on it. In this way, the silicone paper will not move randomly. 8. Ferment in a tray or mold for 30 ~ 45 minutes. If there is a problem with fermentation, please refer to the solutions to fermentation failure under making starter. 9. Meanwhile, preheat the oven. Preheat the oven: Set the oven to the highest temperature and bake empty...

Additional content: 1. Conversion of common raw materials (for reference only) | Volume / cup | Raw materials | Mass / g | |:---------:|:----:|:-------:| |1 |Butter |227 | |1 |Raisins|170 | |1 |Honey |340 | 2. How to save excess bread. You can slice the bread and freeze it. When you use it next time, you can place it at room temperature and wait for it to warm up, or you can heat it directly. But never put it in the refrigerated area! Bread moisture will quickly lose in the refrigerated area. 3. Recommended eating method a. Take a large piece of bread and divide it into two parts. Place in a pot and heat over low heat (generally no oil is needed, but if you want a crispy crust, you can spread butter on the surface of the bread before frying) for 1 to 2 minutes. b. Use a spray bottle to spray 3 ~ 4 pumps of oil into the pot. Heat over high heat until the pot smokes slightly. Turn to minimum heat. c. Then add an egg and close the lid. Wait 2~3 minutes. Then turn over and heat for another 2~3 minutes. (This is how to make runny eggs. If you need a hard-boiled egg, you can add up to 1 ml of water before turning over, and turn to medium-low heat until the water is boiled. In this way, you will get a hard-boiled egg) d. Coat both sides of the bread with any sauce you like, and sandwich the eggs in the middle.
The starter needs to be activated 4 hours in advance, and the main dough can be mixed after dense bubbles appear.
Kneading the dough to the complete stage can pull out the light-transmitting film to ensure the delicate texture of the bread.
After fermenting until doubled in size, gently tap to release air, ferment for 40 minutes before placing in the oven.

Case: Xiaolin, a novice baking enthusiast, made the starter according to the tutorial, kneaded and shaped the dough after fermentation. The baked bread has a rich milky aroma and a soft texture. The family mistakenly thought they bought it from a bakery, and the users were greatly encouraged.

items.id: 微波炉腊肠煲仔饭-微波炉腊肠煲仔饭
items.title: Microwave Sausage Claypot Rice
items.core: This is a simple and quick Cantonese-style staple food. The rice absorbs enough of the sausage fat and is oily and salty. It is paired with crispy green vegetables and carrots for a rich taste. Rich in carbohydrates, protein and multivitamins, nutritionally balanced. The cooking process is microwave-friendly and very beginner-friendly, and you can expect it to be ready in just 15 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Tools - Microwave oven - 2 large bowls (microwave bowls are recommended) - 1 small bowl - Ingredients - 200 ml of rice - 1 sausage - 1 egg - 1 carrot - Salt - 15 ml of oil - 10 ml of light soy sauce - 1 chive
Calculation: 1 serving.

Operation: 1. Wash the rice and pour it into a rice bowl, add 400ml of water, and cover it. 2. Put it in the microwave, set it to high heat for 6 minutes, and prepare the ingredients while cooking - cut the sausages - wash the vegetables - cut the carrot slices - chop the green onions - put the vegetables and carrot slices in the vegetable bowl, pour 10 ml of oil, add 5 g of salt - pour in a small bowl 10 ml light soy sauce, 5 ml oil 3. After 6 minutes, use a towel or heat-resistant gloves to take out the bowl. You can see that the rice is half cooked. 4. Place sliced sausages on the rice and continue to cook on high for 2 minutes. 5. Take out the sausage rice, put it in a vegetable bowl, and cook on high for 4-5 minutes. 6. Arrange the vegetables on the sausage rice, crack in the eggs, and continue to cook on high for 40-60 seconds depending on your preference. 7. Take out the sausage rice, it is basically done now. 8. Put the small bowl in and continue to cook on high heat for 30 seconds. 9. Pour the hot soy sauce over the sausage rice and sprinkle with chopped green onion. 10. The excess vegetables can be eaten with soy sauce
Additional Content
The ratio of rice to water is 1:1.2. Heat on high heat for 10 minutes and then simmer for 2 minutes to avoid getting cooked.
Slice the sausage diagonally and spread it on the rice so that the fat can penetrate into the rice more evenly.
Add the green vegetables in the last 3 minutes and use the residual heat to blanch them to keep them crispy and tender.

Case: Xiaomei, an office worker, puts rice and water into a microwave container, puts sausage and vegetables on top, and heats on high heat for 15 minutes. When the lid is opened, the sausage fat soaks into the rice, making it salty and oily. Colleagues are envious of its convenience.

items.id: 意式肉酱面-意式肉酱面
items.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
items.core: Spaghetti Bolognese is a simple and quick home-cooked Western dish with rich sauce and chewy noodles, suitable for busy daily life. Minced meat and onions paired with finished pasta sauce can quickly replenish protein and carbohydrates. Onions also contain dietary fiber. The method is very friendly to beginners. It only requires simple cutting and frying. Once you are familiar with it, it can be served on the table in 15 minutes. It is more satisfying than instant noodles.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: - Pasta - Pasta sauce - Minced meat - White onion (purple onion is also acceptable)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Per serving: - 180g pasta (can go up or down according to the amount of food) - 80g minced meat (can go up or down according to the amount of food) - half of an onion (about 150g, usually twice the weight of the meat) - 300g pasta sauce (can go up or down depending on the situation) - cooking oil 10-15ml

Operation: 1. Add water to the pot, boil and add the pasta (wait 6 - 12 minutes) 2. You can perform the following steps while boiling water, but please pay attention to the cooking time 3. Cut the onion into small dices 4. Pour oil into an empty pot and add chopped onion over medium heat 5. Stir all the time and be careful not to burn the onion until the onion becomes translucent 6. Add minced meat and continue stirring (stir loose) until the minced meat turns brown 7. Add spaghetti sauce and stir slightly 8. Drain the cooked pasta and pour it into the meat sauce and stir evenly (or just pour the prepared meat sauce directly on the pasta)

Additional content: - Pasta comes in many different thicknesses, please pay attention to the time marked on the pasta box before cooking the noodles - Spaghetti sauce is not tomato sauce, the tomato sauce commonly used is called tomato sauce, and although pasta sauce and tomato sauce are both seasoned tomato sauce, the seasonings are different
Cook the noodles until they are medium cooked and retain their chewy texture. After taking them out, add a little olive oil to prevent them from sticking.
Stir-fry the minced meat until it changes color, then add diced onions and stir-fry until soft to enhance the sweetness.
The sauce needs to be simmered over low heat for 3 minutes to allow the minced meat and sauce to fully blend and coat the noodles.

Case: Busy programmer Xiao Zhang used ready-made pasta sauce and minced meat to finish a plate of bolognese noodles in 15 minutes. The noodles are chewy and the sauce is rich. He posted on WeChat that it is "a hundred times better than instant noodles."

items.title: Handmade Dumplings
items.core: Handmade dumplings are a classic Chinese staple food. They have thin skin and large fillings, are delicious and juicy. They are filling and can be seasoned according to your personal taste. Pork filling provides high-quality protein and fat, and when paired with leeks, it can also supplement vitamins and dietary fiber. This dish is more difficult for novices. It requires mastering the dough, rolling out the dough, adjusting the fillings and cooking the dumplings. It is expected to take about 3 hours to make.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Rolling pin - Flour - Cold water - A basin with a diameter of more than 30cm - Sesame sesame oil

Calculation: - Single person, about 20 pieces Per serving: - Flour 200g - Cold water 150ml - Sesame sesame oil 2-3ml - Lean minced meat 250g - Fatty minced pork 20g #You can omit it if you don’t like it - Ginger 3g - Onion 15g - salt 3g - oyster sauce 2ml - sesame oil 2ml - light soy sauce 2ml - 1 egg

Operation: Make dumpling wrappers: 1. Add all the flour to the basin 2. Add sesame sesame oil 3. Make a small hole in the center of the flour 4. Add water in 4-5 times and stir until a crumbly and slightly dry dough appears 5. Cancel adding water and compact the dough with your hands 6. The dough is compacted until the flour around the basin can be incorporated. This step is dough baking. 7. Place the dough on the table, turn the basin upside down on the table, and let the dough rise for about 45 minutes at an ambient temperature of 25 degrees. 8. After the proofing is completed, roll the dough into a strip, form a ball, and roll it into a strip again. Repeat 3 times. 9. Roll into a strip, cut into 20 evenly sized pieces of dough, and roll into a ball with a diameter of about 3-3.5cm. 10. Flatten the dough and sprinkle flour on your hands, on the table, on the rolling pin, and on the dough. This step prevents the dough from becoming sticky. 11. Use a rolling pin to roll the dough flat, about 8cm in diameter, about 2mm thick, and the middle is slightly 1mm thicker than the surroundings. Mix the stuffing: 1. Peel the pork, keep some of the fat, and cut it into small pieces. 2. Use a kitchen knife (two are recommended) to chop the pork into minced meat and put it in a bowl. 3. Chop the green onion and ginger into mince, and mix well in a meat bowl. 4. Wash the leeks and cut them into lengths less than 3mm. 5. Mix the leeks and minced meat, add 2ml each of oyster sauce, light soy sauce, and sesame oil. Add the egg white of one egg, and mix well with your hands. 6. Leave it for 30 minutes to start making dumplings. To make dumplings: 1. Place the dough on your left hand, and try not to stick to the flour on the stuffing side of the dumpling to prevent it from being able to close. 2. Use chopsticks in your right hand to pick up fillings about 1/2 the diameter of the dough. 3. Gather along the circumference of the dumpling wrapper and pinch it firmly. You don’t need to pinch the flowers to eat it individually, and the dumpling wrapper will not leak. Cook dumplings: 1. Use a pot that can hold 20 dumplings, or cook in batches. 2. Boil water, about 3/4 of the height of the pot. 3. Boil the water over high heat, add the dumplings, and adjust to medium heat. 4. When the dumplings are put in for the first time and the water bubbles, add 50ml of cold water to the side of the pot (repeat this step twice) 5. After the water boils for the third time, add 50ml of cold water. After the water boils, reduce the heat to low and wait for 60 seconds before serving.

Additional content: - There is no need to cover the pot when cooking dumplings. Add water three times to prevent the dumplings from being boiled all the time and causing the skin to break and turn into dough. There are some supplementary methods for this dish, including but not limited to: Add the following additional ingredients: * 10ml black vinegar * 50g small piece of ginger * 2 drops sesame oil * 3 cloves/person of garlic/garlic paste * Consider eating with black vinegar. Recommended dosage: 10-20ml. * Consider cutting the ginger into shreds, add 20ml of black vinegar and shredded ginger in a small bowl and stir as a dipping sauce for a richer flavor. * Consider adding 1~3 drops of sesame oil when paired with black vinegar, stir it as a dipping sauce. * Consider adding minced garlic when paired with black vinegar and stir to use as a dipping sauce. (The smell of garlic will remain in your mouth. If you need to talk face-to-face with others after a meal, it is recommended to give up or clean your mouth)
The water temperature is controlled at 60℃ when kneading the dough. The dough will be softer and the dough will not break easily when rolled out.
Stir the fillings in the same direction and add a little peppercorn water to enhance the juiciness of the meat fillings.
When boiling the dumplings, add cold water and repeat three times to ensure that the skin is translucent and the filling is cooked.

Case: During the Spring Festival family gathering, Xiao Li’s family rolled out the dough, mixed the fillings, and made 100 leek and pork dumplings. After cooking, the skin is thin and the filling is large, delicious and juicy. While eating, the relatives praised the craftsmanship as good as the restaurant.

items.title: Yangzhou Fried Rice
items.core: This is an upgraded version of fried rice with rich ingredients. The rice has distinct grains and tender eggs. It is paired with shrimp, lunch meat and diced vegetables. It has a distinct taste and is a classic staple food in Huaiyang cuisine. Rich in high-quality protein, carbohydrates and multiple vitamins, nutritionally balanced. Although there are many steps, the operation is intuitive and friendly to beginner cooks. All you need to do is prepare the ingredients patiently. Estimated production time is approximately 1 hour.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Cold rice (dry is better) - Eggs - Frozen peeled prawns - Canned luncheon meat - Green beans - Carrots - Corn kernels (optional) - Green onions - Oil - Salt

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 1-2 people. Each serving: - 500g cold rice - 2-3 eggs - 10-15 frozen headless and peeled prawns - 150g canned luncheon meat (recommend Shanghai Meilin's canned ham luncheon meat, 340g per can, use half a can at a time) - 30g green beans - 30g carrots - 30g corn kernels - 1 green onion - 30-40ml oil - salt 12-15g

Operation: 1. Dice carrots into 0.2cm0.2cm0.2cm, set aside 2. Cut luncheon meat into dices 0.2cm0.2cm0.2cm, set aside 3. Take white and green onions, cut each into 0.25-0.5cm segments, separate and set aside 4. Pour egg liquid into a bowl, stir evenly, set aside 5. Cook the carrots, green beans and corn kernels and take them out and set aside (don’t pour the water) 6. Cook the shrimps and take them out and set them aside (the water can be poured in) 7. Heat the oil in the pan, you can refer to the hot pan double oil in learning to fry and fry - use 20-30ml of oil for the second pour of oil. After the second cold oil is hot, slowly pour in the eggs (control the diameter of the direct flow of oil from the bowl to about 0.5cm) without stirring 8. Remove the eggs immediately after solidification and set aside 9. Pour the luncheon meat, green beans, carrots, corn kernels, and shrimp into the pot and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Plate and set aside. 10. Rinse the pot with water to wash away the debris and make sure it is clean (there can be oil but no impurities). 11. Heat the oil (10ml) in the pot and sauté the green onion. 12. Reduce to low heat (if the oil temperature is too high, turn off the heat 1-2 minutes), add the rice, quickly smash the rice with a spatula and stir-fry to ensure that the rice is evenly coated with oil and the grains are distinct. 13. Pour in the eggs and continue to smash to break the eggs and mix well with the rice. 14. Turn up the heat, pour in all other reserved ingredients, and stir-fry quickly for 1-2 minutes. 15. Sprinkle in salt and stir-fry until well mixed. 16. Sprinkle in green onions and stir-fry for 1 minute. 17. Turn off the heat and plate

Additional content: - If arm soreness after finishing is normal, you need to strengthen your upper limbs - there are mixed frozen packages of green beans, carrots, and corn kernels in supermarkets. You can use this to save the trouble of dicing. We recommend Pams Mixed Veges, which are very cheap, or similar ones can be used (as shown below)
Cut the ingredients into even dices to ensure you can taste a variety of textures in every bite.
Pour the egg liquid into the hot oil and quickly break it up, fry it into pieces and serve it out to avoid becoming hard.
Use overnight rice for the rice. Break it up with your hands before frying. Stir-fry over medium heat until the grains are distinct.

Case: Xiao Zhao, a novice cook, prepared shrimps, luncheon meat and diced vegetables according to the tutorial, and patiently stir-fried them. The finished product has distinct grains and bright colors. It was praised as "hotel quality" at the family banquet, and he felt full of accomplishment.

items.title: Pizza Crust
items.core: Provide mainly carbohydrates and a small amount of good fats. The production process is simple, but you need to be patient and wait for the dough to ferment. It is also friendly to novices. From preparation to completion of baking, it takes about 10-14 hours including overnight refrigeration time, so it is suitable to be prepared a day in advance.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: Raw materials - All-purpose flour - Water (warm water) - Angel dry yeast - Edible salt - Olive oil - White sugar Tools - Oven - Baking paper - Pizza stone (preferable, you can do without a regular baking pan) - Rolling pin (optional)

Calculation: An 8 ~ 9-inch pizza requires about 125g of flour, which is almost the amount for one person (an adult male will eat enough) Mixing ratio of raw materials Flour: Water: Olive oil: Yeast powder: Salt: Sugar 100: 70: 7: 1: 0.6: 0.6 Example If you want to make 4 crusts at a time, you need: - Flour 125g x 4= 500g, - Water 70 x 5 = 350g, - Olive oil 7 x 5 =35g, - Yeast powder 1 x 5 = 5g, - salt 0.6 x 5 = 3g, - sugar 0.6 x 5 = 3g

Operation: 1. Dissolve the yeast powder with the prepared warm water, stir slightly and set aside. 2. Take the prepared flour, add salt, olive oil, and white sugar in sequence. 3. Prepare to mix the water and flour, and stir while adding water until all the water is added. 4. Stir until the dry rice flour is no longer visible. 5. Pack the dough into a container that is almost three times the size, seal it, and refrigerate it (4 degrees Celsius). Wait for 8 to 12 hours. Generally, you can make it at night and use it the next day. 6. Observe that the dough has proofed. It is almost twice the original size. 7. Take the proofed dough, divide it evenly into four parts, cover each with plastic wrap, and set aside. 8. Sprinkle a little more dry flour on the chopping board and prepare to start kneading the dough. 9. Because it is a relatively wet dough, it is less sticky after adding dry flour. You don’t need to knead it too many times. The surface of the dough should be slightly smooth. 10. Pull it with your hands or flatten it with a rolling pin. It doesn’t have to be rounded, as long as the thickness is uniform and can fit in the oven. 11. Lay out the oil paper and put the crust on it. According to your personal taste, put the prepared ingredients on top and sprinkle with grated cheese. 12. Fruit oven at 180 degrees, lower. 220 degrees for 16 minutes. 13. For meat and vegetables, bake the oven at 200 degrees for 200 degrees and 230 degrees for 18 minutes. 14. Top with salad dressing or other sauces of your choice and enjoy~

Additional content: - Be sure to pay attention to the proportion of water - The quality of the oven is uneven. Pay attention to the effect of heat on pizza when making it for the first time - Generally, it is not specifically marked as low-gluten or high-gluten flour, it is basically medium-gluten flour - Fruits that are prone to becoming watery cannot be used as ingredients, such as watermelons, oranges, etc.
Knead the dough until smooth, seal and refrigerate for 12 hours, and ferment at low temperature to enhance ductility.
When rolling out, push gently from the center outwards, making the edges slightly thinner to form a natural edge.
Preheat the oven to 220℃, brush the crust with thin oil, and bake for 10 minutes until the edges are golden.

Case: I kneaded the pizza crust dough on Friday night and put it in the refrigerator. The next afternoon I took it out to warm up, spread the ingredients and bake. The edge of the bottom of the cake is slightly burnt and chewy, and it is more fragrant than the ready-made cake crust. It really saves trouble to prepare it in advance.

items.id: 日式咖喱饭-日式咖喱饭
items.title: Japanese Curry Rice
items.core: Japanese curry rice is a rich and mellow home-style Japanese cuisine, seasoned with curry cubes, paired with potatoes, carrots, onions and meat. It has a smooth, dense, spicy and slightly sweet taste. It is rich in protein, carbohydrates and multiple vitamins, which can provide the body with sufficient energy. The overall method is not complicated, but it requires mastery of heat and stirring skills. It is suitable for friends with a little cooking experience to try. It takes about 1 hour from preparation to serving, and the flavor will be better after being refrigerated.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: Main ingredients: - Curry cubes (recommended brand Haoshi) - Potatoes - Carrots - Onions - Meat (pork, chicken, beef are acceptable) - Garlic Secondary ingredients: Additional ingredients for garnish, optional - Cauliflower (boiled in water) - Bacon (ready to eat) - Omelette or sun-cooked eggs

Calculation: The amount of ingredients is proportional to the curry, and the calculation part uses half a box of Haoshi curry cubes (115g) as an example. Half a box serves about six bowls. The curry tastes better after being refrigerated in the refrigerator, so you don’t have to worry about not being able to finish it by one person. - 2 onions - 2 potatoes - 1 carrot - 2~3 cloves of garlic - 2 pounds of meat

Operation: 1. Ingredients preparation: 1. Peel the carrots from head to tail, peel and cut with a hob 2. Peel off the outer layer of the onion and cut into crescent shapes 3. Peel the potatoes and cut into large pieces 4. Cut the meat into cubes 5. Peel and flatten the garlic and mince it 6. Chop the curry cubes to increase the contact area to speed up dissolution 2. Cooking process: 1. Add garlic and meat to a hot oil pan and stir-fry quickly until the surface of the meat turns white 2. Add carrots and stir-fry quickly until evenly heated. 3. Add onions and stir-fry quickly until onions become transparent. 4. Add potatoes and stir-fry until potatoes become soft (you can use chopsticks to confirm). 5. Add water to cover all ingredients and wait for 15 minutes after boiling. 6. Turn off the heat, add curry and stir. 7. Wait until the curry melts and then turn on the heat. Stir slowly for 10 minutes to prevent the pot from being burned. 8. Turn off the heat and finish the preparation when the appearance is sticky. 3. Refrigerate and reheat: Take out the amount of curry you need to eat each time from the refrigerated curry, heat it and then cover it with rice. 1. Microwave oven: single serving on high heat for 2-3 minutes 2. Pot: add 50ml of additional water and keep stirring while heating

Additional content: Remarks: - Steps 1-6 can be performed during the waiting process of 2-5. During this process, you can also use a pot of water to cook some vegetables or make an omelette. - Between 2-5 and 2-6, you need to pay attention to the boiling water level. If you find that the food is lower than 2/3, you should heat the water until the food is submerged. Flowchart: graph TD A [process meat, carrots, onions, potatoes] --> B (turn on the oil pan, fry them one after another) B --> C [add water to cover the ingredients, cook for 15 minutes] C --> D [chop the curry, boil the cauliflower, etc.] C --> E [add the curry and stir for 10 minutes] D --> E Finished product: Reference: - Weibo video of world food tutorials
Cut potatoes and carrots into small pieces, fry them on the surface first and then stew them to keep their shape and not fall apart easily.
After the curry cubes melt, stir over low heat to prevent them from sticking to the pan and ensure the sauce is smooth.
Add a little honey after turning off the heat to balance the spiciness, and the flavor will be more mellow after refrigeration.

Case: Food blogger Xiao Zhou stirs constantly when cooking curry to avoid burning the bottom. The flavor becomes more intense after being refrigerated overnight and served with rice. Fans commented that "just looking at it makes me drool", and the video received over 10,000 likes.

items.id: 日式肥牛丼饭-日式肥牛丼饭
items.title: Japanese-style beef rice bowl
items.core: A classic Japanese home-style rice bowl, beef slices and white onions are simmered in a salty and sweet sauce. The meat is soft and tender, the onions are sweet, and the juice is rich. Beef provides high-quality protein and heme iron, and onions are rich in dietary fiber and various antioxidants. The preparation is not complicated, and novices can easily complete it as long as they follow the steps. The stir-frying process takes about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: Main ingredients: - Onions (be sure to use onions with a white-yellow skin, do not use purple onions) - Fatty beef (hot pot fat beef is enough, you can also use raw beef slices) - Green onions (you can also use chopped green onions) - White sesame seeds - Mirin (a commonly used Japanese seasoning, which can be purchased on major e-commerce platforms, or can be replaced with cooking wine) Secondary ingredients: Additional ingredients for garnishing, optional - Hot spring eggs - Making the juice (soup made with dried bonito and kombu can be used to enhance the freshness)

Calculation: The amount of ingredients is proportional to the rice. The calculation part uses a cup of rice (160ml) as an example. It is about the amount of food for two people. If you can't finish it, you can keep it in the refrigerator, but it may not be as delicious - 1 onion - 250 grams of beef - 1~2 green onions - 5 grams of white sesame

Operation: 1. Ingredients preparation: 1. Peel off the outer layer of the onion, core it, and cut it into crescent shapes 2. Wash the green onion and cut it into 0.5cm pieces 3. Directly add white sesame seeds to the hot pot, shake the pot back and forth to evenly heat the sesame seeds until they turn slightly golden. 4. Blanch the beef for 1 minute and take it out. 5. Combine 40g mirin (or 30g cooking wine), 30g soy sauce, 20g oil, 5g sugar, 5g dark soy sauce (optional, for coloring), stir in a bowl and mix into seasoning (this step can be done directly by placing the bowl on an electronic scale) 2. Cooking process: 1. Add the onions to the hot oil pan and stir-fry quickly until the onions become transparent. 2. Turn down the heat, add 250g of water (or juice), return to high heat and wait for 3 minutes. 3. Add the beef and seasonings. 4. Keep turning all the ingredients for 10 minutes to prevent them from sticking to the pan. 5. Turn off the heat. 6. Put the beef bowl on the rice (be careful to pour some juice on the rice) 7. Sprinkle with chopped green onion and white sesame seeds and it's done. 3. Refrigerate and then reheat: Take out the amount of beef bowl you need to eat each time from the refrigerated beef bowl, heat it and then cover it with rice. 1. Microwave oven: single serving on high heat for 2-3 minutes 2. Pot: additional 50ml of water is required, and it needs to be stirred continuously during heating

Additional content: struct Staple{float saltiness;}; struct Staple Beefdon Beefdon.saltness = taste the soup; while(beefdon.saltiness < expected) add (1 g) soy sauce; beefdon.saltness = taste the soup; Remarks: - If you are using relatively good beef, you can choose not to blanch it, which can preserve the flavor of the beef. Because the mirin is added, it will not be too fishy. There is no need to worry about the beef being undercooked. It will definitely be cooked after 10 minutes of heating. - If possible, choose to add 15g of sake. Flowchart: graph TD A [process meat, onions, chopped green onions, white sesame] --> B [open oil pan, fry onions] B --> C [add water, cook for 3 minutes] C --> D [Add beef and seasonings, stir and cook for 10 minutes] D --> E [Place in a bowl, sprinkle with chopped green onion and white sesame seeds] Finished product: References: - Hesui Yangyang Laboratory [Beef Bowl | Fatty Beef Rice] The authentic recipe of Yoshinoya beef rice - Uncle Xia's Kitchen Make the fairy recipe in 60 seconds, delicious and easy-to-eat fat beef rice!
Blank the beef slices in water for 10 seconds to remove the blood foam, making it more tender and avoiding hardening after being cooked for a long time.
Shred the onions and sauté over low heat until translucent to release the sweetness and blend more well with the sauce.
The sauce is prepared according to light soy sauce: mirin: sugar = 2:2:1, and the sauce is thickened before pouring over the rice.

Case: Xiao Chen, a white-collar worker who lives alone, quickly stir-fries beef slices and onions and pours them on hot rice. The meal was ready in 15 minutes, and the sauce soaked into the rice. She took a photo and posted it on WeChat with the caption "Healing Dinner."

items.title: Soup Noodles
items.core: Soup noodles are a home-cooked staple food that can be mixed freely. The soup is refreshing and the noodles are soft and smooth. It is compatible with various meat and vegetable ingredients and the taste can be fresh or bland. It is rich in carbohydrates and high-quality protein. When paired with vegetables, it can also supplement vitamins and dietary fiber. It is nutritionally balanced and filling. The method is very simple, no cooking skills are required, and novices can easily master it. From preparing ingredients to serving, it usually takes about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Pasta materials: It can be handmade noodles, dragon whisker noodles, fish noodles, instant noodles, vermicelli of various sizes, or any other form of pasta you like. - Dish ingredients: It is recommended to mix meat and vegetables, just choose your favorite ingredients and wash them well. For example: - Beef, sheep, fish and shrimp and other meats (both raw and cooked) - Eggs, duck eggs, goose eggs, ostrich eggs and other eggs - Bean cubes, bean gluten, tofu skin and other soy products - Lettuce, spinach, lettuce - Green peppers, tomatoes, carrots and other vegetables.

Calculation: - Noodle materials: The amount of instant noodles for one person can be chosen between 70-230g. - Cold water: add the amount that can submerge the noodles, generally choose between 200 - 400 ml - Vegetables: the volume is about the same as noodles - the volume of vegetables can be ignored

Operation: 1. Cut the vegetable materials into pieces with a side length of no more than 4cm for easy cooking 2. If there is raw meat, put it into cold water first, cover the pot, bring to a boil, remove the upper layer of blood foam, then turn off the heat, and remove the half-cooked meat for later use. 3. First heat the water to boiling over high heat, then adjust to medium heat. 4. Put the ingredients that are difficult to cook into the pot (such as half-cooked meat, mushrooms, etc. are put into the pot first). To ensure doneness, time the cooking time for 10 minutes after boiling, and add an additional 5 minutes for large pieces of ingredients that are particularly difficult to cook. 5. Put the pasta into the pot, stir properly to ensure that the noodles and soup are fully in contact, keep the liquid level at a slight boil, and cook for 5 minutes. After adding the noodles, white foam will easily appear on the liquid surface. You can lift the lid appropriately to ventilate it or remove the lid. 6. Put easy-to-cook ingredients such as vegetables into the pot, stir properly to fully submerge, and cook for 2-5 minutes. 7. Turn off the heat, then add salt, pepper, sesame oil and other seasonings of your choice, stir properly and serve

Additional content: - The operation process can be changed according to your own preferences. You will be surprised if you try more - If you are not sure about the amount of salt, you can add small amounts multiple times to avoid overdose
Cook the noodles until they are medium cooked, add cold water to make them more chewy, and blanch them in hot soup before eating.
Use bone broth or mushroom broth as the soup base, add a little white pepper to make it fresh and avoid being too salty.
Add the side dishes in order: put the carrots that can withstand cooking first, and blanch the green leafy vegetables last.

Case: I often make clear noodle soup on weekday evenings. While the water is boiling in the pot, I chop green onions and green vegetables, and when the noodles are almost cooked, I crack an egg and I have a bowl of hot noodle soup in a few minutes. The soup is light and not greasy. It makes your stomach feel comfortable after eating it and you can clean it up quickly.

items.id: 河南蒸面条-河南蒸面条
items.title: Henan steamed noodles
items.core: Henan steamed noodles are a home-cooked snack originating from Henan. The noodles are first steamed and then stir-fried and then steamed again. They are oily and flavourful, and have a chewy and smooth texture. Pork belly and garlic sprouts provide rich protein and dietary fiber, and bring balanced nutrition with staple food. There are a few more steps to make, but novices can succeed as long as they follow the order. From preparation to serving, it takes about 40 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - noodles (round ones are recommended) - pork belly - garlic sprouts - onions + ginger + garlic + cooking wine - salt + chicken essence + thirteen spices - light soy sauce + dark soy sauce + oyster sauce - sesame oil - oil + pot + kitchen knife + shovel - steaming grate - extra basin

Calculation: The amount below is only 1 It’s enough staple food for one person’s meal! Please adjust the amount of ingredients according to the actual situation! Each serving: - 300g noodles - 350g pork belly - 150g garlic sprouts - 10-15ml cooking oil - 15ml light soy sauce - 10ml dark soy sauce - 5ml oyster sauce - 2g salt - 2g chicken essence - 1g thirteen spices - 10g green onion - 5g ginger - 10g garlic - 5ml cooking wine - Sesame oil 5ml

Operation: Steam for the first time: 1. Add 70% water to the pot, boil the water, and put on the steaming grate 2. Spread the noodles evenly, pour 5ml of oil and spread evenly, steam for 15 minutes 3. Take out the noodles and steaming grate, set them aside, and drain the water in the pot. Cut vegetables: 1. Pork belly, cut into 2mm thick slices 2. Garlic sprouts, cut into 3cm sections 3. Green onion, cut into 0.2cm thin slices 4. Ginger, cut into 1mm x 1mm x 3cm filaments 5. Garlic, smash on a cutting board and cut into 1mm particles Stir-fry: 1. Heat the pot, dry out the water, add 3ml cooking oil 2. Hold the pot handle, shake the pot so that the cooking oil fully covers 2/3 of the pot 3. On medium heat, add the meat slices and stir-fry for 1 minute 4. Add onion, ginger, garlic, cooking wine, and continue to stir-fry for 1 minute. 5. Add the garlic sprouts into the pot, and stir-fry for 1 minute. 6. Start seasoning, add dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt, chicken essence, and thirteen spices, and stir-fry for 1 minute. 7. Add 500ML water to cover the vegetables, and simmer for 1 minute. 8. Add the steamed noodles, stir continuously for 3 minutes, until the noodles are all evenly colored, and turn off the heat. 9. Pour all the mixed noodles and vegetables into an extra basin for the second steaming: 1. Heat up the pot, add 70% cold water, put the steaming grate, and evenly spread the mixed noodles and vegetables on top 2. After the water boils, cook on high heat for 15 minutes, then remove from the pot 3. Pour 10g of sesame oil and serve
Additional content: Thickness and texture of noodles: - Thin, round (Most supermarkets have this kind, and the taste is stronger) - Wide, flat (softer texture)
Steam the noodles for the first time until they are done. Shake them loose and mix with a little oil to prevent them from clumping and becoming sticky during re-steaming.
Stir-fry the pork belly over low heat to remove the oil, then add the garlic sprouts and stir-fry quickly over high heat. The meat will be more fragrant and the dish will not brown.
Steam for no more than ten minutes for the second time. When the steam is stable, turn off the heat and simmer for two minutes. The texture will be chewier.

Case study: At noon on weekends, I sauteed the pork belly and stir-fried it with garlic sprouts, mixed in the steamed thin noodles and steamed them for ten minutes. When they came out of the pan, they were shiny and non-stick, and my family added two bowls of them.

items.title: Tengzhou vegetable pancakes
items.core: Tengzhou vegetable pancakes are a traditional snack in Tengzhou City, Shandong Province. They were founded in the Qing Dynasty and were created by Wang Niugao. It is made of white flour pancakes wrapped with cabbage, vermicelli, tofu and other seasonal vegetables, paired with eggs, ham sausage, and fried with oil and spices. The finished product is crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, fresh and refreshing, suitable as a staple food or breakfast. It takes about 15 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - White flour pancakes (commercially available Shandong pancakes, or homemade) - Cabbage - Vermicelli (dried) - Tofu - Carrots - Leeks (optional) - Eggs - Ham sausage (optional) - Cooking oil - Salt - MSG (optional) - Cumin powder - Chili powder (optional) - Black pepper - Spoon or flat-bottomed non-stick pan (diameter no less than 28 cm)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Total amount: - Number of white flour pancakes = number of servings * 2 sheets - Cabbage = number of servings * 100 g - Vermicelli (dry weight) = number of servings * 50 g - Tofu = number of servings * 80 g - Carrots = number of servings * 50 g - Leeks = number of servings * 30 g (optional) - Eggs = number of servings * 1 piece - Ham sausage = number of servings * 40 g (optional) - cooking oil = number of servings * 20 ml - salt = number of servings * 2 g - MSG = number of servings * 1 g (optional) - cumin powder = number of servings * 2 g - chili powder = number of servings * 2 g (optional) - black pepper = number of servings * 1 g

Operation: 1. Soak the vermicelli in warm water for 10 minutes until soft, remove and drain, and cut into no more than 5 pieces cm segments, set aside 2. Wash the cabbage and cut into thin strips no more than 1 cm wide; peel the carrots and cut into thin strips no more than 1 cm wide; cut the tofu into small dices no more than 1 cm square; wash the leeks and cut them into segments no more than 1 cm wide. Put everything into a mixing bowl. 3. Add 15 ml of cooking oil, 2 g of salt, 1 g of MSG, 2 g of cumin powder, 1 g of black pepper, and 2 g of chili powder in the mixing bowl. Stir evenly with chopsticks to coat the vegetables evenly with the seasoning. Set aside. 4. Preheat a pan (or spatula) over medium heat, pour 5 ml of cooking oil, and turn the pan to spread the oil all over the pan. Break in the eggs, use a spatula to break up the egg whites and yolks, and spread them into a round thin egg crust that is slightly smaller than the pancake. 5. Take 1 pancake and lay it flat on the egg skin so that the egg skin fits the pancake. Cover the vegetable pancake with a spatula and press lightly with a spatula to make the two layers of pancake fit together. 8. Turn on medium-low heat and heat for 2 minutes until the bottom is slightly brown. Use a spatula to turn the whole pancake over and continue to heat for 2 minutes until the other side is slightly brown and oily. 9. Turn to minimum heat and continue to heat for 1 minute until both sides are golden brown and the vegetables are cooked (you can insert chopsticks into the center to confirm that there is no resistance from the raw vegetables) 10. Turn off the heat, fold both sides of the vegetable pancake towards the middle into a rectangle about 10 cm wide, use a spatula or knife to divide it in half from the middle, and serve on a plate

Additional content: - Vegetables can be replaced according to preference: spinach, pumpkin, radish, shepherd's purse, etc., and the total amount of vegetables in a single serving should be kept at 300-350 g - Vegetable pancakes are suitable for eating while hot; if left at room temperature for more than 30 minutes, they will become soft and lose their crispy taste - If there is no spatula, use a flat-bottomed non-stick pan with a diameter of not less than 28 cm. Be careful not to overheat the pancakes to avoid burning them - white flour pancakes can be purchased commercially; you can also use 100 g of flour and 150 ml of drinking water to make a thin batter and spread it on the pan - Reference: Tengzhou Cuisine Pancakes - Baidu Encyclopedia
Squeeze out the water from the cabbage and vermicelli first to prevent the pancakes from becoming soft and broken during baking, and the texture will be crispier.
Do not fill the pancakes with more than seventy percent of the filling. Roll them up tightly and flatten them before putting them in the pan. They will not spread easily when you turn them over.
Fry over low heat twice until both sides are golden brown, then simmer for half a minute to let the eggs and vegetables cook thoroughly.

Case: On the morning of work day, I mixed cabbage, vermicelli and eggs and spread them on the pancakes. I rolled them up and seared them on both sides over low heat. After five minutes, they were out of the pan. The outside was crispy and they were still hot when I brought them to work.

items.title: Ham Rice Balls
items.core: A simple and quick Japanese-style rice ball. The salty ham is paired with salad dressing and seaweed. It has a rich and filling taste. Rich in carbohydrates, proteins and vitamins, it can quickly replenish energy. It is extremely easy to make and can be easily picked up by novices. It only takes about 1 hour from cooking to completion.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Ham - Rice - Water - Frozen green beans (optional) - Frozen corn kernels (optional) - Shredded seaweed (optional) - Favorite salad dressing (Japanese mayo is recommended!)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Per portion: - Ham (100g) - Rice (125g) - Water (90ml) - Frozen green beans (30g) - Frozen corn kernels (30g) - Shredded seaweed (10g) - Favorite salad dressing (20g) - Edible oil 10-15ml

Operation: 1. Put the rice and water into the rice cooker, click rice mode, and wait for completion 2. Place frozen corn kernels and green beans in a pot, add water to cover all ingredients, wait for 2 minutes after boiling, then remove. 3. Cut the ham into 1cm cubes 4. At the same time, add 10ml of cooking oil, add the ham and stir-fry until the ham is colored. 5. Put the rice, ham, chopped seaweed, green beans, corn kernels and salad dressing into a bowl and mix evenly. 6. Plate (if any)
Additional content: - The degree of salad dressing can be reduced according to personal taste. - Try mixed salad dressings. - Reference: Xiaohongshu - Dry rice contestants are sleepy again
After the rice is cooked, let it dry until it is not too hot before wrapping it. If it is too hot, the salad dressing will overflow and it will be difficult to shape it.
Dip a small amount of cold water on your hands and press the rice balls. The rice grains will not stick to your hands easily and the surface will be firmer and shiny.
Apply the seaweed before going out to avoid being refrigerated for a long time and retaining moisture, and it will still remain crispy and fragrant when eaten.

Case: In order to catch the next day’s bento at night, I wrapped the diced ham and salad dressing in warm rice, dipped it in water and formed a triangular rice ball, covered it with seaweed and refrigerated it, and took it away in the morning without falling apart.

items.title: Fried jelly
items.core: Fried jelly is a special snack in Shanxi and Shaanxi regions. It is smooth and tender in the mouth, salty and slightly spicy, with the aroma of garlic and sauce. Jelly is mainly made of starch, which can provide rich carbohydrates and quickly replenish energy. The cooking difficulty is moderate and suitable for novices with a certain basic knowledge. The whole process takes about 15 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - jelly - corn oil - garlic - chives - bean paste - light soy sauce - dark soy sauce - salt - thirteen spices - medium thick chili noodles - mineral water

Calculation: The following materials are for one person. You need to determine how many copies you plan to make before each production. One serving is just enough for one person. - 500g jelly - 10ml corn oil - 10g minced garlic - 15g chives - 15g bean paste - 20ml light soy sauce - 10ml dark soy sauce - 5g salt - 5g Shisanxiang - 15g medium-thick chili noodles - 20ml mineral water

Operation: 1. Change the jelly to the size of mahjong pieces 2. Turn on low heat and heat the oil in a pot. After the pot is slightly hot, add minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. Add bean paste and stir-fry until the red oil comes out. 3. Add the jelly cubes into the pot and stir-fry for 10 seconds. 4. Add light soy sauce to enhance the flavor and dark soy sauce to add color. Stir-fry evenly. Add chili noodles and continue to stir-fry evenly. 5. Add salt and thirteen spices and continue to stir-fry for 10 seconds. 6. Add the prepared mineral water and stir-fry again 10 Seconds, when the soup thickens, turn off the heat and serve on a plate. 7. Sprinkle with chopped green onion and it is done
Additional content: - When choosing jelly, it is best to use pea starch. If conditions do not permit, sweet potato starch or other can also be used
Cut the jelly into thick slices or small pieces. Drain the surface water before putting it in the pot. It will not break or splash oil when frying.
Heat oil in a hot pan and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant, then add the jelly and stir gently to keep the shape intact and beautiful.
Pour the light soy sauce and vinegar along the edge of the pot, stir quickly and turn off the heat. The sour aroma will be more prominent and water will not leak out easily.

Case study: I ​​only had a piece of jelly left after get off work. I cut it into thick slices, simmered it with minced garlic and chili pepper, and quickly stir-fried it. Seasoned with light soy sauce and vinegar, it was ready in ten minutes. It was tender and tasty and went well with rice.

items.title: Fried rice cake
items.core: This is a staple food in southern Fujian style. The rice cake is soft, waxy and chewy, with the burnt aroma of scallion oil, homely and filling. Rice cakes made from rice flour provide sufficient carbohydrates, and paired with eggs and vegetables, they can supplement protein and vitamins for a balanced nutrition. It’s simple, novice-friendly, and takes about 30 minutes from prep to dish.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - rice cakes/white rice cakes (no limit on shape) - green onions - seasonings: soy sauce, salt - (optional): eggs, greens

Calculation: You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Total amount: - 250 g rice cake * number of servings - 2 green onions * number of servings - cooking oil 50 ml - soy sauce 15 ml - salt 1-2g * number of servings, as per taste.

Operation: 1. Add water to the pot and boil, cook the rice cake. Add water to the bowl to ensure that the rice cake will not stick to each other. Remove the rice cake and set aside. 2. Cut the green onions into finely chopped green onions (separate the green onion whites and green onion leaves), and cut the green vegetables into small sections and set aside. 3. (Optional) Make scrambled eggs, see Tomato Scrambled Eggs. 4. Heat the pan and add 30ml cooking oil. 5. Pour the scallions into the pot until most of the scallions turn brown and become fragrant. Pour out the scallion oil and set aside. 6. Reheat the pan and add 20ml cooking oil. 7. Add all the auxiliary ingredients (eggs, vegetables, etc.) and stir-fry evenly. 8. Pour off the rice cake water and add rice cakes to the pot. 9. Add soy sauce and salt and stir-fry evenly. 10. Turn off the heat, add scallion oil, stir-fry evenly, and serve on a plate.

Additional content: - The selection of auxiliary ingredients can be added according to personal choice, such as adding lean meat, etc. - Be careful to stir when cooking the rice cakes to avoid sticking to the pan
Soak the rice cakes in cold water for ten minutes in advance to prevent them from sticking to the pan when frying and shorten the cooking time.
First stir-fry the eggs and take them out, then return them to the pot and mix well. The egg whites will not be old and the appearance will be better.
For green vegetables, choose Chinese cabbage or Shanghai greens. Leave the stems first and then the leaves to keep them crisp, tender and bright green in color.

Case study: For weekday dinner, I fry the eggs first, then put the soaked rice cakes and vegetables into the pan together, stir-fry them with scallion oil over high heat, and when they come out of the pan, they are soft and chewy, and I am full in ten minutes.

items.id: 炒意大利面-炒意大利面
items.title: Fried pasta
items.core: This fried pasta is soft, glutinous and refreshing. It is paired with fat beef and sauce. The sauce is rich and fragrant. It is a home-cooked staple food with a Western flavor. Rich in carbohydrates and protein, it can quickly replenish energy. The method is simple and can be easily mastered by novices, and the whole process takes about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Pasta - Beef slices - Tomato sauce / black pepper sauce (choose one) - Rapeseed oil (other vegetable oils are also acceptable)
Calculation: - 50 grams of pasta / person - 5 slices of fat beef / person - Edible oil 5ml / 50 grams of pasta

Operation: 1. Add 250 grams of water / person 2. When the water boils, add the noodles and cook over medium heat for 15 - 20 minutes (this noodle is usually hard, it is best to taste it before picking it up. If the center is a little hard, you need to continue cooking) 3. Take out the noodles and put them into a plate and set aside. 4. Pour cooking oil into the hot pot, wait until the oil is medium hot, add the noodles and stir-fry for one minute (if it is too dry, add a small amount of water) 5. Add 10 grams of tomato paste, beef, and 2g salt and continue to stir-fry for one minute 6. Heat the pot
Additional Content
Cook the pasta for two minutes less than the packaged time, leaving half a bowl of noodle soup, which makes it easier to coat the sauce when frying.

The fat beef slices are quickly scattered after being put into the pot, and they are taken out immediately when they change color. Finally, they are returned to the pot and stir-fried briefly to keep them tender and smooth.
Saute the sauce over low heat until fragrant before adding the noodles to avoid clumping and the flavor can hang evenly on each noodle.

Case: For lunch when living alone, I cooked the pasta until medium rare, sauteed the beef and garlic slices in another pot until fragrant, poured in the pasta and sauce, stirred well, sprinkled with black pepper and put it on the plate, the sauce was fragrant but not greasy.

items.title: Fried instant noodles
items.core: This fried instant noodles has a chewy texture and a salty aroma. It is a quick home-cooked staple food that is improved from traditional boiled noodles. Paired with eggs and ham, it enriches the source of protein and energy. The method is simple, just rinse the noodles with cold water to maintain the taste. Even a novice can complete it easily. The whole process can be done in about 15 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Instant noodles * Eggs * Ham sausage (optional)

Calculation: You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Total quantity: * The amount of instant noodles is 1 pack/person. *The amount of eggs is 1/person. * The amount of ham sausage is 1 piece per person. * The dosage of cooking oil is 10 - 18 ml / person. Using the conditions above, calculate the proportion of raw materials you plan to use.

Operation: Pre-processing of ham sausage: 1. Tear the ham sausage out of the package and cut into small pieces with a width of 1cm. Noodle processing: 1. Add 1200 ml of water to the cooking pot, and the actual amount will be enough to cover the noodles. Bring to a full boil and do not add noodles while it is still boiling. 2. Add instant noodles and cook for 45 seconds. Stir it during cooking to break up the noodles. 3. Turn off the heat immediately after the noodles are broken up. Don't overcook! 4. Scoop out 80ml of hot noodle soup from the pot and set aside. 5. Separate the noodle soup and noodles. Rinse the noodles with cold water. 6. Drain the water from the noodles. Do not soak the noodles in water for a long time. Sauce processing: 1. Prepare a small bowl and squeeze the instant noodles seasoning packet into it. * Squeeze in all the vegetable packets * Squeeze in all the sauce packets * Squeeze in 50% - 80% of the powder packets. (Squeezing all the flour packets in will make it very salty) 2. Pour all 80ml of hot noodle soup from the previous step into a small bowl, stir well to get a seasoning bowl. Pre-processing of eggs: 1. Take out the calculated number of eggs and break them into a small bowl. Don't add salt! (The eggs will eventually mix with the salt of the ingredients in the pan) 2. Heat the pan for 20s and add portions * 8ml of oil. 3. Add the bowl of eggs you just prepared. Stir-fry for about 20 seconds until the eggs become solid. 4. Take out the fried eggs and store them temporarily. No need to wash the pot. But generally there won’t be too much oil left in the pot. Final steps: 1. Reheat the pan for 20s and add oil to the pan: number of servings * 10ml. 2. Add the ham processed in the first step. Stir-fry for 10 seconds. 3. Add the dough from step 2. Stir-fry for 30 seconds. 4. Add the seasoning bowl from step 3. Stir-fry for 30 seconds. 5. Add the fried eggs from step 4. Stir-fry for 30 seconds. 6. Turn off the heat and serve.

Additional content: * In Beijing, consider adding sesame sauce after serving. If the tahini is too thick, dilute it with water 1:1. * Must use cold water to make noodles! Cold water can instantly peel off the gelatinized starch on the surface of the noodles and forcibly interrupt the residual temperature heating inside. This is the core principle to ensure that the noodles do not become lumpy when fried, do not stick to the pan, and maintain elasticity. * Another way to process noodles can also make the noodles chewy and chewy. This prolongs the overall processing time of the noodles and allows you to prepare other auxiliary ingredients at the same time: * Washing the noodles: Soak the instant noodle cakes in cold water for 2 minutes to completely absorb the water and become moist, remove and drain (no need to soak them until soft). * Steaming: Put the wet noodle cake into the steamer, boil the water and steam over high heat for 8 minutes, take it out and shake it out and set aside (steaming can lock in the moisture and ensure the elasticity of the noodles).
The instant noodles are cooked until they just fall apart, then drained under cold water. They will not become soft and lumpy when fried.
Put half of the seasoning pack in first and add it after tasting to avoid the saltiness of the ham itself from being overly salty.
Fry the eggs into large pieces first, then scoop them out, and then return them to the pan to maintain the aroma and tender taste.

Case: I worked overtime until nine o'clock in the evening. After boiling soft instant noodles, I immediately poured them into cold water, stir-fried them with the eggs and ham sausage in the hot pot, added the sauce packets and stirred them well. After eating them in twelve minutes, they were still very chewy.

items.title: Fried rice noodles
items.core: Fried rice noodles is a classic snack popular in Guangdong. It is full of wok flavor, dry and smooth. The rice noodles are soft, tough and translucent. It is paired with shredded pork, bean sprouts and cucumbers, and has a rich taste. It mainly provides carbohydrates and protein, and the addition of vegetables also supplements vitamins and dietary fiber. This recipe is moderately difficult, and even a novice can try it as long as he has all the ingredients. The entire preparation process takes about 30 minutes and can be served on the table.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Fried rice noodles, pork/beef * Stir-fried ingredients: salt, MSG, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, cumin powder (or use rice noodles directly) * Other seasonings: pepper * Cucumber, gluten cubes, mung bean sprouts, eggs, garlic cloves, shallots, starch * Basins, plates Suggested purchase plan: Purchase fresh rice noodles in bags on platforms such as Moubao and Maicai. The price usually starts at 1 jin and has a refrigerated shelf life of up to two weeks. Rice noodles stir-fry ingredients are also included!

Calculation: * The dosage of rice noodle is 250g/person. If you need more food, you can add 100g/person and round down. * 30g cucumber shreds/person, 30g gluten pieces/person, 30g mung bean sprouts/person, 1 beaten egg/person. * 2 chopped garlic cloves/person, 1 green onion/person * 20g of rice noodles ingredients can be added per person. If you prepare your own stir-fry ingredients, you can add 10g of salt + 2g of MSG + 3g of cumin powder. * Starch can be prepared at a ratio of 100g meat + 5g starch. *Dark soy sauce/light soy sauce, respectively, are 10ml/15ml per 250g of rice noodles.

Operation: Preparation work: 1. Chop the green onions (separate the green onions and leaves), smash the garlic cloves, and set aside on the chopping board. 2. Crack the eggs, scoop a little of the egg white into one bowl, and throw the rest into another bowl and set aside. 3. Add mung bean sprouts to the pot and cook over high heat for 60 seconds. Remove the bean sprouts, rinse in cold water, and place in a plate for later use. 4. Cut the cucumber into shreds and put it on a plate for later use. You can throw it with the bean sprouts. 5. Dispose of gluten and transfer to a separate plate. 6. Cut the meat into thin strips, add starch, egg white and pepper from the bowl just now, and mix evenly in a clockwise direction. 7. Note: Liangpi purchased from supermarkets usually has cooking oil on the surface and can be cleaned with tap water. Same with gluten. 8. Note: After washing the gluten, please squeeze out a lot of water from the gluten with your hands (no need to use too much force). Stir-fry meat in a hot pan: 1. Add cooking oil, heat the pan and pour it out. 2. Pour in the cooked meat, stir-fry evenly until it changes color, pour into a bowl and set aside. Stir-fry rice noodles: 1. While the pot is hot, add 20g of cooking oil (people with high blood pressure can reduce the amount), add scallions and garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Add the rice noodles, pour in the dark soy sauce to enhance the color, stir-fry evenly, then add the rice noodles stir-fry ingredients and continue to stir-fry. 3. When the rice noodles are almost transparent, add the fried shredded pork and gluten, add light soy sauce to enhance the freshness, and stir-fry twice. 4. Add bean sprouts and cucumber shreds and stir-fry until the rice noodles are completely transparent. 5. Turn off the heat! Final steps: 1. Garnish with green onion leaves and lift the pot. 2. Pour it into a plate and start cooking the rice.

Additional content: Personal tastes vary according to region, weather, and time. The specific amount of seasonings to be used depends on personal circumstances. If you like chili, you can add it yourself.
After buying the rice noodles, shake them first and gently separate them with your hands to make them more flavorful when fried.
Burn the pot until it is smoking slightly, then add oil. Stir-fry the shredded meat until it changes color, which can bring out enough pot gas.
Add the bean sprouts and cucumber shreds last and stir-fry over high heat for 30 seconds to keep them crispy and moist.

Case study: For weekend lunch, I shaken up the rice noodles and cut them into wide strips, quickly stir-fried the shredded pork and bean sprouts in a hot pan, then added the rice noodles and cucumber shreds for seasoning. The dish was dry and smooth without sticking into a lump.

items.title: Fried steamed buns
items.core: Fried steamed buns are a salty and crispy home-cooked noodle dish with northern flavor. The diced steamed buns are fried until golden brown, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The addition of cumin and five-spice powder makes the flavor more intense. It can be paired with eggs to provide protein and green onions to add fragrance and balanced nutrition. It is moderately difficult to make and can be easily picked up by novices. It is expected to be ready in about 15 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Steamed buns (slightly harder the next day is better) * Salt * Oil * Cumin powder * Five-spice powder * Spring onions * Eggs (optional)

Calculation: * 2 steamed buns (slightly harder the next day is better) * Salt 3g * Oil 20ml (peanut oil or sesame oil is better) * Cumin powder 3g * Chili powder 3g * Five-spice powder 3g * Shallots 2 * eggs (optional, 2) Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials you plan to use.

Operation: 1. Cut the steamed buns into small pieces or slices. 2. If there are eggs, break them into a bowl and beat them up (you can add 1g each of salt and five-spice powder or not, and add them during the frying process). 3. Pour the eggs on the steamed buns and mix well. Do not add too many eggs. 4. Heat the pot over high heat and pour in cooking oil (if you are afraid of damaging the stainless steel pot, you can pour the oil first and heat it until the oil is hot) 5. Add the diced buns and stir-fry evenly. 6. Reduce the heat to low and fry until the buns turn golden brown. 7. Add salt, pepper and allspice. 8. Finally add the chopped green onion and stir-fry for a few times. 9. Turn off the heat and remove from the pot.

Additional content: - Pay attention to control the heat during the frying process to prevent it from being burnt - Remedies for high heat: Turn down the heat, add oil or sprinkle water along the edge of the pot, be careful not to pour it all in one place, it is best to spread it out - Seasonings can be added according to personal preferences (such as Nande seasoning) - If you like to eat crispy food, you can turn the heat to the minimum, stir-fry for a while, turn off the heat and wait for a while while the pot is hot before pouring it out, it will be more crispy - The auxiliary ingredients can also be minced garlic, garlic sprouts, etc. according to personal taste. They can be sautéed separately and mixed
Cut the steamed buns into 1cm square dices, all of the same size, which will heat evenly and make the outer skin crispier.
The egg liquid only covers the surface of the steamed buns. Don't soak them for too long, otherwise they will become sticky and not crumbly when fried.
First fry over medium-low heat until golden brown, then sprinkle with cumin and five-spice powder. The aroma will be stronger and less likely to be bitter.

Case: I had two steamed buns left at home. I cut them into small dices, fried them in a pan with eggs and green onions, and sprinkled them with cumin and five-spice powder. After ten minutes, the diced steamed buns will be golden and crispy. Paired with a cup of soy milk, it will be a simple dinner.

items.title: Zhajiang Noodles
items.core: Zhajiang Noodles is a traditional Beijing home-cooked noodle dish with rich sauce and chewy noodles. It is paired with refreshing dishes and is salty and sweet. The main nutrients come from lean protein and vegetable vitamins, which can provide the human body with sufficient energy. The method is friendly to novices and the preparation time is expected to be about 30 minutes. Once mastered, the time can be further shortened by preparing the vegetables and stir-frying the sauce in parallel.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * diced/minced meat * noodles (vermicelli or ordinary noodles) * garlic * vegetable code (select according to personal preference, usually 4-10 types, you can choose cucumber, cabbage, radish, etc.) * bean paste * sweet noodle sauce

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One portion is just enough for 1 person. Each portion: * diced pork/minced meat 150g. If you choose noodles*: 150g. If you choose ordinary noodles: 250g * green onions 15g * total vegetable code 35g * edible oil 10g * bean paste 20g * sweet noodle sauce 20g

Operation: 1. Cut the vegetable code into shreds and set aside. 2. Chop green onions. Heat the oil pan, add the onion and meat, and stir-fry until the meat is completely cooked (no red color). 3. Add the bean paste and sweet noodle sauce, and continue to stir-fry until slightly sticky. Dish out and get the fried sauce. 4. Take a large bowl, add cold water and set aside. 5. Cook the noodles until they are tender (no white core) and put them into the bowl filled with cold water in step 4. 6. Immediately drain out the water and put it into a clean bowl. 7. Take the fried sauce from step 3, pour it into a bowl and mix well. Then take the recipe from step 1, pour it into a bowl, and mix well.
