Additional content: * It is recommended to use lean diced meat, which tastes better. It is recommended to buy it now and use it now. For noodles, it is recommended to use regular noodles*. * The key to the texture of noodles lies in their consistency. Do not choose thin noodles such as Longxu. * If conditions permit (another pot) and you are proficient, steps 2, 3 and 1, 4, 5, and 6 can be executed in parallel in a time-sharing manner. * I personally have a preference for sweet and salty flavors, and the ratio of the two sauces needs to be iteratively optimized by myself.
Choose 30% fat and 70% lean meat. After frying slowly over low heat to release the oil, the sauce will be more fragrant and not burnt.
Mix sweet noodle sauce and soybean paste at a ratio of one to one, with a balance of salty and sweet, making it easier for novices to master the seasoning.
Drain cucumber shreds and bean sprouts before placing them on the surface to avoid diluting the fried sauce and make the taste more refreshing and crisp.

Case study: When friends came to my house, I fried the diced meat over low heat to make a sauce. While the noodles were cooking, I cut the cucumbers and bean sprouts. After mixing the noodles with the sauce, I garnished them with vegetables. Everyone ate them very cleanly and asked about how to make them.

items.title: Pancakes
items.core: This home-style pancake has distinct layers, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, with a crispy burnt aroma. It is a common staple food on northern tables. It mainly provides carbohydrates and energy and is suitable for consumption with dishes. It requires a bit of skill to make, especially the rolling and rolling out the cakes, but it is not difficult to follow the steps and can be mastered by novices. It takes about 1 hour from kneading to baking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Oil * Flour * Electric baking pan
Calculation: Note: This staple food does not provide less or more versions, here is the most suitable amount for novices: * Flour = 400g * Hot water = 130ml (80 degrees) * Cold water = 130ml

Operation: 1. Add 400g Pour the flour into a basin, mix half with cold water and half with hot water, stir into dough, and knead into a ball with your hands. Seal it with plastic wrap and let it rest for 40 minutes. 2. When there are still 10 minutes left before the resting time is completed, please check the pastry method in Tips (hot pastry is more effective) 3. Don’t knead the risen dough, press it slightly, and use a horizontal knife and a vertical knife to divide it into four parts. 4. Roll it into a ball, roll it out, and roll it into a cake about the same size as the electric pan. Take 1/4 of the pastry and spread it evenly on the surface of the cake. 5. Cut along the radius of the cake, roll it into a cone from the outer ring, and then pinch the end of the cone to prevent the pastry from leaking out. 6. Press the conical tip of the dough to flatten it, and then roll it out again into a dough about the same size as the electric baking pan (thickness is about 3mm). 7. Preheat the electric baking pan, apply cold oil (hot pan, cold oil), put the rolled cake into the electric baking pan, brush the top of the cake with some oil, spread evenly (to lock in moisture), and cover the lid. 8. Fry on high heat for one minute, open the lid, turn the cake over and bake for another minute. 9. Repeat the above steps to complete the baking of the cake
Additional Content
Knead the dough with half boiling water and half cold water. The dough will be softer and less likely to shrink and deform when rolling out the cake.
Don’t spread the pastry too thickly. Leave a centimeter on the edge so that it can be sealed without oil leakage when rolled up.
Slowly fry the pan over low heat until the pancake puffs up and then flip over. The layers will be more distinct and less likely to burn.

Case study: For Sunday breakfast, I mixed the dough with half-boiled dough and let it rest for 20 minutes. I greased the pastry and rolled it into a long strip, then rolled it into a cake. I seared both sides over low heat until it bulged, and the layers were clear and fragrant.

items.title: Sesame Shaobing
items.core: Sesame Shaobing is a well-known pastry in the north. The outer shell is covered with sesame seeds and is crispy and delicious, and the inner layer is well-structured, soft and delicious. Flour provides ample carbohydrates, and sesame seeds are rich in calcium and unsaturated fatty acids. Although the production process includes steps such as kneading dough and making puff pastry, the operation is not complicated and even beginners can follow it. It takes about 40 minutes from prep to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Flour - Yeast powder - White sugar - Thirteen spices - Edible oil - Warm water (40℃)
Calculation: The recipe ingredients are the amount of 7 cakes

Operation: 1. Dough: 300 grams of flour, 3 grams of yeast powder, 3 grams of white sugar, 180 grams of warm water, 20 grams of cooking oil, rest for 10 minutes 2. Pastry: place 30 grams in a small bowl Grams of flour, 2 grams of salt, 4 grams of Panxiang, 20 grams of cooking oil, mix well and let stand 3. Make cakes: roll the dough into a rectangular shape, spread with the prepared pastry, roll up from one end, cut into 7 pieces of dough, fold in half, gather it with the tiger's mouth, first dip it in water and then white sesame seeds, roll it into a small round cake 4. Pancakes: Preheat the electric pancake pan, pour cold oil (the bottom of the pan is covered with oil), put the rolled pancakes into the pancake pan, brush some oil on top of the pancakes, spread evenly and cover the lid, select the large pancake pan, and when you hear a ding sound, take it out of the pan
Additional content: - If you don’t have an electric pancake pan, you can also use a pan - You don’t have to use sesame seeds, it’s just as delicious
After the dough has doubled in size, it will be fully deflated. The inside of the sesame biscuits will be softer and the texture will not be dull.
Brush a thin layer of water on the surface and then dip it in sesame seeds. It will stick firmly when roasted and the sesame seeds will not fall off easily.
The oven is heated at 200 degrees Celsius for 18 minutes, until the surface turns golden. Avoid drying out the oven if the time is too long.

Case study: During lunch in the afternoon, I rolled out the dough and spread it with butter. After rolling it, I pressed it into small cakes, brushed them with water and dipped in sesame seeds. I baked them in the oven for 18 minutes. The outer shell was crispy and fragrant, and the inside was soft and layered.

items.title: Hot Dry Noodles
items.core: Hot dry noodles are one of the most representative snacks in Wuhan and belong to Hubei cuisine. The alkaline water noodles are chewy and smooth, covered in thick sesame sauce, and paired with pickled beans, dried radish and minced meat. It is salty, slightly spicy and has a mellow taste. Providing primarily carbohydrates and protein, tahini is also rich in calcium. It is simple and quick to make, and even novices can easily get started. It only takes about ten minutes from cooking to mixing.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Alkaline water surface unique to hot dry noodles * Spring onions * Pickles * Minced meat * Garlic water * Broth juice * Dried radish * Sesame paste * Chili oil * Pepper * Soy sauce * Salt * Chicken essence

Calculation: Per portion: * Hot dry noodles’ unique alkaline water surface (250g) * Spring onions (10g) * Pickled beans (20g) * Minced meat (30g) * Garlic water (30ml) * Broth juice (30ml) * Dried radish (50g) * Sesame paste (40ml) * Chili oil (0-10ml) * Pepper (0-10g) * Soy sauce (5ml) * salt (3g) * chicken essence (0-3g)

Operation: 1. Boil water, add alkaline water, blanch for 25 seconds and remove. 2. Sprinkle salt, chicken essence and pepper 3. Dilute sesame paste with 90ml water, stir well, and then add 4. Add 5ml soy sauce, 30ml broth and garlic water 5. Add dried radish, minced pork, pickled beans, chopped green onion 6. Mix well and serve
Additional content: * Add chili oil according to personal taste
Boil the alkaline water until it is just raw, take it out, shake it off after cooling, and the texture will be more chewy and less likely to form lumps.
Mix the sesame paste with warm water in small amounts several times, then add light soy sauce, salt and sesame oil to make it smoother.
Chop the pickled beans and dried radish in advance and drain, then sprinkle in and mix well to increase the crispiness and salty aroma.

Case: At noon on Saturday, Xiao Li rushed to work. He boiled alkaline water first, then mixed sesame paste, sprinkled with pickled beans and dried radish, mixed a bowl of hot dry noodles in ten minutes, and went out on time after eating.

items.title: Teriyaki Chicken Leg Rice
items.core: Teriyaki Chicken Leg Rice is a sweet and salty side dish. The chicken legs are fried until fragrant and then blended into the rich sauce, giving it a tender and smooth taste. Chicken thighs are rich in high-quality protein, and paired with broccoli and carrots, they can supplement dietary fiber and vitamins. Making it requires a little bit of bone removal skills, but the overall process is not complicated and even a novice can succeed by following the steps. From preparation to cooking, it can be on the table in about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Chicken legs - Cooking wine - Light soy sauce - Honey (optional) - Crushed black pepper - Black pepper powder - Salt - Broccoli (if not available, use non-spicy green pepper instead) - Carrots - Dark soy sauce - Garlic - Ginger - Edible oil - Water - Rice

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is enough for 1-2 people. Each portion: - 500 g chicken legs (about 3 pieces) - 15 ml cooking wine - 30 ml light soy sauce - 15 ml honey (if not available, use 20 g sugar + 5 g cornstarch + 0.5 ml lemon juice or vinegar instead) - 5 g chopped black pepper - 5 g black pepper powder - 2.5 g salt - 50 g broccoli - 50 g carrots - Dark soy sauce 12 ml - Garlic 10 g (smashed, no need to mince) - Ginger 10 g - Cooking oil 15-25 ml - Water 30 ml - Rice 300-400 g

Operation: 1. Take a chicken leg, skin side down and place it on the cutting board 2. Use the tip of a knife to gently cut along the outline of the chicken leg bone, from one end to the other 3. Use your fingers or the back of a knife to slowly push apart the chicken to expose the bones. If fascia is encountered, cut it off with the tip of a knife. 4. When the chicken is completely separated, hold one end of the bone, gently twist and pull it out. 5. Repeat the above steps to debone all the chicken legs. 6. Add black pepper powder, cracked black pepper, salt, and ginger slices to the boneless chicken legs and marinate for 5 minutes. 7. Add cooking wine, light soy sauce, honey, dark soy sauce and water to the bowl and mix well. 8. Blanch the vegetables for 1-2 minutes, cook and remove. 9. Heat oil in the pan 15 ml. Add the crushed garlic and sauté until fragrant. 10. Add the chicken legs and fry over medium-low heat until both sides are golden brown. If the pot feels too dry, add 5-10 ml of oil. 11. Add the prepared sauce, cover the lid and simmer over medium-low heat (use low heat on the gas stove) for 5-10 minutes until cooked through, and the sauce is thick and bubbly. 12. Cut into pieces, place on top of rice with vegetables, pour in the sauce for fried chicken legs and enjoy slowly

Additional content: - If you use a combination of white sugar and starch instead, be sure to completely dissolve the sugar and starch before adding it to the pot, otherwise it will be easy to burn the pot - Stir every 3-5 minutes during simmering to avoid local overheating - If the sauce bubbles, becomes dark brown, or fine caramel crystals appear on the edge, turn off the heat immediately - Reference material: [Step-by-step diagram of how to make Teriyaki Chicken Leg Rice, how to make Teriyaki Chicken Leg Rice delicious] Sister Xiaoxiao_Go to the Kitchen
Debone the chicken legs and pat them loosely with the back of a knife. Sprinkle a little salt and black pepper to make them more flavorful when fried.
First fry the chicken skin side down over low heat until golden brown, then turn over and fry until cooked through to avoid burnt on the outside and raw on the inside.
Mix the teriyaki sauce with light soy sauce, mirin, and sugar about 2:2:1, and stir constantly when the juice is reduced.

Case: On a weekday evening, Xiao Zhang didn’t want to order takeout after get off work. He fried the boneless chicken legs and then poured the teriyaki sauce to thicken it. He served it with broccoli and covered it with rice. He was full in half an hour and still had lunch left for the next day.

items.title: Boiled instant noodles with eggs
items.core: Boiled instant noodles with eggs is a convenient quick staple food with a smooth texture and rich soup flavor, suitable for filling your stomach at any time. Mainly provides carbohydrates and protein, which can quickly replenish energy. The method is extremely simple. You only need to boil water, boil noodles, and add eggs to cook. Even novices can easily master it. The whole process can be completed in about 10 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Instant noodles - Eggs - Water

Calculation: - One person can support an adult for about 3 to 4 hours without hunger. Per portion: - 1 pack of instant noodles - 550ml-1000ml of water, depending on the pot. The instant noodles can be completely immersed in it. - 1 egg

Operation: 1. Heat the water to boiling first (the heat is not strict, using hot water will be faster) 2. Put the taken out noodle cake into the pot 3. Put the condiments included in the instant noodles into the pot 4. Take out the chopsticks and stir the instant noodles slightly to fully dissolve the condiments and fully soak the noodles and heat them 5. Cover the pot and wait for about 1 minute until the water in the pot boils again 6. Peel the eggs and add them to the pot 7. Wait for about 3 to 4 minutes, then

Additional content: - Eggs in this guide include but are not limited to: raw eggs, cooked eggs, braised eggs, etc. - Raw materials for instant noodles can be purchased at the convenience store downstairs - Seasonings can be added according to personal needs, and other ingredients include but are not limited to: ham sausage, lettuce, shredded pork, spicy strips, dried fish, shrimp, chicken legs
Put the noodles in after the water boils and spread them out with chopsticks so that the noodles can be heated evenly without clumping.
If you want to add eggs, turn down the heat to low, slide the eggs into the side of the pot, and push the egg whites gently to disperse after they are solidified.
Put half of the seasoning packet in, taste the soup and then add more. Pair it with greens to relieve the greasy feeling.

Case: Xiao Chen came home from working overtime late on Wednesday and found that only instant noodles were left, so he boiled water and cracked in an egg, sprinkled with chopped green onion and green vegetables. After finishing a bowl of hot noodle soup in ten minutes, his stomach quickly warmed up.

items.title: Lard Bibimbap
items.core: This is a simple bibimbap full of southern home-cooked flavor. The rice grains are wrapped in melted lard, with the saltiness of soy sauce and the fragrance of chopped green onions. It is a safe choice for many children when they have a loss of appetite. It mainly provides quick carbohydrate and fat energy, but it has high cholesterol and should not be eaten frequently. There is no threshold for making it. Even if you don’t know how to cook, you can easily complete it. It only takes a few minutes to mix the cooked rice into a bowl of fragrant staple food.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Rice (Japonica rice is recommended) - Lard - Light soy sauce (Lee Kum Kee or Haitian is recommended) - Dark soy sauce - Oyster sauce (optional) - Chopped green onion (optional) - Lard residue (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is enough for 1 person. Per portion: - 200 g of rice - 15 g of lard (when adding oyster sauce, reduce to 10 g) - 5 ml of light soy sauce (when adding oyster sauce, reduce to 3 ml) - 2 ml of dark soy sauce - 8 g of oyster sauce - 0-12 g of chopped green onion (initial recommendation is 5 g) - 5 g of lard residue
Operation: 1. Spread lard on the bottom of the bowl 2. Add rice 3. Drizzle with soy sauce and oyster sauce 4. Sprinkle with chopped green onion and lard residue 5. Stir evenly

Additional content: - Recommended to eat with lean meat and vegetables to balance nutrition - High cholesterol, not recommended for regular consumption - Reference: Lard bibimbap - Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
The rice should be mixed while it is hot. The lard melts more easily. Add a small spoonful to each bowl first to make it fragrant.
Pour the soy sauce along the edge of the bowl, sprinkle with chopped green onions, and stir from the bottom to coat every grain of rice evenly.
This bowl is high in fat and sodium. Pair it with stir-fried vegetables that day. Don’t use it as breakfast for multiple days in a row.

Case: On a rainy day, the child had no appetite after school. The mother filled a bowl of hot rice, scooped out a small spoonful of lard, mixed it with soy sauce, and sprinkled with chopped green onion. The child quickly finished half the bowl and asked for more.

items.id: 电饭煲三文鱼炊饭-电饭煲三文鱼炊饭
items.title: Rice cooker salmon rice
items.core: This is a home-cooked dish that combines Japanese rice cooking methods. The rice absorbs the aroma of butter and salmon, and has a rich and delicious taste. Salmon provides high-quality protein and unsaturated fatty acids, and mushrooms add dietary fiber. The operation is extremely simple, just use the rice cooker to complete it with one click, and it takes about 45 minutes from preparing the ingredients to cooking, which is very suitable for novices to try.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Salted butter - Salmon - Rice - Corn (optional) - Enoki mushrooms (optional) - Mushrooms (optional) Tools: - Rice cooker
Calculation: - 50g of rice / person - 300g of salmon / person - Water - 1 tablespoon of butter / person

Operation: 1. Remove the scales and bones from the salmon 2. Chop the enoki and winter mushrooms 3. Wash the rice three times. 4. Put the salmon, rice and butter into the rice cooker. 5. If you want a thicker texture, add an extra tablespoon of butter. 6. Add water according to the scale of the rice cooker. 7. Adjust the rice cooker to rice cooker mode and wait for about 30 - 45 minutes
Additional Content
Drain the rice after washing, and use slightly less water than usual for cooking so that the cooked rice will not become sticky.
Cut the salmon into pieces and marinate them with salt and pepper for ten minutes. The mushrooms can absorb the fish aroma and oil.
After the rice cooker trips, let it simmer for another ten minutes. Open the lid and use a rice spoon to fluff it from the bottom to make the aroma more even.

Case: Roommates came to have a dinner at home on the weekend. Xiaolin washed the rice in the rice cooker, added water, spread mushrooms and marinated salmon pieces, pressed the button and waited, then opened the lid and mixed the rice. Everyone felt relieved when they tasted the aroma of fish and cooked rice.

items.id: 空气炸锅照烧鸡饭-空气炸锅照烧鸡饭
items.title: Air Fryer Teriyaki Chicken Rice
items.core: This Japanese teriyaki-style chicken rice has a rich sweet and salty sauce. The surface is slightly crispy and the inside is soft and juicy. It goes very well with rice. Chicken and eggs provide plenty of high-quality protein, but more soy sauce and sugar are used, which is more suitable for occasionally improving the taste. The method is simple, just mix the ingredients and hand it to the air fryer. Even a novice can make it easily. It takes about 1 hour from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Ritz crackers - soy sauce - sugar (white sugar)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Each portion: - 900g chicken - 100-125ml soy sauce - 60-65g sugar - 30-35ml white vinegar - 16 Ritz crackers (savory cookies can be substituted) (48g) - 2 eggs

Operation: 1. Mix soy sauce, sugar and vinegar together, stir well and set aside. 2. Add chicken, eggs, 1/2 to another bowl Sauce and crushed Ritz crackers. Stir evenly 3. Place a foil bowl on the bottom of the air fryer, add the patty mixture, and pour the remaining sauce evenly on top. 4. Fry at 350°F (177°C) for 40 minutes. Best served on rice. 5. Take it out of the pot when it is golden and crispy, cut into pieces and serve on a plate

Additional content: - For how to make rice, please refer to steaming rice in a rice cooker or steaming rice in a pot - When operating, you need to pay attention to the temperature to avoid burns. - Reference: Cook's Food Tutorial: Air fryer Teriyaki Chicken Meatloaf
Cut the chicken legs into large pieces, wipe them dry, and coat them with a small amount of starch. The surface will be more charred when grilled.
Brush the teriyaki sauce twice. Bake for fifteen minutes before turning over and brushing again to prevent the sauce from becoming bitter.
After the rice is served, add chicken and soft-boiled eggs, and then drizzle a little sauce from the pot to make the taste more complete.

Case: Not wanting to turn on the range hood on Sunday afternoon, Xiao Zhou put the chicken legs and teriyaki sauce into the air fryer, flipped the chicken legs and teriyaki sauce halfway through to brush on the sauce, and served it with rice and soft-boiled eggs. It was delicious and satisfying for one person.

items.title: Pot Steamed Rice
items.core: This is a simple and unpretentious home-cooked staple food. You can make soft, glutinous and delicious rice in an ordinary pot. White rice mainly provides carbohydrates to quickly replenish energy for the body. The method is extremely simple, and novices can easily master it by paying attention to the heat throughout the process. It takes about 25 minutes from adding the rice to taking it out of the pan.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Northern rice - Water - Thick-bottomed cooking pot + tight-fitting lid (there will be no large amount of steam leaking during the production process)
Calculation: - Rice: 100ml-200ml/person - Water: 2 times the volume of rice

Operation: 1. Wash the rice 2. Add the rice and water to the pot 3. Boil over high heat until the water boils 4. Stir the bottom to prevent sticking 5. Cover the pot, turn to low heat and heat for 10-15 minutes (according to your preference for softness), do not open the lid during the process 6. Turn off the heat and let it sit 5 Minutes 7. Enjoy :)
Additional content: People from Fu country are studying cooking rice, I really want to give them a rice cooker!
After washing the rice, add water and soak it for ten minutes. After the rice grains absorb water, they will become more plump and not uncooked.
The amount of water should be about a knuckle higher than the rice noodles. After boiling over high heat, turn down the heat and cover and simmer until done. Do not open the cover frequently.
When the sound of water in the pot becomes smaller, remove from the heat and simmer for five minutes, then loosen the rice along the edge of the pot to prevent the bottom from burning.

Case: Xiao He, who just joined the company and lives in a dormitory, does not have a rice cooker. At night, he uses a pot to wash rice and add water. After boiling over high heat, he simmers the rice over low heat. After 25 minutes, he has soft rice and is very satisfied with fermented bean curd.

items.title: Steamed rice in rice cooker
items.core: A well-known basic staple food, the rice has a pure aroma and a soft and waxy texture. It can be hard or moist depending on the amount of water. Rich in carbohydrates, it can quickly replenish energy and is suitable for a variety of dishes. The operation is extremely simple, and even novices can easily get started. It takes about forty minutes from washing the rice to stewing it.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Rice cooker * Jiangnan rice or northern rice * Water

Calculation: * Generally, one person can eat 100ml-200ml of rice. Fingertip water measurement method (method used to accurately determine the amount of rice water) * Jiangnan rice, rice and water are placed in the rice cooker container. When the index finger touches the rice, the amount of water can just cover 1/4 of the first and second knuckles of the index finger (that is, about 2.6 cm). * For northern rice, put the rice and water in the rice cooker container, touch the rice with your index finger, and the amount of water can just cover the first knuckle of the index finger (that is, about 2 cm). Using the conditions above, calculate the proportion of raw materials you plan to use.

Operation: 1. Wash the rice 2. Add the rice and water to the rice cooker. 3. Connect the rice cooker to the power supply and enter heating mode. Wait approximately 30 minutes. 4. Wait until the rice cooker automatically enters the keep warm mode. 5. Simmer the rice in the rice cooker for 10-15 minutes. 6. Pour out the rice.

Additional content: - Technical summary - Regardless of the container, the amount of water can be used to cook good rice using the "fingertip water measurement method". - The amount of water can seriously affect the taste of a good bowl of rice. - The south generally eats Jiangnan rice, and the north generally eats northern rice. Jiangnan rice will be more slender, while northern rice will be shorter and rounder. - Different types of rice and different amounts of water will greatly affect the taste. - For more information, please refer to the instruction manual of the rice cooker you are using.
Add water to new rice at a ratio of 1:12, and add a little more to old rice. It is more appropriate to cook it until it is soft and hard.
Don’t rub the rice repeatedly for too long until the water is slightly clear, which can reduce the loss of nutrients and rice flavor.
Don’t open the lid halfway after pressing the cooking button. Leave it on for another ten minutes to make the rice softer.

Case: When Xiao Wu comes home from get off work every day, he is used to washing rice in the rice cooker and then frying two home-cooked dishes. After the rice is simmered by pressing the button, the rice grains are soft and the family of three quickly sits down to eat hot rice.

items.title: Red kidney bean bibimbap
items.core: This North Indian home-cooked dish is a traditional delicacy in Punjab and Delhi. The tomato and onion soup is rich and spicy. After simmering, the red kidney beans are soft and glutinous. It is warm and filling when mixed with hot rice. Beans are rich in protein, dietary fiber and a variety of trace elements, and are nutritionally balanced. The method is simple and can be easily started by beginners. The whole process takes about 40 minutes, but the dried beans need to be soaked for 8 hours in advance. Rich home-cooked taste, just like mom's.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Kidney Beans / Rajma - Basmati rice or regular rice - Onion - Tomato - Ginger - Garlic - Green chilli - Coriander - Cooking oil or ghee - Turmeric powder - Red chilli powder - Coriander powder - Cumin powder - Garam Masala - Bay leaf - Salt - Pressure cooker (recommended) or ordinary soup pot

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2-3 people. Per portion: Red kidney bean curry part: - 200g dry red kidney beans (soaked 8 hours in advance) - 2 onions (about 200g), chopped - 3 tomatoes (about 300g), chopped (or 30ml tomato paste) - 10g ginger, grated - 4 cloves of garlic (about 12g), grated - 1 green chili, slit - cooking oil 30ml - 2 bay leaves - turmeric powder 3g - red chilli powder 5g - coriander powder 5g - cumin powder 3g - Indian mixed spice powder 3g - salt 6g - water 600ml - coriander leaves 15g (for decoration) Rice part: - rice 200g - water 400ml

Operation: Preparation (8 hours in advance): 1. Soak dry red kidney beans in water for at least 8 hours (overnight). The volume will expand about twice after soaking. Cook red kidney beans: 1. Drain the soaked red kidney beans. 2. Use a pressure cooker: add red kidney beans and 600ml water, cover the pot, turn to medium heat after the fire is steamed, and press for 15-20 minutes, until the beans can be easily crushed with your fingers. 3. Use an ordinary pot: add red kidney beans and enough water, bring to a boil over high heat, then turn to medium heat and cook for 60-90 minutes until the beans are completely soft. 4. After cooking, reserve the bean soup water and set aside. To make the curry: 1. Pour 30ml cooking oil into the wok and heat over medium heat. 2. Add 2 bay leaves and fry until fragrant (about 10 seconds). 3. Add chopped onions and stir-fry until golden brown (approx. 6-8 minutes) 4. Add grated ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute 5. Add chopped tomatoes and stir-fry until tomatoes are completely soft and oily (about 5 minutes) 6. Add 3g turmeric powder, 5g red chili powder, 5g coriander powder, 3g cumin powder, 6g salt 7. Stir-fry for 2 minutes to allow the spices to blend with the tomatoes 8. Pour the cooked red kidney beans into the pot together with the soup 9. Add green chilies and stir evenly 10. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes 11. During this period, use the back of a spatula to crush part of the beans to make the soup thicker 12. Add 3g of Indian mixed spice powder and stir evenly 13. Turn off the heat and sprinkle with coriander leaves. Steam rice: 1. Rinse the rice clean 2. Put it in a rice cooker and add 400ml of water 3. Steam and serve as normal: 1. Put the rice into a plate 2. Pour the red kidney bean curry on or next to the rice 3. Can be paired with onion salad and lemon wedges

Additional content: - Red kidney beans must be cooked thoroughly before eating. Uncooked red kidney beans contain phytohaemagglutinin, which may cause food poisoning. - In India, Rajma Chawal is considered the most homely food, similar to China's "braised pork with rice". - If you want a richer taste, add 30ml whipping cream. - Leftover red kidney bean curry will taste even better when kept refrigerated for up to 3-4 days.
Soak dry red kidney beans for eight hours in advance and pour out the soaking water before cooking to reduce the feeling of flatulence.
Saute onions and tomatoes until soft and release the juice, then add cumin, chili powder and salt to make the soup base thicker.
When the beans are simmered until they can be crushed with the back of a spoon, turn off the heat and leave some soup to mix with the hot rice for more flavor.

Case: On Sunday morning, Xiaomei poured the red kidney beans soaked the night before into the pot, added sauteed tomatoes and onions and simmered slowly. At lunch, she poured it on the hot rice and mixed it well. The spicy aroma made the family full.

items.id: 老友猪肉粉-老友猪肉粉
items.title: Laoyou Pork Noodles
items.core: Laoyou Pork Noodles are sour, spicy and fragrant, and the rice noodles are smooth, with the unique rich flavor of tempeh and sour bamboo shoots. It is a typical Nanning home-cooked taste. Pork provides high-quality protein, while rice noodles quickly replenish carbohydrate energy. The overall preparation is moderately difficult. You need to pay attention to soaking the rice noodles in advance. Once you are proficient, it can be served in about 40 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Rice noodles - Pork - Sour bamboo shoots - Chopped pepper - Black bean sauce - Garlic - Cooking wine - Light soy sauce - White sugar - Rice vinegar - Salt - Oil - Cornstarch - Pepper

Calculation: per portion: - Rice noodles (250g, remember to soak in 50 degree warm water for half an hour) - Pork (50g) - Sour bamboo shoots (50g) - Chopped pepper (15g After mincing the peppers, add appropriate amount according to personal needs) - Tempeh (30g) - Garlic (10g) - Cooking wine (10-20ml) - Light soy sauce (15ml) - White sugar (5g, if you don't like sugar, you can consider leaving it out) - Rice vinegar (5ml) - Salt (5ml) - Oil (15ml) - Cornstarch (15ml) - Pepper (10ml)

Operation: 1. Pour all the pork into a bowl with cooking wine, salt, soy sauce, cornstarch, and pepper, and set aside. 2. Heat the pan without adding oil, add all the sour bamboo shoots, stir-fry them dry, and leave some space in the middle of the dried sour bamboo shoots. 3. Add 10ml - 15ml cooking oil, all garlic, chopped pepper, and black bean to the middle of the fried sour bamboo shoots, push them all to the middle and stir-fry until fragrant. 4. Add all the seasoned pork, continue to add 10ml of light soy sauce and stir-fry for one minute. 5. Add 5ml of rice vinegar, 10ml of light soy sauce, and 450ml of water and bring to a boil. 6. After the water boils, add the rice noodles soaked in warm water and continue to cook for 3 minutes before serving.
Additional content: - Remember that the rice noodles must be soaked to taste delicious. If they are not soaked, they will be difficult to eat!
Soak the dry rice noodles in warm water in advance and cut them into shorter lengths so that they are less likely to break into a ball after being put into the pot.
Sauté the sour bamboo shoots and tempeh in hot oil first, then add the meat slices and stir-fry, so that the flavor will be fully released.
The pork is marinated in light soy sauce, cooking wine and a little starch for ten minutes, making it more tender and less chewy.

Case: In the early morning of the rainy season in Nanning, Aunt Huang soaked the rice noodles, sauteed the sour bamboo shoots and black beans, then added the meat slices and stir-fried until fragrant, and cooked it into a hot and sour soup base.

items.title: Laoganma Noodles
items.core: A spicy and appetizing home-cooked noodle dish. The noodles are chewy and filled with the spicy aroma of Laoganma's black bean sauce. The soy sauce adds freshness, simple but full of flavor. As a staple food, it can quickly replenish carbohydrates and energy, and capsaicin can also help stimulate appetite. There is no barrier to making, and novices can easily master it. It only takes about ten minutes from boiling water to taking it out of the pot.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Noodles * Laoganma * Soy sauce

Calculation: You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. One portion is just enough for 1 person Total quantity: * Water 1 liter Noodles 120 grams Serving Laoganma 15ml Serving Soy sauce 5ml Serving

Operation: 1. Pour the water into the pot and bring to a boil 2. Put the noodles evenly into the pot 3. Stir carefully during the cooking process to prevent the noodles from sticking into a lump 4. When you pick up a noodle with chopsticks and the noodle can slide off the chopsticks naturally, wait another 30 seconds and turn off the heat. 5. Put the noodles into the bowl. 6. Add Lao Gan Ma and soy sauce according to the above measurement. 7. Use chopsticks to mix the noodles, Lao Gan Ma and soy sauce in the bowl evenly. 8. Eat
Additional Content
The noodles are cooked until they are slightly white in the middle, then take them out and leave half a bowl of noodle soup. Mix it and it will not be dry.
First put Laoganma, light soy sauce and a little sesame oil in the bottom of the bowl, pick up the noodles while they are hot and mix them quickly.
Add a handful of green vegetables or a fried egg to supplement vitamins and protein, and also make you less hungry.

Case: After working overtime on a rainy night, Xiao Zhao just wanted to eat quickly. He blanched the vegetables while cooking the noodles. He put Laoganma and soy sauce at the bottom of the bowl. When the hot noodles were mixed, the aroma came out, and he still felt appetizing after finishing it ten minutes later.

items.title: Meat and Egg Rice Bowl
items.core: This dish is rich in sauce, salty and sweet, the meat filling is charred, and the eggs are tender and smooth. It is very satisfying when topped with hot rice. It is a quick home-cooked dish. Rich in high-quality protein and essential amino acids, it can quickly replenish energy. The method is simple and intuitive, and even novices can easily get started. It only takes about fifteen minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Rice - Eggs - Minced meat - Dark soy sauce - Light soy sauce - Vinegar - Shallot oil (optional) - Green onion - Oil - Sugar

Calculation: One serving is for one person, for multiple people, please increase the amount in equal proportions, but you need to consider the capacity of the pot. One serving: - 240g rice - 4 eggs - 300g meat filling - 10ml dark soy sauce - 25ml light soy sauce - 20ml vinegar - optional 10g shallot oil - 10g green onions - 30ml oil - 15g sugar

Operation: 1. Cook the rice, usually use the measuring cup that comes with buying rice, one cup of rice is 240g 2. Put oil in the pot 30ml 3. Add the meat filling, adjust the heat to medium and fry until both sides are lightly browned. 4. Crack the eggs into the pot, do not break them up, and cover the pot with a lid. 5. Mix a bowl of juice, and put the calculated amount of dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and shallot oil into the bowl. Stir evenly. 6. Open the pot lid, pour the bowl of juice into the pot, and wait for three minutes. 7. Turn off the heat, and cover the rice with the meat and eggs. 8. Safety check, start eating the rice bowl
Additional content: - If you like sweet taste, you can add 10g of sugar - Please make sure to turn off the gas equipment after cooking to avoid danger
After the meat filling is put into the pot, press it loosely before frying until it is slightly charred and oily, and the sauce flavor will be more obvious.
Add a little salt and water to beat the eggs, stir-fry them until they are just solidified, and then serve them out for a more tender texture.
Mix the sauce with light soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and a little water, return to the pot to thicken and pour over the rice.

Case: He had a tight lunch break, so Xiao Liu stir-fried the minced meat with sauce, cooked the eggs in a separate pan, and covered them with the freshly heated rice. It was served to the table fifteen minutes later. The fragrant meat and eggs made him more energetic for work in the afternoon.

items.id: 茄子肉煎饼-茄子肉煎饼
items.title: Eggplant Pancakes
items.core: This home-made pancake combines the saltiness of bacon and the softness of eggplant. It is crispy on the outside and moist on the inside. It is a rice noodle staple food full of local flavor. It is rich in carbohydrates and high-quality protein. Eggplant can also provide dietary fiber and vitamins, with a balanced combination of meat and vegetables. The difficulty of making it is medium, and you need to master the consistency of the batter and the frying temperature, but beginners can also succeed if they follow the steps. It takes about 30 minutes from prep to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Rice flour (referring to flour ground from rice) * Wheat flour * Eggs * Cooked bacon * Eggplant (buy long strips, the rounder the better) * Cooking oil * Salt

Calculation: Make 1 serving, 1 serving is just enough for 2 people. Each portion: * 250g rice noodles * 50g flour * 1 egg * 100g cooked bacon * 1 eggplant (about 10-15cm long) * 10-15ml cooking oil * 1-2g salt

Operation: 1. Peel the eggplant and cut into slices, cut the bacon into slices, and set aside. 2. Add 250g to the basin in turn. Rice flour (ground rice), 50g flour and 1 egg 3. While stirring with chopsticks, add water (water is used to adjust the viscosity) to mix the rice flour, flour and eggs into a batter. Stop adding water when the batter can adhere to the eggplant slices and meat slices without falling off. Then put all the eggplant slices and meat slices into the batter and fully wrap them with the batter. 4. Add 10-30ml of cooking oil to the pan and turn on low heat 5. Use chopsticks or a spoon to put the batter-coated eggplant slices and meat slices into the pot, fry until both sides are golden brown, and then fry for 3-6 minutes (during the frying process, the cooking oil will become less, you can add more cooking oil) 6. Sprinkle salt, stir-fry evenly, remove from the pot and plate
Additional content: * Fry over low heat
After shredding the eggplant, sprinkle salt and let it sit for ten minutes before squeezing out water to prevent the pancakes from falling apart in the pan.
Cut the bacon into small cubes and stir-fry it in advance. After the fat has seeped out, mix it into the rice paste to make the whole pot more fragrant.
Adjust the rice paste to a consistency that can be easily hung on a spoon, put it in the pan and fry over low heat until both sides are golden brown, then flip it over.

Case: For weekend lunch, Sister Li shredded the eggplant and diced the bacon, mixed them into the rice paste, brushed the pan with thin oil and slowly fried them over low heat. When both sides are golden brown, take them out of the pan. They are crispy on the outside and soft and waxy on the inside. The kids ate two of them with porridge.

items.title: Scallion Oil Noodles
items.core: Scallion Oil Noodles is a classic Shanghai home-cooked noodle dish. It is famous for its unique scallion oil aroma and is simple and quick to make. Rich in carbohydrates and fats, it provides quick energy replenishment. It usually only takes 20 minutes for beginners to make, making it perfect for a quick everyday dinner.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Dry noodles - Spring onions - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - White sugar

Calculation: Scallion oil sauce can be made in multiple portions at one time and used in batches. The following provides the basic amounts for making scallion sauce, as well as the amount of scallion sauce required for each serving of noodles. Basic amount of scallion oil sauce (approximately enough for 3-4 servings): - 100 g shallots - 100 ml cooking oil - 60 ml light soy sauce - 20 ml dark soy sauce - 15 g sugar. Noodles per serving: - 80 g dry noodles (approximately equivalent to 150 g wet noodles) - 15 ml scallion oil sauce

Operation: Make scallion oil sauce: 1. Combine shallots Wash and cut into long pieces (about 5-7 cm). Onion white and onion green can be separated. 2. Add 100 ml cooking oil to the pot and heat over medium heat. Add the green onions first and stir-fry until slightly brown. 3. Add green onions, turn to low heat and continue to stir-fry. 4. Keep the heat low and sauté patiently for about 15-20 minutes until the green onions become brown and crispy. 5. Remove the browned scallions (retain the scallion oil in the pot). 6. In the scallion oil in the pot, add 60 ml light soy sauce, 20 ml dark soy sauce, and 15 g white sugar. Heat over low heat and stir, until sugar dissolves and sauce is blended, about 1 minute. Turn off the heat immediately. Pour the prepared scallion oil sauce into a container, let it cool and seal it for storage. Cook noodles (operate according to portions): 1. Take 80 g dry noodles. 2. Add 1000 ml drinking water to the pot and bring to a boil over high heat. 3. Add noodles and cook until cooked through according to package instructions (usually 3-8 minutes, subject to package instructions). 4. Take out the cooked noodles, drain them and put them into a bowl. Mix the noodles (operate according to portions): 1. In the bowl with noodles, add 15 ml of the scallion oil sauce prepared previously. 2. You can add the fried green onions (optional). 3. Use chopsticks to quickly stir evenly and serve.

Additional content: - When frying scallions in oil, the fire must be low and you must be patient so that the aroma of the scallions can be fully fried. - The prepared scallion oil sauce can be refrigerated for a period of time and used directly the next time you eat noodles.
Fry the white scallions over low heat until slightly yellow, then add the green scallions and slowly fragrant. This can prevent the scallions from becoming bitter and black.
Take out the noodles when they are cooked until they are just tender. Run them through cold water before mixing them. The texture will be more chewy and non-sticky.
Mix scallion oil, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce and sugar according to taste. Add two spoons of hot noodle soup before mixing to make it easier for the juice to hang on.

Case: It’s already eight o’clock in the evening when Xiao Wang comes home from overtime work. He boils water for fried noodles, takes up another pot and fry the green onions until fragrant, pours in soy sauce and mixes well. It was served on the table ten minutes later. The noodles were shiny and fragrant, and he could still make it in time to take a shower.

items.title: Steamed Braised Noodles
items.core: This is a classic home-cooked noodle dish in southern Henan. It is a combination of meat and vegetables. The noodles absorb enough soup and have a soft texture and a salty aroma. Pork belly provides high-quality protein and fat, and celery is rich in dietary fiber. The method is simple and easy to learn, and even beginners can easily get started. The overall production takes about an hour.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Pork belly - Celery - Fresh noodles (the requirements must be the thinnest. If there are no nearby vegetable markets, please refer to making braised noodles) - Onions, ginger, garlic - Edible oil (peanut oil is best) - Light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, cooking wine, salt, five spice powder - Steamer, with a basket - Wok The following ingredients are for students who have a certain cooking foundation or have room to learn - Sichuan peppercorns - Dried red peppers - Green pepper

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. - Celery Two medium-sized celery - Pork belly 350g - Noodles 500g - Green onion 10cm - Garlic 5 cloves - Ginger slices 20g - 2 green peppers - 3 dried red peppers - 20 Sichuan peppercorns - Salt 10g - Five spice powder 5g - Light soy sauce 15ml - Dark soy sauce 10ml

Operation: Preparation: 1. Peel the pork and cut into 2 cm 6 cm 0.5 cm thin slices for later use. 2. Remove the leaves from the celery, remove 2cm from the root, then cut it in half and cut into 2cm segments for later use. 3. Peel and dice the garlic and set aside. Cut the green onions into 0.2cm thin slices and set aside for later use. Cut the ginger into thin strips and set aside for later use. Preparation: 1. Heat the wok until smoking, pour 3ml of cooking oil into the pan and pour out the base oil 2. Add the cooking oil again, add the meat slices, onions, ginger, garlic, and dried red pepper, stir-fry for 1 minute, and stir-fry at an even speed. 3. Add cooking wine, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and stir-fry for another 1 minute. 4. Add 500ml of hot water. Cover the pot and simmer for 3 minutes. 5. Pour the celery and green pepper into the pot, add salt and five-spice powder to taste, cover the pot and continue to simmer for 3 minutes, then turn off the heat. 6. Add 1000ml of water to the steamer, bring it to a boil, spread the noodles flat on the basket, put them into the pot, and steam for 15 minutes. 7. After the noodles are steamed, take them out, use chopsticks and a ruthless iron hand to spread them on the chopping board, and cool to room temperature. Processing: 1. Put the noodles into the vegetable pot and stir. Use chopsticks in one hand and a spatula in the other to turn the vegetables over the noodles. The noodles are all evenly colored as the mixing completion standard. 2. Place the mixed noodles on the whole tray again and steam for 10 minutes again. Turn off the heat

Additional content: - Technical summary - When cutting pork, you can ask the vegetable market vendor to help. According to experience, the best success rate is to seize the opportunity to ask for the best time after cutting but before paying - When cooking for the first time, you can prepare the ingredients in advance to avoid being in a hurry. After you become familiar with it, you can execute it concurrently - when steaming the noodles twice, try to spread them out as much as possible to avoid clumps together after steaming. When the noodles are too long, you can pull them off to make it easier to stir and pick them up - try to be gentle when taking out the steamed noodles to avoid turning over the steamer and the noodles touching the water - it goes well with beer!
Steam the noodles until soft and then mix them with the marinade. After steaming, shake them while they are still hot. This can prevent them from becoming lumpy and help enhance the flavor.
Stir-fry the excess fat from the pork belly first, then add onions, ginger and seasonings and stir-fry until fragrant. The marinade will be thicker and moister.
Don’t re-steam for too long, only about fifteen minutes after steaming to keep the noodles soft and tough.

Case: On Sunday morning, Aunt Chen steamed the thin noodles in a pot until soft, sauteed the pork belly and celery, added soup to taste, then mixed in the noodles and steamed them again. When it came out of the pot, the noodles were soaked with marinade. My father ate two bowls and said it tasted like his hometown.

items.title: Omelet rice
items.core: Fried rice with tomato sauce wrapped in tender egg skin is rich in taste, sweet and sour and appetizing. It is a classic Japanese home dish. Rich in protein, carbohydrates and multiple vitamins, nutritionally balanced. Wrapping the egg skin requires a little skill, but the overall difficulty is moderate and can be tried by novices. It takes about 25 minutes from preparation to completion.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: - Eggs (it is recommended to use free-range eggs for a more fragrant taste) - Onions - Carrots - Corn kernels - Green beans (optional) - Ham sausage or chicken breast - Rice - Tomato sauce - Edible oil (it is recommended to use vegetable oil) - Milk (optional, to make the egg skin more tender)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. Serves 1 person. Each portion: - 2 eggs - 30g onions - 30g carrots - 50g ham sausage or chicken breast - 30g total of corn kernels and green beans - 200g rice - 20ml tomato sauce - 15ml cooking oil - 10ml milk (mixed with eggs)

Operation: 1. Cut onions, carrots, ham sausage or chicken breast into small dices, set aside 2. Heat the pot, pour 10ml cooking oil into the pot, wait for 10 seconds to heat. 3. Add the diced onion and stir-fry for 1 minute. When fragrant, add the carrots, corn kernels, and green beans and continue stir-frying for 2 minutes. 4. Add the diced ham or chicken breast and stir-fry until it changes color. 5. Add the rice and stir-fry, then add 20ml of tomato sauce, stir evenly, and the fried rice is done. Take it out and set aside. 6. Beat the eggs, add 10ml of milk, and stir well. 7. Put 5ml of cooking oil in the pot, pour in the egg liquid, and gently shake the bottom of the pot to spread the egg liquid evenly on the surface of the pan. 8. Heat over low heat, and when the surface of the egg liquid is half-cooked, put the fried rice into the center of the egg liquid. 9. Use a spatula to fold the egg skin around the rice to form an oval shape. 10. Use a spatula to gently push it to the plate, organize the shape, and squeeze a small amount of tomato sauce on the surface for decoration

Additional content: - Use overnight rice to make fried rice less likely to stick to the pan and taste better. - Adding milk when beating eggs can make the egg skin more tender. - Use low heat when operating the egg skin to avoid burning the bottom. - If you are not good at wrapping, you can also directly spread the fried rice on a plate and cover it with egg skin.
Add a small amount of water to the egg liquid and mix thoroughly, spreading it into a thin and complete egg skin, which is easier to wrap without breaking.
Fry the fried rice until it is dry and the rice grains are separated. It is not easy to break the egg skin after wrapping it in it.
When the egg skin is about 80% ripe, add fried rice and use the remaining heat to continue shaping, making the egg texture more tender and not burnt.

Case: On Friday night, Xiao Zhou fried diced carrots in tomato sauce with leftover rice, and spread out a thin egg skin to wrap the rice balls while they were soft. After putting it on the plate, pour a little tomato sauce on it. The child cut it open and found rice and eggs inside, which was very delicious.

items.title: Egg Fried Rice
items.core: A home-style egg fried rice, golden egg shreds wrapped in distinct grains of rice, paired with ham, carrots and cucumbers. It has a rich texture and a delicious salty aroma. Eggs provide high-quality protein, carrots add vitamins, and carbohydrates provide sufficient energy. There are a little more steps to make, but novices can still succeed if they follow the process. The whole process takes about 25 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Cold rice * Eggs * Ham * Cucumber * Carrots * Oil * Salt * Pepper * Light soy sauce * Chives * Dengying shredded beef/luncheon meat/sausage/braised pork... and other cooked meats (optional) When preparing rice, you can refer to the rice cooking method.

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1-2 people. Total amount: Cold rice (portion 500ml) Eggs (portion 1.5 // 1 round down) Ham (portion 2) Cucumber (optional, serving 30g) Carrot (optional, serving 30g) Oil (portion 12ml) Salt (portion\4g - serving*6g) Pepper (portion 8g) Chives (portion 1) pcs) light soy sauce (10ml portion) Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials planned to be used.

Operation: 1. Use a shovel to cut the rice into small pieces in advance. 2. Slice or block ham, carrots, cucumbers, etc. as needed. 3. If you have cooked meat at home, prepare it for better taste. 4. Separate the egg whites and egg yolks, put them into a large bowl, and mix well. Be careful not to add salt at this step. 5. Heat the pot over high heat. When the pot is smoking, add cooking oil and egg whites. Wait until the main body solidifies and set aside. 6. If there is enough oil, add the egg yolk directly. If the oil is not enough, add cooking oil and wait for it to heat up to high heat. Heat the pan. 7. After the main body is solidified, reduce the heat to medium-low, pour in the ham sausage, cooked meat, carrots, cucumbers and other ingredients, and stir-fry for 10 seconds (until it is fragrant). 8. Add the egg whites again, stir-fry for 5 seconds, quickly add the rice and stir-fry over high heat, so that every grain of rice is coated with eggs. 9. During the stir-frying process, mash the lumps of rice. This step will take a long time. Once all the rice is mashed, stir-fry evenly. 10. Reduce the heat to low, add salt, pepper, and light soy sauce. 11. Stir-fry further. When you can see some rice "jumping" in the pot, it is almost ready. 12. Finally, add the chives and stir-fry for 10 seconds. 13. Turn off the heat and put it into a bowl.

Additional content: * Technical summary - It is best to use cold rice that has been left overnight for fried rice. Those who do not have cold rice can also cook it freshly (you can use the refrigerator to cool down the rice immediately), but to achieve a "distinct" texture, you need to fry it longer. - To achieve "separate grains" in fried rice, you actually need to fry the rice dry. The reason why you need to use cold rice overnight is because a certain amount of water has been lost overnight.
Use cold rice overnight, or spread out the hot rice and let it cool. The rice grains will be drier and less likely to clump when fried.
Fry the eggs first into large pieces and then return to the pan after the rice is fried. This can maintain the egg fragrance and tender texture.
Add the diced vegetables into the pot according to their degree of ripeness. Saute the carrots first until they are soft and tender, and add the cucumbers last until they are crispy.

Case: At noon on Sunday, Xiao Lin used the cold rice from the night before to make fried rice. He first stir-fried the egg liquid and poured it out, then stir-fried the ham, carrots and cucumbers, and finally stir-fried them together for seasoning. When the rice came out of the pot, the rice grains were clearly defined and the color was bright. He ate two plates by himself.

items.title: Snail Noodles
items.core: Snail Noodles are a specialty snack in Liuzhou, Guangxi. The soup is rich in flavor, sour and spicy, and the rice noodles are soft and chewy. The taste combines the deliciousness of snail soup, the unique fermented flavor of sour bamboo shoots and the stimulation of chili oil, with distinct layers. As a staple food, rice noodles provide sufficient carbohydrates, snail meat buns and toppings provide a certain amount of protein, and sour bamboo shoots help to stimulate appetite and promote digestion. This dish requires simple operations, just cook the rice noodles and season them in order, making it very friendly to novices. From boiling water to taking out the pot, it can be on the table in about ten minutes at the fastest, making it perfect for a quick meal.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: For home cooking purposes, it is not practical to start making snail noodles from snails, pickled bamboo shoots and other processes, so this recipe is based on bagged snail noodles. Ingredients: - A package of bagged snail noodles, which should contain: - Rice noodles - Snail meat buns (may be placed in the ingredient package) - Soup packets - Sour bamboo shoot buns, peanut buns, tofu skin buns, fungus buns and other ingredient packets - Vinegar packets, chili oil and other seasoning packets Tools: - Cooking pot - Induction cooker/stove - A pair of chopsticks
Calculation: - According to personal experience, one package of snail noodles is enough for one person and one meal (although it looks very big) - Water 1L

Operation: 1. Add water to the pot and boil the water 2. Add the rice noodles and cook for 3-5 minutes, stirring with chopsticks to prevent the rice noodles from sticking together 3. Add the soup packet and add according to personal taste 4. Next, add the remaining ingredient packets, such as fungus, peanuts, and snails (this part of the ingredients needs to be cooked for a while to taste) 5. Add the seasoning packet and add according to personal taste 6. Stir it out and put it in a bowl 7. Add the remaining ingredient packets, such as pickled bamboo shoots and tofu skin (this part of the ingredients is not suitable for soaking in the soup for too long) 8. Enjoy the food

Additional content: - If you want chewier noodles, you can shorten the second step of cooking the noodles - If you want to add fried eggs to the snail noodles, please refer to the tutorial on fried eggs - please choose the ingredients according to your personal taste
Dry rice noodles are easier to cook thoroughly under cold water. Cook until they can be pinched but are still elastic in the mouth.
Put less sour bamboo shoots and spicy oil first, taste the soup and then add it according to taste. This can avoid being too sour or spicy to cover up the umami flavor.
Put the yuba and peanuts last before serving to maintain the crispy taste and make the soup more refreshing and not muddy.

Case: Xiao Zhao came home after working overtime on a rainy day. He cooked rice noodles in the order of packaging, then added snail soup, sour bamboo shoots and yuba. The sour aroma of the kitchen filled his nostrils. He cooked the noodles until they were soft and chewy. One bowl of noodles warmed his whole body.

items.id: 西红柿鸡蛋挂面-西红柿鸡蛋挂面
items.title: Tomato and Egg Noodles
items.core: Tomato and Egg Noodles are a home-cooked quick-serve noodle dish with sweet, sour, salty, rich soup and chewy noodles. It is a daily staple food that incorporates northern flavor. Eggs provide high-quality protein, and tomatoes are rich in lycopene and vitamins. Together with carbohydrate staple foods, they are nutritionally balanced. The operation is simple, the steps are clear, and it is friendly to novices. It only takes about 20 minutes from preparation to completion.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Hanging noodles or fresh noodles are fine - One tomato - Salt - Egg - Green onions - Soy sauce, oyster sauce or chicken essence - White sugar (to neutralize the sourness of tomatoes, no need to add if tomatoes are not sour) - Green peppers (not line peppers) - Sesame oil

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. The following amounts are just enough for one person. Total amount: - 1 handful of noodles (depending on food intake) 50-100g - 1 tomato, about 200g. - 1~2 eggs - 5g salt - 5g oyster sauce or 3g chicken essence - 2g sugar - 5-8g soy sauce - 20g edible oil - 5g sesame oil

Operation: Preprocessing of ingredients: The pre-processing of ingredients is very important. No matter what dish you are cooking, you can do it in advance so that you will not panic during the preparation of the dish, and the preparation is a very comfortable process. This may be why the kitchen needs a separate loading station. 1. Wash the shallots and cut into chopped green onions. 2. Cut the tomatoes into pieces. If you are not good at cutting, it is recommended to search on Baidu first~ 3. Cut the green peppers into diamond-shaped pieces. 4. Break the raw eggs into a small bowl and beat them. If the eggs have a fishy smell, you can add 2g. White vinegar to remove fishiness. Pre-treatment of eggs: 1. Heat the pot and pour in 15~20g of cooking oil. A little more oil will be needed to make the eggs tender and smooth. At the same time, leave some base oil for frying tomatoes later. 2. When the oil temperature reaches 70% heat (you can feel the heat with your palms about 10cm apart), pour in the egg liquid and quickly spread it. 3. When the eggs are solid and there is no egg liquid left at all, pour them into a small bowl and set aside. Leave some base oil here. If the eggs are not photographed, please use the pictures from the Internet instead. To make tomato and egg sauce: 1. Leave some oil in the pot and add green onions and minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Add tomato cubes and green peppers, and stir-fry the tomatoes until they produce a little juice. 3. At this time, quickly add 5g soy sauce and 2g white sugar. 4. Stir-fry for ten seconds and then add a bowl of water (just enough to cover the tomatoes). 5. After boiling, add the fried eggs and oyster sauce. 5g or 2g chicken essence is used to enhance the freshness. 6. Collect the juice over medium-low heat, stirring during this period to prevent sticking to the pan. After the juice is reduced to the picture below, add a little chopped green onion (the remaining green part) and sesame oil (you can also add it without adding). The sautee is finished. Finally, cook the noodles: 1. You don’t need to wash the pot, just add 500ml of water. 2. Boil and add the noodles. When the noodles are soft, add 100ml of water. 3. After boiling again, if the noodles float, add 100ml of water. 4. After boiling, check whether both sides of the noodles are transparent. If they are transparent, they are cooked. 5. Transfer the noodles to a sautee bowl and mix them~

Additional content: - You can add 2g of black pepper to the egg liquid for a better taste - Add 2g of white pepper during the process of boiling the sautee to enhance the spicy taste - You can cook the noodles all at once. Adding water multiple times is to make the noodles chewy and non-sticky. The trick is to add cold water to the boil and repeat the cycle two or three times
Fry the tomatoes until they become sandy and juicy, then add more water to cook the soup. The soup base will be thicker, sweeter and sour.
After the noodles are put into the pot, stir them gently with chopsticks to prevent them from sticking to the bottom of the pot. Cook until there is no hard core in the middle.
Pour the egg liquid thinly along the edge of the pot, let it sit for a few seconds and then use the back of a spoon to spread it. The egg blossoms will be beautiful and tender.

Case: In the evening of a weekday, cut young tomatoes into pieces and stir-fry to extract the juice, add water to boil the noodles, and finally pour in the egg liquid. Less than twenty minutes later, a bowl of sweet and sour soup noodles was served on the table. After finishing it, he felt warm and full.

items.title: Braised Bean Noodles
items.core: Braised Bean Noodles is a home-cooked noodle dish in the north. The noodles absorb the soup and have a soft and salty texture, with the freshness of the beans and the oiliness of the meat slices. Pork belly provides protein and fat, beans are rich in dietary fiber and vitamins, and the mix of meat and vegetables is balanced. The overall operation is not difficult, but you need to pay attention to the heat and the timing of adding soup. It is suitable for friends with certain cooking experience. It can usually be served in about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Fresh noodles (leek leaves or Erxi <see the bottom column for the explanation of the thickness of the noodles) * Meat (preferably pork belly) * Salt * Beans * Chicken essence * Oil consumption * MSG * Thirteen spices * Light soy sauce * Dark soy sauce * Onions * Garlic * Ginger * Hot water * Kitchen knife

Calculation: The amount below is only 1 amount of staple food for one person's meal! Please adjust the amount of ingredients according to the actual situation! * Fresh noodles 300g. * Meat 100g. * Beans 150g. * The amount of salt used is: 2g. * The amount of cooking oil is 10 - 18 ml. * The amount of chicken essence is: 2g. * The dosage of light soy sauce is: 10ml. * The amount of fuel consumption is: 5g. * The dosage of Thirteen Incense is: 1g. * The dosage of dark soy sauce is: 5ml. * The dosage of MSG is: 1g. * The amount of hot water is: 150ml. * Onion 10g. * Ginger 5g. * Garlic 10g. Using the conditions above, calculate the proportion of raw materials you plan to use.

Operation: Preparation: 1. Cut the beans into 5cm - 6cm pieces. 2. Cut the green onions into 1cm - 2cm pieces. 3. Cut the ginger into long strips of 1mm x 1mm x 3cm. 4. Crush the garlic on a cutting board and cut it into 1mm pieces. 5. Cut the pork belly into 2mm thick slices. 6. First, heat the pot to remove all the water vapor in the pot. Put your hand 10cm away from the bottom of the pot. You will feel your hands are obviously a little burnt. 7. Add the above-mentioned amount of cooking oil, hold the pot handle 5cm away from the stove, and shake the pot so that the cooking oil fully covers two-thirds of the pot (bottom to top). ps: Please ignore the above operation for non-stick pans and wait for 3-5 seconds for the oil to heat up. 8. Add all the ginger and all the green onions, stir-fry and sauté for 5 seconds (note! There is a risk of oil splashing at this time, so it is recommended to wear gloves or take protective measures). 9. Put all the meat slices into the pot, let it sit for 5 seconds, and then stir-fry until all the meat is covered with cooking oil. 10. Stir-fry the meat slices continuously until all the meat slices have changed color, pour the prepared light soy sauce evenly along the edge of the pot, and stir-fry evenly. 11. Add the prepared salt, dark soy sauce, oil, thirteen spices, chicken essence and all the prepared beans in sequence, and stir-fry for 2 minutes. 12. Add the prepared hot water. 13. When the water is boiling, use a spoon to scoop out half of the vegetable soup in the pot (note! Do not scoop out the vegetables). 14. Spread all the noodles on top of the dish. 15. Cover the pot and simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes. 16. Open the lid of the pot, use a ladle to scoop out the vegetable soup, and sprinkle it evenly on the noodles one ladle at a time. 17. Cover the pot and simmer over medium heat for 3 minutes. 18. Open the lid of the pot and sprinkle all the garlic and MSG evenly. ps: There may still be water in the pot at this time. If you want to eat something wet, please turn off the heat, otherwise there is no need to turn off the heat. 19. Use chopsticks to stir-fry continuously to mix the vegetables and meat evenly. 20. Turn off the heat

Additional content: Differences in thickness of noodles: * Capillary (as the name suggests, just like hair, actually a bit as thin as thin vermicelli) * Thin (this is thicker than capillary, the same as Xiangtou) * Second thin (a bit thick like ordinary stir-fried noodles) * Third thin (slightly thicker than second thin, it tastes like thick vermicelli, but if the noodles are pulled more firmly, this one will taste delicious) * Chive leaves (the chicken is as wide as leek leaves) * Dakuan (just like the wide noodles used in Malatang)
The green beans must be simmered thoroughly and stirred once during the process to avoid any raw material that may affect the taste and safety.
The appropriate amount of soup to add is just enough to cover the beans. Too much soup will make the noodles rotten, and too little soup will make it easy to burn the bottom.
After the noodles are laid out, cover and simmer over medium-low heat. Finally, open the cover and shake quickly to coat each noodle with the soup.

Case: Early in the summer after get off work, Lao Zhang sautéed the pork belly slices until fragrant, added the beans, stir-fried and seasoned. When the soup just covered the beans, he spread the noodles and simmered. After opening the lid and mixing well, the noodles will be shiny and soft, and the whole family will eat them up with minced garlic.

items.id: 酱拌荞麦面-酱拌荞麦面
items.title: Soba noodles with soy sauce
items.core: Soba noodles with soy sauce are sweet and sour, refreshing and smooth. It is a simple and quick home-cooked cold noodle dish. Soba noodles are rich in dietary fiber and protein. Paired with cucumbers and carrots, they add a refreshing taste and vitamins, and are nutritionally balanced. You only need to cook the noodles, chop the vegetables, and mix in Laoganma. It is done in a few steps. It is very friendly to novices and can usually be completed in about 20 minutes. It tastes better when eaten refrigerated.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Buckwheat noodles * Cucumbers * Carrots * Laoganma
Calculation: per portion: * 100 g buckwheat noodles * 0.5 cucumbers * 0.5 carrots * Laoganma 20 ml

Operation: 1. Boil buckwheat noodles under cold water for 8-10 minutes, remove and drain and set aside 2. Cut cucumbers and radishes into small strips 3. Put the buckwheat noodles, cucumbers and radishes on a plate, put Laoganma on top and stir

Additional content: * After the buckwheat noodles are drained, they can be chilled in the refrigerator for a better taste * You can choose other ingredients according to your personal preferences, such as shrimps, minced meat, etc. * You can choose other sauces according to your personal preferences, such as peanut butter, sesame sauce, etc. * Soba noodles have almost the same calories as other noodles, so they are not suitable as a staple food for fat loss.
Cook the buckwheat noodles according to the package time until they are elastic, remove them and immediately rinse them in cold water and drain them to prevent them from becoming softer.
Cut the cucumbers and carrots into thin strips. The carrots can be blanched for ten seconds to make them crispier and more colorful.
Laoganma mixes light soy sauce and a little balsamic vinegar, mix well and refrigerate for ten minutes to make the flavor more refreshing.

Case: When I have no appetite in the summer, I will cook a small bowl of buckwheat noodles, cool them and mix in cucumber shreds, carrot shreds and a spoonful of Lao Gan Ma. Sweet, sour and slightly spicy, it is very appetizing. Put it in the refrigerator for half an hour before eating, and the taste will be smoother.

items.title: Hot and sour fern root powder
items.core: Spicy and sour fern root powder has a smooth and chewy texture, is sour and appetizing, and is a home-cooked cold dish that can also be enjoyed as a staple food. Fern root powder is rich in starch and dietary fiber, which can provide energy to the body. This dish is incredibly simple and beginner-friendly, taking just 10 minutes from prep to finish.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * fern root powder * spicy oil * soy sauce * balsamic vinegar * spicy millet (optional) * garlic (optional) * green onions (optional) * salt * sugar * a deep pot

Calculation: per serving: * Soy sauce: Vinegar: Spicy pepper = 3: 2: 2 (The specific amount of sauce is determined by the amount of fern root powder. This ratio is only to ensure that the taste is correct) * If you think the sauce is lighter, you can add 2 to 5 grams of salt * If you want the sauce to be fresher, you can add 2 grams of sugar

Operation: Cooking fern root powder: 1. Add water about 3/5 of the depth to the pot and bring to a boil. 2. After the water boils, add fern root powder and cook for 8 minutes on medium-low heat. 3. Remove from the pot. Sauce preparation: 1. Add soy sauce, vinegar and spicy oil according to the ratio. 2. Dip it with chopsticks and take a bite. 3. If you feel that the soy sauce taste is slightly stronger at this time, add the prepared salt 4. If you feel it is not fresh enough at this time, add the prepared sugar 5. Stir thoroughly until most of the granular seasoning is dissolved. Steps for loading and finishing: 1. Take a bowl 2. Add the sauce prepared in the previous step 3. Pour the fern root powder into cold water and add it to the sauce 4. Stir thoroughly 5. Chop the prepared onions, garlic and millet and sprinkle them on the powder 6. Done (｡･∀･)ﾉﾞ

Additional content: * Onions, ginger, and garlic are additional seasonings that can be added to add flavor. It is not a big deal if they are not added. * The specific amounts of sugar and salt that need to be added vary according to personal taste, so please add them as appropriate. * It is recommended to use a bowl as the final serving utensil, because using a plate will make it more difficult to eat the noodles.
Soak the fern root powder in warm water until soft and then cook it in a pot. The time should not be too long to maintain elasticity.
When making the sauce, mix the minced garlic, balsamic vinegar, light soy sauce and sugar first, then add the chili oil. The ratio of sour, sweet and spicy is easier to control.
Be sure to drain the water after running it through cold water, mix it and refrigerate it for ten minutes, which will make it smoother and more appetizing.

Case: At noon in the dog days of summer, Xiao Wu soaked fern root powder and boiled it for two minutes, then poured it into cold water and stirred in minced garlic, balsamic vinegar, chili oil and light soy sauce. After being put on the plate and sprinkled with coriander, it was sour, spicy and smooth. Even though he had no appetite, he ate a large plate.

items.title: glutinous rice dumplings
items.core: Rice dumplings with fermented glutinous rice are a traditional Chinese dessert that is sweet and glutinous. The slight acidity of the fermented rice wine blends with the smoothness of the glutinous rice, which is both stomach-warming and comforting. It is rich in carbohydrates and a small amount of B vitamins, which provides a quick energy boost and also helps improve blood circulation. There are no barriers to making this recipe, and it is especially friendly to novices. It only takes about 15 minutes from boiling water to taking it out of the pot. It is a bowl of home-cooked sweet soup that can be easily prepared at any time.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Small glutinous rice balls * Fermented glutinous rice * Sugar * Wolfberry (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1-2 people. Total quantity: 300 ml of water. Serving of small glutinous rice balls 250 g. Serving of glutinous rice glutinous rice 50 g. Serving of 5 wolfberry pcs. Serving * Sugar

Operation: 1. Pour water into the pot and bring to boil 2. Add glutinous rice balls and cook for 8 minutes 3. Add fermented glutinous rice and wolfberry and cook for another 2 minutes 4. Put into a bowl, add sugar according to personal taste and stir well 5. Eat

Additional content: * The amount of sugar can be changed according to personal taste * If you like a thicker taste, you can reduce the water within 100 ml * If you like a softer taste of wolfberry, you can cook the wolfberry and the dumplings at the same time
After the water boils, add the small glutinous rice balls, gently push the anti-stick pan with the back of a spoon, and cook until they all float.
Put the fermented glutinous rice at the end and keep it on low heat to avoid boiling for a long time to evaporate the aroma of the wine and make the taste softer.
If you like egg droplets, pour the egg liquid into the pot carefully, turn off the heat and simmer for half a minute to make the egg droplets more tender.

Case: After returning home on a winter night, Aunt Liu boiled a small pot of water, put in the glutinous rice balls and cooked them until they floated, then poured in the fermented glutinous rice and beaten eggs. Ten minutes later, I served it to my family. It was sweet and slightly sour, and my hands and feet quickly warmed up.

items.id: 陕西油泼面-陕西油泼面
items.title: Shaanxi Youpo Noodles
items.core: This traditional northwest noodle dish is famous for its chewy pulled noodles and spicy flavor splashed with hot oil. It is a well-known daily staple food in Shaanxi. Noodles are rich in carbohydrates, and paired with vegetables and bean sprouts, they can quickly replenish energy and provide a reasonable meal mix. The whole process is simple, straightforward and friendly to novices, and it only takes about 30 minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Fresh noodles (preferably pulled noodles) - Salt - Onion - Garlic - Dried chili pepper noodles (or Qin pepper noodles) - Edible oil - Light soy sauce - Balsamic vinegar - Green vegetables (rapeseed or spinach can be used) - Pot

Calculation: Generally, 4 sticks are enough for boys and 3 sticks for girls. If the amount is large, you can increase it appropriately - 2g of salt - 1 green onion - 3 cloves of garlic - 15g of dried chili noodles - 50ml of cooking oil - 10ml of light soy sauce - 5ml of balsamic vinegar - 50g of green vegetables - 50g of bean sprouts (optional)

Operation: Preparing ingredients: 1. If you want to pull noodles, use a rolling pin (you can use your hands if you don’t have a rolling pin) to gently press the upper and lower sides, grab the left and right ends with both hands, and pull them apart gently 2. Cut the onions into chopped green onions, and mince the garlic and set aside. 3. Wash the green vegetables and bean sprouts and set aside (if used). Cooking noodles and seasoning: 1. Add enough water to the pot, bring to a boil and add 1g of salt 2.
