Add the noodles, stir gently with chopsticks to prevent them from sticking, and cook until the noodles float and then cook for 1-2 minutes. 3. During the last minute of cooking the noodles, add the green vegetables and bean sprouts to blanch. 4. Remove the cooked noodles, green vegetables, and bean sprouts, drain them and put them in a bowl. 5. Add light soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, chopped green onion, minced garlic and dried chili noodles to the noodles in sequence. You can also add some sesame seeds. Sprinkle oil: 1. Pour cooking oil into the wok, and add peppercorns, star anise, cinnamon, and bay leaves (if used). Fry over low heat until fragrant and remove the spices. 2. When the oil temperature rises to 70% hot (slightly smoking), quickly and evenly pour it on the dried chili noodles in the bowl until you hear a "sizzling" sound. 3. Use chopsticks to mix all the seasonings and noodles thoroughly before eating.

Additional content: - Technical summary - The choice of chili noodles is very important. It is recommended to use Shaanxi Qinjiao noodles, which are fragrant but not spicy; one of the eight weirdos of Shaanxi: a dish of oily spicy noodles 😂 - The oil temperature of the oil is the key to success. If the oil temperature is too low, the chili peppers will not be fragrant, and if the oil temperature is too high, it will be easy to burn - If you like meat, you can add minced meat to make spicy noodles - The traditional Shaanxi Youpo Noodles pay attention to "one green, two white, three red and four green", that is, the color combination of noodles, minced garlic, pepper, and chopped green onion. Finished product:
Choose thick and thick noodles or hand-pulled noodles. Cook them until they are slightly hard in the middle and still retain their chewy texture after being taken out.
Put the chili noodles, minced garlic and chopped green onion at the bottom of the bowl first, heat the oil until it smokes slightly and then pour it over to add more flavor.
After pouring the hot oil, mix immediately and add light soy sauce and balsamic vinegar for seasoning. The hot and sour aroma will be more even.

Case: At noon on weekends, Xiao Qin cooked the lasagna and put it into a bowl, spread it with bean sprouts, green vegetables, chopped green onion and chili noodles, heated up the oil and poured it on, and the aroma burst out from the sizzling sound. After mixing well, the noodles become chewy and spicy, and he even mixes the soup thoroughly.

items.title: Korean Bibimbap
items.core: Korean Bibimbap is a colorful and rich Korean home-cooked dish. Rice, vegetables, beef and soft-boiled eggs are wrapped in sweet and spicy sauce. Mix well and satisfy after one bite. A variety of vegetables provide vitamins and dietary fiber, while beef and eggs supplement high-quality protein and provide balanced nutrition. It’s simple to make but requires a little more preparation, so novices can easily complete it. It takes about 45 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Rice - Eggs - Hot pot beef rolls - Bean sprouts - Mushrooms - Carrots - Zucchini - Korean hot sauce - Sprite - Sesame seeds - Sesame oil

Calculation: Per serving: - 1 bowl of rice (400g) - 1 egg - Hot pot beef rolls 6 rolls 60g - 1 handful of bean sprouts 80g - Mushrooms 50g - Carrots 1/4 root - Zucchini 50g - Korean hot sauce 25ml - Sprite 2 bottle caps, 20ml - Sesame seeds 10g - Sesame oil 20ml - Light soy sauce 15ml

Operation: 1. Wash the vegetables, cut into shreds and stir-fry in the pot until the ingredients become soft and weigh out 2. Boil the water and wait until it boils. Blanch the beef rolls. Just cook them and take them out in about three minutes. 3. Fried soft-boiled eggs 4. Put the rice in a bowl and invert it in a large bowl. 5. Place the prepared vegetables and meat rolls in a circle on top of the rice. Place the fried egg in the middle. 6. Prepare the sauce - 10ml Korean chili sauce (sweet and spicy) + 5ml light soy sauce + two bottles of Sprite (if you are losing weight, you can put sugar-free Sprite) + 10g sesame seeds + 5ml sesame oil - Stir the above sauce, you can add more light soy sauce and salt. 7. Pour the prepared sauce into the bowl on the plate

Additional content: - This is a very simple dish. The process will be more tedious, but it will be very satisfying when you mix the vegetables, meat, rice and sauce. - If you have certain requirements on the appearance, you can use a casserole instead of the ordinary bowl
Cut the beef into thin slices against the grain, mix well with a little light soy sauce and marinate for 5 minutes. Stir-fry it until it becomes more tender.
Blanch bean sprouts, spinach and other green vegetables in water for 30 seconds in advance and drain them under cold water to prevent the bibimbap from becoming watery.
Add a spoonful of Sprite and cooked sesame seeds to the spicy sauce to thin it out. It is sweet and spicy, making it easier to coat every grain of rice.

Case study: After get off work, cook the rice, shred the carrots, blanch the bean sprouts, fry the hard-boiled eggs, stir-fry the beef and put it in a bowl, pour Korean hot sauce and mix well, dinner is ready in 15 minutes, the color is bright and the aroma is full of flavor.

items.title: Leek Box
items.core: Chive box is a traditional Chinese noodle dish, with a golden and crispy exterior and a juicy and fragrant filling. Leeks paired with shrimp and eggs are rich in vitamins and high-quality protein. The recipe is simple and friendly to novices, and it takes about 2.5 hours from kneading to cooking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Leeks - Shrimps - Eggs - Sesame oil - Salt - Flour

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each serving: - 500g leeks - 100g shrimp - 3 eggs - 10ml sesame oil - 5g salt - 250g flour

Operation: 1. Put the flour into a large bowl, add water, stir to form a smooth dough, and let it rest for 30 minutes. 2. Wash and chop the leeks, add beaten eggs and 5g of salt, and stir evenly. 3. Divide the dough into small pieces, roll it into a thin round cake, and fill it with leeks, shrimps and egg liquid. 4. Heat the pan, add cooking oil, add the wrapped leek box, and fry until both sides are golden brown, about 3-4 minutes. 5. Plate, let cool slightly and enjoy.

Additional content: - You can add dried tofu and other ingredients according to your personal taste when making. - Pay attention to the heat when frying to avoid burning on the outside and burning on the inside.
Wash the leeks, dry them thoroughly and then chop them into small pieces. When mixing them with the stuffing, wrap them in a layer of sesame oil, which can effectively prevent water from leaking out.
The dough is mixed with half hot water, half boiling water and half cold water. The outer skin of the finished product is crispy but not hard.
During the frying process, the heat is low. Cover and simmer for two minutes before opening the lid and frying to ensure that the filling is cooked through and the outer skin is golden.

Case study: Make the noodles and let them rest for half an hour on weekends. Chop the leeks and mix them with shrimps, eggs and sesame oil. Wrap them into a half-moon shape. Fry them in a pan over low heat until they are golden on both sides. The outside is crispy and the noodles are juicy when you bite them.

items.title: Fresh Meat Siomai
items.core: This is a delicate snack with Jiangnan flavor. The skin is as thin as paper, and the filling is plump and juicy. When you bite into it, the meat is fragrant, the fresh bamboo shoots and the soup after the skin jelly melts together. It is salty and sweet, and has a soft and chewy texture. Pork and shrimp provide high-quality protein, winter bamboo shoots and shiitake mushrooms add dietary fiber and trace elements, and the low-fat version further reduces saturated fat. Although the wrapping technique requires a little patience, the overall steps are clear and even a novice can master it with more practice. It takes about an hour from mixing the stuffing to taking it out of the pan.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Shaomai skin - Minced pork (fat to lean 3:7, if you want to make a low-fat version, use pork tenderloin or pork front shank) - Minced ginger - Minced green onion (only use the green part) - Light soy sauce - Cooking wine - Salt - Sugar (optional) - White pepper (optional) - Sesame oil - Stock or thick soup - Winter bamboo shoots (optional) - Skin jelly (optional but recommended) - Mushrooms (or soaked dried mushrooms, optional) - Shrimp (optional) - Lard (or chicken fat) (low-fat version) - Compound food thickener (κ-carrageenan 45%, guar gum 35%, potassium chloride 20%) (or corn starch) (low-fat version) - Steamer mat (the recommended order is oiled bamboo mat, straw mat, rice dumpling leaves, and perforated silicone paper. Traditionally, straw mats are used, but now more perforated silicone paper is used)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is enough for 2-3 people. Per serving: - 240-465 g siomai skins (about 24-31 sheets, it is recommended to use 30 siomai skins of 10g each) - 300 g minced pork (for a low-fat version, use 280 g pork loin or pork shank meat) - 5-10 g minced ginger - 10-20 g minced green onions - 15 mL light soy sauce - 10 mL cooking wine - salt 3-5 g (if using pureed soup, reduce 3 g) - Sugar 2-3 g - White pepper 2 g - Sesame oil 5 mL - Broth 30 mL - Pureed Soup 6 g (Knorr brand is recommended, about 1/8 piece) - Winter bamboo shoots 50 g - Skin jelly 100 g - Shiitake mushrooms 75 g (or 30 g dried shiitake mushrooms soaked) - Shrimp 100-200 g (about 20-25 pieces) - 1.2 g compound food thickener (or 2 g corn starch) - 15 g lard (or chicken fat)

Operation: 1. (Low-fat version) Take 10 mL of cold water, add compound food thickener, and mix into a paste 2. (Low-fat version) Add 25 mL of boiling water, stir until translucent gel 3. (Low-fat version) After cooling, mix in 280 g of pure lean minced meat + 15 g of melted lard (or chicken fat) 4. Mix the minced pork with minced ginger and green onions, add soy sauce, cooking wine, salt, sugar, and white pepper, and stir vigorously in one direction. 5. If using a thick soup cube, add 15 mL of hot water to the thick soup cube, stir until the emulsion is completely dispersed, and then add 15 mL of normal temperature water. 6. Slowly add water or stock and continue stirring until the filling absorbs water and becomes sticky. If you feel that the meat filling is too thick, add 5 mL of water and continue stirring. 7. Add optional ingredients (winter bamboo shoots, jelly skin, mushrooms), and finally drizzle with sesame oil and mix well. Refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to blend. 8. Take a piece of siomai skin and put about 20-25 g of filling (don’t be too greedy, otherwise you won’t be able to wrap it) 9. Use the tiger’s mouth to gently gather the edges of the skin to form a “vase” shape, leaving an opening at the top 10. Use your fingers to lightly press the bottom to ensure a stable standing 11. If you want to add shrimp, add one shrimp on top 12. Repeat the steps of wrapping the siomai until it is well wrapped 13. Place in a steamer, spaced apart to avoid sticking. 14. Steam over high heat for 8-10 minutes

Additional content: - The fat in the siomai mainly comes from fat meat. After the fat in the low-fat version is removed, a small amount of animal oil needs to be used to compensate to ensure the taste - If there is no siomai skin, you can use a large wonton wrapper, or a thin dumpling wrapper - The diameter of the skin is between 8-10 cm, and each skin weighs about 10-15g, the ratio of skin to filling is controlled at 1:2 - 1:2.5 - It is recommended to use a medium-range meat grinder, so that the minced meat will not be too fine (like paste) or too thick (like pieces), maintaining a moderate texture, so that the filling tastes Q-bright - Use 5 g of minced ginger and 10 g of minced scallion to not easily mask the taste of fresh meat; 10 g of minced ginger and 20 g of minced scallion are a bit like dumpling fillings - When wrapping the siomai, apply some oil on the tiger's mouth so that it won't stick to your hands - When steaming, remember to boil the water before putting it on the basket, so that the skin will not collapse - If you make too much, freeze it at -18 ℃ and steam it for 12-15 minutes. It tastes better when dipped in rose rice vinegar. You can also add Tongxiang hot sauce, spicy oil, light soy sauce, and shredded ginger according to your taste - Reference: [Step-by-step diagram of how to make fresh meat siomai, how to make fresh meat siomai delicious] Little _ Kitchen
Cut the jelly into small cubes and mix it with the fillings. After steaming, it melts into soup. This is the key to the juiciness of the siomai.
The siomai skin is rolled into a disc with a slightly thicker middle and thin edges. When wrapping, the waist is narrowed to reveal the filling, making the shape more authentic.
Bring water to a boil and steam over high heat for 8 minutes. If steamed for too long, the skin will become hard and the filling will taste stale.

Case: Boil the jelly in advance on the weekend, mix the stuffing with pork and shrimp, winter bamboo shoots and shiitake mushrooms, roll out the skin into pleats, and steam it for 8 minutes. The soup is delicious when you bite into it, and the meat filling is elastic. Family members say it looks like something bought from a dim sum shop.

items.id: 鲣鱼海苔玉米饭-鲣鱼海苔玉米饭
items.title: Bonito and seaweed corn rice
items.core: This is a delicious and delicious Japanese simple meal. The rice has clear grains and combines the saltiness of bonito, the crispy fragrance of seaweed and the sweetness and crispiness of corn. Bonito is rich in high-quality protein and DHA, and combined with the minerals of seaweed and the dietary fiber of corn, it is nutritionally balanced. The method is very simple and can be easily completed by novices. It only takes 5 minutes to actually do it, and it takes about 40 minutes in total to cook and enjoy.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Necessary: Northeastern rice (Arowana is 30 yuan for 5kg, it is recommended to use Mijia IH rice cooker, the tutorial uses Mijia small rice cooker, pressure cooker is not recommended for cooking) - Necessary: chopped bonito seaweed (available in JD and Taobao, you can search: Japanese bibimbap ingredients) - Necessary: corn kernels (Taobao search: corn kernels ready to eat)
Calculation: - Crushed bonito seaweed 20g - corn kernels 80g/bag
Operation: 1. Serve the rice, add corn kernels and mix well 2. Add bonito seaweed crushed
Additional content: - If you use Mijia rice cooker to cook northeastern rice, the water will be enough to cover the rice by 3 mm. If you cook too much water, it will not be rice one grain at a time
After the rice is cooked, stir in the seasoning while it is still hot. The higher the temperature, the easier it is to absorb the fresh aroma of bonito and seaweed.
Use scissors to cut the seaweed into small pieces, which is more uniform than tearing it by hand. You can enjoy the crispy texture in every bite.
The chopped bonito itself has a salty taste, so add soy sauce in small amounts in batches to avoid the finished product being too salty.

Case study: Cook the rice in the rice cooker, stir in chopped bonito, chopped seaweed and sweet corn kernels while it's still hot, add a little Japanese soy sauce and sesame oil, toss briefly and serve. It's salty, sweet and crispy, and it's ready for one person in five minutes.

items.title: Chickpea Fritters
items.core: Chickpea curry with deep-fried flatbread is a classic street snack in North India. The soft fried flatbread is paired with richly spiced chickpeas. The taste is rich in layers, sour, spicy and salty. Chickpeas are rich in plant protein and dietary fiber, filling and nutritious. There are a little more steps to make, but it is not difficult to follow the process. It is suitable for home cooking with a certain foundation. It’s done in about 50 minutes (chickpeas need to be soaked 8 hours in advance).
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Chickpeas (dry) - All-purpose flour - Yoghurt - Onion - Tomato - Ginger - Garlic - Green chilli - Coriander - Black tea bag (for coloring the chickpeas) - Cooking oil - Turmeric powder - Red chilli powder - Coriander powder - Cumin powder - Indian mixed spice powder (Garam Masala) - Pomegranate powder (Amchur/Anardana) - lemon juice can be substituted - Salt - Baking soda - deep pot (for fried cakes)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2-3 people. Each portion: Chickpea curry (Chole) part: - 200g dry chickpeas (soaked 8 hours in advance) - 2 onions (about 200g), chopped - 3 tomatoes (about 300g), chopped - 10g ginger, grated - 4 cloves of garlic (about 12g), grated - 2 green chilies, slit - 30ml cooking oil - black tea bag 1 piece - Turmeric powder 3g - Red chili powder 5g - Coriander powder 8g - Cumin powder 5g - Indian mixed spice powder 5g - Pomegranate powder 3g (or lemon juice 15ml) - Salt 6g - Water 500ml Fried bread (Bhature) part: - All-purpose flour 250g - Yogurt 60ml - Edible oil 15ml (for kneading) - Baking soda 2g - salt 3g - warm water about 60ml - cooking oil 500ml (for fried cakes)

Operation: Preparation (8 hours in advance): 1. Soak the dried chickpeas in water overnight (at least 8 hours), the volume will expand to about twice after soaking. Cook the chickpeas: 1. Drain the soaked chickpeas 2. Put it in a pot, add 500ml water and 1 black tea bag (for coloring) 3. Bring to a boil over high heat, then turn to medium heat and cook for 25-30 minutes until the chickpeas can be easily crushed with your fingers 4. Remove the black tea bag and keep the bean soup for later use. Stir-fry the curry paste: 1. Pour 30ml cooking oil into the wok and heat over medium heat 2. Add chopped onions and stir-fry until golden brown (about 6-8 minutes) 3. Add grated ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute. 4. Add chopped tomatoes and stir-fry until the tomatoes are completely soft and oily (about 5 minutes). 5. Add 3g turmeric powder, 5g red chili powder, 8g coriander powder, 5g cumin powder, 6g salt. 6. Stir-fry for 2 minutes to fully release the aroma of the spices. 7. Pour the cooked chickpeas into the pot together with the soup. 8. Add green chili and stir well. 9. Bring to a boil, then reduce to low heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes. During this period, you can crush some chickpeas with the back of a spatula to thicken the soup. 10. Add 5g of Indian mixed spice powder and 3g of pomegranate powder (or 15ml of lemon juice) 11. Stir evenly, turn off the heat and set aside. Make fried cake dough: 1. Mix 250g of all-purpose flour, 2g of baking soda, and 3g of salt in a large bowl. 2. Add yogurt 60ml and cooking oil 15ml 3. Gradually add warm water and knead while adding to form a smooth and soft dough (the dough should be slightly softer than ordinary dough) 4. Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for 30 minutes. Fry the dough: 1. Divide the dough into 8 equal-sized dumplings 2. Take a dumpling, dip your hands in a small amount of oil, and roll it into a round dough with a diameter of about 15cm and a thickness of about 3mm 3. Pour 500ml cooking oil into a deep pot and heat over medium-high heat until the oil temperature is about 180°C. 4. Gently slide the dough into the hot oil and use a slotted spoon to gently press the dough to puff up. 5. Fry for 1-2 minutes, flip over and fry until both sides are golden brown. 6. Remove and use kitchen paper to absorb excess oil. Serve: 1. Reheat the chickpea curry 2. Serve the fried dough hot and serve with the chickpea curry. 3. Can be served with sliced onions, green peppers and lemon wedges

Additional content: - Soaking the chickpeas in advance is a must. If not soaked, they will not become soft. If you're pressed for time, pressure cook the unsoaked chickpeas for 20 minutes. - The purpose of the black tea bag is to color the chickpeas, giving them a dark brown color. This is the secret of Indian restaurants. -The yogurt and baking soda in fried dough are key to making it light and fluffy. The dough should not be too hard. - This dish is a national brunch dish in India and is served from roadside stalls to high-end restaurants. It is often called "chickpea curry with fried rice cakes" in Indian restaurants in China.
Chickpeas are soaked for more than 8 hours in advance to make them softer and more flavorful when cooked.
Let the fried cake dough rise for 30 minutes, roll it into a thin pancake, place it in a frying pan, and fry over medium-low heat until it becomes golden brown.
Add a little tomato paste to the curry sauce and stir-fry until fragrant. The sour taste can relieve greasiness, and it is more balanced when paired with fried pancakes.

Case: Soak the chickpeas in advance, press them in a pressure cooker until soft, then add tomatoes and curry spices to stew into a thick sauce. At the same time, wake up the fried pancakes and pair them with onion yogurt. Dip the pancakes into the beans and it will be spicy, soft and glutinous and very filling.

items.title: Sesame Oil Noodles
items.core: Sesame oil has a strong aroma, and is simply seasoned with dark soy sauce and pepper. It is salty and delicious. It is a home-made noodle dish that saves time and money. Noodles provide sufficient carbohydrates, and sesame oil contains unsaturated fatty acids and vitamin E, which can replenish energy for the body. There is no difficulty in making it, and even kitchen novices can easily get started. It only takes about ten minutes from boiling water to mixing.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Air-dried instant noodles/any brand of instant noodles (no seasoning required) * Sesame oil * Pepper * Dark soy sauce * Salt

Calculation: per portion: * 1 liter of water * 1 piece of instant noodles * 15ml of sesame oil * 10 grams of dark soy sauce * 30 grams of salt (optional, all 30g of salt will not be eaten) * 10 grams of pepper * 5 grams of light soy sauce (optional)

Operation: 1. Pour water into the pot and boil (those who like to eat springy noodles can add 30 grams of salt to the water, the noodles cooked in salt water will be more springy) 2. Put the instant noodles into the pot for 3 minutes (you can also refer to the cooking time of the current brand of instant noodles) 3. When the noodles begin to fall apart, you can start stirring to let the noodles heat evenly 4. Drain the water and pour the noodles into a bowl 5. Add sesame oil, dark soy sauce, pepper, and light soy sauce according to the measurements above (optional) 6. Stir evenly with chopsticks 7. A simple and cost-effective lazy sesame oil noodle dish is completed
Additional Content
Add a little salt to the cooking water to make the noodles more chewy and less likely to stick. Scoop out half a bowl of noodle soup before taking it out and set aside.
Turn off the heat and pour the sesame oil into a bowl to avoid the aroma evaporating and nutrient loss caused by long-term cooking at high temperature.
Only half a spoonful of dark soy sauce is needed for coloring. It mainly relies on sesame oil and chopped green onion to enhance the flavor and keep it fresh and not greasy.

Case: When you are hungry late at night, cook a handful of noodles. Put sesame oil, dark soy sauce, pepper and chopped green onion in a bowl. Pour in the hot noodle soup and mix well. After ten minutes, you will have a hot midnight snack. The salty aroma warms your stomach and is very satisfying.

items.title: Spicy fat-reduced buckwheat noodles
items.core: The spicy soup base combines hot pot base ingredients with peanut butter and milk. It has a rich and smooth taste with a distinct spicy flavor. Paired with high-fiber soba noodles and fresh vegetables, it is low in calories and filling, and is suitable for enjoying during the fat loss period. It’s easy to make and requires no basic cooking skills. The whole process takes about 20 minutes and you can start eating.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Seasonings: hot pot base, peanut butter, whole milk, light soy sauce, chili oil, vinegar, pepper oil * Ingredients: semi-dried buckwheat noodles, baby cabbage, lettuce * Sink, small pot with a diameter of 18cm Suggested purchase plan: Buckwheat noodles: pdd Buy Shi Shang Braised Buckwheat Noodles, a pack of 400g, price 4.9 yuan, can make 4 servings Hot pot base: Moubao Xiaolongkan traditional clear oil hot pot base has the best taste, 29.8 yuan a pack, can make 20 servings Peanut butter: pdd Yingge peanut butter 24.8 yuan, two bottles, can make 68 servings Sichuan pepper oil: pdd Wufeng Lihong pepper oil 400ml, 32 yuan two bottles, can make 80 servings Others: Whatever, will not affect the taste

Calculation: per serving: - Semi-dry soba noodles 100g - 8 slices of baby cabbage (150g in total) - 6 slices of lettuce (80g in total) - Hot pot base 25g - Peanut butter 15g - Whole milk 150ml - Light soy sauce 6ml - Chili oil 10ml - Vinegar 20ml - Sichuan pepper oil 10ml - Water 500ml

Operation: 1. Wash the baby cabbage and lettuce and set aside. 2. Pour 500ml of water into the pot, turn on the high heat, put the buckwheat noodles and baby cabbage in, and wait for the water to boil. 3. After the water boils, turn to low heat, add hot pot base ingredients, peanut butter, milk, light soy sauce, and chili oil, and cook for 5 minutes after the water boils. 4. Add the lettuce and cook for another 2 minutes. 5. Add vinegar and pepper oil, turn off the heat, and start eating directly in the small pot.

Additional content: * Be sure to choose semi-dry soba noodles, which have the best taste * You can add other things at will, such as hot pot balls, egg dumplings, etc. * Be sure to add hot pot base, peanut butter, and milk, the three giants of taste * If you can't eat sour food, you don't need to add vinegar
Cook the buckwheat noodles until there is no hard core and immediately pour them in cold water. This will make the noodles chewier and less sticky.
The hot pot base is stir-fried over low heat until red oil is added, and then milk and peanut butter are added to make the soup base smooth and not lumpy.
Blanch the vegetables in the pan for the last 30 seconds until they are cooked to maintain a crisp and tender texture and reduce nutrient loss.

Case study: When I was losing weight, I often made spicy soba noodles at night. I added less hot pot base ingredients, added peanut butter and a small amount of milk to make a soup base, and then added vegetables and tofu. Having a full meal in twenty minutes is easier than ordering takeout.

items.title: Fried crab with curry
items.core: This is a home-cooked seafood dish that combines Thai flavors. The rich curry is wrapped in crab meat, with the aroma of crab roe and the smooth taste of coconut milk. Crab is rich in high-quality protein and a variety of trace elements, which helps to replenish physical strength. The production process is clear. You only need to pay attention to sealing and frying the crab roe and finally turning off the heat and stir-frying the sauce. It is more friendly to people with certain cooking experience. It usually takes about 30 minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Blue crab (also known as: meat crab) - Curry cubes (recommended Lehui crab curry) - Onions - Coconut milk - Eggs - Cornstarch (also known as: starch) - Garlic

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Total amount: - 1 meat crab (about 300g) * number of servings - 15g curry cubes (a small piece) * number of servings - coconut milk 100ml * number of servings - 1 egg * number of servings - 200g onion * number of servings - 5 cloves of garlic

Operation: 1. Open the lid and cut the crab in half. Use the back of the knife to gently pat the crab claws into cracks. Dip the cut and crab claws into cornstarch, not too much. Sprinkle 5g cornstarch into the crab lid, cover the crab roe, and set aside. 2. Chop the onion into fine pieces, set aside. 3. Chop the garlic, set aside. 4. Boil a pot of water, set aside. 5. Heat oil in a pot, pour in about 20ml of cooking oil, wait 10 seconds for the oil temperature to rise. 6. Put the crab cut side down, gently put it into the pot, and fry for 20 seconds. This step is mainly to seal the crab roe and crab meat. Then flip and cook for 10 seconds on each side. After frying, take out the crab and set aside. 7. Put the crab lid into the pot, use a spoon to scoop up the hot oil in the pot and pour it into the crab lid. Fry the crab roe in the crab lid. Fry for 20 seconds and then take it out and set aside. 8. Without brushing the pot, pour in 10ml of cooking oil. Let the oil temperature rise until it smokes slightly. Add minced garlic and onion and fry for 10 seconds. 9. Put the curry cubes into the pot and stir-fry (10 seconds), add the fried crabs and stir-fry evenly. 10. Pour in 300ml of boiling water and simmer for 3 minutes. 11. After simmering, pour in the coconut milk and egg white, turn off the heat, and continue to stir-fry until the sauce thickens. 12. Remove from the pot
Additional content: - Reference method: A Macau kitchen guy who has been teaching for more than ten years how to make curry crab with juicy sauce.
Dip the cuts of crab pieces in dry starch and then fry them, which can effectively seal the crab roe and prevent it from being lost during cooking.
Saute the curry cubes first and then add water, then add the coconut milk last to maintain the rich aroma and smooth taste.
Turn off the heat and sprinkle a little lemon juice or lime zest to relieve greasiness and enhance the freshness, making the flavor closer to Thai style.

Case: Cut the crab into pieces and dip them in starch to seal and fry to lock the crab roe. Sauté the ginger and garlic curry cubes and add coconut milk to make a sauce. Add the crab chunks and stir-fry until evenly coated. The crab meat is plump and fragrant, and the curry is fragrant. It is very enjoyable to eat with rice.

items.title: Fried eel with oil
items.core: Xiangyou shredded eel is a classic home-cooked dish from Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Shanghai. The shredded eel is tender and smooth, rich in garlic aroma, and the sauce is slightly sweet. When topped with hot lard, the aroma is overflowing, and it goes very well with rice. Eel is rich in high-quality protein and DHA and is rich in nutrients. This dish requires certain knife skills and heat. It is moderately difficult and requires a little practice for novices. From preparation to cooking, it usually takes about 40 minutes to have it on the table.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Shredded eel - Garlic - Minced ginger - Cooking wine - Light soy sauce - Oyster sauce - Dark soy sauce - Edible salt - White sugar - Pepper - Starch - Minced garlic - Chopped green onion - Lard

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is enough for 2 people. Each serving: - 400 g shredded eel - 40 g garlic - 20 g minced ginger - 13 g cooking wine - 3 g light soy sauce - 2 g oyster sauce - 2 g dark soy sauce - 2 g edible salt - 6-15 g white sugar - 3.5-8 g pepper - 10 g starch - 50 g water - 40 g minced garlic - 15 chopped green onions g - lard 20 g

Operation: 1. Cut the eel into three sections and then cut into thin strips. 2. Add 0.5 g pepper and 3 g cooking wine, stir evenly, and then add 5 g sesame oil to marinate. 3. Heat oil in a pan. 4. Add vegetable oil and heat to 60% heat. 5. Add half of the minced garlic and all the minced ginger, stir-fry for a few times. 6. Add the shredded eel and stir-fry for 30 seconds over medium heat. 7. Pour 10 g of cooking wine around the edges and stir-fry a few times. 8. Add light soy sauce and stir-fry evenly. 9. Add oyster sauce and dark soy sauce and stir-fry a few times. 10. Add salt, sugar, and 3 g pepper and stir-fry evenly. 11. Mix starch and water to form water starch, pour it into the pot, and reduce the juice until thick. 12. Place on a plate, and sprinkle with minced garlic and chopped green onion. 13. Heat up another pot, add lard, heat until 70% hot, pour on shredded eel

Additional content: - Don't wash the eel's blood too clean, otherwise the eel will easily turn black and smelly - You can ask the stall owner to help butcher the eel - You can add more pepper and sugar to remove the fishy smell and increase the aroma - Reference: The home-made recipe of "Shredded Eel in Xiangyou", it tastes great, I will save it first - YouTube
Blank the shredded eel for 10 seconds before taking it out. If the time is too long, the meat will become old and lose its smooth and tender texture.
Put the minced garlic in twice, saute half to make the base fragrant, and drizzle half with oil to stimulate the aroma.
Finally, pour hot oil on the minced garlic. Only when you hear the sound of oil is heard is success, and the aroma is released instantly.

Case: Blanch the shredded eel to remove the fishy smell and cut into sections, sauté the minced garlic in a hot pan with oil, quickly stir-fry the shredded eel, add light soy sauce and sugar to taste, pour in boiling lard and hear a sizzling sound, the garlic is fragrant and you can eat two bowls with rice.

items.title: Crayfish
items.core: This dish is spicy and fragrant, and the shrimp meat is tender and juicy. It is a classic Sichuan-Hunan style dish for drinking. It is clean and affordable to make at home. Crayfish is rich in high-quality protein and a variety of trace elements, but the soup contains more oil and salt, so it is suitable for occasional enjoyment. Handling live shrimp and a variety of spices can be challenging for novices, but not deveining the shrimp can significantly reduce the difficulty. It takes about 45 minutes from prep to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Crayfish - Oil - Bay leaves - Star anise - Cinnamon - Green Sichuan peppercorns - Sichuan peppercorns - Bullet peppers - Onions, ginger and garlic - Pixian bean paste - Soybean paste - Beer - Light soy sauce - Salt

Calculation: The following is the amount of two kilograms of crayfish, just adjust according to the proportion. - Crayfish = 2 pounds - Oil = 70 ml (this is 3 times the usual amount for stir-frying) - Bay leaves = two pieces - Star anise = one - Cinnamon = 3 grams - Green pepper = 10 grams - Zanthoxylum bungeanum = 10 grams - Bullet pepper = 5 grams - Onion = a green onion - Ginger = 30 grams - Garlic = 7 cloves of garlic - Pixian bean paste = 30 grams - Soybean paste = 30 grams - Beer = 500 ml - Light soy sauce = 30 ml - Salt = 10 grams

Operation: 1. Brush the crayfish and remove the shrimp lines, cut the green onions into 2cm pieces, mince the ginger and garlic. 2. Heat the oil slightly, add bay leaves, star anise, cinnamon, green peppercorns, Sichuan peppercorns and bullet peppers. 3. When the aroma of the spices comes out, add the onion, ginger and garlic to the pot. 4. After the onion, ginger and garlic are sautéed, add the Pixian bean paste and soybean paste, and stir-fry until the red oil comes out. 5. Add the crayfish and stir-fry until it changes color. 6. Add beer, wait until the beer boils and then add light soy sauce and salt. 7. Cook the crayfish completely and remove from the pot.

Additional content: Restaurants should all deep-fry the food. If you fry it at home, it is too wasteful. So in this recipe, use more oil than cooking oil and fry it. The actual test is that it is equally delicious. The taste of shrimp meat after removing shrimp lines is slightly worse than that of shrimp meat without removing shrimp lines, and removing shrimp lines from crayfish is a challenge for novices. If you can accept the shrimp lines, you can do it without removing shrimp lines.
Soak live shrimps in salt water and a few drops of vinegar for 20 minutes, which can promote spitting out sand and make them taste cleaner.
Stewing with beer can remove the fishy smell and increase the aroma, making the soup more mellow, and leaving only the aroma of wheat after the alcohol evaporates.
You can omit deveining the shrimp if you find it troublesome, but use a toothpick to pick at the second section of the back of the shrimp to release the fishy smell.

Case study: Soak the crayfish in salt and vinegar, wash them clean, sauté dried chili peppers in hot oil until fragrant, add shrimps and stir-fry, add beer and simmer. After the juice is reduced, it is spicy and fragrant. It is very enjoyable to eat with ice Coke at night to catch up on dramas.
