items.title: Dry-fried Argentine red shrimp
items.core: A delicious and tempting seafood quick dish. The fried Argentine red shrimp has white and tender meat, a sweet and rich taste, and a crispy shrimp shell. Rich in trace elements such as iodine, phosphorus and astaxanthin, it helps strengthen immunity, protect the heart and lower cholesterol. The difficulty is moderate, and you need to master the heat and flipping skills, but the steps are clear, and novices can succeed if they follow the instructions. Expect it to take about 20 minutes to complete.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Argentine red shrimp (quick-frozen shrimp is selected) - Sea salt (ground) - Black pepper (ground) - White wine - Light soy sauce - Coriander - Lemon - Onion - Ginger - Garlic
Calculation: - 2-3 Argentine red shrimp - Sea salt 5g - Black pepper (ground) - White wine 20ml - Light soy sauce 1ml - 3 slices of coriander - 1 slice of lemon - 10g onion - 10g ginger - 10g garlic

Operation: 1. Thaw the Argentinian red shrimp. It is best to take it out of the freezer 1 day in advance and place it in the refrigerator to thaw naturally, which can better maintain the flavor and taste. You can buy the ones with the backs open and the shrimp lines removed, which saves a lot of time. 2. Wash and dry the thawed red shrimps and set aside. Be sure to drain the water. If you are in a hurry, you can use kitchen paper to absorb the water. 3. Slice the ginger, cut the onions into small cubes, wash the coriander, separate the leaves and stems, chop the coriander leaves, crush the garlic and cut into small pieces. 4. Heat a pan over high heat. Pour two tablespoons of olive oil into the pan. When the oil temperature rises, add ginger slices, onion pieces and coriander stems and stir-fry. 5. After about 1 minute, remove the ginger, onion and coriander stems and discard. 6. Turn up the heat to medium, add red shrimp and start frying. Note that all shrimps need to be completely exposed to the pan on one side. Fry for about 2 minutes. At the same time, brush each shrimp with a layer of oil. 7. When the shrimp shells on the bottom are slightly browned, turn over and sprinkle with minced garlic. Shake the pan slightly to heat evenly. 8. After about 1 minute, add 20ml of white wine. 9. Fry for another 1 minute, then reduce the heat to medium-low and evenly sprinkle with a layer of salt and black pepper. 10. Add a drop of light soy sauce to each shrimp. 11. Sprinkle with coriander leaves and serve on a plate. 12. Cut the lemon slices and place them on the side of the plate
Additional content: - Lemon can enhance the taste of the shrimp, but it is sour. You can add it or not according to your preference - Eat it hot
After thawing the shrimp, wipe the surface moisture thoroughly with kitchen paper so that no water will come out when frying.
The pot should be heated until it smokes slightly before adding the shrimp. Quick frying over high heat can lock in the juice of the shrimp and keep the meat fresh and tender.
After frying one side, turn it over. Do not turn it frequently during this period, otherwise the shrimp meat will fall apart easily and the shell will not be crispy.

Case: Defrost the red shrimp and wipe away the water. Heat the pan and pour a little oil. Fry the shrimp for 1 and a half minutes on each side. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper and turn over. When the shrimp shell comes out of the pan, the shrimp shell is crispy and fragrant. The shrimp meat is white and tender. Squeeze the lemon juice to highlight the sweetness.

items.title: Microwave black cod with onion and ginger
items.core: Microwave the fish, add the onion and ginger to enhance the freshness, drizzle with hot oil, and the aroma will overflow. It is a home-made steamed fish dish with tender meat and salty taste. It is an improved Cantonese method. Black cod is rich in high-quality protein and omega-3 fatty acids, which are good for heart and brain health. The operation is not complicated, but you need to master the heat and oil temperature. It is more suitable for friends with some cooking experience. It only takes about twenty minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: Ingredients: - Black cod, with skin Seasonings: - Green onions - Ginger - Cooking wine - Soy sauce - Sesame oil - Peanut oil Tools: - Sealable bag

Calculation: per 2 servings: - black cod, skin on, 2 slices, 450g (the main character of this recipe, all seasonings can be adjusted according to the actual weight of the cod) - green onions, white, 25g. - Shallots, green onions, 10g. - Ginger, 13g. - Cooking wine, 5mL. - Soy sauce, 25mL. - Sesame oil, 2mL. - Peanut oil, 50mL.

Operation: 1. Put the fish fillets into sealed bags respectively, with the fish skin side down on the plate. 2. Cut 25g of green onion into shreds, peel and shred 10g of ginger, mix them together, divide into two halves, and place them on the fish fillets in the bag. 3. Pour 2.5mL of cooking wine into each bag. 4. Seal the airtight bag and place it in the microwave at medium heat (800 watts) until it becomes opaque and spreads easily (about 3.5-5 minutes). Remove the fish fillets from the bag. 5. Remove the shallots and ginger. 6. Take 25mL of soy sauce and 2mL of sesame oil, mix evenly and pour evenly on the two fish fillets. 7. Cut 10g green onions into thin strips, peel and cut 3g ginger into thin strips, mix and divide into two portions and sprinkle on the fish fillets. 8. Take 50mL of peanut oil and heat it to 190℃ in a small pot. 9. Pour the hot oil onto the green fish fillets and serve immediately.

Bonus content: Using sea bass, tilapia, halibut or tuna: | Fish | Fillet or not | Weight | Microwave time | |----------|----------|------|-----------| | Sea bass | Whole | 450g | 6.5 minutes | | Tilapia | Whole | 800g | 6 minutes | 2.25 minutes | | Lobster fish | Sliced | 170g | 1.5 minutes | Other changes: - If you want the aroma to be more intense, you can evenly apply the onion, ginger and cooking wine on both sides of the fish fillet before microwave heating.
The surface water of cod should be wiped dry so that it will not become boiled when heated in the microwave and the meat will become firmer.
The microwave time is adjusted according to the power, about 3 minutes at 700W. You can use chopsticks to gently pull the thickest part to separate it and it is done.
Be sure to pour out the fishy water in the plate after heating, and then pour soy sauce and hot oil to make the taste more pure.

Case: Cut the black cod into thick pieces and drain them with kitchen paper. Place the ginger slices and green onion slices in a microwave bowl. Cover and turn on high heat for 3 minutes. Remove the fish and pour out the fishy water in the plate. Steam the fish with soy sauce and hot oil. The fish meat is tender and salty and goes well with rice.

items.title: Boiled Fish
items.core: Boiled fish is a classic Sichuan dish with spicy, fragrant and tender fish meat. Pangasius is rich in high-quality protein and low in fat. It is nutritionally balanced when paired with seasonal vegetables. The method is of medium difficulty and may pose a challenge to novices, but you can still succeed if you follow the steps. Estimated production time is approximately 2 hours.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Basa fish - Vegetables (such as potato slices/bean sprouts/cauliflower/lettuce/...) - Red bean paste - Vine pepper oil - Rapeseed oil - White pepper - Garlic cloves - Salt - Sugar - Measuring cup - Kitchen scale (optional) - Large stainless steel bowl

Calculation: The following amounts are suitable for 3 to 5 people. - Pangasius 500g - Vegetables (such as potato slices/bean sprouts/cauliflower/lettuce/...) can be combined in different ways, the recommended total weight is 300g to 500g - 40g red bean paste (add 10 to 20g more red oil if you are not afraid of spicy food) - 10g tempeh (optional) - 10ml cane pepper oil - 25ml rapeseed oil - 3g white pepper - 2 cloves garlic - 5g salt - 2g sugar

Operation: 1. Preparation: If the pangasius fish is taken out of the freezer, it needs to be defrosted naturally at room temperature for 5 hours before slicing. 2. Slice: Cut pangasius into thin slices, about 5cm long and 3cm wide. 3. Marinate: Put the sliced ​​pangasius into a large stainless steel bowl. 4. Add 30g bean paste, 3g salt, 10ml pepper oil, and 3g white pepper. 5. Grip evenly with your hands and add 5ml rapeseed oil to seal the taste. 6. Let it sit at room temperature for at least 30 minutes to absorb the flavor. 7. Preparation: Chop the garlic into minced pieces. Take 300g of cauliflower and 200g of lettuce as an example. Wash the cauliflower and lettuce. 8. Blanching and stir-frying: blanch the cauliflower in a pot of boiling water and set aside; wash and dry the lettuce, stir-fry and set aside (no need to add oil). 9. Fried bean paste: Heat a pan with cold oil (rapeseed oil 20ml), add 10g bean paste, 10g tempeh (optional), add minced garlic, and stir-fry slowly over medium heat. 10. Braised fish fillets: Add 150ml hot water. When the water boils quickly, add the marinated fish fillets. Gently turn the fish fillets to spread in the water. Add 2g salt and 2g sugar to taste (you can adjust the amount of salt according to personal taste). Once the water boils again it is ready to serve. 11. Plate: First put the cooked vegetables into a large bowl, then put the hot fish fillets on top of the vegetables, and pour the remaining hot soup in the pot!

Additional content: - The combination and amount of vegetables at the bottom can be freely used, but you need to pay attention to the characteristics of various vegetables. For example, when changing to potatoes, the potato slices/potato cubes need to be cooked (you can poke them with chopsticks to confirm). - The amount of red bean paste (spiciness) and salt can be adjusted according to personal taste. - Note that when cutting fish fillets, you can first chop the fish into 5cm pieces perpendicular to the length of the fish fillet, then turn it 90 degrees and slice it diagonally into thin slices. - Be careful not to grab too hard when marinating. - How to Fillet a Fish How to debone fish Reference:

Use an oblique knife method when filling the fish, and control the thickness to about 0.3 cm. If it is too thin, it will easily break into pieces, and if it is too thick, it will not be easy to taste. When marinating, add a little egg white and starch to lock in the moisture.

For side dishes, you can first blanch them in boiling water with salt and oil until they are cooked through, then remove them and place them on the bottom of a bowl. This will keep the crispy texture while removing some of the grassy smell.

The key is to pour hot oil at the end. Spread the dried chili segments, Sichuan peppercorns, and minced garlic on the fish fillets, and pour the hot oil until it is smoking, which can instantly stimulate the spicy aroma.

Case: When friends came to my house for dinner, I cooked boiled fish according to the steps. Basa fish was sliced ​​and marinated, and bean sprouts were placed on the bottom. After frying the base ingredients, hot oil was poured over it. It took nearly two hours to serve it, and it was spicy and delicious. Everyone said it was like what you eat in a restaurant.

items.title: Braised Prawns in Oil
items.core: This classic Shandong cuisine wraps whole shrimps in a salty and sweet sauce. The finished dish is bright red and oily, and the shrimp meat is firm and tender. Shrimp itself is rich in high-quality protein and astaxanthin, and has low fat content. It is a nutritional supplement without adding burden. The preparation requires refining scallion oil, cutting shrimps, stewing, and collecting juice. There are certain requirements for heat and seasoning. It is more suitable for experienced cooks. The whole process takes about 40 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - black tiger shrimp or prawns, - green onion, ginger - cooking wine, salt, rock sugar, vegetable oil
Calculation: version for 1 person. - 10 shrimps - 5g peppercorns - 50g green onions - 20g ginger - 30g rice wine - 3g salt - 10g rock sugar - vegetable oil

Operation: 1. Cut the shrimp gun to the root, cut off all the shrimp whiskers and claws, remove the sandbags, pick out the open back shrimp lines, wash and set aside 2. Frying oil - When the oil is 30% hot, add Sichuan peppercorns. Remove from heat and add scallions and ginger (it is best not to let the oil change color). Drain the scallions until they turn slightly yellow (if there is too much scallion oil, you can save it for use as noodles). 3. Add oil, arrange the shrimps neatly, press the shrimp heads gently after both sides change color - add ginger rice (cut ginger into fine particles) - 30g rice wine - two small bowls of water - 3g salt - 10g rock sugar 4. Bring to a boil over high heat, turn to low heat and cover with lid (do not add more soup in the middle, do not open the lid) 5. When the skin is shiny, you can start the pot and arrange the shrimps. 6. Collect the juice (filter and pour it back into the pot to thicken, add scallion oil) when 1/4 of the soup remains. 7. Pour the sauce 8. Complete 9. 10. Start eating✅
Additional content: - Recipe reference: The braised prawns cooked in oil from snacks to big ones in the old rice bone video at Station B are actually fake? The master master restores the true taste

When making scallion oil, fry the scallion segments over low heat until golden brown and slightly charred. Remove the scallion residue and then add the shrimp. This way, the scallions will be fragrant and will not be bitter and affect the color of the sauce.

When cutting the shrimp, remove the shrimp gun, shrimp whiskers and shrimp thread. Especially the shrimp thread must be picked out. You can use a toothpick to gently pick out the second section of the shrimp's back to remove it completely.

When stewing, add enough water to just cover the shrimp body. Turn to medium to low heat and simmer covered for 2 minutes to allow the shrimp meat to absorb the flavor. Finally, turn over high heat to reduce the juice and stir constantly to coat the sauce evenly.

Case: Lao Li hosted a banquet with old friends on the weekend and decided to challenge the braised prawns. He carefully refined the scallion oil, cut off the shrimp whiskers and shrimp lines, simmered it over medium heat and accurately collected the juice. After the shrimp came out of the pan, the shells were red and attractive, and the sauce was rich, salty and sweet. After tasting it, my friends were full of praise and devoured it.

items.title: Grilled fish
items.core: This Sichuan-style grilled fish is spicy and fragrant, the fish is charred on the outside and tender on the inside. The side dishes are full of soup and go well with the rice. Grass carp is rich in high-quality protein, paired with a variety of vegetables, and has balanced nutrition. The method may seem complicated, but it is not difficult to follow the steps. It is suitable for novices who want to challenge tough dishes. It takes about an hour from prep to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Grass carp (ask the store to kill it at the farmer's market or supermarket and remove unnecessary organs) - Green onions - Cooking wine - White pepper - Edible salt - Garlic - Cinnamon - Star anise - Bay leaves - Green peppercorns - Dried chili sections - Bell peppers - Hot pot base (optional) - Qianzhang - Mung bean sprouts - Onions - Bean paste - Celery sections - Cooked peanuts - White sesame seeds - Coriander (it tastes better, you can add it or leave it out according to your personal taste)

Calculation: per serving: - About three pounds of grass carp - Half a green onion - 20ml of cooking oil - 10-15ml of cooking wine - 5-10g of edible salt - 5g-10g of white pepper - A small piece of cinnamon - Two star anise - Eight garlic granules - Two bay leaves - A small handful of green peppercorns - Dried chili pepper segments 10 pcs - 4 bell peppers - celery segments 2 stalks - half an onion - 1,000 sheets

Operation: 1. Cut grass carp (generally 3 pounds) from the back, and make a few cuts along the back of the fish on both sides. Do not scratch the belly of the fish, otherwise it will not be easy to shape. - You can pour hot water on the fish to wash away the mucus or use a brush to scrub under the running faucet until it is no longer sticky to the touch. 2. Put the fish in a container, add cooking wine, 10g white pepper, 5g salt and marinate for 20 minutes. 3. Cut half a green onion into pieces, cut the garlic in the middle, and put it in a container with star anise, bay leaf, cinnamon bark. 4. Cut the dried chili pepper in half and put it in a container with the bell pepper. 5. Cut the celery into small pieces. 6. Blanch the bean sprouts. 7. Blanch a thousand pieces and cut them into shreds. 8. Cut the onion into shreds. 9. Grilled fish - If you have an oven at home, you can brush the baking pan with base oil, and bake the fish skin side down until both sides are golden brown, and then sprinkle with cumin powder. - If you don't have an oven, you can heat a pan with hot oil, sprinkle 2g of salt on both sides of the pan, add grass carp and start frying. 10. Spread 20ml cooking oil in the pot, wait until the oil is hot, add the green onion, garlic, star anise and bay leaves and stir-fry until fragrant. 11. Add half of a pack of hot pot base ingredients and 15-20g bean paste, stir-fry until the red oil comes out. 12. Add 5g white sugar, 10g salt, 5ml light soy sauce to taste, pour water level with the ingredients and bring to a boil. 13. Add the celery segments, bean sprouts, and shredded celery in sequence. Do not cook them. Blanch them slightly and put onion shreds on top. Place the grilled fish on top. 14. Add dried chili peppers, bell peppers, and green peppercorns. 15. Heat oil in another pot. When the oil is hot, pour it on the newly added chili peppers to stimulate the aroma. 16. Finally, sprinkle with cooked peanuts, chopped green onions, white sesame seeds, and coriander. 17. Cook for 5-6 minutes, and it is delicious.

Additional content: - Technical summary: Above - The amount of salt, pepper, cumin powder, cooking oil, light soy sauce, sugar, etc. used in this dish is determined based on personal taste and the proportion of ingredients. It does not need to strictly follow the above-mentioned amounts.

When marinating the fish body, use kitchen paper to absorb the water, then evenly apply salt, cooking wine and pepper powder. The marinating time should be no less than 20 minutes to ensure the effect of removing fishy fish and increasing aroma.

Before grilling, brush a thin layer of oil on the surface of the fish body, place it in the middle of an oven preheated to 200 degrees, and bake for 15-18 minutes until the skin is slightly charred and set, then take it out.

When frying the soup, first sauté the bean paste and dried chili until fragrant, then add stock or boiling water to cook out the red oil, and finally add the side dishes and cook until soft before pouring on the grilled fish.

Case: Novice Xiao Wang tried to cook Sichuan-style grilled fish for the first time. He carefully marinated the grass carp and put it in the oven while frying the side dishes and spicy soup. Although the process was tense, following the steps, the grilled fish was charred on the outside and tender on the inside, and the side dishes soaked up the soup. The family was very satisfied with the meal.

items.title: Steamed Oysters
items.core: Steamed oysters are an authentic coastal home-cooked dish. The oyster meat is tender and juicy, with a light salty aroma of sea water, and the minced garlic and shredded ginger bring out the sweet taste. Oysters are rich in high-quality protein and zinc, which can help improve immunity. The operation is not complicated, but you need to be careful when opening the hot pot lid and handling the oyster shells, and novices can complete it smoothly. From scrubbing to taking it out of the pot, it only takes about twenty minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Oysters * Onions * Garlic * Ginger * Soy sauce * Brush
Calculation: * 1 liter of drinking water * 6 oysters * 3 green onions * 6 cloves of garlic * 1 small piece of ginger * Soy sauce 1 ml for each oyster

Operation: 1. Brush the oysters clean with a brush (use a toothbrush if there is no brush). 2. Pour water into the steamer, put the steamer on, place 6 oysters flat on the steamer, use 50% power, and steam for 3 minutes. 3. Use your right hand to hold a wet rag to open the lid of the scalding pot. Open half of the shell of each oyster and remove it. The convex side of the oyster is down and the flat side is up. Place 1 piece of shredded ginger and 10g of minced garlic on each oyster. 4. Close the steamer lid and steam at 100% power for 3.5 minutes. 5. Stop the heat, hold the rag in your right hand to open the lid of the hot pot, and put 5ml of soy sauce into each pot. 6. Serve on a plate.
Additional Content

When purchasing oysters, oysters whose shells will quickly close quickly when lightly touched are fresh. Those whose shells are tightly closed may have deteriorated. When cleaning, use a hard-bristled brush to carefully scrub away any sediment in the gaps between the shells.

When steaming, put the oysters in after the water boils. Steam them over high heat for 5-8 minutes. For oysters that are too large, you can extend the cooking time by 1-2 minutes. Over-cooking will cause the meat to shrink and become old.

When taking out the meat, use a knife to pry open the oyster shell. Be careful not to cut the oyster meat. Keep the juice in the shell and eat it together. Pair it with ginger vinegar sauce or garlic chili sauce to enhance the freshness and remove the fishy smell.

Case: Aunt Zhang, who grew up by the sea, bought fresh oysters early in the morning and carefully scrubbed the sediment from the shells with a brush. After the water is boiled, steam it in a pot and serve it with minced garlic and ginger. The fresh air hits your face as soon as you lift the lid, and the oyster meat is plump and juicy. After dipping it in the sauce and tasting it, my daughter said that this is the taste of hometown.

items.title: Steamed seabass
items.core: Steamed seabass is a classic Cantonese steamed dish. The fish meat is tender and smooth, and the taste is light and delicious. It can retain the original flavor of the seabass to the greatest extent. Sea bass is rich in high-quality protein and DHA, making it nutritious and easy to digest. This dish is easy to operate and very friendly to novices. It only takes about thirty minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Bass (those who are afraid of killing fish can ask the store to kill them for help) - Chives - Ginger - Cooking oil - Steamed fish soy sauce - Cooking wine - Edible salt
Calculation: per serving: - One sea bass - Three chives - One piece of ginger - Edible oil 10-15ml - Steamed fish soy sauce 10-15ml - Cooking wine 10-15ml - Edible salt 5-10g

Operation: 1. Slice the ginger into shreds, cut the white scallions into sections, and cut the green scallions into shreds. After shredding, soak in cold water and set aside. 2. Wash the seabass after processing, dry it with kitchen paper, score a few cuts on both sides, use salt to wash off the mucus on the fish body, and rub 10g of salt all over the inside and outside of the fish body, marinate for more than 10 minutes. 3. Add a method for changing the cutter and plating of seabass. After changing the cutter, the seabass can be steamed standing up and heated evenly. At the same time, it is more convenient to eat without turning it over. 4. 5. 6. Stuff the fish belly with ginger and green onions, and sprinkle ginger and green onions on the fish body, half of the amount reserved. Use chopsticks to steam the fish on a plate that separates the fish from the plate. 7. When the water is hot and you feel the water temperature, add the fish. 8. Steam over high heat for 10 minutes. 9. Put the steamed fish on a clean plate and remove the ginger and garlic. 10. Pour 15ml steamed fish soy sauce over the fish body. 11. Sprinkle the fish body with ginger and green onions again. Add 10ml cooking oil to the pot and heat it. Pour the cooking oil onto the fish body and serve.

Additional content: - Technical summary: - This dish is all about cooking with your hands. The key point is the heat. The size of the fish is related to the heat. If it is too long, the fish will be too old and the taste will be affected. If it is too short, some of the fish will be undercooked. Therefore, it is generally better to steam fish over high heat within 10 minutes. - Remember that when steaming fish, you need to use chopsticks to separate the fish plate. There are two advantages to doing so: - 1. The fish will drip water onto the plate during the steaming process. If the fish comes into direct contact, it will cause the fish to be fishy when eaten. - 2. The fish can be heated evenly. - The difficulty level of this dish is simple, and the taste is great

When processing the sea bass, cut it open from the back and connect it to the abdomen, so that it will be heated evenly and have a beautiful shape during steaming. Make a few cuts on both sides of the fish body to facilitate steam penetration and make the meat cooked.

After the water boils, put the fish in the plate, steam over high heat for 8 minutes, then turn off the heat and simmer for 2 minutes. This time can ensure that the fish meat is just cooked and remains tender. The specific time can be adjusted according to the size of the fish.

After steaming, pour away the fishy water in the plate, remove the shredded ginger and green onions, and replace with new shredded green onions. Pour the steamed fish soy sauce along the edge of the plate, and then pour a spoonful of boiling oil to stimulate the aroma.

Case: Xiao Chen, an office worker, wanted to make a quick and healthy dish. She chose a fresh seabass, cut it with a knife, spread it with shredded ginger and steamed it in a pot. The whole process takes less than half an hour. The fish is steamed out of the pan and drizzled with soy sauce and hot oil. The fish meat is tender, smooth and has no fishy smell, making it the perfect protagonist for a simple weekend meal.

items.title: Boiled shrimp
items.core: Boiled shrimp is a classic Cantonese quick-serve dish. The shrimp meat is sweet, tender and authentic. The shrimp itself is rich in high-quality protein and various minerals, and it is appetizing and not greasy when paired with dipping sauces. The method is simple, highly error-tolerant, and very friendly to novices. It only takes about 15 minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Live shrimp - Onions - Ginger - Garlic - Green onions - Edible oil - Soy sauce - Cooking wine - Sesame seeds - Oyster sauce - Balsamic vinegar

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Total amount: - Shrimp 250g * number of servings (recommended for 1-2 people) - One green onion - One piece ginger - One onion - 5-8 cloves garlic - Cooking oil 10-15ml - Cooking wine 20 ml - Soy sauce 10-15ml - A handful of sesame seeds - Balsamic vinegar 10 ml - Oyster sauce 10 ml

Operation: 1. Cut the onion into small pieces, slice the ginger, and lay them flat on the pan. 2. Rinse the live shrimp (removing the shrimp threads and trimming off the shrimp legs and slivers with scissors are optional), control the water, and place them on the onions and ginger slices in the pan. 3. Pour cooking wine into the pot, cover the pot, cook on medium heat for 1 minute, low heat for 5 minutes, and turn off the heat for 5 minutes. 4. Make the dipping sauce in parallel with the previous step: - Chop the green onion into chopped green onions, mince the garlic, add soy sauce, sesame seeds, and balsamic vinegar, and stir. - Heat the oil and pour in the dipping sauce. 5. Take the shrimp out of the pan and put them on a clean plate.

Additional content:-Technical details:-Don't make a big fire at the beginning to prevent the bottom from being smeared. - If the pot lid has a vent, adjust the time accordingly (consider adding 30 seconds to medium heat). - The dipping sauce is actually optional, and it can also be pure vinegar. The fresh shrimps gifted by nature taste great without water to dilute the freshness and sweetness.

When purchasing live shrimps, give priority to prawns or sand shrimps. The ones with blue-grey, transparent and shiny shells are fresher, and the shrimp heads are tightly connected to the body and are not easy to fall off.

Add ginger slices, scallion knots and a little cooking wine to the water. After the water boils, pour in the shrimp and cook over high heat. Remove the shrimp immediately after it bends into a C shape and turns completely red in color.

Immediately after taking it out, put it into ice water and soak it for 1 minute. This will make the shrimp meat firmer and more tender, and at the same time, it will cool down quickly to prevent the residual temperature from causing the meat to age.

Case: Fitness coach Xiao Li wanted to supplement protein during dinner but was afraid of being greasy. He boiled a pot of water, added ginger slices and green onion knots, put in the prawns and boiled them for 2 minutes, then fished them out. Paired with minced ginger and vinegar sauce, the shrimp meat is sweet and tender. It can be a meal in 15 minutes, which not only meets nutritional needs but also controls calories.

items.title: Sweet and sour carp
items.core: Sweet and sour carp is a classic Shandong dish. It is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, sweet and sour. The fish body is fried until golden brown and topped with red sweet and sour sauce. It is very tempting. Fish meat is rich in high-quality protein and various minerals, and is easy to digest and absorb. This dish is not very friendly to novices, and the difficulty is above average. You need to master the knife, batter and frying temperature. It takes about 1 hour from prep to dish.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Carp - Tomato paste - White sugar - White vinegar - Starch - Salt - Green onions - Ginger - Cooking wine - One coriander - Pots (two) - One kitchen knife - One fence, one spatula

Calculation: Note that this dish is only available for more than 3 people (fish that are too large or too small are not suitable), so no formula calculation is needed, and it is especially suitable for family dinners, such as New Year's Eve dinner - Carp = about 3 pounds - water = 50g - tomato sauce = 40g - sugar = 20g - white vinegar = 10g - starch = 10g - salt = 30g - green onion = 30g (about half a head) - ginger = 30g - cooking wine = 25g

Operation: 1. Clean the fish and make sure there are no foreign matter such as fish scales 2. Turn the fish head to the left, belly down, and hold the knife in your right hand. Cut 1cm vertically with the knife, press the fish body firmly and slice 3-4cm to the left, then lightly cut the middle of the fish fillet. 3. Put the fish into a basin, then slice the ginger and cut the green onion into sections (you can cut it as you like, mainly to remove the fishy smell) 4. Squeeze the juice from the green onion and ginger into the basin with the force of sucking milk. 5. Add 20g of salt and 25g of salt. Cooking wine, then give the carp a bath and spread it evenly 6. (The longer you marinate the fish, the less fishy smell, it is recommended to marinate for more than 30 minutes) 7. Find a clean basin, add 100g flour, 200g starch, 180g water, 5g salt, mix it evenly with your hands, the batter will be thick and stringy at this time, then add an egg and mix again 8. Wait for 30 minutes 9. Place the fish on the chopping board and dry the water on the fish with a dry towel (this will allow the paste to hang better) 10. Rinse the basin and dry it with a dry towel 11. Heat the oil in a pot, add about 1L of oil, and heat the oil to 70% hot, about 200-240 degrees 12. Pinch up the tail of the fish, sink the fish head to the bottom of the pot, pour hot oil on the fish with a spoon, after the batter is formed, slowly put the fish into the pot, use a spatula to gently scoop up the head of the fish, and then put it on the grate. Prevent the bottom from burning. 13. Prepare a plate for the fish and place it next to the pot. 14. Use a spatula to gently shovel in the fish, and use the two tools to turn the fish over. Fry for another two minutes in the same way (hold the fish head with a fence, hold the fish body with a spatula, and put the fish into a plate) 15. Pour the oil in the pot into a dry basin, set it aside, and then brush the pot clean. 16. Put 50g of water, 40g of tomato paste, 20g of white sugar, and 10g of white vinegar into a small bowl and stir evenly. 17. Prepare a small bowl and add 10g. Starch, 10g water, stir into water starch 18. Heat the pot over high heat, then pour in the sauce prepared previously, bring to a boil over high heat, then turn to low heat 19. Add the prepared water starch, stir while pouring, then turn off the heat after 20 seconds 20. Pour the boiled sweet and sour sauce evenly on the fish with a spoon, you can add some coriander or chopped green onion to garnish, the sweet and sour carp is ready 21. The sweet and sour sauce here is a bit thick...
Additional content: The difficulty of this dish is moderate, and it is not very friendly to novices...

When changing the knife, first cut peony flowers on both sides of the fish body. The knife should be as deep as the fish bone but do not cut it. In this way, after frying, the fish pieces will naturally roll up into a petal shape and look beautiful.

Use dry powder to pat the cracks and edges of the fish body and shake off the excess paste. When the oil is 60% hot, fry the fish tail first to set it, then dip and fry the whole body until golden and crispy.

The sweet and sour sauce is prepared according to the ratio of cooking wine, light soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, and water starch. When it is thick and bubbly, add a little hot oil to make it shiny. Make sure the fish body is dry and hot before pouring the sauce.

Case: Xiao Zhou, a Shandong cuisine lover, tried sweet and sour carp for the first time. He carefully changed the cutter and batter, and controlled the oil temperature properly to fry until golden brown. The sweet and sour sauce is brewed in a precise proportion, making a sizzling sound when the sauce is poured in. The skin is crispy and sweet and sour, and the family exclaims that it looks like the skill of a restaurant chef.

items.title: Braised fish
items.core: Braised fish is a classic dish with a strong home-style flavor. It is salty and slightly sweet, and the fish is tender and delicious. It is a popular Chinese dish. Fish meat is rich in high-quality protein and unsaturated fatty acids, and its nutrients are easy to absorb. It requires processing raw fish and frying, which requires a few steps, so it is a challenge for novices, but you can still succeed if you follow the recipe. From preparation to serving, it takes about 40 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Ginger, garlic cloves, dried chilies - Oil, salt, cooking wine, vinegar, soy sauce, white sugar - Fish Additional materials that can be added: Note that these materials are calculated based on experience, and adding more other than coriander is not a good thing - Oyster sauce - Green onion - Coriander - Millet pepper - MSG (chicken essence)

Calculation: * Fish It is recommended that novices start with a medium-sized crucian carp and cut it in advance to make it easier to mature (otherwise it is easy to get raw on the back of the fish) * Shredded ginger, cut into 2-3 pieces of normal old ginger, and then shred it * 3-4 garlic cloves, smashed or chopped or sliced * 2-3 dried chili peppers (according to personal taste), chopped * Coriander according to personal taste * Salt 10g, if the chili pepper is spicy, a little more is recommended * Vinegar 5ml * Soy sauce 5ml * White sugar 10g * 1-2 green onions, normally sprinkle with chopped green onions * 1-2 millet peppers, you can leave them out, experience from experienced people, add at most 2, otherwise the spiciness will be too high and the chrysanthemums will be broken. * MSG, it depends on personal taste, don’t add too much, 5g is enough. * Oyster sauce, 5g is enough, the same as MSG

Operation: Raw material preparation: 1. Prepare the ginger and garlic, chop it 2. Chop the dried chili pepper, and mix it with the ginger and garlic. Final steps: 1. Add 30-50ml oil and wait for the pot to heat up... 2. Put in the fish that has been wiped dry (if you don’t want to be splashed with hot oil), then shake the pot and fry the fish with hot oil. Note that this process must be on low heat 3. Turn the fish over and repeat the frying process above. 4. Add ginger, garlic and chili and stir-fry until fragrant. 5. Pour in cooking wine, a little more. Be careful during this process as it will produce a lot of fumes. 6. Pour in vinegar (if you like vinegar, add a little more) 7. Then add sugar and soy sauce (dark soy sauce). 8. Add cold water to just cover the fish, then turn to medium heat and cover the pot. After about 1 minute, turn the fish over and continue to cover the pot. 9. After 3-4 minutes, add salt, millet pepper, oyster sauce (MSG, chicken essence, etc.), then continue to cover the pot, and continue to turn it over. 10. When the soup in the pot has reduced to a little under the fins on the back line of the fish (or when there is not much soup), turn to low heat, add coriander, chopped green onion, then cover the pot for 20 seconds, and turn off the heat. 11. Start the pot
Additional Content

Before frying the fish, use kitchen towels to dry the fish body and pat a thin layer of cornstarch on the surface. This can effectively prevent the fish from sticking to the pan and break the skin, and keep the fish body intact and beautiful.

When frying fish, heat the pan with cold oil. The oil temperature is 60 to 70% hot. Add the fish. Do not turn it frequently. Wait until one side is golden and then turn it over. This way you can fry the caramelized shell.

When adding water for stewing, it must be boiling water. The amount of water only needs to cover half of the fish body. Bring to a boil over high heat and simmer over medium to low heat for 8 minutes. Finally, reduce the juice over high heat and keep shaking the pot.

Case: Housewife Sister Liu uses a grass carp to make braised fish. She first pan-fries the fish until both sides are golden brown, then adds seasonings and simmers it until the flavours develop. When it comes out of the pot, the soup is thick, salty, slightly sweet, the fish meat is tender and smooth, and it is especially fragrant when paired with rice. The child who usually doesn't like fish actually added rice for the second time today.

items.title: Braised fish head
items.core: Braised fish head is a classic home-cooked dish. The fish head is rich in colloids, the meat is smooth and tender, and the soup is salty and slightly spicy, making it a great addition to rice. Fish heads are rich in high-quality protein, lecithin and unsaturated fatty acids, which are beneficial to nourishing the skin and brain. Since it requires processing raw fish and chopped bones, it is slightly more difficult. It is not recommended for novices with no basic knowledge to operate alone. The entire preparation (including marinating) takes about 2-2.5 hours.
body: Essential raw materials and tools: - Note: If possible, try to prepare another kitchen knife. There are cheap kitchen knives with thicker blades available in supermarkets or markets. The optimal blade thickness is 5-7mm. - Green onions, ginger, garlic, coriander, bell pepper - Oil, salt, chicken essence, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, aged vinegar, black pepper, cooking wine - Star anise, dried chili pepper - One fish head - Note: Fish heads sold directly in the market are generally divided into two types: white silver carp and flowered silver carp. The former is cheaper, while the latter is slightly more expensive, but tastes better too!
Calculations: Note that this dish only serves 2 people. * One fish head * 200g green onions * 80g ginger * 3-4 garlic cloves * 1/4 bell pepper * 4 cilantro * Two star anise, five dried chili peppers

Operation: Raw material preparation: 1. Wash onions, ginger, garlic, coriander, and bell pepper separately. 2. Rinse the dried chilies and star anise slightly. 3. Cut green onions in half. Cut the second half of the scallions (white part) into sections, each section is about 4cm long. Cut the first half (onion leaves) into sections first, and then split each section into four pieces. 4. Slice ginger, each slice is about 3mm thick. 5. Crush the garlic. 6. Take out two coriander stalks, remove the roots and cut into 1.5cm pieces. 7. Cut the bell peppers into 3mm thick pepper rings. 8. Cut dried chili into four sections. Pickled fish head: 1. Note: The fish body mentioned below is the fish meat that comes with the purchase of the fish head. 2. Remove the scales from the fish head and clean the uncleaned internal organs of the fish head. 3. Chop off the fins and clean the gills. 4. Chop the joint between the fish head, chin and fish body, chop the fish body into pieces, and chop the fish head into four/six petals. *Note: It is difficult to fully describe fish processing in words. You can search for videos related to fish head processing. 5. Wash the chopped fish heads. It is best to wash away the blood retained on the fish pieces. 6. Put the cleaned fish pieces into a basin, add 5g salt, 10g light soy sauce, and 10g cooking wine. Add scallions (the first half chopped) and 1/3 ginger slices. Mix it well and let it sit for 1-2 hours. Final steps: 1. Add 30ml of oil and wait for the pan to heat up... 2. Once the oil is hot, turn the pan down to low heat * If you don't understand why you are doing this, check out the Stir-frying Ingredients in Learn to Stir-fry and Fry. 3. Add the ginger slices and stir-fry slowly until most of the juice in the ginger slices is taken out and turns golden brown. 4. Add the scallions and stir-fry until the scallions turn slightly white. 5. Add minced garlic, star anise, and dried chili pepper, stir-fry for 5 seconds. 6. Pour the marinated fish heads into the pot and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. 7. Pour 500ml of water, add 2g salt, 3g chicken essence, 5g light soy sauce, 3g dark soy sauce, 5g cooking wine, 2g black pepper, and 3g mature vinegar. 8. Put two coriander stalks into the pot and cover the pot. 9. Turn up the heat and bring the water to a boil. 10. Turn to medium heat and simmer until the flavors are absorbed. 11. When the soup is reduced by half, open the lid. 12. Turn up the heat to reduce the juice. When 1/3 of the soup is left, turn off the heat and transfer it to a small basin. 13. Note: Pour the soup in the pot evenly onto the fish head. When serving, you can put the coriander cooked in the pot into the bottom of the small basin. This will make the finished dish look good and delicious. 14. Place the coriander on the fish head that has been scooped out, and place the cut bell pepper rings on top of the coriander. 15. Braised fish head with delicious color and aroma is out of the oven!
Additional Content

Chop the fish head from the lip but keep it connected, remove the internal black membrane and gills. These parts have a strong fishy smell and must be completely removed, and then use kitchen paper to absorb the water.

When marinating, use green onions, ginger slices, cooking wine and pepper to smear the inside and outside of the fish head. Marinate for at least 30 minutes. This can effectively remove the earthy smell and increase the base flavor.

When cooking, first stir-fry the onions, ginger, garlic and dried chilies, add the bean paste and stir-fry the red oil, add the fish head and fry until it is set, then add boiling water, simmer over low heat for 20 minutes to allow the gum to fully dissolve.

Case: Lao Zhang bought a fat fish head and prepared it for braise. He marinated it with onion, ginger and cooking wine in advance to remove the fishy smell, chopped the fish head into pieces and handled it carefully. After stir-frying, add bean paste and spices and cook until the gum blends into the soup and becomes thick and shiny. The aroma fills the air when the lid is uncovered, and the fish head is tender and tasty, making it the focus of the family banquet.

items.title: Braised carp
items.core: Braised carp is a home-cooked Shandong dish. The fish is first fried and then stewed. The skin is slightly tough and the meat is fresh and tender. The salty and sweet sauce is full of mellow pork belly, and the soup is thick and goes well with rice. Rich in high-quality protein and minerals such as calcium and phosphorus, it helps nourish. It takes a little patience to handle the fried fish and seasoning ratio, but the steps are clear and even a novice can complete it by following them. Estimated time from preparation to serving is approximately 1 hour.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - green onions, ginger, garlic, dried chilies - oil, salt, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, mature vinegar, oyster sauce, cooking wine, sugar - carp, pork belly
Calculation: Version for 2 people. - Carp (about 2 pounds) - 100g pork belly - 200g green onions - 80g ginger - 3-4 garlic cloves - 2 dried chili peppers - 50g sugar

Operation: Note: The fish described below are simply processed by the seller at the time of purchase. The fish scales have been scraped and the internal organs have been removed. 1. Wash onions, ginger, garlic and dried chilies separately. 2. Cut the white part of the scallion into sections, each section is about 4cm long, and then split each section into four pieces. 3. Slice ginger, each slice is about 3mm thick. 4. Crush one garlic and chop the remaining garlic into two cloves. 5. Cut dry chili into four sections. 6. Slice the pork belly into slices, about 4cm*4cm. 7. Clean the fish. 8. Make a few slits on the thick part of the fish's back to facilitate the flavor. 9. Pour more oil into the pot and heat it until it is 70% hot (just starting to smoke). Add the fish and fry for 1 minute until the fish skin becomes slightly hard. Take it out and set aside (be careful not to fiddle with the fish right after frying. Wait for a while before flipping and flipping). Pour out the oil for frying the fish and leave a little base oil in the pot. 10. Heat the oil in the pot, add the pork belly and stir-fry until fragrant. 11. Add dried chilies, green onions, ginger and garlic cloves and stir-fry for 1 minute. 12. Pour the fried fish into the pot. 13. Pour along the edge of the pot - 50ml cooking wine - 50ml aged vinegar - 50ml very fresh flavor - 20ml dark soy sauce for coloring - 5ml oyster sauce for freshness - 5g spoonful of salt - 50g white sugar - water to cover the fish noodles. 14. Turn the heat to medium and bring the water to a boil. 15. Reduce the heat to low and simmer until the flavors are absorbed. 16. After 15 minutes, open the lid of the pot and pick out the onions, ginger, garlic and dried chili peppers. 17. Turn up the heat to reduce the sauce. When 1/4 of the soup is left, sprinkle some minced garlic, turn off the heat and serve. 18. Braised carp is out of the pot!

Additional content: Pork belly needs to be added to braised carp for the following reasons: - Lard will be released when the pork belly is stir-fried. Compared with vegetable oil, animal fat is more fragrant. - The pork belly that is stir-fried until golden brown tastes very fragrant after being stewed. It is equivalent to a side dish. - Fish itself has low fat content, so it lacks flavor and the emphasis is on the texture of the meat. Therefore, it is generally recommended to use lard when making fish dishes. If you want a pot of milky and fragrant fish soup. Lard is the best choice~

After cutting the carp, apply a thin layer of salt and cooking wine evenly on the inside and outside of the fish body. After marinating for 15 minutes, use kitchen paper to absorb the surface moisture, and then pat dry starch on it to lock in the gravy.

When frying fish, the oil temperature should be high enough. Heat the pan to 70% heat and fry first to set the shape, then fry over medium heat until the surface is golden. This way, the skin will be slightly tough and can withstand subsequent stewing and will not fall apart easily.

Stir-fry the diced pork belly to remove the fat, then add the onion, ginger, garlic and star anise and sauté until fragrant. Add the sweet noodle sauce and light soy sauce and stir-fry evenly. Add the fish, add boiling water and cook until the sauce becomes thick and thick.

Case: Uncle Wang is a fan of Shandong cuisine. He bought fresh carp, changed the knife and fried it in an oil pan until it was finalized. Stir-fry the diced pork belly to release the oil, add seasonings and cook together with the fish. The finished product is bright red in color, has a strong aroma of salty and sweet sauce, and the fish meat is tender and flavourful. Even the soup is eaten up by the family mixed with rice.

items.title: Meat Crab Pot
items.core: This dish is rich in sauce, the crab meat is sweet and slightly spicy, the potatoes are soft and glutinous, the rice cakes are chewy, and the rice with soup is particularly enjoyable. It is a hard dish suitable for a party. It is rich in high-quality protein and a variety of trace elements and is rich in nutrients. There is a certain degree of difficulty in making it. It requires handling live crabs, controlling the heat and seasoning ratio. It is a bit challenging for novices. The whole process is expected to take about 1 hour.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Meat crabs (recommended priority from high to low: Burmese black crab, blue crab, swimming crab, hairy crab) - Shrimp (optional) - Potatoes - Rice cakes (hard rice cakes are recommended, fresh rice cakes are also acceptable) - Onions - Garlic - Ginger - Dried chilies - Green peppers - Red peppers - Oyster sauce - Hoisin sauce (optional) - Soybean sauce (optional) - Sweet noodle sauce (or barbecue sauce, optional) - Tomato sauce (if not available, squeeze half a tomato and crush it) - Starch (cornstarch or potato starch) - Rock sugar - Chicken essence - White pepper - Cooking wine (you can use rice wine instead) - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Beer - Water

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving is enough for 3-4 people. Per serving: - Meat crab 500 g - Shrimp 200 g - Potatoes 450 g - Rice cake 200 g - Onion 100 g - Garlic 20 g (if shrimp is added, add 10 g) - Ginger 15 g - Dried chili 5 g - Green pepper 30 g - Red pepper 30 g - Oyster sauce 20 g - Cooking oil 30-50 ml (if shrimps are added, add 10 ml; additional 500 ml is needed for frying) - 15 g seafood sauce (substitute: 12 g oyster sauce + 3 g sugar) - 15 g soybean paste (substitute: 12 ml light soy sauce + 2 ml dark soy sauce + 1 g sugar) - 10 g sweet noodle sauce (substitute: 5.5 g sugar + 4 ml light soy sauce + Dark soy sauce 0.5 ml) - 10 g tomato sauce - 40 g starch - 10 g rock sugar - 3 g chicken essence - 2 g white pepper (if shrimp is added, add 1 g) - cooking wine 15 ml - light soy sauce 20 ml - dark soy sauce 5 ml - beer 200 ml (if shrimp is added, add 50-100 ml) - water 800 ml (if shrimps are added, add 200 ml)

Operation: 1. Cut potatoes into cubes with 3 cm sides, cut green/red peppers into 4 cm rhombus slices, cut onions into 3 cm wide crescents, and cut rice cakes into 1 cm thick slices 2. Cut crabs into 50-80 g pieces, wrap in thin starch, and fry in oil at 180 °C 1 3. Put oil in the pot, sauté garlic, ginger and dried chili until fragrant, add all sauces + rock sugar and stir-fry the red oil over low heat, be careful not to burn the bottom. 4. Add crabs, potatoes, beer and water, bring to a boil and simmer for 12 minutes. 5. Add rice cakes and green and red peppers, turn up the heat and reduce the juice until the soup can adhere to the surface of the items, and finally sprinkle with white pepper

Additional content: - Recommended freezing 20 Minutes to make the crab unconscious (don't freeze it hard!), or use chopsticks to insert from the mouthparts to destroy the nerves - if you are using frozen crabs, completely defrost the crab legs and easily fall off, causing the loss of meat. It is recommended to half-thaw and then coat in flour and fry, and extend the frying time to 2 minutes - If the stove power is small, the food will quickly cool down after being put into the oil pan. It is recommended to preheat the oil temperature to 200 °C and fry it in multiple batches - Be sure to remove the crab stomach (triangular bag), crab gills, and crab heart (hexagonal white slices) - Be sure to dry the starch-coated crabs before putting them in the pot, as hot oil will easily splash when exposed to water - Dead crabs must not be used (except those bought frozen, but not used in time after thawing) - Do not eat with persimmons or strong tea - Gout patients should eat with caution - Soak the rice cakes in cold water after slicing them, and rinse them before putting them in the pot to prevent them from sticking to the pot. Minutes, if serious, seek medical attention immediately. If the wound is deep, seek medical attention immediately

When handling live crabs, first insert chopsticks into the crab's mouth to stun it, then uncover the crab shell and remove the gills, stomach and heart. These parts are cold and contain sediment and are inedible.

Dip a little dry starch into the cut edges of the crab pieces and fry them in oil until the cross-sections solidify. This way, the crab meat will not easily fall apart during cooking and can better absorb the flavor of the sauce.

When stir-frying the bean paste and oyster sauce, stir-fry the bean paste and oyster sauce over low heat until they are fragrant. Add an appropriate amount of water and bring to a boil. Then add the potato pieces and cook until soft, then add the rice cakes and crab pieces. Finally, reduce the sauce over high heat until it becomes thick.

Case: Xiao Zhao organized a dinner party with friends and decided to cook crab pot. He carefully chops the live crab into pieces, stir-fries the sauce and cooks it with potato rice cakes. The heat was well controlled, the crab meat was fresh and sweet, and the potatoes were soft and glutinous. Everyone sat around the pot and ate enthusiastically, even the soup and rice were eaten up.

items.id: 芥末黄油罗氏虾-芥末黄油罗氏虾
items.title: Rossian shrimp with mustard butter
items.core: This dish is highlighted by the wonderful combination of butter and mustard. The shrimp meat is firm and tender, and the sauce is rich and spicy. It is a new style seafood dish. Shrimp meat is rich in high-quality protein and a variety of trace elements, and is nutritionally balanced. The difficulty of making it is moderate. As long as you prepare the ingredients in advance and control the heat, even novices can succeed. It takes about 30 minutes from handling live shrimp to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Shrimp Roche * Butter * Mustard * Sugar * Light soy sauce * Oyster sauce * Salt * Cooking wine, rum or beer * Coriander * Garlic

Calculation: According to the amount of 1 plate: * Shrimp Roche 1 catties. The market price in Guangdong is about 40~45 per kilogram * Butter about 20g * Mustard 15g * Sugar 3g * 30g light soy sauce * 30g oyster sauce * 3g salt * 15g to 30g cooking wine, rum or beer * 5 cilantro, cut into sections * 5 garlic, minced into minced garlic

Operation: 1. Cut off the head and tail spikes, tentacles and feet of the shrimp, open the back of the shrimp with scissors, and remove the shrimp line. 2. Stir the mustard sauce in advance: soy sauce, oyster sauce, mustard, salt, sugar, and stir evenly! 3. Wash the coriander and cut into sections and set aside. 4. Drain the water from the shrimps, add oil to the pot, add the shrimps directly, fry over medium heat until golden brown, remove. 5. Add the minced garlic, turn on high heat, and continue to fry the minced garlic using the remaining oil from the fried shrimp. Wait until the white mist comes out of the pot and the minced garlic has fragrant. Add the shrimp and butter, so that the shrimp can fully absorb the fragrance of the butter. 6. Add the prepared sauce, continue to boil over high heat, stir-fry the shrimp until the sauce is reduced, and add wine (30g of cooking wine and beer can be added, and 15g of rum for a strong flavor.) 7. Wait for the sauce to reduce slightly, add coriander and stir-fry twice before serving.

Additional content: * The sauce is prepared in advance and the butter is prepared in advance to prevent time-consuming preparation. * Remember to wait until the shrimps are fried before adding minced garlic to prevent them from turning black and bitter after frying for too long. * If you can't tolerate the mustard, add less. If you can tolerate it, add more. If you add too much, the mustard smell will dissipate after cooking for a while.

Open the back of the Roche shrimp, remove the shrimp lines, drain the water with kitchen paper, sprinkle with a little salt and black pepper and marinate for 10 minutes. This will make it easier to taste and less likely to splash oil when fried.

Melt the butter over low heat until it bubbles slightly, add the shrimp, and fry over medium heat until the shrimp turn red and curved. Be careful not to flip frequently. When one side is golden, flip over and fry the other side.

Mustard sauce is added before serving to use the residual heat to stimulate the spicy flavor. It can be paired with a little honey or sugar to balance the spiciness. It can be poured on the shrimp or used as a dipping sauce.

Case: Xiao Chen, a young white-collar worker, tried new seafood dishes. She deveined the shrimps from their backs, melted the butter and pan-fried the shrimps, and added mustard sauce. The finished shrimp meat is tender and the sauce is spicy and rich. It is served with baguette for dipping. It is served to friends at gatherings and gets unanimous praise.

items.title: Mandarin fish with scallion oil
items.core: Mandarin fish with scallion oil is a home-style steamed dish with rich onion aroma and fresh fish meat. It has a light Chinese taste and is suitable for people from all over the world. Mandarin fish is rich in high-quality protein and unsaturated fatty acids. It has been carefully processed to remove the fishy smell, retaining the deliciousness and nutrition of the fish meat. The method is very friendly to novices and has high fault tolerance. As long as you follow the steps, there is basically no failure. From preparation to serving, the whole process takes about 45 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Mandarin fish - Spring onion - Spicy millet - Ginger - Cooking wine - Vegetable oil - Salt - Steamed fish soy sauce - Steamer basket (including steamer) - Water - Cutting board - Iron pot - Plastic plate or plastic basin (for pickled fish) - Disposable gloves - Kitchen paper - Steamed fish plate (just enough for one fish) - Kitchen knife - Paring knife - Anti-scalding plate clamp (or anti-scalding gloves)

Calculation: Here we take 2 copies as an example for arrangement. During the actual operation, considering that the texture and umami of the fish itself will change with the volume of a single fish, it is recommended that you try to cook in 2 portions for the best umami - Mandarin fish = 1 catty (500g) - Spring onion = 1 root (length 30cm) - Spicy millet = 2 pieces - Ginger = 50g - Cooking wine = 25g - Vegetable oil = 15g - Salt = 8g - steamed fish soy sauce = 10g - water = 5L

Operation: 1. Go to the vegetable market to buy fish that has been processed (it is best not to remove the internal organs if you handle it yourself), and scrape all the scales on the surface of the fish. 2. Use kitchen paper to wipe off the blood and black membrane in the belly of the fish (the blood on the bones will affect the taste, and the black membrane is the source of the fishy smell). 3. Use a kitchen knife to scrape the surface of the fish back and forth several times to scrape off the mucus on the fish to further remove the fishy smell, and then rinse the inside and outside of the fish with clean water. 4. Place the fish flat on the cutting board, use kitchen paper to dry the water inside and outside the fish, then put the fish head to the left and tail to the right. Starting from the gills, make a cut every 3cm lengthwise until the depth reaches the backbone of the fish. Use the same treatment method on the other side. 5. Place the fish flat in the basin and make sure there is no excess water in the plate. 6. Take a 50g piece of ginger (the size of an egg), use a paring knife to remove and wash the skin on the surface, and then cut it into 3mm thick slices. 7. Wash the millet, remove the stems, and cut into 2mm thick discs (or cut into 1mm wide filaments) 8. Wash the shallots, remove the roots, and cut into 3cm segments. For slightly thicker shallots, you can split them in the middle along the direction of the shallot growth. 9. Add 8g of salt and 25g of cooking wine to the basin, put on disposable gloves, and then perform a full-body massage on the fish 1 Minutes, make sure every part of the fish body is evenly coated with salt and cooking wine. 10. After massaging the fish, stuff a piece of ginger into each incision of the fish body, put 3 slices of ginger into the belly of the fish, and marinate for 10 minutes (it is recommended not to marinate for too long, otherwise the freshness of the fish will be reduced) 11. During the marinating period of the fish, add 5L of water to the steamer, and after boiling, put a steamer basket on the steamer 12. After the fish is marinated, water will precipitate. Pour off the excess water, cooking wine and ginger slices, rinse the fish body and fish maw with clean water, and dry the fish body and fish maw with kitchen paper. 13. Place the fish flat on the steaming fish plate, and re-stuff the ginger slices on the fish body and fish maw knife edge. 14. Then put the steaming fish plate into the steamer, cover the lid, and steam over medium heat for 20 minutes 15. During this period, the water vapor will adhere to the whole fish and the plate, and condense to form fish soup. Do not pour this soup after it is out of the pot. This soup is the essence of umami. 16. Use anti-scalding clips to take out the steamed fish plate, and pour 10g of steamed fish soy sauce on and around the fish. 17. Then evenly sprinkle green onion and millet pepper on and around the fish. 18. Pour 15g of vegetable oil into the iron pot and simmer slowly over medium-low heat 5 Minutes, do not use high heat, otherwise the oil will evaporate quickly. 19. Pour the hot oil evenly and slowly over the fish, and the fresh mandarin fish with scallion oil will be out of the oven!

Additional content: After several tests, the success rate is 100%. This dish is very tolerant and is compatible with people of all provinces and tastes. In addition, although this set of tutorials is called making mandarin fish with scallion oil, the raw materials are not limited to mandarin fish. You can use sea fish such as sea bass and turbot instead (freshwater fish itself has more parasites than sea fish, so it is not recommended to use freshwater fish. For freshwater fish recipes, please refer to tutorials such as "Braised Fish"), which has low coupling and strong scalability.

When handling mandarin fish, be sure to remove the black membrane in the abdominal cavity and the blood attached to the bones. This is the key to removing the fishy smell. Marinate it with scallions and ginger slices in cooking wine for ten minutes.
Steam the fish for eight to ten minutes. Turn off the heat and simmer for two minutes before taking it out of the pot. The fish will be the most tender and will not fall apart.
Pour away the steamed water from the plate before pouring the hot oil, and sprinkle with fresh shredded green onions. The oil is 70% hot and poured in to bring out the rich aroma of green onions.

Case: I wanted to cook a light dinner for my family after get off work on the weekend, so I chose mandarin fish with scallion oil. Follow the steps to clean the fish body, marinate it to remove the fishy smell, steam it in a pot and then drizzle it with hot scallion oil. The whole process takes less than an hour. After it was served, the family praised the fish for being fresh and tender without any fishy smell, and even the usually picky eater ate half a bowl of rice.

items.title: Grilled sea cucumber with green onion
items.core: This is a classic Shandong cuisine home-cooked seafood, characterized by the strong aroma of green onions and soft and glutinous sea cucumbers. The soup is thick, bright, salty, fresh and sweet. Sea cucumbers are rich in collagen and a variety of trace elements, which are very beneficial to nourishing the body. The overall cooking difficulty is not high, but you need to spend time in advance to fully soak the dried sea cucumber. The actual cooking process can be completed in about thirty minutes. Novices can easily succeed as long as they follow the steps.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - soaked sea cucumbers - white green onions

Calculation: per portion: - 4 soaked sea cucumbers (Arctic ginseng) - white scallions, just the whites of 1 scallion - 20-25ml edible oil - 20g oyster sauce - 5g light soy sauce - 2g sugar - 2g starch

Operation: 1. Cut green onions into 1cm sections and set aside. 2. Cut the sea cucumber into 1cm sections and set aside. 3. Prepare an empty bowl, pour 20g oyster sauce, 10g light soy sauce, 2g sugar, and stir evenly. 4. Pour starch and water into another empty bowl to prepare water starch for thickening. 5. Heat the pot and put 20ml - 25ml cooking oil in the pot. Wait 10 seconds for the oil to heat up. 6. Add the scallions and turn down the heat, being careful not to let the scallions burn. Fry for about 3-5 minutes. 7. Use chopsticks to pick out the white scallions and put them on a plate and set aside. 8. Pour in the prepared sauce, stir-fry until fragrant, and wait for 1 - 2 minutes. 9. Add the chopped sea cucumber and stir-fry for 1 minute. 10. Add 100 ml of water, wait for 5 minutes over medium-low heat. 11. When the soup in the pot is almost dry, add water starch, and add the green onion taken out earlier. 12. Turn off the heat when it becomes sticky and serve on a plate.
Additional content: - During operation, you need to pay attention to the amount of water in the pot. If it is about to bottom out, just add water starch directly.
Dried sea cucumbers need to be soaked in pure water for 48 hours in advance, and the water should be changed 3-4 times to remove the sand spit and inner wall fascia.
When cooking, use the white part of scallions and fry them in oil until golden brown, then add cooking wine and stock to make the scallions more fragrant and mellow.
The final thickening should be done in two steps, the first time to collect the thick soup, and the second time to let the thick soup wrap around the sea cucumber brightly.

Case: Soak the dried sea cucumber one day in advance before entertaining friends. When cooking it the next day, first saute the green onions, then add the sea cucumber and stock and simmer slowly. When it comes out of the pot, the soup is thick enough to hold up the spoon, the sea cucumber is soft and chewy, and the green onions are fragrant. After tasting it, my friends thought it was from a high-end restaurant and asked about how to make it.

items.title: Garlic Shrimp
items.core: This traditional Cantonese dish is famous for its freshness and tenderness. The shrimp meat is sweet and chewy, and the garlic is rich and tangy. Shrimp is rich in high-quality protein and trace elements such as calcium and selenium. Paired with minced garlic, it can help sterilize and appetizer. The method is very simple, just a few steps of preparing the shrimp, spreading the sauce, steaming, and pouring oil. Even novices can easily master it. The whole process takes about 15 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Shrimp * Garlic sauce * Edible oil * Light soy sauce
Calculation: per serving: * 8 shrimps * 50 g garlic sauce * 20 ml cooking oil * 5 ml light soy sauce

Operation: 1. Use a knife to cut the shrimp head from the middle to 1 cm from the tail. 2. Spread the garlic sauce in the middle of the shrimp body and place it on a plate. 3. Pour hot water into the pot, put the plate into the pot, and steam for 3 minutes. 4. Heat the oil, pour it into the shrimp plate, and pour in light soy sauce
Additional Content
The shrimp backs are opened to a depth of two-thirds, which is convenient for flavoring and maintains the integrity of the shrimp meat. _Remove the shrimp lines thoroughly.
There are two types of minced garlic: raw and cooked. Half of it is fried until golden and mixed with raw garlic, which makes the aroma richer.
Strictly control the steaming time to 5-6 minutes. Take the shrimp out of the pot as soon as it is cooked. If it takes too long, the meat will become old.

Case study: When you have no appetite in summer, try making garlic shrimp. Open the back of the fresh shrimp and remove the shrimp lines, cover with gold and silver garlic paste and steam for six minutes. Sprinkle with chopped green onion and drizzle with hot oil before serving. The garlic is rich and tangy, the shrimp meat is sweet and chewy, and paired with a bowl of white porridge, it has become the most popular summer dinner for the whole family.

items.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
items.core: Garlic Butter Shrimp is a classic Western seafood dish. The shrimp meat is tender and elastic, wrapped in rich garlic and butter, with a light lemon fragrance. Shrimp meat is rich in high-quality protein, and when paired with butter, it provides energy and is suitable for quick nutritional supplements. The recipe is simple and only requires a few common ingredients. Even novices can easily get started. It takes about 20 minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Prawns (black tiger shrimp or prawns are recommended) - Unsalted butter (Anchor is recommended) - Garlic - White wine (optional) - Lemon - Frying pan - Kitchen tongs

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 1-2 people. Each serving: - 8-10 prawns (about 200g) - 30g unsalted butter - 4 cloves of garlic (about 20g) - 15ml white wine (optional) - 1/4 lemon - 10ml olive oil

Operation: 1. Remove the heads and shells of the prawns and leave the tails, pick off the shrimp lines with a toothpick, wash and drain with kitchen paper 2. Cut the garlic into minced garlic and set aside 3. Heat a pan over medium heat and add 10ml of olive oil. 4. When the oil is hot, add the prawns and fry for 1-1.5 minutes on each side until they change color. Remove and set aside. 5. Add butter to the same pan, melt and add minced garlic and sauté over low heat until fragrant (about 30 seconds). 6. If using white wine, add it at this time and cook until the alcohol evaporates (about 1 minute). 7. Return the shrimp to the pan and stir-fry evenly with the garlic butter sauce (about 1 minute). 8. Squeeze in the lemon juice, stir-fry evenly and turn off the heat immediately 9. Place on a plate and pour over the remaining sauce in the pot
Additional content: - Shrimp should not be overcooked, otherwise they will become hard
Use kitchen paper to thoroughly absorb the water from the shrimps. When fried, they can form a golden charred shell and lock in the juice inside.
Add the butter in two batches, the first time to fry the shrimp to add flavor, and finally add a small piece before removing from the heat to make the sauce smoother.
Lemon juice should be squeezed in after turning off the heat to avoid the sourness evaporating due to high temperature, leaving only the fresh and fruity aroma.

Case study: A novice in Western cuisine is trying garlic butter shrimp for the first time. Follow the tutorial to fry the shrimp until both sides turn red, add butter and minced garlic, stir-fry, and finally squeeze lemon juice. After it comes out of the pan, the aroma of milk and lemon are intertwined. The shrimp meat is juicy and springy. It is eaten with a baguette and dipped in the sauce. It is not inferior to the restaurant quality at all.

items.title: Razor clam egg
items.core: Razor clam egg is a traditional home-cooked dish in Fuzhou, Fujian. The razor clam meat is wrapped in egg liquid and fried until it is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with the salty aroma of onions and light soy sauce. Razor clams are rich in high-quality protein and trace elements such as zinc and iron, and are nutritionally balanced when paired with eggs. The preparation is moderately difficult and requires mastering the frying temperature, but the steps are not complicated. You can expect it to be on the table in about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * razor clams * eggs * cooking oil * onions * starch * light soy sauce * chicken essence * cooking wine
Calculation: per portion: * 200 g razor clams * 2 eggs * 100 ml cooking oil * 0.25 onions * starch 20 g * light soy sauce 5 ml * chicken essence 5 ml * cooking wine 5 ml

Operation: 1. Boil the water, put the razor clams into the water, boil them for 2 minutes, pick them up and shell them, and put them into a large bowl. 2. Add onions, light soy sauce, cooking wine, chicken essence, and cornstarch to the large bowl, and stir thoroughly. 3. Break 2 eggs into the large bowl and continue stirring 4. Heat oil in a pan, pour razor clams into a bowl, fry until one side is golden, turn over and continue frying

Additional content: * In more cases, Fuzhou locals will use water chestnuts (to relieve greasiness) and potatoes (to wash oil). Because they are not available during the epidemic, pineapples are chosen. * Fujian cuisine is mainly sweet. If you are not used to it, you can give up sugar. * You can use a spoon to hit the lean meat pieces and hear the sound to judge whether the lean meat is fried thoroughly.
Soak the razor clams in salt water for 2 hours in advance to spit out the sand, blanch them until half boiled and take them out immediately to prevent the meat from getting old.
Stir the egg liquid with a little starch water to wrap the razor clams more firmly and prevent them from falling apart during frying.
First fry the razor clams and then pour in the egg liquid. Fry slowly over medium-low heat until the bottom is solidified, then turn over to keep the complete shape.

Case: A friend from Fuzhou taught me how to make razor clam eggs. Blanch the razor clams that have spit out the sand until they are slightly open, wrap them in seasoned egg liquid and fry them until both sides are golden. The sweet aroma of the onions is combined with the deliciousness of the razor clam meat. The egg skin is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. It is especially delicious when eaten with rice. It has become a must-order dish for family gatherings.

items.title: Braised Crab with Sauce
items.core: This dish is a salty and fresh flavor limited to the Pinghu area of Zhejiang Province in autumn. The crab roe is moist and wrapped in the fragrance of sauce, the crab meat is sweet, and the soup is perfect when mixed with rice. Rich in high-quality protein and trace elements. The difficulty is moderate and suitable for beginners with basic knowledge. It takes about 30 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Crab (river crab is preferred, swimming crab is preferred next) - Doubanjiang - Rock sugar (optional) - Dark soy sauce - Rapeseed oil (unbleached rapeseed oil, commonly known as "rapeseed oil" or "local rapeseed oil", peanut oil is optional) - Tomato paste - Cooking wine - Ginger - Spring onions - Eggs (optional) - Minced pork (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each serving: - 500 g crabs (about 3-4 medium river crabs) - 30-50 g bean paste - 0-15 g rock sugar - 15 ml dark soy sauce - 20 ml vegetable oil - 15 ml tomato sauce - 5 ml cooking wine - 10 g ginger - 10 g green onions - 1 egg (about 50 g) - 50 g minced pork - Water 500 mL

Operation: 1. Wash the crabs clean, then split them in half on the cutting board. 2. Pour vegetable oil into the pot, add minced ginger and bean paste and sauté until fragrant. Add rock sugar and fry until small bubbles appear. 3. Spread a layer of sauce on the plate, then put the cut crabs cut side down and arrange them neatly on the sauce. 4. Put some green onion and ginger slices. It is recommended to crack an egg or spread minced meat on the bottom of the plate. 5. Steam for 10-12 minutes

Additional content: - For salty taste, add 50 g of bean paste, for sweet taste, reduce the amount of bean paste and add rock sugar and tomato paste - Sprinkle a little chopped green onion after it is out of the pot, it will be more fragrant and look better - Reference: The autumn wind is blowing, this delicious Pinghu dish goes well with rice_Chao News Official Website
Chop the crab into pieces and dip the cut surface with a little dry starch. This can seal the crab roe and prevent it from being lost when frying.
The bean paste needs to be minced in advance and stir-fried with oil to produce red oil, and then stewed with crab meat to fully release the flavor of the sauce.
Add a little sugar during stewing to enhance the freshness, and finally reduce the juice over high heat so that the sauce thickens and hangs on the crab pieces.

Case: I bought fresh hairy crabs during the golden autumn season, cut them into pieces according to the Pinghu method, fried the crab roe, and added bean paste and light soy sauce to stew. The rich flavor of the sauce penetrates into the crab meat, and the soup is thick enough to be mixed with rice. Paired with a glass of warm rice wine, it completely restores the authentic flavor of Jiangnan autumn.

items.id: 阳朔啤酒鱼-阳朔啤酒鱼
items.title: Yangshuo beer fish
items.core: Yangshuo Beer Fish is a famous local dish in Yangshuo, Guangxi. It is made from fresh fish with scales from the Li River and braised with beer instead of water. The fish scales are crispy and the fish meat is tender. The aroma of beer and the slightly sour tomato blend together, creating a rich and unique flavor. Fish is rich in high-quality protein and minerals, and paired with tomatoes and peppers, it is rich in vitamins and appetizing. The difficulty of making it is medium, and it is a little challenging for novices, but you can still succeed if you follow the steps. It is expected to be completed in 30 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Swordfish or carp (about 1.5 pounds, let the store handle the internal organs, but do not scrape the fish scales) - Liquan beer (one bottle, about 330ml, Guilin local beer, the most authentic) - Tomato (2 pieces) - Green pepper (2 pieces) - Red pepper (1 piece) - Garlic (5-6 cloves) - Ginger (1 piece) - Onion (2 sticks) - Guilin chili sauce - Cooking wine - light soy sauce - dark soy sauce - sugar - salt - cooking oil
