Calculation: per portion: - 1 swordfish or carp (about 750g, not scaled) - 15ml of cooking wine - 330ml of Liquan beer (1 bottle) - 2 tomatoes (about 300g) - 2 green peppers (about 150g) - 1 red pepper (about 80g) - 6 cloves of garlic (about 30g) - 1 ginger block (about 20g) - 2 green onions (about 40g) - Guilin chili sauce 15g - light soy sauce 15ml - dark soy sauce 5ml - sugar 5g - salt 5g - cooking oil 30ml

Operation: 1. Prepare the internal organs of the fish, keep the scales, clean them, cut them in half from the abdomen (connected at the back), marinate with 15ml of cooking wine, ginger slices, and 3g of salt for 15 minutes. 2. Cut the tomatoes into cubes, green and red peppers into cubes, mince the garlic, slice the ginger, and cut the green onion into sections (separate the white and white green onion leaves). 3. Wipe the bottom of the pot with ginger slices, and pour 30ml into the pot after heating. Heat cooking oil, add fish (skin side down), fry until both sides are golden brown and fish scales are crispy, set aside. 4. Leave the bottom oil in the pot, add scallions, ginger slices and garlic cloves and sauté until fragrant. 5. Add 15g Guilin chili sauce and stir-fry until the red oil comes out. 6. Add tomato cubes and stir-fry until the tomatoes are juicy and soft. 7. Pour in the whole bottle of beer, add 15ml light soy sauce, 5ml dark soy sauce, 5g Add sugar and 5g salt, stir well. 8. Add the fried fish, bring to a boil over high heat, then turn to medium-low heat, cover the pot and simmer for 15-20 minutes. 9. Open the lid, add green and red pepper cubes, and continue to cook for 3-5 minutes. 10. Reduce the sauce over high heat until the soup is thick, sprinkle with green onion leaves, remove from the pot and serve on a plate

Additional content: - The fish scales are the key feature of this dish and must be preserved. They will become crispy and delicious after frying - Cutting the fish in half is easier to fry and the flavor is better than cutting the whole fish - The authentic method uses Guilin chili sauce (not Pixian bean paste) and goes with Liquan beer. If you don't have Guilin chili sauce, you can use garlic hot sauce instead - Tomatoes should be fried until soft to release the juice, so that the soup will be richer - Don’t make the soup too dry, leaving some rice or noodles is very delicious - Reference: Yangshuo Beer Fish Recipe
Choose carp or hairy fish, keep the scales and wash them. When frying, fry the scale side until crispy and then turn it over.
Add enough beer to cover the fish body at one time. After boiling, turn to medium to low heat and simmer to allow the malty aroma to fully penetrate.
Add tomatoes in two batches, half stewed to create a sour taste, and half added at the end to maintain the fleshy taste.

Case: When traveling in Yangshuo, I learned to make beer fish locally. Fry the fish with scales until the skin is golden, then add beer, tomatoes and peppers to stew. The aroma of beer malt is perfectly blended with the sweet and sour tomato. The fish scales are crispy and edible, and the fish meat is tender and tasty. Enjoy it with Lijiang beer and it will feel like you are back on West Street.

items.id: 香煎翘嘴鱼-香煎翘嘴鱼
items.title: Pan-fried fish
items.core: Pan-fried fish is a home-cooked river fish with a strong flavor. The fish is marinated and sun-dried to make it firm and fragrant, and fried until the skin is golden and crispy. The meat is delicate and salty, with a slightly spicy and sweet taste from watercress and green pepper. Fish meat is rich in high-quality protein and unsaturated fatty acids, and its nutrients are easy to absorb. It needs to be marinated and sun-dried for two to four days in advance, and the cooking time is about half an hour. When frying the fish, you need to be patient and control the fire. It is a little challenging for novices, but the aroma is fragrant when it is ready, and it is especially delicious with rice.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Squid (carnivorous fish, delicate meat, good taste) - Ginger - Onion - Garlic - Green pepper - Coriander - Dark soy sauce - White sugar - Doubanjiang - Cooking wine - Light soy sauce - Salt

Calculation: Note: This amount is about 2-3 people per portion: - Pork fish: 2 pounds is best - Ginger foam: 20g - Green onions: half (50 grams) - Garlic: 4 pieces - Coriander: personal taste - Dark soy sauce: 2ml (you can leave it out if you don’t like the strong taste) - White sugar: 10g - Dried chili peppers: 4-6 pieces (choose according to personal taste) - Cooking wine: 100ml - Light soy sauce: 4ml - Salt: about 50g for marinating fish - Edible oil: 100ml

Operation: 1. Kill the fish open-backed (let the fish seller kill it, never open-belly the fish, remember to open the back) and clean it. 2. Spread salt evenly on the surface of the fish, pour about 80ml cooking wine and 20g minced ginger, put it in the fresh-keeping layer of the refrigerator and marinate for 1-2 days. 3. Take out the marinated fish and hang it with a rope to dry in the sun until it is semi-dry (about 1-2 days, the specific time depends on the temperature and sunlight) 4. Please wash the fish with clean water and drain it before eating (to prevent the water from splashing with oil) 5. Heat the pot over high heat, quickly reduce the heat to low, put oil in the pot, try to keep the entire surface of the pot covered with oil, and put the fish into the pot along the edge of the pot (fry the back side first) 6. After the fish is put into the pot (and after turning it over), do not move the fish in a hurry (the skin is easy to break at this time), fry for about 30 seconds, try to shake the pot 7. Fry the back side for about 1 After a few minutes, turn over and fry for about 1-2 minutes until both sides are golden. 8. When both sides are fried, push the fish to the edge of the pot, leave some space and stir-fry the bean paste until fragrant. Add ginger and garlic. 9. After the seasonings are fragrant, add cooking wine, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and pour hot water. The amount of water should be equal to or less than the fish. 10. At this time, change to medium-high heat and cook for 5-10 Minutes, then add chopped green pepper, sugar, chicken essence, thirteen spices, and mature vinegar 11. Reduce the heat to low for 2-5 minutes, add onions and coriander, and it is ready to serve

Additional content: - Remember to kill the fish from the back. When marinating, just apply salt evenly on the surface of the fish. The marinating time and drying time are 1-2 days. - Fry the fish on low heat throughout the whole process. Do not move the fish when it is first put into the pot, as the skin will break. - Pay attention to the degree of doneness after adding the green pepper pieces. The green pepper inside is delicious. In addition, put the coriander last. - Pay attention to the switching of heat, the freshening effect of bean paste, white sugar, and the aroma-enhancing effect of aged vinegar.
When marinating, rub the fish body with coarse salt and Sichuan peppercorns and hang it in a ventilated place to dry. It takes 2 days in summer and 3-4 days in winter.
Before frying the fish, use kitchen paper to absorb moisture from the surface, heat the pan with cold oil to prevent sticking, and fry slowly over medium heat until golden and crispy.
After frying the bean paste until red oil is produced, add the fish, add a small amount of water and simmer for 2 minutes to allow the fish to absorb the aroma of the sauce.

Case: Marinate and sun-dry the fish in advance according to the hometown method. After three days, the fish body will be dry and firm. Heat the pan with cold oil and slowly fry until both sides are golden brown, add the watercress and green pepper and stir-fry. It's salty, slightly spicy and has a sun-dried aroma. Served with freshly steamed rice, I ate two bowls in one go.

items.id: 鲤鱼炖白菜-鲤鱼炖白菜
items.title: Carp stewed with cabbage
items.core: Carp stewed with cabbage is a home-cooked stew with a rich aroma. The fish meat is soft and tender, and the cabbage is sweet and juicy. It is a typical northern flavor. Carp is rich in high-quality protein and unsaturated fatty acids, and when paired with cabbage, it provides dietary fiber and vitamins for a balanced nutrition. The preparation process requires frying and stewing the fish, which is difficult but not complicated. It is suitable for friends with basic cooking experience. It takes about 40 minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Edible oil - Ginger - Garlic - Carp - Cabbage heart/baby cabbage - Salt - Dark soy sauce - Light soy sauce - Cinnamon - Star anise - Pixian bean paste - Dried chili pepper (you can omit it if you don't like spicy food)

Calculation: Note: Seasonings are converted based on the size of the fish. Each portion: - Edible oil: 10ml - Ginger: 3 slices - Garlic: 3 cloves (cut into pieces) - Carp: 1.2 pounds (cleaned) - Baby cabbage: 13 slices (you can put more, it will shrink after one meal) - Salt: 5-8 grams - Dark soy sauce: 3ml - Light soy sauce: 6ml - Cinnamon: 1 piece - Star anise: 3 pieces - Pixian bean paste: 20 grams - Dried chilies: 4-6 (choose according to personal taste)

Operation: 1. Clean the carp and change the knife (make a few more wounds on the fish to facilitate the flavor) 2. Clean the baby cabbage and put it on a plate for later use. 3. Add oil to the pot, and when the oil is hot, add "less salt", "ginger", "garlic", "Pixian bean paste", "cinnamon" and "star anise" and stir-fry until fragrant. 4. Put the fish in the pan and fry (3 minutes) and turn it over every (30 seconds) 5. Add "water" (the amount of water should be as level as the fish, or a little less), add "light soy sauce", "dark soy sauce" and "baby cabbage" 6. Simmer over high heat for 15-20 minutes. When the soup is almost dry, add "salt" and serve.
Additional content: - You can also put some vermicelli. The vermicelli needs to be soaked in cold/hot water first. It needs to be soaked until soft. You can put it in together with the baby cabbage.
Before frying the carp, wipe the pan with ginger slices to prevent it from sticking. Fry on both sides until it is set and then flip to keep the fish skin intact.
When stewing fish, add boiling water instead of cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then simmer over medium to low heat for 20 minutes. The soup will turn milky white.
Put the cabbage in twice, stew the cabbage for 10 minutes first, and add the cabbage leaves for the last 5 minutes to keep them sweet.

Case study: In the winter in the north, carp is stewed with home-pickled pickled cabbage. First fry the fish until both sides are golden, then add cabbage and vermicelli to stew it together. The cabbage soaked up the deliciousness of the fish soup, and the fish meat was soft and tender. A large pot of hot fish was served on the table, and the whole family sat around and ate it to warm their bodies and hearts.

items.id: 鳊鱼炖豆腐-鳊鱼炖豆腐
items.title: Braised bream with tofu
items.core: Braised bream with tofu is a home-style braised dish. The fish is tender and tasty, the tofu is full of soup, salty and slightly spicy. Bream is rich in high-quality protein and unsaturated fatty acids, while tofu provides plant protein and calcium, making the combination nutritionally balanced. The difficulty of making it is moderate, and you need a little patience to prevent it from sticking when frying the fish. The overall steps are clear, and even novices can try it. It takes about 40 minutes from prep to finish.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - bream (the fish can be handled by the stall owner for help) - old tofu - ginger - onion - garlic - dark soy sauce - cinnamon (optional) - rock sugar - dried chili (you can leave it out if you don't like spicy food) - cooking wine - light soy sauce - salt - star anise (optional) - bay leaves (optional) - hot water

Calculation: Note: This amount is about 2-3 people per portion: - Bream: 550 grams - Lao tofu: 400 grams - Ginger: 5 pieces - Green onion: half (50 grams) - Garlic: 4 pieces - Dark soy sauce: 2ml (you can omit it if you don't like the strong taste) - Cinnamon: 1 piece - Rock sugar: 5 pieces - Dried chili peppers: 4-6 pieces (choose according to personal taste) - Cooking wine: 5ml - Light soy sauce: 4ml - Salt: 5-8g (choose according to personal taste) - Star anise: 1 - Bay leaves: 1-3 pieces - Edible oil: 10ml - Hot water: 400g

Operation: 1. Cut the bream into a knife, add ginger slices and cooking wine and marinate for 5-10 minutes. 2. Cut the old tofu into pieces and put it into water for later use. 3. Add oil to the pot. You can put some salt in the pot to prevent the fish from sticking to the pot when frying. Dry the marinated fish with kitchen paper, put the fish into the pot, and fry both sides. 4. When both sides are fried, push the fish to the edge of the pot, leave some space and add onions, ginger, garlic, dried chili peppers, bay leaves, and star anise to stir-fry to bring out the flavor. 5. After the seasonings are fragrant, add cooking wine, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, rock sugar, and cinnamon. Pour in hot water. The amount of water should be equal to or less than the fish. 6. After the fire is boiled, add the old tofu. The tofu sticks to the edge of the pot. Add salt and turn to low heat. 7. Simmer for 10-15 Minutes, then use high heat to reduce some juice, and you can take it out of the pot
Additional content: - Fry both sides of the fish for 2-4 minutes each - Fry the fish over medium-low heat throughout - When taking it out of the pan, add some chopped garlic to make it taste better
Score the bream on both sides, dry it with kitchen paper, sprinkle with a little salt and marinate for 10 minutes before frying to prevent sticking.
Cut the tofu into pieces and soak it in light salt water for 10 minutes. It will not break easily when stewed and will be more flavorful.
Stew the fish for 8 minutes before adding the tofu, allowing the tofu to absorb the essence of the fish soup, and finally reduce the juice over high heat.

Case study: Homemade bream stewed with tofu, first fry the fish until both sides are golden brown, add tofu and bean paste and cook together. The tofu absorbs the umami flavor of the fish soup, the fish meat is tender and flavourful, and the salty and slightly spicy soup mixed with rice is particularly fragrant. The novice made it successfully the first time, and it has become a regular weekend dish at my house ever since.

items.title: Butter fried shrimp
items.core: Butter-fried shrimp is a home-cooked seafood dish with rich flavor and tender and chewy shrimp meat. Fresh shrimp is rich in high-quality protein and minerals such as calcium and zinc. When paired with butter, it adds milky flavor and energy. The preparation is relatively simple, just need to be patient with the live shrimps, and even a novice can get started smoothly. It takes about an hour in total.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Fresh shrimps (I highly recommend firm-fleshed nine-section shrimps, ordinary prawns are also acceptable) - Butter (Anchor is recommended, use a small box of 7g at a time) - Black peppercorns (the kind ground in a bottle) - Light soy sauce - Salt - White sugar - Rice wine
Calculation: per serving: - 300g fresh shrimp - 7g butter - About 15ml black peppercorns - 45ml cooking oil - 10ml light soy sauce - 5ml rice wine - 10ml sugar - 2.5ml salt

Operation: 1. Remove the heads of fresh shrimps, and pull out the shrimp threads (if this step is not handled well, you can remove the shrimp threads when opening the backs in the next step), use scissors or a kitchen blade to open the shrimp backs, drain the water and set aside. 2. Prepare the sauce: put all the above-mentioned light soy sauce, rice wine, sugar, and salt in a small bowl, stir well and set aside. 3. Heat the pot over medium high heat, put cooking oil in the hot pot, wait 10 seconds for the oil temperature to rise 4. Put all the shrimps into the pot, start to grind black pepper, sprinkle evenly on the shrimps and stir-fry. 5. When the shrimps change color, add butter. When the butter is completely melted, pour in the prepared sauce and continue to stir-fry. 6. Stir-fry over high heat for 15 seconds until the juice is reduced and then serve on a plate.
Additional content: - The shrimp tastes better when the back is open, but remember to use a knife carefully when handling it, as novices can easily hurt their hands - Chef Feng's recipes
Use the kitchen to cut the backs of live shrimps after processing, which not only facilitates the removal of shrimp lines but also allows the butter sauce to penetrate better.
Melt the butter over low heat and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant, then add the shrimp and fry to prevent the butter from becoming burnt and bitter due to the high temperature.
Sprinkle a little sea salt and black pepper before serving, and squeeze a few drops of lemon juice to enhance the fresh taste.

Case study: Try frying live shrimps in butter. Cut off the tails, feet, back and back of the shrimps and remove the threads. Fry over low heat until the shrimp shells are bright red. Add minced garlic and butter and stir-fry. When it comes out of the pan, it has a rich milky aroma, and the shrimp meat is chewy with a hint of garlic. Paired with a glass of white wine, the simple ingredients create a stunning effect.

items.title: toast jam
items.core: This is a minimalist and quick breakfast. Slightly toasted toast is sandwiched with sweet and fragrant jam. It is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. It is easy to carry around. It is a typical convenient Western-style simple meal. Mainly provides carbohydrates and sugar, which can quickly replenish morning energy. The operation is almost zero-threshold, which is very suitable for busy novices who are not good at cooking. It only takes about 2 minutes from prep to done, no fire required, and almost no cooking utensils to clean.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Fresh toast - Jam - Bread machine
Calculation: - two slices of toast - enough jam to cover one side of toast

Operation: 1. Put the toast into the bread machine 2. Set the gear and it will pop up automatically when the time is up 3. After two minutes, the toast will pop up after heating. 4. Take out a piece of toast, spread it with jam and cover it with another piece of toast. 5. Wrap it in a napkin and you can eat it while walking or finish it before going out. It can be done in two minutes, the operation is very simple, the taste is very delicious, and it is very suitable for programmers. It takes a short time, does not produce extra waste, and does not require cleaning tools or anything.

Additional content: Bread machines generally cost no more than 100 yuan. Toast can be delivered to your door from the supermarket downstairs or Meituan. It usually costs 10 yuan per pack for eight pieces. The shelf life is relatively short and it is very clean and hygienic.
Choose whole wheat or multigrain toast, toasted until slightly burnt, for a better taste and better nutrition than refined white bread.
Choose low-sugar jams with high pulp content and avoid too many additives and refined sugars.
Can be paired with cheese slices or peanut butter to increase protein, making breakfast more balanced and lasting.

Case: In the morning when I was catching the early train, I made toast and jam breakfast in two minutes. Put the whole wheat toast in the toaster, spread it with homemade strawberry jam while it's hot, and add a slice of cheese. Eat on the go, crispy and sweet, healthier than convenience store breakfast, and save time queuing.

items.title: Sun Egg
items.core: Sun Egg is a home-cooked breakfast made quickly in the microwave. The taste is tender and smooth, the egg white is solidified and the yolk is slightly runny. It is a typical quick dish. Eggs are rich in high-quality protein and multiple vitamins and are easy to digest and absorb. The method is very simple and friendly to novices. It only takes 3 minutes to use a microwave oven with controllable heat, and it only takes a few minutes to reheat it if the heat is not controllable.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggs - Salt - Oil - Microwave oven with controlled heat or microwave oven without heat control (see additional content for definition and differentiation) - Chopsticks or toothpicks

Calculation: - The amount of eggs is 1. - The amount of salt is 1 g per egg. - The amount of oil is 5 mL per egg. Using the conditions above, calculate the proportion of raw materials you plan to use.

Operation: Microwave oven with controllable heat: 1. Prepare a small bowl, pour in the oil calculated in the previous step, sprinkle with salt, and stir evenly. Tilt the bowl so that the oil coats the surface of the bowl. 2. Take out an egg and break it into a small bowl. 3. Poke holes on the surface of the egg yolk. Poke 5 with toothpicks or 1 with chopsticks. 4. Place in the microwave on medium heat for 3 minutes. Uncontrollable heat microwave oven: 1. Prepare a small bowl, pour in the oil calculated in the previous step, sprinkle with salt, and stir evenly. Tilt the bowl so that the oil coats the surface of the bowl. 2. Take out an egg and break it into a small bowl. 3. Poke holes on the surface of the egg yolk. Poke 5 with toothpicks or 1 with chopsticks. 4. Place in microwave for 1 minute. 5. While (the sun-cooked egg is not solid in a large area), beat it in a microwave oven (30s);

Additional content: while (the cookedness of the sun-cooked egg does not meet personal taste) Beat it in a microwave oven (1 minute); - Uncontrollable heat microwave oven: - Definition: A microwave oven that cannot control the heat and can only control the duration. - Identification method: If the words "low fire", "medium fire" and "high fire" cannot be found on the operating panel of the microwave oven, it is a non-controllable heat microwave oven. - Controlled heat microwave oven: - Definition: A microwave oven that can control both the heat and the duration. - Identification method: If the words "low fire", "medium fire" and "high fire" can be found on the microwave oven operating panel, it is a controllable heat microwave oven
Use a microwave-friendly container, apply thin oil on the inner wall to prevent sticking, and season the egg liquid with a little salt.
Adjust the time according to the microwave power: 700W heating for 90 seconds, 1000W heating for 60 seconds.
Sprinkle freshly ground black pepper on the surface of the egg yolk, and pair it with whole wheat bread to enhance the taste.

Case: Xiao Lin, an office worker, is pressed for time in the morning, so he cracks eggs into an oiled mug, heats them in the microwave at high heat for 1 minute and then takes them out. The egg yolks and egg whites solidify, and he eats them with toast for 3 minutes for breakfast.

items.title: Perfect Poached Egg
items.core: This is an egg made through the circulating poaching method developed by scientists. The yolk is dense and delicate, the protein is evenly coagulated, and the taste is distinct. It retains more nutrients, contains 23% more polyphenols than traditional cooking, and is rich in protein. The production is difficult and requires precise temperature control and repeated transfers. The production is expected to take about 35 minutes.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: - Fresh eggs (AA grade recommended) - 100°C boiling water pot (diameter ≥ 15cm) - 30°C warm water pot (diameter ≥ 15cm) - Timer - Colander
Calculation: per serving: - 1 egg (about 60g) - 100°C boiling water 1500ml - 30°C warm water 1500ml

Operation: 1. Prepare two pots of water: Pot A maintains 100°C boiling water, and Pot B maintains 30°C warm water. 2. Use a slotted spoon to put the eggs into Pot A and start the timer. 3. Transfer the eggs to another pot of water exactly every 2 minutes. 4. Repeat the transfer operation for a total of 16 times (total 32 minutes). 5. After the last transfer, let it sit in Pot B for 30 seconds. 6. Immediately put into ice water (0 degrees Celsius) to stop heating (maintain for 30 seconds) 7. When peeling, start from the blunt end air chamber and peel off the egg membrane along the longitudinal axis

Additional content: - Key parameters: - Yolk center temperature: 67±1°C - Egg white layer temperature: - Outer layer: 100°C→87°C - Middle layer: 87°C→55°C - Inner layer: 55°C→30°C - Nutritional advantages: The polyphenol content is 23% higher than traditional cooking methods
Prepare two containers to hold boiling water and 50°C warm water respectively, and monitor them in real time with a thermometer.
Leave the eggs at room temperature for 20 minutes before handling to avoid excessive temperature differences that may cause eggshell rupture.
Finally, soak in ice water for 5 minutes to completely stop heating, making it easier to peel and maintain the taste.

Case: Fitness coach Ms. Zhang strictly followed the scientific formula and soaked the eggs alternately in 100°C boiling water and 50°C warm water. After precise temperature control for 35 minutes, she obtained perfect hard-boiled eggs with dense yolks and no ash rings.

items.title: Poached eggs in microwave oven
items.core: Poached eggs in microwave oven are a convenient home-cooked dish, with tender and smooth protein, soft and waxy yolk, and the fragrance of sesame oil. Eggs are rich in high-quality protein and lecithin. The method is extremely simple and can be easily mastered by novices. It only takes about 2 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggs - Sesame oil - Salt

Calculation: You need to determine how many servings you plan to make before each production. One serving is just enough for 1 person for breakfast. Per serving: - 2 eggs - 35ml drinking water - 3ml sesame oil - 0.8g salt

Operation: 1. Break the eggs into a small bowl and use chopsticks to poke 2 holes in all the egg yolks to avoid heating and staining the microwave oven. 2. Then pour room temperature drinking water into the bowl. 3. Pour edible salt into the bowl. 4. Finally add sesame oil. 5. Place the bowl with the ingredients in the microwave and heat it on high heat for 80 seconds. 6. After the set time is reached, use a rag to take out the finished product.
Additional content: - Before heating in the microwave, if you want to further avoid egg yolks and egg whites from splattering, you can put a lid on the bowl to avoid staining the microwave
Choose a microwave bowl with a depth of 15cm or more to prevent the egg liquid from boiling and overflowing.
Use a toothpick to poke 3-4 small holes in the egg yolk to prevent it from exploding when heated.
After taking it out of the pot, let it sit for 30 seconds to use the remaining heat to solidify, and sprinkle with chopped green onion to add flavor.

Case: Xiao Wang, a college student, uses a microwave bowl to make breakfast in his dormitory. He cracks the eggs and pierces the yolk, pours a little sesame oil on high heat for 1 minute, the egg white solidifies and the yolk becomes soft and glutinous. Pair it with rice for a quick meal.

items.title: Microwave steamed eggs
items.core: A tender steamed egg made quickly in the microwave, with a texture as delicate as pudding, it is a quick home-cooked dish. It is rich in high-quality protein, easy to digest and absorb, and is suitable for breakfast or light snacks. It is very simple to make and can be easily started by novices. The whole process can be completed in about 10 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggs - Warm water or stock - Salt - Light soy sauce (optional) - Sesame oil - Heat-resistant bowl - Plastic wrap or microwave-safe lid

Calculation: - 2 eggs (about 100g of egg liquid) - 100-120ml of warm water or stock (1.0-1.2 times the volume of egg liquid) - 1g of salt - 2ml of light soy sauce (optional) - a few drops of sesame oil (for cooking) Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials planned to be used.

Operation: 1. Beat the eggs, add warm water/broth, salt, and light soy sauce, stir gently and try not to foam. 2. Sieve the egg liquid into a heat-resistant bowl. If there are any bubbles on the surface, poke them lightly with a toothpick. 3. Cover with plastic wrap and poke 8-10 small holes, or use a microwave-safe lid (leaving gaps). 4. Heat in the microwave: - 700W: 1 minute and 30 seconds → Heat for another 20-30 seconds depending on the situation until the surface is just solid. - 600W: Approximately 1 minute 40 seconds – 2 minutes 10 seconds. - 800W: Approximately 1 minute 10 seconds – 1 minute 40 seconds. 5. After heating is completed, take it out and let it sit for 1 minute to allow the residual temperature to fully mature the center. 6. Drizzle with sesame oil, sprinkle with chopped green onion and serve. Different power and containers will affect the time. It is recommended to heat small amounts and multiple times for the first time to find the best time for your equipment.

Extras: - Water temperature should be 40–50°C and should not be overheated. - The ratio of egg liquid to water should be between 1:1 and 1:1.2 for the best taste. - Covering with plastic wrap and punching holes can prevent the surface from popping or honeycombing. - Sifting significantly improves fineness. - If there are bubbles or water coming out of the surface, it means the heating has been overdone. Just shorten the time next time.
Mix egg liquid and warm water in a ratio of 1:1.5, and sieve to remove foam for a more delicate mixture.
Cover with high-temperature plastic wrap and punch holes to prevent water vapor from dripping and forming honeycombs.
Adopt segmented heating method: first high heat for 2 minutes, then medium heat for 6 minutes.

Case: Ms. Li, a new mother, uses microwave steamed eggs to make complementary food for her 1-year-old baby. The egg liquid is sieved with water at a ratio of 1:1.5, covered with plastic wrap and heated over medium-low heat for 8 minutes. She gets steamed eggs that are as tender as pudding, and the baby eats them deliciously.

items.title: microwave cake
items.core: The microwave version of quick cake has a soft and sweet texture. It is a family dessert that can be easily made with no basic knowledge. It is based on eggs and flour, and is paired with butter to provide energy and rich aroma. The sugar quickly replenishes physical strength. Adding nuts or fruits can also increase dietary fiber and vitamins. You only need to prepare a few ingredients, and it can be completed in one minute with the help of a microwave oven on high heat. From preparation to tasting, it only takes 2 minutes at the fastest, and a novice can cook it in about 20 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Microwave - Microwave-safe container - Butter - Flour - Baking powder (it tastes like cake without it) - Eggs

Calculation: - 1 egg 🥚 - 15g flour 🍚 - Baking powder 🍚 2.5g - White (brown) sugar 🍬 10g - Salt 🧂 1g (optional taste) - Coffee powder ☕ - Chocolate 🍫 - Oatmeal 🍿 - Milk 🥛 - Nuts 🥜 - Cookie crumbs 🍪 - Banana🍌 - Not Dark Cuisine🍆

Operation: 1. Add the following ingredients, be careful not to exceed 3/4 of the container - Scoop butter as big as half an egg into the container, heat it in the microwave for 15 seconds until it melts - Melt/mash the chocolate/banana into granules/paste - Crack in an egg and beat it up - 15g white (brown) sugar (you can add more if it’s sweet) (see Attachment 4) - Add 1g salt (if the subsequent flavor ingredients contain salt, you need to consider it yourself) - Add 2.5g baking powder - Add 15g flour (gluten does not have much effect) - Add any flavor ingredients you like! (Dry ingredients such as nuts and biscuits are not added now) - Stir until the dry powder is invisible and thick yogurt-like - Add optional dry ingredients (excluding brewing powder) at the top 2. Praise yourself🥰 3. Heat in microwave (high heat) for 1 minute (to a fluffy cake shape) 4. Take out the cup (it’s hot to the touch↑) and take a photo of it on your WeChat Moments and you’re ready to eat.

Additional content: - The operation before praising yourself can be repeated many times to make a bigger cake - Baking powder is used to make the cake fluffier. Most of them do not contain aluminum. They cost a few yuan a pack. You can buy it and prepare it at home - Add any flavor ingredients you like! If you add liquid (such as milk) in this step, please make sure it can be stirred into thick yogurt in the next step. It is recommended to add small amounts multiple times to prevent excess water from causing the finished product to become shriveled - the ingredients should not exceed 3/4 of the container!!
The flour and baking powder need to be sieved and mixed to avoid clumping and affecting the fluffiness.
Use room temperature eggs and softened butter, making sure ingredients are mixed evenly.
Do not open the door during heating. It tastes best when eaten while it is hot.

Case: Xiao Chen, a baking enthusiast, uses a mug to make emergency desserts, mix flour, eggs, butter and sugar, microwave on high heat for 1 minute to get a fluffy cake, sprinkle with chopped nuts, and complete afternoon tea in 2 minutes.

items.title: Sausage North African Egg
items.core: Italian Sausage North African Eggs is a rich and fragrant Mediterranean-style dish. The soft-boiled eggs are nestled in the sweet and sour tomato meat sauce and served with crispy bread for dipping. It has a rich taste. The main ingredients provide high-quality protein, and tomatoes, bell peppers and onions bring vitamins and dietary fiber. It’s not difficult to make, just pay attention to the temperature of the eggs and it will be ready to serve in about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Pork sausage (casing removed), chorizo or diced lunch meat - Barilla Napoletana Sauce - Eggs - Bell peppers (green or red) - Onions - Olive oil - Parmesan cheese (optional) - Fresh parsley (optional) - Chili peppers (optional) - Bread (sourdough bread recommended) Sourdough, ciabatta or thick-cut toast) - wide pan (with lid)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Per serving: - Meat (sausage/luncheon meat): 100g - 150g - Barilla Napoli Pasta Sauce: 1 jar (400g, provides basic tomato, onion and herb flavor) - Eggs: 3 - 4 - Bell pepper: half (finely sliced) - Onion: half (diced) - Olive oil: 10ml - 15ml (for stir-fry)

Operation: 1. Remove the casings from the Italian pork sausage and set aside; dice the onion; cut the bell pepper into thin strips. 2. Pour 10ml - 15ml olive oil into a wide pan and heat over medium heat. 3. Add the processed sausage or luncheon meat and stir-fry until the edges are golden and crispy (if using raw sausage, mash it with a spoon to change color). 4. Add the diced onions and shredded bell peppers to the pan with the meat and stir-fry for 4 - 5 minutes, until the vegetables are soft and the onions are translucent. 5. Pour in Barilla Napoli Pasta Sauce and stir evenly. Reduce heat to medium-low and maintain simmering for 2 - 3 minutes. (If the sauce seems too thick, add 15ml water). 6. Use the back of a spoon to make 3 - 4 small "dimples" in the sauce in the pan. 7. Carefully crack the eggs into each hole in turn. 8. Close the lid of the pan and use steam to simmer the egg whites. Wait 3-5 minutes. NOTE: Please check status frequently. Finish this step when the egg whites are opaque and set, but the yolks still jiggle when you shake the pan gently (to a runny state). 9. Turn off the heat. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese, fresh parsley or chopped dried chili pepper, if desired. 10. Serve directly from the pan with crusty bread for dipping in the egg yolk and sauce.

Extras: - Meat Selection Suggestions: - Italian Sausage: For the most authentic flavor (recommended to look for sausages with Fennel seeds in the ingredients). - Luncheon meat: brings a salty, nostalgic taste, and can be fried to a slightly crispy surface. - Chorizo: If you like a smoky, spicy taste and can dye the base an attractive red, this is the best choice.
Choose Italian sausage with a fat content of more than 20%, and stir-fry the red oil to make it more fragrant.
Add a little honey to tomato sauce to balance the acidity and enhance the layering of the sauce.
After beating in the eggs, turn to low heat and cover. Turn off the heat immediately when the egg whites solidify and the yolks flow.

Case: A food blogger made North African eggs for weekend brunch. He sauteed Italian sausage and vegetables in a cast iron pan, added tomato sauce to boil, then added eggs and simmered for 5 minutes. The soft-boiled eggs were served with crispy bread for dipping, which was well received by his family.

items.title: Hand cake
items.core: The hand cake is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, with distinct layers. It is a popular home-cooked pastry. The crust is made of semi-hot noodles, which is pliable and chewy. It is paired with eggs and vegetables for a balanced nutrition. The recipe is beginner-friendly and only takes about 40 minutes from kneading to cooking, making it perfect for busy mornings.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - plain flour - boiling water - cold water - cooking oil - salt - eggs - lettuce - ham - cheese slices

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1~2 people. Total amount (per serving): - 200 g flour - 100 ml boiling water - 50 ml cold water - 15 ml cooking oil - 3 g salt - 1 egg - 30 g lettuce - 30 g ham - 1 cheese slice

Operation: 1. Put the flour in a bowl, add boiling water and stir until it becomes flocculent, then add cold water and knead it into a smooth dough, cover it with a damp cloth and let it rest for 20 minutes. 2. Divide the dough into portions of about 100 grams, roll into balls, and roll into thin slices. 3. Spread cooking oil evenly on the surface, sprinkle with salt, roll into a snail shape, and let rest for 10 minutes. 4. Roll the dough into a thin pancake again with even thickness. 5. Pour oil into the hot pan and fry over low heat until golden brown and bubbly on both sides. 6. Place fried eggs, lettuce, ham, cheese slices and other ingredients on the fried pancakes, then roll them up.

Extras: - Use boiling water mixed with cold water to knead the dough, which will help improve the pliability of the crust. - The dough should not be proofed for less than 20 minutes, otherwise it will be difficult to roll out thinly. - You can add or reduce ingredients according to personal taste. It is recommended that the total weight of ingredients be controlled within 100 grams. - The remaining raw dough can be kept in the refrigerator for 24 hours and then rolled out when used.
Choose quick-frozen cake crust with semi-scalded dough process, which can be fried directly without thawing.
Place the crust in a cold pan and fry slowly over medium-low heat until golden brown and distinct layers on both sides.
Beat the eggs when the pie crust is slightly cooked, and use a spatula to spread it gently to cover the entire pie.

Case: In the morning, an office worker mother grabs the semi-finished pancake crust with her hands, fry it in a pan over low heat without adding oil, cracks an egg on the pancake, flips it over, rolls it up and cuts it into sections, garnishes it with lettuce and ham, and makes a sumptuous breakfast in 15 minutes.

items.title: Longan and red dates porridge
items.core: A sweet, soft and glutinous traditional Chinese porridge. Boiled with glutinous rice, red dates and longan, it has its own sweetness and warms the body and stomach. It has the nutritional effects of nourishing blood and calming the nerves, strengthening the brain and improving intelligence, and nourishing the heart and spleen. The method is very user-friendly and can be easily mastered by novices. It takes about 70 minutes from preparation to when the porridge fills the house with aroma.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Glutinous rice (or rice) - Red dates - Longan
Calculation: per serving: - 100g glutinous rice - 15 red dates - 15 longan

Operation: 1. Take out the longan meat, wash it twice with clean water, put it into a bowl and soak it for 10 minutes. 2. Wash the red dates twice with clean water, put it into a bowl and soak it for 10 minutes. 3. Put the glutinous rice into the rice cooker, rinse it twice with clean water, and then add 2000ml of water. 4. Add the longan and red dates to the rice cooker. 5. Turn on the rice cooker cooking mode. The porridge will be ready after 1 hour.

Additional content: Friends who have different preferences for the thickness of the porridge can increase or decrease the amount of water as appropriate. The cooked porridge will be sweet, and the sweetness can be controlled by controlling the amount of longan added.
Soak glutinous rice in cold water for 2 hours in advance to make it easier to cook and have a sticky texture.
Peel the red dates to avoid overheating, and place the dried longans in the pot for the last 20 minutes to retain their aroma.
Use a casserole to simmer over low heat. After the rice grains bloom, turn off the heat and simmer for 10 minutes to make it more fragrant and sweet.

Case: A health expert cooks longan and red date porridge every week, soaks the glutinous rice for 2 hours in advance, removes the pits of the red dates and cooks them with dried longan. After simmering for an hour on low heat, the porridge and rice bloom. After eating a bowl before going to bed, the quality of sleep is significantly improved.

items.title: boiled corn
items.core: Boiled corn is a quick home-cooked dish with a sweet and chewy texture. Fresh corn is cooked in its husks to retain its original flavor, and salt and sugar are added to enhance the taste. It is rich in dietary fiber, vitamins and carbohydrates, which can provide the body with a feeling of satiety. It’s extremely simple to make, even for novices, and only takes about 15 minutes from prep to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Fresh corn - A pot large enough to hold the corn - Water - Salt - Sugar (optional)

Calculation: - One corn with husk - About half a finger of water covering the corn - When cooking the corn, start with light salt water, about 2 grams of salt and 50ml of water - Add or not add sugar according to taste (optional)

Operation: 1. Peel off the husk of fresh corn and put the remaining corn husks into the pot. 2. Add about half a finger of water to cover the corn, add salt and sugar. 3. After the water boils, turn to low heat, cover and continue to cook for 15-20 minutes. The corn will be fine as long as it is cooked. 4. Drain the water after cooking and eat after cooling.
Additional Content
Choose corn with 2-3 layers of inner skin and corn silk to retain the original flavor.
Put cold water into the pot to completely cover the corn. After the water boils, turn to medium heat and cook for 10 minutes.
Remove and drain immediately after cooking to avoid loss of flavor caused by prolonged soaking.

Case: Mr. Wang, a fitness enthusiast, boils corn for breakfast. Put the corn in the skin in cold water. After the water boils, add a little salt and sugar and cook for 10 minutes. After taking it out, the corn kernels will be full and sweet. Pair it with eggs to supplement protein.

items.title: Hot spring egg
items.core: Hot spring eggs originate from Japan. The egg white is in the shape of semi-fluid curd, but the yolk is warm and solid. The taste is smooth and delicate, which is exactly the opposite of the soft-boiled egg. Eggs are rich in high-quality protein, lecithin and multiple vitamins, and are very nutritious. When making, you need to use a thermometer to control the water temperature at 70°C. Although there are slight temperature requirements, the steps are simple and can be completed after waiting patiently for about half an hour. Served with kombu soy sauce and chopped green onion, it is fragrant and refreshing, making it an easy snack.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: Main ingredients: - Eggs Necessary tools: - Kitchen thermometer (try to use a thermometer with a clip) - Cup (no specific requirements, as long as it is a cup) Secondary ingredients: Additional ingredients for garnishing, optional - Kombu soy sauce (a Japanese-style less salt soy sauce, used to season hot spring eggs) - Chives
Calculation:- The amount of egg is 1 as per your food intake and the size of the pan.

Operation: Boil eggs: 1. Fill a pot with a certain amount of tap water, make sure that the water surface is about 3cm below the eggs, and insert a thermometer into the water. 2. Turn on the heat or open the induction cooker, and gradually adjust the power or flame size of the induction cooker to keep the water temperature at 70 degrees Celsius. 3. Put the eggs in the pot. Eggs cannot be stacked on top of each other. They should all be at the bottom, leaving room for shaking. 4. Maintain the current temperature for 25 minutes. 5. Prepare a cup of ice water. 6. Take out the eggs and immediately put them into the ice water and wait for 3 minutes. 7. Crack the eggs into a small bowl to complete the preparation.

Additional content: Flow diagram: graph TD A [Add water to the pot and insert the thermometer] --> B [Control the water temperature to 70°C] B --> C [Put in the eggs and keep the water temperature at 70°C for 25 minutes] B --> D [Prepare ice water] C --> E D --> E [Take the eggs out and put them in ice water and wait for 3 minutes] E --> F [Put the eggs into a small bowl] Remarks: - If you use a mechanical thermometer (no power supply required), the thermometer probe needs to be submerged in the water at least 6cm. If you use an electronic thermometer, there are no special requirements. - The pot can be slightly thicker to facilitate temperature control. - Although 70 degrees Celsius for 25 minutes can completely kill salmonella, you should still eat as little as possible, or buy regular eggs that can be eaten raw.
Use a probe thermometer to monitor in real time and keep the water temperature stable at 70℃±1℃.
Take the eggs out of the refrigerator and let them warm to room temperature for 20 minutes before putting them in water.
Eat immediately after cooking. The flavor will be better with kombu soy sauce and freshly ground wasabi.

Case: Japanese food enthusiasts use a low-temperature slow-cooking machine to make hot spring eggs at home, set the water temperature to 70°C, wait for 30 minutes after putting the eggs in, take out the egg whites and make them semi-liquid, and pair them with kombu soy sauce and chopped green onions. The taste is amazing.

items.title: Soft-boiled eggs
items.core: This is a home-cooked egg dish that can be easily made with an ordinary electric pot. The egg yolk is in a runny state and has a tender, smooth and fragrant taste. Each egg provides about 6 grams of high-quality protein, which is especially suitable for fitness people to supplement nutrition. The production process is simple and straightforward. As long as you master the heating and resting times, novices can get started quickly. The whole process only takes about 15 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggs - Electric pot - Water - Stopwatch (optional)
Calculation: - 1 egg or more (no matter how many eggs you have as long as your electric cooker can fit it) - about 2 cm of cold water to cover the eggs

Operation: 1. Put the eggs into the electric pot. The eggs should not be stacked on top of each other. They should all be at the bottom, leaving room for shaking. 2. Pour in cold water covering about 2 centimeters of the eggs. 3. Open the lid and use maximum power to heat until the water boils (about 85 - 95 degrees, rolling slightly, not completely boiling). 4. Turn off the heat, cover the lid, and let the eggs sit. - If you want a runny yolk in the center, let it sit for 6 minutes. - If you want a fully cooked, brittle yolk, let it sit for 10 minutes. 5. Drain the water, rinse the eggs with cold water for about 1 minute, and then shell them for consumption.

Additional content: If you feel that the eggs are not cooked enough, you can add more water according to your preference. WARNING: Soft-boiled eggs carry a risk of salmonella infection. It is not recommended to let it sit for less than 5 minutes.
Put the eggs into the pot with cold water, and the water should completely cover the eggs by more than 2cm.
Turn off the power immediately after the water boils, and use the residual temperature to continue heating for 6 minutes.
After timing accurately, remove and put into ice water. The shelling effect will be best after 5 minutes.

Case study: A newcomer to fitness uses an ordinary rice cooker to make soft-boiled eggs. Put the eggs into the pot with cold water. After the water boils, turn off the power and simmer for 6 minutes. Remove the cold water and peel the shells. The egg yolk will be runny. Use it with fitness meals to supplement high-quality protein.

items.title: Fried dumplings
items.core: Pan-fried dumplings are a home-cooked pastry with golden and crispy bottoms and juicy fillings. They are commonly found on northern dining tables. Made with quick-frozen dumplings, it is rich in carbohydrates and protein and is quick and easy. Estimated difficulty level is two stars, it is very beginner-friendly, and it takes about 15 minutes to serve.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Dumplings (quick-frozen dumplings) - Sesame seeds, green onions (cut into sections) or other ingredients
Calculation: Per portion: - One package of dumplings (choose according to personal appetite, about 10-15 pieces)

Operation: 1. Take out the pan (non-stick pan is best) 2. Add 10ml - 15 ml cooking oil 3. Turn on the heat and put in the dumplings (spread them as evenly as possible, not stacked) 4. Add water immediately, so that the water line does not cover 1/2 of the average height of the dumplings 5. Cover the pot (the stove should be on high heat at this time) 6. Wait 8 - 10 minutes 7. When there is only 2mm of water left in the pot, Turn to medium heat and start frying. 8. When all the water has evaporated, shake the pan to heat the dumplings evenly. 9. Add black sesame seeds and chopped green onion and simmer for 10 seconds. 10. Take out a dumpling after 1-2 minutes and observe the bottom. If a golden crispy skin appears, take it out immediately.
Additional content: - During operation, you need to observe the situation inside the pot at all times and remember not to be distracted by playing with your mobile phone.
Quick-frozen dumplings do not need to be defrosted, just fry them in a pan over medium-low heat.
Cover immediately after adding water and use the steam to cook the filling.
After the water dries, open the lid and fry for 1 minute to restore the crispy texture on the bottom.

Case: An office worker uses quick-frozen dumplings to make fried dumplings in the morning. Brush the pan with thin oil and place the dumplings. Fry until the bottom is golden, then add water to 1/3 of the dumpling. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. The bottom of the pan will be crispy and the filling will be juicy.

items.title: Oatmeal Egg Pancake
items.core: Oatmeal Egg Pancake is a quick and nutritious breakfast. It has a soft and tender texture, with the aroma of oatmeal and the richness of egg milk. It is a simple home-cooked style. Rich in protein, carbohydrates and dietary fiber, it can provide the body with sufficient energy, especially suitable for fitness people and workday mornings. The method is simple and friendly to novices, and it usually only takes ten minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggs - Oats - Milk 50-100g, just stir the oats into a thick consistency - You can add 50g of vegetables, such as spinach, according to taste.

Calculation: - Two eggs, you can also choose two egg whites and one egg yolk. - 50g pure dry oatmeal (about the same amount as an egg) - A carton of milk, about 250ml - A handful of chopped vegetable leaves

Operation: 1. Mix the milk and dry oatmeal and stir well until it becomes sticky. 2. Beat the eggs until uniform in color. 3. Pour the egg liquid into the oat milk and continue stirring until thick and uniform. 4. Add a layer of butter to the pan and cover evenly. 5. Add the mixed ingredients and spread them into a cake shape. 6. Heat over low heat for two to three minutes. If you want to add vegetables, you can add chopped vegetable leaves during the heating process. 7. Turn over and continue heating for two minutes. 8. Take out of the pot and serve with remaining milk for breakfast.

Additional content: - If the taste is salty, you can add salt, pepper and other seasonings when stirring the egg liquid. - Use low heat when pancakes to avoid partially burning the oats. Nutritional content: The estimated nutritional value (three major nutrients) of a serving of the above breakfast is as follows, for reference for those who love fitness*. - Carbohydrates: 39g - Protein: 30g - Fat: 19g - Total calories: 450kcal *: Milk is calculated based on the common 250ml
Soak the oats in milk for 3 minutes, then mix with egg liquid after softening. The cake body will be more delicate and not easy to fall apart.
Brush a thin layer of oil on the bottom of the pan, pour a ladle of batter into a round shape, fry over low heat until the edges are solidified, then turn over.
To increase satiety, add half a mashed banana or a small handful of chopped spinach, fry it and eat it hot.

Case: On weekday mornings, Xiao Lin mixed instant oats, eggs and milk into a paste, fried them into two small cakes in a pan over low heat, packed them with blueberries and took them away. He arrived at work before nine o'clock and was not hungry.

items.title: Milk Oatmeal
items.core: A convenient and nutritious breakfast with high protein and high fiber, which cleverly combines the smoothness of milk, the grain flavor of oats and the tenderness of fried eggs. It is warm and soft in the mouth, easy to digest, and has a strong feeling of satiety. The preparation process is simple and straightforward, extremely friendly to novices, and can be completed in about three minutes. It is even more refreshing when paired with fruits and vegetables.
body: Essential raw materials and tools: - Milk (pasteurized milk tastes better) - Oats - Eggs
Calculation: - 🥛 Milk 280ml/per - 🍳 Egg 1/per - 🍚 Oats 40g/per Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials planned to be used.

Operation: Conventional method for cooking oats: 1. Pour milk into a breakfast cup (cold is enough) 2. Prepare 200ml of water. If it is drinking water, add oats directly, otherwise please add oats after boiling 3. After the water boils for 2 minutes, the oats are cooked 4. Take out the cooked oats and pour them into the milk (try not to pour the water used to cook oats into milk, which will affect the taste) Quick method for cooking oats: 1. Replace oats with quick-cooking oats 2. Pour the milk into the container with quick-cooking oats and stir. 3. Put the mixture in the microwave. 4. Microwave at medium heat for 4 minutes. Cooking method of omelette: 1. Heat a pan, put a layer of oil in the pan, fry the eggs after the oil is hot, fry for 20 seconds on each side, consider adjusting the base (3g salt and pepper, optional) 2. Turn off the heat, put on a plate, cook for basically 3 minutes. Done, the finished dish will be at room temperature, easy to eat, and usually eaten in 2 minutes at a time. 🥑 It is better to eat fruits, vegetables, and soda crackers

Additional content: - Due to the different firepower of different microwave ovens, the firepower of microwave ovens cannot be accurately indicated - It is not recommended that the mixture exceed 50% of the container capacity, otherwise the contents are likely to overflow during the heating process - It is not recommended to use glass cups for cooking, the same reason as above
Heat the milk until it is slightly steaming and then mix it with the oats. The texture will be smoother and the oats will be less clumped.
Mix oatmeal and milk in a ratio of 1:2, simmer for 2 minutes and then stir. The consistency is more suitable for breakfast.
Keep the omelette on low heat. Turn off the heat when the egg white is solidified. Mixing the egg yolk into the oats will make it more moist.

Case: In the morning when I was in a hurry, Amin brewed instant oats with hot milk, fried a tender egg and put it beside the bowl. He finished the meal while packing his schoolbag, and he did not feel bloated on the way.

items.title: Air fryer bread slices
items.core: Air fryer bread slices are a simple and quick staple food, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, with a pure wheat aroma, especially suitable for consumption during the fat loss period. It is rich in dietary fiber and plant protein, which can provide a feeling of satiety for a longer period of time. There are no barriers to making it, just put the bread slices into the air fryer. It is extremely friendly to novices and only takes about five minutes from preparation to completion.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Bread slices - Air fryer
Calculation: per serving: - Bread slices (two slices)

Operation: 1. Take out two slices of bread (it is recommended to use coarse grain bread slices) 2. Place the bread slices vertically into the air fryer 3. Bake at 200°C for 5 minutes 4. Take it out and use it
Additional content: Nutritional information table (data based on whole wheat bread slices) - Calories 254 kcal - Protein 12.3 g - Fat 3.5 g - Carbohydrates 43.1 g - Dietary fiber 6.0 g
Choose whole wheat or multigrain toast. The thickness of a single slice is about 1 cm. It is heated evenly and will not burn easily.
Preheat the air fryer for 3 minutes in advance and bake at 180 degrees for 3 to 5 minutes until the surface is slightly crispy.
Control the sauce to less than half a spoonful, and give priority to yogurt sauce or avocado puree to avoid excessive calories.
Case: On Tuesday during the fat loss period, Xiao Zhou put two slices of whole-wheat bread into the air fryer and baked them at 180 degrees for 4 minutes.

items.title: American scrambled eggs
items.core: This is a soft and tender American home-style egg dish. After adding milk, the egg flakes are fine and moist, rich in high-quality protein and calcium. It’s simple and beginner-friendly and only takes about 20 minutes from prep to dish.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: - Eggs - Whole milk/cream - Butter - Salt
Calculation: per portion: - 3 eggs - 10g of whole milk/cream - 5 grams of butter - 1 gram of salt

Operation: 1. Crack the eggs into a large bowl, add salt and beat until foamy, let stand for 15 minutes 2. Cut the butter into small pieces and put it into the pot, pour the egg liquid, and stir continuously over low heat 3. As soon as the butter melts, quickly stir the egg liquid and break it into a fine shape. Turn off the heat before the egg liquid is roughly solidified. 4. Add milk and stir for 15 seconds until the scrambled eggs are moist and dense. Place on a plate

Additional content: - If you want to eat more, you can add fried diced tomatoes, diced onions, diced bacon, diced cheese, etc. in the last step. (Anyway, water won’t come out anymore) - Use a frying pan (non-stick pan). - Considering that many people only scramble one or two eggs per person, a pot with a smaller caliber may be more convenient for stirring evenly in the pot.
Beat eggs and milk in a ratio of 2:1, sift once, and stir-fry them until they are smoother and free of egg lumps.
After the butter melts, turn down the heat to low, pour in the egg liquid and continue to stir-fry. Remove from the heat immediately when it is half solid.
Sprinkle salt and black pepper last to avoid adding salt too early to make the egg liquid water out, which will affect the fluffy taste.

Case: At eight o'clock on the weekend, Xiao Chen beat up two eggs with a spoonful of milk, slowly stir-fried them in a butter pan over low heat, and they were still soft when placed on toast. The children loved to eat them.

items.title: Scotch Egg
items.core: This simple version of Scotch egg is crispy on the outside and soft and tender on the inside. It combines the milky aroma of cheese and the smoky flavor of bacon. It is a creative snack originated from British cooking. Eggs provide high-quality protein, cheese supplements calcium, and the hand-made crust can meet the energy needs of a meal. The preparation process is not complicated and can be easily picked up by novices. It only takes about 20 to 30 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggs - Hand pie crust - Cheese - Bacon - Air fryer or oil pan
Calculation: one serving - 50g eggs (about 1) - 1-2 portions of hand pancakes (depending on the size of the eggs) - 1-2 slices of cheese - 1-2 slices of bacon

Operation: 1. Boil the water for 3 minutes with cold water and take it out 2. Remove the eggs and put them in ice water to peel them faster and more completely. 3. Wrap the eggs with cheese slices 4. Wrap the eggs with bacon slices 5. Cut off both ends of the hand cake and wrap the eggs in a rectangular shape. 6. Put the oil in the pan at 60% (the oil surface fluctuates, there is smoke, and when the chopsticks are inserted into the oil, bubbles appear around it is the 60% temperature). Fry until golden brown. 7. Air fryer at 160 degrees for 15 minutes 8. Cut and eat
Additional content: - Cheese slices, bacon slices, and hand cakes can be purchased directly from Taobao
Cook the eggs in cold water for 6 and a half minutes, take them out and refrigerate them immediately. This will make them easier to keep intact when peeling.
Use your hands to warm up the pie crust slightly before wrapping it, and place it with the seam facing down so that the filling will not be exposed during baking.
Bake in the air fryer at 180 degrees for about 12 minutes. Let the surface turn golden and let it sit for 2 minutes before cutting.

Case: At noon on Sunday, Xiaoxia wrapped the soft-boiled eggs with cheese and bacon, then wrapped them tightly with the crust, and baked them in the air fryer until golden brown. After cutting them, they were runny and crispy. Family members said they looked like store-bought ones.

items.title: Tea Eggs
items.core: This traditional snack is rich in tea, fresh and delicious, and rich in high-quality protein. It is a quick and nutritious breakfast choice. The preparation steps are clear and the difficulty is moderate. Novices need to pay attention to the heat and spice ratio. It can be completed in about 30 minutes. It can feed 2-3 people at a time and is suitable for leisurely preparation on weekends.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Eggs - Star anise - Bay leaves - Cinnamon - Fennel - Rock sugar - Black tea - Light soy sauce - Dark soy sauce - Salt

Calculation: - 400g eggs (about 8 pieces) - 4g star anise (about 2 pieces) - 0.5-1g bay leaves (about 2 pieces) - 3g cinnamon bark (1 small piece) - Fennel 5g - rock sugar 15g - black tea 20g - light soy sauce 15g - dark soy sauce 25g - salt 3g Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials planned to be used.

Operation: 1. Boil the eggs in cold water over high heat for about 8 minutes (depending on your own kitchen utensils) 2. Remove the eggs and submerge them in cold water 3. Crash the eggs against each other to create cracks in each egg 4. Put the eggs in the pot, add star anise, bay leaves, cinnamon, fennel, rock sugar, black tea, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and salt 5. Add water until the eggs are covered 6. After boiling over high heat, turn to medium and low heat and cook for 15 minutes After cooking for 15 minutes on medium heat, remove the residue and soak the eggs for a while for a better taste.

Additional content: - The purpose of removing the eggs from supercooled water is to create a gap between the eggs and the shells - You can choose not to add salt according to your personal taste - Star anise, bay leaves, cinnamon, fennel, rock sugar. If you don’t have so many ingredients, you can buy ready-made marinade bags - The conventional marinade penetrates slowly and the internal taste is easy to be bland. If you want to taste it faster and cut it better: peel the shell → make 3-11 cuts on the side of the egg white (in the up and down cross direction, just close to the yolk, not too deep to avoid the egg yolk scattering) → put it in a small container, and the marinade will cover the egg → soak it for more than 2 days
After the eggs are cooked, crack them first so that the marinade can penetrate into the egg whites and the taste will be more uniform.
Add soy sauce and spices after boiling the black tea to a brown color to prevent the tea from becoming astringent and affecting the overall taste.
Soak for at least 4 hours after marinating to make it more flavorful overnight; refrigerate in time if left at room temperature for too long.

Case: On Saturday afternoon, Lao Zhao boiled six eggs, cracked them lightly, soaked them in black tea, star anise, cinnamon and light soy sauce, and peeled them open for breakfast the next day. The tea was fragrant and not greasy.

items.title: Steamed Eggs
items.core: This is a home-cooked dish known for its smooth texture like pudding and elegant and delicious flavor. It is eaten in both north and south. The north often calls it "chicken cake" affectionately. Eggs are rich in high-quality protein and lecithin, making them a convenient choice for daily nutritional supplements. The method only requires mastering the egg-water ratio and slow steaming over low heat. It is very friendly to novices and can usually be completed in about 15 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Fresh eggs - Hot water - Tin foil or plastic wrap
Calculation: - Two eggs - 2g of salt - 260ml of hot water

Operation: 1. Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them up 2. Take another container and pour 1.5 times (half an eggshell is 0.5 times water) into the warm water (temperature 20~30) of the egg liquid (temperature 20~30), pour the salt into the water and dissolve 3. Pour the salt water into the egg liquid and stir evenly in one direction clockwise or counterclockwise. You can scoop out any bubbles and discard them, and sieve them for a better taste. 4. Wrap the bowl containing the egg liquid with tin foil (or cover it with a plate), place it in a pot with a lid and add about 3cm of water. 5. Boil the water over medium heat, then turn to the lowest heat and continue steaming for 4 minutes

Additional content: - Generally, it can be eaten after leaving the pot for a while, retaining the original flavor of the eggs. - You can also add steamed fish soy sauce and chopped green onion sesame oil as condiments.
Mix egg liquid and warm water at a ratio of 1:1.5. The water temperature is not hot, and it will become more tender and less likely to form honeycombs after steaming.
Sift the egg liquid and skim off the foam. Cover the bowl with a plate or plastic wrap to prevent water vapor from dripping in.
After the water boils, turn to low heat and steam for 10 to 12 minutes, then turn off the heat and simmer for 2 minutes until the center is solidified.

Case study: For summer breakfast, Xiao Tang mixed the egg liquid with an egg-to-water ratio of 1:1.5, sieved it and steamed it over low heat for 12 minutes, then took it out of the pan and poured some light soy sauce and sesame oil on it. The entrance was as smooth as pudding.

items.title: Steamed Hanamaki
items.core: This is a traditional northern pasta dish, soft and delicious, with a light wheat aroma. Steaming frozen Hanamaki can quickly replenish carbohydrates and dietary fiber. The recipe is extremely simple and can be easily mastered by novice cooks. The whole process only takes half an hour, making it an ideal quick breakfast.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Frozen Hanamaki - Round plate - Steaming rack - 400ml water

Calculation: - 5 frozen Hanamaki (3 pieces for girls) (can be purchased in supermarkets and various grocery shopping platforms) - Round dish, 28cm in diameter - Steaming rack, 20cm in diameter - 400ml water

Operation: 1. Take out 5 Hanamaki from the packaging bag of the Hanamaki 2. Lay the flower rolls flat on the plate, trying not to overlap. 3. Pour 400ml of water into the pot, put the steaming rack inside, place the plate containing the flower rolls on the steaming rack, and cover the pot. 4. Turn up the heat and heat until the water boils. 5. Turn to medium heat and heat for 15 minutes. 6. Open the lid and feel the surface temperature of the Hanaki with your hands. If it is not hot enough, continue to cover the lid and heat. Otherwise, you can turn off the heat and remove from the pot. 7. Take out the plate and let it cool to 50 degrees before eating
Additional content: - During operation, you need to pay attention to the fact that the water in the pot cannot be less than 50ml.
There is no need to defrost the frozen flower rolls. Put them in the pot after boiling water to reduce collapse and keep them soft.
Leave a distance of two fingers between the flower rolls to allow smoother steam circulation and avoid local inclusions.
After steaming, turn off the heat and simmer for 3 minutes before uncovering to prevent the temperature difference from shrinking and hardening the surface of the rolls.

Case: On a winter morning, Xiao Guo took out four flower rolls from the freezer, steamed them for 15 minutes after the water boiled, and brought them to the office with a cup of soy milk. He ate them warmly without looking for snacks in the morning.

items.title: Egg Fried Rice Cake
items.core: A simple and quick snack, slightly crispy on the outside, soft and glutinous on the inside, wrapped in the aroma of eggs and sweetness, it is a southern home-cooked snack. Glutinous rice cakes provide rich carbohydrates, and eggs supplement protein. They are high in calories but very filling. The production process is extremely simple and can be easily mastered by novices. The whole process only takes about ten minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggs - Rice cakes - White or brown sugar
Calculation: per serving: - Two pieces of rice cakes - Brown sugar 10g (recommended between 8g - 15g) - 1 egg - Cooking oil 10-15ml - Edible salt 2g

Operation: 1. Cut the glutinous rice cake into rectangular pieces for easy frying later. 2. Crack an egg into a bowl and beat it into pieces. Add 2g of edible salt. 3. Put the cut small glutinous rice cake into the beaten eggs accordingly until both sides of the glutinous rice cake are coated. 4. Pour 10ml of vegetable oil into the pot, put the coated glutinous rice cake into small pieces and fry slowly over low heat until soft. 5. Slowly pour the remaining egg liquid on the surface of the glutinous rice cake. 6. Use chopsticks or a spoon to turn the glutinous rice cake over, fry it back and forth until golden brown and then eat

Additional content: - When putting the glutinous rice cake in, be careful to space the glutinous rice cakes apart to prevent them from sticking together - The amount of eggs depends on the amount of glutinous rice cake - The amount of sugar depends on personal preference - Egg Fried Rice Cake Tutorial
Cut the glutinous rice cake into 1 cm thick slices. If it is too thin, it will be hard to fry. If it is too thick, it will not be easy to heat through the center.
Add a little water to the egg liquid to disperse, dip the glutinous rice cake evenly and put it in the pot. The surface will be more golden and non-stick.
Fry over low heat until both sides are lightly browned and then serve. Sprinkle a small amount of sugar or soybean flour.

Case: In the morning in a small southern town, Xiao Liang cut the glutinous rice cake into thick slices, dipped it in egg liquid and slowly fried it over low heat. When both sides were slightly brown, sprinkled with sugar, and ate it with soy milk while walking. He was not hungry until noon.

items.title: Tuna Sauce Sandwich
items.core: This Western-style breakfast sandwich is made of water-soaked tuna mixed with mayonnaise and Russian pickle juice. It is salty, slightly sour, and has a dense texture. It is particularly filling when paired with crispy toast. Rich in nutrients such as high-quality protein and Omega-3, it can quickly replenish energy. It's very simple to make, just mix the sauce and heat it in a light food maker, and even a novice can make it in 5 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Water-soaked canned tuna (it is not recommended to use oil soaking, it will be very greasy) - Square toast slices - Mayonnaise - Russian pickle juice - Cheese slices (optional) - Ham slices (optional) - Light food machine
Calculation: - Water-soaked tuna 65g - 2 square toast slices - Mayonnaise 50 mL - Russian pickle juice 10-15mL (can be adjusted according to personal taste)

Operation: 1. Pour the tuna, mayonnaise, and Russian pickle juice into a bowl, stir with a spoon to ensure that the tuna pieces are broken up, and the sauce will be mushy, and set aside. 2. Place 1 piece of toast on the light food machine 3. Spread the prepared tuna sauce on the toast, 10-15ml is recommended 4. Cover it with another square piece of toast and press the machine to turn it on. 5. After the machine stops heating automatically, you can put it on a plate and use

Additional content: - Tuna sauce can be refrigerated in the refrigerator the night before - It is recommended that the tuna sauce be refrigerated for no more than a week, and it needs to be covered with plastic wrap - Be careful not to turn on the machine before pressing to avoid safety issues
Drain the water from the canned tuna before mixing with the sauce. The filling will not be thin and the sandwich will not collapse easily.
Limit the mayonnaise to 1 tablespoon, and add a few drops of pickled cucumber juice to enhance the flavor, which is refreshing and not greasy.
Preheat the snack machine and press-bake for 2 to 3 minutes. The toast will become crispy and the fillings will be slightly hot before taking it out.

Case: In the morning before fitness, Xiao Lu drained the water-soaked tuna, mixed it with mayonnaise and pickle juice, put it into toast and baked it in a light food machine for 3 minutes. After finishing the training, he felt very calm.

items.title: Korean numbing eggs
items.core: A sweet, spicy and rich Korean soft-boiled egg side dish, the sauce is full of egg whites, the entrance is tender and smooth, and the aftertaste is slightly spicy. Eggs provide high-quality protein and lecithin, which are nutritious and satiating. The recipe is extremely simple and can be easily mastered by novices. It takes about an hour and a half from boiling the eggs to refrigerating them.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggs - Korean soy sauce (or light soy sauce) - Japanese mirin - White sugar - Sesame oil - Green onions - Chili peppers (millet or green and red peppers)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. The following amounts are for one serving of sauce, enough to marinate 5 - 8 eggs. Each serving: - 5 - 8 eggs - 4 tablespoons of soy sauce (or light soy sauce) - 4 tablespoons of water - 2 tablespoons of mirin - 2 tablespoons of sugar - 5ml of sesame oil - 15g of green onions (chopped into scallions) - 15g of chili pepper (cut into rings)

Operation: 1. Boil a pot of water, add the eggs after the water boils, and cook for 7 minutes (to get the perfect soft-boiled egg state). 2. While the eggs are cooking, prepare the sauce: Pour 4 tablespoons of soy sauce, 4 tablespoons of water, 2 tablespoons of mirin, and 2 tablespoons of sugar into a small pot. 3. Heat the sauce until it boils, boil to evaporate the alcohol smell in the mirin, then turn off the heat and set aside. 4. Add the sliced ​​pepper rings to the cooled sauce. 5. Take out the hard-boiled eggs, cool them in ice water and peel off the shells. 6. Put the peeled eggs into the prepared sauce, drizzle 5ml sesame oil on the surface and sprinkle with chopped green onion. 7. Place in the refrigerator and wait for 1 - 2 hours to allow the eggs to fully infuse.

Extras: - The proportions of the sauce can be fine-tuned to personal taste. If you like it sweeter, you can increase the amount of sugar. -The remaining sauce is delicious and can be used directly with rice.
Chill the eggs immediately after boiling them for 6 to 7 minutes, making them easier to peel and keeping them soft.
The sauce is mixed with 1 spoon of soy sauce, 1 spoon of Korean hot sauce, and half a spoon of honey. The sweet and spicy taste is more balanced.
Put the eggs and sauce together in a sealed box and refrigerate them. Marinate them for at least 4 hours to enhance the flavor overnight.

Case: The night before, Xiaolin cooked four soft-boiled eggs, soaked them in a sauce made of soy sauce, Korean hot sauce, honey and minced garlic, refrigerated them overnight and had them for breakfast. The sweet and spicy taste went very well with rice.

items.title: Egg Sandwich
items.core: This is a simple and quick Western-style meal. The toast is filled with dense egg sauce and salty bacon. It tastes soft and tender with a burnt aroma. Eggs are rich in high-quality protein and can be paired with bacon and butter for a quick energy boost. The operation is very user-friendly, even for kitchen novices, and the whole process only takes about 10 minutes to complete.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Eggs - Toast - Bacon - Butter - Mayonnaise - Salt - Black pepper
Calculation: - 1 egg - 2 slices of toast - 2 slices of bacon - 10 g of butter - 20g of mayonnaise - 1g of salt - 2g of black pepper

Operation: 1. Cut off all sides of the toast and set aside 2. Cook the eggs and mash them 3. Mix the eggs, mayonnaise, salt and black pepper 4. Add butter to the pan and fry the bacon 5. Assemble the toast, add the prepared egg sauce and bacon between the two pieces of toast 6. Cut the square toast into triangles and serve on a plate
Additional content: - You can also add cheese, pickles and other ingredients
Crush the eggs after they are cooked, add a little mayonnaise and black pepper, and the filling will be dense and easy to hold.
Fry the bacon in a dry pan until the edges are slightly charred, and then use kitchen paper to absorb the oil. It will taste crispy and not greasy.
Toast the toast lightly before spreading the sauce to prevent it from becoming soft, and the filling will be more stable when cut.

Case: Before going to work, Xiao Wu crushed the eggs and mixed them with a little mayonnaise, fried the bacon until slightly crispy, put it on toast with lettuce, cut it in half and bagged it, and ate it on the subway without losing the filling.
