items.title: Thickened Mushroom Soup
items.core: Thickened Mushroom Soup is rich in flavor, smooth and palatable, making it a quick home-cooked soup. Shiitake mushrooms are rich in amino acids and polysaccharides, which help strengthen immunity. The production process requires some basic fire control and thickening skills, but is still friendly to novices. From preparation to serving, it only takes about 25 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Shiitake mushrooms * Chives * Edible oil * Edible salt * Chicken essence * Cornstarch
Calculation: Each serving: * 2 fresh shiitake mushrooms * 0.5 chives * Chicken essence 3 g * Edible oil 10 ml * Edible salt 3 g * Boiled water 350 ml * Cornstarch 10 g

Operation: 1. Slice the mushrooms (thickness of each slice) 0.5-1 cm, thicker points are chewier than thinner ones), put it into a large bowl, pour 2g of edible salt, and soak for 15 minutes. 2. Pour the cornstarch into a small bowl, add 50ml of water, and stir the cornstarch until it melts and there are no particles (i.e., water starch). 3. Pour out the salt water in the bowl, and properly remove the moisture from the mushrooms themselves (to facilitate the next step of frying) [Optional] 4. Pour in the oil over low heat, and wait until the oil starts to bubble (low heat for 30 seconds) (depending on the power of each pot), pour in the mushrooms and fry for 10 seconds on each side [Optional] 5. Pour in 300ml of boiling water, adjust the heat to medium and cook for 3-5 minutes. 6. Pour in the water starch, stir the soup in the pot properly, add 3g of salt, 3g, and finally sprinkle with chopped green onion and cook
Additional Content
After soaking the mushrooms, squeeze out the water before slicing them into slices to avoid water diluting the flavor of the soup. Stir-fry and heat the water to make them fresher.
Mix the water starch thoroughly at a ratio of starch to water at a ratio of one to three. When the soup is slightly boiling, stir and pour to prevent clumping and smearing the bottom.
After thickening, turn to low heat and remove from the pot as soon as possible. If cooked for a long time, it will become thin or sticky. Finally, add sesame oil to enhance the fragrance.

Case: Xiao Zhou wanted to drink hot soup on a rainy day. He sliced ​​soaked shiitake mushrooms and stir-fried them, added water to boil and slowly poured in water starch. After a few minutes, the soup became thick and smooth, and it was very warm when eaten with rice.

items.title: Cream of Mushroom Soup
items.core: This is a classic French soup with a silky and dense texture, a blend of fungus and milk aroma. Mushrooms are rich in dietary fiber and trace elements, while milk provides high-quality protein and calcium. The method is very simple and can be easily mastered by novices. It takes about 30 minutes from preparation to completion.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - white mushrooms - onions - butter - flour - milk - light cream - cracked black pepper - salt - water

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough for 1~2 people. Total amount (per portion): - 200 grams of white mushrooms - 50 grams of onions - 15 grams of butter - 10 grams of flour - 200 ml of milk - 30 ml of light cream - 100 ml of water - 2 grams of salt - 1 g of cracked black pepper

Operation: 1. Slice the white mushrooms and chop the onions into mince. 2. Put butter in a pan, melt over low heat, add onions and sauté until translucent. 3. Add white mushrooms and stir-fry until the water becomes soft, sprinkle in flour and stir evenly. 4. Add milk and water, stir evenly and bring to a boil over low heat. Keep stirring to prevent the mixture from burning. 5. Reduce heat and simmer for about 10 minutes until the soup thickens. 6. Pour in the whipping cream and continue to heat for 1 minute. Add salt and black pepper to taste. 7. After turning off the heat, use a food processor to make a fine soup (optional).

Additional content: - You can reserve part of the mushrooms as decoration and fry them in advance before adding them. - Use chicken stock instead of water for a better flavor. It is recommended to control the total liquid to no more than 300ml/portion. - If you like the texture of thick soup, you can increase the amount of flour and light cream appropriately. - It is recommended to be cooked and eaten immediately. Refrigeration or freezing is not recommended.
After slicing the mushrooms, stir-fry them in a dry pan to remove the water, and then stir-fry them with butter until fragrant. This can reduce the raw smell and highlight the fungus aroma.
Add the milk and cream in batches, keep the heat low and do not boil, to avoid the milk aroma becoming dilute or particles appearing.
Crush it and sift it for a finer texture. If it is too thick, add a small amount of milk. Add salt at the end to make it more stable.

Case study: For weekend lunch, Xiaolin fried sliced ​​mushrooms in butter until soft, added milk and light cream and beat them up before heating. The thick soup was smooth and silky, and it was very French when eaten with bread for dipping.

items.title: Millet porridge
items.core: Millet porridge is a common home-cooked porridge in the north. It has a smooth texture and rich rice aroma. The rice oil cooked out is particularly nourishing to the stomach. It is rich in protein, fat, carbohydrates and carotene. Its vitamin B1 content ranks among the best among grains and is easy to digest and absorb. The method is very simple and can be easily mastered by novices. It takes about 30-35 minutes from boiling water to taking it out of the pot.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Millet - Water (mountain spring water is best)
Calculation: - Millet 100 g - Water (spring water is best) 2000 g Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials you plan to use.

Operation: 1. Put 100 grams of millet into a bowl, wash it with water (stir it with your hands, pour out the water, just remove the floating ash on the outside, do not scrub!!!) 2. Boil the water, be sure to boil! ! ! 3. When the water boils, pour the millet into the pot. (A very important step that is easily overlooked) 4. Stir so that the millet will not stick to the bottom of the pot. Continue to simmer over high heat for 6-10 minutes, paying attention to stirring several times in between. 5. Change to medium heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes. The lid of the pot should be staggered by a gap to prevent the millet oil from slipping away. Continue stirring a few times in the middle to avoid burning the bottom of the pot.

Additional content: * This is cooked in an ordinary pot (it only takes 30-35 minutes to cook it), and it has the best taste. Pressure cookers and rice cookers save trouble, but the effect is reduced, and the amount of water should be appropriately reduced, usually 100 grams of millet + 1800 grams of water * Millet only needs to be removed with water to remove floating ash. Do not wash it too much, as you will lose millet oil * Remember that millet needs to be cooked when the water is boiling * I don't like to add alkali, and I prefer the original flavor of millet
Gently wash millet twice. Repeated scrubbing will cause the surface nutrients to be lost and the rice aroma will become lighter.
After the water boils, add the rice. Stir it a few times to prevent the bottom from sticking. Turn to low heat and cover until the rice grains bloom.
If you want to cook the rice oil, you can extend the time and stir less. Turn off the heat and simmer for five minutes for a smoother texture.

Case: When the weather turns cold in the morning, Aunt Wang grabs a handful of millet, washes it, boils it in a pot, cooks it over low heat until the rice grains bloom and rice oil floats on the surface, and serves it with pickles for breakfast for the whole family.

items.title: Yam and Pumpkin Stewed Chicken Soup
items.core: Yam and Pumpkin Stewed Chicken Soup is a warm-up soup for autumn and winter. Yams strengthen the spleen, pumpkin is sweet, and chestnut powder is glutinous. Stewed in one pot, it is delicious and sweet. Rich in protein, dietary fiber and multiple vitamins, nutritionally balanced. The recipe is simple and takes about 50 minutes from preparation to cooking, making it easy for novices to complete.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Chicken - Ginger - Cooking wine (for blanching) - Chestnut - Yam - Small pumpkin - Red dates - Salt (for seasoning)

Calculation: per portion (one portion is just enough for 2 people): - 500 g chicken - 150 g chestnuts - 200 g yam - 1 small pumpkin (about 300 g, scoop out the pulp after steaming and make puree) - 8 red dates - 5 slices of ginger - 10 ml of cooking wine - 5 g of salt

Operation: 1. Cut the chicken into pieces, add ginger and cooking wine, blanch in a pot with cold water, boil for 3 minutes, remove and set aside. 2. Peel the yam and cut into hob pieces, peel the chestnuts and set aside. 3. Wash the small pumpkin, steam it in the pot, scoop out the pulp, and press it into pumpkin puree for later use. 4. Put the blanched chicken, yams, chestnuts, and ginger slices into the pot, add water to cover the ingredients, bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low heat and simmer for 30 minutes. 5. Add pumpkin puree, stir, add red dates, and cook for another 10 minutes. 6. Add salt to taste, and serve
Additional content: - Add pumpkin puree last, the soup will be golden and not turbid - It is recommended to wear gloves when peeling yam to avoid itchy hands
Blanch the chicken pieces in cold water to remove any blood foam, remove them and rinse them thoroughly. The stewed soup will be clearer and less fishy.
Cut the yam into sections and soak in light salt water to prevent oxidation. Put the pumpkin 20 minutes later to avoid stewing it too much.
Add salt ten minutes before serving. Adding it too early will make the chicken tight and the sweetness of the soup will weaken.

Case: On the night of the beginning of winter, Mr. Chen put the blanched chicken pieces, yam segments and pumpkin into a casserole, and simmered it until the pumpkin was soft and waxy and the soup was slightly yellow. The whole family said it warmed their stomachs after the meal.

items.title: Pork Ribs, Yam and Corn Soup
items.core: Pork Ribs, Yam and Corn Soup is sweet and mellow. The yam is soft and waxy, and the corn is sweet. It combines the delicious flavor of the ribs. It is a home-cooked soup suitable for all ages. It is rich in protein, dietary fiber and multiple vitamins, which can strengthen the spleen and stomach and enhance resistance. The method is simple and the pre-processing and stewing steps are clear, making it easy for novices to get started. The whole process takes about 1 hour to complete.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Spare ribs (recommended fine ribs) - Yams (Iron bar yams recommended) - Carrots - Corn (recommended sweet corn or waxy corn) - Ginger - Spring onions - Cooking wine - Salt - Casserole or deep soup pot

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each serving: - 500g pork ribs - 1 yam (about 300g) - 1 carrot (about 150g) - 1 corn (about 250g) - ginger (about 20g, sliced and set aside) - shallot (about 15g, knotted or minced and set aside) - cooking wine 15ml - cooking oil 10ml - drinking water 1500ml - 2000ml - salt 6g - 8g

Operation: 1. Ingredients pre-processing: - Wash and peel the carrots, cut into hob pieces about 3cm. - Wash the corn and chop into cylindrical pieces about 4cm. - Peel the yam (it is recommended to wear gloves to prevent mucus from causing skin allergies), cut into long sections of about 4cm, and set aside. 2. Blanch the spareribs: - Add enough cold water to the pot and add the washed spareribs. - Add about 10g ginger slices, scallion knots and 15ml cooking wine. - Bring to a boil over high heat, wait for 3 minutes after boiling, and use a spoon to skim off any foam on the surface. - Remove the ribs, wash them with warm water at about 40℃ to remove any impurities, drain and set aside. 3. Stir-fry the pork ribs: - Heat the pan, pour 10ml cooking oil, wait 10 seconds for the oil temperature to rise. - Add the remaining 10g of ginger slices and sauté until fragrant. - Add all the prepared ribs and stir-fry over medium heat for about 1 minute until the surface of the ribs is slightly browned. 4. Stewing process: - Add 1500ml - 2000ml drinking water into the pot at one time. - Add all prepared carrots, corn and yams. - Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot and simmer for 40 minutes. 5. Seasoning and serving: - Add 6g - 8g salt and stir evenly with a spoon. - Keep the heat low and continue to simmer for 2 minutes to incorporate the salt. - Turn off the heat, sprinkle in chopped green onions according to personal preference, and serve on a plate.

Additional content: - Anti-oxidation tips: If the yam is not put into the pot immediately after peeling, it should be soaked in clean water to prevent it from oxidizing and turning black when exposed to air. - Taste control: If you like the yam to be extremely soft and waxy, you can add it to the pot at the same time as the ribs; if you like the yam to stay lumpy, you can add the yam after simmering the ribs for 20 minutes. - Note on replenishing water: If the water level is found to be lower than the ingredients during the stewing process, be sure to add hot water to avoid adding cold water, which will cause the meat fibers to shrink and become woody.
Blanch the pork ribs in a pot under cold water, skim off any scum, and rinse with warm water to prevent the meat from shrinking and becoming woody when exposed to cold.
Cut the corn into small pieces to produce sweetness more easily. Add the yam after stewing the ribs for half an hour for a more complete taste.
Add a few slices of ginger to remove the fishy smell, and season with salt at the end. If you want to drink clear soup, keep it simmering over low heat throughout.

Case: At noon on Sunday, Xiao Li made soup for his parents. He blanched the ribs and stewed them with corn segments and yam for an hour. The corn was sweet and the yam was soft and waxy. The old man drank two bowls.

items.title: Pork Ribs Bitter Melon Soup
items.core: Pork Ribs Bitter Melon Soup is a Cantonese home-cooked soup with clear color, delicious taste and sweetness. The pork ribs are tender and the bitter melon clears away heat and relieves greasiness. Rich in protein and vitamins, dried shrimps can also supplement calcium. The process requires blanch water to remove the fishy smell and carefully remove the flesh of the bitter melon, which is a certain challenge for novices, but it can be greatly simplified with the help of an electric pressure cooker; traditional slow cooking takes 2 to 4 hours, and it is recommended to prepare 4 hours in advance. The pressure cooker only takes about 1 hour.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: Optional tools - Electric pressure cooker (can greatly simplify the cooking process and time) - Casserole (more suitable for stewing soup than a wok) Necessary ingredients - Spare ribs - Bitter melon - Shrimp skin

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions to make. One serving is just enough to feed 4 people. Per portion: - Spare ribs 250g to 500g - Bitter melon 100g to 200g - Dried shrimp 5g to 15g - Ginger 5~10g (optional, used to remove the fishy smell when blanching)

Operation: 1. Wash the ribs and cut into small pieces of about 4cm ±2cm * 3 ± 2cm (if you don’t have the tools to chop the ribs, you can ask the stall owner for help) 2. Pour 700ml of cold water into the wok and heat it with the ribs until it boils. Turn off the heat and take out the ribs. 3. Cut the bitter melon in half, clean the seeds and pulp inside, cut it into 0.5 ± 0.3 cm strips, wash them. Use a soup pot for cooking - Pour 1100ml of water and the ribs into the soup pot, turn on high heat - Wait for the water to boil, add the bitter melon and dried shrimps to the pot, turn down the heat and wait. 120~240 minutes (after 120 minutes, you can take out a piece of meat and taste it. If the meat can be easily separated from the bones, turn off the heat) - Add salt and white pepper when taking it out of the pot. The recommended amount is 0.3 to 0.6g salt and 0.1 to 0.5g white pepper per 250ml. Use an electric pressure cooker for cooking - Pour 1000ml of water, pork ribs, shrimp skin and bitter melon - Select the stew function and start cooking (usually pressure cooking for 45 minutes) - Take it out of the pot and add salt and pepper like a soup pot
Additional content: - You can use other ingredients with umami flavor instead of shrimp skin, such as scallops
Bitter melon is cut in half and the white flesh is scraped clean, which can reduce the bitter taste. Cut into thick slices and stew for a long time without falling apart.
Blank the pork ribs first to remove the fishy smell, add ginger slices and shrimp skin to the pressure cooker, and then open the lid to add salt after pressing for more accuracy.
If you want it to be more moist, add less oil. After stewing, skim off the oil on the surface. Drink it hot or cool.

Case: On a summer night in Guangdong, A Ling used an electric pressure cooker to stew pork ribs and bitter melon soup. She first blanch the ribs and scrape off the white flesh of the bitter melon. After 40 minutes of pressure, the soup became clear and sweet, and was much less greasy.

items.title: Angili Fish and Tofu Soup
items.core: Angi Fish and Tofu Soup is a home-cooked soup with a fresh and tender texture and a rich white soup. The fish meat has few bones and is tender, and the tofu is smooth, with a slightly spicy and warm flavor of pepper. It is suitable for all ages. Fish is rich in high-quality protein, and when paired with tofu, it can supplement calcium and provide a balanced nutrition that is easy to absorb. The production process is not complicated. As long as you pay attention to removing the fishy smell and preventing the fish from sticking, even beginners can get started. The production is expected to take about 40 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Angi fish or saguang fish * Tofu * Chives * Ginger * Edible oil * Cooking wine * Edible salt * Pepper

Calculation: Per portion: * One piece of Angi fish or saguang fish * 100 g of tofu * One piece of chives * One piece of ginger * Pepper 3-5 g * Edible oil 15 ml * Edible salt 10-15 g * Boiled water 1L

Operation: 1. Wash the fish after processing, (pay special attention to the blood in the belly, there will be a fishy smell if not washed), put it into a large bowl, pour cooking wine, 10g ginger slices, 5g salt, marinate for 15 minutes 2. Cut the tofu into pieces, soak in cold water for 5 minutes, remove and set aside. 3. Before frying the fish, wipe the pan with ginger slices to prevent sticking, pour in oil (the amount of oil is 15ml * the number of fish) ), add the fish and fry for 2~3 minutes. During this period, you need to shake the fish to prevent it from sticking to the bottom, and you need to turn it over once. 4. After the fish is completely fried, pour in boiling water, 5ml cooking wine, and ginger slices, turn the heat to high, cover the pot, and cook for 10 minutes (the water should be slightly more, as some will evaporate later) 5. When the soup turns white, pour in the prepared tofu, adjust the heat to medium and cook for another 5 minutes, and add 10g Season with salt and 3g pepper, and finally sprinkle with chopped green onion and serve
Additional Content
Remove the gills and internal organs of the fish, rinse and dry it, and then fry it without water on the surface, which can reduce oil splashing and skin breakage.
After frying, be sure to add boiling water and keep the soup boiling over medium-high heat. The color of the soup will turn white more easily and the taste will be stronger.
Cut the tofu into cubes and put it in. Push the pot gently without stirring. Add salt and pepper to enhance the flavor before serving.

Case: Before dinner, Xiao Zhao cleaned and dried the fish, lightly fried it on both sides, added boiling water, added tofu and stewed it into a milky white soup. After adding pepper, the family ate the fish together with the soup.

items.title: Suzaku Soup
items.core: Suzaku Soup is a home-made quick-serve soup in eastern Henan. It has a smooth and sweet taste, with the mellow aroma of sesame oil. Eggs provide high-quality protein and are very simple to prepare. It only takes a few steps to boil water and rinse the eggs. It can be served in less than ten minutes. It also has the effect of clearing away heat and eliminating internal heat.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Eggs - Sesame oil (sesame oil) - Sugar - Water
Calculation: According to the amount for 1 person: - One egg - 500ml water - 20 grams of sugar (adjust according to personal taste) - 2ml sesame oil
Operation: 1. Beat the eggs in a bowl, and then pour in the sesame oil. 2. After the water boils, quickly pour it into the bowl containing the eggs while it is still boiling. 3. Add sugar.

Additional content: - The eggs must be beaten, and the water must be boiling and bubbling when poured into the egg liquid, otherwise the soup may be turbid and affect the taste - This is the method in eastern Henan. In other regions, there are methods that do not add sugar and salt. The taste is different. Adjust it according to personal taste - This soup is a fire-removing artifact!
Rinse the bowl with boiling water before beating the eggs, which can reduce the egg liquid from being washed into hard lumps and make the taste smoother and more even.
Add a little salt and warm water to the egg liquid and mix well. When rinsing, stir with one hand and the other hand to make the egg flakes thinner.
Keep the seasoning simple, just a few drops of sesame oil and chopped green onion. If the water is not hot enough, the egg drop will be fishy.

Case: When Xiao Chen came home from overtime work at night, he felt his mouth was dry. He heated the bowl, beat in the eggs, stirred them in, poured in boiling water and simmered for a while, added sesame oil for seasoning, and drank the hot soup in ten minutes.

items.title: Corn Spare Ribs Soup
items.core: Corn Spare Ribs Soup is a delicious and sweet home-cooked soup. The ribs are tender and the corn and carrots bring natural sweetness. Rich in protein, vitamins and dietary fiber, nutritionally balanced. The method is simple and friendly to novices. You only need to blanch the pork ribs and simmer them for about an hour. It takes about an hour and a half from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Spare ribs * Corn * Carrots * Ginger * Green onions * Edible oil * Vinegar * Cooking wine * Black pepper * Edible salt * Casserole (if not available, you can also use an iron pot)

Calculation: per portion: * 500-800g of ribs * One corn (if you like corn, you can have one more) * One carrot (if you like carrots, you can have one more) * Half a green onion * One chive * Edible oil 10 ml * Black pepper 4g * Cooking wine 10ml * Vinegar 10ml * Edible salt 10-15g (depending on the amount of soup left in the end) * Boiling water 1000 ml

Operation: Preparation: 1. Cut the green onions into large pieces of 3-4cm and pat them with the back of a knife 2. Chop the corn into small pieces 3. Cut the carrots into hob pieces 4. Peel and cut the ginger into large pieces 5. Chop the fresh ribs into small pieces Operation: 1. Put the ribs in a pot of cold water, add green onions, ginger, and cooking wine and start to blanch, bring to a boil over high heat, skim off the foam, take out the ribs, and drain the water. 2. Heat the oil in the pot, add large slices of ginger and stir-fry with the ribs. When the surface of the ribs is slightly browned, add vinegar (can speed up the tenderness of the meat) and continue to stir-fry for one minute. 3. Pour in boiling water, add enough at a time, do not add more after that, and bring to a boil over high heat 4. Add the corn first, add the pepper, cover and simmer for twenty minutes, then add the carrots, cover and continue to simmer for forty minutes. 5. The seasoning is very simple. Three minutes before taking it out of the pot, you don’t need to add anything except salt. Finally, sprinkle a handful of chopped green onions.
Additional content: This dish is not difficult to make, and the ingredients are simple and friendly to novices. It is suitable for a large bowl when the temperature is cooling down.
After blanching the pork ribs, rinse off the foam with warm water, then stir-fry with a small amount of oil until fragrant. The soup will be clearer and the meat will be more fragrant.
Cut corn and carrots into hob pieces and cook them with the ribs at the same time, which can slowly release the natural sweetness.
When stewing, add enough water at a time, add less water in the middle, skim the oil and add salt before serving, the taste will be cleaner.

Case: Before the National Day family banquet, Ms. Zhou blanched the ribs in advance, put them into the pot with corn and carrots and simmered them slowly. Only salt was added before serving. The soup was sweet and not greasy, and all the relatives took a bowl first.

items.title: Raw Boiled Meatball Soup
items.core: Raw Boiled Meatball Soup has a tender and smooth texture and is an authentic home-cooked soup. Pork provides high-quality protein, and when paired with fungus, yellow flowers and other ingredients, the nutrition is relatively balanced. During the production, you need to chop the meat yourself and master the heat of squeezing the meatballs. There is a slight threshold, and it is more suitable for cooking enthusiasts with a certain foundation. It takes about 1 hour from prep to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: Meatball ingredients: * Front leg meat * Salt * Pepper * Onion, ginger, and pepper water * Egg white of one egg * Potato starch * Cooked soybean oil Ingredients for meatball soup: * Fungus * Yellow flowers * Chives * Soaked vermicelli (put in the bottom of the bowl) * Salt * Chicken powder * Pepper * Sesame oil * Coriander
Calculation: Per portion: Amount of salt = 6 grams of pork Amount of pepper = 2 grams of pork pound Potato starch = 40 grams for how many people, this tutorial is based on the amount for one person

Operation: Chop the meat: 1. Cut the meat with a knife, and divide the fat and leanness into 37% 2. Chop with the knife, smash it with the back of the knife, and loosen the tendons 3. Chop it, smash it, and chop it into minced meat. If you want it to be delicious, you have to chop it yourself, but the machine will make it too sticky. Seasoning: 1. For each kilogram of meat, 6 grams of salt, 1 gram of pepper. 2. Grasp it with your hands. 3. Add the green onion, ginger, pepper, and water in batches, stir while adding, and knead evenly with your hands to let the meat absorb the water. 80 grams of green onion, ginger and pepper water per pound 4. Add egg white and continue to stir in one direction 5. Add 40 grams of potato starch and stir well 6. Add cooked soybean oil to keep it tender, smooth and elastic. Boil the meatballs: 1. Boil water in a pot, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to a low heat, as if it is not boiling 2. Start by squeezing the meatballs, 3. Float them all and cook on low heat for 1 minute. Make meatball soup: 1. Put the vermicelli in the bottom of the bowl 2. Add fungus, yellow flowers, chives and season with salt, pepper and chicken powder 3. Pour the soup with the meatballs into a bowl 4. Pour 3-5 drops of sesame oil 5. Add a small piece of coriander

Additional content: Reference from: Raw meatball soup, what you eat is fresh, tender and elastic, learn these skills of making meatballs, this bowl of soup will be authentic * Chili oil can be added according to taste
Choose 30% fat and 70% lean pork. Chop it yourself to make it more elastic. Add green onion and ginger water and stir in batches until absorbed.
When squeezing the balls, wet your hands with water. Form into a round ball and put it next to the pot and add slightly boiling water to prevent it from falling apart.
After the meatballs float, cook for another two minutes to ensure they are cooked through. Blanch the fungus and yellow flowers in advance to make the soup taste more refreshing.

Case: Winter solstice family gathering, the eldest brother chopped the pork stuffing in advance, added onion and ginger water and stirred it up, squeezed the meatballs with a small spoon and put them into the pot. After the meatballs floated, they were served with fungus soup. They were very tender and tender in the mouth.

items.title: Tomato, Beef and Egg Drop Soup
items.core: Tomato, Beef and Egg Drop Soup is a sweet and sour, appetizing home-cooked soup with a fresh and smooth taste. Beef is rich in high-quality protein and iron, tomatoes provide lycopene and vitamin C, and eggs provide lecithin. The recipe is simple and can be easily mastered by novices, and it can usually be served on the table in about half an hour.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Beef - Tomatoes - Eggs - Onions, ginger, garlic - Salt - Pepper

Calculation: - The amount of beef is 150 g/person - The amount of tomatoes is 1/person - The amount of eggs is 1/person - The amount of salt is 2 g/person - The amount of pepper is 0.5 g/person Using the above conditions, calculate the proportion of raw materials planned to be used.

Operation: Side dish preparation: 1. Cut beef into thin slices 2. Cut tomatoes into small pieces 3. Cut onions into chopped green onions 4. Cut ginger into slices 5. Chop garlic into minced garlic Preparation of beef: 1. Put beef in a bowl 2. Add salt and pepper and marinate for 15-20 minutes Make soup: 1. Add water and boil 2. Add ginger slices and beef slices and cook until the beef changes color 3. Add the tomato cubes and cook until the tomatoes become soft. 4. Break up the egg liquid, slowly pour it into the pot, and stir with chopsticks to form egg flakes. 5. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Finally add chopped green onion, and the pot is ready.
Additional content: - You can add a certain amount of vinegar or sugar to adjust the taste according to taste - If you like spicy, you can add a certain amount of chili or chili sauce to taste
Peel the top of the tomatoes by making crosses and peeling them. Cut them into small pieces and stir-fry until they become sandy. The soup base will be more sour and sweet.
Cut the beef into thin slices against the grain, and spread it evenly with a little starch. Do not cook it for a long time after putting it in the pot to keep it tender.
Pour the egg liquid in a thin stream along the edge of the pot, turn off the heat and simmer for ten seconds before stirring again. The egg blossoms will be thin and shiny but not old.

Case: For weekday dinner, Xiao He used leftover cooked beef slices, first stir-fried the tomatoes to extract the juice, then added water, and finally poured egg liquid on it. It took more than 20 minutes to make a sweet and sour appetizer soup, which goes well with noodles.

items.title: Shredded white radish clear soup
items.core: Shredded white radish clear soup is a refreshing, simple and quick home-cooked vegetarian soup. White radish is rich in water and vitamin C. When cooked, it is soft, tender and sweet, and has very low calories. It’s super easy to make and takes about 10 minutes to cook.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - White radish - Salt - White pepper - MSG - Lard (or sesame oil) - Grater

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many copies you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each portion: - 200g white radish - 800ml drinking water - 3g salt - 2g white pepper - 3g MSG - 3g lard (or 3g sesame oil)

Operation: 1. Peel the white radish, grate into thin strips with a grater, and set aside. 2. Add 800ml of drinking water to the pot, and add shredded white radish at the same time. 3. Add 3g of salt, 2g of white pepper, and 3g of MSG. Stir evenly with a spoon. 4. Turn up the heat and bring the water to boil. 5. After boiling, reduce the heat to medium-low and continue to cook for 5 minutes until the shredded white radish becomes soft and translucent. 6. Before turning off the heat, add 3g of lard (or 3g of sesame oil), stir evenly, then turn off the heat and remove from the pot.

Additional content: - Cooking white radish in cold water can better bring out the sweetness inherent in the radish and at the same time evaporate the spicy smell of raw radish. - If you prefer a softer texture, you can extend the cooking time to 8 minutes in step 5. - If you like the aroma of green onions, you can sprinkle 5g of chopped green onions after serving.
Peel and cut the white radish into thin strips. The thinner the radish, the easier it is to cook and release the sweetness faster.
First boil the ginger slices in the pot to remove the fishy smell, add water and cook until the radish is transparent and the soup tastes refreshing but not bland.
Only add a small amount of salt and white pepper, and sprinkle with chopped green onion. If you want it to be more fresh, add a few drops of sesame oil to enhance the flavor.

Case: The day after the dinner, Xiao Sun felt greasy. She cut the white radish into thin strips, sauteed ginger slices in a little oil until fragrant, then added water and boiled until soft. Ten minutes later, the clear soup was served. It was very comfortable to drink.

items.title: Preserved egg and lean meat porridge
items.core: Preserved egg and lean meat porridge is a classic home-cooked porridge in Guangdong. The porridge base is dense and smooth. The mellow aroma of preserved eggs and the tenderness of lean meat are combined, and the taste is warm and delicious. It is rich in carbohydrates and high-quality protein. When paired with vegetables, it has balanced nutrition and is easy to digest and absorb. Although this porridge has many steps, the operation is intuitive and even a novice can successfully complete it by following the process. It is expected to take about 1.5 hours to make. It is especially convenient for breakfast with the help of the rice cooker's reservation or keep-warm functions.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Drinking water * Preserved eggs (preserved eggs) * Lean meat * Rice * Spring onions * Coriander * Lettuce * Ginger * Soy sauce * Oyster sauce * Salt * Pepper * Edible oil * Rice cooker * Several small bowls

Calculation: Wear disposable gloves when measuring and handling ingredients if possible. It is recommended to wash raw vegetable ingredients in advance and set aside * 1 liter of drinking water * 2 preserved eggs * 100g of lean meat * 150ml of rice * 1 green onion * 1 stalk of coriander * 4 leaves of lettuce * 1 thumb piece of ginger * 5 ml of soy sauce * oyster sauce 5 ml * 2g of salt * pepper 1g * edible oil 10ml

Operation: Main ingredients: 1. Rice - wash - put into the rice cooker liner - add 1 liter of drinking water 2. Lean meat - wash - briefly dry out the water - add 10ml cooking oil - knead evenly - put into the rice cooker liner 3. Preserved eggs - shelled - wash - cut in half - separate egg yolks - simply chop the egg whites into pieces - mash the egg yolk - put into the rice cooker liner 4. Ginger - Wash - Peel - Remove the yellow, black and inedible parts - Shred - Put in the rice cooker Ingredients: 1. Green onions - Wash - Remove the roots - Remove the yellow and black parts that are inedible - Chop - Put in a small bowl and set aside 2. Coriander - Wash - Remove the roots - Remove the yellow and black parts that are inedible - Chop - Put in a small bowl and set aside 3. Lettuce - Wash - Remove the roots - remove the yellow, black and inedible parts - chop into small pieces - put in a small bowl and set aside. Sauce: 1. Soy sauce + oyster sauce + salt + pepper - mix well - put in a small bowl and set aside. Cooking process: 1. Main ingredients - use the rice cooker cooking mode to cook 2. Ingredients - after the main ingredients are cooked, lettuce is boiled in hot water separately, then open the lid and add to the main ingredients together with the rest of the ingredients and stir evenly 3. Sauce - After the main ingredients are cooked, open the lid and add the remaining ingredients to the main ingredients and mix well.
Additional content: * For breakfast, you can prepare the main ingredients overnight in advance, keep warm mode until breakfast the next day, and then add ingredients and sauces
Wash the rice in advance and soak it in a little oil and salt. The porridge bottom will be smoother and less likely to clump when cooked.
The lean meat is mixed with salt, light soy sauce, starch and a little oil. Finally, it is cooked smoothly in the pot and has a smooth texture.
Cut the preserved eggs into pieces and add them a few minutes before turning off the heat. Boil the shredded ginger together to remove the fishy smell and enhance the aroma.

Case: On Monday morning, Xiao Li used a rice cooker to make a reservation for white porridge. After getting up, he added marinated lean pork shreds and diced preserved eggs, cooked for ten minutes, and sprinkled with chopped green onion and ginger. After finishing the meal, his family said the porridge was smooth and the meat was not good.

items.title: rice porridge
items.core: White porridge is light and soft. It is a must-have stomach-warming staple food at home. It has a pure rice aroma and is suitable for all ages. It is rich in carbohydrates and a small amount of protein, easy to digest and absorb, and has the effects of nourishing the spleen, harmonizing the stomach, and clearing the lungs. The operation is simple, just master the heat and the amount of water, and even beginners can complete it easily. The whole process takes about 25 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Rice * Water * Vegetable oil (optional)

Calculation: * Generally, one person can consume 60ml-110ml of rice. *The volume of water is 9-12 times the volume of rice. *The capacity of a bowl is 500ml. The latest time to interrupt high-fire heating T1: 1.5 minutes/500ml water volume The earliest time when rice porridge can be eaten Tr: 10 minutes/500ml water volume * oil quality Mo: uncooked rice volume / 10 * refrigeration time Tc = uncooked rice volume / 10 ml / minute. Using the conditions above, calculate the proportion of raw materials you plan to use.

Operation: 1. (Optional) Mix Mo ml of oil with washed rice, try to ensure complete mixing, that is, each grain of rice is stained with at least a small amount of oil. 2. (Optional) Store the rice-oil mixture in the refrigerator for a refrigeration time of Tc. 3. Add rice and water to the pot. 4. Turn on high heat and heat to T1. 5. Turn down the heat before T1. If you forget this step, the water may overflow and extinguish the flame. Very dangerous! 6. Heat to Tr. Turn off the fire at Tr.
Additional Content
Adjust rice and water from 1:8 to 1:10. If you like gruel, add more water for a more refreshing taste.
After the water boils, add rice, stir gently to prevent the bottom from sticking, turn to low heat and cover to leave a seam to prevent overflowing.
Turn off the heat and simmer for five minutes before serving. The rice grains will bloom more and the porridge and noodles will be softer and smoother.

Case: I had a bad appetite after catching a cold. Aunt Wang bought half a cup of rice at night, added water at a ratio of 1:8, boiled over high heat and then simmered over low heat for 20 minutes. After drinking two bowls for breakfast the next day, my stomach was warm and not bloated.

items.title: Seaweed and egg drop soup
items.core: Seaweed and egg drop soup is a light and delicious home-cooked soup, which is a simple Chinese soup dish. Seaweed is rich in iodine, calcium and dietary fiber, and eggs provide high-quality protein. The combination of the two is nutritionally balanced. It's super simple and beginner-friendly, taking only about 20 minutes from prep to out of the pan.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Eggs * Seaweed * Chopped green onions * Water * Salt * Oil * Shrimp (optional or not according to personal taste)
Calculation: According to the amount for 1 person: * 10g of dried seaweed (you can add more if you like seaweed) * Two eggs * 2 grams of salt

Operation: 1. Soak the dried seaweed in water for 15 minutes, remove and drain the water and set aside. 2. Heat the pot, pour 1.5 liters of water, 5ml of oil, and 2g of salt. After the water boils, add the seaweed. 3. 3 minutes after the seaweed is boiled, slowly pour the beaten egg liquid into the pot and serve in 30 seconds. 4. Sprinkle with chopped green onion and reduce heat to low for 20 seconds. 5. Turn off the heat and add a few drops of sesame oil before serving. Some people also add a little shrimp skin, which tastes good.

Additional content: * After the water boils, turn down the heat and pour the beaten egg liquid around the boiling water in the middle. In order to make the egg drop tender, cover the pot, turn off the heat and wait for half a minute before opening. * If you like a thicker taste, you can add 2g of starch.
Rinse the seaweed quickly with clean water first, remove impurities and then squeeze it dry. The soup will taste cleaner and less fishy.
Add a little salt to the egg liquid and beat it up. When the water is slightly boiling, pour in a thin stream. Let it sit and then gently push it into egg droplets.
Turn off the heat and add salt and sesame oil. A small amount of sesame oil is enough to avoid covering up the delicious taste of seaweed.

Case: It was already ten o'clock in the evening when Xiao Chen came home from overtime work. He boiled a bowl of water, sprinkled seaweed and shrimp skin, poured in egg liquid, turned off the heat, added salt and sesame oil, drank hot soup in five minutes, and his fatigue was relieved a lot.

items.title: Borsch soup
items.core: A Shanghai-style home-style soup derived from Russian beet soup and improved in Shanghai. It is based on tomatoes and beef. The taste is sweet and sour, mellow and delicious. Rich in high-quality protein, lycopene and multivitamins, nutritionally balanced. It’s easy to make, beginner-friendly, and should take about 2–3 hours to complete.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Vegetable stock (three-piece set of parsley, carrots, onions) - Beef stock (can be replaced with 〇 soup treasure) - Beef (optional beef brisket or oxtail) - Tomatoes (tomato paste, canned tomatoes)

Calculation: per serving: - Beef stock 500 mL - Beef 250 g (optional beef brisket or oxtail) - 2 cans of canned tomatoes (Tomato can be substituted, but the flavor is not good) - Tomato paste 5 g (increases tomato flavor) - Potato 400 g - Onion 100 g - Carrot 100 g - Parsley 100 g - Cabbage 200 g - Red sausage 100 - 200 g - Olive oil 5 mL (Olive oil is used for cooking vegetables and can be replaced with vegetable oil) - Vegetable oil 5 mL (Vegetable oil is used for cooking beef and cannot be replaced with olive oil) - Salt 18 g - Black pepper 3 g

Operation: Cut and prepare: 1. Cut onions, carrots, and parsley into 1cm cubes 2. Cut red sausage and potatoes into 2cm pieces 3. Remove the stems of cabbage and tear it into 2cm pieces 4. Sprinkle 3 g of salt and 3 g of black pepper on the beef and marinate for 5 minutes. Frying process: 1. Heat a pan and add vegetable oil. 2. Fry the beef until the surface is browned (it can be raw, but don’t burn it), take it out and set aside. Cooking process 1 (first hour): 1. Heat the soup pot, add olive oil, diced onions, diced carrots, and parsley 2. Fry until the onions are transparent, add tomato paste, and canned tomatoes 3. Add beef and diced potatoes, stir-fry evenly 4. Add water to cover the ingredients, and cook over medium heat for 1 hour Cooking process 2 (second half hour): 1. Add diced cabbage and red sausage to the pot, and stir evenly 2. Cook over medium heat for half an hour 3. Open the lid and add the remaining 15 g of salt, mix evenly and serve on a plate

Additional content: - Try not to replace tomatoes with fresh tomatoes. The combination of canned tomatoes + tomato paste has more flavor - Except carrots, onions, parsley, and beef are essential ingredients, the rest can be freely mixed
Cut the beef into pieces and blanch them in cold water to remove the blood foam, then rinse with warm water. The soup will become clearer and less fishy.
Fry the onions until soft, then stir-fry the tomato sauce to produce red oil. The sweet and sour taste will be more natural and mellow.
Put the potatoes and carrots last and cook until soft and glutinous before seasoning to avoid boiling for a long time and turning into a paste.

Case: To cool down on the weekend, Xiaolin stir-fried onions and tomato sauce when stewing beef, then added tomatoes, potatoes and carrots and simmered for two hours. The whole family had a sweet and sour soup, which was very satisfying when served with bread for dinner.

items.title: Mutton Soup
items.core: Mutton soup is a home-style warming soup. The soup is milky white in color, and the meat is tender and tender. It is fragrant and slightly spicy with green onions and white pepper. It is rich in protein, calcium, iron and other nutrients, and has the effect of warming the spleen and stomach and resisting cold. The preparation steps are simple and can be easily mastered by novices, and the entire cooking process takes about 30 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - mutton or haggis - cooking oil - cooking wine - green onions - white pepper - edible salt - cumin powder (optional) - coriander (optional)
Calculation: per portion: - mutton 300g - cooking oil 10ml - cooking wine 20ml - green onions 50g - boiling water 1000ml - white pepper 1g - edible salt 5g - Cumin powder 1g - coriander 20g

Operation: 1. Cut the mutton into 5cm wide and 0.5cm wide pieces 2. Cut the green onions into small sections 3. Put the mutton into the pot, add 1000ml of room temperature water, add cooking wine and green onions 4. After boiling for 2 minutes, take out the mutton, wash it with room temperature water and drain the water 5. Add cooking oil to the hot pot, add the mutton and stir-fry 2 minutes until the surface of the mutton is slightly brown. 6. Add boiling water and turn it to high heat. 7. After 5 minutes, add white pepper and salt and continue boiling for 5 minutes. 8. After taking it out of the pot, add coriander and cumin powder and stir evenly
Additional content: - When adding boiling water, be sure to turn up the heat so that the oil and soup can better blend
Blanch mutton in cold water, add ginger slices and cooking wine, skim off the floating foam, and then transfer to the soup pot.
Scallions and white pepper can remove the odor and enhance the aroma. Add the salt last to prevent the meat from becoming tight after being cooked for a long time.
Keep the fire slightly boiling, the color of the soup will turn white more easily, and the mutton will remain fresh and tender.

Case: On the night of the winter solstice, Mr. Zhang put the blanched mutton, onion, ginger, white pepper into a casserole, simmered it on low heat for half an hour, and then sprinkled coriander over the soup when it turned white. The family's hands and feet were warm after drinking.

items.title: Laba porridge
items.core: Laba porridge is a traditional seasonal sweet porridge. The porridge is thick and soft, and it combines the complex aroma of various grains, beans and dried fruits. Rich in carbohydrates, minerals and multivitamins, lotus seeds also have the effect of nourishing the mind and calming the mind, making them suitable for people who are under high work pressure. Although there are many types of ingredients, the operation is simple and requires patience and slow cooking, making it friendly to novices. Excluding preparation time such as soaking, simmering takes about 3 hours.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Drinking water - Rice - Glutinous rice - Peanuts - Red beans - Red dates - Porridge pot (ordinary pots are easy to burn the bottom, you can choose a pressure cooker if possible) - Medium glass bowl (or other medium stainless steel containers) - Several small bowls Optional ingredients: Since the recipes of Laba porridge are diverse, you can choose the following ingredients according to your own taste preferences. - Barley - Black rice - Millet - Lotus seeds - Mung beans - Soybeans - Peas - Red kidney beans - Longan (dried longan without seeds) - Chestnuts - Shelled walnuts - Raisins - Rock sugar (or white sugar, for seasoning)

Calculation: For one person (three small bowls), the portion size is: - 1 L of drinking water - 50 g of rice - 50 g of glutinous rice - 50 g of barley - 50 g of black rice - 50 g of millet - 25 g of lotus seeds - 25 g of mung beans - 25 g of red beans - 25 g of peanuts - 25 g of soybeans - 25 g of peas - 25 g red dates - 25 g longan - 25 g chestnuts - 25 g shelled walnuts - 25 g raisins - 25 g red kidney beans - 10~25 g rock sugar. The amount of the above ingredients can be adjusted appropriately according to your own taste preferences. For rice, it is not recommended to exceed 150 g, and for other beans, it is not recommended to exceed 50 g.

Operation: 1. Wash mung beans, red beans, peanuts, soybeans, peas, and red kidney beans in advance, put them in a clean glass bowl, pour 3/4 of the glass bowl size of drinking water, and soak overnight (or at least 8 hours). 2. Wash the rice, glutinous rice, barley, black rice, millet, and lotus seeds in advance, put them in a clean glass bowl, pour 3/4 of the glass bowl size of drinking water, and soak for 3 hours. 3. Separate and pour out the water in the glass bowl containing mung beans, red beans, peanuts, soybeans, peas, and red kidney beans prepared in step 1. Pour the remaining ingredients into the porridge pot, add 1 liter of drinking water (or cover 1 thumb piece of the ingredients), bring to a boil over high heat, close the lid after boiling, and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes. 4. Separate and pour out the water from the glass bowl containing rice, glutinous rice, barley, black rice, millet, and lotus seeds prepared in step 2. Continue to pour the remaining ingredients into the porridge pot, close the lid, and cook on low heat for 60 minutes. 5. Wash the red dates, longans, chestnuts, walnuts, raisins (cut the red dates into small pieces), and rock sugar, pour them into the pot, close the lid, and cook over low heat for 60 minutes. 6. After confirming that the cooked porridge is thick, turn off the heat, serve on a plate, and eat.

Additional content: - When adding ingredients to the porridge pot, you should stir to make the ingredients evenly distributed everywhere, and pay attention to the water level. If you find that the water level is lower than the rice noodles and the ingredients, you should replenish water immediately. - Pay attention to control the heat, do not overheat, and stir regularly. If you use an ordinary pot, it is recommended to boil the water before adding the ingredients, stir until it boils again and then lower the heat to avoid burning the bottom of the pot. If possible, it is recommended to use a pressure cooker or porridge pot instead. - Reference: The most authentic recipe of Laba porridge on the Internet, sweet, soft and glutinous, a success the first time! \_bilibili\_bilibili, Laba porridge (porridge cooked with a variety of ingredients during the Laba Festival)_Baidu Encyclopedia
Soak beans and lotus seeds for more than four hours in advance, and cook them at different times with the rice to make them softer and glutinous.
After boiling over high heat, turn to low heat and simmer slowly, stirring every twenty minutes to prevent the bottom from burning.
Put in the raisins and red dates later. Test the taste before serving and adjust the sweetness to avoid being overly sweet and greasy.

Case: The night before Laba, Xiao Zhou soaked the red beans, lotus seeds and rice, simmered it for two hours the next day, stirred it halfway to prevent it from burning, and sprinkled it with raisins after serving it out. My office colleagues said it was sweet and soft.

items.id: 菌菇炖乳鸽-菌菇炖乳鸽
items.title: Stewed pigeon with mushrooms
items.core: The pigeon stewed with mushrooms is bright in color, the meat is tender, and the mushroom aroma blends with the fresh pigeon. It is a home-style Cantonese stew. Squab is rich in high-quality protein and a variety of amino acids, while mushrooms provide polysaccharides and dietary fiber, which are mild and nourishing. The whole dish requires squabs to be blanched first to remove the fishy smell, and then stewed with corn and mushrooms. There are some requirements on the control of heat and time, and novices can master it with a little attention. From preparation to serving, it takes about 45 minutes in a pressure cooker or just over an hour in a crock pot.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Squab * Mushrooms * Corn * Ginger * Cooking wine * Edible salt * Crock pot or pressure cooker
Calculation: 2 servings: * 300 g pigeon * 100 g mushrooms * 200 g corn * 30 g ginger * 15 ml cooking wine * 10 g edible salt

Operation: 1. Wash the squabs that have been treated by the enthusiastic stall owner with cold water. 2. Put the washed squabs in a cold water pot, add 15ml of cooking wine and ginger, and boil the water to remove the squabs, otherwise the nutrients will be lost. 3. Put the squabs in a high-pressure or earthen pot, pour in water to cover the squabs, add 20 g of ginger, 200 g of corn, and 100 g of mushrooms. Note: Pressure cooker 30 Minutes, the crock pot needs to boil the water, then turn down the heat and simmer for 40-60 minutes. 4. When the time is up, transfer it to a bowl and add 3~5g of salt.
Additional Content
After blanching the squab, rinse off the foam. The stewed soup will be clearer and the fishy smell will be much less.
Wash the mushrooms, squeeze out the water, stir-fry them first and then stew them. The umami flavor will be more concentrated and natural.
After the pressure cooker is put on steam for about 20 minutes, the natural pressure relief will make the meat more tender.

Case: When the season changes, Ms. Chen blanchs squab, puts it into the pressure cooker with corn and mushrooms, and puts it on steam for 20 minutes. The soup is clear and delicious, and her children want to add more after drinking a bowl.

items.title: Tomato and egg soup
items.core: Tomato and egg soup is a home-cooked soup that is sour, sweet, appetizing, and has a smooth texture. It is very simple to make and is a popular dish suitable for all ages. Rich in lycopene, vitamin C and high-quality protein, the nutrition is balanced and easy to absorb. It is very friendly to novices and saves time. The estimated production time is about 15 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Tomatoes - Eggs - Sesame oil - MSG - Salt - Onions, ginger, garlic

Calculation: - 1 tomato - 1-2 eggs (depend on your taste, if you like eggs, put 2, usually just 1) - 2 drops of sesame oil - 5 grams of seasoning (optional) - 15 grams of salt - 15 grams of onions, ginger, and garlic in total

Operation: 1. Wash the tomatoes and cut into pieces. 2. Chop onion, ginger and garlic. 3. Crack the eggs into a bowl and stir evenly with chopsticks (or a whisk). 4. Heat the pan and add 15 ml of oil. When you can see a hint of smoke coming out of the oil, add the onion, ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds. 5. Add tomatoes and stir-fry for 1 minute. 6. Pour in water, the height of the water is about 1.2 times the height of the dishes in the pot, and add salt. 7. After the pot is boiled, add the egg liquid, break the eggs with chopsticks, and add the seasoning and sesame oil. 8. Wait 30 seconds, turn off the heat and remove from the pot.
Additional content: MSG can be added or not.
Blanch the tomatoes by making crosses, then stir-fry them until they become sandy and add water to make the soup more sour, sweet and thick.
Add a little warm water to beat the eggs. After boiling, turn to low heat and pour in. The egg flakes will be thinner and more tender.
Put the salt and sesame oil last. If you like a clear soup, add less oil. If you like a thicker soup, add a little water starch.

Case: Before lunch, Xiao He cut the tomatoes into cubes and stir-fried the juice, added water to boil, poured in egg liquid, sprinkled with chopped green onion, and served it on the table in fifteen minutes. The children ate it with soup and rice.

items.title: Enoki mushroom soup
items.core: This is a light and refreshing home-cooked soup with delicious taste. It is a simple and quick dish. Enoki mushrooms are rich in amino acids and dietary fiber, and adding eggs can also supplement high-quality protein. The production threshold is extremely low, and even novices can easily master it. It only takes about 10 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Enoki mushrooms - Eggs (if needed)
Calculation: per serving: - 400-500 grams of Enoki mushrooms (one bag sold in the market is enough) - 15 grams of salt - 5 grams of MSG

Operation: 1. Break up the enoki mushrooms with bare hands. The more scattered the better, otherwise it will be easy to hide teeth. Wash and set aside. 2. Use a kitchen knife or fruit knife to cut the above-mentioned enoki mushrooms into sections according to personal preference, but the length should not exceed 5 cm. 3. Put the enoki mushrooms into the pot, add water to cover about 1.1 times the total height of the ingredients, wait for 3 minutes after boiling. 4. Add MSG and salt and stir. 5. Continue heating for about 30 seconds, turn off the heat and serve on a plate.

Additional content:- If you like to add eggs to the soup, pour the beaten egg liquid into the pot after the water boils in step 3. - After serving, add 3-4 drops of sesame oil (or sesame oil) to enhance the flavor.
Cut off the roots of the enoki mushrooms and tear them into pieces. Blanch them for a minute or two to keep them crispy and tender.
Pour in the egg liquid in a thin stream after the soup boils. Don't stir it in a hurry. After it forms, gently push it away.
Season with salt, white pepper and chives, add less oil, and highlight the refreshing flavor of the enoki mushrooms.

Case: When Xiao Liu was hungry late at night, he cut off the roots of the enoki mushrooms, boiled water and added the mushrooms and egg liquid. He made a small pot of soup in a few minutes and served it with whole wheat bread as a late night snack. It was refreshing and not greasy.

items.id: 银耳莲子粥-银耳莲子粥
items.title: Tremella fungus and lotus seed porridge
items.core: Tremella fungus and lotus seed porridge is sweet and smooth, with soft and waxy white fungus and dense lotus seeds. It is a common nourishing porridge. Rich in natural colloids, dietary fiber and various trace elements, it helps nourish the mind and calm the mind. The production requires soaking and slow boiling, which will test the patience of novices. The whole process takes about 3.5 hours.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Tremella fuciformis - Coreless lotus seeds - Red dates - Wolfberry (optional) - Rock sugar
Calculation: According to the amount for 1 person: - Tremella fuciformis 60g - Coreless lotus seeds 20g - Red dates 6g - Wolfberry 5-6g - Rock sugar 10-20g

Operation: 1. Soak the white fungus and lotus seeds in water 2 hours, soak the red dates for 10 - 20 minutes, wash the wolfberries and set aside. 2. Pour 600ml of water into the pot, boil and add the white fungus, lotus seeds, and red dates in sequence. 3. Wait for the water to boil again, cover the pot, turn to medium heat and continue to cook. 4. After boiling for about 1 hour, add 5g - 10g of rock sugar and 5g - 6g. wolfberry, turn to low heat and simmer. 5. Continue to simmer on low heat for 30 minutes. At this time, the white fungus begins to become sticky. 6. Add 5g - 10g of rock sugar again and stir with a spoon for 5 - 10 minutes. 7. Turn off the heat and scoop out with a spoon
Additional content: - When the Tremella becomes viscous, you need to stir it in time with a spoon to prevent the Tremella from sticking to the bottom of the pot
Soak the white fungus for two hours in advance, remove the yellow roots and tear it into small florets to make it easier to boil out the glue.
Put the lotus seeds and rice into the pot at the same time, simmer the white fungus over low heat, stirring in one direction halfway through.
Put the rock sugar ten minutes before serving to make the sweetness clearer and avoid bitterness after long cooking.

Case: On the weekend afternoon, Ms. Lin tore the soaked white fungus into small florets and simmered it with lotus seeds and rice for three hours. When it came out of the pot, the gelatin was thick and the whole family was satisfied with it as a dessert.

items.id: 陈皮排骨汤-陈皮排骨汤
items.title: Tangerine Peel Pork Ribs Soup
items.core: This soup is a Cantonese-style old fire soup. It is clear in color, sweet and fragrant in the mouth, and has the unique aging charm of tangerine peel. Spare ribs provide high-quality protein and calcium. When combined with tangerine peel, American ginseng, dendrobium and other ingredients, it helps regulate qi, strengthen the spleen, nourish yin and moisturize the lungs. It is suitable for drinking when staying up late for a long time or when the throat is uncomfortable. The overall operation is not difficult, just prepare the ingredients and master the stewing time, and even a novice can complete it easily. It takes about two hours from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: * Spare ribs * Tangerine peel * American ginseng * Dendrobium * Polygonatum odorifera * Ophiopogon japonicus * Soup cup * Salt

Calculation: per portion: * Spare ribs, you can also use pork bones instead, 4-5 pieces * Tangerine peel (usually 8-20 years old), usually 1 piece of tangerine peel is 3 segments, just take 1 segment * American ginseng (also known as American ginseng), 9 pieces * Dendrobium, 6 pieces * Polygonatum odorifera, 5 pieces * Ophiopogon japonicus, 7 pieces * Soup cup, for 1 person * Salt, 5g

Operation: Preparation: 1. Rinse the ribs with hot water and remove the blood 2. Rinse tangerine peel, Ophiopogon japonicus, Polygonatum odoratum, Dendrobium and American ginseng 3. Clean the soup pot. Operation: 1. Open the soup pot, first put the ribs at the bottom, then add tangerine peel, Ophiopogon japonicus, Polygonatum odoratum, Dendrobium and American ginseng in sequence. 2. Add hot water into the soup pot. The water should not be too full. 3. Add water to the soup pot and simmer for 1.5 hours. 4. Add salt and drink while hot

Additional content: The soup pot is very hot, be careful not to burn it or break it when you handle it. Guangdong Laohuo soup pays attention to the ingredients and heat. As long as you prepare the ingredients and stew for a certain period of time, you are done!
Soak the tangerine peel in warm water until soft and scrape off the white flesh. The soup will have a softer flavor and will be less likely to be bitter.
Blanch the pork ribs in a pot under cold water, wash off the foam and then stew. The soup will be clear and not turbid.
A small amount of American ginseng and dendrobium is enough. After stewing, taste it first before deciding whether to add salt.

Case: After staying up late continuously, Xiao Wu put the blanched ribs, tangerine peel and American ginseng into the stew pot, and simmered it for two hours. The soup was sweet and moist in the mouth, and the throat was dry and comfortable.

items.title: Cucumber and Preserved Egg Soup
items.core: Cucumber and Preserved Egg Soup is a quick homemade soup with a light taste and the caramel aroma of stir-fried preserved eggs and garlic cloves. It is heart-warming and not greasy. Cucumber clears away heat and replenishes water, while preserved eggs provide a certain amount of protein, which is low in fat and less burdensome. There are almost no technical barriers to making this recipe, and even a novice kitchen user can easily complete it. It only takes about ten minutes from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Cucumber - Preserved eggs - Garlic - Spring onions - Edible oil (lard is recommended) - Salt - Chicken essence (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 2 people. Each serving: - 1 cucumber - 2 preserved eggs - 2 cloves of garlic - spring onions - 10-15 g of cooking oil - 2-3 g of salt - 0.5-1 g of chicken essence - 400-500 ml of water

Operation: 1. Wash the cucumber and cut into 0.5-1.2 mm thick slices. 2. Wash and mince the green onion. Use a knife to peel the garlic and cut it in half. 3. Peel off the shell of the preserved eggs and cut each into 6-8 parts. Pour oil into the pot, add the sliced ​​preserved eggs and garlic. 4. Fry over low heat until the surface of the preserved eggs and garlic is slightly browned. Add water and turn to high heat and bring to a boil. 5. Add cucumber slices. When the water boils again, immediately turn off the heat, add salt and chicken essence to taste, and serve. 6. Put it in a bowl, and sprinkle with chopped green onion.

Additional content: - You can decide whether to peel the cucumber according to your preference - You can use a spatula to scrape the thin slices of cucumber - When cutting the preserved eggs, apply some sesame oil to prevent them from sticking to the knife - Reference: [Step-by-step diagram of how to make cucumber and preserved egg soup, how to make delicious cucumber and preserved egg soup] It’s spring __ Let’s go to the kitchen
Cut the preserved eggs into slices and fry them in a small amount of oil until fragrant. Add water when the garlic cloves are slightly brown, and the soup will be more fragrant.
Cut the cucumber into thin slices and add it to the pot last, and cook for half a minute to maintain a crisp texture and fragrance.
The preserved eggs themselves are salty, taste them first before adding salt. A small amount of white pepper is enough to enhance the flavor.

Case: I have no appetite in summer, so Mr. Zhao fried garlic cloves and preserved eggs until they were caramelized, added water and boiled them, then added cucumber slices. It took ten minutes to make a clear soup, which was very refreshing to eat with rice.

items.title: B52 Bomber
items.core: This cocktail has a distinct taste. The strong taste of vodka is first followed by the aftertaste of coffee cream. After lighting it, you will have a unique ice and fire experience. It is a classic creative cocktail. Coffee wine and Baileys provide a small amount of caffeine and cream, but the overall nutrition is dominated by alcohol. Making it requires practicing layered pouring and lighting techniques, it’s a little difficult for novices, and the whole process only takes about 5 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Kahlua Coffee Liquor - Irish Baileys Liquor - Blue Sky Original Vodka - Bar Spoon - Liqueur Glass - Lighter
Calculation: Per serving: - Kahlua Coffee Liquor 10ml - Irish Baileys Liquor 10ml - Blue Sky Original Vodka 10ml

Operation: 1. Pour Kahlua Coffee Liquor to 1/3 of the bottom of the liqueur glass. (10ml) 2. Slowly pour 1/3 of the Irish Baileys (10ml) along the bar spoon. Be careful to go slowly and make sure the layers are clear. (The sweet wine will mix with the coffee too quickly) 3. Finally, pour Blue Sky Original Vodka (10ml) on the top layer. 4. Use a lighter to heat the rim of the cup. 5. The last step is to light the fire: Do you see the small light blue flame?

Additional content:- When drinking, a common method now used in bars is to provide a straw, insert it while the fire is still burning, and then quickly inhale it all. - Because the straw is too thin and there is not enough oxygen in it, the flame will go out, so don’t worry. At this time, you will feel a heat running down your throat and into your stomach, followed by a long sweet aftertaste of coffee cream. Very exciting and delicious.
Pouring follows the order of density: the heaviest coffee liquor at the bottom, Baileys in the middle, and the lightest vodka at the top.
When layering, be sure to use the back of a spoon to drain and pour slowly to avoid direct impact of the liquid and damaging the layering.
Make sure the alcohol content of the vodka is high enough before lighting. Drink it quickly after lighting. Be careful not to burn your lips.

Case: On Friday night, Xiao Li tried to make a B52 bomber while resting at home. He poured coffee liquor, Baileys and vodka in order according to density. After lighting the fire, blue flames ignited at the mouth of the cup. He held his breath and drank it in one sip. The taste of ice and fire surprised him.

items.title: Mojito
items.core: This cocktail has a refreshing and sweet taste, with the coolness of mint and the hint of rum. It is a classic summer drink. It has a low alcohol content and is served with lime, which is rich in vitamin C, to quench your thirst and refresh your mind. It's very simple and beginner-friendly to make and only takes about ten minutes from preparation to completion.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Crushed ice cubes - Chilled soda water - Juice press - Highball glass - Pestle
Calculation: per serving: - A piece of lime (cut into two halves) - Mint leaves - Syrup 20ml - Golden rum 45ml - Blue Sky original vodka 10ml

Operation: 1. Cut one of the half-cut limes into small pieces, put it into a highball glass, and then mash it with a pestle to extract the juice; 2. Spread 3-4 mint leaves along the rim of the cup, and then put it into the cup; 3. Add 20ml of syrup; 4. Add 45ml of golden rum; 5. Squeeze the juice from the remaining half of the lime into the cup; 6. Stir gently to make the sugar/syrup semi-fused; 7. Put the crushed ice cubes into the glass until it fills 3/4 of the glass; 8. Add ice-cold soda water until the crushed ice is just covered; 9. Rotate and stir for half a minute; 10. Use crushed ice to fill the highball glass; 11. Shake up the remaining mint leaves and insert crushed ice for decoration.
Additional content: - Reference: [Bilibili] Mojito is one of the most famous classic cocktails in the world.
Just pat the mint lightly to release the aroma. Do not mash it too much, otherwise it will release a bitter taste and affect the taste.
Squeeze the lime juice and use it immediately. The sweetness and sourness can be adjusted according to taste. If you like it sweeter, you can add a little syrup.
Finally, pour soda water and stir gently to keep the bubbles, making the refreshing taste last longer.

Case: During the weekend camping trip, Xiao Zhang felt thirsty due to the hot weather. He picked fresh mint, squeezed lime juice, and added rum and soda water to make a mojito. He was full of praise for the cool mint fragrance that instantly dispelled the heat.

items.title: Winter Melon Tea
items.core: Winter melon tea is a refreshing traditional drink that relieves summer heat. It has a sweet and soft taste with the unique fragrance of winter melon. The flavor is better after being chilled. Winter melon itself is low in calories and rich in water. When cooked with rock sugar, it can replenish energy, produce body fluids and quench thirst. It’s not complicated to make, but it does require some patience for newbies, and the process takes about 4 to 5 hours.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Winter melon - Rock sugar - Plastic wrap - Filter - Large pot
Calculation: You need to determine how many portions to make before each production. One serving is just enough for 4-5 people. Per portion: - 1000g winter melon - 300g rock sugar

Operation: 1. Prepare the winter melon: Peel the winter melon, remove seeds, and cut into small pieces (each piece should not exceed 4cm). 2. Add rock sugar: Add rock sugar to winter melon, mix well, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for more than 2 hours. 3. Boil the winter melon: At this time, the winter melon has released a lot of water. Pour it into the pot and bring it to a boil over high heat. Then turn to medium to low heat and simmer slowly for 1 to 2 hours. Stir frequently to prevent the pot from sticking. 4. Filter the winter melon tea: Use a filter to filter the cooked winter melon tea liquid, take out the winter melon pieces, and keep only the tea liquid. 5. Cooling: Let the winter melon tea liquid cool down, pour it into a clean container, and put it in the refrigerator to refrigerate. 6. Enjoy: The boiled winter melon tea liquid is a concentrated juice. Add water or other drinks according to personal preference. It is suitable for hot or cold.

Additional content: - Taste adjustment: The amount of rock sugar can be adjusted to achieve your personal preference for sweetness. - Storage method: Store in the refrigerator. It is recommended to drink it within 1 week.
Cut the winter melon into small dices or grate to make it easier to taste; add rock sugar and marinate for 1 hour to release the water faster.
When cooking, first bring to a boil over high heat and then turn to low heat, stirring constantly to prevent the pot from being burnt and affecting the flavor.
After cooking, filter the residue, let it cool, bottle and refrigerate it. It can be stored for 3-5 days. Dilute with water when drinking.

Case: In the afternoon of the dog days, Aunt Wang makes winter melon tea at home. She dices the winter melon and mixes it with rock sugar to pickle the juice, then simmers it over low heat for several hours until it thickens. After the filter residue is cooled and iced, the whole family drinks it. It is sweet and relieves the heat. They all say it tastes better than the purchased drinks.

items.title: Ice powder
items.core: Finished product 1.jpg) Finished product 2.jpg) Stone jelly is a traditional snack in Xinyang, Henan. It tastes as smooth as jelly and is served with mint juice or lemon juice to cool down and relieve the heat. It belongs to the Henan cuisine. Made from hand-kneaded ice powder seeds, it is natural and contains no additives and is rich in plant gum. The production is very simple and friendly to novices. The whole process takes about 3 hours, of which 2.5 hours is the resting time, which requires almost no labor.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - 200g ice powder seeds - a piece of gauze to filter soy milk residue - 2000g Liangbaikai - 10ml mint juice / 10g mint powder - disposable transparent plastic cup (optional) - ice cubes that glow when exposed to water (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving feeds 5 people. Each portion: - 200g ice powder seeds - 2000g Liangbaikai - Mint juice 10ml / Mint powder 10g

Operation: 1. Pour Liangbaikai into a basin; 2. Wrap all the ice powder seeds with gauze and tie the opening 3. Put the wrapped ice powder seeds into Liangbaikai and rub them vigorously in Liangbaikai for 6 minutes 4. Then leave the Liangbaikai for 2.5 hours to take shape 5. Then put the stone jelly into the prepared disposable transparent plastic cup with a spoon, add 10ml mint juice or 10g mint powder (lemon juice, hawthorn juice, mulberry juice can also be used), then add ice cubes that glow when exposed to water, and stir slowly with a spoon evenly

Additional content: - During operation, you need to pay attention to the changes in color and viscosity of Liangbaikai. If the color is too light or the water is not sticky, it means that the amount of ice powder seeds is insufficient, or the kneading intensity and time are not in place.
Use cold water to rub the ice powder seeds, the water volume ratio is about 1:50, and squeeze out the mucus while rubbing.
Adding a small amount of lime water (clarified liquid) can help solidification, but the amount should not be too much, otherwise it will become bitter.
Do not shake while it rests. It tastes better after being refrigerated. It is delicious with mint juice or brown sugar water.

Case: Grandma Li from Xinyang often makes stone jelly in summer. She put the ice powder seeds into a gauze bag, repeatedly kneaded them in cold water to form a gelatin, let them stand to solidify, cut them into pieces, and poured mint juice over them. After eating it, the family felt cool and smooth, which relieved the heat.

items.title: Chai milk tea
items.core: Chai milk tea is an exotic home-cooked drink made from freshly brewed black tea, milk and various spices. It has a rich and smooth taste, with the spicy warmth of ginger, cardamom and cinnamon. Milk provides high-quality protein and calcium, while spices help warm the body, dispel cold, and promote digestion. The process is simple, intuitive and beginner-friendly, taking only about 10 minutes from prep to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - black tea (CTC black tea is best, or Assam black tea) - whole milk - ginger - cardamom (green) - cinnamon sticks - cloves - black peppercorns - sugar - small milk pot

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. Per portion (approximately 200ml): - 120ml water - 120ml whole milk - 8g black tea (approximately 2 teaspoons) - 5g ginger (approximately 1cm piece), crushed - 2 green cardamom, crushed - 1 small cinnamon stick (approximately 2cm) - 2 cloves - 2 black peppercorns, crushed - Sugar 10-15g (adjust according to personal taste)

Operation: 1. Crush the ginger (don’t chop it too finely, just pat it open to release the ginger juice) 2. Clap the cardamom with the back of a knife to reveal the seeds inside 3. Crush the black peppercorns 4. Pour 120ml water into a small milk pot 5. Add the chopped ginger, cardamom, cinnamon sticks, cloves, and black peppercorns 6. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low heat and cook 2 minutes to allow the flavor of the spices to fully release. 7. Add 8g of black tea and continue to simmer for 2 minutes until the color of the tea soup becomes darker. 8. Pour in 120ml of whole milk. 9. Heat over medium heat and watch carefully. When the milk tea starts to bubble and rise, immediately turn down the heat (milk can easily overflow). 10. Boil over low heat for 2-3 minutes. During this period, you can lift the pot and return it (repeatedly 3-4 times) to fully integrate the tea soup and milk. 11. Add sugar, stir to dissolve 12. Turn off the heat 13. Strain into the tea cup with a strainer to remove tea leaves and spice residues 14. Drink while hot

Additional content: - CTC black tea (made by Crush, Tear, Curl process) is the best choice for Indian milk tea because its particles are finely crushed and can release a strong tea flavor in a short time. Chinese Keemun black tea or Dianhong tea can also be substituted. -The ratio of milk to water can be adjusted according to personal preference. Thicker milk tea uses more milk and less water, while refreshing milk tea uses more water and less milk. - Ginger is the soul of Indian milk tea and is not recommended to be omitted. - Indians like their milk tea to be very sweet. If you are not used to it, you can reduce the amount of sugar. - In India, Chai is not only a drink, but also a social culture. Friends gatherings, business negotiations, and even first meetings all start with a cup of Chai.
