According to statistics, over 1 billion servings of tea are consumed in India every day. - Indian street milk tea stalls (Chai Wala) usually use clay cups (Kulhad) to serve tea, giving the tea a unique earthy fragrance.
The spices can be adjusted according to taste. Ginger slices can dispel cold and cardamom adds fragrance. Use the back of a knife to crack it to release the flavor more easily.
Brew the tea first and then pour the milk to avoid the milk from being scorched at high temperatures. Stirring can prevent clumping.
After cooking, sieve to remove the residue. If you like sweetness, add a little sugar or honey to taste.

Case: In the early morning of winter, Indian student Ajie cooked Indian milk tea to prevent colds. He boiled black tea, milk with ginger slices and cardamom, and sprinkled cinnamon powder before serving. After drinking the hot drink, the spicy aroma will warm you up and you will be full of energy throughout the morning.

items.title: Coke Bucket
items.core: Coke Bucket is a simple and easy-to-make casual cocktail with a refreshing and sweet taste. The bubbles and lemon juice of Coke can well neutralize the strong taste of whiskey, making it suitable for party occasions. Primarily providing energy, lemon supplements vitamin C. The entire blending process only takes 5 minutes to complete, making it easy for novices to get started.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: Ingredients - Bourbon - Coca-Cola - Ice cubes - Lemon (optional, to enhance the taste) Tools - Manual juicer
Calculation: One cup, about 900 ml (including ice) - Whiskey 100 ml - Coca-Cola 500 ml - 1 lemon - 300 g ice cubes

Operation: Lemon processing 1. Cut the lemon in half (the direction of the knife is perpendicular to the line connecting the head and tail of the lemon), and cut a lemon from one half for later use. 2. Cut the lemon in half again, squeeze out the lemon juice from the 4 corners of the lemon with a juicer and put it in a container for later use. 3. Place the squeezed lemon in a container for later use. Formal preparation 1. Choose a cup, it is recommended to use a large glass or tin wine barrel with a capacity of about 1 liter. 2. Put ice cubes and squeezed lemon into the cup (the arrangement of lemon and ice cubes can be designed according to personal preference) 3. Pour 15 ml of lemon juice (if you like sourness, you can add more or all) 4. Slowly pour Coca-Cola along the wall of the cup to 3/4 of the distance from the mouth of the cup (control the ratio of Coke to whiskey to about 5:1) 5. Pour the whiskey until the glass is full

Additional content: The taste of the whiskey is masked by the ice cubes and the taste of cola. Therefore, people who are not good at drinking can easily drink too much without knowing it. Please prepare it while ensuring the safety of yourself and the drinker.
Pour Coca-Cola last to keep the bubbles; add enough ice cubes to maintain a cool taste.
The ratio of whiskey to cola is about 1:3, which can be adjusted according to the amount of alcohol. Lemon juice can enhance the taste and relieve greasiness.
Drink as soon as possible after preparation to avoid ice cubes melting and diluting, affecting the flavor.

Case: When friends got together, Xiao Wang prepared a Coke bucket to add to the fun. He cut lemon slices and put them in a vat, poured whiskey and iced Coke into it, added ice cubes and stirred. Everyone drank from the bucket, and the refreshing and sweet taste made the atmosphere instantly lively.

items.id: 奇异果菠菜特调-奇异果菠菜特调
items.title: Kiwi spinach special blend
items.core: This is a refreshing and healthy fruit and vegetable drink with a sweet and sour taste, with the natural fruity aroma of kiwi and apple, and the light spinach flavor. Rich in vitamin C and dietary fiber, it helps improve digestion. It's so simple to make that even a novice can do it right the first time, and the whole process is expected to only take 10 minutes.
body: Essential raw materials and tools: - Ingredients: - Kiwi - Apple - Spinach leaves (2-5 pieces) - Water - White sugar - Tools - Juicer
Calculation: - 700ml drinking water - 2 kiwis - 1/2 apple - 4 spinach leaves - 12 grams of sugar

Operation: 1. Cut the kiwi fruit in half, and divide each half into four small pieces 2. Dice the apple 3. Stem the spinach leaves, leaving only the leaf part 4. Chop the spinach 5. Pour them into the mixing cup of the juicer 6. Fill in water 7. Add white sugar 8. Start the mixer and mix for about 4 15 seconds (stop every 15 seconds to check the status)

Additional content: - About the amount of white sugar: full sugar is 12g, can be adjusted from 0-12g according to personal circumstances - This product is developed by ourselves based on IKEA's kiwi fruit and spinach juice. It is not as delicious as IKEA's, but it is not bad either - improvements are welcome! Finished product:
Blanch the spinach for 30 seconds to remove the oxalic acid, making it smoother and less astringent after juicing.
Choose kiwi fruits that are ripe and soft, with high sweetness and easy to break. Remove the core of apples to retain part of the peel to increase fiber.
Add a small amount of lemon juice to prevent oxidation and discoloration. Drink it as soon as possible after mixing for the best taste and nutrition.

Case: Xiao Chen, who pays attention to health, makes special kiwi fruit and spinach for breakfast. He blanches the spinach and juices it with kiwi, apple, and yogurt. After drinking it, I feel sweet and sour, with a fruity aroma in my mouth, smooth bowel movements, and my whole body feels much lighter.

items.title: Milk Tea
items.core: This is a home-cooked drink easily made with black tea and milk powder. The aroma of tea and milk blend together, and the taste is smooth and warm. The tea polyphenols in black tea combined with the protein and calcium in milk can not only refresh your mind but also supplement your daily nutrition. The method is very simple, and even a novice can succeed in one attempt. It only takes about half an hour to drink homemade milk tea.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Black tea bags (Lipton Yellow Label Selected Black Tea is recommended) - Whole milk powder or evaporated milk - Cups, such as graduated cups, ceramic cups or thermos cups
Calculation: per serving: - 2 bags of black tea bags (about 4g) - 11-12g milk powder - 5-7g sugar

Operation: 1. Put 2 bags of black tea bags into the cup, add 180-200mL boiling water. 2. Wait 20 - 30 minutes. 3. Weigh 11-12g of milk powder and 5-7g of sugar, and add them to the liquid obtained in the previous step. 4. Stir evenly and drink.

Additional content: - After adding boiling water, try to keep the inside of the cup warm, such as using a cup with a smaller opening or covering it with a lid. If the temperature is low and using a measuring cup may cause the boiling water to cool before being poured into the black tea, you can directly estimate its volume without using a measuring cup. - After the waiting time, you can lift or stir the tea bag to make the brew more even.
First soak the black tea in boiling water for 5 minutes to develop the flavor, then add milk in a 1:1 ratio to make the tea more fragrant.
Choose whole milk powder or fresh milk for a smoother taste, while skimmed milk will be slightly lighter.
If you like sweet taste, you can add sugar or honey to hot milk, mix well and drink it hot to warm your stomach.

Case: On Sunday afternoon, I cooked a small pot of milk tea with black tea and milk powder. I brewed the tea first and then slowly added the milk. It took less than half an hour. It has a smooth and slightly sweet taste. Sitting by the window and drinking a glass of it feels more at ease than buying one from outside.

items.title: Poplar nectar
items.core: This is an improved version of the classic Hong Kong-style dessert, using chia seeds instead of sago rice. The texture is smooth and tender with the slight chewiness of the seeds. The sweetness of mango is intertwined with the slight acidity of grapefruit, and the coconut milk adds richness. Rich in dietary fiber, vitamin C and high-quality fat, it is refreshing and refreshing. It's very simple to make, even for novices, and it only takes about 20 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - cup - fruit knife - milk - ice cubes - blender/juice machine

Calculation: per serving: - 24g chia seeds - 50ml milk - 2 small cubes of ice - 1 mango - 1/2 grapefruit - 150ml coconut milk Garnish: - shredded dried mango (optional) - shredded dried orange (optional)

Operation: 1. Soak chia seeds in milk for 10 minutes. 2. While soaking the seeds, peel and dice half of the mango and grapefruit and put them into a cup. 3. Cut half a mango into small pieces, add ice cubes and coconut milk to a blender and puree. 4. Pour into a cup and top with garnishing ingredients (if any). 5. Enjoy and write code at the same time! !
Additional Content
Soak chia seeds in coconut milk for 30 minutes in advance, and then use them after they are fully swollen. The texture will be smoother and more tender.
Choose ripe mangoes with a strong and sweet aroma; remove the grapefruit pulp when removing it to avoid bitterness.
The flavor will be better after refrigeration. You can adjust the amount of coconut milk according to your preference and control the consistency.

Case: On a summer afternoon, Xiaomei makes Yangzhi Manna at home. She mixes diced mango and grapefruit pulp with cooked chia seeds and coconut milk. Eat it after refrigeration. The Q-shaped seeds blend with the fruity aroma, which is refreshing and relieves the heat. She ate two large cups in one go.

items.title: Lemonade
items.core: This drink uses fresh lemon as the main character and is blended with fruit honey to balance the sweetness and sourness. It will feel more refreshing after being chilled. Lemon is rich in vitamin C. Regular drinking can help to supplement nutrition, refresh and whiten your skin. The production steps are extremely simple, just beat, add ingredients and shake, and even a novice can complete it in three to five minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Raw materials - Lemon - Fruit nectar - Ice (optional) - Tools - Shake cup
Calculation: One cup, about 500 ml - 40~45 grams of lemon - 40~45 grams of fruit nectar - A few pieces of ice (optional)

Operation: 1. Weigh 40~45 grams of lemon and put it into the shaker cup 2. Hammer the lid of the shaker cup about 10 3. Add 40~45 grams of fruit honey 4. Add water 5. Shake evenly 6. Finally, add ice according to preference
Additional content: - Reference: Lemonade Tutorial
Wash the lemon skin with salt to remove wax, cut into thin slices and remove seeds to avoid bitterness.
When beating, use moderate force to release the juice without destroying the pulp, and the aroma will be stronger.
Adjust the amount of fruit honey according to taste. Add ice water and shake well. You can add mint leaves to increase the cooling effect.

Case: Xiaolin felt thirsty and tired after exercise, so he quickly made lemonade. He cut the lemon into pieces and pounded it to extract the juice, then added fruit honey and ice water and shook it well. After drinking it in one sip, the sweet and sour taste quenched his thirst and instantly restored his energy. He repeatedly praised the simple and delicious taste.

items.id: 泰国手标红茶-泰国手标红茶
items.title: Thai hand-labeled black tea
items.core: This is a classic milk tea originating from the streets of Thailand. It has a rich tea aroma, a dense and smooth texture, and the condensed milk and milk bring a sweet and milky taste. The combination of tea and milk can provide a small amount of protein and calcium, but the sugar content is high, making it suitable as a drink to relieve summer heat and quench thirst. The preparation steps are simple, but you need to repeatedly filter the tea soup and wait for a long time to refrigerate. The overall process takes about 4 hours and 20 minutes, and it can be completed with a little patience for novices.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Water - Tea powder - Condensed milk - White sugar - Milk - Gram scale - Container with graduation - Hong Kong-style milk tea filter bag

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Each portion: - Water (600cc) - Tea powder (20g) - Sugar (24g) - Milk (18ml) - Condensed milk (24g)

Operation: 1. Boil 600cc water over high heat 2. Put 20g tea powder in the filter bag, pour the boiling water into the filter bag, filter 20 times 3. Use grams to weigh 24g condensed milk, 24g sugar and Put 18ml milk into a kettle of more than 1000ml 4. Pour the filtered tea into the kettle and stir until the sugar melts 5. Place the kettle in the refrigerator for more than 4 hours 6. Add 6-8 ice cubes before drinking
Additional Content
The tea should not be brewed for too long to avoid bitterness; filter it 2-3 times to ensure that the tea soup is clear and residue-free.
Condensed milk determines the sweetness. You can add less to taste first and then adjust according to taste. Add milk at the end to make it smoother.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours to allow the flavors to blend. You can add ice cubes when drinking for a cooler taste.

Case: Thai restaurant clerk Xiaopa prepares hand-labeled black tea for guests. She boiled the tea leaves to make a red tea soup, filtered it repeatedly, added condensed milk and milk, and refrigerated it for several hours. After drinking it, guests praised the tea for its rich aroma, creaminess and smoothness, which was refreshing and satisfying.

items.title: Sunset at the Seaside
items.core: This cocktail has distinct layers of color. The pomegranate syrup at the bottom is like sunset, the orange juice in the middle is translucent, and the blue orange liquid at the top is like sea water. The overall mood is like a sunset at the seaside. It tastes sour, sweet and refreshing, with the aroma of rum. Orange and lemon juice contain small amounts of vitamin C, and alcohol can help relax you. The steps for making wine are not complicated, but it takes a little patience to pour the liquid along the stirring rod to create layers. Novices can also succeed if they follow it. It takes about a quarter of an hour to prepare and mix.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: Raw materials - grenadine - NFC orange juice - soda water - white rum - blue cura liqueur - lemon juice - ice cubes - lemon Tools - large glass - stir stick - wine measurer - mixing glass - straw - fruit knife

Calculation: one cup (including ice) - grenadine 15ml - orange juice 35~50ml - soda water 50ml - white rum 30ml - blue orange liqueur 15ml - lemon juice 15ml - a large ice cube will do - 1 lemon slice

Operation: lemon processing 1. Wash the lemon and cut out a slice for formal preparation 1. Choose a cup, it is recommended to use a transparent glass with a capacity of 350~400 ml 2. Add large ice cubes and stir the ice cup with a stir stick 3. Add grenadine syrup 4. Let the orange juice pour into the wine glass along the stirring stick until it is half full. 5. Gently stir half a circle. 6. Pour in soda water. 7. Take out the mixing glass and add white rum + blue cura liqueur + lemon juice + ice cubes. Then shake, shake 8. Gently pour into the wine glass 9. Insert lemon and straw
Additional content: Finished product:
Sort by density: syrup is the heaviest at the bottom, orange juice is in the middle, and blue curacao is the lightest at the top.
When pouring the liquid, slowly flow it down along the stirring rod to avoid impact, so that clear layers can appear.
Orange juice and lemon juice are best freshly squeezed, the sourness and sweetness are more natural, and the flavor can be better mixed by gently stirring before drinking.

Case: Xiao Zhou, who was on vacation on the island, was making sunset cocktails by the sea at a B&B. She poured grenadine, orange juice and blue curacao along the stirring rod, layering them like sea water at sunset. After raising the glass and taking a photo, drink it. It is sour, sweet and refreshing, and the aroma of rum is relaxing.

items.title: Avocado Lassi
items.core: This is an innovative drink that combines the traditional Indian yogurt drink "Lassi" with a smooth and smooth taste, sweet and not greasy, and is especially suitable as a breakfast or afternoon refreshing drink. Avocado is rich in monounsaturated fatty acids and dietary fiber. Combined with the high-quality protein and probiotics of yogurt, one cup can provide a long-lasting feeling of satiety. It's extremely easy to make, even for novices, and it only takes about 5 minutes from preparation to serving.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Plain yogurt - Ripe avocado - Honey - Cold milk - Cardamom powder (optional) - Mint leaves or chopped nuts (optional, for decoration) - Blender (wall breaker/juicer)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Per serving: - 120 ml plain yogurt - 1 ripe avocado - 1 tablespoon honey (can be increased or decreased according to taste) - 60 ml cold milk - 1 pinch cardamom powder (optional)

Operation: 1. Cut the avocado in half, remove the core, peel off the skin, and cut the flesh into small pieces and set aside. 2. Add 120ml plain yogurt, chopped avocado, 1 tablespoon honey and 60ml cold milk to a blender. 3. (Optional) Add a pinch of cardamom powder for a unique flavor. 4. Start the blender and blend until the liquid is completely smooth and rich, about 1 minute. 5. Pour the whipped drink into the cup. 6. (Optional) Place a few mint leaves on top or sprinkle with 5g chopped nuts for garnish.

Additional content: - The avocado must be ripe, so as to ensure the dense taste and color of the drink. - If you like a cooler taste, you can reduce the amount of milk appropriately and add a few ice cubes and stir together.
Choose ripe avocados with dark brown skin and soft texture. Use a spoon to scoop out the pulp. Be sure to remove overripe and blackened parts to avoid affecting the flavor.
Prefer thick Greek yogurt, which has higher protein content and can make the finished product denser. If it is too thick, add a small amount of milk to adjust.
Complete within five minutes to retain the most nutrients. If you need to take it out, it is recommended to put it in a thermos cup and add a few ice cubes to prevent stratification.

Case: Fitness coach Xiao Lin often feels tired after morning exercises. She blends half an avocado, sugar-free yogurt and a little honey in a food processor for 60 seconds. The creamy lassi provided a quick boost of energy, keeping her full and focused throughout the morning's teaching session.

items.id: 百香果橙子特调-百香果橙子特调
items.title: Passion fruit and orange special blend
items.core: This is a sweet and sour summer drink that combines the tropical fruity aroma of passion fruit and the fresh sweetness of orange. Paired with jasmine green tea or soda sparkling water, it has a distinct taste and is refreshing and refreshing. Rich in vitamin C, it helps strengthen immunity and moisturizes skin. It includes steps such as pickling, making tea, and juicing. It is a little more complicated but moderately difficult, and even novices can try it. The passion fruit needs to be marinated one day in advance, which takes about 24 hours in total, and the actual hands-on time is only about 30 minutes.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: - Ingredients: - Passion fruit - Orange - Choose one of jasmine green tea leaves/soda sparkling water - White sugar - Ice cubes - Honey (optional) - Mint leaves or other green leaves (optional, for decoration) - Tools - Manual juicer

Calculation: - Prepared based on the jasmine green tea version, one cup, about 380 ml - 1 orange (about 200 grams, fist size) - 3~6 grams of jasmine green tea leaves - 150 ml of boiling water - more than 160 grams of ice cubes - pickled passion fruit part (because the quantity is small and difficult to prepare, here is the amount of two times) - 3 passion fruits - 30 grams of white sugar - 10 grams of honey (if not available, you can use 5 grams of white sugar instead)

Operation: 1. Pickle passion fruit (because the quantity is small and difficult to prepare, here is the amount for two times) - Take out the pulp of three passion fruits (the juice inside cannot be let go) and put it in a container - Weigh 30 grams of white sugar and put it in - Weigh 10 grams of honey and put it in (if it is not available, you can use 5 grams of white sugar instead) - Stir evenly - Seal the container with plastic wrap and put it in the refrigerator for 12 to 24 hours of marinating 2. Jasmine green tea preparation (recommended ratio => tea: water: ice = 1~2: 50: 30) - Weigh 3~6 grams of tea leaves in a container, add 150 ml of boiling water, and steep for 6 minutes - Add 90 grams of ice cubes to the brewed green tea to cool, stir to speed up cooling - After the ice cubes disappear, filter the tea leaves to obtain about 240 ml of jasmine green tea water 3. Processing of oranges (can be done while making tea) - Cut the orange in half (the direction of the knife is perpendicular to the line connecting the head and tail of the orange), and cut an orange from one half for later use - Cut the orange in half again, use a juicer to squeeze out the orange juice from the 4 corners of the orange, and put it in a container for later use. 4. Formal preparation - Choose a cup, it is recommended to use a transparent glass with a capacity of 350~400 ml - Put 70 Place ice cubes at the bottom of the glass and pour all the orange juice - Place the previously prepared orange slice against the inner wall of the glass - Pour a portion of the pickled passion fruit over the ice - Slowly pour in jasmine green tea until the glass is full to facilitate layering - Place green leaves for decoration on the liquid surface (optional) Stir evenly and enjoy
Additional content: If you lack or don't like jasmine green tea, you can use soda sparkling water instead, eliminating the need for the preparation process of jasmine green tea
Scoop out the passion fruit seeds and marinate them with brown sugar in a ratio of 1:1. Refrigerate overnight to release the pectin and effectively reduce the sharp acidity.

Jasmine green tea needs to be brewed with 80-degree warm water and cooled quickly to avoid brewing at high temperature for a long time, which will cause the tea soup to become bitter and affect the overall taste.
When assembling, first fill with ice cubes, then pour in juice and tea soup in sequence, and finally garnish with orange slices. The sparkling water version needs to be filled before drinking.

Case: Office worker Xiao Zhou was drowsy in the hot summer afternoon. She took out the passion fruit pickled the night before and mixed it with cold-brewed jasmine green tea and orange juice. The sour, sweet and refreshing special blend entered her throat and instantly dissipated the heat, making her particularly sober during her speech at the afternoon meeting.

items.id: 砂糖椰子冰沙-砂糖椰子冰沙
items.title: Sugar Coconut Smoothie
items.core: Sugar Coconut Smoothie is a quick and tropical cold drink. The sweet coconut aroma is combined with the caramel aroma of coarse brown sugar, and the taste is dense and refreshing. Coconut water is rich in natural electrolytes and minerals, which can quickly replenish water, and coffee mixed with sugar adds carbohydrate energy. The production threshold is extremely low. You only need to freeze the coconut milk in advance and beat it into sand. There is no pressure on novices. It takes more than 10 hours to prepare from freezing to serving, but the hands-on operation only takes a few minutes, making it perfect for a leisurely afternoon ice cream.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Bottled coconut milk (larger bottle mouth is better) - Coffee sugar (yellow coarse grains)

Calculation: The optimal amount of smoothie is usually related to the melting speed. A 300g smoothie made at minus 18 degrees can usually be maintained at room temperature for 30 minutes. Each portion: - 500ml bottled coconut water - 10g coffee sugar (two packs of Taikoo coffee sugar) - chopped nuts (optional)

Operation: 1. Pour out 200ml of 500ml bottled coconut water and tighten the bottle cap immediately. 2. Place the bottle of coconut milk into the freezer section of the refrigerator and freeze for more than 10 hours. 3. Take out the bottle of coconut juice. If you confirm that the coconut juice in the bottle has been completely frozen, tap it hard on a hard surface such as a wall, chair back, or table corner. (Please make sure that the surface will not be damaged) 4. When the frozen coconut milk turns into smoothie, open the bottle cap and pour out the smoothie. 5. Sprinkle coffee sugar or chopped nuts evenly on the surface of the smoothie. 6. Complete
Additional content: - In the above steps, bottled coconut milk can be frozen in advance, but it should not be frozen for more than 7 days, otherwise there is a risk of spoilage.
Pour pure coconut milk into a shallow-bottomed container and freeze. The thin layer freezes faster and is easier to crush. The coconut milk and coconut water taste more mellow.
Coarse brown sugar can provide caramel flavor and chewiness, while coffee sugar can add a slightly bitter layer. You need to add it according to your personal sweetness tolerance.
After taking out the frozen coconut milk, leave it at room temperature for two minutes. Wait until the edges are soft before beating. This will make it easier to form a fine sand-like texture.

Case: On the weekend afternoon, Ajie pounded the coconut milk blocks that had been frozen in advance into fine sand, and sprinkled them with coarse brown sugar and coffee sugar. The dense smoothie melted in his mouth, and the aroma of caramel and coconut intertwined, making him feel extremely cool and comfortable while watching the movie.

items.title: Rake Mandarin Tea
items.core: Rake Mandarin Tea is a fruit tea drink that combines the sweetness of citrus and the fragrance of jasmine. It has a refreshing and sweet taste. It is a creative drink and is not limited to specific cuisines. Mandarin orange is rich in vitamin C and dietary fiber. Drinking it with green tea can bring a refreshing and refreshing experience. The recipe is very simple and beginner-friendly, and the entire process from making tea to stirring only takes about 15 minutes to complete.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Ingredients: - Mandarin oranges (see additional content for substitutions) - Jasmine green tea - Ice cubes - Cane sugar syrup (optional) - Tools - Blender
Calculation: One cup, about 300 ml - 1~2 mandarin oranges (more than 200 grams) - Jasmine green tea 2~4 grams - Ice cubes 60 grams - 1: 1 sucrose syrup 10 grams (optional)

Operation: 1. Jasmine green tea preparation (recommended ratio => tea : water : ice = 1~2 : 50 : 30) - Weigh 2~4 grams of tea leaves in a container, add 100 ml of boiling water, and steep for 6 minutes - Add 60 grams of ice cubes to the brewed green tea to cool, stir to speed up cooling - After the ice cubes disappear, filter the tea leaves to get about 160 ml of jasmine green tea. 2. Formal preparation - Choose a cup, it is recommended to use a transparent glass with a capacity of about 300 ml - Take out the fleshy segments of the tangerine and peel off the skin to get the pulp - Take 130 grams of pulp and 130 ml of jasmine green tea and put it into a blender - Pour 10 grams of sucrose syrup (optional, add if you like sweetness) - Close the lid and start the blender, stir for 20 seconds and then pour the blended product into the cup - Tear a little pulp and sprinkle it on the liquid. Start enjoying

Additional content: - Rake tangerines can be replaced with other citrus whose pulp is easy to separate, such as ugly tangerines - The ratio of pulp to tea is 1: 1. If you need to prepare a larger portion, you can increase the dosage in proportion
Choose tangerines with thin and juicy skin, and try to tear off the white tangerine veins after peeling, which can significantly reduce the bitterness and retain the sweet and fruity flavor.

It is recommended to brew green tea with 85-degree hot water for 3 minutes. The best tea-to-water ratio is 1:50. Remove the tea leaves to prevent them from becoming thicker and astringent after continuous soaking.

Mix tangerine pulp and warm tea soup in a ratio of 1:3. You can add a small amount of honey according to taste. It can be drunk hot or cold. It is recommended to enjoy it immediately for the best flavor.

Case study: Peel out the pulp of the mandarin orange, add a small amount of rock sugar and water and boil it for ten minutes. Let it cool, bottle it and refrigerate it. After three days, mix it with sparkling water and drink it. The sour and sweet taste is the most stable.

items.id: 菠萝咖啡特调-菠萝咖啡特调
items.title: Pineapple Coffee Special
items.core: This special drink combines the mellow aroma of coffee and the sweet and sourness of pineapple, with refreshing bubbles, dense milk cap, and rich taste. Pineapple is rich in vitamin C and dietary fiber, and can be refreshing when paired with coffee. It's medium easy to make, just whip the cream and mix in the liquids, and it's done in about 10 minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Coffee liquid (recommended for concentrated or cold brew) - Pineapple juice (freshly squeezed or NFC) - Ice cubes - Soda water - Cream - Milk - Sugar - Sea salt (optional) - Rum (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 1 person. Each serving: - Coffee liquid 30ml - Pineapple juice 60ml - Ice cubes 50g - Soda water 30ml - Cream 30ml - Milk 10ml - Sugar 8g - Sea salt 0.5g - Rum 5ml

Operation: 1. Add ice cubes, coffee liquid, pineapple juice and soda water to the cup in sequence 2. Whip cream with sugar until wet foam, add rum and milk until even and fluid. 3. Pour cream on top of the first mixture. 4. Sprinkle sea salt on top of the cream

Additional content: - It is recommended to use floral and fruit flavor for the coffee liquid. For concentration, use medium-roasted beans. For cold brew, you can wash it with ordinary water or dry it in the sun - When pouring the cream, keep the height as low as possible so that the cream can float evenly on the surface of the drink to form a milk cap - Using fresh coffee liquid and pineapple juice can greatly enhance the overall flavor

Select fresh pineapples for fresh juice and filter the residue. The sweetness and sourness are natural. If you use canned pineapples with sugar water, you need to reduce the additional sugar accordingly.
Add a little sea salt when whipping cream to better highlight the milky aroma and balance the sweetness. Beat until eighty-fold to maintain fluidity and allow it to float on the liquid surface.
The assembly sequence is ice cubes, pineapple juice, coffee liquid, and finally slowly pour in sparkling water and milk cap to form clear layers to enhance the visual and taste.

Case: Barista Azhe prepared a special concoction for the party. He shook the iced pineapple juice and espresso, poured it into the cup until it was eighty full, and then squeezed a layer of whipped cream on top. After tasting it, friends all praised it, saying that the denseness of the milk cap and the stimulation of the bubbles were perfect.

items.title: Wine Rice Fermented Rice
items.core: This is a traditional Chinese fermented dessert with a sweet and slightly drunk taste, with a faint aroma of wine. It has the effect of strengthening the spleen, appetizing and promoting digestion. The production process is simple and interesting. Although you need to wait for fermentation, the hands-on operation is not complicated and is very suitable as an introduction to fermentation. The total production time is expected to be approximately 2 days, of which only approximately 1 hour of hands-on time will be required.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - 800g glutinous rice (round glutinous rice is recommended) - One pack (8g) of Anqi sweet rice wine (although the proportion is 3g per 1000g glutinous rice, but adding more rice wine can increase the probability of success) - 720g + 600g water (720g is used for steaming rice, and the last 500g is used for fermentation) - Steamer (a rice cooker will do) - Thermometer (optional but recommended) - Clean, airtight glass or ceramic container 1
Calculation: This recipe serves 1 serving, serving 6 to 8 people.

Operation: 1. Wash 800g of glutinous rice and put it into the rice cooker, add 720g of water and select the rice steaming mode. 2. After steaming, pour the rice out and let it cool. Use a clean tool to spread it to 30°C (it is better to measure it with a thermometer, it will feel warm to the body but not hot to your hands). 3. Mix 8g of Angel Rice with 20ml of warm water (approx. 30°C), dissolve evenly in the glutinous rice, and stir evenly. 4. Add 600g of water to the glutinous rice to help stir the koji evenly. After letting it sit for 2-3 minutes, you will find that the glutinous rice has absorbed enough water. Adding water this time will enrich the soup during the first fermentation of the glutinous rice. 5. Use a rolling pin to dig a small hole in the center of the glutinous rice (to facilitate the release of the wine). 6. Put the mixed rice into a clean container, flatten the surface gently, cover with a lid or plastic wrap and seal well. 7. Place it at 28 to 32°C for fermentation for 24 to 48 hours. Do not shake or move violently during the fermentation period. 8. The standard for successful fermentation is: there is transparent wine oozing out from the middle groove, with a slight wine aroma overall, no peculiar smell, and no rancidity. 9. It can be refrigerated and stored immediately after the fermentation is completed (osmanthus can be added during the process). It can be taken out with clean tools for each consumption and can be refrigerated for 7 to 10 days. 10. You can continue the secondary fermentation and add 500ml of water to increase the yield of the wine (within 800g of water is enough) 11. The wine will continue to ferment. If you want to stop the fermentation, you can steam it in a pot for 10 minutes to sterilize it, or put it in the refrigerator to refrigerate. Advanced version 1: Soak rice in advance: 1. Wash 800g of glutinous rice, pour it into water and soak it for 6 to 8 hours (8 to 10 hours is recommended in winter) until the rice grains are full. 2. Drain the glutinous rice, put it in a steaming cloth, and steam it for 40 to 60 minutes. Open the pot lid and stir it every 20 minutes to ensure even steaming. 3. After steaming, pour out the rice and let it cool, add the koji, follow the same steps as above. Advanced version 2: Mixed rice: 1. Of course, jiuyang veterans can try different rice combinations at will. You can replace 20% of the glutinous rice with millet, oats, yellow rice, blood glutinous rice, etc.

Additional content: - Fermentation temperature is very important, low temperature will cause slow fermentation or failure, and high temperature will kill the distiller's yeast - Common reasons for fermentation failure: the temperature is too high, the rice is too hot when the distiller's yeast is mixed, the container is not clean, or water and oil are introduced - It can be heated and eaten with glutinous rice balls, egg drops, wolfberry, etc., but be careful not to boil it for too long to avoid the loss of the aroma of the wine - Fermented glutinous rice juice can be used to make fermented fermented rice cakes, fermented fermented rice cakes, etc., and can also be used as seasoning to add flavor to beef rice and teriyaki sauce.

After the glutinous rice is steamed, it needs to be cooled thoroughly to about 30 degrees before mixing with the koji. High temperature will burn the bacteria and cause fermentation failure. It is best to feel slightly warm.

The fermentation container must be water-free and oil-free. After mixing the rice, compact the rice and dig a hole in the middle to facilitate observation of the wine production and ensure ventilation.

The fermentation can be stopped after 36 to 48 hours when the wine becomes clear and the rice grains float. If the fermentation continues and the wine tastes too strong, it can be moved to the refrigerator to refrigerate.

Case: Xiao Wu, a new mother, mixes steamed glutinous rice into distiller's yeast and puts it into a yogurt machine to ferment at a constant temperature for 36 hours. When she opened the lid, the aroma of wine was fragrant, and the rice grains floated up one by one. She cooked a small bowl of fermented glutinous rice and egg drop for a midnight snack, and her whole body felt warm.

items.title: Sour plum soup
items.core: Sour plum soup is a traditional drink that is sweet and sour, refreshing and relieving the heat. It is especially refreshing when consumed chilled. The raw materials such as black plum, hawthorn, and licorice in the formula help to produce body fluids, quench thirst, and stimulate appetite. It’s simple and beginner-friendly, just soak, boil and refrigerate. The entire preparation process includes soaking, two decoctions and refrigeration, which takes about 6 hours or more. It is recommended to prepare in advance.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - water - black dates - black plums - hawthorn slices (raw) - yellow rock sugar - licorice - tangerine peel - red cardamom - dried osmanthus

Calculation: - two liters of water - black dates 25 grams - black plums 25g - yellow rock sugar 100 grams - hawthorn slices 30 grams - licorice 2 grams - tangerine peel 4 Grams - Red cardamom 1 g - Dried osmanthus 3 g All the above dosages can be increased or decreased in equal proportions.

Operation: 1. Rinse the ingredients (except dried osmanthus and rock sugar), soak in 1.5 liters of water at room temperature for more than two hours (except dried osmanthus and rock sugar). 2. Bring to a boil over medium heat, cover, and simmer over low heat for 40 minutes. 3. Put the rock sugar in a basin, then pour the drained soup while it is hot, and stir until the rock sugar melts. 4. Put the medicinal materials back into the pot and add 600 ml of water, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to medium heat, and cook for another 20 minutes for the second decoction. 5. Finally, mix the second decoction and rock sugar water while hot to form the finished product. Add dried osmanthus flowers to the finished product at 60-70℃ (do not exceed 80℃), cover and let cool, then refrigerate for more than 3 hours. 6. Remember to drain out the dried osmanthus flowers when drinking. Sip it carefully like drinking tea, it is cold and refreshing, sour and refreshing, moderately sweet, and the taste is full and long
Additional content: It will be better to drink it after refrigeration.
Wumei, hawthorn and licorice need to be soaked in cold water for 30 minutes in advance to help the active ingredients dissolve. After boiling for the first time, turn to low heat for 20 minutes.

The second decoction can squeeze out the flavor of the ingredients, and the sweetness will be more balanced after the two soups are mixed. In the last five minutes, dried osmanthus is added to enhance the flavor.

The sour plum soup needs to be cooled completely before moving to the refrigerator. The flavor will be better after being chilled. It is recommended to drink it within three days to ensure the quality.

Case: Retired teacher Lao Li makes sour plum soup every summer solstice. He soaks black plums, hawthorns and licorice and boils them twice. The filter residue is adjusted by adding osmanthus sugar, and after being chilled, the whole family sits around and drinks it. They all say that this sour, sweet and refreshing soup is better than cold drinks to relieve the heat.

items.title: Sour plum soup (semi-finished product)
items.core: Sour plum soup (semi-finished product) is a sweet and sour summer drink, traditional Beijing style. Sour plum soup itself has the benefits of promoting body fluids, quenching thirst, and helping digestion. The method is extremely simple, just stir in order, it is not difficult for novices, and the whole process can be completed in about five minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Sour plum crystal solid drink - Sugar cubes (optional) - Beijing Erguotou wine (optional)

Calculation: - 1177 grams of drinking water - 120 grams of sour plum crystal solid drink - 9 grams of sugar cubes - 48 grams of Beijing Erguotou wine All the above dosages can be increased or decreased in equal proportions.

Operation: 1. Take 1177 grams of drinking water. 2. Add 60 grams of sour plum crystal solid drink and stir clockwise 50 times with a spoon. 3. Add the remaining 60 grams of sour plum crystal solid drink and stir clockwise 50 times with a spoon again. 4. Add 9 grams of cubed sugar and stir clockwise 100 times with a spoon. 5. Add 48 grams of Beijing Erguotou wine and stir clockwise 30 times with a spoon.

Additional content: If you have not prepared sugar cubes or Beijing Erguotou, you can omit step 4 or 5 in the operation. The effect will be better if you put it in the refrigerator before drinking. Please do not drive while drinking alcohol.

Read the packaging instructions carefully and distinguish the mixing ratio of concentrate and solid powder package. Add cold water first and then pour the semi-finished product to avoid agglomeration.

When stirring, use a long-handled spoon to quickly draw circles along the wall of the cup to ensure that the syrup and plum juice are fully integrated, there is no sedimentation at the bottom of the cup, and the taste is more uniform.
The sweetness of semi-finished products is often fixed. You can add a small amount of honey or lemon juice according to your personal taste, and add ice cubes to enhance the refreshing taste.

Case: Xiao Chen, a college student, wanted to eat sour plum soup in his dormitory. He took out the semi-finished product package and poured it into a cup, then added cold water and syrup in order and stirred. In less than five minutes, a sweet and sour refreshing drink was ready, and his roommates all praised his quick hands and feet.

items.title: Gin and Tonic
items.core: This is a classic gin cocktail with a refreshing and slightly bitter taste, with the bright sour aroma of lemon and the delicate bubbles of tonic water, making it light and smooth in the mouth. Although it mainly provides water and a small amount of calories from alcohol, fresh lemon juice can provide a boost of vitamin C and help boost your mood. It's so simple that even a novice can master it, and it should only take 5 minutes to complete.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: Raw materials - Gin - Tonic sparkling water - Lemon - Ice cubes - Fresh green leaves (optional, for decoration) Tools - Manual juice press
Calculation: One cup, about 350 ml (including ice) - Gin 30~40 ml - 1 can of tonic sparkling water - 1 lemon - 100 grams of ice cubes

Operation: Processing of lemons 1. Cut the lemon in half (the direction of the knife is perpendicular to the line connecting the head and tail of the lemon), and cut a lemon from the half for later use. 2. Cut the lemon in half again, squeeze out the lemon juice from the 4 lemon corners with a juicer, and put it in a container for later use. Formal preparation 1. Choose a cup, it is recommended to use a transparent glass with a capacity of 350~400 ml. 2. Place 100 grams of ice cubes at the bottom of the cup 3. Pour 30~40 ml of gin 4. Pour 15 ml of lemon juice (if you like sourness, add more or all) 5. Stir evenly with a spoon 6. Place the slice of lemon prepared previously 7. Slowly pour tonic water along the wall of the cup until the cup is full (do not pour it over ice to avoid the loss of bubbles) 8. Use a spoon to gently lift the liquid up and down to stir the liquid evenly (do not rotate and stir to avoid the loss of bubbles) 9. Place decorative green leaves on the liquid surface (optional)
Additional content: Finished product:
Choose large slices of fresh lemons, squeeze out the juice and put them into the cup together with the pulp, which can provide a brighter sour aroma and visual embellishment.
The recommended ratio of gin to tonic water is 1:3 or 1:4. The tonic water needs to be poured slowly along the wall of the cup to retain fine bubbles and avoid violent shaking.
Filling the cup with large pieces of transparent ice can reduce the melting speed and prevent the wine from diluting too quickly, giving it a better and continuously refreshing taste.

Case: Programmer Xiao Zhang felt bored after get off work. He filled the spherical cup with ice cubes, poured in gin and tonic water, and squeezed in fresh lemon juice. After drinking it in one sip, the bubbles carry the fragrance of juniper gin, and your fatigue is instantly washed away by the refreshing taste.

items.title: Golden Fizz
items.core: Classic gin cocktail, sweet and sour, with refreshing bubbles. The lemon provides a rich source of vitamin C, and the cane sugar syrup balances the acidity. It is very simple to make and can be prepared by novices in just 5 minutes, making it suitable for easy enjoyment at home. Please note that drinking alcohol is harmful to your health, please do not overdose.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: Raw materials - Gin - Sparkling water - Lemon - Cane sugar syrup - Ice cubes - Fresh green leaves (optional, for decoration) Tools - Manual juicer - Shaker bottle (optional)
Calculation: One cup, about 350 ml (including ice) - 30~40 ml of gin - 1 can of sparkling water - 1 lemon - 1:1 sucrose syrup 30~40 grams - 100 grams of ice

Operation: Lemon processing 1. Cut the lemon in half (the direction of the knife is perpendicular to the line connecting the head and tail of the lemon), and cut a lemon from one half for later use. 2. Cut the lemon in half again, squeeze out the lemon juice from the 4 corners of the lemon with a juicer, and put it in a container for later use. Formal preparation (no shaker bottle) 1. Choose a cup, the recommended capacity is 350~400 ml transparent glass 2. Place 100 grams of ice cubes at the bottom of the cup 3. Pour 30~40 ml of gin 4. Pour in 20 ml of lemon juice (if you like sourness, you can add more or all) 5. Pour in 30~40 grams of sucrose syrup 6. Stir evenly with a spoon 7. Place the slice of lemon prepared previously 8. Slowly pour soda sparkling water along the wall of the glass until the glass is full (do not pour over ice to avoid foaming and loss) 9. Use a spoon to gently pull up and down to stir the liquid evenly (do not rotate and stir to avoid foaming and loss) 10. Place decorative green leaves on the liquid surface (optional) If you have a shaker bottle, you can replace the above steps 2~6 with the following steps 1. Pour ice cubes, gin, lemon juice, and sucrose syrup into the shaker bottle, and the shaker will be evenly distributed 2. Pour enough shake into the cup (if the ice inside is too broken, you can choose to filter the ice and refill the cup with ice cubes)
Additional content: Finished product:
Add gin, freshly squeezed lemon juice and syrup into a shaker in a ratio of 2:1:1, add ice and shake thoroughly to fully incorporate the wine and cool it down extremely.
After straining into an ice-cold highball glass, immediately fill it with ice-cold soda water until it is 80% full. Use a bar spoon to gently lift it once to avoid over-stirring and deflation.
Choose syrup with a fine texture or homemade sugar water to better balance the tartness of lemon. If you like a lighter taste, you can reduce the amount of syrup.

Case: Xiao Liu, a bartending enthusiast, tried Gin Fizz at home. He shook the gin, lemon juice and syrup, poured it into a highball glass, and filled it with soda water. The wine quickly rose into dense bubbles, and he was full of praise for the sweet and sour taste, instantly dispelling the busy day.

items.title: Long Island Iced Tea
items.core: Long Island Iced Tea is a classic cocktail that tastes like iced tea, is soft in the mouth but has a high alcohol content. It itself has low nutritional value, and you can relax by drinking it occasionally, but don't overdo it. The preparation is very simple, just mix four base wines, liqueur and fruit juice in proportion, and even novices can make it easily. It only takes about 5 minutes from prep to finish.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Gin - Tequila - Vodka - White rum - Orange liqueur - Lemon - Maple syrup - Coke - Ice cubes - Highball glass (capacity 300ml)

Calculation: one cup, about 300ml (including ice): - Gin 15ml - Tequila 15ml - Vodka 15ml - White rum 15ml - orange liqueur 15ml - lemon juice 30ml - maple syrup 20ml - cola 75ml - 1 lemon - 100g ice cubes

Operation: 1. Cut the lemon in half, squeeze out 30ml lemon juice into the cup; 2. Add to the cup in turn: - 15ml gin, - 15ml tequila, - 15ml Vodka, - 15ml white rum, - 15ml orange liqueur; 3. Slowly pour 20ml maple syrup into the cup, stirring while pouring; 4. Add 75ml cola to the cup; 5. Add ice cubes to the cup until the cup is full; 6. Stir gently for 20 seconds; 7. Start enjoying.

Additional content: Long Island Ice Tea, which does not contain tea but has the taste of ice tea, is a cocktail with a high alcohol content (about 15%) but a soft and easy-to-accept taste. Reference: International Bartenders Association: Long Island Iced Tea
Measure vodka, gin, white rum and agave strictly in equal proportions, and use measuring cups to avoid pouring by feel, which may lead to alcohol imbalance.
Pour in the lemon juice and syrup before adding the cola, then top it up with the cola and stir gently to help maintain the bubbles and make the ice tea flavor more realistic.
Because mixing a variety of base wines has a strong stamina, be sure to follow the principle of moderation. Don’t be greedy for the soft taste. Drinking water and eating can relieve drunkenness.

Case: At a friend's party, bartender Xiao Li mixed four base wines and juice in proportion and poured them into an iced tea cup. Everyone initially thought it was a non-alcoholic iced tea, but after drinking it, they found that it had a strong stamina. They all lamented that this drink has a gentle taste but a strong alcoholic taste.

items.title: Fan Sha Taro
items.core: Fan Sha Taro is a traditional Chaoshan snack that is crispy on the outside, glutinous on the inside, sweet and delicious, and is often served as afternoon tea. Lipu taro is rich in dietary fiber, potassium and multiple vitamins, which can provide a long-lasting feeling of satiety. It is not difficult to make, but you need to master the temperature of boiling sugar. It is suitable for beginners with a little basic knowledge. The whole process can be completed in about 20 minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Lipu taro (you can buy it on e-commerce platforms, affordable and fresh) - White sugar or rock sugar - Water - Green onion
Calculation: - Lipu taro 200g - White sugar 30g - Water 15g

Operation: 1. Cut the taro into long strips (slightly larger, so it will not break easily during stir-frying) 2. Add enough oil to cover the taro and wait until the oil warms up (insert chopsticks to make small bubbles) 3. Put the taro into the oil and fry until it floats, usually it is slightly yellow and can be easily poked with chopsticks 4. Don’t waste the oil for frying the taro, it can be used for cooking and other things later. 5. The next key step is to mix sugar (30g) and water (15g) according to 2:1 Proportion, heat until no color changes and small bubbles appear. 6. Pour in the chopped green onion and taro, turn off the heat and stir-fry. When the temperature comes down, the sugar will have an anti-sand effect. 7. Plate and serve!
Additional content: - The freshly made taro is very hot, be careful to burn your mouth - Pair it with tea, ah~ it’s so comfortable
Cut Lipu taro into hob pieces, uniform in size and easy to fry at the same time. Heat the oil to 60% and fry until golden and firm in appearance. Remove and drain.

When boiling sugar, the ratio of sugar to water is about 2:1. Boil over medium heat until the big bubbles turn into small bubbles and the syrup turns slightly yellow. Remove from the heat immediately. This is the key point for the formation of sand.

After removing from the heat, quickly pour in the taro and continue to stir-fry. As the temperature drops, the syrup will gradually crystallize into frost. Stir-fry until each piece is evenly coated with white frost.

Case: Chaoshan housewife Sister Chen cut Lipu taro into pieces and fried them until golden and crispy. She precisely controlled the heat of the syrup and stir-fried it until the frosting was even and sandy. The finished product is sweet on the outside and glutinous on the inside. My family enjoys it with Gongfu tea during afternoon tea time and praises its authentic taste.

items.id: 咖啡椰奶冻-咖啡椰奶冻
items.title: Coffee coconut milk jelly
items.core: This dessert combines the mellowness of coffee and the sweetness of coconut milk. It tastes as delicate and smooth as pudding and has rich layers. Whipped cream and coconut milk provide high-quality fats and plant nutrients, which can bring you a sense of satisfaction. The method is very user-friendly, just mix and heat it, no complicated skills are required, even a novice can succeed in one go. Not counting refrigeration, the actual operation takes about 1 hour, plus the refrigeration setting, a total of about 4 hours before you can enjoy it.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - 125ml whipping cream - 250ml Coconut Juice - 35ml espresso - 50ml coconut water - 10g gelatin - filter (optional) - (that...if you need to put it on the plate, you can have some blueberries and/or coffee powder)

Calculation: 3-4 people: - 125ml Whipping cream (35% M.E) - 250ml coconut brand coconut milk - 35ml espresso (I personally do not recommend using fruity coffee beans) - 50ml coconut water (vita coco coconut water is recommended, you can knock a coconut if possible) - 10g gelatine - sugar (optional)

Operation: 1. Mix a certain amount of whipping cream, coconut milk, espresso, and coconut water and set aside. 2. Heat the above liquid for 1 minute until the temperature reaches 50-60 degrees. 3. (Optional) Add extra sugar if you like it extra sweet. 4. Add gelatine, stir until melted, and cook for 1 minute. 5. (Optional) Sieve (this step can make the coconut milk jelly taste smoother). 6. Place in the mold. 7. (Optional) Filter out the bubbles on the surface. This step will make the coconut milk jelly taste better and look better. 8. Place in the refrigerator and wait for 3 hours.

Additional content: NOTE: Be sure not to let liquids boil! ! ! No bubbles either! ! ! Regarding cleaning kitchen utensils: It is recommended to use a dishwasher directly. If not available, you can wash it with warm water. (Because gelatin is not easy to clean, a dishwasher is better)
The coffee liquid is first thickened with hot water, and then mixed with coconut milk after cooling to avoid the high temperature causing the whipping cream to separate.
Soak the gelatine slices in ice water in advance, add to the warm liquid and stir until completely melted, then sift and pour into the mold.
Refrigerate for at least four hours before unmoulding, and scald the cutting edge with hot water to make it smoother and less likely to collapse.

Case: A friend came to my house on the weekend afternoon. I mixed the coffee liquid, coconut milk and light cream, heated it, poured it into the mold, refrigerated it for four hours, took it out and cut it into pieces. When I served it to the table, it was praised to be smooth and tender, and the coffee flavor and coconut aroma were just right.

items.id: 奥利奥冰淇淋-奥利奥冰淇淋
items.title: Oreo ice cream
items.core: Oreo ice cream has a delicate taste, the milky aroma blends with the crispy sweetness of Oreo, and the pure animal cream makes the whole thing light and not greasy. It mainly provides energy, contains fat and carbohydrates, and is suitable as a dessert to relieve the heat. The preparation process is relatively simple. You only need to deal with the biscuit filling and whipping cream. A novice can complete it with a little patience. The whole preparation takes about half an hour, and it can be frozen for more than 4 hours before you can enjoy it.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Whipping cream (recommended brand Anchor Animal Whipping Cream) - Original Oreo - Electric egg beater - A deep container with a capacity of more than 600 ml and a small diameter (PS: you need to pay attention to the electric egg beater) (if you prepare an ice cream mold, the container needs to have a sharp mouth for easy transfer) - A knife (or a tool that can remove the filling) - Ice cream mold (optional)
Calculation: Per serving: - Oreo 6 Blocks - 18 grams of white sugar - 250 ml of whipping cream

Operation: 1. Unscrew the Oreos and remove the core (sandwich), set aside 2. Chop the Oreos with chopsticks, half of the Oreos need to be powdered, and the maximum length of the other half should be less than 0.5 cm, set aside (Search for "Oreo Cookie Crumbs" on a Baobao, save time and energy ^-^) 3. Invert all the cream into a deep container and add the prepared sugar. 4. Start whipping with the electric egg beater at high speed until the hanging cream (0.5 cm - 1 cm) will appear below after the electric egg beater is lifted, instead of all dripping like a liquid (partial dripping is normal). 5. After the whipping is complete, add the oats into the cream and stir evenly until there are oats at the bottom. 6. Optional: Pour the mixture into the ice cream mold 7. Place in the freezer of the refrigerator (-18 degrees) for more than 4 hours before taking out

Additional content: - Container for mincing Oreos Be careful not to use fragile containers. - Be careful not to cut your hands when removing the Oreo filling. - Reference: Make [Oreo McFlurry] in 5 minutes, so satisfying!
Scrape out the Oreo filling separately and whip it together with the cream to make the sweetness more even. Add the biscuit crumbs at the end.
The light cream and cream cheese are refrigerated in advance and can be whipped until they are eighty minutes. Over-whipping will make the ice cream taste rough.
Smooth the ice cream batter and cover it tightly before freezing, and stir it every two hours to reduce ice residue and make the texture smooth.

Case: My child wanted to eat ice cream in the summer evening. I opened the Oreos, scraped off the filling, crushed the biscuits, mixed in the whipped cream and froze it overnight. When I dug it into the ball, it had a delicate texture without any ice residue, and the biscuit crumbs still had a crispy aroma.

items.title: Chiffon Cake
items.core: This introductory baking dessert has a delicate and soft taste and a cloud-like light texture. It is a classic basic style in Western pastries. The main raw materials, eggs and milk, provide high-quality protein and calcium and are rich in nutrients. The production process requires high heat for whipping, mixing and baking, which is a certain challenge, but as long as you follow the steps patiently, even novices can succeed. It usually takes 1.5 to 2 hours from prep to out of the oven.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: Tools: * Oven (a rice cooker can be substituted, but in most cases it is prone to failure due to the material of the pot) * Egg beater (electric is best, manual labor is laborious and has a certain probability of failure) or chopsticks (very not recommended) * Aluminum alloy anode mold (never choose a non-stick mold, the common size is 6 inches or 8 inches) * Scraper (used for mixing cake batter) Ingredients: - Eggs - Sugar - Milk (or water) - Cooking oil (or butter, but need to be heated to soften) - Cake flour (Huiyi is recommended) - [Optional] Lemon juice or white vinegar

Calculation: Each serving is based on 1 egg (normal medium size, about 50g). | Ingredients | 1 portion (standard) | 6 inches (3 portions, area 36) | 8 inches (5 portions, area 64) | 40g | | Milk | 10g | 30g | 50g | | Low-gluten flour | 17g | 50g | 90g

|Operation: Preliminary separation operation: 1. Take out fresh eggs from the refrigerator 2. Prepare two containers and dry them to hold egg white and egg yolk respectively 3. There can be a little water droplets in the container holding egg white, but there should be no oil; there should be no water droplets in the container holding egg yolk 4. Beat the eggs, either by hand or using an egg separator, and separate the egg whites and yolks into two containers. 5. During the separation process, the egg yolk cannot be broken, and the egg white cannot be mixed with any egg yolk, otherwise it will seriously affect the beating. (The white lace can enter the egg white and will not affect it) 6. (Note that when a kitchen machine is not used, the container holding the egg white is also the container for beating eggs. To avoid overflow, do not exceed 1/8 of the container after adding all the egg whites) Mixing the egg yolk liquid (post-egg method): 1. Prepare a new empty bowl, add all the cooking oil and all the milk in the formula 2. Use a whisk to stir quickly by hand until the oil and water are completely combined and present a milky white suspension state (emulsification is completed). 3. Sieve all the low-gluten flour in the formula and add it to the above emulsion. Use a spatula to mix in a "Z" shape until there is no obvious dry powder (the batter may be a little rough at this time, which is normal) 4. Add all the separated egg yolks into the bowl, and continue to use a spatula to mix in a "Z" shape. 5. At this time, the batter will become very fine and smooth, and it is not easy to produce gluten. Let it stand for later use. Whip egg whites: 1. Prepare the remaining 3/4 of the sugar. Divide into three portions, each portion is 1/4 of the total amount. 2. Add lemon juice or white vinegar to the egg whites (optional) 3. Beat the egg whites at medium speed until there are thick bubbles, add the first portion of sugar. 4. Beat the egg whites at high speed until the bubbles are finer, add the second portion of sugar. 5. Beat the egg whites at high speed until "wet foam" is formed, add the third portion of sugar. Visual characteristics: Lift the whisk head, and the meringue will bring out a long and downward-curved sharp corner (commonly known as a big curved hook). This state is suitable for making cake rolls. 6. Beat the egg whites at medium to low speed with a whisk to a "dry foam" state. Visual characteristics: Lift the whisk head, and the meringue will have short, upright and strong sharp corners (commonly known as small straight points); turn the container upside down, and the meringue will stick firmly to the bottom of the basin and will not slip at all. This is the standard state required to make chiffon cake. 7. At this point, the egg whites have been whipped to the required level * Please refer to the picture in the attached link to determine the state of the egg whites. ) * The egg beater should be as close to the bottom of the container as possible to prevent the floating surface layer from being whipped and the bottom still being liquid) Mixing and mixing: 1. Simply stir the egg yolk liquid a few times 2. Use a spatula to take 1/3 of the meringue and add it to the egg yolk paste 3. Use the "turning" technique, this method is to avoid defoaming * The mixing technique is * first use the right hand to hold the spatula from the center of the mixing bowl and insert it into the bottom of the batter * to Scrape it at 8 o'clock until it hits the wall of the basin, scoop up the batter and lift it into the air, then move it back to the center of the basin and put the batter into the basin * Hold the mixing bowl with your left hand from 9 o'clock to 7 o'clock, rotate it exactly 60 degrees, and complete a cycle * The speed is about two times per second * This method comes from "Ms. Kojima's Cake Classroom". To put it in down-to-earth terms, stir-fry like stir-fry. 4. Pour 1/3 of the mixture of meringue and egg yolk liquid into the remaining 2/3 of the meringue, and continue to mix evenly. 5. Pour the cake batter into the mold, shake a few times to avoid large bubbles. Baking: 1. Total baking time: 30-35 minutes for a 6-inch cake, 50 minutes for an 8-inch cake. Flexibly adjust according to the characteristics of your own oven, generally no more than $\pm 5$ minutes. (You can observe in front of the oven during the last few minutes) 2. Preheat and bake the upper tube at 150 degrees Celsius and the lower tube at 160 degrees Celsius. It will take about 10 minutes to reach the predetermined temperature. 3. After preheating is completed, place the mold into the lower shelf of the oven. 4. Select variable temperature baking, which is divided into two stages. * The first stage oven setting temperature is: 150 degrees Celsius for the upper tube and 160 degrees Celsius for the lower tube; * The first 3/5 of the total baking time is the first stage of baking * The second stage temperature is: 160 degrees Celsius for the upper tube and 170 degrees Celsius for the lower tube; * The last 2/5 of the total baking time is the second stage of baking. Simply adjust the oven temperature to switch. 5. After baking, take it out of the oven * This operation may be hot, please use a towel to assist. Special operation guide for air fryer (taking 6-inch as an example): The air fryer has extremely strong hot air circulation and is very close to the heating tube, until...

Additional content: - Refer to the following tutorial, the instructions in the text are very detailed and have pictures for each step. At the same time, there is also an explanation of why a certain operation is done, the principles behind it, and an analysis of certain problems that arise: - In order to make this chiffon cake, a whole carton of eggs is used, so that we can say goodbye to concave bottoms and collapses - For chiffon cakes, beating the egg white is a secondary issue, the key is the temperature and time during baking. - Egg white containers can have water droplets, but egg yolk containers cannot. - Reason: Oil will affect the beating of egg whites. Egg whites are 85% water, and a little water droplets will not affect the beating. - The egg whites of particularly fresh eggs will be relatively hard. For hard egg whites, adding 15ml of water will help the egg whites to be beaten (the recipe of 1 egg is 3g of water) - The sugar added during the egg white beating process actually melts into the water in the egg whites first, forming a syrup solution that wraps around the bubbles and protects the beaten bubbles. - Temperature has a great influence on the rate and solubility of sugar in water. Egg whites just taken out of the refrigerator are not easy to beat. However, eggs with lower temperature are easy to separate the egg white and yolk. It is recommended to return to room temperature after separation before beating. - Some reference pictures
The egg white basin and egg beater must be free of water and oil. Add sugar to the egg whites in three batches, and beat until straight peaks appear when lifted.
When mixing, use a spatula to stir from the bottom, do not draw circles, and move briskly to avoid defoaming of the protein and causing the cake to collapse.

Immediately after taking it out of the oven, turn it upside down and let it cool before demolding it. Slice it after it is completely cooled. The structure will be more stable and will not stick to the knife.

Case: The night before my birthday, I divided the eggs according to the recipe, beat the egg whites until they were stiff and foamy, then mixed them with the egg yolk paste, baked them in the oven and then inverted them to cool. The slices did not shrink or collapse the next day. My friend said it looked like a bought sponge cake.

items.title: Tiramisu
items.core: This traditional Italian dessert does not require an oven. The cheese paste is dense and light, and the finger biscuits soaked in coffee liquid are mellow and soft. It is an entry-level dessert. Rich in protein and calcium, but high in sugar and calories, it should be enjoyed occasionally. It is easy to operate and is very friendly to novice bakers. It only takes about half an hour to start, and it can be refrigerated for another four hours before it can be shaped and tasted.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - mascarpone cheese - finger biscuits - cooled espresso - sterile eggs - white sugar - cocoa powder - rum (if you don't like alcohol, you can omit it and adjust it according to your own taste) - a container for the finished product (glass locks are used here) - egg beater (those with strong hands can also exercise their arm strength)
Calculation: - Mascarpone cheese 450g - 1 pack of finger biscuits - 350ml of cooled espresso - 4 sterile eggs - 50g of white sugar - 10g of cocoa powder - 35ml of rum

Operation: 1. Separate egg yolks and egg whites 2. Add 10g of white sugar to the bowl containing the egg whites and beat until wet 3. Add 40g of white sugar in three batches to the bowl of egg yolks, and stir until evenly 4. Add mascarpone cheese to the egg yolks in three batches and stir until even. 5. Add rum to the egg yolks at the end and stir evenly. 6. Add the beaten egg whites to the egg yolk cheese liquid in three batches. 7. Soak both sides of the finger biscuits in the coffee liquid and lay them flat in the container. 8. Place two layers of cheese liquid and two layers of biscuits in the container alternately (this step is handled according to your wishes and the height of the container). 9. Place it in the refrigerator for four hours (impatient friends can take it out earlier) 10. After taking it out, sift cocoa powder on the surface and enjoy
Additional content: - Specific tutorial on whipping egg whites in the kitchen
Dip finger biscuits in the coffee liquid for no more than two seconds on each side. If they are soaked too wet, the cake batter will become thinner and the layers will collapse.
Rewarm the mascarpone in advance and mix it with the egg yolk paste in batches to avoid clumping, so that the cheese paste will be dense and smooth.
After assembling, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least four hours. Sift the cocoa powder before eating to prevent clumping and moisture return.

Case: After a dinner party with friends, I made tiramisu for dessert. I quickly dipped finger biscuits in coffee liquid and layered them, then spread mascarpone paste and refrigerated it for four hours. The next day, I sifted cocoa powder and cut it into pieces. The layers were clear, and the aroma of coffee and milk were blended.

items.id: 无厨师机蜂蜜面包-无厨师机蜂蜜面包
items.title: Honey Bread without a chef machine
items.core: This is a home-made honey bun that does not require a chef machine. It is soft and sweet, with a slightly crispy bottom. The surface is brushed with honey water and sprinkled with sesame seeds, revealing a simple and sweet aroma. The main ingredients are high-gluten flour, milk, eggs and butter, which provide sufficient carbohydrates, protein and calcium, making it a safe breakfast or snack. The method is simple, the whole process is kneaded by hand, and the fermentation time is flexible. You can even put it in the refrigerator one night in advance and bake it the next day, which is very friendly to novices. It takes about 3 hours to make, most of which is waiting time for the dough to rise, and the actual work is not strenuous.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: Bread body - High-gluten flour: 400g - Milk: 200g - Yeast: 4g - Egg: 1 - White sugar: 70g - Salt: 2g - Butter: 30g honey water (spread on top) - Honey: 20g - Water: 20g optional (sprinkle on top) - Sesame

Calculation: When baking the following ingredients, use a rectangular baking pan (10 x 15 inches (approximately 25 x 38 cm)) + a square baking pan (9 × 9 inches (approximately 23 × 23 cm)) + oil paper. It is recommended to reduce the dosage according to needs. Each breakfast can be eaten for about two weeks (stored in the refrigerator). It will become hard when stored in the refrigerator. It can be heated in the microwave for 10-20 seconds.

Operation: 1. Make dough: Mix flour, milk (recommended to heat to 40°, I use microwave for 15-20s), yeast, eggs, flour, sugar and salt. 2. Stir the dough and mix the ingredients evenly into a ball. 3. Add butter and mix. 4. Continue stirring + kneading by hand to mix evenly. 5. Start proofing, cover the container with plastic wrap, and leave it at normal temperature (10 - 20°) for 1 - 2 hours. A longer time will have little effect on the effect. 6. When you can obviously see that the dough has fermented and increased in size (2 times), you can start cutting the dough. At this time, the dough should no longer be very sticky. 7. Cut the dough into pieces: ideally each portion should be 60g (good looking), you can adjust the size according to your preference. 8. Use a rolling pin to roll each small piece of dough into a tongue shape, then roll it up and let it rest again 10. 9. Use the rolling pin again to roll it into a tongue shape, roll it up, and cut it from the middle (one becomes two). 10. Use the rolling pin again to roll it into a tongue shape, roll it up, and cut it from the middle (two becomes four). (You can roll/roll this step several times according to your own time, just control the size of one portion) 11. Place oil paper on the baking sheet and pour peanut oil. Dip the bottom of each rolled portion with water + flour and place it on the baking sheet. 12. Let it rise again (cover it with plastic wrap). You can put it in the refrigerator and bake it the next day. 13. Brush with egg wash. 14. Oven at 180°(355°F), 18 - 20 minutes. 15. After taking it out of the oven, brush it with honey water and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

Additional content: - The fermentation time is not fixed. Just check it every hour to confirm. It will suffice if the dough is obviously fermented and enlarged. It is recommended to ferment 2 - 2.5 times in size. - The size of the dough will not significantly affect the taste and baking effect and can be adjusted according to preference. - Reference: Go to the Kitchen - Crispy Honey Buns
Knead the dough until a thick film can be pulled out. Add butter in batches and knead evenly before performing basic fermentation.
The refrigerated fermentation can be completed one night in advance, and the next day it can be warmed for 30 minutes before shaping, and the operation will be less sticky.
Brush twice with honey water and sprinkle sesame seeds immediately after brushing. The aroma will be more obvious and will not fall off easily when baking.

Case study: On Sunday morning, I didn’t use a kitchen machine. I kneaded the dough by hand until it was smooth and refrigerated it to ferment overnight. The next day, I took it out and shaped it, brushed it with honey water and sprinkled it with sesame seeds. The baked bun was soft and stringy, with a slightly crispy bottom. My family quickly ate it for breakfast.

items.title: Fried Milk
items.core: Fried Milk is a dessert with a crispy shell and soft filling. The preparation itself is not difficult, but the milk paste must be fully heated and refrigerated to set, otherwise it will easily fall apart when cut into pieces and fried. The actual operation takes about 30 minutes and requires at least 2 hours of refrigeration to set.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Milk - Cornstarch - Cake flour or plain flour - Bread crumbs - Eggs - White sugar - Heat-resistant square container about 20cm × 15cm - Kitchen paper

Calculation: The following amounts can make about 12 pieces of fried milk, suitable for 3 - 4 people. - Milk 250ml - Cornstarch 30g - White sugar 25g - Low-gluten flour or plain flour 40g - 1 egg, about 50g after shelling - Breadcrumbs 80g - Edible oil 700ml, the actual consumption will be less than this value

Operation: 1. Take 80ml from the milk, mix with cornstarch, and stir until there are no visible particles 2. Mix the remaining 170ml Pour the milk and sugar into the pot, heat over low heat and continue stirring until the sugar is completely dissolved. 3. Stir the cornstarch liquid again, slowly pour it into the pot while continuing to stir. 4. Keep heating over low heat and stirring continuously for about 3 - 5 minutes, until the milk paste is thick and the lines left after scraping the bottom of the pot can remain for 3 seconds. 5. Evenly apply about 2ml of cooking oil on the inner wall of the heat-resistant container, pour the milk paste and smooth the surface to make the thickness of the milk paste about 2cm. 6. After the milk paste has cooled to room temperature, cover it and place it in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours; take it out when the surface is not sticky and the whole body does not flow. 7. Unmold the shaped milk paste and cut it into strips of about 6cm × 2cm × 2cm, a total of about 12 strips. 8. Put the flour, beaten egg liquid and bread crumbs into 3 containers respectively 9. Coat each milk bar evenly with flour, egg liquid and bread crumbs, ensuring that all sides are covered. 10. Pour 700ml cooking oil into the pot and heat to 165 - 175°C over medium heat; if there is no thermometer, you can put in a small amount of bread crumbs to test. The bread crumbs should float within 2 seconds and continue to make small bubbles. 11. Put the milk bars into the oil in 2 - 3 batches, and fry each batch for about 60 - 90 Seconds; flip 1-2 times during this period to ensure that all sides are evenly heated. 12. When the surface of the milk bar is evenly golden, take it out, place it on kitchen paper to drain for about 2 minutes and then eat it

Additional content: - Cornstarch sinks to the bottom easily, and must be stirred again before pouring into the pot. - Putting too many milk bars in at one time will cause the oil temperature to drop quickly, causing the shell to absorb oil and easily break. - The temperature of the freshly fried milk filling is relatively high. You should break it in the middle to dissipate the heat before eating to avoid burns. - Reference: Wang Gang’s teaching video
The milk paste should be stirred continuously over low heat until it can catch the spatula and is not easy to flow. Let it cool and then refrigerate it to set.
Do not cook it after refrigeration for less than two hours. After cutting into pieces, you can coat it with a layer of cornstarch to help make the outside crispier.

Control the oil temperature to 60% hot, and fry in batches for a short period of time until light golden brown, to avoid external burnt internalization or oil splashing when the oil temperature is too high.

Case study: When I made fried fresh milk for the first time, I fried the milk paste over low heat until it became thick and refrigerated it for two hours. I cut it into pieces and coated it with starch and egg liquid and put it in the pot. The outer shell turned golden quickly, but the inside was still tender and smooth, and it was not scattered into a paste. It was eaten up quickly when it was served.
