items.title: Oven version of Basque cheesecake
items.core: Basque cheesecake is a dessert with a rich and dense texture, a charred surface and a moist interior. It is a classic flavor of the Basque region in Spain. The main raw materials are cream cheese and eggs, which are rich in high-quality protein and calcium. The production process is very simple and can be easily mastered by novices. It only takes about 30 minutes from prep to out of the oven, but it is recommended to refrigerate overnight before serving, taking about 8+ hours in total.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Cream cheese: 212g (this is the mass of a piece, it is more convenient, the original tutorial is 250g) - White sugar: 60g - Eggs: 2 - Egg yolk: 1 - Whipped cream: 120g - Low-gluten flour: 10g optional (chocolate flavor) - Chocolate: 38g (I have only tried to melt ordinary chocolate, add the whipping cream and stir evenly)
Calculation: Use a 7-inch round mold when baking the following ingredients, and the original tutorial uses a 6-inch round mold.

Operation: 1. Soften the cream cheese and microwave for 10s + 10s. 2. Add sugar to the cream cheese and beat with a whisk until smooth. 3. Add 2 whole eggs + 1 egg yolk and mix well. 4. Add light cream and stir evenly. 5. Add low-gluten flour and stir evenly. 6. Oven at 220°(425°F) for 20 - 25 minutes (I usually use 20 or 22 minutes). 7. Let cool and then put it in the refrigerator, preferably overnight.

Additional content: - It is normal for the finished product to shake when it comes out of the oven. The taste will not be the best after cooling. It must be refrigerated to taste! - Reference: Go to the Kitchen - Basque Cheesecake "The Simplest Cake" Zero Failure🔥Cheese Control
The cream cheese is softened at room temperature in advance, and mixed with the eggs in batches. The batter will be more delicate and grain-free after sifting.
The mold is lined with baking paper and raised above the edge, so that the whole piece can be easily lifted after refrigeration, and the skin will not break easily when cutting into pieces.
Bake the surface until dark brown and take it out of the oven. The center will shake slightly and the taste will be more stable after being refrigerated overnight.

Case study: When a friend came over temporarily, I mixed the cream cheese, eggs and sugar and poured them into paper-lined molds. I baked them at a high temperature to get a burnt surface and refrigerated them overnight before cutting them. The inside was moist and dense, and it was just enough to be eaten with black coffee without feeling greasy.

items.title: Baked Egg Tart
items.core: Baked egg tart is a classic Chinese dessert with crispy outer skin, tender filling and rich milky aroma. Rich in protein, calcium and multiple vitamins, it can provide abundant energy. The production process is very simple, and even novices can easily get started, and the semi-finished product can be frozen and stored for eating at any time. From prep to out of the oven, it takes about 1 hour.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: This formula is the amount required for the whole package of egg tart shells. It can be frozen and stored directly after filling - Egg tart crust is not limited to the brand - Eggs - Milk - Whipping cream - White sugar - Oven. No size limit - Gram scale - Mixer Including but not limited to chopsticks Egg beater and other tools - Sieve Mesh mesh is about 1 mm

Calculation: Per portion: This formula is the amount required for the entire package of egg tart crusts It can be frozen and stored directly after filling - the brand of tart crust is not limited. The whole package of tart crust is about 30 pieces - 8 eggs, ordinary eggs are enough - milk 200 ml, ordinary bagged milk is enough - whipping cream 450 ml, available in bakeries or supermarkets - 80 grams of white sugar, ordinary sugar is enough, fine sugar is better, easy to melt

Operation: 1. Place the bowl on the gram scale and weigh it 450 grams of light cream (the density of light cream is recorded as 1 here) 2. Add 80 grams of white sugar (medium sweetness, which can be increased or decreased according to personal taste, the recommended range is 60-100 grams) 3. Add 200 grams of milk (the density of milk is recorded as 1 here) 4. Take 8 egg yolks and add them. The egg whites can be reserved for other uses. 5. Stir all ingredients evenly until the sugar is completely melted 6. Use a mesh sieve to filter the mixed ingredients. Filter out the egg mucous membrane, egg shells, unmelted white sugar, and clumped whipping cream. 7. At this time, please set the oven to 220 degrees Celsius and start preheating (about 10 minutes). Remember to take out the baking tray. 8. Place the egg tart shells evenly on the baking tray at 0.5 cm intervals. 9. Pour the filtered ingredients into the egg tart shell. The liquid level should be 0.5 cm away from the upper edge of the egg tart shell. It should not be too much. 10. At this step, the preparation of the semi-finished egg tarts has been completed. It can be directly placed in the refrigerator for quick freezing and stored for more than 12 hours. 11. Place the semi-finished egg tarts in the oven for baking at a temperature of 200 degrees Celsius for 25 minutes. 12. It can be eaten after baking
Additional content: Please be careful of the high temperature of the oven when operating Prevent burns
There is no need to defrost the frozen tart crust, just place it on a plate and pour the egg milk liquid directly into it, which can reduce softening, leakage and deformation.
Sift the egg milk twice and pour it eight-tenths full. The surface will be more delicate after baking and it will not easily overflow and stain the tart crust.
Bake for the last two minutes and observe the coloring. Cover with tin foil if burnt spots appear to keep the tart surface evenly golden.

Case: My children ordered egg tarts on weekends. I took out the frozen tart shells from the refrigerator, poured in the prepared egg milk and baked them for 20 minutes. When they came out of the oven, the outer shell was layered and crispy, and the filling was tender and creamy. I baked twelve pieces at a time and divided them all.

items.title: Margarita biscuits
items.core: Margarita biscuits have a crispy texture and rich butter aroma. They are a classic Western dessert. It is mainly made of egg yolks, butter and flour. It is rich in carbohydrates and fats and can quickly replenish energy. It is moderately difficult to make and takes about 45 minutes from preparation to baking, making it easy for novices to get started.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Cooked egg yolks - Butter - White sugar - Salt - Cake flour - Cornstarch - Oven

Calculation: In view of the high calorie content of this small dessert, you need to determine how many servings to make before each production. One serving is just enough for one person. Each serving: - 1 cooked egg yolk - 50g butter - 20g white sugar - 1g salt - 50g low-gluten flour - 50g cornstarch

Operation: 1. Melt the butter over hot water and grind the egg yolks and set aside. 2. Add sugar, salt, and crushed egg yolk to the melted butter, mix well. 3. Add low-gluten flour and cornstarch, and knead into a dough. 4. Divide the dough evenly into small pieces weighing about 8 grams, and then roll them into balls. 5. Using your thumb, press lightly onto each dough ball to create cracks. 6. Preheat the oven to 150°C, place the small dough in the oven and bake for 20 minutes. 7. Allow to cool slightly before serving

Additional content: - You can fine-tune the ratio of salt to sugar according to your personal taste. If you like other flavors, you can replace the 3 grams of cornstarch per serving with cocoa powder or matcha powder. - If conditions permit, you can sift egg yolks, low-gluten flour and other ingredients to taste better. - Due to the difficulty in obtaining the material, I chose white sugar. If conditions permit, I can replace it with 30 grams of powdered sugar. - If you don’t have an oven, you can use a microwave oven, an air fryer, etc. The microwave is set to high heat for 2-3 minutes, and the air fryer is set to 150°C for 20 minutes. - Reference: The 100th mailable cookie, crispy and glutinous that melts in your mouth~-Bilibili
The egg yolks should be cooked and pressed very finely, and it is best to sift and add them, so that the finished product will have a delicate texture and will not have a grainy feel.
The butter should be softened until you can press it with your fingers. Over-beating will cause the biscuits to spread too much and make the pattern unclear.
Refrigerate the dough for twenty minutes before dividing into balls. The cracks will be more natural when flattened, and the shape will be more complete after baking.
Case study: At afternoon tea time, I crushed the cooked egg yolks and mixed them into the butter dough. I divided them into small balls and pressed them with my thumbs to make cracks.

items.title: Red Pomelo Cake
items.core: Red Pomelo Cake is a refreshing dessert that can be easily made with an air fryer. It combines the slightly sour fruity aroma of red grapefruit pieces with the soft texture of the cake. It is suitable for a single afternoon tea. Eggs and flour provide protein and carbohydrates, and red grapefruit is rich in vitamin C, providing simple basic nutrition. The difficulty of making it is medium. The key is to stir it into a light yellow batter without particles. Novices can succeed as long as they follow the steps patiently. It takes about 35 minutes from prep to serving, so it won’t take up too much time when you’re craving a freshly baked dessert.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Air fryer - Eggs - Red grapefruit pulp - Flour - Tinfoil plate - Oil - Sugar - Water

Calculation: One serving is for one person. For multiple people, please increase the amount of ingredients in equal proportions. In this example, the diameter of the tinfoil plate is 18 cm. If you use a larger tinfoil plate, please also increase the amount of ingredients in equal proportions. One serving: - 2 eggs - 80g flour - 20g red grapefruit pulp - 15ml oil - 80ml water - 15g sugar

Operation: 1. Crack 2 eggs into the tinfoil plate, add 20g red grapefruit pulp 2. Pour 15ml oil into the tinfoil plate and shake the tinfoil plate to evenly cover the bottom of the plate 3. Put 10g sugar in the tinfoil plate, And 40g flour and 40ml water 4. Use chopsticks to stir clockwise until it becomes a light yellow paste. 5. Put 5g sugar, 40g flour and 40ml water in the tin foil plate. 6. Continue to stir with chopsticks until it becomes a light yellow paste. 7. Place the tin foil plate on the baking basket of the air fryer and bake at 180 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes. 8. Open the air fryer, carefully remove the tin foil plate, and turn the cake over with chopsticks or a spoon. 9. Continue to bake at 180 degrees Celsius for 8 minutes. 10. Take it out and serve

Additional content: - If you like a sweeter taste, you can add 10g of sugar - Red grapefruit pulp can be added as appropriate, but it is best not to exceed 40g per portion so as not to affect the appearance of the finished product - Pasty means there are no flour lumps and the overall color is uniform - The tinfoil plate that has just come out of the pot is relatively hot, so please use tongs or an insulating material such as a wet rag to handle it
Drain the water from the red pomelo pulp first, and then mix it into the batter to avoid water from making the cake tissue wet and collapse.
The batter should be stirred in batches until there are no particles and the color is light yellow, then stir in the meringue to reduce defoaming.
Preheat the air fryer in advance and observe the coloring halfway. If the surface becomes darker too quickly, cover it with tin foil and continue baking.

Case: I wanted to have a refreshing dessert in the afternoon, so I mixed the red pomelo pulp into the egg yolk paste, then added the meringue in batches, and baked it in an air fryer for 30 minutes. When it came out of the pan, the aroma was obvious, the cake was soft and not dry, and it was just enough to satisfy my craving for a single serving.

items.title: Carrot Sweet Cake
items.core: Carrot Sweet Cake is a well-known winter dessert in India. Shredded carrots and milk are slowly simmered and concentrated, and mixed with ghee and nuts. It has a dense and sweet taste and a golden color. Rich in carotene, calcium and high-quality fat, it warms and nourishes the body. The production process is simple, but requires some patience for novices, and the whole process takes about 45 minutes to complete.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Carrots (red carrots are recommended) - Whole milk - Sugar - Ghee - Butter can be substituted - Cardamom Powder - Cashew nuts - Almonds - Raisins - Grater - Thick-bottomed pot

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many portions you plan to make. One serving is just enough for 3-4 people. Per portion: - 500g carrots (about 5-6 medium-sized ones) - 500ml whole milk - 80g sugar (can be adjusted to 60g-100g according to personal taste) - 40g ghee - 3g cardamom powder - 15g cashews - 15g almonds - 15g raisins

Operation: 1. Peel the carrots and grate them into thin strips with a grater 2. Pour 20g (half the amount) of ghee into a thick-bottomed pot and heat over medium heat to melt. 3. Add shredded carrots and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until the shredded carrots become soft and fragrant. 4. Pour in 500ml of whole milk and stir evenly. 5. Bring to a boil over high heat, then turn to medium to low heat and keep boiling slowly. 6. Keep stirring for 25-30 Minutes, until the milk is almost completely absorbed by the carrots and evaporates (this is the most critical step, patience and constant stirring are required to prevent the bottom from being mushy) 7. When there is almost no liquid in the pot, add 80g of sugar and stir evenly 8. After adding the sugar, the water will come out again, continue to stir-fry over medium-low heat for 5-8 minutes, until the water evaporates again 9. Add the remaining 20g of ghee and 3g of cardamom powder, and stir-fry for 2 minutes 10. In another small pan, fry the cashews, almond slices and raisins separately in a little ghee until golden (about 1 minute), taking care that the raisins will swell 11. Fold half of the fried nuts and raisins into the carrot sweet cake 12. Serve on a plate and sprinkle the remaining nuts and raisins over the surface for garnish

Additional content: - Carrot sweet cake can be eaten hot or cold, each with its own flavor. - Use red carrots to create a better color than orange carrots. - If you want a richer taste, you can replace part of the milk with whipped cream. - Stores airtight and refrigerated for 4-5 days. Microwave for 1 minute before serving. - This dessert is made in almost every family in India and is an essential dessert during Diwali and weddings.
Cut the carrots into thin strips and it is easier to cook them until they become softer and more flavorful. Adding the milk in two batches can reduce the paste and maintain the milky aroma.
Simmer over low heat and stir constantly until the milk is obviously thickened and can hang on the back of a spoon, then turn off the heat.
Ghee and nuts are added in the last ten minutes to make the aroma more prominent and the nuts to retain a bit of crunch.

Case: It was a bit cold at home on a winter night, so I simmered shredded carrots and milk over low heat, added ghee, sugar and cashews and continued to simmer until thickened. After serving in a bowl, I sprinkled pistachios on it. It was sweet and dense in the mouth, and my palms were warm after eating.

items.id: 芋泥雪媚娘-芋泥雪媚娘
items.title: Taro Snow Meiniang
items.core: Taro Snow Meiniang has a soft and chewy outer skin, and the filling is delicate and sweet taro puree and light cream. It has a rich texture and is a Chinese dessert inspired by home-cooked creativity. Taro and purple sweet potato provide dietary fiber and anthocyanins, while milk and light cream supplement calcium and provide balanced nutrition. No oven is required to make it, the steps are simple, and it is friendly to novices. Even if you are not good at baking, you can easily complete it. It takes about two hours from start to finish to make homemade snacks that your kids will love.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Lipu taro (can be bought on e-commerce platform, affordable and fresh) - Purple sweet potato flour - Milk - Glutinous rice flour - Corn starch - Butter - Whipped cream - White sugar - Cooking mixer (electric egg beater is also acceptable) - Sieve - Plastic wrap - White sugar

Calculation: - Lipu taro 200g - Purple sweet potato flour 3g - Milk 165g - Glutinous rice flour a 50g - Glutinous rice flour b 75g - Corn starch 22g - Butter 30g - Whipping cream (Anjia is recommended) 145g - White sugar 26g

Operation: 1. Cut the taro into pieces, cook over high heat until soft (40 minutes), and put it all into a food processor 2. Add 30g of milk, 25g Whip the cream and beat it into a puree. 3. Add 3g of purple sweet potato flour and 18g of white sugar, and continue to stir until it becomes a fine taro paste. 4. Take out another bowl, add all the glutinous rice flour b, 22g of corn starch, 135g of milk, 50g of white sugar, mix and sift once, cover with plastic wrap and make small holes, and steam over medium heat for half an hour. 5. During the steaming process, put the glutinous rice flour a into a pan and stir-fry over low heat until it turns slightly yellow (that is, stir-fry), and use it as hand flour. 6. Add 30g of butter to the glutinous rice-milk mixture (jelly-like) that has been steamed for half an hour over medium heat, knead the butter until the dough is completely absorbed, and then put it in the refrigerator for one hour. 7. Take out another bowl and add 120g of light cream, 8g Whisk white sugar until it has texture, put it into a piping bag and set aside. 8. Take out the refrigerated dough, knead it for 5 minutes, divide it into 30g pieces, sprinkle 2g hand flour evenly to prevent sticking, roll it into a round shape, first squeeze 5g piping cream, then put 30g taro paste, and finally wrap the dough like a bun (excess skin can be subtracted) 9. After wrapping, sprinkle evenly 2g hand powder to prevent sticking 10. Repeat the above two steps until the raw materials are used up
Additional content: - It is best to wear non-stick gloves when making - You can eat it after making, no need to reheat
After the snow meiniang skin is steamed, stir in sugar and butter while it's still hot, let it cool and then knead it. The surface will be smoother and less sticky to your hands.
Add a small amount of milk and sugar to the taro paste and fry until it forms a ball. Let it cool before wrapping it to prevent the heat from melting the butter.
After wrapping, sprinkle with cooked glutinous rice flour to prevent sticking, and refrigerate for an hour before eating. The outer skin will be more elastic and the filling will not collapse easily.

Case: My child wanted to eat glutinous chichi snacks after school. I steamed taro and purple sweet potato and pressed them into puree. Then I wrapped them in snow meiniang skin and added butter to refrigerate them for an hour. After biting into them, the outer skin was soft and glutinous, and the filling was dense. The child said it felt more at ease than the ones bought outside.

items.title: British scone
items.core: British scone is a classic British afternoon tea snack. It is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. It has a rich custard aroma and is better eaten with jam or cream. It is mainly made of flour, butter, eggs and whipping cream. It is rich in carbohydrates and protein and can quickly replenish energy. The production process is relatively simple. As long as you master the basic kneading techniques, even a novice can do it. It takes about an hour from preparation to delivery.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: - Unsalted butter (recommended brand President) - Cake flour - Sugar - Salt - Baking powder - Eggs - Light cream - Cream cheese (optional)

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings you plan to make. One serving is just enough to feed 4-6 people. Each serving: - 40g unsalted butter - 180g low-gluten flour - 30g sugar - 1g salt - 5g baking powder - 1 egg (about 50g) - 45g light cream - 50g cream cheese

Operation: 1. Beat the eggs, weigh out 30g of egg liquid and put it into a clean container, add all the light cream and cream cheese and mix evenly. If the cheese is too hard, heat it in a water bath to about 40 degrees before mixing. 2. Put the low-gluten flour, salt, sugar, and baking powder into a clean container and mix well. 3. Cut the butter into small pieces and add it to the mixture in the previous step. Knead the butter into the mixture with your hands to make it have the texture of coarse cornmeal. 4. Pour the egg-milk mixture from the first step into the powder-oil mixture obtained from the previous step, and stir until the mixture is evenly combined. Stack the dough into a uniform dough. 5. Place the dough on the chopping board, roll it out into a 1.5cm thick sheet, and cut it into appropriate shapes with a knife or mold. 6. Dip the remaining 20g egg liquid with a brush and brush it on the surface of the scone. 7. Preheat the oven to 180 degrees and bake for 27 minutes
Additional content: - The simplest cutting method is to roll the dough into a round shape and cut it into 6 pieces with a knife fan shape
Keep the butter in a refrigerated state, cut it into pieces and quickly rub it into the flour. The thickness of the particles will be retained, and it will become crispier after baking.
Add the egg milk in batches and stop as soon as it forms a dough. Do not knead the dough repeatedly to prevent the scones from becoming hard due to excessive gluten.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about two centimeters, brush the surface with egg wash before baking, serve hot and serve with jam or clotted cream.

Case: On the weekend afternoon, Xiaolin cut the refrigerated butter into the flour, gently kneaded it into coarse sand, added the egg milk and pressed it into a ball, and baked it for twenty minutes. After taking it out, it was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. It was very popular with friends with strawberry jam.

items.id: 草莓冰淇淋-草莓冰淇淋
items.title: Strawberry Ice Cream
items.core: This is a home-made strawberry ice cream that can be easily made without a blender. It has a rich fruity aroma and a dense texture. Strawberries are rich in vitamin C and paired with the creamy condensed milk and cream, they provide energy and calcium. The method is simple and does not test your cooking skills, and even a novice can succeed in the first try. The entire production process takes about eight hours, most of which is freezing time, and the actual work only takes a few dozen minutes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Sweetened condensed milk - Strawberries - Heavy cream - Vanilla extract - Ice cream mold (optional)

Calculation: one serving: - Strawberry syrup: - 500 g strawberries - 45 g caster sugar - 1 g vanilla extract - 1 g table salt - Ice cream base: - 5 g vanilla extract - 1 g table salt - 6 g heavy cream - Sweetened condensed milk 400 g

Operation: 1. Make the strawberry syrup first. Wash the strawberries and remove the top leaves. Cut the strawberries into 5mm pieces. Reserve half of the chopped strawberries to fold into the ice cream later. 2. Add the other half of the chopped strawberries to the sauce pan along with the sugar. Stir and cook over medium heat until the strawberries release their liquid and form a syrup in the pan. 3. Let the strawberries heat in the syrup, stirring occasionally, until they break down and lose their shape and the syrup thickens slightly. 4. The syrup is ready when it remains separated for 3 seconds. Remove the syrup from the heat and stir in the vanilla and salt. Set the strawberry syrup aside to cool. 5. While the syrup is cooling, prepare the ice cream base. Add sweetened condensed milk, heavy cream, vanilla extract and salt to a bowl. Use a hand mixer to beat the mixture until it is light and fluffy and forms soft peaks. 6. Fold the reserved chopped fresh strawberries into the ice cream base. Transfer the uncooked ice cream base to a freezer-safe container. Drizzle the cooled strawberry syrup over the ice cream and gently swirl it into the mixture. 7. Cover and freeze the ice cream for eight hours, then scoop and serve.
Additional content: - Pay attention to safety during the production process and avoid cutting/burning your hands.
Wash the strawberries, remove the stems, and press into a fine paste. If you like a grainy texture, you can keep the small fruit pieces, but the water must be drained.
Beat the whipped cream until clear lines appear, and mix evenly with the strawberry condensed milk to avoid excessive defoaming.
Put the mixed liquid in a shallow box and freeze it. You can take it out and fluff it once in the first two hours. The finished product will taste denser and not ice-hard.

Case: On a summer evening, Amin mixed the strawberry puree with condensed milk and light cream, poured it into a sealed box and froze it overnight. The next day, he scooped out ball-shaped ice cream. The fruity aroma was obvious, and his children happily ate it as a weekend dessert.

items.id: 酸奶意式奶冻-酸奶意式奶冻
items.title: Yogurt Panna Cotta
items.core: A classic Italian dessert that has been improved upon. After incorporating original yogurt, the taste becomes more refreshing and smooth, sweet but not greasy. It is suitable as an after-dinner snack with fruit or jam. Dairy products are rich in calcium and protein and are mildly nutritious. The preparation steps are simple, just heat, stir and refrigerate to set. Even novices can get started smoothly. It takes about 5 hours from preparation to refrigeration.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - whipping cream - sugar - plain yogurt - gelatine sheets - sieve

Calculation: Before each production, you need to determine how many servings to make. One serving is just enough to feed 3-6 people. Each serving: - 200g whipping cream - 40g sugar - 250g original yogurt - 6g gelatine sheets

Operation: 1. Cut the gelatine sheets into small pieces and soak them in cold water 2. Put the whipping cream and sugar in the pot and heat to 60 degrees 3. Turn off the heat, remove the gelatine from the water, drain the water, add it to the hot whipping cream, and stir evenly 4. Cool the whipping cream to 40 degrees degree, add plain yogurt, stir evenly 5. Pass the mixture obtained in the above steps through a sieve twice. 6. Divide into suitable containers and refrigerate for more than 4 hours

Additional content: - The traditional version of panna cotta only uses whipping cream, and has a larger amount of sugar, making it more sweet. This version has been improved and is less burdensome to eat.
Soak the gelatine tablets in ice water first, then squeeze out the water and add warm liquid. Excessive temperature will affect the solidification.
Choose thick and original yogurt, and wait until the milk liquid is cool enough to not be hot before mixing in. This can reduce the sourness and layering.
Pour into the mold and gently shake to remove air bubbles. Refrigerate for at least four hours. Apply a warm towel to the cup wall before demoulding.

Case: After the meal, Sister Chen soaked the gelatine slices until soft, then mixed them with the warm yogurt milk liquid, poured it into a small cup and refrigerated it for four hours. It condensed into a smooth custard, garnished with blueberries and honey. It had a refreshing taste, and everyone in the family said it was less greasy than the cream version.

items.title: Snowflake Crispy
items.core: Snowflake Crispy is a small dessert with a crispy, sweet and rich milky aroma. It is a simple and quick home-baking method, and is also suitable for boxing and giving as gifts. Because it contains butter, milk powder and mixed nuts, it provides rich energy and protein, but is high in calories and suitable for occasional enjoyment. It is moderately difficult to make and may be challenging for novices, but as long as you pay attention to the heat and mixing techniques, it usually only takes 30 minutes to complete.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: Tools: - Non-stick pan - Baking spatula (can be replaced with a spatula, be careful not to damage the non-stick coating) - Disposable plastic gloves - Snowflake/nougat mold - Rolling pin Ingredients: - Unsalted butter - Marshmallows - Whole milk powder - Mixed nuts (Three Squirrels Daily Nuts) - Biscuits (non-sandwich biscuits, Xiaoqifu is recommended or special biscuits for Snowflake Baking)
Calculation: per serving: - unsalted butter 20g - marshmallows 75g - whole milk powder 40g - mixed nuts 60g - biscuits 75g

Operation: 1. Cut biscuits larger than one yuan coin into small pieces 2. Add unsalted butter to the pot and heat over low heat until the unsalted butter is completely melted 3. Add marshmallows to the pot and use a spatula to stir until the marshmallows melt and evenly blend with the unsalted butter. 4. Add 20g of milk powder to the pot and stir with a spatula. Stir the milk powder and butter marshmallow mixture evenly and turn off the heat immediately. 5. Add all the prepared mixed nuts and biscuits to the pot while they are hot and stir with a spatula 6. After stirring until the temperature drops to a temperature that your hands can touch, put on plastic gloves once and rub the pot or pick it up and pull with both hands to disperse the biscuit mixed nuts and marshmallow butter milk powder mixture evenly. 7. Press the mixture of the above steps into the mold, compact the corners, flatten with a rolling pin, and use your hands to press the unfilled side into a straight edge. 8. Let cool at room temperature, remove from the mold after complete cooling, cut into pieces according to the pattern of the mold, or cut into the size you like, sprinkle with remaining milk powder, try to make every side of the snowflake cake covered with milk powder

Additional content: - The longer the marshmallow is heated, the harder the final product will be - Reference: [A small pot Internet celebrity strawberry "snowflake cake" ready in ten minutes - Bilibili】

Melt the sugar over low heat throughout the process, and remove from the heat immediately after the marshmallows are completely softened to avoid overheating and causing the finished product to become hard.
Saute the nuts in advance and keep the biscuits dry. Pour in and stir quickly so that each piece is evenly coated with toffee.
Put oiled paper on the plate and shape while it's hot. Cool completely before cutting into pieces. The cut surface will be neater and less likely to stick to the knife.

Case: Before the end of the year party, Xiao Xu melted the marshmallows and butter over low heat, poured in milk powder, biscuits and nuts, stirred quickly, flattened and cooled, then cut into small pieces, boxed them and sent them to colleagues. Everyone commented that they were crispy and milky.

items.title: Konjac Cake
items.core: Konjac Cake is a low-calorie, gluten-free dessert that uses erythritol instead of white sugar. It has a light and moist taste with a cocoa aroma, and is especially suitable for people who want to lose weight. It is rich in dietary fiber and protein and has a strong feeling of satiety. It’s a bit difficult to make, as you need to beat the egg whites and pay attention to the mixing techniques, but it only takes about half an hour in total, making it a quick and healthy baking option.
body: Necessary Ingredients and Tools: Tools: * Oven * Electric whisk * Metal cake mold (any shape) * Baking paper * Table knife (for folding and smoothing the cake batter) * Oven gloves * [optional] Egg separator Ingredients: * Eggs * Erythritol * Cocoa powder * Konjac powder * Cream of tartar
Calculation: Per serving (9.25 × 5 × 1 inches): * 3 eggs * Erythritol 50g * Cocoa powder 10g * Konjac powder 10g * Tartar powder 1g

Operation: Preheat the oven: 1. Before preparing the cake batter, you can start to preheat the oven to 350 ℉ (150 ℃) to save time. Preliminary separation operation: 1. Take out fresh eggs from the refrigerator 2. Prepare two containers and wipe them dry to hold egg whites and egg yolks respectively 3. There can be a little water droplets in the container for egg whites, but not any oil; there should be no water droplets in the container for egg yolks. 4. Beat the eggs, and separate the egg whites and egg yolks into two containers by hand or using an egg separator. 5. During the separation process, the egg yolk cannot be broken, and the egg white cannot be mixed with any egg yolk, otherwise it will seriously affect the beating. (The white ties can enter the egg white and will not affect it.) 6. (Note that when a kitchen machine is not used, the container holding the egg white is also the container for beating eggs. To avoid overflowing, do not exceed 1/8 of the container after adding all the egg whites) Beat the egg whites: 1. Add 1g of cream of tartar to the egg whites 2. Use the egg beater at high speed to beat the egg whites until they form thick bubbles, and add 50g erythritol 3. Use the whisk at medium-low speed to whip the egg whites to a dry foamy state (lift the whisk head, there will be a short upright sharp corner; turn the container upside down so that the egg whites can stick to the container and not fall off) 4. At this time, the egg whites have been beaten to meet the requirements * The egg beater should be as close to the bottom of the container as possible to prevent the floating surface layer from being whipped and the bottom is still liquid) Mix other ingredients: 1. Add the separated egg yolks to the beaten egg whites and mix evenly with the whisk at medium-low speed. 2. Add 10g cocoa powder and 10g konjac powder to the egg whites, and stir with a table knife first. This is because if you stir directly with a whisk, the powder will splash. 3. The mixing method is * first use the right hand to insert the spatula from the center of the mixing bowl to the bottom of the batter * scrape it in the 8 o'clock direction until it hits the wall of the bowl, scoop up the batter and lift it into the air, then move it back to the center of the bowl and put the batter into the bowl * Hold the mixing bowl with your left hand from Turn from 9 o'clock to 7 o'clock, rotate exactly 60 degrees, and complete 1 cycle * The speed is about 2 times per second * This method comes from "Ms. Kojima's Cake Classroom". To put it in down-to-earth terms, stir-fry like stir-fry. 4. After mixing, use a whisk to mix evenly at low speed. Bake: 1. Line the mold with baking paper and fit the bottom and inner wall. 2. Pour the cake batter into the mold, smooth it out with a table knife, and shake it a few times to avoid large bubbles. 3. Bake for 25 minutes. 4. After baking, take it out while wearing heat-resistant gloves. Cooling and demoulding: 1. (Optional) Drop the mold from a high place to shake out the heat. 2. Turn the mold upside down. Let the cake cool for 10 minutes * Immediately unmolding the cake that has not been cooled will damage the cake * This operation may be hot, so be careful to wear insulated gloves 3. Unmold and cut into pieces with a table knife
Additional content: * This recipe mainly refers to the video Keto Konjac Chocolate Cake｜Keto Cake * The whipped protein and other parts draw heavily on the chiffon cake making process
Konjac powder and cocoa powder are mixed first and then sieved to avoid clumping, and the finished product will have a more delicate and even texture.
Beat the egg whites until wet and stiff peaks form, then stir in the batter three times, moving briskly to reduce defoaming.
Erythritol can be dissolved with the liquid first. If it shrinks after baking, lower the oven temperature appropriately and extend the time next time.

Case: On the night of the fat loss period, Xiao Liu mixed konjac powder and cocoa powder, beat the egg whites and folded them into the mold in batches. After baking for 30 minutes, the dough became fluffy and moist. He cut it into two pieces for dessert. He felt full and unburdened.

items.title: Guiling Paste
items.core: Guiling Paste is a traditional Cantonese dessert with a tender and smooth taste, slightly bitter and sweet, and is often used as a summer snack to relieve the heat. Guiling paste can clear away heat and dampness, nourish yin and nourish the skin. It is a nutritious and healthy snack. The recipe is simple and can be easily mastered by novices. The whole process only requires preparing ingredients, stirring and heating, then refrigerate and wait for about two hours before enjoying.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - 25 grams of Guiling paste powder - 120 ml of cold water - 500 ml of boiling water - 100 grams of white sugar - small pot - mixing tool - mold or bowl
Calculation: Each time you make about 3-4 small bowls of finished product, suitable for 2-4 people.

Operation: 1. Pour 25 grams of Guiling paste powder and 120 ml of cold water into the pot, and stir thoroughly until there is no graininess. 2. Add 100 grams of white sugar to another container, pour 500 ml of boiling water, and stir until the sugar is completely dissolved. 3. Slowly pour the sugar water into the Guilinggao powder and stir evenly immediately to avoid clumping. 4. Put the mixed liquid into the pot, maintain medium-low heat while heating, and stir continuously to prevent sticking. 5. Heat until the liquid becomes thick and starts to bubble, then turn off the heat. 6. Quickly pour the liquid into the mold and let it cool and solidify naturally. It is recommended to refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours before eating for a better taste.

Additional content: - Do not move the container at will during the cooling process of Guiling paste, otherwise it may affect the molding. - Avoid using high heat when heating to prevent clumping or burning. - You can add honey, condensed milk or fruit according to your personal taste. - The concentration of Guiling paste powder varies slightly among different brands. It is recommended to adjust the ratio according to the packaging instructions.
Guiling paste powder is first mixed with a small amount of cold water into a particle-free paste, and then poured into boiling water to reduce agglomeration.
While heating, continue stirring in the same direction and cook until the liquid is slightly thickened and bubbling to prevent the paste from becoming bitter.
It will be easier to cut into pieces after refrigeration. Honey or coconut milk can be used for seasoning. If the taste is slightly bitter, add less syrup.

Case: In the afternoon of the dog days, Aunt Wang mixed the Guiling ointment with a powder-to-water ratio, cooked it over low heat until smooth, poured it into a bowl and refrigerated it for two hours, then cut it into pieces and added honey and coconut milk.

items.title: Shanxi Fried Tomato Sauce
items.core: Shanxi Fried Tomato Sauce is a homemade topping suitable for noodles such as knife-shaped noodles and hand-rolled noodles. Tomatoes contain lycopene, vitamins and dietary fiber. This recipe comes from an actual method that has been used repeatedly by Shanxi families for a long time. By peeling, stir-frying and pressing, the tomato pulp forms a thick sauce. It is relatively easy to make and is expected to take 20 to 30 minutes, depending on the ripeness and juice production of the tomatoes.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Tomatoes - Onions - Garlic - Light soy sauce - Salt - Chicken essence - Heat-resistant container for boiling water to peel - Slotted spoon - Hard frying spoon for stir-frying and pressing tomatoes. For ordinary uncoated woks, you can use wooden, stainless steel or high-temperature-resistant hard silicone frying spoons; for non-stick pans, it is recommended to use high-temperature hard silicone frying spoons to avoid damaging the coating.

Calculation: The following is the amount of raw materials required to make a pot of tomato sauce: - 2 to 3 tomatoes, a single reference weight of about 150 to 200 g, a total of about 300 to 600 g. - A piece of green onion about 2 cm long. - Half a clove of garlic, about the size of a fingernail. - Edible oil 15~20 ml. - Light soy sauce 7~10 ml. - 2~3 g of table salt. - Chicken essence is about 1 g, please refer to the estimated value. - Starting from 0 ml of clean water, add 5 to 10 ml each time when water is lacking. - About 1 to 2 L of boiling water is used to soak the tomatoes, as long as the tomatoes can be submerged. Measuring instructions: - For tomatoes, it is recommended to choose larger mature fruits. For individual sizes, please refer to the large Orion pie. 300~600 g is a reference range based on the specifications of common large-fruit tomatoes, not the actual weighing value. - When making at home, use the same small salt spoon for salt and chicken essence. Each flat spoon can hold about 2 g of salt. - The household dosage of table salt is 1 to 1.5 level spoons, about 2 to 3 g. - The household dosage of chicken essence is about 70% to 90% of the capacity of the same small salt spoon. Due to the different particle sizes and densities of chicken essence and table salt, approximately 1 g is only for conversion reference and has not been verified by weighing. - Both chicken essence and light soy sauce contain a certain amount of salt, so the salt should be added in batches and adjusted according to the actual saltiness. - Estimated calories are based on 450 g tomatoes, 17.5 ml cooking oil and remaining seasonings, and are approximate for the entire pot of sauce, excluding accompanying pasta.

Operation: 1. Clean all the tomatoes, and use a knife to lightly make a cross-shaped incision on the skin at the bottom of each tomato (the side opposite the fruit stem). The incision only needs to scratch the skin, and does not need to be cut too deep to prevent the pulp and juice from flowing out in advance. 2. Put the tomatoes into a heat-resistant container, pour enough boiling water to cover all the tomatoes, and soak for about 1 minute to gradually loosen the skin. 3. Use a slotted spoon to take out the tomatoes. After they have cooled slightly until they are safe to handle, peel off the skin starting from the cross cut. After peeling, drain excess hot water from the surface of the tomatoes. 4. Cut the peeled tomatoes in half lengthwise along the base and stem. Observe the white and hard fruit core near the fruit base from the cut surface. Use a knife to cut diagonally along both sides of the hard core to form a V-shaped incision. Cut off the fruit base and the nearby hard parts and discard them, trying to retain the normal pulp. 5. Cut the processed tomatoes into small pieces. The recommended size of each piece is about a quarter of a large Orion pie, but you can also cut it into smaller pieces. But the smaller the cut, the easier it is for the juice to flow out during the cutting process. Put the tomato pieces into a bowl or basin together with all the juice that came out during the cutting process, and set aside. Do not pour away the juice. 6. Cut a piece of green onion about 2 cm long into thin slices. Take half a clove of garlic, peel and cut into small pieces. 7. Check the inside of the wok to make sure there are no visible drips remaining. Turn on the heat, briefly preheat an ordinary wok, and pour 15 to 20 ml of cooking oil. When the oil is fully heated but not yet smoking, prepare to add the onions and garlic. When using non-stick pans, avoid empty cooking at high temperatures for long periods of time. 8. Put all the chopped green onions and garlic slices into the hot oil, wait for about 1 to 3 seconds, and then immediately pour in all the tomato pieces and reserved juice. The water in the tomatoes may splash when it comes into contact with the hot oil, so be careful to avoid it when pouring. 9. About 4 seconds after the tomatoes are in the pan, use a hard frying spoon to start stir-frying. During the stir-frying process, keep tapping and pressing the larger tomato chunks with a frying spoon to help the pulp gradually spread out, soften and release the juice. Avoid hitting the bottom of the pan hard, especially non-stick pans. 10. Continue to stir-fry and press the tomatoes until most of the pulp has softened significantly, larger chunks have gradually broken up, and a continuous sauce begins to appear in the pan. Adjust the heat to medium or medium-low according to the conditions in the pot. Keep the heat on medium when there is enough juice; adjust to medium-low heat when the sauce gradually thickens. There is no need to deliberately use the lowest heat. Keep the sauce in a state where it can continue to heat and simmer slowly. 11. Determine whether to replenish water based on the juice production of tomatoes. Fresh, ripe, juicy tomatoes usually do not require additional water. For tomatoes with hard texture and insufficient ripeness, if there is insufficient juice in the pot and the bottom of the pot begins to dry out, you can add 5 to 10 ml of water each time, stir-fry evenly and then observe the condition. Repeat if necessary until the pulp can continue to soften and the bottom of the pot no longer shows signs of scorching. Do not add too much water at one time, otherwise the finished product will become thinner and affect the consistency and taste. 12. After the tomatoes are basically fried and form a sauce, add 7 to 10 ml of light soy sauce and stir-fry until the sauce is evenly colored. The reference color in home cooking is #D0253E, which is a darker tomato red. However, different varieties of tomatoes and different brands of light soy sauce will affect the actual color and should be judged based on the taste. 13. Mix the light soy sauce evenly, then add salt. It is recommended to add 1 to 2 g of salt first, stir-fry evenly and then taste. If the taste is bland, gradually add to the reference total amount of 2 to 3 g. Light soy sauce itself contains salt, so using the order of cooking first and then adding salt can avoid adding light soy sauce after the salt is properly seasoned, causing the finished product to be too salty. 14. Continue to stir-fry over medium or medium heat to mix the light soy sauce and salt evenly, and continue to press the tomato pieces that have not yet completely softened. At this point, the tomatoes should basically lose their obvious hard lumps and gradually form a thick sauce with a certain fluidity. 15. When the tomatoes have softened enough and there is plenty of water in the pot without obvious separation, and the sauce can be poured over and mixed with the noodles but not as thin as soup, turn off the heat. 16. Turn off the heat and add chicken essence, the recommended dosage is about 1 g. In home cooking, use a small salt spoon that is the same as table salt and add about 70% to 90% of the capacity. Use the residual heat of the wok to continue stir-frying until the chicken essence is fully dissolved and mixed evenly. 17. Pour the tomato sauce into a bowl and use it as a topping for noodles such as knife noodles and hand-rolled noodles.

Additional content: - About the actual method: This recipe comes from a cooking method that has been used repeatedly by Shanxi families for a long time. It is not a theoretical formula without actual production. The weight of tomatoes, the quality of chicken essence and the volume of single water replenishment are reference values ​​added for the convenience of standardization, and not all have been verified by weighing. - Regarding peeling tomatoes: It is recommended to make crosses on the skin first, and then soak in boiling water for about 1 minute. Peeling can give the finished product a more delicate texture. Heat-resistant containers should be used during operation, and care should be taken to prevent burns caused by boiling water. - About removing the hard core: First cut the tomato in half lengthwise, then observe the hard part near the fruit base from the cut surface, and remove it using a V-shaped cut method, which helps reduce the waste of normal fruit pulp. - About cutting: Tomatoes can be cut smaller, but the increased cutting surface will make it easier for the juice to flow out in advance. It is recommended to cut it into pieces about a quarter of the size of Orion Pie, and then press it during the frying process to turn it into a paste. All the juice that flows out during cutting should be retained. - Regarding adding water: Ripe and juicy tomatoes usually do not require additional water. Tomatoes with hard texture and insufficient juice may need to be fried for a longer time, and the water can be replenished in stages according to the state of the pot. Each replenishment of 5 to 10 ml is a recommended amount for ease of operation and should not be understood as a fixed amount of water that must be added. Adding too much water will make the sauce thin. - About firepower: After the tomatoes gradually form a sauce, you can continue to fry them over medium or medium heat according to the amount of juice in the pot. There is no need to deliberately adjust the heat to the minimum. Avoid using high heat continuously when the water content is too low to cause scorching. - Regarding the order of seasoning: This recipe uses the order of smoking first, then adding salt, and finally turning off the heat and adding chicken essence. Since both light soy sauce and chicken essence may increase the saltiness, it is recommended to add salt in batches. - Regarding color: #D0253E is a reference color in home cooking experience. Different tomato varieties, maturity, soy sauce brands and lighting conditions will affect the final color and cannot be used as the only completion standard. - About the state of the finished product: The tomato pulp should be basically soft and rotten, and the whole should be in the shape of a thick sauce. It can be poured evenly on the noodles and mixed with the noodles, but it should not be as thin as soup. No added sugar, extra tomato paste or starch required. - About the oil temperature: According to family experience, there is a practice of waiting for the cooking oil to smoke slightly. However, in order to avoid the oil temperature being too high and frying the onions and garlic to a paste, it is recommended to add the onions and garlic when the oil has been fully heated and has not yet smoked.
Peel the ripe tomatoes by scalding them in cross-sections in advance to have a more delicate texture and make it easier to stir-fry into a thick sauce.
Saute the chopped green onions first, then add the tomatoes. Stir-fry over medium heat and keep pressing until the pulp gradually releases juice and thickens.
Add salt and a small amount of sugar according to taste before serving. If the sauce is slightly thin, stir-fry for another two minutes to add more juice when mixing with the noodles.

Case: At noon on weekends, Sister Li, a housewife from Shanxi, boiled the tomatoes, cut them into pieces, stir-fried them in a pan and squeezed out the juice, then boiled it into a thick sauce and poured it on the hand-rolled noodles.

items.title: You Spicy Pepper
items.core: A spicy and tangy Shaanxi-style seasoning, moist with red oil, intertwined with sesame and garlic, spicy but not dry in the mouth, with a long aftertaste. Chili peppers are rich in vitamin C and capsaicin, which can increase appetite, warm the body and ward off cold. The production process requires controlling the oil temperature, which is a bit challenging for novices, but you can succeed if you follow the steps. The whole process takes about 10 minutes to complete and is the finishing touch to home-style mixed vegetables and noodles.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Garlic - Dried chili powder - Salt - Cooked white sesame - Millet pepper - Peanut oil (rapeseed oil can be replaced) - Small household ceramic bowl - Household iron spoon - Five spice powder (optional) - Grasshopper (optional) - Spring onion (optional) - Star anise - Sichuan peppercorns - Bay leaves - Angelica dahurica - Ginger slices (optional) - Sugar - White vinegar

Calculation: - 1 head of garlic - 100 grams of dried chili powder - 5 grams of salt - 15 grams of cooked white sesame seeds - 1 millet pepper - 150 ml of peanut oil (can be replaced with rapeseed oil) - 10 grams of five-spice powder (optional) - 1 grasshopper (optional) - 3-5 green onions (optional) - Other ingredients: star anise (1), Sichuan peppercorns (20-50) You can use any amount, depending on personal taste), bay leaves (2-3 pieces), Angelica dahuricae (2-3 pieces), ginger slices (thumb-thick slices of ginger) (optional) - 30 grams of sugar - 5 ml of white vinegar (about the amount of a small iron spoon)

Operation: 1. Take out the garlic, break off 2 small garlic heads and peel them 2. Take out the cutting board and chop the small garlic and millet pepper 3. Take out the bowl and pour in the peanut oil. 4. Heat the oil and add other ingredients and green onions. Wait until the spices are browned. Remove and throw away. 5. Take out the iron pot and heat the oil in the bowl for 2 minutes (burn the rapeseed oil until it smokes). 6. The bowl is now empty. 7. Add dried chili noodles, white sesame seeds, minced garlic, millet pepper, salt, five-spice powder and grassroots to the empty bowl as "seasonings". 8. Turn off the heat and cool the oil temperature to 210 degrees Celsius. 9. Pour the hot oil in the pot into a bowl and stir with a spoon (you can add the same "seasoning" to the bowl at 165 degrees Celsius and mix at the end to increase the spiciness) 10. Pour in the hot oil, stir briefly and then add white vinegar. It will boil again. Continue to stir and add aroma to the white vinegar. 11. Cool the chili seeds until warm and add sugar and MSG. The sugar can soften the spiciness and make it less choking
Additional content: - Five-spice powder and strawberry are added as "seasonings" to increase the fragrance and make the chili seeds more fragrant

Choose the thickness of the chili noodles and mix them. The coarse powder adds flavor to the fine powder, and the white sesame seeds are first stirred with a small amount of hot oil to make the aroma more stable.
Control the temperature of the oil at 60 to 70% hot. Remove from the heat when you see slight smoke. Pour in the oil in two batches to prevent it from becoming burnt and bitter.
After pouring oil, add a little balsamic vinegar or light soy sauce to enhance the flavor, let it sit for ten minutes before mixing with vegetables, the spiciness will be more mellow.

Case: Before dinner, Xiao Zhao put the chili noodles, white sesame seeds and minced garlic into a bowl, let the hot oil let it smoke slightly, then poured it in twice. The aroma spread instantly, and the cucumbers and noodles were even more fragrant. His family also asked about the method.

items.title: Puffy Pastry
items.core: This is a Chinese pastry ingredient, often used in pancakes, which can make the finished product layered, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. Mainly provide carbohydrates and fats to replenish energy for the body. It’s simple, beginner-friendly and should only take 3 minutes to whip up.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Flour - Oil - Salt
Calculation: - Oil = (Number of pancakes to be pancaked * 10ml) - Salt = (Number of pancakes to be pancaked / 2) g - Flour = (Number of pancakes to be pancaked / 0.13) g
Operation: 1. Put flour in a small bowl and add salt 2. Add 200 degree hot oil 3. Use chopsticks to stir it into a smooth paste.
Additional Content
Use medium-gluten flour. Pour the hot oil in portions, stirring while pouring. It is best to spread the pastry until it becomes thick and yogurt-like.
You can add a little salt or five-spice powder to the pastry, and leave a small portion of the original flavor before seasoning to make sweet pancakes easier.
The pastry should be spread thinly and evenly, leaving a centimeter on the edge. This will make it easier to seal without oil leakage when rolling up.

Case: Before making pancakes in the morning, Aunt Sun put the flour into a small bowl, poured in hot oil and quickly stirred it into a thick paste. She spread it on the rolled out dough and rolled it up before baking. After the pancake came out of the pan, the layers were clear, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.

items.title: Fried Skewers Sauce
items.core: This all-purpose Fried Skewers Sauce is spicy, rich, salty and delicious, and is a street style. It mainly provides aromatic substances brought by fats and spices, which can increase appetite. It’s easy to make, stress-free for beginners, and only takes about 10 minutes to complete.
body: Essential raw materials and tools: - Dried chili noodles (prepared in both thickness and thickness) - Cumin powder - Pepper powder - Five spice powder - Sichuan pepper powder - Thirteen spices - Spicy fresh - White sesame seeds

Calculation: - 60 g dry chili noodles - 20 g cumin powder - 10 g pepper powder - 15 g allspice powder - 20 g salt - 15 g Sichuan pepper powder - 8 grams of chicken essence - 5 grams of Shisanxiang - 5 grams of Malaxian - 30 grams of white sesame seeds

Operation: 1. Mix all the ingredients in a container and stir evenly. 2. Heat oil in a pot. Use enough oil to cover all the raw materials in the container. 3. Pour in the hot oil in three batches, 1/3 each time, while stirring. 4. Finally add 10ml of sesame oil, 10ml of light soy sauce, 10ml of pepper oil and 10ml of oyster sauce.

Additional content: - The seasoning in the last step can be added according to your own preference. - Do not pour all the hot oil at once, it must be poured in portions and stirred. - Ingredients can be scaled down.
Add a small amount of water to make the base of the sweet noodle sauce and garlic chili sauce 2:1 to make it smoother.
Saute cumin powder and chili powder in a dry pan over low heat until fragrant, then mix into the sauce. The street flavor will be more prominent.
After the fried skewers are out of the pan, brush them first while they are still hot. Sprinkle sesame seeds and lightly brush them a second time. The taste will be more consistent and not bland.

Case: Before setting up a stall at the night market, Xiao Zhou mixed the sweet noodle sauce, garlic chili sauce and cumin powder thoroughly, and brushed the fried chicken steak and potato slices with the sauce while they were still hot. The aroma was so fragrant that the first customer tasted it and ordered two more skewers.

items.title: Simple version of fried sugar color
items.core: Sugar coloring is a key technique for coloring Chinese braised dishes. When the heat is right, it can bring a bright red luster and a unique burnt flavor. The main ingredient is sugar, which provides energy, but more importantly, it harmonizes the color and taste of dishes. This simple version of fried sugar has certain requirements on heat control. Newbies need more practice to avoid it becoming bitter or sweet. The overall preparation takes about ten minutes.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Sugar (choose one): - Rock sugar: The fried sugar has the brightest color and bright red color. It must be fried in water and oil, and it will melt very slowly without adding water. - White sugar: It must be fried in water and oil, and it will melt very slowly without adding water. ! ! The temperature of the induction cooker is not enough, and the heat is too bitter and not sweet enough

Calculation: - Oil: 100ml - Boiling water: 500ml - Sugar: 50g (about 15 pieces of single crystal rock sugar, or equal weight of white sugar. Base ratio: 50g of sugar for every 1000g of meat, 10g can be increased or decreased according to personal taste)

Operation: ⚠️ High-energy warning and pre-processing: The last step of frying sugar color (adding water/adding ingredients) is a continuous operation that must be responded to quickly. Once the sugar color reaches the critical point, a few seconds of hesitation will lead to bitterness. Requirements: Before starting the fire, 400ml of boiling water and all prepared onion, ginger, and garlic ingredients must be placed on the stove to ensure that they can be taken within 1 second. 1. Turn on the heat and pour 100ml boiling water into the pot. 2. Pour 100ml of oil into the pot. The shorter the interval from the first step, the better. At this time, the pot can be set to medium or high heat. If you are in a hurry, you can use high heat. 3. Add rock sugar (if the rock sugar is too coupled, you can crush it in advance to make the coupling as low as possible) 4. Adjust the heat to medium heat. 5. Start stirring - keep stirring until it turns brown, then turn to low heat - It will become thinner again, turn to black brown, then turn into sauce red and then form small bubbles. Be ready to perform the following operations 1 or 2 - the small bubbles will gradually disappear, and then large bubbles will appear. When the large bubbles appear, the sugar color is completed - you need to quickly proceed to the next operation at this time (no matter which operation must be prepared in advance and quickly! Otherwise, the sugar will become bitter if the heat is too high). Make a choice according to the style of the dish and personal taste - Operation 1: You can directly add 400ml boiling water to cool down - Operation 2 (Advanced seasoning version): When the sugar liquid turns maroon red and forms dense bubbles, quickly add the onion, ginger, garlic, pepper and other auxiliary ingredients prepared in advance and stir-fry. After the aroma explodes (within about 5-10 seconds), 400ml of boiling water must be poured in immediately to cool down and stop the reaction. (Note: If the subsequent recipes require stir-frying the meat for coloring, please add the meat and stir-fry at this step, and finally add water.)
Additional Content
Slowly stir-fry rock sugar or white sugar over low heat. When dense bubbles appear on the edge of the pot and the color turns amber, add the ingredients immediately.
When adding meat or adding water, work along the edge of the pot, and be careful that the steam will burn your hands. Once the color of the sugar turns black, do not continue to use it.
Novices can try frying a small amount first and record the temperature and color of the pot. It only takes a short time for the sugar liquid to change from light yellow to maroon.

Case: When making braised pork, Xiao He put rock sugar and a small amount of oil into the pot, stir-fried the meat over low heat until it turned amber, and immediately added the meat and stir-fried. The finished product was bright red in color and had a faint burnt aroma. The family thought it had been stewed for a long time.

items.title: Sweet and Sour Sauce
items.core: This sauce is sour and sweet, and is the classic flavor source of sweet and sour dishes in Chinese food. The preparation is simple, the proportions are easy to remember, and novices can easily get started. It takes about 10 minutes from preparation to completion. The sugar can provide energy, and the aroma of vinegar helps to appetize and relieve greasiness, making home-cooked dishes instantly delicious.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Clear water - White sugar - White vinegar/rice vinegar - Cooking wine - Light soy sauce
Calculation: - Clear water (50ml) - Light soy sauce (40ml) - White sugar (30g) - White vinegar (20ml) - Cooking wine (10ml)

Operation: 1. Mix each seasoning in a small bowl according to the proportion evenly 2. After processing according to different dishes, pour the prepared sweet and sour sauce into the pot. 3. Cook for 5-10 minutes depending on the dish. 4. Reduce the juice over high heat, which can increase the concentration, aroma and luster of the dish
Additional Content
Remember the order of cooking wine, light soy sauce, sugar, balsamic vinegar, and water, and adjust them in advance to avoid rushing into the pot.

After adding the sweet and sour sauce to the pot, bring it to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a low heat and reduce the consistency. When the soup is ready to hang on a spoon, coat the ingredients immediately.
If you like a more refreshing sour taste, you can add a small amount of balsamic vinegar to the pot before serving. The aroma will be more obvious and not greasy.

Case: Before making sweet and sour pork ribs for dinner, Xiao Zheng adjusted the sauce according to the ratio of one wine, two sauce, three sugar, four vinegar and five water. After frying the ribs, pour in and thicken. The sweet and sour taste evenly coated the bones and meat. After the children finished the mixed rice, they asked for the recipe.

items.title: Strawberry Jam
items.core: This is a sweet and sour home-made jam with a rich fruity aroma, perfect for spreading on bread. Strawberries are rich in vitamin C, but the sugar content is higher when boiled, so you can adjust it according to taste. The recipe is very simple and can be easily done by novices. It takes about two hours from preparation to cooking.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Strawberries - White sugar - Plastic wrap
Calculation: per serving: - 1200g strawberries - 400g sugar (if you need a low-sugar diet, you can consider reducing it to 200g)

Operation: 1. Wash the strawberries and remove the leaves. 2. Chop the strawberries into a suitable bowl. 3. Pour the white sugar into the bowl and mix with the strawberries. 4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let it sit for 1 hour. 5. Pour the mixture of resting strawberries and sugar into a non-stick pan and bring to a boil. 6. After boiling, turn down to low heat and stir until the jam is thick. Turn off the heat. 7. After the strawberry jam has cooled, put it into the prepared sealed jar.
Additional Content
Wash the strawberries, remove the stems and cut them into small pieces. Add sugar according to taste and let it sit for twenty minutes. After the juice is released, boil it more evenly.
In the early stage of cooking, use medium heat to melt the sugar, then turn to low heat and stir constantly to prevent the jam from sticking to the bottom and gradually thicken the jam.
Before filling the sauce, scald the jar with boiling water and wipe it dry. Tighten the lid while it is hot. Cool and then refrigerate and eat as soon as possible.

Case: On weekend morning, Sister Li removed the stems of two boxes of strawberries and cut them into pieces, added sugar and let them stand, then simmered them over low heat and put them into boiled glass jars. Spread it on toast for your family for breakfast. The sweet and sour fruity flavor is very popular and you can eat it within a week.

items.title: scallion oil
items.core: Scallion oil is a home-made seasoning oil that enhances fragrance and freshness. It has a strong aroma of scallions and a complex umami flavor. It is very suitable for stuffing, cold dishes or hot dishes. It mainly provides oil energy. Spices such as onion and ginger also contain plant active ingredients, which can help remove fishy smell and stimulate appetite. The method is simple and friendly to novices. It usually takes about 30 minutes to prepare and simmer.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: - Oil - Green onions (green onions and small green onions are acceptable) - Ginger - Onions - Cooking wine - Coriander (optional) - Kaiyang (optional)
Calculation: - 200g oil - 80g green onion - 20g ginger - 10ml cooking wine - 150g onion - 50g Kaiyang

Operation: 1. Soak in warm water at 50 degrees, add 10ml cooking wine to remove the fishy smell, soak for 10 minutes, take out and drain the water. 2. Wash the onion and coriander, cut into 5cm long sections, and dry the surface water. 3. Cut the onion into shreds, cook in hot water for 5 minutes in a pot, take out and drain the water. 4. Peel the ginger and cut into slices 5. Pour all the oil into the pot, add the above pre-processed ingredients, and fry on medium-low heat for 20 minutes

Additional content: - The chopped onion residue can also be eaten. The scallion oil can filter out these residues or keep them. - The scallion oil can greatly enhance the freshness of the scallion oil and add a fresh and sweet flavor.
Put the green onion and green onion leaves into the pot separately. Fry the green onion first to get fragrant, and put the green onion leaves later to avoid bitterness and black color.
Soak the Kaiyang in warm water in advance and drain it. Then fry it slowly in a pot with cold oil over low heat to release the umami flavor more easily.
Don’t let the oil temperature be too high. Turn off the heat when you see the green onions turn golden. Filter the residue and put it into a clean sealed bottle and refrigerate it.

Case: At noon on Sunday, Lao Wang cooked noodles mixed with scallion oil, put the scallions, ginger slices and boiled cold oil into the pot, fried them over low heat until the scallions were fragrant, and then filtered the residue. Stir it into noodles and vegetables, and the aroma will be obvious. Bottle the remaining oil and refrigerate it for immediate use.

items.title: garlic soy sauce
items.core: Garlic soy sauce is a home-made dipping sauce with rich garlic aroma, salty and oily flavor. It is often used to enhance the flavor of boiled chicken, dumplings and other dishes. Garlic and sesame seeds have antibacterial and unsaturated fatty acid supplement effects respectively. It’s extremely simple and beginner-friendly, and only takes about 5 minutes to complete.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: - Garlic - White sesame seeds - Peanut oil - Soy sauce - Dipping dish
Calculation: - 2 cloves of garlic - 5 grams of white sesame seeds - 15 ml of peanut oil - 30 ml of soy sauce - 1 dipping dish

Operation: 1. Crush the garlic 2. Add soy sauce to the dipping dish 3. Heat the pot, add peanut oil, wait until the oil is hot, add the chopped garlic, and fry for half a minute 4. After half a minute, turn off the heat, pour the hot oil into the dipping dish, and stir with chopsticks.
Additional Content
Chop the garlic into fine pieces and let it sit for ten minutes to fully release the garlic aroma and make the taste softer.
Saute the sesame seeds over low heat until fragrant, then stir in the soy sauce to avoid the strong smell of raw sesame seeds and increase the nutty aroma.
Pour the hot oil into the minced garlic twice, the first time to stir up the aroma, the second time to adjust the oiliness, and finally add light soy sauce.

Case: When cutting plain chicken for a family dinner, Xiaolin mixed minced garlic, cooked sesame seeds, light soy sauce and hot oil into a dipping saucer, let it sit for a few minutes and then served it. When the family dipped the chicken and dumplings, they all found the garlic aroma to be outstanding, salty and not greasy.

items.title: sucrose syrup
items.core: Homemade beverage syrup is made by mixing and dissolving white sugar and water in a ratio of 1:1, making it easy to control the sweetness of cold drinks. It is the basic formula for making drinks. Rich in carbohydrates, it can quickly replenish energy. It's super simple and beginner-friendly, takes just a few minutes to make and can be refrigerated for up to a week.
body: Necessary raw materials and tools: Raw materials - white sugar - water Tools - sealable container (it is recommended to use high borosilicate reagent bottles, which are cheap)

Calculation: Recommended ratio => Sugar: Water = 1: 1, which makes it easy to control the amount of sugar. For example, if you want 15 grams of sugar, measure 30 grams of syrup - 100 grams of water - 100 grams of white sugar
Operation: 1. Mix the weighed white sugar and drinking water in the container 2. Cover the container and place it in the refrigerator

Additional content: Water can be either hot or cold. If it is needed urgently, you can dissolve the syrup in hot water and then cool it down. The prepared syrup will not go bad easily, and it is usually no problem to store it in the refrigerator for a week.
Weigh the sugar and water one to one, heat over low heat and stir until completely dissolved. Once boiling, turn off the heat.
After the sugar water is cooled, put it into a clean sealed bottle to prevent heat from entering the refrigerator and affecting storage and taste.
Use a dry spoon to scoop out the food, mark the production date, and refrigerate it within a week for peace of mind.
Case: Add water to sugar and heat it to about 114 degrees, then slowly pour in lemon juice, stir until thick, cool and become a syrup that can be drawn, used for dessert glaze.

items.title: Liangpi
items.core: Liangpi is a home-cooked snack originating from Shaanxi. It has a chewy and smooth texture, is sour and spicy, and has a rich sesame paste aroma. Tahini and gluten provide rich plant protein and calcium, paired with crisp cucumber and mung bean sprouts, which are rich in vitamins and dietary fiber. The overall operation difficulty is medium. It only requires simple blanching, shredding and sauce making, and even beginners can complete it calmly. It takes about 40 minutes from prep to serving, making it perfect for the summer table.
body: Necessary ingredients and tools: * Liangpi, gluten * Salt, chicken essence, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sesame oil, balsamic vinegar, sesame paste (original sesame paste is best) * Cucumber, garlic, mung bean sprouts * Pots, bowls, plates, garlic mortar
Calculation: * The amount of Liangpi is 300 g/person. Round down. * The amount of sesame paste is 30 g/person, round down. * Cucumber 100g/person, mung bean sprouts 50g/person.

Operation: Preparation: 1. Add 500ml water to the pot. boiled. 2. Add mung bean sprouts to the pot and cook over high heat for 60 seconds. Remove the bean sprouts, rinse in cold water, and place in a plate for later use. 3. Cut the cucumber into shreds and put it on a plate for later use. 4. Peel 10g of garlic cloves, put them in a garlic mortar and add 1g of salt. Hammer the garlic into paste and add 10g of tap water. Set aside. 5. Note: Liangpi purchased from supermarkets usually has cooking oil on the surface and can be cleaned with tap water. Same with gluten. 6. Note: After washing the gluten, please squeeze out a lot of water from the gluten with your hands (no need to use too much force). Salt water preparation: 1. Prepare a small bowl, add 3g salt, 2g chicken essence, 5g light soy sauce, 1g dark soy sauce, 1g sesame oil, 2g oyster sauce, 5g balsamic vinegar (salt and balsamic vinegar can be added according to personal taste, the above data is for public taste only). 2. Add 25-35g of warm water (depending on personal saltiness) to the above seasonings, mix well and dissolve with chopsticks. Set aside to cool. Preparation of sesame paste: 1. Note: The following measurements are for one person. If there are n people, please multiply the measurement by n. 2. Take out a small bowl and put the prepared sesame paste into it. 3. Add 4g salt, 3g chicken essence, 5g light soy sauce, 1g dark soy sauce, and 3g oyster sauce. 4. Use chopsticks to mix the seasoning and sesame paste evenly. 5. Add 10g of water and mix well. 6. Repeat the previous step 2 or 3 times (the number of times depends on how thick the sesame paste is). Final steps: 1. Take out the small basin prepared previously and add the cold skin prepared previously. 2. Pour in the salt water and mix well using chopsticks. Then put it into a small bowl (pour the salt water into the bowl as well). 3. Place the bean sprouts on the cold skin, followed by the gluten. 4. Pour the prepared sesame paste over the gluten. 5. Sprinkle with shredded cucumber. 6. You can add chili oil if you like. 7. Home-made cold skin with delicious flavor and color is ready!
Additional content: Personal tastes vary according to region, weather, and time. The specific amount of seasonings to be used depends on personal circumstances.
Cut the cold skin into strips and mix it with a small amount of cooked oil to prevent sticking and make it smoother and chewier in the mouth.
Cut the cucumber into thin strips, blanch the bean sprouts and then cool them to maintain a crisp texture and avoid water diluting the taste.
Mix the sauce with vinegar, light soy sauce, garlic water, and chili oil first, then pour in sesame sauce and mix well before serving.

Case: For midsummer lunch, Aunt Zhang washed the gluten in advance, cut the cold skin into strips, added cucumber shreds, bean sprouts and garlic water, and finally poured sesame sauce and vinegar. Mix well and serve. The kids said it was sour, spicy, smooth and very appetizing.

items.title: Semi-finished pasta
items.core: This is a Western-style simple meal that is quickly prepared using commercially available semi-finished products. The noodles are elastic and chewy, and paired with ready-made sauces, they are rich in flavor. Mainly composed of carbohydrates, it can quickly replenish energy and contains protein. It is extremely easy to make, and even beginners can make zero mistakes. It only takes about 2 minutes from firing to loading.
body: Essential ingredients and tools: * 1 bag of semi-finished pasta (recommended brand Pumido) * 50 ml water * pan or microwave. Different types of pasta have different cooking times. Here are the standards for Italian straight noodles.

Calculation: - 2 people, 1 meal 520g (subject to semi-finished product) Use the above conditions to calculate the amount of materials according to needs (including but not limited to daily food intake, mood and exercise before meals).

Operation: Method 1 - Pan: 1. Heat the pan 2. Pour 50 ml of water into the pan 3. Add the noodles and stir-fry for 1 minute 4. Pour in the sauce and stir-fry for 1 minute 5. Plate it Method 2 - Microwave oven: 1. Put the noodles in a "microwave-safe" plate 2. Pour the accompanying sauce on the noodles 3. Pour 50 ml of water 4. 700W Heat for 2 minutes 5. Remove and mix well

Additional content: - Traditional pasta is very long. Short spaghetti became popular in the second half of the 20th century, with a typical length of 25–30 cm. - "Spaghettoni" is thicker spaghetti. "Spaghettini" thinner pasta. "Capellini" is a thinner version of pasta.
After the water boils, add the noodles and cook according to the package time until elastic and tender. Leave two ladles of noodle soup before taking it out to make the sauce easier.
Heat the sauce bag and bag with warm water or pour it into a pot, and stir quickly with the noodles to coat the sauce evenly.
Sprinkle a small amount of black pepper or cheese powder after serving to enhance the aroma, but do not add too much additional salt.

Case: After returning home from overtime, Xiao Zhou boiled a pot of water, put the semi-finished pasta and sauce packets in and heated them for two minutes, took them out and put them on a plate and sprinkled them with cheese powder. It's simple, filling and delicious, more like a meal than instant noodles.

items.title: Lazy Egg Tart
items.core: This dessert uses ready-made egg tart crust and egg tart liquid. It has a crispy outer crust, tender filling and caramel spots. It is the most accessible version of the classic Cantonese dim sum. The main ingredients, eggs and milk, provide high-quality protein and calcium, making it suitable as a family snack. The whole operation only requires assembly and baking, and is also friendly to novices with no basic knowledge. It takes about 40 minutes from preheating the oven to taking it out of the oven.
